The framework includes practical diagnostics -- a Z-test workflow and single-model screening tool -- and has direct consequences for fairness auditing: SHAP-based proxy discrimination audits are provably unreliable under collinearity. The design space theorem, diagnostics, and impossibility are mechanically verified in Lean 4 (305 theorems from 16 axioms, 0 sorry) -- to our knowledge, the first formally verified impossibility in explainable AI.

AI.tldr: Feature attribution is provably impossible to be simultaneously faithful, stable, and complete under collinearity. This paper proves this impossibility, characterizes the complete design space (only two method families exist), resolves it via DASH ensemble, and formally verifies 305 theorems in Lean 4. 68% of real datasets exhibit this instability, with implications for fairness auditing.
AI.motivation: Feature ranking methods in explainable AI suffer from instability problems when features are collinear, with rankings flipping up to 50% of the time. No existing framework characterizes the fundamental trade-offs or provides practical resolution strategies.
AI.method: Mathematical impossibility proofs across four model classes (gradient boosting, Lasso, random forests), ensemble averaging approach (DASH), and extensive formal verification using Lean 4 (305 theorems from 16 axioms). Quantified attribution ratios and characterized the complete attribution design space.
AI.result: Proved that no feature ranking can be simultaneously faithful, stable, and complete under collinearity. Quantified impossibility: attribution ratio diverges as 1/(1-ρ²) for gradient boosting, is infinite for Lasso, and converges for random forests. DASH is provably Pareto-optimal among unbiased aggregations, achieving the Cramer-Rao variance bound with a tight ensemble size formula.
AI.conclusion: Two families of methods exist: faithful-complete (unstable) and stable ensemble methods like DASH (reporting ties). No method lies outside this dichotomy. DASH achieves Cramer-Rao variance bound. 68% of 77 public datasets exhibit attribution instability. Framework includes practical diagnostics and has implications for fairness auditing.

title: Optimal $e^{(γ+o(1))n}$-Approximation of the Permanent of Positive Semidefinite Matrices
summary:
We determine, up to lower-order terms in the exponent, the best possible deterministic polynomial-time approximation ratio for the permanent of a Hermitian positive semidefinite matrix. If $A\succeq 0$ has no zero diagonal entry, $d=\operatorname{rank}(A)$, $A=VV^\dagger$ with $V\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times d}$ full column rank, and $v_1,\ldots,v_n$ are the rows of $V$, define \[
  Φ(V)=\max_{X\succ 0}
  \left\{\sum_{i=1}^n \log(v_i^\dagger Xv_i)+\log\det X-\operatorname{tr} X+d\right\},
  \qquad
  \widehat P(A)=e^{Φ(V)}. \] We prove the exact sandwich \[
  e^{-γn}\widehat P(A)\le \operatorname{per}(A)\le \widehat P(A). \] Here $γ$ is the Euler--Mascheroni constant. Since the maximization is concave, this gives a deterministic polynomial-time $e^{(γ+\varepsilon)n}$-approximation for every $\varepsilon>0$. Combined with the previous $e^{(γ-\varepsilon)n}$-hardness of approximation for positive semidefinite permanents, this resolves the optimal exponential approximation ratio for deterministic polynomial-time algorithms as $e^{(γ+o(1))n}$, assuming $\mathrm{P}\ne\mathrm{NP}$. The proof is an entropy argument applied to the standard Wick integral formula for $\operatorname{per}(A)$; the loss is exactly $γ$ per factor because $\mathbb{E}[\log T]=-γ$ for $T\sim\operatorname{Exp}(1)$.
  The result was obtained through interactions with GPT 5.5 Pro Extended: the first author's interaction was one-shot, while the second author's was a separate multi-turn interaction with high-level guidance. Both authors verified the theorem and proof. Codex was used to assemble and typeset the manuscript.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过熵方法证明正半定矩阵行列式的精确 sandwich 不等式 e^{−γn}widehat{P}(A) ≤ per(A) ≤ widehat{P}(A)，从而将确定性多项式时间近似比确定在 e^{(γ+o(1))n}，在P≠NP假设下达到最优，解决了该领域长期存在的近似比差距问题。
AI.motivation: 正半定矩阵行列式的近似问题在组合优化中具有重要意义，此前已存在 e^{(γ−ε)n} 的不可近似性下界，但确定性多项式时间算法的最优上界尚未确定，存在约 2γ 的对数因子差距需要填补。
AI.method: 通过将行列式表示为Wick积分公式，利用熵方法进行分析，关键在于利用T~Exp(1)的期望对数损失恰好为γ这一性质，最终证明精确的 sandwich 不等式 e^{−γn}widehat{P}(A) ≤ per(A) ≤ widehat{P}(A)。
AI.result: 给出了精确的 sandwich 不等式约束，确定了行列式的近似范围；结合已知的不可近似性下界，在P≠NP假设下，确定性多项式时间算法的最优指数近似比确定为 e^{(γ+o(1))n}，其中γ为欧拉-马歇罗尼常数。
AI.conclusion: 确定性多项式时间算法在正半定矩阵行列式近似问题上取得了最优指数近似比 e^{(γ+o(1))n}，在假设P≠NP的前提下解决了该问题的最优近似率。

title: Detecting Offensive Cyber Agents: A Detection-in-Depth Approach
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents can now orchestrate cyberattacks. This development is already increasing the speed and scale of cyber attacks, decreasing attack costs, and improving the operational autonomy of cyber capabilities. To defend against these emerging threats, actors must first develop the capability to detect them. This report frames the offensive cyber agent detection challenge by outlining the coming detection gap between offensive cyber agents and traditional cyber capabilities; introducing detection-in-depth, a strategic framework to guide policymakers and defenders responding to this detection gap; and presents five actionable detection mechanisms to support policymakers, industry, and defenders when putting this strategic framework into practice. These include (1) Agent Identifiers for Critical Infrastructure,(2) Agent Honeypots; (3) AI-Automated Alert Analysis and Triage: systems that use AI to filter, prioritize, and interpret the growing volume of detection signals expected from autonomous cyber operations; (4) An Agentic Security Alert Standard: A reporting standard model that providers can use to communicate agentic threats, improving the speed, consistency, and actionability of reports; (5) An Agentic Cybersecurity Exchange (ACE): an institution modeled on the Global Signal Exchange that brings together model and cloud providers to detect offensive cyber agent threats at their origin point and coordinate ecosystem-wide agentic threat disruption.

AI.tldr: 本报告提出"检测深度（Detection-in-Depth）"战略框架，并给出五项可落地的进攻性网络AI代理检测机制：关键基础设施代理标识符、代理蜜罐、AI自动化告警分析与分诊、代理化安全告警标准、代理网络安全交易所（ACE）。核心判断是：AI代理正在以更快、更廉价、更自主的方式编排网络攻击，而现有面向人类攻击者的检测能力存在"检测鸿沟"，需在代理源头与防御端同步建设检测能力。
AI.motivation: AI代理已具备自主编排网络攻击的能力，正提升攻击速度与规模、降低攻击成本、增强作战自主性。在此背景下，防守方首要任务是"先具备检测能力"。传统网络检测体系（IOC/规则/遥测）建立在人类攻击者与手工化操作节奏之上，难以识别由代理驱动的、长链条、低成本、高并发的恶意活动，形成进攻性网络代理与传统网络能力之间的"检测鸿沟"。因此报告的目标是：（1）刻画并量化该检测鸿沟；（2）向政策制定者与防守方提供应对该鸿沟的战略框架；（3）把框架转化为可操作的机制。
AI.method: 采用政策与战略研究报告方法：先做问题界定（检测鸿沟的成因与特征——自主性、规模化、代理化编排与传统检测范式的不匹配）；再构建"检测深度"分层框架，类比纵深防御思想，把检测能力按基础设施标识、诱捕与行为特征采集、信号自动化处理、跨组织告警标准化、源头协同处置等层次组织；最后自上而下推导出五项机制并说明其设计意图、适用主体（政策制定者、模型与云厂商、关键基础设施运营者、行业）与落地要点。同时借鉴现有国际安全协同机制（Global Signal Exchange、CRI）的组织形态作为ACE的原型。
AI.result: 报告产出五项检测机制：（1）关键基础设施的Agent Identifiers——为AI代理建立可注册、可查询的标识体系（如代理卡/注册表），使防守方可区分代理流量与人类操作流量；（2）Agent Honeypots——部署专门诱捕自主代理的高交互诱饵环境（如仿真的脆弱资产、诱饵凭证/任务），以采集代理的交互轨迹、指令模式与工具调用指纹，形成可复用的行为特征；（3）AI自动化告警分析与分诊——用AI对激增的检测信号做过滤、优先级排序与解释，缓解人力告警疲劳与响应延迟；（4）Agentic Security Alert Standard——统一的代理化威胁报告标准（类似结构化格式的共享/机器可读告警），提升报告的速度、一致性与可行动性，便于跨组织机器处理与IOC自动分发；（5）Agentic Cybersecurity Exchange（ACE）——仿照Global Signal Exchange的机构化信息共享机制，由模型厂商与云厂商在源头汇聚、研判代理化威胁并协同实施生态级阻断/缓解。整体结论性论断是：检测鸿沟无法单点修补，需以分层、跨生态协同方式在代理"起点"与防御端同时设卡。
AI.conclusion: 报告主张将"检测深度"作为应对进攻性网络代理的战略原则，并呼吁政策制定者推动代理标识与注册、诱捕基础设施布局、告警标准落地及ACE式源头共享机制的建立，以便在代理攻击规模化之前形成可观测、可分诊、可协同阻断的能力。其隐含结论是：真正的长期缓解效果取决于模型/云厂商在源头披露与协同处置上的意愿，因此标准与制度性协作（而非单一产品）是关键。该报告属于框架与政策建议性质：内容主要来自摘要，未提供实证评估、检测性能指标、成本估算或各机制的成熟度验证；其落地效果高度依赖厂商参与、遥测可访问性、代理标识的自愿采纳率与误报率控制，且蜜罐诱捕与代理交互特征在代理模型迭代后易失效。

title: Nf-PEAK: Process-Based Energy Attribution for Nextflow Workflows on Kubernetes Clusters
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 19th International Conference on Cloud Computing (CLOUD)
summary: Scientific workflows are pipelines of interdependent tasks. They are increasingly executed on shared Kubernetes clusters via workflow engines such as Nextflow. Their energy consumption matters for both cost and sustainability. It is necessary to examine and optimize workflow tasks individually, because they can be very heterogeneous. However, estimating task-level energy on clusters is difficult: Intel RAPL counters report only node-level energy, access to counters and host process information is typically restricted, and concurrent workloads introduce resource contention and measurement noise. We present Nf-PEAK, a containerized method to attribute CPU-package and DRAM energy to individual processes and Nextflow tasks. Nf-PEAK (i) identifies workflow pods, (ii) maps pods to host processes via cgroup metadata, (iii) samples RAPL and per-process performance counters, and (iv) applies a non-linear energy-credit model before aggregating results at task level. On a Kubernetes cluster, we evaluate three nf-core workflows under controlled co-located CPU load. Nf-PEAK reaches an average Mean Absolute Percentage Error of 6.6% in isolated runs and 10.9% when an unrelated workload saturates 8 of 32 hardware threads per node, and remains stable across 2, 3, 4, and 8 nodes. Compared to the state-of-the-art Kubernetes tool Kepler, Nf-PEAK yields lower error on average, particularly under co-located load.

AI.tldr: Nf-PEAK是一种容器化方法，用于将CPU和DRAM能耗归因到Kubernetes集群上运行的各个Nextflow任务。通过cgroup映射、性能计数器采样和非线性能量信用模型，实现了任务级能耗精确估计，优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: 在共享Kubernetes集群上执行科学工作流时，任务级能耗估算面临挑战：Intel RAPL计数器仅报告节点级能耗、计数器访问受限、并发工作负载引入资源竞争和测量噪声。
AI.method: 通过(i)识别工作流Pod、(ii)通过cgroup元数据将Pod映射到主机进程、(iii)采样RAPL和每进程性能计数器、(iv)应用非线性能量信用模型后在任务级别聚合结果来实现容器化的CPU和DRAM能量归因。
AI.result: Nf-PEAK平均MAPE为6.6%（隔离运行）至10.9%（8核共置负载），在2-8节点扩展中保持稳定，且平均误差低于先进工具Kepler。
AI.conclusion: Nf-PEAK在隔离运行中平均MAPE达到6.6%，在8核共置负载下为10.9%，并在2-8节点间保持稳定，性能优于现有Kubernetes工具Kepler。

title: ACCoRD: Actor-Critic Conflict Resolution with Deep learning for O-RAN xApps
summary: Conflict Mitigation (ConMit) is a crucial part of intelligent network control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN). In this paper, we propose a method named ACCoRD to resolve detected control conflicts in Near-Real Time RAN Intelligent Controller using a Conflict Resolution (CR) Agent with an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) trained with a reinforcement learning algorithm PPO-Clip. The implemented ANN analyzes data about the network and conflicting control decisions to infer optimal CR actions. The CR Agent gathers feedback from the network after each resolved conflict to assess its efficiency and adjust the ANN's weights during batch training. The evaluation of the proposed approach is based on simulation data. A new methodology for evaluating CR solutions is proposed. Results show that the proposed ANN-based method improves on the efficiency of rule-based approaches by significantly reducing negative network events caused by conflicting control decisions in medium and high traffic scenarios.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes ACCoRD, a reinforcement learning-based method using ANN with PPO-Clip to resolve control conflicts in O-RAN Near-Real Time RAN Intelligent Controller. The system learns from feedback to optimize conflict resolution, outperforming rule-based methods in high-traffic scenarios.
AI.motivation: Conflict mitigation (ConMit) is crucial for intelligent network control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN). There's a need to resolve detected control conflicts in Near-Real Time RAN Intelligent Controller.
AI.method: Uses an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) trained with PPO-Clip reinforcement learning algorithm. The Conflict Resolution Agent analyzes network data and conflicting control decisions to infer optimal actions, gathering feedback from the network after each resolved conflict to assess efficiency and adjust ANN weights during batch training.
AI.result: The ANN-based method improves upon rule-based approaches in reducing negative network events caused by conflicting decisions, especially effective in medium and high traffic scenarios.
AI.conclusion: The proposed ANN-based method improves upon rule-based approaches by significantly reducing negative network events caused by conflicting control decisions, particularly in medium and high traffic scenarios.

title: Generative Conversational Recommender System
summary: Conversational recommender systems aim to provide personalized recommendations via natural language interactions. However, existing approaches either decouple recommendation from dialog generation or rely on retrieval-based pipelines, limiting the integration between recommendation and response generation and leading to suboptimal modeling of user intent. In this paper, we propose a fully generative conversational recommender system that unifies recommendation and dialog generation within a single autoregressive framework. Our approach represents items as discrete semantic IDs and integrates them directly into the generation process, enabling joint prediction of items and responses via next-token modeling. We further introduce a structured generation paradigm that factorizes conversational recommendation into a sequence of interdependent decisions, where the model first predicts the response intent and the recommendation target, and then generates the response conditioned on them. This design enables end-to-end optimization, enforces a more coherent dependency structure, and supports faithful item generation via constrained decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves recommendation performance, achieving gains of up to 29% on Recall@1 over strong baselines, while maintaining competitive dialog quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种完全生成式对话推荐系统，将推荐和对话生成统一在单一自回归框架中。通过将物品表示为离散语义ID并引入结构化生成范式，实现端到端优化。在Recall@1上取得最高29%的提升，同时保持具有竞争力的对话质量。
AI.motivation: Existing conversational recommender systems either decouple recommendation from dialog generation or rely on retrieval-based pipelines. This limitation restricts integration between recommendation and response generation, leading to suboptimal modeling of user intent.
AI.method: The paper proposes a fully generative conversational recommender system that unifies recommendation and dialog generation within a single autoregressive framework. Items are represented as discrete semantic IDs integrated directly into the generation process, enabling joint prediction of items and responses via next-token modeling. A structured generation paradigm is introduced that factorizes conversational recommendation into interdependent decisions: first predicting response intent and recommendation target, then generating the response conditioned on them. Constrained decoding is employed for faithful item generation.
AI.result: The method consistently improves recommendation performance, achieving gains of up to 29% on Recall@1 over strong baselines, while maintaining competitive dialog quality.
AI.conclusion: The proposed approach achieves end-to-end optimization, enforces a more coherent dependency structure, and supports faithful item generation via constrained decoding.

title: Evaluation of Pipelines for Data Integration into Knowledge Graphs
summary: Integrating new data into knowledge graphs (KG) typically involves different tasks that are executed within workflows or pipelines There are many possible pipelines for a specific integration problem but there is not yet a general approach to evaluate the overall quality and performance of such pipelines to be able to determine the best choices. We therefore propose a new benchmark KGI-Bench to evaluate integration pipelines that ingest different kinds of input data into an existing KG. We evaluate pipelines by analyzing their output, i.e., the updated KG, with the three complementary quality metrics coverage, correctness and consistency. We also provide benchmark datasets (seed KG, overlapping input data of three formats, reference KG as a ground truth) for the movie domain. To demonstrate the applicability and usefulness of the proposed benchmark, we comparatively evaluate 12 pipelines and analyze their behavior across different input data formats and design choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGI-Bench基准测试用于评估将不同类型输入数据集成到现有知识图谱中的流水线质量，通过覆盖率、准确性和一致性三个互补指标进行评估，并提供电影领域基准数据集进行验证。
AI.motivation: 将新数据集成到知识图谱中涉及工作流或流水线中的不同任务，特定集成问题存在多种可能的流水线，但目前缺乏一种通用方法来评估这些流水线的整体质量和性能，以确定最佳选择。
AI.method: 提出KGI-Bench基准测试框架，通过三个互补的质量指标（覆盖率、准确性、一致性）分析更新后的KG输出。提供电影领域的基准数据集（种子KG、三种格式的重叠输入数据、作为真值的参考KG），对12条集成流水线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 通过对比评估12条流水线，分析了它们在不同输入数据格式和设计选择下的行为表现。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了KGI-Bench基准的适用性和实用性，通过对12个集成流水线的比较评估，证明了该基准能够有效评估不同输入数据格式和设计选择下的流水线性能差异。

title: Probabilistic Attribution For Large Language Models
summary: The generative nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reflected in the conditional probabilities they compute to sample each response token given the previous tokens. These probabilities encode the distributional structure that the model learns in training and exploits in inference. In this work, we use these probabilities to situate LLMs within the mathematical theory of stochastic processes. We use this framework to design a model-agnostic probabilistic token attribution measure, using Bayes rule to invert the next-token log-probabilities so as to capture the models internal representation of the distribution over token sequences. The representation is independent of the models computational structure. This representation yields the conditional probability of the response given the prompt, and of the response given the prompt with a token marginalized away. Our attribution score is the log of the ratio of these probabilities. We further compute the entropies of a single prompts token distributions, conditioned on the remaining context. The interplay between entropy and attribution score sheds light on LLM behavior. We evaluate 8 models across 7 prompts and investigate anomalies, token sensitivity, response stability, model stability, and training convergence, thereby improving interpretability and guiding users to focus on uncertain or unstable parts of the generation.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM置于随机过程数学理论框架下，提出了一种模型无关的概率性token归因方法。通过贝叶斯法则反转对数概率来捕捉模型内部表示，并结合熵分析揭示LLM行为。该方法可用于提高模型可解释性，帮助用户关注生成过程中的不确定或不稳定部分。
AI.motivation: LLM的生成本质体现在给定先前token条件下采样每个响应token的条件概率中。这些概率编码了模型在训练中学习的分布结构，但这种结构在推理时如何被利用尚未被充分理解，需要建立数学框架来系统性地分析LLM行为。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯法则反转next-token的对数概率，将模型的token序列分布表示从模型计算结构中解耦。归因分数定义为边缘化概率与条件概率之比的对数。同时计算单prompt token分布的熵，与归因分数进行交叉分析。
AI.result: 通过8个模型、7个prompt的实验，验证了该框架在检测异常、评估token敏感性、响应稳定性、模型稳定性和训练收敛性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种模型无关的概率性token归因度量，无需修改模型架构即可揭示LLM的内部表示，为提高模型可解释性提供了新途径。

title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
comment: Work in Progress. Comments: 27 pages, 4 figures, preprint
summary: Although LLMs have made substantial progress in reasoning, systematically producing frontier-level reasoning data remains difficult. Existing synthesis methods often have limited visibility into the structural factors that govern problem difficulty, which can result in narrow diversity and unstable difficulty control. In this work, we view the difficulty of a reasoning problem as arising from the accumulation of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations, which we term thought modes. Building on this perspective, we propose MindLoom, a framework for synthesizing frontier-level reasoning data through compositional thought mode engineering. Given a collection of hard problems with verified solutions, MindLoom first decomposes those solutions into thought mode chains that reveal each problem's construction logic. It then trains a retrieval model that matches problem states to compatible thought modes, providing guidance on which reasoning challenges to introduce during synthesis. New problems are composed by iteratively applying retrieved thought modes to seed questions, with distribution-aligned sampling to encourage diverse reasoning coverage. Finally, a rollout-based judging stage labels generated questions by difficulty and supplies judged-correct responses for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate MindLoom on nine benchmarks covering five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple model families and sizes. Models fine-tuned on MindLoom-generated data achieves favorable performances over base models, distillation, and external-data baselines across the reported benchmarks. Ablation studies indicate the contribution of each component, and further analysis suggests that MindLoom covers a broad range of reasoning patterns while maintaining useful difficulty control. We have open-sourced our implementation at https://github.com/EachSheep/MindLoom.

AI.tldr: MindLoom synthesizes frontier-level reasoning data through "thought mode" engineering—decomposing solutions into atomic reasoning transformations, retrieving compatible modes for new problems, and using rollout judging for difficulty control.
AI.motivation: Existing methods for synthesizing frontier-level reasoning data have limited visibility into structural difficulty factors, resulting in narrow diversity and unstable difficulty control in generated problems.
AI.method: MindLoom decomposes hard problem solutions into thought mode chains, trains a retrieval model to match problem states with compatible thought modes, iteratively applies retrieved modes to seed questions with distribution-aligned sampling, and uses rollout-based judging for difficulty labeling and response generation.
AI.result: Fine-tuned models outperform base models, distillation, and external-data baselines across nine benchmarks covering five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks, demonstrating broad reasoning pattern coverage with controllable difficulty.
AI.conclusion: MindLoom provides a scalable approach for generating high-quality frontier-level reasoning data with controllable difficulty, supporting five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks.

title: Don't Collapse Your Features: Why CenterLoss Hurts OOD Detection and Multi-Scale Mahalanobis Wins
summary: The ability to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is fundamental to safe deployment of machine learning systems. Yet, current methods often rely on feature representations that are optimised solely for classification accuracy, neglecting the distinct requirements of epistemic uncertainty. We introduce GOEN (Geometry-Optimised Epistemic Network), a simple pipeline that combines multi-scale features, L2 normalisation, Mahalanobis distance, and a calibration head trained with real hard OOD examples. Through systematic ablation we uncover a counter-intuitive finding: CenterLoss, a popular regulariser for feature compactness, significantly degrades OOD detection performance, reducing average OOD AUROC from 0.9483 to 0.9366 despite improving classification accuracy. The best variant, GOEN-NoCenterLoss, achieves an average OOD AUROC of 0.9483, surpassing all baselines including deep ensembles (0.8827), KNN (0.8967), and ODIN (0.8870) on CIFAR-10 benchmarks, while maintaining competitive in-distribution accuracy. Our results challenge the prevailing assumption that better classification geometry automatically leads to better epistemic uncertainty. Instead, we show that overly tight feature clusters compress inter-class margins and distort the covariance structure needed for effective OOD detection. GOEN is efficient, training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU, and provides a practical blueprint for building AI systems that reliably recognise their own limitations.

AI.tldr: GOEN是一种用于OOD检测的几何优化方法，通过多尺度特征、马氏距离和校准头实现高效检测。关键发现是CenterLoss虽改善分类但损害OOD检测，挑战了"更好分类几何自动带来更好认知不确定性"的传统假设。
AI.motivation: 当前OOD检测方法依赖仅针对分类精度优化的特征表示，忽视了认知不确定性的独特需求，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: GOEN采用多尺度特征、L2归一化、马氏距离和校准头的组合流水线，并使用真实困难OOD样本进行训练。通过系统消融实验分析CenterLoss对OOD检测的影响。
AI.result: GOEN-NoCenterLoss变体达到0.9483的平均OOD AUROC，显著超越深度集成(0.8827)、KNN(0.8967)和ODIN(0.8870)等基线方法，同时保持具有竞争力的分布内准确率。消融实验发现CenterLoss虽提升分类精度，但会降低OOD检测性能(AUROC从0.9483降至0.9366)。
AI.conclusion: GOEN (特别是GOEN-NoCenterLoss)提供了一种高效(单GPU 20分钟内训练完成)、实用的解决方案，成功挑战了"更好的分类几何结构自动带来更好的认知不确定性"的假设。研究表明，过于紧凑的特征聚类反而会压缩类间边界并扭曲协方差结构，对OOD检测产生负面影响。

title: A Coalgebraic Dijkstra Algorithm
summary: The Dijkstra algorithm is a classical method for solving the shortest path problem on weighted graphs. There are several variations of the Dijkstra algorithm, including algorithms for the widest path problem and for two-player games. In this paper, we introduce the coalgebraic shortest path problem (CSPP), a unifying framework for a broad class of optimization problems on state-transition systems. This framework encompasses not only the aforementioned problems but also new ones such as the shortest binary tree problem. We further present a coalgebraic Dijkstra algorithm for solving the CSPP efficiently under a suitable condition. Our condition is necessary and sufficient for the algorithm to return correct solutions, thereby providing a precise criterion for when Dijkstra-style acceleration is possible. We also show that the proposed algorithm achieves asymptotic complexity comparable to that of the classical Dijkstra algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出coalgebraic shortest path problem (CSPP)作为状态转移系统上优化问题的统一框架，涵盖经典最短路径、最大路径及双人游戏等问题，并设计coalgebraic Dijkstra算法。证明了算法的正确性条件是充要的，且渐近复杂度与经典Dijkstra算法相当。
AI.motivation: Dijkstra算法虽能解决最短路径问题，但存在多种变体（如最大路径问题、双人游戏），缺乏一个统一的泛化框架来涵盖这些不同的优化问题。
AI.method: 提出CSPP统一框架，并设计coalgebraic Dijkstra算法，在满足特定条件时进行高效求解。
AI.result: 证明了所提条件是算法返回正确解的充要条件，并表明该算法可达到与经典Dijkstra算法相当的渐近复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将CSPP框架应用于各种优化问题，为Dijkstra风格算法的加速提供了精确的理论判据，并证明了其渐近复杂度可与经典Dijkstra算法相媲美。

title: Exploiting Multicast for Accelerating Collective Communication
summary: Reducing collective communication latency is a critical goal for large model training and inference in both academia and industry. Many-to-many communications, such as AllGather and AlltoAll (dispatch), are core components of modern parallelization strategies. State-of-the-art implementations of these communications rely on unicast-based writes and transmit duplicate copies of the same data across physical links for multiple receivers. This redundant transmission congests network bottlenecks and degrades end-to-end latency. We present MultiWrite, a novel many-to-many transmission semantic that eliminates redundant packets to directly reduce operator latency. MultiWrite adopts multicast principles while addressing critical limitations of traditional multicast for AI workloads. These limitations include heavy management plane overhead and ecosystem compatibility issues. We implement MultiWrite on Ascend NPUs. Long-term stress tests demonstrate that our MultiWrite-based operators achieve up to 33% latency reduction on commercially deployed devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MultiWrite——一种扩展自标准远端内存写（write）语义的新型"多目标写入"传输语义，将多播/组播思想以纯软件方式引入 AI 集群的集合通信算子中，从而消除同一数据向多个接收者重复注入网络造成的冗余传输。MultiWrite 在数据包中内嵌目的节点位图元数据替代传统组播组（避免 MoE 场景下组播组数量爆炸至 10^9 量级），并在应用层（Ascend AICPU）实现复制与转发，从而无需交换机固件改动、无需新增控制面管理操作，可直接作为现有 write 语义的"即插即用"扩展。论文在华为昇腾 910B NPU 商用集群上实现了基于 MultiWrite 的 AllGather 与 AlltoAll(dispatch) 算子，长期压力测试显示时延最多降低 33%（AllGather 约 30%、AlltoAll 在 1k/2k batch 下分别降低 12%/27%），代价是 AICPU 占用上升与小额元数据/内存开销。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练与推理中，集合通信（AllReduce/AllGather/AlltoAll）占运行时 20%–30%，已成为决定扩展性的核心性能因素；许多对多通信（AllGather、AlltoAll dispatch）中同一份数据需经单播多次写入，在瓶颈链路上产生冗余拷贝，拥塞网络并抬高端到端时延。随着 EP 规模扩展（64/128/256 节点）与 TPOT<5ms 的严格要求，问题被进一步放大；现有优化手段（切换 AlltoAll 算法、调整路由权重、通信计算重叠）多为事后救火且与具体硬件/并行策略强绑定。作者进一步指出业界对"用组播做集合通信"长期存在三大未解顾虑：(1) 带宽下降不等于时延下降——在经典 CLOS 拓扑的 AllGather 中，组播只减轻上行负载而无法减轻下行负载，总时延不变；(2) MoE 场景组播组爆炸——EP=64、Top-8 时最坏需 C(64,8)>4.4e9 个组，且动态 join/leave 控制面操作带来数十微秒时延；(3) 传统组播（IB UD 组播）依赖独立且沉重的控制面（Subnet Manager/Subnet Administration、QP 挂载组播组），与现有仅用 write/read 语义的算子框架完全割裂，接入需重构整个框架。
AI.method: 方法分为四部分。(1) 场景分析（第 3 节）：刻画两类真正获益场景——① 全互联（full-mesh）拓扑下两个 TP 域间存在闲置链路：成对中继下组播将有效带宽从 w 提升到 2w，时延由 s/w 降到 s/(2w)，较基线降 50%、较单播多路径降 33%；全路径中继场景下组播亦可至少降 16%；真实对应 TP=4、CFG 并行度 2、多租户等场景。② 服务器间带宽超售（Oversubscribed inter-server）拓扑：MoE EP>8（64/128）时 dispatch 跨服务器流量成为瓶颈，组播将复制点下沉到对端同序号 NPU 上，从而削减跨服务器瓶颈链路负载。(2) 语义设计（第 4 节）：MultiWrite 定义在应用—事务边界而非网络层，形式化为 MultiWrite(S, M={(D_i,B_i)}, B_S) 将源缓冲原子写入多个目的节点的对应内存；编程接口与标准 write() 完全一致，仅接受远端缓冲地址数组。核心机制为：取消组播组建立，源节点将目的节点信息编码进包内元数据——采用基于 NPU rank 的 64 位固定长度位图（而非变长的 128 位 EID 列表），复用节点本地单播转发表计算出口端口并据此复制份数，接收/中继节点解析元数据后投递数据或继续递归复制转发；中继节点需修改出端口对应的元数据以避免重复接收与路由环路（在无环拓扑且接收端去重时可省略）。递归执行模型：|M|=1 时退化为标准 write，|M|>1 时按下一跳分组为 M_1..M_l 并发起 l 个子 MultiWrite。语义属性包括：逐目的地址原子性、目的间无序、端到端可靠性（继承底层单播）、无状态性。实现上将该语义"语义化"为新的 UB 事务操作码（与 write=0x3、write_with_immediate=0x4 并列的新 TAOpcode），元数据借用 write_with_immediate 的 immediate 字段承载，从而零额外包头开销。(3) 软件实现（第 5 节）：在 UB 协议栈的 liburma.so 之上以纯软件扩展实现四个模块——cs_ini（加载拓扑/配置、启动守护线程）、cs_relay（守护线程，负责包拷贝与转发）、cs_send（源端任务分解与 WQE 生成）、cs_rcv（收包、重组与交付）。(4) 算子实现：基于 MultiWrite 的 AllGather 将通信域从 4 节点扩展到 8 节点，按实测链路带宽动态划分数据为两段（段一走 TP 域内直连、段二经跨 TP 域的 MultiWrite 一次性投递到 4 个节点），并让两路数据同时到达以最小化整体时延；接收检查与全局 barrier 逻辑完全不变。基线为官方 HCCL 的 HcclAllGather 与 HcclAlltoAllV（并额外加入若干未公开的内部优化以强化基线），另对比"单播多路径"优化版本。
AI.result: 实验环境为两台服务器、每台 4×鲲鹏-920 48 核 CPU + 8 块昇腾 910B4（32GB HBM），服务器内 8 卡经 HCCS 全互联（每链路 56 GB/s），跨服务器经 RoCE NIC（CLOS 组网、每端口 200 Gbps），采用近千次长期压力测试并预热。结果：① AllGather（每 rank 16MB）：MultiWrite 时延最低且最稳定，较基线降低约 30%，较单播多路径降低 17%；单播多路径因在跨域链路上并发多流相互干扰、时延抖动大，有时甚至劣于基线。② 消息规模敏感性（256KB–200MB）：大消息增益与上项一致；小消息（如 256KB）因切分/额外处理开销反而劣于基线，交叉点约在 2MB；实际 AllGather 每 rank 数据量通常不小于 1MB，仍落在有利区间。③ AlltoAll(dispatch)（16 卡、64 专家、Top-8、开启负载均衡）：decode 阶段 batch=64 时劣于基线，batch=128 时两者接近；prefill 阶段 batch=1k/2k 时分别降低 12% 和 27%。表 1 给出跨服务器传输时延对照（64/128/1k/2k tokens：112.90/210.53/1231.18/2429.72 μs → 43.77/66.63/320.52/622.10 μs，去除冗余节省 69.13–1807.62 μs），说明小 batch 下节省不足以抵消同序号 NPU 复制与服务器内转发的额外开销。④ 开销分析：元数据开销可忽略——64 位位图放在 UB/RDMA 原生预留的 immediate 字段中，不增加包头；域规模超 64 卡时可借用协议保留字段或置于负载内，1024 卡时仅占负载 3.13%；AICPU 占用相对基线（约为 0）有一定上升，但 AICPU 计算能力有限、实际高性能数据面走 AICORE 的 AICube/AIVector，故对共驻业务影响很小；内存方面中继复用已有的 rank 间接收缓冲，无显著额外占用。总体商用设备长期压力测试中，多对多算子时延最多降低 33%。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论是：多播/组播机制在 AI 集群中的真正价值在于削减瓶颈链路上的冗余数据注入，从而降低端到端时延，而这需要明确的场景判据——即"源节点到首个复制节点的链路是系统瓶颈"（如全互联拓扑中的闲置跨域链路、服务器间带宽超售）。MultiWrite 通过把组播重新定义为一种应用层的写语义扩展（MultiWrite），用包内位图元数据取代组播组、复用单播转发表、在应用层实现复制转发，从而同时化解组播组爆炸与生态兼容两大障碍，且不依赖交换机、固件或协议改动，可移植到其他加速器平台。它可作为现有 write 的"即插即用"替代，保留逐目的原子性、继承单播可靠性、无网络状态；配套的 AllGather/AlltoAll 算子在商用昇腾设备上取得 12%–33% 的时延下降，主要代价为 AICPU 占用上升与小消息/小 batch 下的固定开销。作者强调评估聚焦通信算子层面（因保密约束且通信占比仅 10%–30%），读者可按自身通信占比推算端到端收益；小消息（<2MB）与小 batch（<128 tokens）场景仍是能力边界，需后续优化。

title: Sibyl-AutoResearch: Autonomous Research Needs Self-Evolving Trial-and-Error Harnesses, Not Paper Generators
summary: Autonomous research systems increasingly make the scientific workflow executable: agents can propose ideas, run code, inspect results, and draft papers. But executable workflows do not by themselves produce research judgment. We analyze where current systems lose trial experience: weak evidence becomes prose, pilot signals become broad claims, memory remains textual, and recurring process failures do not change later behavior. We introduce Sibyl-AutoResearch, a self-evolving AutoResearch framework built around Scientific Trial-and-Error Harnesses. A harness lets agents run bounded trials, preserve positive and negative outcomes, and route lessons into later planning, validation, claim scope, scheduling, critique, writing, and harness repair. We formalize this through two auditable conversion units: trial-to-behavior conversion, which links trial signals to later research actions, and trial-to-harness-behavior conversion, which links recurring process failures to system updates. We implement the framework in SIBYL, a file-backed autonomous research system that exposes the state, roles, memory, gates, and artifact traces needed to inspect these conversion paths. A retrospective audit identifies eight high-confidence conversion events, with a median latency of one iteration and a maximum latency of three iterations. A recovered-failure registry further shows how five naturally occurring failure classes, including duplicate results, stale numbers, and unsupported statistics, were blocked, downgraded, or routed into later repair. These traces do not establish a comparative performance claim; they show that the proposed conversion units are recoverable from realistic autonomous-research workspaces. The SIBYL framework and system are available at https://github.com/Sibyl-Research-Team/AutoResearch-SibylSystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sibyl-AutoResearch 框架与文件驱动的自主研究系统 SIBYL，主张自主科研的关键不是"能自动写出论文"，而是"能把试验经验转化为后续研究行为"。作者用两个可审计的转换单元来形式化这一要求：trial-to-behavior conversion（迭代 t 的试验信号改变迭代 t+k 的计划/验证/主张边界/调度/评述/写作）与 trial-to-harness-behavior conversion（反复出现的流程失败改变门控、提示覆盖层、遥测要求、调度策略、修复任务与受保护约束），二者构成 agent-harness 协同演化。框架归纳出七项 harness 功能 H1–H7 与六个失败模式 F1–F6，并在 SIBYL 中落地（角色分离的反思→问题分类→演化记录→角色化教训覆盖层；带成熟度标签的声明注册表；决策/质量门；GPU 调度与自愈）。证据为回溯式过程审计：8 个高置信转换事件（中位延迟 1 迭代、最大 3 迭代）、5 类自然发生的失败注册表、51 份生成式评审/11 个工作区的评审—行动审计、演化记忆 416 条复发问题模式与 1853 条阶段转移计数。作者明确声明这些只是"可审计性/可恢复性"的存在性证明，不构成比较性能结论。
AI.motivation: 现有自主科研系统（AI Scientist、Agent Laboratory、Cosmos、AlphaEvolve 类等）已能把"提想法—跑代码—读结果—写草稿"等流程自动化，但论文指出：流程可执行 ≠ 研究判断（research judgment，即以经验为依据、能改变下一步行动的行为）。四类具体的"经验丢失"表现为：弱证据被写成漂亮文字（paper completion hides evidence immaturity）、试点信号被当作一般性主张（pilot collapse）、记忆只停留在文本而不被路由到需要的角色、重复的流程失败（如产物缺失、陈旧数字、遥测缺失、论文与证据不同步）不改变 harness 本身。作者进一步提出反面观点：若以最终稿质量或评审分数为唯一目标，评审器之间 schema/校准差异巨大（保守评审器 31/35 评分为 3、rubric 评审器均值 3.94、长文本评审只能文本推断），优化分数只会制造另一个脆弱目标。此外作者担心门控与路由记忆可能被系统优化为"过程合规"而非科学完整性。核心诉求是把分析单元从"研究阶段是否完成"转向"试验信号到后续行为的更新路径（update path）是否存在且可检查"。
AI.method: 方法上是"失败分析 + 框架形式化 + 系统实现 + 回溯式过程审计"四段式。①失败分析：从 SIBYL 工作区轨迹归纳六种经验流失模式 F1–F6（论文完成掩盖证据不成熟、试点信号坍缩为论文主张、可见目标变成坏目标、记忆未路由、试验量漂移、harness 静止），每条给出缺失的更新路径与对应的正向 harness 功能。②框架形式化：定义两个可审计转换单元——trials-to-behavior（信号→轨迹路径→后续行为改变的三元链接）与 trial-to-harness-behavior（复发流程失败→门控/提示覆盖层/遥测要求/调度策略/修复任务/受保护约束的改变）；给出七项 harness 功能 H1–H7（试验编排、证据成熟度、可追溯性、路由研究记忆、视角分离、资源感知试验策略、带受保护约束的 harness 自演化）及各自的可观测承诺（observable commitment），并把 F 与 H 做成映射表。③系统实现：SIBYL 为文件后端的自主研究系统，研究状态、计划、角色输出、实验产物、评审、反思、写作均落盘为可检查文件；关键边界有两点——反思输出被归一化为问题类别→演化记录→按角色注入的教训覆盖层（而非长上下文文本）；写作代理只消费带成熟度标签、产物链接与验证状态的"声明注册表"，试点信号无法仅靠行文升级为 paper-ready 主张；另有 planner/experimenter/critic/supervisor/skeptic/methodologist/writer/editor 角色分离、GPU 调度、依赖图、监控恢复、自愈任务与受保护文件约束。④审计协议（附录 E 给出 6 条评测协议，本文仅执行第 1 条"回溯式 trial-to-behavior 审计"）：由人工保守标注转换事件并测量迭代延迟；构建"自然发生失败注册表"（每行含失败类别、审计产物类型、捕获机制、后续更新）；对 51 个项目-迭代快照 × 3 个生成式评审面做评审—行动对齐审计，并把内部反思生成的结构化行动方案（12 条轨迹、37 行可解析）与下一迭代任务计划做启发式多标签分类；再统计 1853 条阶段结束记录的转移矩阵与演化记忆的问题模式分布。作者以"trace-evidenced vs paper-described"两档不可直接比较的证据等级做系统对照表。
AI.result: （1）转换事件审计：8 个高置信转换事件，中位延迟 1 个迭代、最大 3 个迭代。典型如动态权重衰减案例（控制器不稳定/预算混淆/隐藏负对照 → 第 14 迭代做 floor clipping 与滑动平均修复、9/9 稳定性单测、epoch 预算断言、原始日志核对、对照审计并收窄为三层主张，作用域化推进）；扩散语言模型加速案例（伪造 Wilcoxon 统计、accept-rate 不符、某加速器近似 no-op → 拒绝不支持统计，把"加速可乘"改写为"干扰分类学"，并设 N≥1319、3 seeds 的全量复现门）；稀疏自编码器吸收案例（写作停滞 + 置信区间倒置 + 4.1× 陈旧标题比率 → 源-论文校验脚本、51/53 检查通过、标题降至 2.7×）；失败复制案例（写作分升至 8/10 而监督/评述分降至 4.5/5，9 项指标上出现字节级重复复本、1024 vs 16384 特征数不符、81.6% 惰性特征 → 重复检测与特征数校验成为前置条件）；图像增强试点（2.68pp 差异但全量证据缺失 → 主张被阻断于 pilot/full 边界）；缓存试点（54 分钟才测出 15.2× 开销 → 后续策略要求 10 分钟吞吐 sanity check）。（2）失败注册表 5 类被拦截/降级/路由：重复结果文件、CI 倒置、陈旧标题数字、特征数不符、不支持统计。（3）评审—行动审计：评分下降行的严重问题密度约为评分上升行的两倍（8.7 vs 4.0/行），有可见下一计划的下降行中约 2/3 任务为实验与对照；评审分数本身几乎不动（保守评审器 22 次相邻转移中 20 次持平），作者据此主张评审分数不是有效进展指标，异议本身才是有用信号。（4）harness 侧证据：演化记忆中心摘要含 416 条复发问题模式（实验 212、写作 89、分析 84、系统 20、ideation 4、pipeline 3、planning 3、efficiency 1），按角色显式路由；12/13 工作区有非空结果记录，中央账本 173 条结果记录；阶段转移矩阵显示 writing→writing 405 次、experiment→experiment 271 次、review→harness 217 次、validation→experiment 78 次等，显示叙事自循环与门控回流的存在。作者同时声明这些计数含 resume/checkpoint 重复，只支持"过程形状"结论。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张自主科研的评价标准应从"是否产出完整论文"转向"是否把试验历史转化为研究判断"，并认为这要求 Scientific Trial-and-Error Harness 而非 paper generator；框架与系统不可分割——更好的轨迹暴露缺失的更新路径，更好的更新路径理论又告诉后续版本该保留、路由、阻断与审计什么。附录 F 给出治理风险—缓解对（科学灌水、修辞性过度主张、指标博弈、负面记忆抑制、自演化漂移、不安全自修改），并强调人类作者必须能理解、辩护并改写最终稿，系统不应被视为问责作者。局限同样关键：证据为回溯式、集中在作者自建的计算类 AI/ML harness，框架与系统共同演化因而非独立验证集；转换计数为人工标注，失败注册表用自然失败而非注入基准，评审产物为生成式而非同行评审；所有结论限于"转换单元可从真实工作区中恢复"的存在性证明，不支持 Sibyl 优于既有系统的比较结论。作者给出的后续评测契约包括：固定预算的前瞻性对比、注入式失败压力测试、跨项目记忆检索测试、harness 演化测试（检验复发率下降）、以及以过度主张率/异议—行动转化率/成熟度增益为指标的视角与效率消融。

title: Behavior-Guided Candidate Calibration for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Multimodal recommendation benefits from content signals, but the gain depends on how those signals interact with the ranking pipeline. We find that moderate cross-view agreement helps, while stronger agreement suppresses recommendation-specific variation. Spectral analysis shows a clear split: low-frequency components capture shared structure, and higher-frequency components preserve more discriminative signal. Based on this finding, we introduce a behavior-guided candidate calibration model that converts training-only co-user overlap into signed candidate evidence and applies it only to the shortlist produced by the multimodal backbone. The backbone keeps the representation space stable; behavior evidence acts only where ranking is decided. Results on Amazon Baby, Sports, and Electronics show consistent gains over strong multimodal baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/bridge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态推荐系统中跨视图一致性对排序管道的影响。通过频谱分析发现低频成分捕捉共享结构、高频成分保留判别信号。基于此发现，提出行为引导的候选校准模型，仅对多模态主干的短列表应用校准，在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 跨视图一致性对多模态推荐的影响存在两面性：适度一致有助于推荐，但过强一致性反而会抑制推荐特异性差异，导致推荐多样性下降。
AI.method: 1) 频谱分析：分离低频（共享结构）与高频（判别信号）成分；2) 候选校准：将训练阶段共用户重叠转化为带符号的候选证据；3) 短列表应用：仅对多模态主干生成的短列表应用校准，避免全空间干扰。
AI.result: 在Amazon Baby、Sports和Electronics三个数据集上，该方法相比强多模态基线模型取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 行为引导的候选校准模型通过仅在短列表阶段应用校准信号，有效平衡了模态一致性与推荐特异性差异，在Amazon三个类目数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

title: RankJudge: A Multi-Turn LLM-as-a-Judge Synthetic Benchmark Generator
summary: As interactive LLM-based applications are created and refined, model developers need to evaluate the quality of generated text along many possible axes. For simpler systems, human evaluation may be practical, but in complicated systems like conversational chatbots, the amount of generated text can overwhelm human annotation resources. Model developers have begun to rely heavily on auto-evaluation, where LLMs are also used to judge generation quality. However, existing LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks largely focus on simple Q\&A tasks that do not match the complexity of multi-turn conversations. We introduce RankJudge, a benchmark generator for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge on multi-turn conversations grounded in reference documents. RankJudge creates pairs of conversations where one conversation has a single flaw injected into one turn. This construction allows paired conversations to be labeled unambiguously as better or worse, and precisely isolates failure categories to individual turns, enabling a strict joint correctness criterion for judging. We implement RankJudge across the domains of machine learning, biomedicine, and finance, evaluate 21 frontier LLM judges, and rank those judges via the Bradley-Terry model. Our formulation also allows ranking each conversation pair with difficulty ratings, which we use to dynamically curate the evaluation slice to reduce label noise, as confirmed via human annotation. We find that judge rankings are stable under partial observability, coarser correctness criteria, and an alternative random-walk rating algorithm.

AI.tldr: RankJudge是一个用于评估LLM评判者在多轮对话中表现的新型基准生成器，通过创建带有单一注入缺陷的成对对话来实现无歧义的质量标注和失败类别的精确隔离。
AI.motivation: 随着交互式LLM应用的创建和迭代，模型开发者需要沿多个维度评估生成文本的质量。在对话聊天机器人等复杂系统中，生成文本量巨大，人工标注资源不堪重负；而现有LLM评判基准主要关注简单的问答任务，无法匹配多轮对话的复杂性。
AI.method: RankJudge通过在对话的一个轮次中注入单一缺陷来构建成对对话，使得对话对可被明确标注为更好或更差，并精确地将失败类别隔离到单个轮次，从而实现严格的联合正确性判断标准。跨机器学习、生物医学和金融领域实现，评估21个前沿LLM评判者，并通过Bradley-Terry模型进行排名。进一步根据难度等级对对话对进行排名，用于动态策划评估切片以减少标签噪声。
AI.result: 21个前沿LLM评判者的排名在部分可观测性、更粗粒度正确性标准和随机游走评分算法下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: RankJudge提供了一个用于评估LLM评判者的稳健框架，评判排名在部分可观测性、更粗粒度正确性标准和替代评分算法下保持稳定，证实了该方法可有效减少标签噪声。

title: Double descent for least-squares interpolation on contaminated data: A simulation study
summary: Overparametrized models can exhibit an excellent generalization performance, although they should be prone to overfitting according to classical statistical theory. The discovery of the "double descent", indicating that the generalization error decreases after a certain model complexity has been reached, opened a new line of research. Robust statistics considers statistical estimation on contaminated data, which, due to assumptions that do not hold on real data, let data points appear as outliers w.r.t. the assumed "ideal" distribution, potentially severely distorting any classical estimator. We address the question whether a double descent phenomenon can be observed in a linear regression setting with contaminated training data. We compare the performance of the highly non-robust least-squares interpolation estimator with several robust alternatives. It turns out that large overparametrization indeed allows for a double descent phenomenon, resulting in a very good generalization performance of the least-squares interpolator, surpassing that of the robust alternatives.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates whether double descent occurs in contaminated data linear regression settings. Findings reveal that large overparametrization enables double descent, with the least-squares interpolator unexpectedly outperforming robust estimators.
AI.motivation: Classical statistical theory predicts overfitting with overparametrized models, yet "double descent" phenomenon shows improved generalization beyond a complexity threshold. Robust statistics addresses outlier sensitivity in contaminated data, but it's unclear whether double descent can occur under such conditions.
AI.method: Linear regression with contaminated training data, comparing least-squares interpolation estimator against multiple robust alternatives.
AI.result: Large overparametrization indeed induces double descent in contaminated data scenarios. Surprisingly, the non-robust least-squares interpolator surpasses robust alternatives in generalization performance.
AI.conclusion: Large overparametrization enables a double descent phenomenon in contaminated data settings, where the least-squares interpolator achieves superior generalization performance compared to robust alternatives.

title: The Secretary Problem with a Stochastic Precursor
summary: In learning-augmented online algorithms, predictions are usually valued for what they say: a value estimate, a solution, or an algorithmic recommendation. This paper shows that predictions can also be valuable solely due to their arrival time. We study the fundamental secretary problem augmented with a stochastic precursor: a content-free signal that is guaranteed to arrive no later than the best item, but is otherwise stochastically timed. The signal does not carry any additional information; nevertheless, its timing alone changes the structure of optimal stopping. We characterize optimal policies in the random-order and adversarial-order models. In random order, a single uniformly timed precursor already gives success probability at least $\frac12$, improving on the classic $\frac1e$ benchmark. With increasingly late precursors, the success probability approaches $1$. In adversarial order, for which traditional models do not admit strong guarantees, sufficiently concentrated precursors recover constant success guarantees. Our results show that such novel forms of asynchronous temporal information are a distinct and powerful form of advice in online decision making and may also be effective for other problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究秘书问题中一种新型的"异步时序信息"——仅因到达时间就有价值的无内容预测信号。在随机顺序模型中，该信号将成功率从1/e提升至1/2至接近1；在对抗顺序模型中，集中型时序信号可恢复常数保证。这表明时序本身即可作为一种有效的建议形式。
AI.motivation: 传统预测通常关注预测内容本身的价值（数值估计、解或算法建议）。本文探索一种全新的预测形式：仅凭到达时间就有价值的无内容信号。
AI.method: 分析随机顺序模型和对抗顺序模型下，最优停止策略的结构特征。
AI.result: 随机顺序模型中，单一均匀时序的前驱信号即可将成功率从经典的1/e提升至至少1/2；前驱信号越晚，成功率趋近于1。对抗顺序模型中，充分集中的时序信号可恢复常数成功保证。
AI.conclusion: Temporal signal (without content) is a distinct and powerful form of advice; such asynchronous timing information can be effective for other online decision problems beyond secretary problem.

title: The efficiency-gain illusion: People underestimate the rate of AI use and overestimate its benefits on simple tasks
summary: People are increasingly turning to AI assistance for simple tasks, e.g., arithmetic, spell-check, and answering simple questions. But does AI assistance actually save users time and effort? We investigate people's propensity to use AI for cognitively simple tasks and assess whether their reliance is well-calibrated. Across three pre-registered user studies (N = 2691), we find that people frequently choose to use AI even when doing so is inefficient (i.e. provides no meaningful time or effort savings). We identify systematic miscalibration at two levels: (1) a self-estimate miscalibration where people on average believe that they are using AI less than they actually are, and (2) efficiency-gain illusions where people overestimate how much time and effort savings AI use affords. We also identify a session-level carryover effect where a participant's prior AI use leads to further AI adoption and entrenches their miscalibration about time savings. Our results shed light on the mechanisms and biases underlying people's choice of whether to use AI as well as the risk of an overreliance feedback loop.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三项预注册用户研究（N=2691）发现，人们在算术、拼写检查、简单问答等认知负荷极低的简单任务上，频繁选择使用 AI，但这种使用往往并无实际的时间或努力收益。研究识别出两类系统性校准偏差：一是自我估计误校准（人们自述的 AI 使用率显著低于其实际使用率，整体 33% 预测 vs 47% 实际），二是效率收益幻觉（速度加速幻觉与卸载幻觉），即人们高估 AI 所节省的时间（预计节省 55.7 秒，实际仅节省 7.5 秒）与努力。此外还发现会话级迁移效应：先前使用过 AI 会提高后续 AI 采用率并加剧误校准，形成过度依赖的反馈回路。
AI.motivation: 当前关于 LLM 提升生产力的主流叙事受到越来越多的反驳性证据挑战（如 Becker et al. 2025 发现 AI 反而使专业开发者编码速度下降 19%）。人们究竟在何时、为何对认知简单任务（算术、拼写、简单问答）使用 AI 并不清楚：若这些任务本可几分钟内独立完成，AI 辅助则不具备效率收益，使用即属低效行为。理论上，是否委派任务取决于成本—收益比较，而该比较的核心是“校准”（对自身能力与外部工具能力的准确心智模型）。因此本文试图刻画：（1）人们是否高估自己的 AI 使用倾向与 AI 的效率收益；（2）这些误校准的心理机制；（3）AI 使用本身是否会自我强化，从而形成过度依赖的反馈回路。
AI.method: 三项预注册研究，Prolific 招募美国成人样本，GPT-4o 嵌入问卷界面。任务集共 24 项，基于 TUNA（Taxonomy of User Needs and Actions）四大认知类别（信息获取、信息处理与综合、程序指导与执行、内容创作与转换），每类 3 个任务类型，每型含易/难两个变体，均可在 5 分钟内独立完成。Study 1（N=498）：被试真实完成 4 项任务，每题可选择是否使用 AI 聊天机器人（至少输入一次提示即视为使用），用隐藏计时器记录时间、NASA-TLX 测量主观努力，并与另一批被试的“陈述偏好率”作群体层面（组间设计）比较。Study 2（N=1601：预测样本 600、完成样本 1001）：预测样本分别预测自己独立完成与接受 AI/“另一名高水平参与者”帮助时的完成时间与努力；完成样本随机分配独立完成或使用 AI，记录实际时间/努力；分析单位为任务级，用混合效应模型比较预测与实际。Study 3（N=592）：暴露阶段随机分配为 4 个条件（易/难任务 × AI/独立）加 1 个仅填大五人格的控制组，测试阶段在 2 个易变体上提供 AI 选项，记录后续 AI 采用率与时间/努力校准、感知难度、信心，并做开放题质性编码。统计上使用混合效应 logistic 回归（随机截距为 participantID 与 taskID），并检验 condition × type、type × difficulty、type × category 等交互；控制 NFC 与 AIAS（AI 态度量表）作为个体差异协变量。
AI.result: Study 1：实际 AI 使用率 47%，显著高于预测率 33%（β=1.07，p<0.001）；易变体上差距最大（预测 20% vs 实际 38%，β=1.42）。使用 AI 并未带来时间收益（p=0.10），独立完成者报告的努力反而更低（1.99 vs 2.11，β=−0.12，p<0.01）。Study 2：人们预期 AI 可缩短时间 58%（97.1→41.4 秒）、降低努力 35%（2.61→1.71），且这种预期是 AI 特有的——相比“另一名参与者”的基线差异显著更小（β=−44.9、β=−78，均 p<0.001）。实际 AI 完成时间 86.2 秒，远超预测的 43.3 秒；预测节省 55.7 秒，实际仅省 7.5 秒（β=−48.33，p<0.001），形成速度加速幻觉；而独立完成条件的时间预测是准确的（99 vs 93.7 秒，p=0.08）。努力方面，AI 条件预测准确（1.76 vs 1.74，p=0.63），但独立条件努力被高估（2.66 vs 2.36，p<0.001），故努力节省被高估（预测降 0.90 vs 实际降 0.62），形成卸载幻觉。AI 辅助总体未显著缩短时间（β=6.17，p=0.07），在易变体上反而慢 10.0 秒（60.2→70.2 秒，p<0.05）；时间分解显示提示撰写（48.7 秒）显著长于阅读处理（37.6 秒），41% 的提示为直接复制粘贴。Study 3：暴露阶段使用 AI 的被试在测试阶段 AI 采用率达 44.5%，对照独立完成组的 27.7%（β=0.54，p<0.001）；独立完成并未降低后续 AI 使用率；AI 暴露还加剧了速度幻觉（β=−0.34，p<0.001），但对努力校准无显著影响；测试阶段使用 AI 者比独立者多花 7.06 秒且努力更高。附加分析：低 NFC 者更易出现速度幻觉；AIAS 态度分可正向预测 AI 使用；质性分析显示“时间节省”是决策的首要理由。
AI.conclusion: 人类在与 AI 交互中存在系统性的元认知误校准：人们低估自己使用 AI 的频率（自估计误校准），高估 AI 在简单任务上带来的时间（速度加速幻觉）与努力（卸载幻觉）收益，因此对 AI 的使用决策并非资源理性，而是系统性地过度依赖。不同校准模式对应不同机制：时间感知受新奇性/缺乏生动表征影响（AI 技术尚新，人们难以形成完成时长的心理表征），努力预测则受享乐适应效应影响（预期中的独立任务显得更费力）。更关键的是，AI 使用不会修正误校准，反而通过会话级迁移效应提高后续 AI 采用率并加深时间误校准，暗示存在“过度依赖反馈回路”的风险；但暴露于独立完成并不能降低 AI 使用率，提示干预应针对信念水平而非表层提示。政策与实践含义：需要向用户传达更准确的心理模型以改善 AI 使用决策，并关注认知去技能化、信心下降、独立能力与学习能力受损等连带风险。局限包括：任务均可在 5 分钟内完成，未控制激励与动机，众包环境可能影响行为，AI 使用仅以二值近似（未刻画具体使用方式），Study 3 缺乏纵向追踪，Study 1/2 采用组间聚合设计、预测与完成样本存在重叠。

title: Relay-Based Synchronization of Replicated Data Types in Opportunistic Networks
summary: In Opportunistic Networks (OppNets), the dissemination of information can only rely on transient pairwise radio contacts between mobile devices (peers). Designing distributed applications that can run in such conditions is a challenge, but replicated data types, and in particular Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), can help meet this challenge. A CRDT is inherently replicated data type whose replicas can be updated locally, yet eventually converge thanks to an anti-entropy algorithm that allows all replicas to synchronize in the background. Whether the replicas of a CRDT can actually converge in an OppNet, and how fast they can converge, depend on the occurrence of radio contacts between mobile devices. In this paper we investigate the idea of using mobile relays as a means to boost the convergence of stated-based CRDT replicas in an OppNet. New protocols are presented that allow the synchronization of replicas and relays, and new metrics are defined to observe and characterize the convergence of replicas. Simulation results show that using relays can significantly improve this convergence, and even make it possible in scenarios where the replicas alone would be unable to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于中继的同步系统"（RBSS）：在机会网络中允许不具备CRDT副本的移动节点充当"中继"，携带（版本向量 + 序列化状态）元组并代为转发，从而加速基于状态（state-based）CRDT副本的收敛；并提出"收敛时延"与"收敛距离"两个新度量。三个仿真场景（Östermalm 行人、VBN 公交、灾害救援无人机）显示：使用中继可显著降低收敛时延与落后更新数，甚至使原本无法收敛的场景得以收敛，且中继存储/传输的状态数量远低于副本数上界，具备可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 机会网络（OppNet）仅依赖移动设备之间的瞬时无线电接触，网络高度分区、无稳定端到端路径，无法使用Internet/MANET路由或维护覆盖网。基于操作（op-based）的CRDT需要可靠甚至因果广播，会产生大量小消息、迅速耗尽中继缓存并导致消息丢失与无法收敛；基于状态（state-based）的CRDT因合并函数满足交换、结合、幂等，可容忍分区与丢包，天然适合OppNet。然而在规模较大的OppNet中，某个CRDT实例的副本只分布在少数节点上，副本之间相遇概率极低，收敛极慢甚至永不收敛。经典的消息转发协议（store-carry-and-forward）假定载荷是不可变消息，而副本状态是可变对象，快照会迅速过时，用转发协议传播状态效率极低。因此需要一种能在节点间传播"仍有效"状态、且不要求中继理解数据内容的机制。
AI.method: 系统模型：假设CRDT库API可提供序列化状态、合并序列化状态、本地更新事件三类能力；通信中间件负责邻居发现与可靠单对单传输，不支持多跳转发；仅部分节点承载副本，其余节点可作为中继。三类同步协议：(1) 副本—副本：维护版本向量，交换版本向量判断是否有可"膨胀"（inflate）对端的状态，必要时交换序列化状态（一次同步可交换0/1/2个状态）；(2) 副本—中继：副本先发版本向量，中继用 selectInflators() 选出最小可膨胀子集，副本合并后回传自己的新状态（带"最后贡献"标志位），中继存储随之被替换为单一状态；(3) 中继—中继：交换聚合版本向量（各状态版本向量逐点取最大值），相互发送选定状态，并依据偏序关系≺清除被支配的过时状态。selectInflators() 将问题归约为集合覆盖（NP 完全），采用改进贪心算法：先用 getSingleInflators() 选出唯一能覆盖某计数器值的"单一膨胀者"，再对剩余部分执行标准贪心覆盖，复杂度 O(n·m)。增强机制包括：逐状态分批发送以抗接触中断、并发同步时避免中继存储回退（把来自副本的状态按被支配/支配/并发分类处理）、状态膨胀后主动通知邻居触发传递式同步（或改为周期性同步以降低信道开销）。度量：以"全局状态"（所有更新无延迟应用于单一状态）为理想参考，定义收敛距离 D_i(t)（副本落后的更新数）与收敛时延 L_i(t)=t′−t（副本追平全局状态所需时间），并统计中继存储状态数与同步中传输状态数。仿真器基于 GraphStream 的时变图实现，可并行播放"接触场景"与"应用场景"。
AI.result: Östermalm 场景（5 个移动副本 + 2092 名行人中按比例抽取中继，5 小时，11793 次接触）：无中继时副本只能直接相遇 111 次，平均时延约 26 分钟、平均距离约 60 次更新；100% 中继时平均时延降至 7′10″、距离降至 18 次更新，且中继数达 50% 时收益已接近饱和（说明存在最优中继比例问题）。中继存储最多仅 4~5 个冲突状态，58.7% 的同步中中继无需传输任何状态。VBN 场景（60 辆公交车作中继 + 10 个相距较远的静态副本，副本无法直接相遇）：必须依靠中继才能同步；20% 中继时部分副本始终无法追平，50%~100% 时全部收敛，100% 时平均时延约 30 分钟、平均距离 33 次更新。灾害救援场景（1000 个 Levy Walk 救援人员副本 + 100 架 Random Waypoint 无人机中继，24 小时、439552 次接触，258000 次更新）：仅 25% 无人机中继时平均时延 6h34′、距离 12630 次更新且 19:25 后全局状态永不可见；100% 时降至 2h52′、5122 次更新，所有副本最终收敛。值得注意的是 1000 个副本场景下中继存储仍以 1 个状态为主（90.7%），87.9% 的同步无需传输状态，说明选择算法有效抑制了存储与消息开销，方法可扩展到数百副本/中继。
AI.conclusion: 以中继协助基于状态的CRDT副本同步是可行且有效的：中继仅把副本状态视为不透明字节数组（可由源副本签名/加密），因此具备通用性（适配 Yjs、Automerge、Loro 等任意库与任意CRDT类型）、保密性与节俭性；协议在时间与消息复杂度上均可接受，且能显著降低收敛时延与收敛距离，甚至使无中继时无法收敛的场景得以收敛。讨论部分指出：安全上，拜占庭中继无法直接欺骗副本（签名+加密+合并函数的幂等性），但可通过向其他中继注入伪造状态与假版本向量诱导其清除有效状态，在副本完全依赖中继的场景中可能造成永久分区，可通过让中继校验签名或借助联邦学习传播信任信息来缓解；此外该思路可迁移到互联网/云环境，用部署在服务器端的中继作为跨客户端库的稳定状态仓库。后续工作包括寻找最优中继数量与中继选择启发式、安全机制的完善，以及更大规模的真实部署验证。

title: A Generalized Nash Equilibrium-Seeking Scheme for Trauma Resuscitation
summary: Trauma resuscitation is a clinical process for treating life-threatening physiological disorders in safety-critical environments, driven by the experience of healthcare workers (HCWs). Designing and optimizing quantifiable metrics that accurately capture HCW decisions may augment current resuscitation procedures with the potential to improve patient outcomes. This motivates our socio-technical formulation of trauma resuscitation as a distributed generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE)-seeking game with coupled inequality constraints. This method is optimized over a time-varying communication graph. We introduce novel insights from clinical experience to model HCWs behavior. This work facilitates the best possible resuscitation outcome given HCWs workloads, schedules, competencies, and limited resources.

AI.tldr: 本文将创伤复苏（TR）临床团队建模为带耦合不等式约束的分布式广义纳什均衡（GNE）求解问题，在时变通信图上设计主–偶投影梯度/对偶上升算法，用以联合优化每个医护人员的技能配置、敏捷度（alacrity）、任务分配公平性与沟通效率，从而在人力负载、排班、能力与资源受限的条件下求解最佳复苏配置。
AI.motivation: 创伤复苏是高风险、团队协作且常相互冲突的临床过程，团队成员在技能、身心反应速度（alacrity）与沟通能力上差异显著，并随疲劳/倦怠而退化，导致重复执行任务、信息冗余与决策质量下降。既有工作多集中于自主系统、物资配送、手术室消毒或集中式协议对齐软件，缺少能刻画“HCW 以自身视角优化、同时受共享资源与他人决策耦合约束”的可量化算法框架。因此需要一种社会-技术（socio-technical）建模与分布式优化机制，把临床经验转化为可计算的性能度量（技能、敏捷、公平、沟通效能），在任务分配自动化的同时最大化整体技能水平、抑制重复沟通，从而改善患者结局。
AI.method:
1) 博弈建模：玩家为 HCW，每人含个体约束 K_i^p（如止血）与共享约束 K_i^s（如呼吸/脉搏核查），共享约束写成 g(x)=c^T x-d≥0（因技能/时间指标非负）。假设：时变连通无向加权图 G(A)(t)（半径 r 内的邻接构成时变邻域）、各 J_i 关于自身变量凸且连续可微、博弈映射强单调、g 连续可微凸且可行集非空闭凸并满足 Slater 条件；由此由 Facchinei & Kanzow 定理保证 GNE 存在，KKT/变分不等式条件给出最优性刻画（Remark 2 说明等乘子解为 v-GNE）。
2) 临床状态模型：x_i(t)=[s_i, a_i(t), f_i(t), υ_i(t)]，s_i∈[0,1] 为固定技能熟练度；a_i 由二阶欠阻尼阶跃响应 σ_i(t)（ζ<1，ω_n^i=2π b_i/60，b_i 为静息心率）之上升时间导出；f_i 采用 Jain 公平指数度量工作负载均衡（通过动态平均共识获得本地估计 ŝ_i）；υ_i 综合稳定时间 t_s^i、应答时间 k·Δt_ij（交接间隔）与参与度 e_i(t)（邻居访问计数均值）。
3) 局部代价：二次型 J_i=‖s_i‖²+‖a_i‖²+‖f_i‖²+‖υ_i‖²，并按邻域 r_i 对邻居代价做加权平均，形成耦合项。
4) 分布式算法（式 11）：对偶上升更新 λ_i（每个不等式约束一个分量）+ 投影梯度更新 x_i + 以 signum 符号一致性实现有限时间动态平均共识（ζ, η 通道）聚合邻居代价；增益取 κ>(n-1)h_1、ρ>γ(n-1)h_2；解按 Filippov 意义解释；用 smooth-abs √(x²+α²)-α 平滑符号函数消除抖振且保持收敛。
AI.result: 7 名医护人员的 ALS 心脏骤停合成场景（20 分钟事件、按 ALS 流程分配原子动作、初始 alacrity∈[0.5,1.0]、fairness∈[0.8,0.95]、υ∈[0.9,1.0]、技能∈[0.6,0.9]、通信半径 200 ft、共享约束 a_i,f_i,υ_i≥0.2）：不动点残差在约 6 次迭代内降至 1e-3 以下；乘子范数全程有界，说明约束被稳定执行；各玩家目标收敛到异质稳态值，符合 v-GNE 的 KKT 条件（离散来源于各人固定技能 s_i，因其优化个体而非团队共同代价）；200 ft 半径下玩家位置漂移导致邻域集合随迭代变化，时变图上仍稳定收敛。可扩展性：达到 1e-3 阈值所需迭代数随 n 增长平缓（n=5 时约 124 次，n=50 时约 147 次），单次迭代墙钟时间由邻居求和主导，为 O(n+|E|)，优于 O(n²) 最坏参考。平滑 signum 与 tanh(50·) 对比显示：平滑后振荡消失且仍收敛到 v-GNE。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并分析了面向创伤复苏的分布式 GNE 方案：把技能、敏捷度、负载公平与沟通效率统一为耦合决策变量，给出带不等式约束的原始-对偶求解算法，并在 7 人 ALS 场景中验证了收敛性与有界对偶变量，另以至多 50 人的规模扫描刻画迭代数与团队规模的关系。作者明确将本工作定位为合成临床工作流上的可行性研究，尚未刻画协议偏离与压力诱发的决策行为；此外，文中存在数值口径不一致（正文/图 2 称约 6 次迭代收敛，而图 3 规模实验给出 124–147 次迭代），且模型仅基于单一代表性模拟训练观察，约束与代价的临床标定、真实数据验证与安全性评估仍待完善。

title: Integrating Chain-of-Thought into Generative Retrieval: A Preliminary Study
comment: This work was initially submitted to kdd 2026 in August 2025
summary: While generative retrieval (GR) demonstrates competitive performance on standard retrieval benchmarks, existing approaches directly map queries to document identifiers (docids) without intermediate deliberation, limiting their effectiveness for complex queries that require multi-step reasoning. As a preliminary study on integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) into generative retrieval, we introduce ThinkGR, a unified framework that interleaves CoT with docid generation, enabling iterative thinking and retrieval within a single generative process. To bridge the gap between free-form thought generation and structured retrieval targets, we design (1) a hybrid decoding strategy that dynamically switches between unconstrained thought generation and constrained docid decoding, and (2) a two-phase training approach that first aligns thought-retrieval patterns through supervised fine-tuning, then optimizes thought quality via retrieval-grounded reinforcement learning. Experiments on four multi-hop retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkGR achieves state-of-the-art performance with an average improvement of +6.86\%. Our work opens new avenues for enhancing generative retrieval with explicit deliberation capabilities, with promising implications for retrieval tasks requiring complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: ThinkGR integrates chain-of-thought reasoning into generative retrieval via hybrid decoding and two-phase training, achieving +6.86% improvement on multi-hop retrieval benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing generative retrieval approaches directly map queries to document identifiers without intermediate deliberation, limiting effectiveness for complex queries requiring multi-step reasoning.
AI.method: ThinkGR interleaves chain-of-thought (CoT) with docid generation through: (1) a hybrid decoding strategy that dynamically switches between unconstrained thought generation and constrained docid decoding, and (2) a two-phase training approach—first aligning thought-retrieval patterns through supervised fine-tuning, then optimizing thought quality via retrieval-grounded reinforcement learning.
AI.result: State-of-the-art performance on four multi-hop retrieval benchmarks with an average improvement of +6.86%.
AI.conclusion: ThinkGR opens new avenues for enhancing generative retrieval with explicit deliberation capabilities, with promising implications for retrieval tasks requiring complex reasoning.

title: PromptNCE: Pointwise Mutual Information Predictions Using Only LLMs and Contrastive Estimation Prompts
summary: Estimating mutual information from text usually requires training a task-specific critic, which limits its use in low-data settings. We ask whether large language models can instead estimate pointwise mutual information zero-shot, using only prompts and elicited probabilities. We introduce a benchmark with human-derived ground-truth PMI across three publicly available datasets, and evaluate five information-theoretic prompting-based estimators. Our main method, PromptNCE, frames conditional probability estimation as a contrastive task and augments the candidate set with an explicit OTHER category. We show theoretically that adding OTHER recovers the true conditional P(y | x) rather than just a ranking over listed candidates, turning a contrastive prompt into a general-purpose zero-shot probability estimator. PromptNCE is the best zero-shot method on all three datasets, reaching Spearman correlation up to 0.82 with human-derived PMI. We also present a case study in computer science education showing how these estimators can be used to score student knowledge summaries in a low-data setting.

AI.tldr: The paper proposes PromptNCE, a contrastive prompting method with an explicit OTHER category that enables large language models to estimate pointwise mutual information zero-shot. It outperforms five alternative methods across three benchmarks (Spearman ≤ 0.82) and shows practical value in low-data educational scenarios.
AI.motivation: Traditional mutual information estimation from text requires training task-specific critics, limiting applicability in low-data scenarios. There's a need to leverage large language models for zero-shot pointwise mutual information (PMI) estimation using only prompts and elicited probabilities.
AI.method: The paper introduces PromptNCE, which frames conditional probability estimation as a contrastive task by adding an explicit "OTHER" category to the candidate set. This theoretically recovers true conditional probability P(y|x) rather than just a ranking. The authors evaluate five prompting-based estimators against human-derived ground-truth PMI across three public datasets.
AI.result: PromptNCE outperforms all other zero-shot methods on all three datasets, achieving Spearman correlations up to 0.82 with human-derived PMI ground truth.
AI.conclusion: PromptNCE achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across all three benchmarks (Spearman correlation up to 0.82) and demonstrates practical utility through a case study in computer science education for scoring student knowledge summaries in low-data settings.

title: Investigating Concept Alignment Using Implausible Category Members
summary: Developing AI systems with a human-like understanding of everyday concepts is a key step towards developing safe, reliable systems whose behavior makes sense to humans. When probing concept understanding, asking questions about plausible category members (e.g., "Is a car a vehicle?") is likely to recall patterns in the model's vast training data. We pursue an alternative strategy, characterizing the boundaries of conceptual categories by asking about implausible category members (e.g., "Is an olive a vehicle?") to probe the kind of concept-level knowledge we take for granted in fellow humans. We characterize concept boundaries for a set of fundamental concepts by studying AI systems' assignments of objects to superordinate categories from a classic psychological study by Rosch and Mervis, as well as their assignments of the same objects to mismatched superordinate categories. We compare these assignments to those made by human participants on the full range of within-category and cross-category assignment tasks. Our results reveal a range of concepts for which which models differ in meaningful and surprising ways from humans, including treating "words" as belonging to categories like "vehicles" and "clothing," identifying several "vegetable" category members as "fruit," and assigning exemplars from non-weapon categories to the "weapons" category. We also demonstrate how these instances of concept misalignment translate into problematic downstream behavior with implications for AI safety.

AI.tldr: 研究通过比较AI系统与人类在概念分类任务上的差异，发现AI模型对基本概念（如水果/蔬菜、武器）的边界理解与人类存在显著偏差，这些偏差可能导致下游行为问题，具有AI安全意义。
AI.motivation: 现有探测概念理解的方法（如询问合理类别成员"车是车辆吗？"）可能仅召回训练数据中的模式，而非真正的概念知识。需要通过询问不合理类别成员（如"橄榄是车辆吗？"）来探测概念级知识。
AI.method: 使用Rosch和Mervis经典心理学研究中的测试材料，通过对比AI系统与人类在可能/不可能类别成员归属任务上的表现，刻画概念边界。具体包括：测试物体对上位类别的归属（如"橄榄是水果吗？"），以及物体对不匹配上位类别的错误归属（如"橄榄是车辆吗？"）。
AI.result: AI模型与人类在多个概念上存在有意义的差异：如将"words"归入"vehicles"和"clothing"类别；将多种蔬菜错误识别为水果；将非武器类样本归入武器类别。
AI.conclusion: AI models与人类在多个基本概念上存在显著且令人惊讶的分类差异，这些概念错位会引发具有AI安全影响的下游问题。

title: HealthCraft: A Reinforcement Learning Safety Environment for Emergency Medicine
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code, task suite, and Docker bundle: https://github.com/GOATnote-Inc/healthcraft
summary: Frontier language models are being deployed into clinical workflows faster than the infrastructure to evaluate them safely. Static medical-QA benchmarks miss the failure modes that matter in emergency medicine: trajectory-level safety collapse, tool misuse, and capitulation under sustained clinical pressure. We present HealthCraft, the first public reinforcement-learning environment that rewards trajectory-level safety under realistic emergency-medicine conditions, adapted from Corecraft. It is built on a FHIR R4 world state with 14 entity types and 3,987 seed entities, exposes 24 MCP tools, and defines a dual-layer rubric that zeroes reward whenever any safety-critical criterion is violated. We release 195 tasks across six categories, graded against 2,255 binary criteria (515 safety-critical); a post-hoc 10-task negative-class slate extends this to 205 tasks and 2,337 criteria. V8 results on two frontier models show Claude Opus 4.6 at Pass@1 24.8% [21.5-28.4] and GPT-5.4 at 12.6% [10.2-15.6], with safety-failure rates of 27.5% and 34.0%. On multi-step workflows - the closest proxy to real emergency care - performance collapses to near zero (Claude 1.0%, GPT-5.4 0.0%) despite partial competence on individual steps. Six infrastructure bugs fixed between pilots v2 and v8 re-ordered which model "looks stronger," evidence that infrastructure fidelity is part of the measurement. A deterministic LLM-judge overlay bounds evaluator noise, and a 60-run negative-class smoke pilot shows the reward signal is not drop-in training-safe: restraint criteria pass at 0.929 prevalence, a gameability an eval harness can tolerate but a training reward cannot. We scaffold coupling to a Megatron+SGLang+GRPO loop per Corecraft Section 5.2 and leave training-reward ablations as future work. Environment, tasks, rubrics, and harness are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: HealthCraft是首个公开的急诊医学轨迹级安全强化学习评估环境，基于Corecraft和FHIR R4构建，包含24个MCP工具和195+任务/2,255+评估标准。结果显示当前前沿模型多步工作流性能接近零(V8: Claude 1.0%, GPT-5.4 0.0%)，安全失败率超27%，且基础设施缺陷可改变模型排名，提示评估基础设施保真度对测量的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有医学问答基准无法捕捉急诊医学中的关键失败模式：轨迹级安全崩溃、工具误用和持续临床压力下的屈服；前沿语言模型部署到临床工作流程的速度远超安全评估基础设施的发展。
AI.method: 基于Corecraft构建FHIR R4真实感急诊医学RL环境(world state含14类实体和3,987个种子实体)，暴露24个MCP工具，采用双层评分规则(安全关键标准任意违反即零奖励)；通过195个任务(6类)/2,255个二元标准(515个安全关键)及10任务负类扩展进行评估；使用确定性LLM法官控制评估噪声；集成Megatron+SGLang+GRPO训练循环框架。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.4在单步任务Pass@1分别为24.8%和12.6%，安全失败率分别为27.5%和34.0%；多步急诊工作流中性能接近零(Claude 1.0%, GPT-5.4 0.0%)；v2-v8间修复的6个基础设施缺陷导致模型相对强弱排名发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿模型在单步任务上表现有限(Claude 24.8%, GPT-5.4 12.6%)，在多步急诊工作流中性能几乎为零；负类测试显示约束标准通过率为92.9%，提示评估信号对训练不安全但可被评估框架容忍；v2-v8版本间的6个基础设施缺陷导致模型排名重排，基础设施保真度是测量的一部分；未来工作包括训练奖励消融实验。

title: Automated Repair of TEE Partitioning Issues via DSL-Guided and LLM-Assisted Patching
comment: Accepted by the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-based isolation to protect sensitive data and computations from potentially compromised operating systems (OS). However, TEE applications inevitably interact with the untrusted OS through SDK interfaces, and improper partitioning can introduce severe vulnerabilities such as data leakage and code injection. While prior work has proposed static analysis tools to detect such issues, automated repair remains largely unexplored. This problem is particularly challenging due to three TEE-specific factors: the lack of standardized secure development guidelines, the difficulty of extracting semantic information from low-level C code, and the absence of mature testing and validation methods. In this work, we present TEERepair, a framework for automatically repairing bad partitioning issues in TEE applications. Our approach tackles the above challenges by introducing a domain-specific language (DSL) to encode repair rules that express and capture common TEE security patterns, which are instantiated as patch templates with placeholders for context-specific variables. We then leverage large language models (LLMs) to reason about code semantics and synthesize context-aware patches, and further generate test clients to validate the repairs. We evaluate TEERepair on the TEE Partitioning Errors Benchmark (PartitioningE-Bench), achieving a significantly higher repair success rate of 87.6% compared to baselines. Furthermore, applying TEERepair to real-world TEE projects, we submitted 5 repair pull requests, 2 of which have been confirmed and merged by project maintainers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEERepair框架，利用DSL编码修复规则、LLM合成上下文感知补丁、自动生成测试客户端，实现TEE应用分区错误的自动化修复，成功率达87.6%。
AI.motivation: TEE applications interact with untrusted OS through SDK interfaces, and improper partitioning can cause severe vulnerabilities (data leakage, code injection). While static analysis tools exist for detection, automated repair remains unexplored due to three challenges: lack of standardized secure development guidelines, difficulty extracting semantics from low-level C code, and absence of mature testing/validation methods.
AI.method: TEERepair uses a domain-specific language (DSL) to encode repair rules expressing common TEE security patterns, instantiates these as patch templates with placeholders, leverages LLMs for context-aware patch synthesis, and generates test clients for validation.
AI.result: 87.6% repair success rate on PartitioningE-Bench benchmark, 2 out of 5 real-world PRs merged by maintainers.
AI.conclusion: TEERepair achieves 87.6% repair success rate on PartitioningE-Bench, significantly outperforming baselines. Applied to real-world projects, 2 out of 5 submitted PRs have been confirmed and merged by maintainers, demonstrating practical effectiveness.

title: On the Parameterized Complexity of Min-Sum-Radii
summary:
In the Min-Sum-Radii (MSR) clustering problem, we are given a finite set X of n points in a metric space. The objective is to find at most k clusters centered at a subset of these points such that every point of X is assigned to one of the clusters, minimizing the sum of the radii of the clusters. The problem is known to be NP-hard even on metrics induced by weighted planar graphs and metrics with constant doubling dimension, as shown by Gibson et al. (SWAT 2008). In this work, we investigate the parameterized complexity of MSR on metrics induced by undirected graphs. We distinguish between weighted graph metrics (with positive edge weights) and unweighted graph metrics (where all edges have unit weight).
  Weighted Graph Metrics: We show that MSR is W[1]-hard on metrics induced by weighted bipartite graphs, when parameterized by the combined parameter k (the number of clusters) and Delta (the cost of the clustering). We then investigate the structural parameterized complexity of the problem. Drexler et al. (arXiv:2310.02130) showed that the MSR problem admits an XP algorithm on metrics induced by weighted graphs when parameterized by treewidth, and asked whether this can be improved to fixed-parameter tractability. We first answer their question in the negative, and more strongly show that MSR stays W[1]-hard on metrics induced by undirected weighted bipartite graphs when parameterized by the vertex cover number plus k. We then turn our attention to parameters for dense graphs and show that MSR remains W[1]-hard when parameterized by k+Delta even on cliques and complete bipartite graphs. On the positive side, we employ the known XP algorithm parameterized by treewidth, to show that the MSR problem is FPT when parameterized by the parameter treewidth plus Delta.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates parameterized complexity of Min-Sum-Radii (MSR) clustering on graph-induced metrics. Negative results show W[1]-hardness persists even on very structured graphs (cliques, complete bipartite graphs) and with parameters like vertex cover number + k. Positive result shows MSR becomes FPT when parameterized by treewidth + Δ, answering an open question from prior work.
AI.motivation: The MSR problem is NP-hard even on simple metric spaces. This paper explores its parameterized complexity to identify which parameter combinations enable efficient algorithms and which render the problem intractable. A specific open question from prior work (Drexler et al.) asks whether XP with respect to treewidth can be improved to FPT.
AI.method: The hardness results use reductions from k-Clique, establishing W[1]-hardness across various graph classes including cliques and complete bipartite graphs. The positive FPT result employs the existing XP algorithm parameterized by treewidth, incorporating Δ as an additional parameter to achieve fixed-parameter tractability.
AI.result: Negative results: MSR is W[1]-hard on weighted bipartite graphs (k+Δ), weighted bipartite graphs with vertex cover number + k, and cliques/complete bipartite graphs (k+Δ). Positive result: MSR is FPT parameterized by treewidth + Δ.
AI.conclusion: MSR remains W[1]-hard on highly structured graph classes (cliques, complete bipartite graphs, weighted bipartite graphs with bounded vertex cover), but becomes FPT when combining treewidth with the cost parameter Δ. This resolves the open question from Drexler et al. (arXiv:2310.02130) by showing that general weighted graphs cannot yield FPT with treewidth alone, but treewidth+Δ suffices.

title: AI-Driven Multi-Region Provisioning for Cloud Services Using Spot Fleets
summary: Cloud service platforms increasingly rely on elastic infrastructures to support dynamic workloads. Spot instances provide discounted computing resources but introduce uncertainty due to dynamic pricing, resource availability, and interruption risks that vary across geographical regions. In Amazon Web Services, the EC2 Spot Service simplifies fleet provisioning through allocation strategies, but it cannot estimate fleet costs before deployment and restricts provisioning to a single region. This paper presents an AI-driven provisioning service for multi-region spot fleets. The proposed approach combines monitoring of provisioning plans with predictive models to estimate fleet configurations and prices before launch, enabling cost-aware deployment decisions across regions while preserving the operational behavior of the EC2 Spot Service. The system was validated with fleets of up to 1500 vCPUs. Experimental results show a prediction accuracy of 99.79% compared to the EC2 Spot Service and potential cost savings of up to 64% by exploiting regional price variability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI驱动的多区域Spot实例舰队配置服务，通过预测模型在部署前估算成本和配置，结合区域价格差异分析，在保持原EC2 Spot Service功能的前提下实现成本优化部署。
AI.motivation: 现有EC2 Spot Service存在两个关键局限：无法在部署前估算成本，且仅限于单区域配置。这导致用户难以做出成本优化的跨区域部署决策。
AI.method: 该方法结合了供应计划监控与预测模型，在部署前估算多区域Spot实例 fleets 的配置与价格。系统保留EC2 Spot Service的运营行为，同时实现跨区域成本感知部署决策。
AI.result: 该AI驱动服务实现了多区域Spot fleets的智能配置，支持部署前的成本预测与跨区域成本感知决策。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证表明，与EC2 Spot Service相比预测准确率达99.79%，通过利用区域间价格差异潜在节省成本高达64%，系统可扩展至1500 vCPU规模。

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Decentralized Memory
summary: Self-evolving multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising route to LLM agents that continually improve from experience, with persistent memory at their foundation. However, existing designs almost exclusively adopt a centralized repository shared across agents, incurring communication and coordination overhead, raising privacy concerns, and collapsing agent diversity. We propose DecentMem, a decentralized memory framework in which each agent maintains its own dual-pool memory -- an exploitation pool of consolidated past trajectories and an exploration pool of LLM-generated candidates for unseen contexts. The two pools are reweighted online based on stage-wise feedback from an LLM-as-a-judge. Theoretically, we prove that this design guarantees global reachability of the solution space and achieves $O(\log T)$ cumulative regret, matching the stochastic bandit lower bound up to constants. In practice, across three MAS frameworks (AutoGen, DyLAN, AgentNet), three Qwen3 backbones (4B/8B/14B), two Gemma4 backbones (E2B/E4B) and five benchmarks spanning math, code, QA, and embodied tasks, DecentMem improves average accuracy by up to 23.8% over the strongest centralized memory baseline and by up to 52.5% over the no-memory baseline, while reducing token usage by up to 49%.

AI.tldr: DecentMem是一种去中心化记忆框架，通过双池架构（exploitation+exploration）和LLM-as-judge在线调整，实现O(log T)理论最优regret，实践中可在多种配置下将精度提升最高23.8%并将token使用降低49%。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS系统几乎都采用跨智能体共享的集中式记忆库，存在通信协调开销、隐私泄露风险和智能体多样性丧失等问题，亟需去中心化记忆框架以提升系统效率、隐私性和多样性。
AI.method: 提出双池记忆架构：每个智能体维护独立的exploitation pool（存储已验证轨迹）和exploration pool（存储LLM生成的候选探索），两池通过LLM-as-judge进行在线权重调整，实现局部优化与全局探索的平衡。
AI.result: 实验覆盖3个MAS框架、5种模型（Qwen3 4B/8B/14B、Gemma4 E2B/E4B）和5类基准测试，在保持甚至提升精度的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: DecentMem通过去中心化设计解决传统集中式记忆的瓶颈问题，理论证明达到最优 regret 界（O(log T)），实践中在多个框架、模型和任务上均取得显著提升（最高23.8%的精度提升和49%的token节省），证明了去中心化记忆架构的有效性和实用性。

title: Diversed Model Discovery via Structured Table Discovery
summary: Model cards describe model behavior through a mixture of textual descriptions and structured artifacts, including performance, configuration, and dataset tables. Existing model search systems rely predominantly on semantic similarity over text, which can produce homogeneous result sets and limit exploration of alternatives. We argue that model search is inherently comparative: users want models that are task-aligned yet differentiated in measurable ways. We hypothesize that this balance requires retrieval over condensed, high-quality evidence rather than verbose descriptions, and much of that evidence is concentrated in structured tables. We present StructuredSemanticSearch, a table-driven model search framework built on the ModelTables benchmark. Given a query, StructuredSemanticSearch combines a semantic baseline for task alignment with a structure-aware pipeline that discovers query-related model-card tables using table discovery operators such as unionability, joinability, and keyword search. Retrieved tables are mapped back to model cards under a controlled top-k budget, enabling fair comparison between text-based and table-based retrieval. Beyond retrieval, StructuredSemanticSearch adapts table integration to the model-table domain through orientation-aware integration, producing compact integrated views of tables from partially overlapping and sometimes transposed evidence tables. For evaluation, we introduce a nugget-based, auditable protocol that extracts compact evidence items from model cards, matches queries to condition- or intent-specific nuggets, and measures evidence coverage and diversity over retrieved model-card candidate sets. This protocol also provides a scalable path toward approximate, evidence-based labeling in dynamic model lakes. Experiments on 597 model-recommendation queries show improved nugget coverage for the structure-aware pipeline than semantic baseline

AI.tldr: 提出StructuredSemanticSearch框架，通过结构化表格检索增强模型搜索能力，实验证明该方法相比纯语义基线方法能提供更好的证据覆盖。
AI.motivation: Existing model search systems rely predominantly on semantic similarity over text, which produces homogeneous result sets and limits exploration of differentiated alternatives. The authors argue that model search should be inherently comparative—balancing task alignment with measurable differentiation—and that much of the key evidence for this lies in structured tables rather than verbose textual descriptions.
AI.method: A table-driven model search framework combining semantic baseline for task alignment with structure-aware pipeline. Uses table discovery operators (unionability, joinability, keyword search), controlled top-k budget for fair comparison, and orientation-aware table integration for handling partially overlapping/transposed evidence tables. Evaluation employs a nugget-based protocol that extracts compact evidence items, matches queries to condition/intent-specific nuggets, and measures evidence coverage and diversity.
AI.result: Experiments on 597 model-recommendation queries show improved nugget coverage for the structure-aware pipeline than semantic baseline methods.
AI.conclusion: The structured table-based retrieval approach demonstrates improved nugget coverage compared to purely semantic baseline methods in model search tasks.

title: Reflective Prompt Tuning through Language Model Function-Calling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of following instructions and complex reasoning, making prompting a flexible interface for adapting models without parameter updates. Yet prompt design remains labor-intensive and highly sensitive to formatting, phrasing, and instruction order, motivating automated prompt optimization methods that reduce manual effort while preserving inference-time flexibility. However, existing methods often search over prompt candidates or use fixed critique-refine pipelines driven by individual examples or small batches, limiting their ability to capture systematic error patterns and make targeted edits grounded in failure history. We propose Reflective Prompt Tuning (RPT), a framework that uses LLM function calling to simulate the iterative workflow of human prompt engineers. An LLM optimizer calls a diagnostic function that evaluates the target model over an entire optimization set, summarizes recurring failure modes, and returns a structured diagnostic report. The optimizer uses this report, together with an accumulated memory of prior reports, to revise the prompt for the next iteration. RPT further supports confidence-aware optimization by using calibration signals in diagnostic feedback and final prompt selection. Across three reasoning tasks, RPT improves over initial prompts by up to 12.9 points, remains competitive with state of the art, and improves confidence calibration. Our analyses show that RPT is especially effective on multi-hop and mathematical reasoning, producing targeted prompt revisions that align with diagnosed failure patterns and lead to gains in task performance and calibration.

AI.tldr: RPT是一种自动化提示词优化框架，通过LLM函数调用模拟人类工程师的迭代诊断-修订工作流程，利用全量优化集的诊断报告和历史记忆生成针对性提示修订，在推理任务上取得显著改进并改善了置信度校准。
