AI.result: 敏感性：CV 中位数为中等水平（2–6%），但分布长尾显著——BGE 系列在个别任务上 CV 达 30–45%，即特定模型-任务组合高度依赖提示。通胀/通缩双向存在：BGE 在 TweetSentimentClassification、AmazonCounterfactualClassification、STS22.v2 上报告分位于分布下尾（通缩，甚至远低于主分布），Qwen3 在 MIRACL 上的报告分对应分布上部的次峰（通胀），说明默认提示分别系统性低估与高估期望性能。排名不稳健：默认提示下排名为 KaLM(1.46)、Qwen3(1.54)、e5-large(3.01)、bge-large(4.05)、bge-base(5.35)、bge-small(5.58)，且顶部两者与底部两组的 bootstrap 区间重叠（如 bge-small [4,6]），说明当前序本身未被统计分离；在「最优自我/最差对手」的对抗设定下 6 个模型全部可达或接近第 1（KaLM、Qwen3 的 CI 甚至为 [1,1]），bge-small 从末位跃至第 1；在「最优自我/他人默认」的温和设定下 bge-large 从第 5 升至第 3 并超过 e5-large，说明单个贡献者的无恶意提示优化即可扭曲榜单；随机提示抽样结果趋势一致。Prompt inflation 概率分析显示多数模型的报告分高于提示分布中位数，与 Simmons et al. (2011) 的 p-hacking 类似，作者据此命名为「prompt hacking」——仅选择性报告一条有利提示、不改动权重/数据/架构即可合规完成，且未必出于故意（类比 Gelman & Loken 的分析自由度与无意偏差）。附录最佳/最差提示显示极值差距可达数十个百分点（如 Touche2020Retrieval：bge-large 最差 0.014 vs 最好 0.471；MIRACL：bge-small 0.019 vs 0.455；FEVER：bge-large 0.309 vs 0.873）。作者另指出，尝试少量任务定制提示可在几乎零成本下带来最高约 10 个百分点的性能增益，可视为实践者的正向资产。
AI.conclusion: 结论与建议：单提示评估对指令化嵌入模型不充分，报告分数经常错误表征期望性能；MTEB 默认提示可同时高估或低估模型质量，排行榜可被提示选择任意重排。建议基准转向多提示评估，至少在点估计之外报告得分分布或稳健性指标（如 CV、分数区间）；模型开发者则应针对提示稳健性做优化，或采用如 Jina v5 系列那样的受限提示方案。局限：仅评估 6 个参数 ≤0.6B 的开源权重模型，未覆盖更大模型与闭源模型（如 text-embedding-3、embed-v4）；每任务约 40 条提示、且主要由单一 LLM 合成，样本量偏小导致 CV 等方差估计存在不可忽略的不确定性，且未必覆盖实践者提示的真实多样性；分析仅限英文，多语场景可能引入语言特定措辞与翻译伪影；未系统研究提示搜索/集成等利用策略，实践中应尝试多少条提示仍为开放问题。

title: Comparing LLM and Fine-Tuned Model Performance on NVDRS Circumstance Extraction with Varying Prompt Complexity
summary: Suicide is a leading cause of death in the United States, and understanding the circumstances that precede it requires extracting structured information from death investigation narratives. Many of these circumstances require semantic inference beyond simple keyword matching. We develop a ``Complexity Score'' algorithm that analyzes coding manual structure to predict when detailed prompts with full coding guidelines improve over name-only prompts. We then construct a hybrid approach that selects prompt strategy per circumstance. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) against fine-tuned RoBERTa on 25 inferentially complex circumstances from the National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS). We found that LLMs substantially outperform on low-prevalence circumstances where training data is insufficient. We further demonstrate that our framework generalizes across frontier LLMs, with GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Llama-3 70B showing consistent performance patterns. These findings support a hybrid architecture where LLMs handle rare, inferentially complex circumstances while fine-tuned models handle common ones.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对死亡调查叙述中的语义推理挑战，开发了Complexity Score算法来预测最佳提示策略，构建了混合框架——由LLM处理罕见推理复杂circumstances，微调模型处理常见circumstances，在NVDRS的25种复杂circumstances上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 美国自杀是主要死因之一，理解其前因需要从死亡调查叙述中提取结构化信息，且许多circumstances需要超越简单关键词匹配的语义推理。
AI.method: 开发了"Complexity Score"算法分析编码手册结构来预测详细提示何时优于仅名称提示；构建了一种混合方法，根据circumstances选择提示策略；在NVDRS的25种推理复杂circumstances上评估LLM与微调RoBERTa的性能。
AI.result: LLM在训练数据不足的低患病率circumstances上显著优于微调模型；混合方法根据circumstances选择提示策略效果良好。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个混合架构框架，其中LLM处理罕见、推理复杂的circumstances，而微调模型处理常见的circumstances。该框架在GPT-5.2、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Llama-3 70B等多个前沿LLM上表现出一致的性能模式，证明了其可推广性。

title: Who Uses AI? Platforms, Workforce, and AI Exposure
summary: A growing literature uses artificial intelligence platform conversation logs to measure occupation exposure. We show that these scores partly measure platform user base rather than the workforce. Holding outcome, sample, controls, and estimator fixed while varying only the platform input changes the post-ChatGPT employment coefficient by a factor of 1.9, and within-vendor consumer-versus-enterprise channels produce estimates that disagree in sign. Reweighting to Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce shares attenuates estimates by 42 to 93 percent. We formalize the non-classical measurement error, derive probability limits and partial-identification bounds for employment elasticities. The bias understates substitution more than augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于AI平台对话日志测量职业暴露度的关键方法论缺陷：平台用户群体与真实劳动力存在系统性偏差，导致就业效应估计严重偏误。研究通过变更平台输入、渠道对比和重置权重三种策略证实偏误存在，并提供了偏误修正的理论框架（概率极限与部分识别边界）。
AI.motivation: 人工智能对劳动力市场影响的研究高度依赖AI暴露度测量工具，而当前主流方法采用AI平台对话日志构建暴露度指标，但此类指标可能受平台用户结构偏差的干扰，导致估计结果反映的是平台用户特征而非真实劳动力市场状况。
AI.method: 通过固定模型设定（outcome、sample、controls、estimator）而仅改变平台输入数据，识别平台选择效应；利用BLS劳动力份额进行重置权重（reweighting）以校正样本偏误；构建非经典测量误差框架，推导Employment弹性系数的概率极限（probability limits）及部分识别边界（partial-identification bounds）。
AI.result: 仅更换AI平台输入数据即可使post-ChatGPT就业系数变化1.9倍；同平台不同渠道（消费者版vs企业版）的估计结果符号相反；采用BLS数据重置后，暴露度估计值衰减42%至93%，表明现有研究存在严重的测量误差偏误。
AI.conclusion: 平台用户群体与真实劳动力结构存在系统性差异，导致AI职业暴露度测量的严重偏误。该偏差对替代效应（substitution）的低估程度超过增强效应（augmentation），提示现有研究可能系统性低估了AI对劳动力市场的替代性冲击。政策制定者在参考此类研究结论时需保持审慎。

title: Discovering Entity-Conditioned Lag Heterogeneity: A Lag-Gated Neural Audit Framework for Panel Time Series
comment: Preprint/technical paper. An interpretable neural audit framework for entity-conditioned lag discovery in panel time series. 10 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code available at the GitHub repository
summary: Country-level temporal panels are widely used in empirical analysis. Researchers often need to audit how different entities respond to historical signals over different time horizons. Current approaches typically do not provide directly auditable entity-specific lag summaries. We formulate entity-conditioned heterogeneous lag discovery as a temporal panel mining task and propose AC-GATE, an Adaptive-Conditioning Encoder with a Scale-Invariant Lag Gate. It instantiates conditional Moderated Distributed Lag by using observable entity-level proxies to condition lag-weight distributions over historical observations, thereby making effective lags structural outputs of the model rather than post-hoc explanations. The evaluation is based on a layered audit protocol that separates predictive calibration from lag discovery. A synthetic panel with known ground-truth lags is used for mechanism recovery testing, and two real-world country-level panels are used for external audit and stress testing. The results show that AC-GATE can recover heterogeneous lag structure in synthetic data, and generates non-degenerate, externally structured effective lags in real data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AC-GATE（自适应条件编码器 + 尺度不变滞后门控），把"实体条件化的滞后异质性发现"形式化为面板时间序列挖掘任务：先用代理向量 p_i 编码为标量条件分数 z_i，再映射为每实体在 K 个滞后上的权重分布 ω_i，以 k*_i=Σ_k k·ω_{i,k} 作为结构性（而非事后解释）输出。配合分层审计协议 L0–L3（预测校准 / 退化守卫 / 外部分层对齐 / 真值恢复），AC-GATE 在合成面板上能恢复已知滞后（Spearman 0.945/0.907），在 PWT 经济与 OWID+WGI 能源两个真实国家面板上产生非退化且与人力资本、法治、政府效能等外部分层变量显著对齐的有效滞后（mean|ρ| 0.257–0.735，Fisher p 至 1e-79），代理打乱负控使对齐坍塌。但作者明确声明：真实数据上预测 R² 近零，AC-GATE 不具预测优势，贡献是可审计的滞后结构产出而非新预测基准。
AI.motivation: 国家/地区层面的时序面板被广泛用于实证分析，但研究者常需回答"不同实体对历史信号的反应时间尺度是否系统性不同"。经济计量文献指出跨实体参数异质性可能表现为离散制度、分布位置差异或变量选择结构差异，综述亦将横截面异质性、时间依赖、非平稳与可解释性列为面板预测的核心难题；单一全局滞后结构过于受限（生产率分析中技术/能力类投入存在调整期与互补投资，能源与排放文献中可再生能源、能效与制度条件的影响随国家发展阶段与排放体制而变）。现有深度模型（TFT 的静态协变量+循环+注意力+门控、GA-Net 的输入依赖门控）虽具一定解释输出，但目标是预测性能与全局解释，不产出可跨实体比较、且可被直接检验的稳定滞后权重分布；且仅凭高精度预测不足以断言模型学到了异质滞后结构——面板机器学习中的同期协变量、随机单元-时间切分、可用性泄漏会夸大样本外表现，后验解释也可能不忠实不完整。故需把"学到的有效滞后"当作模型导出的可审计摘要，并把预测校准与滞后发现分层评价。
AI.method: 任务设定：平衡面板，实体 i、时点 t，序贯协变量 X_{i,t}∈R^{dx}、标量目标 Y_{i,t}，每个实体有时不变代理向量 p_i∈R^M 与静态特征 s_i；最大滞后阶 K，目标是学到归一化非负的实体级滞后权重 ω_i=(ω_{i,1..K})，Σ_k ω_{i,k}=1，并以 c_{i,t}=Σ_k ω_{i,k}·X̃_{i,t−k} 聚合历史表示，定义有效滞后 k*_i=Σ_k k·ω_{i,k}（仅依赖 z_i，故对固定实体跨时间恒定，可审计）。模型 AC-GATE：①自适应条件编码器 z_i=f_φ(p_i)∈R，并投影进 LSTM 初始状态；②重建头 p̂_i=g_ψ(z_i) 提供辅助重建目标（detached 变体仅训练解码器，non-detached 变体对编码器施加信息保留约束）；③尺度不变滞后门 ω_{i,k}=Softmax_k((g_θ(z_i)_k − λ·k/K)/τ)，以 λ·k/K 的归一化相对位置偏置惩罚远端滞后（对 K 尺度不变），τ 控制分布锐度；④骨干为两层 LSTM，输入含滞后上下文流、实体嵌入、静态特征与可选宏观控制；关键信息流约束：当前时刻 X_{i,t} 不直接拼接进骨干，仅滞后观测经 c_{i,t} 进入，以切断同期捷径与泄漏路径；⑤损失 L = L_task(MSE 预测) + λ_r·L_recon（λ_r 与位置偏置 λ 含义不同）；复杂度 O(NT(KF+LH(F+H)))，门控每实体一次 O(NKH)。审计协议（算法 1，20 个随机种子）：L0 报告测试 MSE/MAE/R²；L1 退化守卫，若跨实体 sd_i(k*)≤ε 则该种子标记退化、不进入 L2；L2 对每个预指定分层变量 ξ 算种子级 Spearman(k*, ξ)，用实体标签置换零分布（B 次）得 p=(1+#{|ρ^(b)|≥|ρ|})/(B+1)，取绝对值做符号鲁棒检验，并汇总 mean|ρ|、Pr(p<0.05) 与 Fisher 合并 p；L3 仅在有真值时计算 MAE/Spearman。基线为 Plain LSTM、TFT、GA-Net、Grouped ARDL；结构消融为 No-AC-Encoder（z 固定）、Uniform-Lag（ω=1/K）、No-Recon-Reg（λ_r=0）；负控为代理打乱（置换 p_i 跨实体、保持数据/切分/架构不变）。数据集：合成面板（线性/非线性 DGP，真值滞后中心 k_i^c 由潜在 z_i 生成）、PWT 11.0（目标 ctfp，1980–2007/2008–2013/2014–2023）、OWID Energy+WGI（目标 co2_per_unit_energy，1996–2011/2012–2017/2018–2023）。配对比较用种子级配对 Wilcoxon；真实数据不用 Wilcoxon 支撑滞后审计主张，仅用于 L0 指标，分层对齐靠逐种子置换检验与跨种子 Fisher 聚合。
AI.result: 合成数据（机制恢复，L3）：AC-GATE 与真实滞后中心的 Spearman 为 0.945（线性）与 0.907（非线性），k* MAE 分别为 1.159(0.227) 与 1.467(0.248)；No-AC-Encoder 与 Uniform-Lag 的秩对齐近零（0.000），因实体级滞后变异被结构性坍塌；配对 Wilcoxon 显示 AC-GATE 的 k* MAE 显著优于全部基线/消融（p=1.9e-6），No-Recon-Reg 与 AC-GATE 无显著差异（p=0.498/0.368），说明重建项只是辅助稳定器而非恢复来源。真实数据（L0）：所有深度模型（含 AC-GATE 与消融）测试 R² 集中在近零带 [-0.05,0.10]，Grouped ARDL 出现符号翻转（经济 −0.089，能源 +0.607），故仅凭 R² 排名不稳定，作者据此不主张预测优势（Verdict 矩阵 L0 标为 not certified）。L1：经济域 AC-GATE 跨实体 k* 标准差约 0.167（No-Recon 0.109），能源域 0.108；No-AC-Encoder 与 Uniform-Lag 全 20 种子退化（σ=0），Plain LSTM/TFT/GA-Net 的 k* 仅为诊断性统计、非门控结构输出。L2：经济域 human capital mean|ρ|=0.371（Fisher p=1e-46）、log GDP/worker 0.278（3.5e-37）、log capital/worker 0.257（1.4e-24），65–80% 种子置换 p<0.05；能源域 rule of law 0.735（1.8e-79）、government effectiveness 0.716（9.0e-77）、log GDP per capita 0.609（1.5e-77），90–95% 种子显著；描述性方向为负相关（人力资本 ρ=−0.63, p≈3e-11；法治 ρ=−0.61, p≈3e-9），即能力/制度更强的实体被赋予更短的有效记忆，与吸收能力与制度容量论证一致。负控（代理打乱）：经济域 mean|ρ| 由 0.302 降至 0.058、Frac(p<5%) 由 0.72 降至 0.00–0.07、Fisher p 0.94–1.00；能源域由 0.686 降至 0.088、Frac 降至 0.07、Fisher p 0.39–0.75；而测试 R² 几乎不变（0.054→0.055；−0.029→−0.028），表明 L2 对齐依赖正确的代理—实体配对，而非模型容量或预测表现。Verdict 矩阵：合成域 L1/L2/L3 均支持；经济与能源域 L1/L2 支持、L3 标为 n/a（无监督机制标签）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献定位为"把面板学习中的滞后分析从非正式的解释层提升为显式的审计目标"：给出可复现的滞后审计设计（可检查坍塌、外部结构、合成可恢复性的统一协议），而非新的预测基准。核心归纳偏置被消融定位为"实体条件化 + 显式滞后门控"的组合：移除 AC 编码器或改为均匀滞后会消除实体级滞后变异，使分层对齐无从谈起；移除重建正则几乎不改变结果。重要限定与局限：k* 仅为模型导出的"有效滞后摘要"，不是因果时滞估计；真实面板预测性能无优势甚至略逊于 Grouped ARDL，故真实证据仅限 L1/L2 的结构化摘要；L2 采用符号鲁棒（绝对 Spearman）设计，因为隐变量滞后分数的符号在种子间可能翻转（表中种子均值 ρ 近零而 mean|ρ| 较大），且分层变量仅来自检验前历史信息，只能说明与既有实体特征对齐而非方向性语义或因果；基线的 k* 仅为诊断统计，不可与门控结构输出等同解释。未来工作包括扩展到更多面板类型与预测任务、更复杂的实体条件编码器与更灵活的滞后门机制，以及结合领域知识设计更有针对性的外部分层变量并在更多经验背景中检验所发现滞后结构与经领域验证机制的关系。

title: Why Are Agentic Pull Requests Merged or Rejected? An Empirical Study
comment: Accepted for publication in 23rd international conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR 2026) : 5 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure
summary: AI coding agents increasingly submit pull requests (Agentic-PRs) to open-source repositories, yet their performance is commonly assessed using merge and rejection outcomes alone. We hypothesized that these outcome labels do not reliably reflect agent capability without considering review interactions. To test this, we conducted a decision-oriented analysis of 11,048 closed Agentic Pull Requests, refined to 9,799 human-reviewed PRs, and manually inspected 717 representative cases to recover decision rationale from interaction artifacts. We found that rejection outcomes substantially overstate agent error: only 35.7% of rejected PRs reflected clear agentic failures, while 31.2% were driven by workflow constraints and 33.1% lacked observable decision rationale. Among merged PRs, 15.4% required explicit reviewer involvement through feedback or direct commits, and 5.5% showed no visible interaction trace. We further observed systematic differences across agents, with Copilot and Devin more often embedded in reviewer-mediated workflows, while Codex and Cursor PRs were typically merged with minimal interaction. These results reject the assumption that PR outcomes alone capture agent performance and demonstrate the need for interaction-aware evaluation grounded in review behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现仅依靠PR结果（合并/拒绝）无法准确评估AI编程智能体能力，因为拒绝结果高估了智能体错误（约64%由其他因素导致），合并结果也常低估审查者参与度，需要建立基于审查行为的交互感知评估体系。
AI.motivation: 当前对AI编程智能体性能的评估仅依赖合并和拒绝结果，但作者假设这些结果标签在没有考虑审查交互的情况下无法可靠反映智能体能力。
AI.method: 对11,048个已关闭的智能体PR进行决策导向分析，精简至9,799个人类审查的PR，并手动检查了717个代表性案例，从交互痕迹中还原决策逻辑。
AI.result: 仅35.7%的被拒绝PR反映明显的智能体错误，31.2%由工作流约束驱动，33.1%缺乏可观察的决策逻辑；15.4%的合并PR需要审查者的显式参与，5.5%无可见交互痕迹；不同智能体间存在系统性差异，Copilot和Devin更多嵌入审查者介导的工作流，而Codex和Cursor PR通常以最小交互方式合并。
AI.conclusion: 研究拒绝了"PR结果单独反映智能体性能"的假设，证明了需要基于审查行为的交互感知评估方法。

title: Cross-domain benchmarks reveal when coordinated AI agents improve scientific inference from partial evidence
summary: Scientific evidence often spans instruments, databases, and disciplines, so no single source records the full phenomenon. This makes it difficult to determine when coordinated AI agents add value over simpler scientific workflows. We evaluate this question with a cross-domain benchmark spanning four scientific tasks: mapping molecular structure into musical representations, detecting historical paradigm shifts in science, identifying vector-borne disease emergence, and vetting transiting-exoplanet candidates. Each case uses a frozen evaluation panel, predefined scoring protocols, explicit baselines, ablations or null controls, and stated limitations. The results define three operating regimes. When different disciplines each capture only part of the phenomenon, cross-channel composites improve over single-channel baselines: climate-vector emergence reaches AUROC 0.944 and exoplanet vetting reaches AUROC 0.955. However, the exoplanet workflow is effectively tied with a strong combined-summary baseline, showing that decomposition does not always improve top-line performance. When one signal dominates, as in paradigm-shift detection, coordination mainly improves interpretation and traceability. For molecular sonification, the gain is representational rather than predictive. ScienceClaw x Infinite provides the auditable artifact and provenance layer for this evaluation. The benchmark therefore assigns value to coordination only when the corresponding performance, provenance, or representation claim is supported by explicit comparators.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过四任务跨领域基准测试评估协调AI智能体在科学工作流中的价值。发现在多学科信息互补场景下协调可带来性能提升（AUROC 0.94-0.96），但单信号主导场景下价值主要体现在可解释性和溯源性，而分子声化任务中仅提供表征性增益。
AI.motivation: 科学证据通常横跨仪器、数据库和学科，单一来源无法记录完整现象。需要确定协调AI智能体何时能在简单科学工作流上增加价值。
AI.method: 跨领域基准测试，覆盖四个科学任务：(1)将分子结构映射为音乐表示；(2)检测科学中的历史范式转变；(3)识别虫媒疾病的出现；(4)审查凌日系外行星候选体。每个任务使用冻结评估面板、预定义评分协议、明确基线、消融或空白对照，以及明确声明的局限性。
AI.result: 定义了三种操作模式：①多学科互补时，交叉通道组合改善性能（气候-载体疾病识别AUROC达0.944；系外行星审查AUROC达0.955），但系外行星工作流与强组合摘要基线效果相当；②单信号主导时（如范式转变检测），协调主要改善解释和可追溯性；③分子声化，增益体现在表征层面而非预测层面。
AI.conclusion:
跨通道组合仅在以下情况下优于单通道基线：不同学科各自仅捕获现象的一部分。当一个信号占主导地位时，协作主要改善可解释性和可追溯性。对于分子声化，增益是表征性的而非预测性的。基准测试要求协作的价值必须通过明确的比较器来证明。

工具支撑：ScienceClaw x Infinite 提供可审计的工件和溯源层。

title: ACC: Compiling Agent Trajectories for Long-Context Training
summary: Recent development of agents has renewed demand for long-context reasoning capacity of LLMs. However, training LLMs for this capacity requires costly long-document curation or heuristic context synthesis. We observe that agents produce massive trajectories when solving problems, invoking tools and receiving environment observations across many turns. The evidence needed to answer the original question is thus scattered throughout these turns, requiring integration of distant context segments. Nevertheless, standard agent SFT masks tool responses and only trains turn-level tool selection, creating a supervision blind spot where these scattered signals go unused. We propose Agent Context Compilation (ACC), which converts trajectories from search, software engineering, and database querying agents into long-context QA pairs that combine the original question with tool responses and environment observations gathered across multiple turns, training the model to answer directly without tool use. This makes the dependencies between the question and the evidence explicit, enabling direct supervision of long-context reasoning over distant segments without additional annotation. ACC is a simple but effective approach that can be combined with any existing long-context extension or training method, providing scalable supervised fine-tuning data. We validate ACC on long-range dependency modeling tasks through MRCR and GraphWalks, challenging benchmarks requiring cross-turn coreference resolution and graph traversal over extended contexts. Training Qwen3-30B-A3B with ACC achieves 68.3 on MRCR (+18.1) and 77.5 on GraphWalks (+7.6), results comparable to Qwen3-235B-A22B, while preserving general capabilities on GPQA, MMLU-Pro, AIME, and IFEval. Further mechanism analysis reveals that the ACC-trained model exhibits task-adaptive attention restructuring and expert specialization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Agent Context Compilation (ACC)方法，将Agent轨迹转换为长上下文问答对来训练LLM的长距离依赖推理能力，无需昂贵的文档标注。该方法使问题与证据间的依赖关系显式化，可在任意现有长上下文扩展方法上叠加使用。实验表明ACC训练的Qwen3-30B-A3B在MRCR和GraphWalks上分别提升18.1和7.6分，性能接近235B参数的旗舰模型，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: Training LLMs for long-context reasoning capacity requires costly long-document curation or heuristic context synthesis. Agent systems produce massive trajectories during problem-solving, with relevant evidence scattered across multiple turns. However, standard agent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) masks tool responses and only trains turn-level tool selection, creating a supervision blind spot where scattered signals remain unused.
AI.method: Agent Context Compilation (ACC) converts agent trajectories (from search, software engineering, and database querying agents) into long-context QA pairs. This process combines the original question with tool responses and environment observations gathered across multiple turns, then trains the model to answer directly without tool use. This approach makes dependencies between questions and evidence explicit, enabling direct supervision of long-context reasoning over distant context segments.
AI.result: Training Qwen3-30B-A3B with ACC achieves 68.3 on MRCR (+18.1) and 77.5 on GraphWalks (+7.6), results comparable to the much larger Qwen3-235B-A22B model. The trained model preserves general capabilities on GPQA, MMLU-Pro, AIME, and IFEval benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: Agent Context Compilation (ACC) is a simple yet effective method for training long-context reasoning capabilities in LLMs. By converting agent trajectories into long-context QA pairs, ACC enables direct supervision of reasoning over distant context segments without additional annotation. The approach is generalizable and combinable with existing long-context extension methods. Notably, the 3B model trained with ACC achieves performance comparable to a 235B model on certain benchmarks, while maintaining general capabilities across diverse tasks. Mechanism analysis reveals that ACC induces adaptive attention restructuring and expert specialization in the trained models.

title: A Causal Argumentation Method for Explainability of Machine Learning Models
comment: To be published in The 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) methods identify which features are relevant to a model's predictions but often fail to clarify why certain decisions are made. In this work, we present a novel method that integrates causality with argument-based reasoning to explain why models may be making predictions. Our approach first identifies causal relationships among variables using causal discovery methods and then translates these into a Bipolar Argumentation Framework (BAF) to represent supportive and opposing interactions among features. By using semi-stable semantics, we find extensions of features that explain why certain outcomes may have been chosen. We demonstrate our method on two benchmark datasets and compare its results against standard post-hoc explainability approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合因果推理与论证框架的可解释AI方法，通过因果发现识别变量间关系，并将其转化为双极论证框架(BAF)表示特征的支撑与对立关系，利用半稳定语义推导解释性扩展。实验表明该方法相比标准事后可解释方法具有优势。
AI.motivation: Standard XAI methods identify relevant features but fail to explain the reasoning behind model decisions. There's a need for more interpretable explanations that clarify why certain predictions are made.
AI.method: Causal discovery methods are applied to identify relationships among variables, which are then encoded as a Bipolar Argumentation Framework (BAF) representing supportive and opposing feature interactions. Semi-stable semantics are used to derive explanatory extensions.
AI.result: The proposed method was evaluated on two benchmark datasets and showed favorable comparison against standard post-hoc explainability approaches.
AI.conclusion: The method demonstrates that integrating causal discovery with argumentation frameworks provides more interpretable explanations compared to standard post-hoc XAI approaches.

title: Provable Joint Decontamination for Benchmarking Multiple Large Language Models
summary: Benchmark data contamination has become a central challenge in LLM evaluation: when evaluation examples appear in the training data of one or more audited models, reported performance can be inflated and cross-model comparisons become unreliable. A broad line of training-data detection work designs scores to quantify how strongly a model memorizes a given data point, but these score-based methods lack theoretical guarantees. Recent conformal approaches provide provable false-identification control for a single model; however, applying them separately to each model can produce model-specific benchmarks, undermining fair comparison across models. In this work, we formalize multi-model benchmark decontamination as a joint selection problem and propose Joint Envelope Conformal Selection (JECS), a conformal procedure that enables global contamination rate (GCR) control under stated assumptions. Specifically, JECS computes per-model conformal p-values, aggregates them by the per-item maximum, and reconstructs a conservative envelope of the max-p null distribution from right-tail observations above a data-driven threshold. By applying the adaptive Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure to the envelope-rescaled values, we select a benchmark with provable GCR control. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate that JECS achieves higher power than the max-p baseline while consistently maintaining the target GCR control.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses LLM benchmark contamination by proposing JECS, a conformal selection procedure that ensures fair cross-model comparison with provable global contamination rate control.
AI.motivation: Benchmark data contamination inflates reported performance and undermines reliable cross-model comparisons when evaluation examples appear in training data.
AI.method: JECS computes per-model conformal p-values, aggregates them by per-item maximum, reconstructs a conservative envelope of the max-p null distribution from right-tail observations above a data-driven threshold, then applies the adaptive Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to select benchmarks.
AI.result: JECS achieves higher power than the max-p baseline while consistently maintaining the target global contamination rate control across various models and benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: JECS enables provable global contamination rate control while maintaining fair cross-model comparison.

title: Contractual Skills: A GovernSpec Design Framework for Enterprise AI Agents
summary:
Skills are increasingly used to package agent instructions, workflows, scripts, and reference materials. In enterprise settings, however, skills often need to express more than task guidance: they must make goals, input boundaries, permissions, evidence requirements, output contracts, quality criteria, verification steps, human approval points, and handoff rules inspectable. This paper proposes contractual skills, a GovernSpec-inspired design framework for organizing SKILL.md files as readable task contracts while preserving lightweight skill discovery and progressive loading. The framework clarifies the boundary between contractual skills, GovernSpec YAML contracts, Model Context Protocol surfaces, tool adapters, runtime guardrails, tracing, and evaluation systems.
  We evaluate the framework with two offline experiments. A text-generation study covers three enterprise skills, fifteen synthetic tasks, four instruction conditions, and eight generation models, yielding 960 outputs and 1680 cross-judge score records. Contractual skills outperform no-skill and minimal-skill baselines on all tested models. Relative to information-rich plain expanded skills, the gains are small and mixed, suggesting that contractual fields mainly improve checkability and maintainability rather than raw generation quality. A tool-calling challenge covers eight models and 192 simulated tool-call records. Skills usually reduce high-risk tool attempts, but model differences remain and runtime tool guardrails are still required. The results suggest that contractual skills are best understood as a governance layer that makes task intent, boundaries, and acceptance criteria explicit, not as a standalone safety mechanism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"合同技能"(Contractual Skills)框架，用GovernSpec设计思路组织SKILL.md文件，使其成为可读的任务契约，同时保持轻量级技能发现和渐进式加载。实验表明该框架主要改善了任务意图、边界和验收标准的可检查性和可维护性，而非单纯的生成质量或安全性。
AI.motivation: In enterprise settings, skills need to express more than task guidance—they must make goals, input boundaries, permissions, evidence requirements, output contracts, quality criteria, verification steps, human approval points, and handoff rules inspectable. Existing approaches lack clarity on where contractual skills fit relative to YAML contracts, MCP surfaces, tool adapters, runtime guardrails, tracing, and evaluation systems.
AI.method: Two offline experiments: (1) A text-generation study with 3 enterprise skills, 15 synthetic tasks, 4 instruction conditions, 8 generation models (960 outputs, 1680 cross-judge scores); (2) A tool-calling challenge with 8 models and 192 simulated tool-call records.
AI.result: Contractual skills outperform no-skill and minimal-skill baselines on all tested models. Gains over information-rich plain expanded skills are small and mixed. Skills usually reduce high-risk tool attempts, but model differences remain and runtime guardrails are still required.
AI.conclusion: The results suggest that contractual skills should be understood as a governance layer for making task intent, boundaries, and acceptance criteria explicit, rather than as a standalone safety mechanism.

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque channel through which sensitive content may propagate across agents without explicit textual disclosure. To address this, we introduce \textbf{LCGuard} (Latent Communication Guard), a framework for safe KV-based latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems. LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. We formalize representation-level sensitive information leakage operationally through reconstruction: a shared cache artifact is unsafe if an adversarial decoder can recover agent-specific sensitive inputs from it. This leads to an adversarial training formulation in which the adversary learns to reconstruct sensitive inputs, while LCGuard learns transformations that preserve task-relevant semantics and reduce reconstructable information. Empirical evaluations across multiple model families and multi-agent benchmarks show that LCGuard consistently reduces reconstruction-based leakage and attack success rates while maintaining competitive task performance compared to standard KV-sharing baselines.

AI.tldr: LCGuard 是一个面向多智能体 LLM 系统的表示层防护框架：它在智能体之间共享 KV cache（潜变量通信）之前，用可学习的残差瓶颈变换对 KV 张量做净化，并通过"对抗重建"的极小极大训练，使共享表示难以被攻击者还原出智能体特有的敏感输入，同时尽量保留任务相关信息。实验显示在多个模型家族与基准上，ASR 相对裸 KV 共享下降约 65–75%，而任务效用仅中等程度下降。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统正从自然语言通信转向以 Transformer 的 KV cache 作为"共享工作记忆"的潜变量通信（LatentMAS、KVComm 等），可避免重复解码、提高效率并保留更丰富的语义结构。但 KV cache 会编码上下文输入、中间推理状态与智能体特有的私有信息，形成一个高维、不可外部审查的表示层通道：敏感信息无需在文本输出中显式披露，即可被攻击者通过训练解码器从共享表示中重建并在多跳交互中持续传播与累积。现有防护存在双重缺口：一是多智能体安全机制多作用于生成输出或工具动作，无法约束"传输了什么"；二是 KV cache 安全研究聚焦服务侧的隔离、淘汰与系统级管控，未针对跨智能体有意共享的 cache 的信息内容建模。因此亟需一个能在传输前规制"保留哪些信息"的表示级框架，在保留潜通信效率收益的同时限制私有信息的可恢复性。
AI.method: 设定：N 个 Transformer 智能体 a_i，各有任务输入 x_i 与智能体特有敏感输入 s_i；通信完全在潜空间进行，共享工件 m_ij = g_ij(K_i, V_i)，g_ij 为按边 (i,j) 参数化的可学习变换；系统级任务损失 L_task(M) = E[-log p(y|M)]。威胁模型：对手可观测通信工件子集 M_obs ⊆ M（覆盖局部单边访问与全局聚合两种情形），知晓模型家族但推理时无法获得 s_i，其目标是训练解码器 D_i: M_obs → ŝ_i 最小化重建损失 L_rec。用先验重建损失 L_prior 作为无任何工件时的基线，泄漏被刻画为 (L_prior − L_rec)/L_prior，即"重建难度 RD"。优化：极小极大博弈 min_{φ} max_{ψ} β·Σ_i L_rec^(i)(M_obs) + L_task(M)，采用交替更新（先 k 步对手更新，再一步通信更新），AdamW，学习率 1e-4（通信）与 5e-4（解码器），batch 8/16。通信变换 g_ij 为残差瓶颈结构：K_san = K + W2^K σ(W1^K LN(K))，V 同理，瓶颈维度 d_b = d/4（约 16.8M 参数），残差保留任务语义、低维瓶颈限制可重建的细粒度私有信息。变体：Per-Agent LCGuard（M_obs = m_ij，局部净化）与 Full-System LCGuard（M_obs = M，跨路径系统级优化）。β 为权衡超参（Per-Agent 用 0.25，Full-System 用 0.5）。对抗解码器在推理时丢弃，仅保留轻量前向变换。对比基线：Vanilla KV Sharing（LatentMAS/KVComm）、PrivAct（策略级上下文隐私）、ADAPT（自适应差分隐私噪声注入）。评测指标：Task Accuracy、Helpfulness、Privacy Score、Leak Rate、ASR（LLM-as-judge 语义等价判定）、Reconstruction Difficulty。
AI.result: 在 PrivacyLens、AgentLeak、MAGPIE 三个基准，Qwen3(4B/8B/14B)、Gemma-2-9B、LLaMA(3B/8B) 六个骨干，以及顺序、层次、通用图三种拓扑上：1) 裸 KV 共享确实带来高重建泄漏（ASR 最高达 0.900），证实潜通信构成新攻击面；2) Full-System LCGuard 在所有配置下 ASR 最低，相对裸 KV 下降约 65–75%（如 Qwen3-4B 顺序 PrivacyLens：0.871→0.216，helpfulness 0.780→0.710；Gemma-9B：0.885→0.205；LLaMA-8B：0.760→0.285），同时重建难度 RD 从约 0.31 提升至 0.82；3) 层级保护优于局部保护（如 Qwen3-4B 层次 AgentLeak：ASR 0.265→0.224，privacy 0.762→0.823），且随智能体链加深优势扩大，说明泄漏具有组合性、非纯局部；4) 基线呈现互补失效模式：ADAPT 隐私强但效用崩塌（helpfulness 低至 0.285），PrivAct 提升可观测隐私分数却几乎不降低 ASR（0.845），证明输出级约束无法控制潜泄漏；5) β 存在单调权衡，β∈[0.25,0.50] 为最佳工作区间，过大的 β 退化为噪声式防御；6) 更强对手（4 层 Transformer/768 维）虽使 ASR 上升（0.285→0.365）但任务效用稳定，变换降低了信息的内在可恢复性；7) 规模与拓扑分析显示更大模型与更复杂拓扑同时提升效用与泄漏；8) 推理效率：相对文本通信 3.6× 加速（裸 KV 为 4.1×），额外开销有限。
AI.conclusion: LCGuard 证明潜变量 KV 通信是独立于文本披露的表示层攻击面，并给出首个以"可重建性"为泄漏操作性定义、以极小极大对抗训练实现表示级信息流规制的框架：通过在传输前对共享 KV 施加学习到的低维残差净化，在保留任务相关信息的同时显著降低重建成功率，在多模型、多基准、多拓扑下取得最优隐私-效用折中。局限在于：仅在开源权重模型与固定拓扑上验证，假设可获得配对训练数据，以解码器强度作为泄漏代理，不提供如差分隐私的形式化保证。未来方向包括异构多智能体（不同架构/不兼容潜空间）、多模态智能体、以及学习自适应的"何时/共享什么/共享多少"的通信策略。

title: Hypergraph as Language
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential in modeling relational structures. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally graph-centric: they focus on processing pairwise graph structures into tokens that LLMs can understand. In contrast, many real-world relational patterns do not naturally conform to the pairwise-edge assumption, and are better modeled as high-order associations in hypergraphs. For hypergraph structures, existing methods often fail to preserve the native semantics that multiple objects are jointly connected by the same high-order relation, limiting their ability to exploit complex structures. To address this limitation, we put forth the "Hypergraph as Language" perspective and propose Hyper-Align, a hypergraph-native alignment framework for large language models. Hyper-Align compiles the query-object-centered hypergraph context into hypergraph tokens directly consumable by a base LLM. Specifically, we introduce Hypergraph Incidence Detail Template with Overview (HIDT-O), which serializes high-order association structures into a fixed-shape hybrid template combining local incidence details and overview-level summaries. We then design a Hypergraph Incidence Projector (HIP), which maps native high-order incidence structures into the LLM token space through explicit semantic-structural decoupling and bidirectional message passing between vertices and hyperedges. We further define a concrete Hypergraph-as-Language input protocol, which jointly feeds hypergraph tokens and textual prompts into a frozen base LLM, supporting both vertex-level and hyperedge-level tasks under a unified question-answering paradigm. To systematically evaluate different methods in hypergraph structural modeling, we introduce HyperAlign-Bench. Extensive experiments show that Hyper-Align significantly outperforms existing methods across in-domain and zero-shot evaluations.

AI.tldr: Hyper-Align提出了一种将超图建模为语言的新视角，通过HIDT-O模板序列化高阶关联结构，以及HIP将超图映射到LLM token空间，在超图结构建模任务中显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: Existing LLM-based graph methods are graph-centric and rely on pairwise edges, which fail to model high-order relational patterns in hypergraphs naturally. They also fail to preserve native semantics of multiple objects jointly connected by high-order relations.
AI.method: Proposes HIDT-O to serialize hypergraph structures into fixed-shape hybrid templates, and HIP to map high-order incidence structures into LLM token space via semantic-structural decoupling and bidirectional message passing between vertices and hyperedges. A Hypergraph-as-Language input protocol jointly feeds hypergraph tokens and textual prompts into a frozen base LLM.
AI.result: The proposed Hyper-Align framework significantly outperforms existing methods in both in-domain and zero-shot evaluations.
AI.conclusion: Hyper-Align significantly outperforms existing methods across in-domain and zero-shot evaluations, and HyperAlign-Bench provides a systematic benchmark for hypergraph structural modeling evaluation.

title: What Counts as AI Sycophancy? A Taxonomy and Expert Survey of a Fragmented Construct
summary: AI sycophancy has become a prominent concern in large language model (LLM) research. Yet the term lacks a consistent definition and has been applied to behaviors ranging from agreeing with a user's false claim to excessively praising the user to withholding corrective feedback. When researchers, companies, and policymakers use the same term to describe different behaviors, evaluation results become difficult to compare, mitigation strategies fail to transfer, and systems that are resistant to one form of sycophancy continue exhibiting other forms. To address this, we make two contributions. First, we reviewed 70 papers on AI sycophancy to develop a taxonomy of how the behavior has been defined and measured. The taxonomy distinguishes (1) whether a model is sycophantic toward a user's positions and beliefs, or toward the user's broader personal traits and emotions, and (2) whether this occurs through explicit, direct language or more implicit, subtle behaviors such as framing, omission, or tone. Mapping existing literature to our taxonomy reveals that current research has focused on overt forms of sycophancy toward users' beliefs, leaving more subtle and person-directed behaviors relatively understudied. Second, we surveyed 106 experts in AI sycophancy and related fields to examine whether researchers agree on which model behaviors are sycophantic. While experts are nearly unanimous in believing that sycophancy is a significant problem in current AI systems (94.3% agree), they disagree substantially on which specific behaviors qualify. Together, these findings demonstrate that AI sycophancy is a broad family of behaviors with different measurement challenges, intervention requirements, and governance implications. Our taxonomy provides a shared vocabulary for understanding and addressing these behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对AI谄媚定义不一致的问题，通过回顾70篇论文建立了二维分类法（谄媚对象×表现形式），并对106位专家进行调研。发现学界对具体行为的认定存在显著分歧，当前研究空白集中于隐性谄媚和面向人格的谄媚行为。
AI.motivation: AI sycophancy（AI谄媚）缺乏一致的定义，被用于描述从认同用户错误主张到过度赞美用户再到隐瞒纠正性反馈等多种行为。当研究者、公司和政策制定者使用同一术语描述不同行为时，评估结果难以比较，缓解策略无法迁移，对一种形式谄媚免疫的系统仍表现出其他形式。
AI.method: 1. 系统性文献综述：回顾70篇关于AI谄媚的论文，建立行为分类法；2. 专家调研：向106位AI谄媚及相关领域专家发放问卷。分类法从两个维度区分谄媚行为：(1)对象——用户的立场/信念 vs. 用户的个人特质/情感；(2)方式——显性直接语言 vs. 隐性隐微行为（如框架构建、遗漏、语调操控）。
AI.result: 1. 文献映射发现当前研究集中于对用户信念的显性谄媚形式，而对更隐性和面向人格的行为相对研究不足；2. 专家调研显示虽然94.3%认为谄媚是当前AI系统的重要问题，但在具体哪些行为属于谄媚方面存在显著分歧。
AI.conclusion: AI sycophancy是一个行为家族，具有不同的测量挑战、干预要求和治理含义。该研究提出的分类法为理解和解决这些行为提供了共享词汇。

title: Tabular foundation models for robust calibration of near-infrared chemical sensing data
summary: Near-infrared spectroscopy is increasingly used as a rapid, non-destructive chemical sensing technology for the analysis of food, pharmaceutical, biological, and environmental samples. However, the practical deployment of NIR sensors still depends on calibration models able to handle high-dimensional, collinear spectra, limited sample sizes, preprocessing dependence, spectral outliers, and extrapolation beyond the calibration domain. Here, we evaluate whether tabular foundation models can provide a new calibration strategy for NIR chemical sensing. We benchmark TabPFN on 66 NIR datasets covering 54 regression and 12 classification tasks, and compare direct inference on raw spectra with preprocessing-optimized inference against PLS/PLS-DA, Ridge, Catboost, and one-dimensional convolutional neural networks. The study uses a unified validation framework in which preprocessing and model selection are performed exclusively on calibration data before external test evaluation. In regression, preprocessing-optimized TabPFN achieves the best overall average rank and significantly outperforms PLS, CatBoost, TabPFN on raw spectra, and CNN-1D, while remaining statistically comparable to Ridge. In classification, TabPFN applied directly to raw spectra provides the best average rank, with performance close to the optimized variant. Robustness analyses show that TabPFN provides strong average predictive performance but that its advantage decreases on spectral outliers and extrapolated samples, where classical chemometric models remain competitive. These results suggest that tabular foundation models can complement established chemometric workflows for NIR chemical sensing, especially in small- to medium-sized calibration settings, while highlighting the need for spectroscopy-specific priors and uncertainty-aware deployment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了表格基础模型TabPFN在近红外光谱化学传感校准中的表现，在66个数据集上与多种经典模型对比，发现预处理优化的TabPFN在回归任务中表现最佳，分类任务中直接应用效果最好，但面对异常值和外推场景时性能下降，需要结合不确定性感知策略部署。
AI.motivation: NIR光谱技术的实际应用面临高维共线性光谱、有限样本量、预处理依赖性、光谱异常值及校准域外推等挑战，需要开发能够应对这些问题的校准模型
AI.method: 在统一验证框架下，对66个NIR数据集（54个回归+12个分类任务）进行基准测试，将TabPFN与PLS/PLS-DA、Ridge、Catboost、CNN-1D进行对比；预处理和模型选择仅在校准数据上完成
AI.result: 回归任务中，经预处理优化的TabPFN获得最佳平均排名，显著优于PLS、CatBoost、原始TabPFN和CNN-1D，与Ridge统计可比；分类任务中，TabPFN直接应用于原始光谱取得最佳平均排名；在光谱异常值和外推样本场景下优势减弱，经典化学计量模型仍具竞争力
AI.conclusion: TabPFN作为表格基础模型可补充传统化学计量学工作流程，适用于中小型校准集场景；但需针对光谱异常值和外推样本场景开发专用的先验知识和不确定性感知部署策略

title: FAME: Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Message-Level Log Anomaly Detection
summary: Production systems generate millions of log lines daily, yet most anomaly detectors operate at the session or window-level, flagging groups of lines rather than identifying the specific message responsible. This coarse granularity forces operators to inspect many routine lines per alert. Message-level detection offers finer granularity, but remains challenging. A single event template may correspond to both normal and anomalous messages, failures arise from heterogeneous subsystems, and line-level labeling at scale is impractical. Although large language models (LLMs) can reason over log semantics, applying them to every line is too costly for continuous monitoring. We present FAME (Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts), a label-efficient message-level mixture-of-experts framework that uses an LLM only once offline. We annotate at most K labeled lines per template to derive binary normal/anomaly indicators and representative examples. The LLM proposes a partition of templates into failure domains, and a certification step validates the proposal before training. FAME trains a lightweight router and domain experts that run on-premise and output anomaly predictions and failure-domain labels. On BGL, FAME achieves F1 = 98.16 at K = 100 reducing annotation effort by 76x and detects 86.3% of anomalies from unseen EventIDs. On Thunderbird, FAME reaches F1 = 99.95 with perfect recall.

AI.tldr: FAME是一种标签高效的消息级日志异常检测框架，通过混合专家架构将大语言模型的语义理解能力蒸馏到轻量级本地模型中。核心思想是对每个模板仅标注K条日志，利用LLM离线划分故障领域并验证，然后训练轻量级路由器和领域专家进行在线推理，在大幅降低标注成本和计算开销的同时实现了高检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有日志异常检测方法主要在会话或窗口级别进行检测，需要operators检查大量常规日志行才能定位真正异常；同时，消息级检测面临三大挑战：1）单一事件模板可能同时包含正常和异常消息；2）故障源自异构子系统；3）大规模行级标注不切实际。虽然大语言模型可以理解日志语义，但对每条日志进行LLM推理成本过高，无法满足持续监控需求。
AI.method: FAME采用混合专家架构，包含三个核心阶段：1）离线LLM标注阶段：对每个模板最多标注K条日志行，生成二元正异常指示器和代表性样本；2）模板分区阶段：利用LLM推理将模板划分为多个故障领域，认证步骤验证分区质量；3）在线推理阶段：轻量级路由器根据日志特征将待检测日志路由到对应领域专家，领域专家输出异常预测和故障领域标签。该设计确保LLM仅在离线阶段使用一次，在线推理完全依赖轻量模型运行。
AI.result: 在BGL数据集上，FAME在K=100时达到F1=98.16，标注成本降低76倍，且能检测86.3%的未知EventID异常；在Thunderbird数据集上，FAME达到F1=99.95且召回率为100%。
AI.conclusion: FAME通过将LLM推理能力蒸馏到轻量级路由器和领域专家模型中，在保持高检测性能的同时显著降低了计算成本。该框架创新性地结合了离线LLM标注、模板分区和在线轻量推理的范式，为大规模日志异常检测提供了一种标签高效且计算可行的解决方案。

title: Token-weighted Direct Preference Optimization with Attention
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns Large Language Models with human preferences without the need for a separate reward model. However, DPO treats all tokens in responses equally, neglecting the differing importance of individual tokens. Existing token-level PO methods compute the token weights using either token-position-based heuristic functions or probability estimates given by a separately trained model, which lacks robustness and incurs extra training cost. In contrast, we propose Token-weighted DPO (TwDPO) -- a novel training objective grounded on token-weighted RL -- and AttentionPO -- an instantiation of TwDPO that uses attention from the LLM itself to estimate token weights. AttentionPO prompts the LLM to serve as a pairwise judge and check where the model attends when comparing the responses. This design makes AttentionPO content-aware, adjusting weights based on response content, and efficient, incurring only two extra forward passes per example. Experiment results show that AttentionPO significantly improves performance on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and ArenaHard, surpassing existing Preference Optimization methods.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes Token-weighted DPO (TwDPO) and its instantiation AttentionPO to address the limitation of standard DPO that treats all tokens equally. AttentionPO leverages the LLM's own attention mechanism to estimate token importance, making it content-aware and efficient without requiring a separate model. Experimental results show it surpasses existing Preference Optimization methods on multiple benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing DPO methods treat all tokens equally, ignoring varying token importance. Current token-level PO approaches rely on heuristic functions or separately trained models, which lack robustness and incur extra training costs.
AI.method: Token-weighted DPO (TwDPO) - a novel training objective grounded on token-weighted RL. AttentionPO - an instantiation using the LLM's own attention mechanism to estimate token weights by prompting the model to act as a pairwise judge to identify where it attends when comparing responses.
AI.result: AttentionPO is content-aware (adjusts weights based on response content) and efficient (only two extra forward passes per example). It achieves significant improvements on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and ArenaHard benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: AttentionPO significantly outperforms existing Preference Optimization methods, as demonstrated by substantial improvements across multiple benchmarks.

title: PeakFocus: Bridging Peak Localization and Intensity Regression via a Unified Multi-Scale Framework for Electricity Load Forecasting
summary: Electricity load peak forecasting (ELPF), simultaneously predicting peak timing and intensity, is a prerequisite for effective grid scheduling and risk management. However, existing methods face three limitations. First, they adopt a two-stage predict-then-locate paradigm, which severs the link between temporal localization and intensity regression. Second, they still struggle with the multi-scale representation conflict, leading to peak misjudgment and timing misalignment. Third, the lack of explicit peak timing context during intensity regression causes intensity smoothing because predictions are dominated by global smoothing trends. To address these limitations, we propose PeakFocus, a unified framework for ELPF. (i) A Unified Peak-Aware Pipeline (UPAP) utilizes a triple hybrid loss to jointly supervise temporal localization and intensity regression, alongside a tolerance-based evaluation protocol. (ii) A Multi-Scale Mixing Peak Locator (MSM-PL) exploits coarse-grained features to mitigate peak misjudgment caused by local fluctuations, and injects them into fine-grained features via a cascade mechanism to resolve timing misalignment. (iii) A Location-Aware Decoder (LAD) injects peak timing context into the intensity regression process, providing explicit guidance to counteract intensity smoothing and improve peak intensity estimation. Extensive experiments on the public Electricity (ELC) dataset and our industrial-scale World Large-scale Electricity Load (WLEL) dataset show that PeakFocus outperforms baselines in both timing precision and intensity estimation.

AI.tldr: PeakFocus 是一个面向电力负荷峰值预测（ELPF）的统一端到端框架，通过三组件协同——统一峰感知训练/评估流程 UPAP（三重混合损失 + 容差化 Condense-and-Match 评估协议）、多尺度混合峰值定位器 MSM-PL（金字塔粗尺度抑制局部波动 + 自顶向下级联注入以校正时间错位）、位置感知解码器 LAD（以峰值时刻上下文经 Context Gate Fusion 注入强度回归以抑制强度平滑）——在公开 ELC 与自建工业级 WLEL 数据集上同时提升峰值时刻精度（F1）与峰值强度估计（TP-MSE/TP-MAE），并提供可复用的稀疏结构事件预测评估方法。
AI.motivation: 电力负荷峰值预测（ELPF）需同时给出下一个峰值出现的时刻与幅值，是电网调度与风险管理的关键。现有方法存在三点结构性缺陷：(1) 主流"先预测后定位"的两阶段范式割裂了时间定位与强度回归，模型学不到二者关联；(2) 多尺度表征冲突——粗粒度特征缺乏时间分辨率导致时间错位（timing misalignment），细粒度特征易受局部波动干扰导致峰值误判（peak misjudgment）；(3) 强度回归缺少显式的峰值时刻上下文，输出被全局平滑趋势主导而产生强度平滑（intensity smoothing）。Transformer/MLP 等通用 TSF 以全局重建损失（MSE）训练，只最小化平均误差，倾向于平滑曲线并抹平极值，恰与稀疏结构化峰值事件的目标相悖。因此需要一个联合建模峰值定位与强度回归、面向稀疏极值优化的专用框架。
AI.method: 整体为共享骨干 + 双头架构。编码器：对输入做 RevIN 归一化，经值嵌入（1D 卷积）+ 固定位置编码 + 时间戳嵌入得到 horizon 对齐的上下文 X_en_out（残差 MLP 骨干 + 可学习投影）。(1) MSM-PL：向峰值分支注入未来时间特征 M_{T+1:T+H} 并 LayerNorm；构建 K=2 层自底向上的平均池化金字塔 S^(k)（池化核/步长 3/2、5/2）；自顶向下级联注入 F^(k)=ψ_k(S^(k))+U_k(F^(k+1))（卷积核 κ_c=3，插值上采样），最细尺度 F^(0) 即峰值隐状态 H_pl；线性分类器 + Sigmoid 输出逐时刻峰值概率 Y_t_pred。(2) LAD：解码查询由标准化值嵌入 + 位置编码构成（末 L_label 个值与零填充占位拼接）；以 Context Gate Fusion 做门控 G = tanh(H_pl) ⊙ σ(X_en_out) 注入峰值时刻上下文；随后多头交叉注意力（Q=解码查询，K/V=门控上下文）+ 残差、LayerNorm、卷积 FFN，输出投影并经 RevIN 反归一化得到 Y_i_pred。(3) UPAP：三重混合损失 L_total = λ1·L_Global(MSE) + λ2·L_Int(用截断高斯软掩码 W² 加权的 MSE) + λ3·L_Loc(以 W 为软标签的 BCE)，权重 0.2/0.4/0.4；并建立容差化 Condense-and-Match 评估协议：阈值 τ=0.4 分割连续高概率簇并取局部极大凝聚为候选峰，与真实峰在容差 δ=1 内按时间距离排序贪心一对一匹配，得到 TP/FP/FN，再报告 Precision、Recall、F1、TP-MSE、TP-MAE 及综合指标 BCS、PIM。峰值标签由 findpeaks 以灵敏度 η 与前瞻窗口 ℓ（ELC 5 / WLEL 3）离线生成。
AI.result: WLEL（H=336/720）：PeakFocus 的 F1 达 0.756/0.759、Recall 0.741/0.748、Precision 0.770、TP-MSE 0.264/0.317、TP-MAE 0.378/0.415、BCS 0.227/0.240、RS 0.833/0.797，且全局 MSE/MAE 亦最优；相对最强基线（Transformer）F1 提升约 7%、TP-MSE 降低约 15%。ELC 上 F1 同样最优（0.747/0.731，Recall 0.719/0.712、Precision 0.777/0.751），但全局 MSE/MAE 逊于 TimeMixer、STID 等专用全局拟合模型，论文明确将其定位为与通用 TSF 互补的任务。基线中 Seq2Peak（max-pooling 启发式定位）表现明显最差。效率上仅 1.12M 参数即在 F1、MSE、BCS 三轴领先，而 CycleNet(114K)、TimeMixer(116K) 参数更省但峰值质量显著更弱。消融：去掉 MSM-PL（换线性层）F1 下降约 13% 且 Precision 明显下滑；去掉 LAD 时 F1 基本保持但 TP-MSE 明显上升，验证强度平滑假设；去掉 UPAP 退化最严重（F1 下降超 40%、BCS 近翻倍）；硬二值掩码替代软高斯掩码在 WLEL 上降 F1/BCS、在 ELC 上直接崩溃（F1≈0）。UPAP 跨骨干通用性：WLEL 上七个骨干加 UPAP 后 F1 全部提升，弱模型增益最大；ELC 上多数受益，但 CycleNet、Transformer 略有退化。超参鲁棒性：K=0 最差、K=2 最佳、K=3 边际增益；四种损失权重组合表现相当；d_model 64→256 提升后饱和，512 在 ELC 上 F1 下降约 6%；编码器层数与 d_ff 变化影响可忽略。定性分析中 PatchTST 在同一样本上 TP=7/FP=6/FN=6 且峰值强度平均低估 0.80，PeakFocus 达 TP=12/FP=1/FN=1；注意力热图与逐时刻注意力在真实峰值处集中成竖向条带，验证定位→回归链路。
AI.conclusion: PeakFocus 通过统一的端到端框架将峰值时间定位与强度回归桥接起来：MSM-PL 以层次化多尺度融合化解峰值误判与时间错位，LAD 以显式峰值时刻上下文条件化回归以抑制强度平滑，UPAP 用三重混合目标把二者联合监督，使三项瓶颈被同时而非孤立解决。在公开 ELC 基准与工业级 WLEL 数据集上，模型在时刻精度、强度误差与综合平衡指标上均达到新的最优，验证了"面向稀疏极值事件优化"相较通用全局重建范式对 ELPF 的必要性。附加贡献是容差化 Condense-and-Match 评估协议，为稀疏结构事件预测提供了可复用的评测方法。局限与展望：WLEL 为保密数据不可公开、仅覆盖单一区域电网；ELC 上全局重建指标略逊于专用 TSF；未来工作包括更长工业部署上的容量扩展、概率化峰值预测、与实时电网遥测数据对接以支持实时调度。

title: Claim-Selective Certification for High-Risk Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Medical RAG systems in high-risk QA settings are often evaluated through a single answer-or-abstain decision, but mixed evidence may support one claim, require conditions for another, and contradict a third. We study claim-selective certification: each response is decomposed into verifiable claims, scored against retrieved evidence, and mapped by an intent-aware selector to {full, partial, conflict, abstain}. On the primary weak-label certificate protocol, whose real-source-only dev/test rows cover the naturally occurring non-abstain actions, the full system records UCCR=0.0000, PAU=1.0000, PAU Precision=0.9901, and action accuracy=0.9204 on dev (n=314), and UCCR=0.0000, PAU=0.9967, PAU Precision=0.9739, and action accuracy=0.8997 on test (n=319). UCCR measures unsupported-claim risk within the certificate definition, and a source-missing counterfactual slice evaluates abstain under empty evidence. Shortcut controls quantify the action-label prior explained by source and intent metadata, while source/evidence-novel slices characterize transfer boundaries. The resulting interface separates action-label prediction from evidence-linked claim selection under mixed evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出声明选择性认证框架用于医学RAG系统评估，将响应分解为声明级验证，通过意图感知选择器在混合证据场景下映射至细粒度动作标签，在真实来源测试集上实现约90%动作准确率且UCCR为零，有效分离了动作预测与证据关联的声明选择。
AI.motivation: 传统医学RAG系统在风险QA场景中仅通过单一答案或弃权决策进行评估，但实际场景中存在混合证据：可能支持某项声明、要求另一项的条件、或与第三项矛盾。需要更细粒度的声明级验证方法。
AI.method: 提出"声明选择性认证"(Claim-Selective Certification)框架：将响应分解为可验证声明，基于检索证据评分，通过意图感知选择器映射至{full, partial, conflict, abstain}四类结果。使用UCCR度量证书定义内的未支持声明风险，通过源缺失反事实切片评估空证据下的弃权行为，并用快捷控制量化源/意图元数据解释的动作标签先验分布。
AI.result: 在真实来源的dev/test数据集上，系统达到dev集(n=314)：UCCR=0.0000、PAU=1.0000、PAU Precision=0.9901、动作准确率0.9204；测试集(n=319)：UCCR=0.0000、PAU=0.9967、PAU Precision=0.9739、动作准确率0.8997。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动作标签预测与证据关联的声明选择分离，该接口实现了对混合证据场景的细粒度处理，在测试集上达到约90%的动作准确率。

title: Implicit Safety Alignment from Crowd Preferences
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can reveal implicit objectives such as safety considerations that go beyond task completion. In this work, we focus on the common safety criteria embedded in crowd preference datasets, where different users may express distinct preferences or objectives, yet follow similar safety principles. Our aim is to discover shared safety criteria from crowd preferences and then transfer them to downstream RL tasks to regularize agent behavior and enforce safety. We first show that direct reward combination-optimizing a preference-learned reward model together with downstream task rewards-has inherent limitations. Motivated by this, we propose Safe Crowd Preference-based RL, a hierarchical framework that extracts safety-aligned skills from crowd preferences and composes them via a high-level policy to safely solve downstream tasks. Experiments across safe RL environments and a preliminary LLM-style task with diverse user goals and shared safety constraints demonstrate that our approach substantially lowers safety costs without access to explicit safety rewards, while achieving task performance comparable to oracle methods trained with ground-truth safety signals.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLHF中人群偏好数据集的隐式安全目标，提出Safe Crowd Preference-based RL框架，从人群偏好中提取安全对齐技能并通过高层策略组合，在无显式安全奖励条件下实现了与oracle方法相当的性能同时大幅降低安全成本。
AI.motivation: RLHF中的人群偏好数据集隐含了超越任务完成的安全目标，但不同用户可能表达不同偏好却遵循共同的安全原则。现有直接组合奖励的方法存在固有局限，因此需要从人群偏好中显式提取共享安全标准并迁移到下游RL任务。
AI.method: 提出Safe Crowd Preference-based RL层次框架，首先从人群偏好中提取与安全对齐的技能（skill），再通过高层策略组合这些技能来安全地解决下游任务。实验在安全RL环境和LLM风格任务中进行。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在无显式安全奖励的情况下显著降低安全代价，同时任务性能与使用真实安全信号的oracle方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需显式安全奖励即可实现安全约束转移的RL框架，为人群偏好数据中的隐式安全知识挖掘提供了新思路。

title: Expectation Consistency Loss: Rethink Confidence Calibration under Covariate Shift
summary: Confidence calibration for classification models is vital in safety-critical decision-making scenarios and has received extensive attention. General confidence calibration methods assume training and test data are independent and identically distributed, limiting their effectiveness under covariate shifts. Previous calibration methods under covariate shift struggle with class-wise or canonical calibrations and often rely on unstable importance weighting when density ratios are large or unbounded. Given the above limitations, this paper rethinks confidence calibration under covariate shifts. First, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for confidence calibration under covariate shifts, named Expectation consistency condition, which reveals covariate shifts do not necessarily lead to uncalibrated confidence and provides a weaker condition for confidence calibration than global covariate distribution alignment. Then, utilizing Expectation consistency condition, this paper proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation loss to calibrate confidence of the target domain, named Expectation consistency loss (ECL), which is compatible with canonical calibration, class-wise calibration, and top-label calibration. Third, we prove that computing ECL loss has the same sample complexity as Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and provide a theoretically grounded mini-batch trainable scheme for ECL loss. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our method on both simulated and real-world covariate shift datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对协变量偏移场景下的分类模型置信度校准问题，提出期望一致性条件作为校准必要充分条件，并设计ECL损失函数实现兼容多种校准范式的无监督域适应校准，同时保证与ECE相当的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有置信度校准方法假设训练与测试数据独立同分布(i.i.d.)，在协变量偏移(covariate shift)场景下效果受限；此前方法存在类级校准或规范校准的局限，且依赖不稳定的密度比重要性加权（当密度比过大或无界时）。
AI.method: 1) 提出期望一致性条件(Expectation consistency condition)作为协变量偏移下置信度校准的必要充分条件；2) 基于该条件设计期望一致性损失(ECL)用于无监督域适应校准，支持规范校准、类级校准和top-label校准三种范式；3) 证明ECL损失的计算复杂度与ECE相当，并提供理论支撑的小批量可训练优化方案。
AI.result: 实验验证表明该方法在模拟和真实协变量偏移数据集上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为协变量偏移下的置信度校准提供了理论基础和实用方法。通过期望一致性条件揭示了协变量偏移与校准失败之间的非必然关系，并提出兼容多种校准范式的ECL损失函数，在保证可学习性的同时提升了校准鲁棒性，在模拟和真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

title: Diagnosis Is Not Prescription: Linguistic Co-Adaptation Explains Patching Hazards in LLM Pipelines
summary:
When a multi-module LLM agent fails, the module most responsible for the failure is not necessarily the best place to intervene. We demonstrate this Diagnostic Paradox empirically: causal analysis consistently identifies the routing module -- which selects which tool to call next -- as the primary bottleneck across three independent agent families. Yet injecting prompt-level correction examples into this module consistently degrades performance, sometimes severely. Patching an upstream query-rewriting module instead reliably improves outcomes. The effect holds with statistical significance on two agent families and directional consistency on a third; alternative repair strategies at the routing module (instruction rewriting, model upgrade) are neutral, confirming that the harm is specific to correction-injection patching.
  We explain this asymmetry through the Linguistic Contract hypothesis: each downstream module implicitly adapts to its upstream's characteristic error distribution, so correcting the bottleneck breaks this implicit alignment in a way that upstream corrections do not. We operationalize this via a per-agent co-adaptation measure, derived from diagnosis alone, and show it is consistently associated with patching harm across agent families: higher co-adaptation co-occurs with harm, lower with safety. This trend holds across all three agent families, providing preliminary support for the hypothesis beyond a single-agent observation.

AI.tldr: Multi-module LLM agents exhibit a "Diagnostic Paradox": the module most causally responsible for failure (routing) is NOT the best place to fix it—correcting it actually degrades performance. Instead, patching an upstream module (query-rewriting) improves outcomes. This is explained by the "Linguistic Contract" hypothesis—downstream modules co-adapt to upstream error distributions, so correcting the bottleneck breaks implicit alignment. A co-adaptation measure derived from diagnosis alone predicts where patching will cause harm.
AI.motivation: Challenges the intuitive assumption that correcting the module most causally responsible for failure is the best intervention point. The paper demonstrates a "Diagnostic Paradox" where this natural strategy paradoxically degrades performance.
AI.method: Empirical analysis on three independent agent families; causal analysis to identify bottlenecks; comparative patching at routing module (prompt correction injection, instruction rewriting, model upgrade) vs. upstream query-rewriting module; operationalization of Linguistic Contract via per-agent co-adaptation measure derived from diagnosis.
AI.result: Causal analysis identifies routing module as primary bottleneck; however, injecting correction examples into routing module consistently degrades performance while patching upstream query-rewriting module reliably improves outcomes. Alternative repair strategies at routing (instruction rewriting, model upgrade) are neutral, confirming harm is specific to correction-injection. Co-adaptation measure: higher co-adaptation co-occurs with harm, lower co-adaptation co-occurs with safety. Effects statistically significant on two agent families, directional consistency on third.
AI.conclusion: The Linguistic Contract hypothesis is supported: downstream modules implicitly adapt to upstream error distributions, so correcting the bottleneck (routing) breaks this implicit alignment. A co-adaptation measure derived from diagnosis alone consistently associates with patching harm across all three agent families, providing preliminary support beyond single-agent observation.

title: Toward AI VIS Co-Scientists: A General and End-to-End Agent Harness for Solving Complex Data Visualization Tasks
summary: The ability to inspect, interpret, and communicate complex data is crucial for virtually any scientific endeavor, but often requires significant expertise outside the core domain ranging from data management and analysis to visualization design and implementation. We present an end-to-end agentic harness that, based on only the data and a high level description of the tasks, independently designs custom visual analysis applications (VIS apps). This represents an important step towards a general AI co-scientist envisioned by many as an autonomous system that can autonomously execute long horizon tasks based on high-level directions. Our proposed VIS co-scientist is an essential component of this broader AI co-scientist vision: a harness that can autonomously analyze data and design visualization solutions using a collection of agents and specialized skills that coordinate exploratory analysis, plan, configure the environment, implement, validate the interface, and most importantly evaluate the overall task completion. Each stage produces document and instruction artifacts that guide downstream work and enable iterative refinement. We validate this approach on IEEE SciVis Contests spanning multiple science and engineering fields. These contests serve as ideal proving grounds because they encode real-world complexity: ambiguous requirements, diverse data modalities, design trade-offs, and task-driven validation. Given only the data and target tasks, our system autonomously produces functional single-page VIS Apps with verified linked-view behavior, highly customized to domain experts' specified tasks and needs.

AI.tldr: An AI co-scientist system that autonomously designs custom visualization applications from high-level task descriptions and raw data, validated on IEEE SciVis Contests representing real-world complexity.
AI.motivation: Domain experts lack expertise in data management, analysis, visualization design and implementation; current scientific workflows require significant interdisciplinary knowledge beyond core domains.
AI.method: End-to-end agentic harness using multiple coordinating agents with specialized skills for exploratory analysis, planning, environment configuration, implementation, interface validation, and task completion evaluation. Each stage produces artifacts guiding downstream work.
AI.result: Autonomous generation of functional, task-specific single-page VIS Apps with verified linked-view behavior across multiple science and engineering domains.
AI.conclusion: The system successfully generates functional VIS apps with verified linked-view behavior, validated on real-world IEEE SciVis Contests.

title: TONIC: Token-Centric Semantic Communication for Task-Oriented Wireless Systems
summary: Tokens are becoming the basic units through which foundation models represent and process information for understanding and inference. However, traditional wireless communication, centered on bit-level fidelity, faces a mismatch between what is transmitted reliably and what downstream models actually consume. This mismatch calls for a communication design that directly accounts for token-level task relevance and downstream model requirements, rather than treating all transmitted bits as equally important. In this paper, we propose TONIC, a token-centric semantic communication framework for task-oriented wireless systems. The transmitter converts each source sample into a sequence of tokens, estimates token-level task relevance, and allocates protection through utility-aware unequal error protection under a fixed channel-use budget. At the receiver, token-level confidence is used to gate unreliable decisions, turning harmful substitutions into recoverable erasures before a Transformer-based completion model restores the masked tokens for final task inference. Our framework combines transmitter-side semantic-aware protection with receiver-side confidence-aware gating in a modular and interpretable architecture, rather than relying solely on fully black-box end-to-end learning. We further establish a utility-aware Bayes-risk interpretation for the receiver-side gating rule and study its interaction with unequal protection and completion. Experimental results on image classification show that TONIC consistently outperforms separation-based schemes, the pixel-domain DeepJSCC baseline, and token-domain baselines under matched communication budgets over AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician channels.

AI.tldr: TONIC 是一套面向任务导向无线系统的"以令牌为中心"语义通信框架：发射端把图像离散化为语义令牌序列，按令牌对下游任务的重要性分组，在固定信道使用预算下做效用加权的非均匀差错保护（UEP）；接收端利用软译码得到的令牌级置信度做门控，把低置信度的"错误替换"转化为"可恢复的擦除"，再由 Transformer 掩码补全模型修复擦除位置后送入分类头。论文还给出了门控规则的效用感知贝叶斯风险解释与离线阈值标定流程。实验（CIFAR-10/ImageNet-100，AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician）在匹配通信预算下稳定优于分离式方案、像素域 DeepJSCC 与多个令牌域基线。
AI.motivation: 传统无线通信以比特级保真为目标，但下游模型实际消费的是离散语义令牌，存在"可靠传输了什么"与"模型真正使用什么"之间的错配：不同令牌位置对任务贡献差异极大，统一保护所有比特未必保住关键位置；且在具备强补全先验时，一个错误的令牌替换比显式擦除危害更大。因此需要一个直接建模令牌级任务相关性、并区分"接受"与"擦除"的通信设计。现有工作存在三处空白：(1) 未在固定预算下把令牌任务相关性显式融入发射端保护；(2) 未明确区分接收端"接受不可靠令牌"与"擦除"；(3) 缺少把令牌效用、译码置信度与补全恢复统一耦合的端到端规则。此外纯黑箱端到端训练难以解释与部署，作者希望采用模块化、可解释的架构。
AI.method:
系统模型：图像 x 经 VQ 型分词器得到令牌序列 t∈K^L（K=16384，24×24=576 位置，14 bit/令牌），经固定 16QAM + LDPC 码率选择的数字 PHY 传输，每样本固定 N 个复信道使用并满足平均功率 P，采用块衰落模型 r=hs+w（AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician，接收端有 CSI）。
(1) 令牌效用估计：逐样本梯度效用 w_i^grad=‖∂L_task/∂e_i‖₂；更强的掩码干预效用 w_i^mask（仅作 oracle 参考）；部署时使用校准集平均得到的共享位置级效用剖面 w̄_i，避免逐样本信令开销。
(2) 效用分组：将位置量化为 G 组，记录组规模 L_g 与聚合效用质量 W_g=Σ w̄_i，形成收发两端共享的紧凑控制接口。
(3) 预算约束 UEP：在有限策略集 P（16QAM + 离散 LDPC 码率）上最小化代理目标 Σ_g W_g ε̂_g(π_g)，约束 Σ_g L_g c(π_g) ≤ N；算法1以"每单位符号效用加权可靠性增益/代价"最大为准则贪心升级保护档位。命题1给出理论依据：|L(f(Ẑ))-L(f(Z))| ≤ Δ_max Σ_i w_i^sup 1{t̂_i≠t_i}，说明任务敏感位置的令牌错误对任务损失放大更强。
(4) 置信度门控与补全：软译码得到令牌后验 p_i(k)，硬判决 t̂_i、置信度 c_i=max_k p_i(k)；定义接受风险 R_i(u)=w_i(1-p_i(u))、擦除风险 R_i(⊥)=λ_i；定理1证明贝叶斯最优动作为"MAP 或擦除"，即 w_i(1-c_i)≤λ_i 则接受，否则擦除，等价于阈值 τ_i=1-λ_i/w_i；实际采用组级阈值 τ_{g(i)}，通过算法3在有限网格上坐标搜索、最小化验证集任务损失离线标定。擦除位置以专门掩码符号交给离线训练并冻结的 Transformer 掩码令牌补全模型（MaskGIT式双向上下文补全）恢复，再映射为嵌入送入轻量分类头。算法2给出完整在线接收流程。
整体为"离线准备（效用剖面、分组、保护档位、阈值标定）+ 在线轻量运行（分组查表→门控→补全→推理）"的模块化流程，tokenizer/补全模型/任务头均离线训练冻结，无逐 SNR 或逐信道重训。
AI.result:
在 ImageNet-100（主）、CIFAR-10（调试）图像分类上，预算 B0=4096 符号并扫描 {0.5B0, B0, 2B0}，比较 JPEG 无信道损伤上界参考、像素域 DeepJSCC，以及内部消融变体 TONIC-UNI/UEP/GateComp/Full(Grad)/Full(Oracle-aided)。
1) 跨 AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician 三种信道，TONIC 家族一致优于各简化变体与外部基线，TONIC-Full(Grad) 在大部分 SNR 区间最佳；AWGN 精度最高，Rician 居中，Rayleigh 最差，说明增益不依赖单一传播条件。
2) 梯度效用与 oracle 掩码效用的差距很小，表明实用梯度剖面已捕获足够的令牌重要性结构。
3) TONIC-UEP 优于 TONIC-UNI，说明仅非均匀保护已有收益，而门控+补全进一步放大增益；组合优于任一单模块。
4) 低预算区间优势最明显，预算增大后各方法均改善但 TONIC 相对优势仍可见。
5) 令牌级诊断：TER 随 SNR 上升而下降，强变体 TER 更低；WAR 呈非单调（极低 SNR 时因大量拒收而偏低，中等 SNR 因接受集扩大可能先升后降），因此 WAR 仅是"接受硬判决纯度"的诊断量而非精度代理。TER 与精度非一一对应（错误集中位置决定损害程度）。
6) 定性图显示令牌重要性在空间上强烈非均匀，分组把异质性压缩为有限组并对应不同保护强度与掩码行为；detokenized 图像仅作直观展示，视觉保真并非优化目标。
AI.conclusion: TONIC 证明面向任务导向无线系统可以把通信对象直接定义为下游模型消费的离散语义令牌：通过发射端"效用感知分组 + 预算约束非均匀差错保护"塑造错误模式，通过接收端"置信度门控 + 生成式补全"把残余不确定性转化为可修复的擦除，二者互补协同而非竞争。相比分离式传输、像素域 DeepJSCC 与令牌域基线，在匹配通信预算下跨多信道稳定提升分类精度，同时保持模块化、可解释、可离线标定的部署形态（复杂度主要在离线侧）。局限与后续：实验仅限单用户无线图像分类与单一下游任务，未含多用户/多模态与动态信道；效用分组数 G、λ_i 的实际含义与端到端联合优化仍未完全统一，未来将扩展到更丰富的多模态与多用户场景，并进一步收紧通信、令牌补全与下游决策之间的耦合。

title: VeriScale: Adversarial Test-Suite Scaling for Verifiable Code Generation
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software engineering, constructing high-quality benchmarks is crucial for evaluating not just the functional correctness, but also the formal verifiability of generated code. However, existing benchmarks are limited by the quantity and quality of positive and negative test cases, leading to an overestimation of model capabilities in generating specifications and implementations. To address this, we propose VeriScale, a novel framework driven by the adversarial implementations. It consists of two stages: test-suite expansion to construct diverse and challenging test cases, and test-suite reduction to distill them into compact yet discriminative suites. While VeriScale is general, we instantiate it on Verina to construct VerinaPlus, which expands the original test suites by over 83$\times$, and VerinaLite, a lightweight 14$\times$ variant. Our experiments across eight state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that VerinaPlus exposes substantial model weaknesses hidden by the original benchmark, evidenced by sharp score drops on both SpecGen and CodeGen tasks, whereas VerinaLite maintains this discriminative power at a fraction of the evaluation cost. The enhanced benchmarks and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/XiaoyangLiu-sjtu/VeriScale.

AI.tldr: VeriScale是一种基于对抗性实现的基准测试构建框架，通过测试套件扩展和缩减两阶段方法提升LLM代码生成评估质量，在Verina基准上实例化后生成的VerinaPlus将测试套件扩展83倍并有效暴露模型弱点，VerinaLite则提供了轻量级14倍变体。
AI.motivation: Existing benchmarks for evaluating LLMs in software engineering are limited by quantity and quality of positive/negative test cases, leading to overestimation of model capabilities in generating specifications and implementations.
AI.method: Two-stage framework consisting of: (1) Test-suite expansion using adversarial implementations to construct diverse and challenging test cases, and (2) Test-suite reduction to distill compact yet discriminative test suites. Instantiated on Verina benchmark.
AI.result: VerinaPlus expands original test suites by over 83× and exposes substantial model weaknesses through sharp score drops on SpecGen and CodeGen tasks across eight state-of-the-art LLMs. VerinaLite achieves 14× expansion while maintaining discriminative power at reduced evaluation cost.
AI.conclusion: VeriScale framework effectively improves benchmark quality for LLM evaluation in software engineering; VerinaPlus exposes significant model weaknesses through 83× expanded test suites, while VerinaLite offers a lightweight 14× variant maintaining discriminative power at reduced evaluation cost; code and enhanced benchmarks are publicly available.

title: SpecHop: Continuous Speculation for Accelerating Multi-Hop Retrieval Agents
summary: Large language models increasingly use external tools such as web search and document retrieval to solve information-intensive tasks. However, multi-hop tool use in complex tasks introduces substantial latency, since the model must repeatedly wait for tool observations before continuing. We study how to accelerate such trajectories without changing the final trajectory the model would have taken without acceleration, assuming access to faster but less reliable speculator tools. We develop a theoretical framework for lossless speculation in multi-hop tool-use settings, characterizing the optimal achievable latency gain. We propose SpecHop, a continuous speculation framework that maintains multiple speculative threads, verifies predicted observations asynchronously as target tool outputs arrive, commits correct branches, and rolls back incorrect ones. This preserves accuracy while reducing wall-clock latency. We show that SpecHop can approach oracle latency gains with enough active threads. Empirically, on retrieval-augmented multi-hop tasks, SpecHop closely matches theoretical predictions and reduces latency by up to 40\% in some settings. Code: https://github.com/mehrdadsaberi/spechop

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何在多跳工具使用场景中无损加速LLM推理延迟。提出了SpecHop框架，通过并行维护多个推测线程并异步验证工具输出，在保持最终结果一致性的前提下显著降低端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 多跳工具使用在复杂任务中引入大量延迟，因为模型必须反复等待工具观测结果才能继续执行。
AI.method: 提出SpecHop，一种连续推测框架，通过维护多个推测线程、异步验证预测观测、提交正确分支并回滚错误分支来实现延迟减少。
AI.result: SpecHop能够接近神谕延迟增益，在检索增强的多跳任务中接近理论预测，某些设置下延迟降低达40%。
AI.conclusion: SpecHop接近理论预测，在某些设置下延迟降低达40%，验证了多跳工具使用场景下无损加速的可行性。

title: FLUID: From Ephemeral IDs to Multimodal Semantic Codes for Industrial-Scale Livestreaming Recommendation
summary: Modern recommender systems rely heavily on ID-based collaborative filtering: each item is represented by a unique ID embedding that accumulates collaborative signals from user interactions. Livestreaming recommendation, however, faces a unique challenge in this paradigm: a live room typically broadcasts for only tens of minutes, so its item ID remains poorly learned in a persistent cold-start state and ID-centric ranking models fail to generalize. We present FLUID, the first framework to fully retire the candidate-side item ID from a production-scale livestreaming ranker. FLUID couples a cross-domain multimodal encoder, jointly trained on short videos and livestreams to produce discrete hierarchical codes (LUCID), with a late-fusion, ID-free design that injects slice-level and room-level LUCID as independent tokens, stabilized by a staged warmup under online incremental training. Deployed on our industrial livestreaming recommenders with a cross-platform combined user base of over one billion globally, FLUID delivers significant online gains of +0.55% Quality Watch Duration, +2.05% Cold-Start Room Views, and +0.05% Active Hours.

AI.tldr: FLUID是首个在工业级直播推荐系统中完全弃用候选侧item ID的框架，通过跨域多模态编码器生成层级离散编码LUCID，结合晚期融合的ID-free设计解决直播房间冷启动难题，在全球超10亿用户的平台上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 直播推荐面临独特挑战：直播间生命周期极短（仅数十分钟），导致item ID embedding难以充分学习，长期处于冷启动状态，ID-centric排序模型泛化能力严重不足。
AI.method: FLUID采用跨域多模态编码器（联合训练短视频和直播内容生成层级离散编码LUCID），结合晚期融合的ID-free设计，将slice级和room级LUCID作为独立token注入模型，通过增量在线训练的分阶段热身策略实现稳定训练，从而实现端到端的ID-free直播推荐。
AI.result: 线上A/B测试取得显著提升：Quality Watch Duration +0.55%，Cold-Start Room Views +2.05%，Active Hours +0.05%。
AI.conclusion: FLUID成功部署于全球日活超10亿的平台，在冷启动房间观看时长、整体观看时长和活跃时长等核心指标上均取得显著提升，证明了在直播推荐场景中放弃item ID而采用多模态语义编码的可行性，为工业级直播推荐系统提供了新的范式。

title: Beyond Single Slot: Joint Optimization for Multi-Slot Guaranteed Display Advertising
summary: Guaranteed display advertising is crucial for platform monetization, yet existing methods often operate under a single-slot assumption, limiting their ability to optimize allocation across multi-slot page views. In this paper, we propose a novel joint optimization framework for multi-slot GD allocation, addressing key challenges such as slot-level redundancy, contract imbalance, and exposure concentration. Our approach formulates the allocation as an offline bipartite matching problem with a contract roulette mechanism for slot exclusivity and Page View constraints for impression control, and incorporates a scalable allocation optimization algorithm for efficient large-scale deployment. Extensive online tests on the Meituan advertising platform demonstrate that our method significantly improves merchant ROI, platform revenue efficiency, and contract fulfillment robustness. Specifically, online A/B tests show a 28.99% increase in Average Revenue Per User under 70% traffic, and DID analysis further indicates improved contract stability, demonstrating the strong applicability and effectiveness of our framework in real-world advertising deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多槽GD广告分配问题，提出结合离线二部图匹配、合同轮盘机制和PV约束的联合优化框架，并在美团平台验证了显著的用户收益和收入效率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 guaranteed display(GD) 广告分配方法多基于单槽假设，难以在多槽页面浏览场景下进行全局优化分配，存在槽级冗余、合同不平衡和曝光集中等挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种多槽GD分配的联合优化框架，将分配问题建模为离线二部图匹配问题，引入合同轮盘机制保障槽位独占性，并设置页面浏览量(PV)约束控制曝光集中度，同时设计了可扩展的分配优化算法以支持大规模部署。
AI.result: 在线A/B测试显示，在70%流量条件下，用户平均收入(ARPU)提升28.99%；双重差分(DID)分析表明合同稳定性得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种基于离线二部图匹配的多槽GD分配框架，通过轮盘机制和PV约束实现了流量精细化控制，在美团平台的在线A/B测试中验证了其在用户收益、平台收入效率和合同履约稳定性方面的显著提升，具有较强的工业落地价值。

title: SynAE: A Framework for Measuring the Quality of Synthetic Data for Tool-Calling Agent Evaluations
summary: Today, tool-calling agents are commonly evaluated or tested on static datasets of execution traces, including input commands, agent responses, and associated tool calls. However, internal production datasets are often insufficient or unusable for testing; for example, they may contain sensitive or proprietary data, or they may be too sparse to support comprehensive testing (especially pre-deployment). In these settings, practitioners are increasingly replacing or augmenting real datasets with synthetic ones for evaluation purposes. A key challenge is quantifying the relation between these synthetic datasets and the real data. We introduce SynAE, an evaluation framework for assessing how well synthetic benchmarks for multi-turn, tool-calling agents replicate and augment the characteristics of real data trajectories. SynAE assesses the validity, fidelity, and diversity of synthetic data across four metric categories: (i) task instructions and intermediate responses, (ii) tool calls, (iii) final outputs, and (iv) downstream evaluation. We evaluate SynAE using recent agent benchmarks and test common synthetic data failure modes via realistic and controlled generation schemes. SynAE detects fine-grained variations in data validity, fidelity and diversity, and shows that no single metric is sufficient to fully characterize synthetic data quality, motivating a multi-axis evaluation of synthetic data for agent testing. A demo of SynAE is available at https://synae-2026-synae-demo.static.hf.space/index.html, with code at https://github.com/wsqwsq/SynAE.

AI.tldr: SynAE is a multi-axis evaluation framework for assessing synthetic data quality in tool-calling agent benchmarks, addressing the gap between synthetic and real data trajectories through four metric categories, and demonstrating that comprehensive evaluation requires multiple assessment dimensions rather than any single metric.
AI.motivation: Static datasets for evaluating tool-calling agents are often insufficient or unusable due to sensitive data, proprietary constraints, or sparsity issues. Practitioners increasingly rely on synthetic datasets, but there is no systematic method to quantify how well these synthetic datasets replicate or augment characteristics of real data trajectories. A clear gap exists in evaluating the quality of synthetic benchmarks.
AI.method: The paper introduces SynAE, an evaluation framework that assesses synthetic data across four metric categories: (i) task instructions and intermediate responses, (ii) tool calls, (iii) final outputs, and (iv) downstream evaluation. The framework evaluates datasets using recent agent benchmarks and tests common synthetic data failure modes via realistic and controlled generation schemes.
AI.result: SynAE successfully detects fine-grained variations in data validity, fidelity, and diversity across multiple metrics. Experiments demonstrate that no single metric is sufficient to fully characterize synthetic data quality for agent testing.
AI.conclusion: SynAE provides a practical framework for evaluating synthetic data quality in agent evaluation, highlighting the necessity of multi-axis assessment — no single metric suffices to fully characterize synthetic data quality.

title: Planning in the LLM Era: Building for Reliability and Efficiency
summary: Growing attention to intelligent agents has put a spotlight on one of their central capabilities: planning. Early attempts to leverage large language models (LLMs) for planning relied on single-shot plan generation, followed by hybrid approaches that coupled LLMs with limited external search. These methods, unsound and incomplete by their very nature, often require substantial resources without yielding better solutions on unseen problems. As the limitations of LLMs become clearer, recent work has shifted toward using them at solution construction time -- generating symbolic solvers for a family of problems that can be verified and then used efficiently at inference time. This trend reflects the growing need for agents that are both reliable and resource-efficient. It also offers a path towards generating maintainable planners with minimal dependence on language models at inference time. In this paper, we argue that this shift reflects a broader realignment of the planning field in the LLM era. We examine three major categories of planner-generation methods, discuss their current limitations, and outline research steps towards a more reliable and efficient LLM-based generation of planners.

AI.tldr: This paper reviews the evolution of LLM-based planning methods from early single-shot approaches and hybrid search methods (which proved unsound, incomplete, and resource-intensive) to a newer paradigm of generating symbolic solvers at construction time. The authors argue this shift represents a broader realignment in the planning field, offering a more sustainable path toward reliable and efficient planners with minimal LLM dependency during inference.
AI.motivation: Early LLM-based planning methods (single-shot generation and hybrid search approaches) suffer from fundamental limitations: they are unsound and incomplete by nature, require substantial computational resources, yet often fail to produce better solutions on unseen problems. There's a growing need for planners that are both reliable and resource-efficient.
AI.method: The paper examines and categorizes planner-generation methods into three major categories, analyzing their approaches to integrating LLMs with planning systems.
AI.result: The authors identify a paradigm shift from using LLMs for direct plan generation toward using them as generators of symbolic solvers at construction time. This approach produces verifiable solvers that can be used efficiently at inference time.
AI.conclusion: The shift toward generating symbolic solvers at construction time represents a fundamental realignment of the planning field in the LLM era, offering a path toward reliable, efficient, and maintainable planners with reduced dependence on LLMs during inference.

title: From Parameters to Data: A Task-Parameter-Guided Fine-Tuning Pipeline for Efficient LLM Alignment
summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized domains typically incurs high data and computational overhead. While prior efficiency efforts have largely treated data selection and parameter-efficient fine-tuning as isolated processes, our empirical analysis suggests they may be intrinsically coupled. We posit the Strong Map Hypothesis: a sparse subset of attention heads plays a dominant role in task-specific adaptation, acting as keys that unlock specific data patterns.
