Building on this observation, we propose From Parameters to Data (P2D), a unified framework that leverages these task-sensitive attention heads as a dual compass for both sample mining and structural pruning. To rigorously quantify the total pipeline cost, we introduce the Alignment Efficiency Ratio (AER) metric for both selection latency and training time. Mechanistically, P2D identifies critical heads via a lightweight proxy and uses them as a functional filter to curate high-affinity data, establishing a synergistic pipeline. Empirically, by updating merely 10% of attention heads on 10% of the data, P2D achieves an 8.3 pp performance gain over strong baselines and delivers a 7.0x end-to-end time speedup. These results validate that precise parameter-data synchronization eliminates redundancy, offering a new paradigm for efficient alignment.

AI.tldr: P2D（From Parameters to Data）提出"强映射假设"（Strong Map Hypothesis）：任务适配由稀疏注意力头主导。据此构建三阶段流水线——快速头定位（FHI）、参数引导数据选择（P2D†）、稀疏头适配（P2D‡），并提出端到端效率指标 AER。在10%注意力头+10%数据预算下，相比强基线取得 8.3 个百分点性能提升与 7.0× 端到端加速。
AI.motivation: LLM 领域微调（SFT）存在数据与算力双重开销。既有工作将"数据选择"与"参数高效微调（PEFT）"视为相互独立的两条路径，导致面向全参数微调优化的数据选择策略在稀疏参数配置下可能次优，而参数筛选工具（LoFiT、ALPS 等）仅被当作剪枝手段，丢弃了模型结构对数据筛选的引导价值。作者的核心诉求是：让模型自身的任务响应结构同时充当数据挖掘与参数剪枝的"双重罗盘"，并需要一个能把选择前置开销计入的统一效率度量（现有指标忽略 selection latency，如 IFD/Nuggets 的 AER 甚至大于 1）。
AI.method:
问题形式化：构造 f=(f_ds, f_ft)，从数据 D 中选 D_T（比例 ρ_D），仅更新注意力头子集 H_T（比例 ρ_P）。定义 AER(f)=t_f/t_FFT，其中 t_f = 数据选择时间 + 适配时间（含代理训练、评分等预处理开销），AER<1 表示端到端真正加速。

Stage I 快速头识别（FHI）：先构建轻量代理模型 M_T（在100条随机样本上全批量训练20步，AER 中约占0.01），对每个头 h 计算复合矩阵 W_comp^h = W_q^h W_k^{h⊤} W_v^h，将基座与代理的该矩阵 flatten 后经全局 Softmax（τ=0.1）转为分布 P_B^h、P_T^h，用 Wasserstein-1 距离 s_h^PAD = W1(P_B^h, P_T^h) 作为头敏感度得分，取 top-ρ_P 构成 H_T。选择 W1 的理由：对小参数漂移呈线性响应（而梯度/Fisher 类指标为二次抑制），且数据无关、评分近零开销（~30s vs 梯度法 ~10min），在 7B→32B 规模上优势递增。也可直接复用现成任务模型（如 Qwen2.5-Math）替代代理。

Stage II 参数引导数据选择（P2D†）：采用 ICL 探针——采样 demo 集 D_d 与 query 集 D_q，构造含任务指令的上下文，按 query 准确率/ROUGE-L 计算基线得分 s(t)；同时用 H_T 内的注意力子矩阵做"结构感知加权"：w_i = (1/ℓ(x))·Σ_{h∈H_T} 1ᵀ A^(h)_i 1，仅在任务敏感头上累加注意力，避免全局聚合引入任务无关噪声；迭代 T 轮后按 s_final(x_i)= (1/n_i)Σ s(k)·w_i(k) 排序取 top-ρ_D，得 D_T。

Stage III 稀疏头适配（P2D‡）：冻结除 H_T 对应投影矩阵外全部参数，梯度掩码 ∇_{θ^h}L ← m_h·∇_{θ^h}L，以标准指令微调负对数似然目标在 D_T 上训练。

基线：数据选择（IFD、Nuggets、Data Whisperer）× 适配方式（Full、LoRA r=128、LoFiT、Random 头）；在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen-3-8B、Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上于 GSM8K/DialogSum/BioInstruct 评测，8×A100、DeepSpeed ZeRO-2、3 个随机种子。
AI.result:
主结果（Table 1）：在 10% 数据 / 10% 头预算下，P2D 平均分 51.87，优于所有基线（Data Whisperer 49.38、Nuggets 43.30、IFD 43.77）；10%/10% 配置在 GSM8K（82.56/84.78/69.12）上已逼近甚至超过全量全参 SFT（81.55/84.89/68.63），在 DialogSum、BioInstruct 上超越全参基线。

效率（Table 2/23）：P2D†+P2D‡ 的 AER 最低（GSM8K 0.32、DialogSum 0.38、BioInstruct 0.25），相对 Nuggets(全参) 提速 5.97×/8.63×/6.48×；选择开销极小（T_sel≈0.08–0.21，Nuggets≈1.17–2.83，IFD≈0.63–0.73）。附录 I 分解：仅参数稀疏贡献 ~1.72×、仅数据稀疏 ~2.22×，二者复合得到 7.0×；ZeRO-2 通信量从 ~30.4 GB/step/GPU 降至 ~0.30 GB（约100×）。

消融：ρ_P 在 10%–30% 达峰（验证参数冗余）；ρ_D 在推理任务冗余高、领域任务需更多数据。LoRA rank 搜索（r=32~256）均落后 P2D 3–4 pp（可训练参数预算相当，0.94%）。锁-钥交叉消融：P2D 数据 + 随机头从 78.82 降至 67.13；P2D 头 + 他法数据同样大幅下降，验证组件不可替换的协同性。

规模扩展（Table 5）：Qwen2.5 1.5B→32B 上 P2D‡ 在全数据设置下于所有规模、全部任务均优于 Full SFT 与 LoRA，且增益随规模扩大（Strong Map 随参数量更集中）。灾难性遗忘（Table 9）：UltraChat 10% 数据对齐后，P2D 保留 MMLU 67.45/ARC-C 78.23，显著优于 Full SFT（56.34/61.89）与 LoRA（63.12/71.56）。稳定性：top-10% 头两两重叠约 91%、10% 数据 Jaccard 约 93%。数据侧可视化：所选子集困惑度更低但平均长度与全量基本一致，排除长度/难度捷径。

局限（Appendix M）：MLP 全冻结导致新知识注入受限；FHI 代理仅 100 样本可能漏检长训练才显现的头；7.0× 加速结论限于特定 ZeRO-2/8×A100 配置；ICL 评分对 demo 敏感；仅验证 SFT，未扩展到 RLHF/DPO。
AI.conclusion: P2D 证明"参数—数据同步"是高效对齐的关键：稀疏任务敏感头作为"锁"，高亲和数据作为"钥"，二者必须精准配对才能释放对齐效率。方法贡献有三：一是强映射假设与随之而来的"稠密→稀疏结构对齐"范式转变；二是把头定位复用为数据筛选的功能探针，形成统一协同流水线（而非组件拼装）；三是 AER 指标将选择前置成本纳入端到端核算，暴露出若干既有选择方法实际 AER>1 的隐性开销。实践含义是：资源受限或需保留通用能力的场景应优先做注意力头级稀疏更新而非全参/LoRA 式微调，且大模型收益更显著；后续方向包括引入少量 MLP 解锁、演示无关的数据打分、RLHF/DPO 与 P2D-LoRA 混合等。

title: HarnessAPI: A Skill-First Framework for Unified Streaming APIs and MCP Tools
summary: Every Python function deployed as an LLM tool must today exist in two forms: an HTTP endpoint for human-facing clients and CI pipelines, and an MCP tool registration for agent runtimes such as Claude and Cursor. These representations share business logic yet diverge in all the surrounding machinery (routing, validation, serialisation, streaming, and schema maintenance), and they drift apart as the underlying code evolves. We present HarnessAPI, a Python framework that eliminates this duplication by treating a typed skill folder as the single source of truth. From one handler.py plus Pydantic schemas, the framework automatically derives a streaming HTTP endpoint with Server-Sent Events, an interactive OpenAPI/Swagger UI, and a zero-configuration MCP tool, all served from a single process. Dual-mode content negotiation lets the same handler serve SSE-streaming and JSON-returning clients with no handler changes. A dynamic code-generation mechanism ensures Pydantic type annotations propagate correctly to FastMCP's inspection layer, resolving a technical limitation that prevents naive closure-based registration. Measured across six representative skills using cloc, HarnessAPI reduces framework-facing boilerplate by 74% compared with a manually maintained dual-stack implementation (FastAPI server + FastMCP server). HarnessAPI subclasses FastAPI, inheriting its full middleware, dependency-injection, and deployment ecosystem. It is available at https://github.com/edwinjosechittilappilly/harnessapi and on PyPI (pip install harnessapi)

AI.tldr: HarnessAPI 是一个 Python 框架，将"类型化技能文件夹（handler.py + Pydantic models）"作为唯一事实来源，自动派生出 SSE 流式 HTTP 端点、OpenAPI/Swagger UI 与零配置 MCP 工具，并由单一进程同时提供 HTTP 与 MCP 两种传输。相较手写的 FastAPI + FastMCP 双栈实现，在六个技能上用 cloc 测得框架侧样板代码减少 74%（170 → 44 行）。
AI.motivation: 部署为 LLM 工具的 Python 函数必须同时存在两份：面向人类客户端与 CI 流水线的 HTTP 端点，以及面向 Claude、Cursor 等智能体运行时的 MCP 工具注册。两者共享业务逻辑，却在路由、校验、序列化、流式支持、schema 维护等外围机制上完全割裂，并随代码演进而漂移。已有实证表明 88.6% 的 MCP 服务器背后是既有 REST 服务，双份维护负担普遍存在；而缺失或过期的类型 schema 会导致 LLM 幻觉式 API 调用。根因在于架构：FastAPI 是"路由优先"、FastMCP 是"工具优先"，都不把"技能"当作一等实体，开发者必须居中手动同步两份定义。
AI.method: 提出 skill-first 架构模式并给出实现：(1) 技能目录解剖——必需 handler.py 与 models.py，可选 skill.toml、SKILL.md、defaults/、examples/；处理器可为 return 或 async yield 两种形态，由 inspect.isasyncgenfunction 判定；元数据优先级为 skill.toml > SKILL.md front-matter > docstring > 文件夹名。(2) 双模内容协商——客户端通过 Accept: application/json 头决定缓冲 JSON 还是 SSE 流式，含 chunk/result/done/error 四类事件。(3) HarnessAPI 子类化 FastAPI，将 FastMCP 作为 ASGI 子应用挂载，并通过合并 lifespan 上下文管理器同时启动两者；每个技能一次注册即产出 SkillRoute 与 MCP 工具。(4) 技能发现采用每技能合成包命名空间（_harness_skills.<name>）配合 importlib.util.spec_from_file_location 实现模块隔离，避免同名 Input/Output 类冲突。(5) MCP 注册采用动态代码生成：用 exec 编译一个 wrapper，其 __globals__ 中显式包含 Pydantic 模型，从而绕过 FastMCP 注解解析器只能查 __globals__、无法解析闭包捕获类型的 NameError 限制。(6) 另有运行时 handler 热替换端点（仅限 loopback，启动时校验）与 CLI 脚手架（含 --function 模式的 AST 解析与类型推断）。
AI.result: 在 Echo、Greet、Summarize、VectorNorm、Classify、Translate 六个技能上以 cloc v2.0 统计（排除业务逻辑与模型声明），手写双栈需 170 行（HTTP 103 + MCP 67），HarnessAPI 仅 44 行，减少 74.1%，各技能区间 68–79%；且框架侧成本在 HarnessAPI 下为 O(1)（固定于 main.py 入口），手写为 O(n)，十技能时手写约 283 行。功能对等表显示 HarnessAPI 独占 HTTP 端点、MCP 工具、Swagger UI、SSE、同路由 JSON 回退、内容协商、逐技能超时、MCP 开关、agentskills.io 兼容与单进程部署等能力。对 12 个公开 agentskills.io 技能目录运行 init --skills-dir，全部无修改导入注册成功。
AI.conclusion: skill-first 反转把"维护两次注册"的约定转变为结构性不变量：HTTP 与 MCP 的 schema 由同一 Pydantic 模型派生，一致性由构造保证而非事后校验；74% 样板代码减少是该不变量的结果而非目的，更持久的结论是技能数的规模特性（常数 vs 线性增长）。局限与未来工作：评估样本为作者自写的六个技能，绝对百分比应视为示意性；缺少端到端延迟与并发基准；Pydantic 复杂 Union 与深层嵌套模型在 FastMCP 注解解析器上可能存在边界情况；exec 式 MCP wrapper 待 FastMCP 显式 schema API 发布后重构移除；MCP 层尚不支持逐工具认证，多租户部署需置于认证代理之后；热替换端点等价于 RCE，仅允许在 loopback 使用（框架启动时强制校验），生产环境应改用基于重启的部署。规划方向包括逐技能认证、文件系统监听热加载、技能注册中心等。

title: Hallucination as Commitment Failure: Larger LLMs Misfire Despite Knowing the Answer
summary: Hallucination is often viewed as a direct consequence of missing knowledge: a model answers incorrectly when the correct answer is absent from its generation-time distribution, and correctly when it is present. We test this assumption by introducing a semantic notion of answer availability that aggregates token-level variants expressing the same answer concept, and asks whether the correct concept is already available at the moment the model commits to an answer. Across Qwen and Llama models from 0.8B to 72B in both Instruct and Base variants, 16-47% of Instruct hallucinations occur with substantial probability mass already on the correct concept, and the rate rises monotonically with scale. Comparing such failures against correct generations with matched semantic support, the distinguishing factor is not whether the correct concept is represented, but how its probability is distributed: correct generations concentrate mass on a single surface form, hallucinations disperse it across alternatives. The same sharpening asymmetry extends across multi-token generation and is detectable in pre-generation hidden states. Together, these results identify a single mechanism: instruction tuning sharpens answer commitment with scale, making helpfulness and confident hallucination two consequences of the same underlying disposition.

AI.tldr: 幻觉并非因为模型"不知道"，而是因为概率分布过于分散而未能集中承诺于正确答案。指令微调通过尺度效应增强答案承诺能力，使助人为乐与自信幻觉成为同一机制的两面。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为幻觉是知识缺失的直接后果：当正确答案不在生成分布中时模型会答错。然而该假设缺乏语义层面的严格验证——模型可能已通过其他表面形式表达正确答案。
AI.method: 研究引入语义层面的答案可用性概念，聚合表达同一答案的不同token形式，通过Qwen和Llama（0.8B-72B，Instruct和Base版本）进行实验，追踪正确概念的表示、概率分布与隐藏状态变化。
AI.result: 16-47%的Instruct幻觉中，正确概念已有显著概率；幻觉与正确答案的区别不在于概念是否被表达，而在于概率分布模式：正确生成将概率集中于单一表面形式，幻觉则分散于多个替代选项。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉并非源于知识缺失，而是源于答案承诺的分散化。指令微调增强了答案承诺能力，且这一能力随模型规模单调提升。模型的"助人为乐"与"自信幻觉"是同一底层机制的两种表现。

title: AutoMCU: Feasibility-First MCU Neural Network Customization via LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Deploying neural networks on microcontroller units (MCUs) is critical for edge intelligence but remains challenging due to tight memory, storage, and computation constraints. Existing approaches, such as model compression and hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS), often depend on proxy metrics, incur high search cost, and do not fully bridge the gap between architecture design and verified deployment. This paper presents AutoMCU, a feasibility-first large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system for automated neural network customization under MCU constraints. Given natural-language task requirements and hardware specifications, AutoMCU iteratively generates structured architecture candidates, filters infeasible designs through vendor toolchain feedback before training, evaluates feasible models under a controlled protocol, and verifies deployability through backend-grounded deployment analysis. AutoMCU includes two key mechanisms: 1) hardware-in-the-loop architecture generation for early elimination of undeployable candidates under RAM and Flash constraints, and 2) state-isolated multi-agent scheduling for stable coordination of proposal, training, evaluation, and deployment stages. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under strict MCU constraints show that AutoMCU achieves competitive accuracy while reducing customization time to about 1--2 hours, compared with hundreds of GPU hours for representative MCU-oriented HW-NAS baselines. Comparisons with ColabNAS and the LLM-based NAS method GENIUS on NAS-Bench-201 further demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of AutoMCU. Real-device deployments on multiple STM32 microcontrollers validate its practical applicability to MCU-scale edge intelligence.

AI.tldr: AutoMCU 提出一个"可行性优先"的 LLM 多智能体系统，用于在 MCU（微控制器）严苛的 RAM/Flash 预算下自动定制神经网络。它将厂商部署后端（如 STM32Cube.AI）直接嵌入搜索闭环，在训练前就淘汰不可部署的候选架构，并通过状态隔离的主管-智能体调度保证长时程稳定性。实验表明，在 CIFAR-10/100 等任务上以约 1–2 GPU 小时（基线为数百 GPU 小时）获得有竞争力的精度，并在 STM32F407VET6 与 STM32H723ZGT6 真机上验证了可部署性。
AI.motivation: MCU 部署神经网络的根本困难在于 RAM/Flash/算力极度受限，且"看起来轻量"（参数量、MACs 等代理指标小）的模型仍可能因算子不支持、后端内存分配行为或转换/运行时限制而部署失败。现有路线各有缺陷：(1) 剪枝、量化、蒸馏等压缩方法面向固定或同质硬件，需专家针对每款 MCU 手工反复调深度、通道与压缩策略，且多为训练后处理，难以与硬件评估和部署工具链集成；(2) NAS/HW-NAS 多依赖代理硬件指标与加权标量化目标，搜索开销大（数百 GPU 小时），且搜索/训练/部署验证相互割裂，最终仍需人工排查算子不兼容、内存溢出与转换失败；(3) LLM 辅助架构生成（GENIUS 等）仅面向常规深度学习场景，未建模 Flash/SRAM 硬预算、算子支持与后端转换行为，也未与部署后端闭环。因此需要一个把"后端可验证可部署性"当作迭代反馈信号（而非最后一步校验）、并能端到端自动化"提案—训练—评估—部署"全流程的 MCU 定制方案。
AI.method: 系统由 Supervisor（主管）+ 三个任务模块构成：Proposal Agent（提案）、Training Agent（训练）、Evaluation & Conversion Agent（评估与转换），构成闭环"提案—筛查—训练—评估"。核心机制有两个：(1) HAG（硬件在环架构生成）：LLM 不输出自由文本，而输出结构化架构规格 a=(B,H)，B=[l1..ln]，每层 li=(ti,θi)，ti 限定在预定义原子模块集（conv/depthwise/downsample/pointwise/ghost/bottleneck 等），θi 含通道、核、步幅、填充、扩张比等；由模型构建器解析实例化，仅当 schema 合法且层间张量维度一致时才算"可构造"。实例化后立即调用厂商工具链获取 RAM、Flash 与算子兼容性，超限者直接淘汰、不进入训练。(2) MSIM（多智能体调度与交互机制）：主管集中解析请求、分配子任务、决定终止；各 agent 内部状态隔离，仅通过结构化摘要（任务状态+关键结果）交换信息，不共享中间推理与工具调用轨迹，避免共享上下文式 MAS 的上下文膨胀、token 浪费与越权行为。训练采用"受控训练"策略：统一数据划分、预处理、优化器与评估指标，限定训练预算并在验证提升停滞时早停，目标是给出可比较的判别性反馈而非逐个收敛到最优。历史仓库 R(k+1)=R(k)∪{(a, P(a;D,T), M(a;C))} 记录架构、精度与后端测量，用于后续提案精化。部署评估基于 STM32Cube.AI（可替换为 TFLite Micro 等），输出含精度、RAM/Flash、算子兼容状态与部署产物路径的部署报告。实验采用 DeepSeek-V3.2（另测 MiMo-V2-Flash、Qwen-Plus），temperature=0；数据集保留原生 32×32 以节省 RAM（3KB vs 上采样 224×224 的 147KB，占 MCU RAM 预算 14.3%–57.4%）；基线含 μNAS、ColabNAS、GENIUS、MCUNet/MnasNet/FairNAS、MobileNetV2/SqueezeNet/ShuffleNetV2。
AI.result: 在 RAM≤1024KB/Flash≤1024KB 下，CIFAR-10：AutoMCU(DeepSeek-V3.2) 89.31±0.16%，RAM 218.81KB，Flash 848.97KB，1.58±1.07 GPU 小时，$0.45；MiMo-V2-Flash 89.30%，Qwen-Plus 88.77%，与 μNAS（89.75%）相当但搜索时间从 257.48 GPU 小时/$53.35 大幅下降；ColabNAS 仅 74.77%。CIFAR-100 同约束下 AutoMCU 61.63±0.50% 优于 μNAS 60.26%，0.72 GPU 小时。严格约束 RAM≤256KB/Flash≤512KB：CIFAR-10 达 87.62±0.52%（μNAS 87.88% 但 RAM 580.92KB 超限），CIFAR-100 达 58.70±0.71%。超低预算 RAM/Flash≤64KB 下仍可生成可行模型：CIFAR-10 76.36%、MNIST 99.23%、FashionMNIST 91.28%。NAS-Bench-201 上与 GENIUS（同等 10 架构预算、10 次重复）对比：验证/测试精度在 CIFAR-10 (90.89/93.74 vs 90.82/93.73)、CIFAR-100 (72.32/72.24 vs 71.37/71.30)、ImageNet16-120 (45.07/45.19 vs 44.63/44.51) 均占优，且方差显著更小（ImageNet16-120 验证标准差 0.85 vs 2.28，测试 0.95 vs 2.49）。消融（CIFAR-10 严格约束，10 次运行/最多 10 轮）显示完整系统最优且失败率 0；w/o MSIM（共享上下文）精度近似但失败率 50%、token 翻倍至 0.99M；w/o HAG（随机搜索）精度降至 82.89±2.81%、时间升至 3.81 GPU 小时；Baseline（两者皆去）精度 81.06±3.72%、token 最高 1.92M、失败率 60%。真机验证：STM32F407VET6（M4 168MHz，192KB RAM/512KB Flash）上 MNIST 99.36%、FashionMNIST 93.42%、CIFAR-10 86.39%、CIFAR-100 58.05%；STM32H723ZGT6（M7 550MHz，564KB RAM/1MB Flash）上分别为 99.37%、93.94%、88.99%、61.66%，均成功编译烧录并完成端侧推理。
AI.conclusion: AutoMCU 证明将真实厂商部署工具链嵌入闭环、把硬件可行性作为训练前的硬约束、并以状态隔离的多智能体调度协调长时程迭代，可同时获得部署可行性、竞争性精度与数量级的搜索效率优势（数百 GPU 小时降至 1–2 小时，token 与失败率大幅下降），并在 NAS-Bench-201 上证明其优势不仅来自硬件检查，也来自结构化的工作流级设计。局限与未来方向：目前聚焦图像分类与 STM32Cube.AI 后端，尚未覆盖更广的 TinyML 负载、更多异构部署后端与开源嵌入式推理框架；也未像 μNAS 那样显式建模延迟与多目标标量化，未来拟结合更先进的架构搜索与硬件建模技术以提升定制质量、效率与跨平台适应性。

title: LatentOmni: Rethinking Omni-Modal Understanding via Unified Audio-Visual Latent Reasoning
summary: Joint audio-visual reasoning is essential for omnimodal understanding, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle when reasoning requires fine-grained evidence from both modalities. A central limitation is that explicit text-based chain-of-thought (CoT) compresses continuous audio-visual signals into discrete tokens, weakening temporal grounding and shifting intermediate reasoning toward language priors. We argue that a unified latent space is a better medium for such reasoning because it preserves dense sensory information while remaining compatible with autoregressive generation. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{LatentOmni}, a cross-modal reasoning framework that interleaves textual reasoning with audio-visual latent states. LatentOmni introduces feature-level supervision to align latent reasoning states with task-relevant sensory features and uses Omni-Sync Position Embedding (OSPE) to maintain temporal consistency between latent audio and visual states. We further construct \textbf{LatentOmni-Instruct-35K}, a dataset of audio-visual interleaved reasoning trajectories for supervising latent-space reasoning. Comprehensive evaluation across multiple audio-visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrates that LatentOmni achieves the best performance among the evaluated open-source models and consistently outperforms the Explicit Text CoT baseline, supporting latent-space joint reasoning as a promising path toward stronger omnimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: LatentOmni是一种跨模态推理框架，通过统一的潜在空间而非离散文本token进行音频-视觉联合推理，解决了传统方法时序定位弱和推理偏向语言的问题，在开源模型中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在需要进行细粒度双模态证据推理时表现不佳。显式文本链式思维将连续音频-视觉信号压缩为离散token，削弱了时序定位能力并将中间推理偏向语言先验。
AI.method: 提出LatentOmni框架，通过在文本推理中穿插音频-视觉潜在状态实现跨模态推理。具体包括：特征级监督对齐潜在推理状态与任务相关感官特征；Omni-Sync位置嵌入(OSPE)维持音频与视觉潜在状态间的时序一致性；构建LatentOmni-Instruct-35K数据集用于监督潜在空间推理过程。
AI.result: 在多个音频-视觉推理基准测试中，LatentOmni在所有评估的开源模型中取得最佳性能，持续超越显式文本CoT基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间联合推理是实现更强全模态理解的可行路径。

title: Format-Constraint Coupling in Knowledge Graph Construction from Statistical Tables
comment: 8 pages main body, 18 pages appendices. Submitted to EMNLP 2026 via ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Corresponding author: Yuxiang Feng (yxfeng@scut.edu.cn). Code and data available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sge_lightrag-BE19
summary: An extraction schema should not reduce knowledge graph fidelity. On statistical CSV, however, it can. We study country-by-year time-series matrices, a common layout on open-data portals. In this setting, serialization format and schema constraints interact super-additively. Their joint effect exceeds the sum of independent effects by up to +1.180 (2x2 factorial, 6 datasets). Bootstrap 95% CIs are strictly positive on 4/6 datasets, with strongest evidence on wide Type-II matrices. More critically, a schema applied to a mismatched format can trigger catastrophic mismatch. Fact coverage falls below the unconstrained baseline on 4/6 datasets through entity inflation or extraction refusal. We call this observed pattern format-constraint coupling. Probing and token ablation support a surface-form anchoring explanation centred on column-name references. Controlled variants across format-schema pairings, GraphRAG hosts, and LLM families show the same direction within the measured scope; one LLM family shows only partial activation. The observation also has a diagnostic consequence. Three standard retrieval modes largely mask construction quality (delta <= 1pp), whereas direct graph access exposes gaps up to +47.6pp (p < 0.0001). To support fidelity-aware evaluation, we release CSVFidelity-Bench. It contains 15 datasets, 11 Type-II matrices, 4 Type-III tables, and 1,892 Gold Standard facts across 6 domains.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CSV提取知识图谱时存在"格式-约束耦合"现象——格式与模式的交互作用会超叠加地降低保真度，导致实体膨胀或提取拒绝。标准检索模式掩盖质量差异，直接图访问才能暴露问题，并发布CSVFidelity-Bench基准支持保真度评估。
AI.motivation: 从统计CSV提取知识图谱时，序列化格式与模式约束的交互作用会超叠加(super-additively)地影响知识图谱保真度，尤其在国家-年份时间序列矩阵中表现明显。
AI.method: 采用2×2因子设计，使用Bootstrap 95%置信区间，跨格式-模式配对、GraphRAG主机和LLM家族进行受控实验，并通过探测和token消融验证假设。
AI.result: 格式-约束耦合效应最强时可达+1.180；4/6数据集上事实覆盖率低于无约束基线；三种标准检索模式几乎掩盖构建质量差异（仅≤1pp），而直接图访问可暴露高达+47.6pp的差距。
AI.conclusion: 发布CSVFidelity-Bench基准数据集，包含15个数据集、11个Type-II矩阵、4个Type-III表，横跨6个领域共1,892条标准事实，用于支持保真度感知评估。

title: Objective-Induced Bias and Search Dynamics in Multiobjective Unsupervised Feature Selection
summary: Unsupervised feature selection is commonly formulated as a multiobjective optimisation problem that jointly optimises subset quality and subset size. Yet the behaviour of this formulation depends critically on the choice of evaluation objective, the direction of subset-size regularisation, and the initialisation strategy. We study these factors in a controlled setting using a synthetic dataset with known informative, redundant, and irrelevant feature types. Six formulations are compared by combining three evaluation objectives: accuracy, silhouette score, and PCA reconstruction loss with subset-size minimisation or maximisation. The results show that formulation strongly affects both search dynamics and the quality of the resulting Pareto front. Silhouette-based formulations exhibit a strong bias toward trivial low-cardinality solutions and remain weak proxies for predictive performance. In contrast, the proposed PCA loss objective produces compact subsets with test accuracy comparable to subsets obtained by directly optimising supervised accuracy. Overall, the study shows that objective design is central to effective multiobjective unsupervised feature selection.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控合成数据上系统研究了多目标无监督特征选择（MOFS）的"问题形式化"问题：通过组合三种评价目标（分类准确率、轮廓系数、作者新提出的 PCA 重构损失）与两种子集规模正则方向（最小化/最大化）、三种种群初始化策略，对搜索动态与 Pareto 前沿质量的影响。核心结论是：轮廓系数类目标强烈偏向平凡的低基数解，只能与"最大化子集规模"搭配；新提出的 PCA 损失目标在最小化规模正则下能给出紧凑且测试精度接近直接优化监督准确率的子集，是有前景的无监督目标。
AI.motivation: 无监督特征选择常被形式化为多目标优化（多目标化）：同时优化评价目标 f1 与子集规模正则项 f2。然而该形式化的行为强烈依赖于：① 评价目标本身对子集基数的敏感性（诱导的基数偏差）；② 规模正则的方向（最小化还是最大化）；③ 初始种群中基数的分布。已有文献普遍只使用"最小化规模 + 最大化质量"的标准组合，但缺少对上述设计选择的系统分析；此外在真实数据上缺乏对"好子集"的真值定义，难以判断目标与特征类型（信息型/冗余型/噪声型）之间的关系。作者希望在一个具有已知特征分类体系（feature taxonomy）的合成数据集上建立受控实验框架，使"哪些特征被选中、为何被选中"可被直接检视，从而区分目标诱导的偏差与真实的最优性。
AI.method: 问题形式化：在二进制决策向量 x∈{0,1}^d 上最小化 (f1(X_x), f2(x))，f2=|x|（最小化规模）或 f2=-|x|（最大化规模）。三种评价目标：轮廓系数（对过滤后数据跑 k-means，k 在候选范围内按轮廓最大选择，取负号作最小化目标）；分类准确率（Random Forest，取负号，作为监督基线）；新提出的 PCA 损失——先在全量 X 上做一次 PCA 得目标投影矩阵 Z（固定预处理），再用过滤子集 X_x 通过多元线性回归预测 Ẑ，最小化 MSE 重构损失。选择 PCA 是因为主成分是原特征的线性组合，线性回归足以刻画，且逐次适应度评估成本低；同时该损失评估的是子集的集体信息，能抑制冗余（与 PCA 载荷排序不同，高相关特征在已存在时边际贡献趋零）。三种初始化：二值随机采样（期望比例 p）、分段采样（p∈{0.25,0.5,0.75} 三等分亚种群）、固定基数采样（如 k=1）。优化器为 SMS-EMOA，种群 50、代数 50、决策空间 {0,1}^d。合成数据集含三类分类，含信息型、线性冗余型、非线性冗余型、高斯噪声、结构化噪声、Sweep 六类特征，并记录派生特征的血缘（lineage）；以"仅信息型特征"作为 naive ground truth。分析手段：搜索历史与初始种群位置、找到的 Pareto 前沿、按所选特征做树状图聚类（C1–C4）分析前沿上的特征构成、测试集上的 RF 准确率分布、以及将各形式化投影到"准确率–规模"空间后用超体积指标 + Friedman–Nemenyi 检验（Holm 校正，α=0.01）进行统计排名（5 个数据集 × 30 个随机种子）。
AI.result: 1) 初始化策略对搜索可达区域影响显著：在"最小化规模+最大化准确率"下，用极低基数（k=1）初始化效果最好——因为目标函数评估昂贵（RF 成本高），优化器难以在预算内跨越基数差距，且多目标压力会把种群推向确有性能增益的大子集；而偏向大基数的初始化反而因远离信息集而更差。2) 轮廓系数与"最小化规模"搭配会迅速坍缩到平凡解（k=1 固定基数初始化时最明显）：高维下距离压缩 + 极小子集人为抬高轮廓分数，目标与正则方向叠加把搜索推向搜索空间原点，选出的子集远离 naive ground truth。因此轮廓类目标应与"最大化规模"配对（尽管反直觉）。3) 即便正确配对（轮廓+最大化规模），其前沿仍倾向选择冗余甚至无关特征，naive ground truth 被前沿支配但支配解的分类精度反而更低，说明轮廓系数在该合成数据上是差的精度代理。4) PCA 损失+最小化规模能有效保留信息型特征（未被显式选中的 Feature 1 由其派生特征 Feature 80 补偿，说明信息被保留），仍存在部分冗余，naive ground truth 位于前沿附近；C1–C3 接近最优，C4 为过度稀疏的低性能组。5) 六种形式化在 5 个合成集×30 seed 上的超体积统计排名显示：表现最佳者为"准确率最大化"与"PCA 损失"，且二者均使用最小化规模正则+固定基数初始化；轮廓类形式化显著更差。PCA 损失未超过直接优化准确率，但无需标签、单次评估更廉价。
AI.conclusion: 问题形式化（评价目标与规模正则方向的交互）而非算法本身，决定了多目标无监督特征选择的成败：基于聚类质量的目标（轮廓系数）会诱导平凡低基数解并与预测性能脱钩，重构类目标提供更稳定的信号；本文提出的 PCA 重构损失作为无监督目标，可在紧凑子集上取得与直接优化监督准确率相当的测试精度。作者明确指出结论目前仅基于合成数据，真实数据集验证是必需的下一项工作；未来方向包括探索更多无监督目标，以及用非线性重建模型（如神经网络）刻画更复杂的潜在表示。

title: FlyRoute: Self-Evolving Agent Profiling via Data Flywheel for Adaptive Task Routing
summary: Enterprise routers assign queries to expert agents, yet deployed profiles stay static while agents evolve (prompts, tools, models), and developers rarely keep descriptions or exemplars current. We present FlyRoute, a self-evolving profiling framework that grows capability evidence from real traffic: dispatch candidates, quality-gate successful pairs into each agent's success store, periodically distill evidence into learned capability descriptions, and inject those descriptions together with BM25-retrieved successes into an LLM router. To make this flywheel data-efficient, FlyRoute introduces a targeted exploration policy that combines profile uncertainty, BM25 relevance, and lexical novelty, prioritizing under-profiled agents only for plausible queries and avoiding redundant evidence collection. In experiments on our proprietary enterprise developer-support dataset of real routed queries, FlyRoute improves a same-backbone zero-shot LLM router from 72.57% to 78.04% with only five seed queries per agent, showing that profile retrieval already strengthens cold-start routing. After streaming 7,211 labeled training queries through the flywheel, accuracy rises to 89.83% (+17.26pp over zero-shot; +11.79pp over cold start), with consistent gains across four expert domains under standard routing accuracy on single-gold test queries.

AI.tldr: FlyRoute 是一个「自我进化」的智能体画像框架：用真实部署流量中的路由交互替代开发者手写的静态能力描述，通过「质量门控 → 成功样本库 → 周期性能力蒸馏 → BM25 检索 + LLM 路由」的数据飞轮闭环持续更新各专家智能体的画像，并引入融合画像不确定性、BM25 相关性与词法新颖度的定向探索策略高效收集证据。在企业开发者支持数据集上，同骨干 Qwen3-8B 路由准确率从零样本 72.57% 提升到 5 条种子冷启动的 78.04%，再在流式回放 7,211 条训练查询后达到 89.83%（较零样本 +17.26pp，较冷启动 +11.79pp），且无需重训练路由器。
AI.motivation: 现有路由方法（监督编码器路由、嵌入相似度、图结构学习、级联/预算感知选择等）普遍假设「智能体能力在注册时即可准确描述且此后保持稳定」，这在企业部署中不成立：一是开发者难以写出精确的能力描述与代表性样例，描述会随系统提示词、工具、底层模型迭代而迅速过期；二是路由决策仍基于过时画像，导致错派。根因被归结为「画像的静态性」，因此需要把画像从一次性初始化的注册元数据，转变为随部署交互持续演化的可维护资产——成功的路由交互本身就是关于智能体实际能力边界的经验证据。
AI.method: 闭环数据飞轮（以每个专家域一个智能体为例）：(1) 注册期仅需名称、可选种子描述与 k=5 条种子样例，画像 P_i=(d_i^seed, ∅, E_i^seed)；(2) 路由阶段，LLM 路由器（Qwen3-8B）系统提示中放入每智能体的活跃描述 d_i^learn（有蒸馏结果则替换 d_i^seed）及按 BM25 从成功库检索的 top-k 成功样例；(3) 质量门控用 LLM-as-Judge 打分 s∈[0,1]，仅当 s≥θ=0.7 时把 (q, r, s) 写入成功库 E_i；(4) 每积累 M=20 条新成功即用 LLM 蒸馏出 ≤500 字符的精炼能力描述，强调只依据实证证据、可覆盖旧描述（画像压缩）；(5) 不确定性驱动的定向探索：以覆盖度不确定性 U(a)=1/(1+|E_i|^α)（α=0.5）刻画画像欠充分程度，以 BM25 归一化相关性 R(q,a) 作相关性门控，再以新颖度 N=1-R 作冗余抑制，得到 V+=U·R·(1+βN)（β=0.5），取分数≥γ=0.06 的前 n_explore=2 个探索目标（不足时按排名回退），与利用集合 S_exploit 合并为有界派发集 S；(6) 全流程仅使用被路由的交互与质量门控结果，金标路由标签对路由器、评审器、画像构建流水线完全不可见，仅用于评估。
AI.result: 主结果（Table 2，同骨干比较）：LLM Router 基线 72.57%（CS 93.61 / AIA 62.33 / SHW 37.41 / MOS 77.45）；FlyRoute 冷启动（仅种子检索）78.04%；完整飞轮 89.83%（CS 94.26 / AIA 88.70 / SHW 81.29 / MOS 91.18）。飞轮效应（Table 3）：N=0/500/1000/2000/4000/7211 对应 78.04→84.05→85.13→85.75→88.44→89.83，各域均提升（+10.28~+13.73pp），呈单调饱和式增长。探索策略对比（Table 4，N=500）：无探索 81.05、ε-greedy(0.3) 81.90、随机广播 81.97、FlyRoute 84.05（Δ+6.01pp）；但 Appendix B 显示流式到全部 7,211 条时各策略差距收敛（无探索/ε-greedy 88.52%，随机广播 88.06%）。消融（Table 5）：去掉质量门控下降最大（−1.39pp），去掉探索次之（−1.31pp），去掉蒸馏 −0.54pp，去掉新颖度 −0.77pp。
AI.conclusion: 结论：把智能体画像视为持续演化的产物（而非静态注册元数据），结合质量门控证据采集、能力蒸馏、检索增强画像与定向探索，可在完全不重训练路由器的前提下显著提升路由质量（72.57%→78.04%→89.83%）。局限：评测依赖私有企业日志，仅覆盖四个专家域，外部可复现性与跨行业/跨语言/大规模智能体生态的泛化性未验证；实验只验证了画像演化，未做显式的提示词/工具/模型能力漂移干预实验；框架对 LLM-as-Judge 的评审质量、校准与提示设计敏感，噪声反馈下的鲁棒性待研究；此外探索策略的收益集中在冷启动早期，证据库变大后探索价值边际化。

title: Echo: Learning from Experience Data via User-Driven Refinement
summary:
Static "human data" faces inherent limitations: it is expensive to scale and bounded by the knowledge of its creators. Continuous learning from "experience data" - interactions between agents and their environments - promises to transcend these barriers. Today, the widespread deployment of AI agents grants us low-cost access to massive streams of such real-world experience. However, raw interaction logs are inherently noisy, filled with trial-and-error and low information density, rendering them inefficient for direct model training.
  We introduce Echo, a generalized framework designed to operationalize the transition from raw experience to learnable knowledge, effectively "echoing" environmental feedback back into the training loop for model optimization. In today's agent ecosystem, user refinement serves as a primary source of such feedback: driven by responsibility for the outcome, users rigorously transform flawed agent proposals into verified solutions. These user-driven refinement sequences inherently distill agents' crude attempts into high-quality training signals. Echo systematically harvests these signals to continuously align the agent with real-world needs. Large-scale validation in a production code completion environment confirms that Echo effectively harnesses this pipeline, breaking the static performance ceiling by increasing the acceptance rate from 25.7% to 35.7%.

AI.tldr: Echo是一个将原始交互经验转化为可用训练知识的通用框架，通过采集用户在智能体生成内容上的修正行为作为反馈信号，实现模型的持续对齐。在代码补全场景中验证，接受率从25.7%提升至35.7%。
AI.motivation: 静态"人类数据"存在成本高、规模受限的局限性；而AI智能体产生的原始交互日志存在大量噪声、信息密度低，不适合直接用于模型训练。需要找到一种将原始经验转化为可学习知识的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出Echo框架，通过系统化采集用户对AI生成内容的修正序列，将这些高质量的反馈信号 harvested 并整合到模型训练循环中，实现智能体与真实需求的持续对齐。
AI.result: 在生产代码补全环境中验证，智能体接受率从25.7%提升至35.7%，成功突破静态性能天花板。
AI.conclusion: Echo框架成功将用户体验反馈转化为可学习的训练信号，在实际生产环境中验证有效，突破了静态性能瓶颈。

title: Embedding-Based Federated Learning with Runtime Governance for Iron Deficiency Prediction
summary: Recent reviews find that the vast majority of published healthcare federated learning (FL) studies never reach real-world deployment. We developed an embedding-based FL pipeline for iron deficiency prediction from routine full blood count (FBC) data and deployed it across real institutional environments at Amsterdam University Medical Centre (AUMC) and NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT), two clinical environments that differ markedly in iron deficiency prevalence, ferritin distribution, and subject populations. A frozen domain-specific haematology foundation model, DeepCBC, performs site-local representation extraction, restricting federated training to a compact downstream classifier and substantially reducing recurrent communication relative to full-encoder federation. The two clinical datasets are structurally not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), with heterogeneity arising from distinct population differences rather than sampling artefacts. Runtime governance is enforced by FLA$^3$, a healthcare-oriented FL platform providing study-scoped execution, policy-based authorisation, and signed audit logging. Standard sample-size-weighted aggregation (FedAvg) reduced the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) at both sites relative to local-only training, as the global update was biased towards the larger AUMC distribution. FedMAP, a personalised aggregation method, raised ROC-AUC from 0.9470 to 0.9594 at AUMC and from 0.8558 to 0.8671 at NHSBT relative to local-only training, achieving the highest macro ROC-AUC of 0.9133 and the best macro balanced accuracy overall. These results support personalised aggregation in clinical federations where client sample size and task relevance diverge substantially.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实临床机构环境（荷兰阿姆斯特丹大学医学中心 AUMC 与英国 NHS Blood and Transplant, NHSBT）部署了一套铁缺乏预测的联邦学习系统：采用冻结的 DeepCBC 血液学基础模型在站点本地提取 256 维表征，仅对小型 MLP 分类器做联邦训练，运行于具备 XACML 策略授权与签名审计日志的 FLA³ 平台。对比 Local-only、FedAvg、FedProx 与 FedMAP 发现，按样本量加权的 FedAvg 在两站点均降低 ROC-AUC（AUMC 0.9470→0.9380，NHSBT 0.8558→0.8432），而个性化聚合 FedMAP 在两站点均取得最佳 ROC-AUC（0.9594 / 0.8671），宏平均 ROC-AUC 0.9133、宏平衡准确率 0.8389 为最优。结论是：在样本量与任务相关性严重背离的结构性异质临床联盟中，应采用个性化聚合，而非样本量加权。
AI.motivation: 近期系统综述显示绝大多数医疗联邦学习（FL）研究未能进入真实部署，仅约 5.2% 报告了真实场景应用，主要缺陷集中在偏倚、隐私、泛化、通信成本与治理合规等方面。作者指出该问题不仅是模型设计问题，更在于：单一机构样本覆盖的临床人群过窄；隐私法规、机构治理与操作信任边界限制了数据集中化；以及临床联盟中各站点的人群、检测指征、检验流程差异使 non-IID 异质性往往是结构性的而非偶然的。此外，静态的数据共享协议或治理文档无法在运行时阻止越权传输、越权参与等行为，而跨国（荷兰/英国）临床部署需要可事后审计的运行时强制控制。因此需要一份来自真实运营环境的经验性报告，同时涵盖表征迁移、结构性异质性刻画与运行时治理三方面。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：①表征收取——预训练血液学基础模型 DeepCBC 在各站点本地以冻结编码器运行，取潜在后验均值作为确定性 256 维嵌入，原始 FBC 与嵌入均不出机构；②联邦训练——仅下游分类器（两层隐藏层 MLP：256→128→64→1，含批归一化、ReLU、dropout p=0.3，共 41,601 个可训练参数）参与联邦，每轮仅传分类器参数，若同步完整 DeepCBC 编码器则每轮参数量约高三个数量级。对照方法为 Local-only、FedAvg（样本量加权）、FedProx（近端惩罚 μ_p=0.05）与 FedMAP（个性化聚合：将本地优化建模为 MAP 估计，用 ICNN 学习正则化器 R(θ;θ_g,ψ)=f_ψ(θ,θ_g)+α‖θ−θ_g‖²+ε(‖θ‖²+‖θ_g‖²)，服务器按后验概率与正则项构成的权重 ω_k ∝ P(D_k|θ_k)exp(−R) 聚合，而非仅按样本数）。所有联邦方法统一 50 轮、batch 256、学习率 10⁻³、每轮 10 个本地 epoch、patience 3 早停；FedMAP 的 ICNN 学习率 10⁻⁵、每轮 3 步 ICNN；阈值在验证集调优。数据：AUMC 医院队列（train 44,032，阳性率 2.8%，反应性铁蛋白检测，炎症负荷高，铁充足者中位铁蛋白 602 ng/ml）与 NHSBT INTERVAL 献血者队列（train 30,997，阳性率 19.5%，普筛铁蛋白，健康低炎症人群，铁充足者中位铁蛋白 39 ng/ml）；标签为铁蛋白 <15 µg/l（WHO 标准）。运行时治理由 FLA³ 平台提供：基于 Flower 的 SuperLink/SuperNode 分层编排、XACML 策略的默认拒绝（deny-by-default）授权、按研究划定联邦范围与角色、仅追加式签名审计日志（记录请求者、策略、时间；越权推送参数在网络传输前即被策略引擎拒绝）。
AI.result: 测试集结果（ROC-AUC / 95%CI / 平衡准确率）：Local-only AUMC 0.9470 [0.9394,0.9545] / 0.8964，NHSBT 0.8558 [0.8442,0.8673] / 0.7344，宏 ROC-AUC 0.9014、宏平衡准确率 0.8154；FedAvg AUMC 0.9380 / 0.8436，NHSBT 0.8432 / 0.7719，宏 0.8906 / 0.8078（两站点 ROC-AUC 均低于本地训练，因 AUMC 训练样本约为 NHSBT 的 1.4 倍，加权聚合使全局更新偏向 AUMC 分布）；FedProx AUMC 0.9446 / 0.8539，NHSBT 0.8487 / 0.7774，宏 0.8967 / 0.8157（部分恢复损失但仍不敏感于任务相关性）；FedMAP AUMC 0.9594 [0.9590,0.9598] / 0.8899，NHSBT 0.8671 [0.8652,0.8690] / 0.7879，宏 ROC-AUC 0.9133、宏平衡准确率 0.8389，均为最优。NHSBT 上所有联邦方法平衡准确率均优于本地训练，AUMC 上本地训练平衡准确率仍最高（0.8964），FedMAP 接近（差距 0.0065），作者归因于低阳性率下阈值敏感性与个体化聚合改变全局先验但不改变最优决策阈值；并指出 AUMC 高炎症导致铁蛋白右移、15 µg/l 阈值下灵敏度损失，临床常用 30 µg/l 作为粗略阈值重优化。嵌入层面两站点按类条件均值差排序的前 5 个判别维度完全无重叠，印证表征级异质性。局限：未做成员推断/梯度反演等隐私攻击分析；未量化个性化聚合与全编码器同步的运行时开销；未做方法间配对显著性检验（嵌入异质性比较为定性）；仅两站点；未评估校准；冻结编码器需监测实验室流程、仪器、预处理与病例结构变化导致的嵌入分布时间漂移。
AI.conclusion: 在 AUMC 与 NHSBT 两家临床机构间的实际运营部署证明：冻结领域基础模型 + 联邦轻量分类器是医院环境下可行的 FL 部署模式（通信量降低约三个数量级，且弥补单站点数据不足以训练大模型的短板）；结构异质性应被视为临床属性而非统计噪声，标签的临床来源与类别平衡同样需要报告；样本量加权聚合在临床用途与患病率分化的联盟中可能同时损害两端站点，FedMAP 这类考虑客户端任务相关性的个性化聚合更优；治理必须内建于执行运行时而非停留在协议文档层面——XACML 默认拒绝策略在传输前阻断越权操作、签名审计日志提供事后可问责性，这也是跨国（荷兰与英国不同监管框架）联合研究得以开展的先决条件。未来工作包括隐私攻击评估、运行时开销剖析、多站点验证、校准与重校准评估、嵌入分布漂移监测，以及将 FedMAP 学到的聚合权重用作站点间异质性的定量指标。

title: Hy-MT2: A Family of Fast, Efficient and Powerful Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
summary: Hy-MT2 is a family of fast-thinking multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages. For on-device deployment, with AngelSlim 1.25-bit extreme quantization, the 1.8B model requires only 440 MB of storage and improves inference speed by 1.5x. Multi-dimensional evaluations show that Hy-MT2 delivers outstanding performance across general, real-world business, domain-specific, and instruction-following translation tasks. The 7B and 30B models outperform open-source models such as DeepSeek-V4-Pro and Kimi K2.6 in fast-thinking mode, while the lightweight 1.8B model also surpasses mainstream commercial APIs from providers such as Microsoft and Doubao overall.

AI.tldr: Hy-MT2 是一套快速思考的多语言翻译模型系列，含 1.8B、7B、30B-A3B 三种规模，支持 33 种语言，通过 1.25-bit 极端量化实现端侧高效部署（440MB），在多项翻译任务中超越主流开源模型和商业 API。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言翻译模型面临复杂真实场景下的挑战，需要同时支持多种语言、遵循多语言指令，并满足从端侧到云端的不同部署需求，同时需在推理速度和存储空间上实现高效压缩。
AI.method: Hy-MT2 包含三种模型规格（1.8B、7B、30B-A3B MoE），支持 33 种语言翻译和多种语言的指令跟随能力；采用 AngelSlim 1.25-bit 极端量化技术实现模型压缩，并启用快速思考模式（fast-thinking）以提升推理效率。
AI.result: 多维度评估表明 Hy-MT2 在通用、业务、领域专用及指令跟随翻译任务中均表现出色；7B 和 30B 模型在快速思考模式下超越 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 Kimi K2.6；轻量的 1.8B 模型整体优于主流商业翻译 API；量化后 1.8B 模型存储仅需 440MB，推理速度提升 1.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Hy-MT2 通过多尺寸模型覆盖从端侧到服务器的部署场景，极端量化技术使 1.8B 模型达到 440MB 存储，支持 33 种语言翻译，在多项翻译任务中超越 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Kimi K2.6 等开源模型以及微软、Doubao 等商业 API。

title: ECPO: Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization for Evidence-Certified Candidate Ranking
summary: Ranking systems used in decision-support settings should not only order candidates but also expose evidence that can be independently checked. We study evidence-certified candidate ranking: given an intent_id, a predefined plan skeleton, a window-local candidate roster, and text-derived candidate trajectories with span provenance, a system must output a Top-K list together with doc_id:span evidence certificates whose cited spans are sufficient to recover the decision. We instantiate this task on MAVEN-ERE and RAMS with fixed upstream extraction, window-local randomized candidate identifiers, skeleton-aligned trajectory supervision, hard negatives, and audit references. We introduce Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization (ECPO), a listwise policy-optimization objective whose action is the joint object of ranking and evidence certificate. ECPO first learns an interpretable trajectory reward from skeleton alignment, argument consistency, and optional graph features; it then optimizes a constrained policy with three coupled rewards: listwise ranking utility, span-level certificate validity, and an evidence-cycle reward computed by a label-free deterministic verifier that reconstructs candidate support from claim-stripped cited spans. This reframes the goal from maximizing ordinary NDCG alone to maximizing CertNDCG and decision-evidence coupling. The evaluation compares ECPO against zero-shot, SFT, and GRPO policies, RM-only scoring with deterministic evidence attachment, grammar/JSON-constrained decoding, validator retry, best-of-N RM selection, and post-hoc evidence rationalization under closed-roster, predicted-roster, and hybrid-roster settings.

AI.tldr: ECPO（Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization）把「候选排序 + 可独立核查的证据证书」作为策略的联合动作，在 MAVEN-ERE 与 RAMS 的封闭候选池（closed-roster）上，以 GRPO 式组归一化优化同时学习列表排序效用、证书有效性（r_cert）和证据周期一致性（r_cycle），目标从最大化普通 NDCG 转向最大化 vCertNDCG 与决策—证据耦合。相较 GRPO、SFT、RM-only+Det 等匹配对照，ECPO 显著提升验证器审计下的可追溯性与排名盲恢复（vCertNDCG@10 0.58/0.40 vs 0.49/0.36；Slot-EVIDCONS@10 0.65/0.49），在留出验证器 B/C、跨骨干（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-14B）、HotpotQA 溯源模式及盲评人类审计中优势稳定，但普通 NDCG 与延迟是明确代价（0.18 s/window → 3.1 s/window）。
AI.motivation: 决策支持场景中的排序系统不能只给分，还必须给出可被第三方独立核查的证据来源：分析员需要知道哪些原文 span 支撑某一候选、这些 span 是否落在暴露的证据范围内、以及证据能否解释该候选为何优于其他候选。已有工作存在两类缺陷：(1) 事后生成（post-hoc）的解释看似合理但可能不忠实（plausibility / attribution / faithfulness 相互背离），无法提供可验证的输出契约；(2) 现有偏好优化（RLHF / GRPO）主要优化标量偏好分数，隐含假设奖励模型可靠，当输出包含不可核验的断言或捏造证据时，高标量分反而会强化无支撑行为。为此作者提出「证据认证候选排序」（evidence-certified candidate ranking）任务：给定 intent_id、预定义 plan skeleton、窗口局部候选池与带 span 出处（doc_id:span）的文本候选轨迹，策略须同时输出 Top-K 列表与步骤对齐的证据证书 bundle，且引用 span 足以反推出决策。作者同时指出「证据指标究竟确立了什么」存在根本歧义——bundle 可能可解析但无支撑、可追溯到候选 A 却不能说明 A 为何优于 B、或对人类足够却过不了自动匹配器——因此必须把 validity、traceability、slot recovery、rank-blind comparative recovery、human support 五类性质分开度量。
AI.method: 1) 接口与契约：窗口 w 含暴露文档 D_w、有限候选池 C_w、预定义软优先骨架 S_w（四阶段 PREP→PROBE→EXECUTE→OUTCOME，每个 step 带 Agent/Target/Context 归一化角色）与候选轨迹 τ_w(c)。策略只见随机化窗口局部候选 ID（cand_001…），输出严格 JSON：k=min(10,|C_w|) 个候选 ID 与一一对齐的 bundle，每 bundle 含 M 个 step 对象，未匹配 step 显式记为 matched:false / event_id:null / evidence:[]。验证器 V 检查 schema、in-roster 去重、位置数与 step 数、证书对齐、文档与边界合法性、轨迹/阶段/角色兼容性。候选为正例的条件是存在窗口内被 S_w 对齐且有效的 source-normalized 链；正例标签仅存于 window_label.jsonl，绝不进入模型输入。2) 骨架对齐与轨迹奖励：DP 将有序骨架对齐到观测事件，局部分数 m(i,t)=role_sat−λ_arg·arg_viol（阶段兼容由 skeleton_hits 判定，优先序为回溯后的软特征而非局部项）；特征 φ(τ;S_w) 含覆盖、角色、优先序、时间与可选图特征，R_θ=θᵀφ；θ 以窗口级最大似然 + 同窗正例/硬负例/扰动轨迹上的 Bradley–Terry 偏好学习。3) Verifier-A（无标签确定性验证器）：同文档内 IoU>0.50 严格匹配（先测 trigger，再测需归一化角色一致的 argument）；支持分 A(b,c)=0.30·StepCov+0.20·RoleSat+0.25·Trace+0.10·Prec−0.15·BadSpan，权重在训练前固定、未使用任何 dev/test 标签；指派要求 A(b,c_best)≥0.55 且与次优差距 ≥0.10，并做最大权一对一匹配（避免复用），失败则弃权。4) 耦合目标：r_rank=Σγ^{j−1}R_θ（γ=0.90）并按窗口组内归一化；r_cert=(1/k)Σ I[V=1]·StepCov；r_cycle=(1/k)Σ I[â_j=a_j]，其中 â_j 由剥离候选断言、生成事件 ID、名次与策略分数后的 bundle 经 Verifier-A 重分配得到；总奖励 r_ECPO=r̄_rank+λ_cert·r_cert+λ_cycle·r_cycle−ξ_inv·I_invalid−ξ_miss·(k−|A|)₊−β_KL·KL̂（λ_cert=0.5、λ_cycle=1.0、两项惩罚 2.0、组大小 8、clip 0.2、β_KL=0.05），以 GRPO 式组归一化优势更新 Qwen3-8B + QLoRA 策略，R_θ 与 Verifier-A 在策略阶段冻结。5) 度量与审计协议：NDCG@10、FeasibleRate、Slot-EVIDCONS@10（槽位可追溯率）、vCertNDCG@10（位置遮罩化的 DCG，天然 ≤ DCG）、以及排名盲评估（移除位置与候选—bundle 配对并置乱 bundle 后）下的 SetRecover@10、RankRecover@10、Pairwise accuracy、Kendall's τ_b、AbstainRate；外部效度包括留出验证器 B（确定性、以引用覆盖率替代 IoU、去掉 RoleSat/Prec）与 C（冻结的原文重抽取评估器，重抽实体/阶段/角色并做别名-共指映射）、反向迁移 ECPO-B、反事实证据替换、跨骨干与 HotpotQA 溯源模式、120 窗口/3,240 bundle 的盲评人类审计（Krippendorff's α=0.71）。
AI.result: 主结果（MAVEN-ERE/RAMS，K=10）：ECPO 的 vCertNDCG@10 为 0.58/0.40，Slot-EVIDCONS@10 为 0.65/0.49，RankRecover 为 0.55/0.42，均高于 GRPO+Cert（0.45/0.33、0.50/0.38、0.40/0.29）与 RM-only+Det（0.49/0.36、0.53/0.40、0.41/0.30）；但 RM-only+Det 的普通 NDCG 更高（0.72/0.63 vs 0.70/0.61）、可行性也更高（0.98 vs 0.94），且推理更快。机制消融：去掉 r_cycle 后 vCertNDCG 从 0.58/0.40 降至 0.43/0.29，而 NDCG 仅从 0.70/0.61 变为 0.68/0.59，说明改进主要来自证据耦合项而非普通排序能力。跨验证器：ECPO-A 在 B 下仍有 0.55/0.38、C 下 0.53/0.36，对 RM-only+Det 的配对增益为 +0.07[0.03,0.11]/+0.04[0.01,0.07] 与 +0.06[0.02,0.10]/+0.03[0.01,0.06]；反向迁移 ECPO-B 在 A/C 下为 0.56/0.39、0.52/0.36。排名盲恢复：SetRecover 0.70/0.55、Pairwise accuracy 0.75/0.69、τ_b 0.53/0.41，且弃答率（0.16/0.24）低于 RM-only+Det（0.22/0.32）。盲评人类审计：比较性支持 0.76/0.69（对 RM-only+Det 增益 +0.12[0.07,0.17]/+0.10[0.05,0.15]），集合支持 0.72/0.56，名次支持 0.57/0.44。迁移：Llama-3.1-8B 上对 GRPO 增益 +0.12/+0.09，Qwen3-14B 上 +0.12/+0.10，HotpotQA 上 +0.08[0.03,0.12]（对 GRPO）、+0.04 对 RM-only+Det。稳健性：47 组仅评估用 Verifier-A 配置下 vCertNDCG 波动为 MAVEN-ERE 0.55–0.60、RAMS 0.38–0.42，方法排序在 45/47 与 43/47 设置中保持。反事实检验揭示可追溯性与比较性支持必须分离：同候选随机 span 仍保留 0.52/0.40 的目标恢复，但 RankRecover 从 0.55/0.42 跌至 0.25/0.18、Verifier-B vCertNDCG 从 0.55/0.38 跌至 0.30/0.21；将一个 bundle 替换为未选中同窗候选的等长等阶段有效 bundle 后，原目标恢复率降至 0.14/0.11。上限分析：固定名单的预测证据 oracle 0.72/0.54、source-normalized oracle 0.86/0.76、更高召回抽取器 0.64/0.48、删除 20% 预测事件 0.50/0.33，说明上游抽取构成硬瓶颈。成本：奖励模型 8 GPU 小时，策略优化每语料-种子 76 GPU 小时，推理 3.1 s/window（对照 RM-only+Align 为 0.18 s/window）。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的核心贡献是三点：(1) 一个把有序候选列表与候选链接的 provenance bundle 耦合为单一动作的排序接口；(2) 把列表效用、确定性证书有效性与证据周期一致性联结起来训练目标（r_rank + r_cert + r_cycle）；(3) 一套把槽位可追溯性、排名盲重建、留出验证器迁移、反事实敏感性与盲评人类判断分离的审计协议。结论是在所测试的封闭名单、有 provenance 的设定下，ECPO 相对匹配对照（含强 RM-only 确定性流水线）提升了验证器审计下的可追溯性、排名盲恢复与人类比较性支持，且优势在留出评估器、不同 8B/14B 骨干、HotpotQA 溯源契约与反事实扰动下持续存在。部署取舍被明确保留：更强的确定性排序器在普通 NDCG（0.72/0.63 vs 0.70/0.61）与推理成本（0.18 s/window vs 3.1 s/window）上仍占优，ECPO 的代价是每语料-种子 76 GPU 小时的策略优化与更高的运行时间。因此结论是：当排序与证据必须作为一个可审计对象被联合生成时，ECPO 才有部署价值；单纯追求排序精度或吞吐量时应选确定性 RM 基线。局限包括：主实验均为封闭有限候选池、固定抽取器、候选链接 provenance、预定义骨架/角色语义与自动支持契约，Verifier-B/C 只改变评估器形式而保留名单与本体；两个主数据集以事件为中心，HotpotQA 仅补充一种 provenance schema；自动分数均为验证器相对，人类审计样本有限，上游表示能力限制了可得证据的上限。

title: Leveraging Self-Paced Curriculum Learning for Enhanced Modality Balance in Multimodal Conversational Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted at Neural Computing and Applications (Springer), 2026
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations (MERC) is a crucial task for understanding human interactions, where multimodal approaches integrating language, facial expressions, and vocal tone have achieved significant progress. However, modality misalignment and imbalanced learning remain major challenges, limiting the effective utilization of multimodal information. To address this issue, we propose a plug-and-play framework based on Self-Paced Curriculum Learning (SPCL) for MERC. We introduce a dual-level Difficulty Measurer that captures both utterance-level and conversation-level challenges. The utterance-level score models fine-grained modality-specific difficulty, while the conversation-level score captures broader dialogue structures, including emotional dependencies and modality coherence. Based on these scores, the Learning Scheduler dynamically guides training from easier to more difficult instances. By integrating SPCL into existing MERC architectures, our method alleviates modality imbalance and improves model robustness. Extensive experiments on the IEMOCAP and MELD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and modality settings. On IEMOCAP, SPCL improves weighted F1-score by approximately +1.2% to +6.6% over baseline models, while on MELD, gains reach up to +10.4%. These results highlight the effectiveness and generalizability of SPCL as a lightweight plug-and-play module for multimodal emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于自步课程学习的即插即用框架SPCL用于多模态对话情感识别，通过双层难度测量器和动态学习调度器解决模态不平衡问题，在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上验证了有效性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别任务中存在模态对齐问题和学习不平衡挑战，限制了多模态信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 提出基于自步课程学习(SPCL)的即插即用框架，包含双层难度测量器(话语层和对话层)和学习调度器。话语层评分建模细粒度模态特定难度，对话层评分捕捉更广泛的对话结构(情感依赖和模态一致性)。学习调度器根据难度评分动态引导从易到难的训练过程。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP数据集上加权F1-score提升约+1.2%至+6.6%；在MELD数据集上提升达+10.4%。
AI.conclusion: SPCL作为轻量级即插即用模块，可有效集成到现有MERC架构中，在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上均表现优异，验证了其有效性和可推广性。

title: Faithful-MR1: Faithful Multimodal Reasoning via Anchoring and Reinforcing Visual Attention
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for advancing complex reasoning in large language models, and recent work extends RLVR to multimodal large language models (MLLMs). This transfer, however, surfaces a faithfulness challenge: faithful perception of task-relevant visual evidence and faithful use of that evidence during reasoning, leading to unsatisfactory gains on multimodal benchmarks. Specifically, existing perception supervision often operates on textual descriptions rather than natively on image regions, and faithful use is largely overlooked, exposing the perception-reasoning disconnect where correctly perceived evidence is dropped or contradicted during reasoning. To close these gaps, we propose Faithful-MR1, a training framework that anchors and reinforces visual attention to address both halves of faithful multimodal reasoning. The Anchoring stage turns perception into an explicit pre-reasoning subtask, supervising a dedicated <Focus> token's attention directly against image regions rather than through textual descriptions. The Reinforcing stage exposes faithful use through counterfactual image intervention, rewarding answer-correct trajectories that concentrate visual attention where vision causally matters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Faithful-MR1 outperforms recent multimodal reasoning baselines on both Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B and 7B backbones while using substantially less training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Faithful-MR1框架，通过锚定和强化两个阶段解决多模态大语言模型中视觉感知与推理不一致的问题。锚定阶段用<Focus> token直接监督图像区域，强化阶段通过反事实图像干预奖励视觉因果重要的区域的注意力集中，在更少训练数据下取得了更好的多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 将可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）从LLM迁移到MLLM时存在忠实性挑战：1）现有感知监督基于文本描述而非原生图像区域；2）忠实使用证据这一关键问题被忽视。正确感知的证据可能在推理中被丢弃或否定，产生感知-推理脱节。
AI.method: 提出Faithful-MR1框架，包含两个训练阶段：锚定阶段（Anchoring）和强化阶段（Reinforcing）。锚定阶段将感知作为显式预推理子任务，用<Focus> token直接监督图像区域而非文本描述；强化阶段通过反事实图像干预暴露忠实使用，只有当视觉注意集中在视觉因果上重要的区域时才给予奖励。
AI.result: Faithful-MR1在Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B和7B骨干模型上均优于近期多模态推理基线，且使用了更少的训练数据。
AI.conclusion: Faithful-MR1在Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B和7B模型上均优于近期的多模态推理基线方法，同时使用了更少的训练数据，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: Calibration, Uncertainty Communication, and Deployment Readiness in CKD Risk Prediction: A Framework Evaluation Study
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary materials (S1-S4) included as ancillary file
summary:
Machine learning models for chronic kidney disease (CKD) risk prediction often post strong discrimination scores on internal test sets. Calibration and uncertainty quantification get far less attention, leaving clinicians without reliable information about whether the probability outputs are accurate.
  We trained five classifiers on the UCI CKD dataset (400 patients, 62.5% CKD prevalence): logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, SVM with Platt scaling, and Gaussian naive Bayes. We evaluated each across calibration quality, conformal prediction coverage, and an eight-criterion deployment readiness framework. A distributional stress-test applied the best-calibrated variant of each model to the open-access MIMIC-IV demo cohort (97 patients, 23.7% CKD) to assess behaviour under prevalence shift and feature missingness. We measured calibration before and after Platt scaling and isotonic regression using Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score, and quantified uncertainty through split conformal prediction targeting 90% marginal coverage.
  All five models reached AUROC 1.00 on the UCI test set. Isotonic recalibration reduced internal ECE to 0.000-0.022. On MIMIC-IV, AUROC fell to 0.48-0.58, ECE rose to 0.68-0.76, and conformal coverage dropped from 0.80-0.98 to 0.21-0.25 against a 90% target. No model scored above 4 out of 16 on the deployment readiness checklist.
  Near-perfect internal performance did not transfer. Calibration stability and conformal coverage should be evaluated on external data before any clinical prediction model moves toward deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了五种机器学习模型在CKD风险预测中的校准和不确定性量化性能。发现在内部测试集上所有模型达到近乎完美的辨别力（AUC=1.00），但这一性能未能迁移到外部数据（MIMIC-IV），AUROC降至随机水平左右，ECE从0.02升至0.7以上，conformal coverage从90%目标降至约22%。强调了在临床部署前必须在外部数据上验证校准稳定性和覆盖率的重要性。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病（CKD）机器学习风险预测模型虽然在内部测试集上表现出色，但校准和不确定性量化研究不足，临床医生缺乏可靠的概率输出准确性信息。
AI.method: 使用UCI CKD数据集（400例患者，62.5% CKD患病率）训练5个分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、SVM with Platt scaling、高斯朴素贝叶斯），通过ECE、Brier Score和分 splits conformal prediction（目标90%边际覆盖率）评估校准质量和不确定性。使用MIMIC-IV演示队列（97例患者，23.7% CKD）进行分布压力测试。
AI.result: 内部测试集所有模型AUROC均达1.00，等渗重校准后ECE降至0.000-0.022。外部数据上AUROC降至0.48-0.58，ECE升至0.68-0.76， conformal coverage从0.80-0.98降至0.21-0.25（目标90%）。
AI.conclusion: 所有五个模型在内部测试集上达到AUROC 1.00，但在外部数据（MIMIC-IV）中性能大幅下降，AUROC降至0.48-0.58，ECE升至0.68-0.76， conformal coverage从0.80-0.98降至0.21-0.25。没有任何模型在部署就绪清单上超过4分（共16分）。结果表明：近完美的内部性能无法迁移；临床预测模型在部署前必须在外部数据上评估校准稳定性和conformal coverage。

title: Ishigaki-IDS-Bench: A Benchmark for Generating Information Delivery Specification from BIM Information Requirements
comment: 7 pages; benchmark data and evaluation scripts are available on GitHub and Hugging Face
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to generate structured outputs such as JSON, SQL, and code, yet public resources remain limited for evaluating generation that must simultaneously satisfy industry-standard XML and domain vocabulary constraints. This paper presents Ishigaki-IDS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the ability to generate Information Delivery Specification (IDS) XML from Building Information Modeling (BIM) information requirements. The benchmark contains 166 BIM/IDS expert-authored and verified examples created by expanding 83 practical scenarios into Japanese and English, corresponding gold IDS files, and metadata for input format, language, turn setting, IFC version, and construction domain. Its evaluation combines IDSAuditTool-based Processability, Structure, and Content audits with content-agreement evaluation against gold IDS files. In zero-shot evaluation over 10 LLMs, the best model reaches 65.6% macro F1 for content agreement, while only 27.7% of outputs pass the Content audit. These results show that current LLMs can express part of the information requirements as IDS, but still struggle to stably generate XML that satisfies the IDS standard and IFC vocabulary constraints. Ishigaki-IDS-Bench supports comparative evaluation, failure analysis, and the development of constrained structured generation methods that conform to domain standards. We release the evaluation scripts and benchmark data under the CC BY 4.0 license on GitHub and Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: Ishigaki-IDS-Bench 是首个公开的"从 BIM 信息需求生成 IDS 1.0 规范 XML"的评测基准，含 166 个专家编写的双语句例、对应黄金 IDS 文件与五轴元数据，并提出"IDSAuditTool 形式审计（Processability/Structure/Content）+ 与黄金 IDS 的 facet 级内容一致性（macro F1）"两阶段评测协议。10 个 LLM 的零样本结果显示最高 Facet F1 仅 65.6%（GPT-5.5）、最高 Content 通过率仅 33.1%（Claude Opus 4.5），说明当前模型尚难稳定生成同时满足 IDS 标准与 IFC 词汇约束的 XML。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被广泛用于生成 JSON、SQL、代码等结构化输出，但在实际专业领域（如建筑施工）中，仅语法正确远远不够：输出还必须同时符合行业标准数据格式、领域词汇表、版本约束以及外部校验工具的审计结论。现有结构化生成基准（JSON/SQL/代码、DSL 语法约束解码）以及建筑领域 AI 评测（法规解读、BIM 合规检查、IFC 问答与编辑等）都未能覆盖"从真实信息需求文档生成 IDS XML 并同时验证形式合法性与领域词汇一致性"这一任务，因此缺乏可用于比较、失败分析和约束生成方法开发的公开基准。
AI.method: 基准构建：由 6 名 BIM/IDS 专家（5 人具 buildingSMART 相关经验、5 人有 IFC/IDS 实践）将约 100 个候选用例归并为 83 个实际场景，人工编写输入信息需求（CSV 或自然语言）与黄金 IDS，经语义评审、IDSAuditTool 校验、facet scorer 复跑与日英术语一致性检查后扩展为日/英双语共 166 个样例（含 245 条 specification、945 个 facet），并附输入格式、语言、轮次设置、目标 IFC 版本、施工领域五轴元数据；因黄金 IDS 源自专家单方编写而非多标注者独立平行标注，未计算标注者间一致性。两阶段评测协议：第一阶段用 buildingSMART IDSAuditTool（v1.0.96）做形式合法性审计，Processability 报告候选 IDS 是否可被送入审计工具、Structure 报告 XML 与 IDS XSD 合法性、Content 报告是否符合 IDS 标准与 IFC 词汇约束；第二阶段用 facet scorer 与黄金 IDS 做内容保真度匹配，比较单元包含 IFC 版本标签、entity/attribute/property facet 及 property 的 dataType/cardinality，以多重集精确匹配计算 P/R/F1 并按样例宏平均（不使用 LLM-as-judge；未指定属性集名称时统一采用提示中明示的非 IDS 标准内部约定）。仅评测 entity、attribute、property 三类 facet，classification、material、partOf 不在范围内。基线实验：2026 年 5 月对 10 个 LLM 进行零样本评测，统一系统提示与样例上下文，Qwen 系 temperature=0.6/top_p=0.95/top_k=20/min_p=0.0，其余 temperature=0.0/top_p=1.0，输出上限 15,000 token，不用截断、语法约束解码、修复、重生成与多样本选择。
AI.result: 第一阶段 Processability 普遍很高（Claude Opus 4.5 与 Kimi K2.6 均 99.4%，GPT-5.5 94.6%），但 Structure 与 Content 显著下滑：最高 Structure 仅 45.8%（Claude Opus 4.5），最高 Content 仅 33.1%（Claude Opus 4.5），GPT-5.5 Content 为 27.7%、Gemini 3.1 Pro 25.9%，Qwen3-32B 与 Qwen3-8B 的 Processability 更低（37.3%、26.5%）。第二阶段最高 Facet F1 为 GPT-5.5 的 65.6%（R 65.8/P 65.6），随后为 Gemini 3.1 Pro 52.2%、Kimi K2.6 48.4%、DeepSeek V4 Pro 40.0%、Claude Opus 4.5 42.2%；开放权重模型中 gpt-oss-120b 仅 21.6%。Qwen 家族随规模增大 Facet F1 整体上升但审计通过率非单调。切片分析显示 GPT-5.5 在 44 个多轮样例上 Content=79.5%、Facet F1=84.8%，远高于单轮的 9.0% 与 58.6%；CSV 输入 Facet F1 77.3% 优于自然语言 59.2%。三类失败模式：可提取可审计但违反 XSD/IDS 标准/IFC 词汇；entity 与 attribute facet 相对易恢复而 property facet（属性集名、基数、值约束）错误频发；自然语言中需求目标与值约束映射歧义导致 facet 遗漏或过生成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作发布了首个专家编制的 IDS 1.0 XML 生成公开基准与两阶段（形式合法性 + 内容一致性）评测协议，证明"可解析/可审计"与"符合标准的内容"之间存在显著落差：最好的 Facet F1 与最好的 Content 通过率由不同模型取得，因此 IDS 生成必须分别评估领域词汇、标准合规与 facet 级内容一致性，而不能只看 XML 良构性。多轮历史条件下的修订比从零生成更可行，CSV 结构化输入优于自然语言，提示属性集约定与 property facet 映射是关键难点。基准数据（CC BY 4.0，Hugging Face DOI 10.57967/hf/8873）与评测脚本/零样本提示（Apache-2.0，Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20550510）已公开发布。局限包括仅覆盖三类 facet、未在含噪真实文档集合上评测端到端性能、未指定属性集的处理仅为内部评测约定、166 例规模面向诊断而非大规模训练；少样本提示、RAG 提示、微调与语法约束解码留作后续对比。

title: Active Evidence-Seeking and Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models for Clinical Decision Support
summary: Large language models perform well on static medical examinations, yet clinical diagnosis often requires iterative evidence gathering under uncertainty. Building on prior interactive evaluation efforts, we introduce an OSCE-inspired standardized patient simulator and a controlled, reproducible benchmark for active diagnostic inquiry. Across 468 cases and 15 models in our protocol, we observe that multi-turn evidence seeking reduces diagnostic accuracy by 12.75% and lowers supporting-evidence quality by 24.36% relative to full-context evaluation; error analyses associate these drops with premature diagnostic closure and inefficient questioning. Together, these results suggest that static full-context benchmarks may overestimate performance in interactive evidence-seeking settings, motivating complementary interactive assessment for safer clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过OSCE风格的标准化患者模拟器，发现多轮交互式诊断询问场景下LLM表现显著弱于静态全上下文评估，揭示了静态基准测试的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估使用静态医学考试，无法反映临床实际中迭代式证据收集的过程，需要交互式评估范式。
AI.method: 构建OSCE启发的标准化患者模拟器，对468个病例和15个模型进行受控可复现的主动诊断询问基准测试。
AI.result: 多轮证据寻求使诊断准确率下降12.75%，支撑证据质量下降24.36%；错误分析表明问题源于过早诊断闭合和无效率询问。
AI.conclusion: 静态全上下文基准测试可能高估LLM在临床决策支持中的实际表现，需要补充交互式评估方法来确保安全应用。

title: Equilibrium Propagation and Hamiltonian Inference in the Diffusive Fitzhugh-Nagumo Model
summary: In this work, we extend the Equilibrium Propagation framework to skew-gradient systems and show an equivalence between deep Energy-Based Models and Hamiltonian neural networks. We focus on networks of diffusively coupled Fitzhugh-Nagumo neurons as a prototypical example. We show that since stationary solutions of the Fitzhugh-Nagumo model are described by self-adjoint operators, the methods of equilibrium propagation for performing credit assignment can be applied. Furthermore, for Fitzhugh-Nagumo networks with the topology of a deep residual network, we show that the steady state solutions admit a (spatial) Hamiltonian, and thus the methods of Hamiltonian Echo Backpropagation can be applied. We end by deriving an explicit layer-wise Hamiltonian recurrence relation governing inference for stationary solutions of both deep Fitzhugh-Nagumo networks and deep Energy-Based Models.

AI.tldr: 本文将平衡传播（EqProp）推广到"偏梯度（skew-gradient）"系统，以扩散耦合的 FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) 神经元网络为原型：证明其稳态下激活子响应矩阵是自伴的，故可用 EqProp 做局部信用分配；同时证明 FHN 网络与深度能量模型（EBM）的稳态都存在（空间）Hamiltonian 量，据此推导出显式的逐层 Hamiltonian 递推，可在给定初始动量条件下用一次前向传播完成推理，取代传统 EBM 的迭代收敛。实验上用 EqProp 训练 5 隐层 FHN 网络在 MNIST 上达到 2.8%±0.2% 测试错误。
AI.motivation: 反向传播需要显式的反向图，与前向图严格对应，因而不具备生物可塑性。替代方案中，平衡传播（EqProp）依赖能量模型（EBM）的自伴性（激活 Jacobian 对称），实现完全局部的权重更新、梯度方差低；Hamiltonian 回声反传（HEB）则依赖 Hamiltonian 系统的时间反演性。但二者覆盖的系统类别存在缺口：真实生物物理神经元同时具有非线性耗散、增益与储能（电容）元件，其动力学一般不自伴、也不是梯度系统，无法直接套用 EqProp 或 HEB，且此前没有方法能把非线性耗散、增益、时变成分统一纳入一个基于自伴结构的信用分配框架。FitzHugh-Nagumo 模型是最简单的可产生动作电位的生物物理神经元模型（同时含耗散、增益、储能），是填补这一缺口的典型例子。此外，EBM 推理需多次前向迭代直至能量极小，代价高昂，也促使作者寻求 Hamiltonian 前馈推理形式。
AI.method: 1) 建模：将扩散耦合 FHN 写成 T u_t = D L u + f(u) - I，其中 L 为分块对角图拉普拉斯 L_i = B_i^T Y_i B_i（实对称），f(u) = Q ∂F/∂u，Q = diag(1,-1)（激活子/抑制子），构成 skew-gradient（极小极大）系统。2) 自伴性分析：在稳态 u_s 处线性化得分块方程，消去抑制子后激活子响应矩阵 M^{-1} = ((d1 L1 + f'(u_s)) + (d2 L2 - γ)^{-1})^{-1} 对称（因 L_i 对称、f' 与 γ 为对角阵、symmetric 矩阵的逆仍对称），故激活子↔输入电流的响应 Jacobians 自伴，EqProp 的 NGRAD 信用分配机制适用。3) Hamiltonian 形式：对接地（去零特征值）拉普拉斯定义"空间速度" e := L^{1/2} u、Z = [u; e]，构造 H = ½ e^T D Q e + F(u)，得到辛形式 K Z_x = -∂H/∂Z；稳态下 H 沿路径守恒，等价于 Kirchhoff 电流定律（节点电流和为零）。4) 深层残差 FHN 网络：将多条路径图并行并以层间耦合 g^i_{jk} 连接，定义动量 p^i = u^{i+1} - u^i（q^i 对应抑制子），由节点电流守恒推得逐层递推：u^{i+1}=u^i+p^i，p^{i+1}=M^i N^i p^i + M^i f^{i+1} - M^i O^i u^{i+1}，其中 M^i=(G^{i+1}+δ²I)^{-1}，N^i=(G^i)^T+δ²I，O^i=(G^i)^T+G^{i+1}-diag(ĝ^i+g̃^{i+1})；抑制子递推 q^{i+1}=ε(u^{i+1}-αv^{i+1}-β)。5) 深度 EBM（Scellier-Bengio 能量）：作变量代换 v=ρ(u) 将交互项非线性吸收为局部非线性 f(v)，定义 p^l=v^{l+1}-v^l，稳态梯度为零给出 v^{l+1}=v^l+p^l，p^{l+1}=M^l f(v^{l+1})+N^l p^l-(N^l+I)v^{l+1}，M^l=(W^{l+1})^{-1}，N^l=(W^{l+1})^{-1}(W^l)^T。6) 实验：5 隐层 FHN 网络用 EqProp（中心差分、β_nudge≈0.9）训练 MNIST；并对 30 层深、64 宽 FHN 残差网络做时间演化稳态与 Hamiltonian 空间积分的对比仿真（首步因 ghost node 边界需乘 1/2）。
AI.result: 理论结果：(a) FHN 稳态的完整线性化矩阵虽不对称，但激活子响应子矩阵 M^{-1} 是对称/自伴的，故 EqProp 信用分配可用；(b) FHN 稳态存在空间 Hamiltonian（H = ½e^T D Q e + F(u)，F = ½αu² - ¼αu⁴ - uv + ½βv²），Hamiltonian 沿路径守恒等价于 Kirchhoff 电流定律；(c) 深层残差 FHN 与深度 EBM 的稳态都可写成显式逐层 Hamiltonian 递推，只需给定 (u⁰,p⁰)、(v⁰,q⁰) 即可单次前向传播直接算出稳态，EBM 的两点边值问题由此转为 Hamiltonian 的初值问题。实验结果：5 层 FHN 网络（784-512×5-10，lr=[1e-2,1e-3,2e-4,1e-4,5e-5]，δ,ε,α,β=0.75,0.85,1.08,0.0，β_nudge=0.9，55 次迭代/14 次 nudge）MNIST 测试错误 2.8%±0.2%；时间演化仿真与 Hamiltonian 空间积分在深度 <30 层时结果吻合，超过约 30 层则因沿不稳定流形积分而发散（作者建议层归一化或更优空间积分格式）。作者还观察到训练中偶发 loss 尖峰，推测源于权重更新累积增大网络有效增益、 使系统离开初始的图灵图样动力学区间，仍需进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: skew-gradient 系统（如 FHN）在稳态下与平衡传播算法兼容，可通过自伴响应矩阵实现局部信用分配；借由 skew-gradient 的 Hamiltonian 工具，可为深度 EBM 导出显式的 Hamiltonian 递推，在给定动量初值的前提下精确逐层计算稳态。二者的差别仅在边界条件的设定：EBM 形式是两点边值问题，Hamiltonian 形式是纯初值问题。该桥梁为深度 EBM 引入了可用的 Hamiltonian 分析工具（尤其是均匀网络空间轨道的分岔分析），并为训练激活子-抑制子结构的深层网络提供新方法，同时为生物网络中普遍存在的激活子-抑制子结构与图样形成提供新的解释视角。

title: ArabDiscrim: A Decade-Long Arabic Facebook Corpus on Racism and Discrimination
summary: We present ArabDiscrim, a decade-long lexical resource and corpus of 293K public Arabic Facebook posts (2014--2024) discussing racism and discrimination. Unlike existing Twitter-centric datasets, ArabDiscrim integrates platform-native engagement signals, including reactions, shares, comments, and page metadata, enabling joint analysis of language and audience response. The resource includes 200 curated terms (100 racism-related and 100 discrimination-related) with morphological regex families (13+ inflections per lemma), and 20 discrimination axes capturing identity-based grounds for unequal treatment. It also provides explicit attribution patterns. Released under a restricted research-use license for ethical compliance with platform terms, ArabDiscrim supports weak supervision, axis-aware sampling, and platform ecology research. By bridging lexical depth and ecological validity, it establishes a foundation for fairness-oriented, platform-aware Arabic NLP.

AI.tldr: ArabDiscrim是一个十年期阿拉伯语Facebook语料库（293K帖子），专注于种族主义和歧视议题。与Twitter中心式数据集不同，它整合了平台互动信号，提供200个词汇术语（13+形态变体/词条）和20个歧视维度，支持弱监督训练和公平导向NLP研究，采用伦理合规的restricted license发布。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语仇恨言论检测数据集多集中于Twitter平台，缺乏平台原生的互动信号；同时，现有资源缺乏对歧视行为具体归因维度的系统化建模，难以支撑公平导向的NLP研究。
AI.method: 该研究构建了一个包含293K阿拉伯语Facebook帖子的语料库（2014-2024），整合了平台原生互动信号（反应、分享、评论、页面元数据）；定义了200个精心筛选的术语（100个种族主义相关、100个歧视相关），每个词条含13+形态学regex变体；建立了20个歧视维度框架，并提供显式归因模式。通过restricted research-use license确保伦理合规性。
AI.result: 发布了ArabDiscrim数据集，包含293K帖子、200个词汇项（20个歧视维度）、形态学regex家族，支持弱监督、维度感知采样和平台生态研究。
AI.conclusion: ArabDiscrim弥合了词汇深度与生态效度，为公平导向的平台感知阿拉伯语NLP研究奠定了基础。其ethical-compliant的设计和restricted license为后续研究提供了负责任的数据访问框架。

title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced video understanding tasks, yet challenges remain in efficiently compressing visual tokens while preserving spatiotemporal interactions. Existing methods, such as LLaVA family, utilize simplistic pooling or interpolation techniques that overlook the intricate dynamics of visual tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-GridPool, a novel training-free visual token enhancement method designed specifically for Video LLMs. Our approach integrates Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG), which captures multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions through hierarchical temporal gridding, and Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP), which preserves high-information visual regions by leveraging the correlation between token norms and semantic richness. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that ST-GridPool consistently enhances performance of Video LLMs without requiring costly retraining. Our method offers an efficient and plug-and-play solution for improving visual token representations. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-GridPool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ST-GridPool，一种无需训练的视觉token增强方法，用于Video LLM。该方法通过金字塔时间网格化(PTG)捕获多粒度时空交互，结合基于范数的空间池化(NSP)保留高信息量区域，实现高效即插即用的视觉token压缩优化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如LLaVA系列）采用简化的池化或插值技术，但忽视了视觉token的复杂动态特性，导致在高效压缩视觉token的同时难以保留时空交互信息。
AI.method: ST-GridPool通过两个核心组件实现视觉token增强：(1) 金字塔时间网格化(Pyramid Temporal Gridding, PTG)：通过分层时间网格化捕获多粒度的时空交互；(2) 基于范数的空间池化(Norm-based Spatial Pooling, NSP)：利用token范数与语义丰富度之间的相关性，保留高信息量视觉区域。
AI.result: 实验表明，ST-GridPool在多个基准测试中持续提升Video LLM性能，且无需昂贵的重训练成本。
AI.conclusion: ST-GridPool offers an efficient, training-free, plug-and-play solution that consistently enhances Video LLM performance across various benchmarks without requiring costly retraining.

title: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
summary: Computational antibody CDR design methods condition on antigen structure to generate binding loops, yet existing architectures conflate two fundamentally distinct sub-problems: identifying which CDR positions will contact the antigen, and selecting amino acids at those positions. This conflation forces models to learn contact reasoning implicitly through uniform message passing, diluting antigen signal across all positions equally. We introduce ConTact, a contact-then-act architecture that explicitly decomposes CDR design into three cascaded stages: learning surface complementarity fingerprints, predicting CDR-antigen contacts, and injecting contact-gated antigen features into the sequence head. A distance-biased cross-attention module encodes geometric priors favoring spatial neighbors, while a contact-weighted cross-entropy loss concentrates gradient signal on binding-critical positions. On CHIMERA-Bench dataset, ConTact achieves the best structural quality (7% RMSD improvement over the next-best baseline), best epitope awareness (10% F1 score over GNN baselines), and competitive sequence recovery (AAR 0.38) among several CDR-H3 design baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ConTact，一种将 CDR 设计显式分解为表面互补学习、接触预测和门控序列生成的级联架构，通过距离偏置交叉注意力和接触加权损失解决现有方法信号稀释问题，在 CHIMERA-Bench 上取得最优结构质量和表位感知性能。
AI.motivation: 现有计算抗体 CDR 设计方法将两个本质不同的子问题混为一谈：CDR 接触位点识别和氨基酸选择。这种混淆导致模型不得不通过统一的消息传递机制隐式学习接触推理，使抗原信号被均匀分散到所有位置，削弱了关键binding位置的梯度信号。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种名为 ConTact 的级联三阶段架构：1）学习表面互补指纹特征；2）预测 CDR-抗原接触区域；3）将接触门控的抗原特征注入序列头部。同时引入了距离偏置的交叉注意力模块（编码几何先验）和接触加权交叉熵损失函数（聚焦binding-critical位置）。
AI.result: 在 CHIMERA-Bench 基准数据集上，ConTact 实现了最佳结构质量（相比次优基线 RMSD 提升 7%）、最佳表位感知能力（相比 GNN 基线 F1 分数提升 10%）以及具有竞争力的序列回收率（AAR 0.38）。
AI.conclusion: ConTact 在 CHIMERA-Bench 数据集上取得了最佳结构质量（RMSD 提升 7%）、最佳表位感知能力（F1 分数较 GNN 基线提升 10%），同时在序列回收率上具有竞争力（AAR 0.38）。该研究证明了将接触预测与氨基酸选择解耦的有效性，为抗体 CDR 设计提供了新的思路。

title: A Comparative Study of Language Models for Khmer Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in retrieved evidence, thereby reducing hallucination and improving factual accuracy. Its efficacy, however, remains largely unexamined for low-resource, non-Latin-script languages such as Khmer. In this paper, we present a RAG-based question answering system for Khmer-language telecom-domain documents. We conduct a two-phase comparative evaluation. First, we benchmark three embedding models: BGE-M3 (567M), Jina-Embeddings-v3 (570M), and Qwen3-Embedding (597M), for dense retrieval over Khmer documents. BGE-M3 consistently performs best, achieving a Hit Rate@3 of 0.285, File Hit Rate@3 of 0.700, MRR@3 of 0.221, and Precision@3 of 0.112, substantially outperforming the other retrievers. Second, using BGE-M3 as the selected retriever, we evaluate five generator backends: Qwen3 (8B), Qwen3.5 (9B), Sailor2-8B-Chat, SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat, and Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT, on a curated golden dataset of 200 Khmer question-answer pairs. To quantify system performance, we apply six RAGAS-inspired metrics: faithfulness, answer relevance, context relevance, factual correctness, answer similarity, and answer correctness. The results show no single model dominates across all metrics: Qwen3.5-9B achieves the highest faithfulness (0.859) and context relevance (0.726), Qwen3-8B attains the highest factual correctness (0.380), and SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat performs best on answer relevance (0.867), answer similarity (0.836), and answer correctness (0.599). These findings highlight that retriever choice remains a major bottleneck for Khmer RAG, while generator strengths vary depending on whether the priority is grounding, factual precision, or semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对柬埔寨语电信领域文档构建了RAG问答系统，通过两阶段实验系统评估了检索器和生成器性能，为低资源语言场景下的RAG系统优化提供了实证依据。
AI.motivation: RAG虽被广泛用于减少LLM幻觉并提升事实准确性，但其在低资源、非拉丁字母语言（如柬埔寨语）场景下的有效性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 两阶段对比评估：第一阶段对三种embedding模型（BGE-M3、Jina-Embeddings-v3、Qwen3-Embedding）进行稠密检索基准测试；第二阶段选用最佳检索器（BGE-M3）评估五种生成器后端（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Sailor2-8B-Chat、SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat、Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT），使用RAGAS启发的六项指标进行量化评估。
AI.result: 检索器方面，BGE-M3在Hit Rate@3（0.285）、File Hit Rate@3（0.700）、MRR@3（0.221）及Precision@3（0.112）上显著优于其他模型；生成器方面，无单一模型在所有指标上占优：Qwen3.5-9B获得最高faithfulness（0.859）和context relevance（0.726），Qwen3-8B达到最高factual correctness（0.380），SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat在answer relevance（0.867）、answer similarity（0.836）及answer correctness（0.599）上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 检索器选择仍是柬埔寨语RAG的主要瓶颈，而生成器的优势取决于评估指标的优先级（事实 grounding、精确性或语义相似性）。

title: A Camera-Cooperative ISAC Framework for Multimodal Non-Cooperative UAVs Sensing
summary: The detection of non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) presents significant challenges for Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems due to the inherent limitations of single-modal perception and the competition for shared communication and sensing resources. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Camera-Cooperative ISAC (CC-ISAC) framework that employs multimodal sensing to enable efficient UAV beam steering and tracking. The proposed framework employs cameras for coarse-grained airspace monitoring and utilizes ISAC for fine-grained, high-precision sensing, forming a complementary perception loop that enhances both sensing accuracy and resource efficiency. Within this framework, two key modules are developed: (1) a Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA) model that aligns visual and echo-domain features through cross-attention mechanisms, and (2) a Multimodal Fusion-Based Estimation (MMFE) model that integrates historical multimodal data with current observations for robust state estimation. Extensive evaluations conducted on the DeepSense 6G dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an average reduction of 71% in beam steering overhead and 1.69-11.15% in tracking overhead while maintaining high angular estimation accuracy. The CC-ISAC framework effectively mitigates resource contention between sensing and communication, enabling reliable UAV surveillance while freeing substantial system resources for additional communication tasks, thereby representing a practical advancement in ISAC system design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Camera-Cooperative ISAC (CC-ISAC)框架，通过融合相机粗粒度空域监测与ISAC精细化高精度感知形成互补感知环路，解决非合作UAV检测中的资源竞争问题，实现71%波束转向开销降低和1.69-11.15%跟踪开销降低。
AI.motivation: 非合作UAV检测面临单模态感知的固有局限以及通信与感知资源竞争两大挑战，传统ISAC系统难以高效完成无人机监测任务。
AI.method: 提出了两大核心模块：(1) 视觉-回波数据对齐(V2EDA)模型，通过交叉注意力机制对齐视觉域与回波域特征；(2) 多模态融合估计(MMFE)模型，结合历史多模态数据与当前观测进行稳健状态估计。使用DeepSense 6G数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 平均降低71%的波束转向开销和1.69-11.15%的跟踪开销，同时保持高角度估计精度，有效缓解了感知与通信的资源争用问题。
AI.conclusion: CC-ISAC框架有效缓解了感知与通信间的资源竞争，为ISAC系统设计提供了实用化进展，可在保证高角度估计精度的同时，释放大量系统资源用于通信任务。

title: When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
comment: Pre-print. Code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/PW-OPSD
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own rollouts using a privileged teacher, but its standard objective weights all generated tokens equally, implicitly treating the privileged teacher target as equally reliable at every student-visited prefix. Existing entropy-based OPD methods relax this uniformity by modulating token-level supervision with teacher entropy, but high teacher entropy in reasoning has an ambiguous reliability meaning: it can reflect either non-viable uncertainty or benign solution diversity. To identify this phenomenon, we introduce a branch-viability diagnostic. Specifically, we record next-token alternatives from the privileged-answer teacher prompt, force each alternative after the student prompt plus its on-policy spine prefix, and test whether the resulting student-template continuation recovers the correct answer. On Qwen3-4B, we find that an oriented within-sequence position score is the strongest tested predictor of teacher-token reliability, reaching an area-under-ROC-curve (AUROC) of 0.83; local uncertainty scores are at most 0.57. Motivated by this trajectory-level structure, we propose Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation (PW-OPSD), which applies an increasing position weight while keeping the same student rollout, privileged teacher pass, and clipped forward-KL target as OPSD. In our comprehensive evaluations with different random seeds, the diagnostic-derived PW-OPSD improves AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 Avg@12 by +1.0 and +1.1 points, and a generalization evaluation on two larger-scale models from different families, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B and Olmo-3-7B-Think, also demonstrates consistent aggregate Avg@12 improvements. These results show that teacher-token reliability in reasoning distillation is trajectory-structured and can be utilized without additional teacher computation.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了推理蒸馏中教师标记可靠性具有轨迹级结构，发现序列内位置评分（AUROC=0.83）优于局部不确定性评分（≤0.57），并基于此提出PW-OPSD方法，在多种模型上验证了有效性，无需额外教师计算即可提升数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 标准OPSD方法对所有生成token一视同仁，隐含假设教师目标在每个前缀处同等可靠，但推理场景中教师熵高可能反映不可行不确定性或良性解多样性，需要诊断工具区分这两种情况。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹级结构的位置加权自蒸馏方法（PW-OPSD），使用within-sequence位置评分预测教师标记可靠性，在保持原有学生rollout、privileged teacher pass和裁剪前向KL目标的基础上，对序列中较后位置赋予更高的权重。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B上，序列内位置评分是教师标记可靠性的最强预测因子，AUROC达0.83；局部不确定性评分最高仅0.57。诊断衍生的PW-OPSD在AIME 2024和2025 Avg@12上分别提升+1.0和+1.1分；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B和Olmo-3-7B-Think上也显示一致的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: PW-OPSD通过利用序列内位置评分来识别教师标记可靠性，实现了无需额外教师计算即可提升推理蒸馏效果的目标。

title: Cross-Lingual Consensus: Aligning Multilingual Cultural Knowledge via Multilingual Self-Consistency
comment: Accepted to The 1st Workshop on Multilinguality in the Era of Large Language Models
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across various tasks, they exhibit significant performance discrepancies across languages. While prompting LLMs in English typically yields the highest general performance, it often induces a Western-centric bias, hindering the model's ability to accurately reflect diverse cultural knowledge. We hypothesize that LLMs already possess rich cultural knowledge embedded within local-language representations, but fail to retrieve it when prompted in English. To bridge this cross-lingual knowledge gap, we propose a novel self-supervised framework. Our method leverages multilingual self-consistency to identify the most reliable cultural responses across languages, combined with a self-critique mechanism to transfer this knowledge to the weaker language. Evaluations on the BLEnD benchmark demonstrate that our approach significantly improves cultural alignment-boosting performance on English queries by an average of 5.03%-relying entirely on self-generated data. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that latent cultural knowledge can be successfully surfaced and propagated across languages, enabling more culturally equitable and consistent LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM跨语言文化知识不对称问题，提出利用多语言自一致性和自批判机制的自监督框架，在无需外部标注数据的情况下，成功将隐含在非英语语言中的文化知识迁移至英语提示场景，在BLEnD基准上实现5.03%的文化对齐提升。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在不同语言间存在显著性能差异，英文提示虽能获得最佳总体表现，但会引入西方中心主义偏见，阻碍模型准确反映多元文化知识。研究假设LLM已在本地语言表示中嵌入了丰富的文化知识，只是在英文提示时无法检索。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架，结合多语言自一致性机制识别跨语言中最可靠的文化响应，并通过自批判机制将知识迁移至较弱语言。整个过程完全依赖自生成数据。
AI.result: 在BLEnD基准测试中，英文查询的文化对齐性能平均提升5.03%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了潜在的文化知识可以在语言间被成功挖掘和传播，为实现更具文化公平性和一致性的LLM提供了可行路径。

title: Knowledge Graph Re-engineering Along the Ontological Continuum (extended version)
summary: Knowledge graphs have become the primary vehicle for data integration and are critical to the success of modern AI, but the diversity of KG modelling practices, from lightweight vocabularies to richly axiomatised ontologies, makes integration and reuse expensive and brittle. This challenge is particularly acute in neuro-symbolic AI, where bridging neural and symbolic components depends on the ability to reengineer KGs to fit new requirements; GenAI now offers unprecedented automation capability, but without a principled understanding of the KG space, such automation remains conceptually ungrounded. We introduce the ontological continuum as that missing conceptualisation, a theoretical construct a theoretical construct whose characterisation framework is defined by two orthogonal distinctions: semantics vs pragmatics, and properties vs affordances; together these define a vocabulary to describe, compare, navigate, and transform KGs across the full range of modelling practices. The methodological stance is empirical: rather than prescribing how KGs should be modelled, the continuum aims to define a theory of the existent, derived from observation of real-world KG engineering practices and whose structure can be made formally explicit, for example, through Formal Concept Analysis (FCA). We ground the vision through a case study on provenance knowledge, showing how a single concern manifests differently across the continuum. We articulate five open research challenges and invite the community to develop the ontological continuum as a shared research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文针对知识图谱建模实践多样性带来的集成与复用挑战，提出"本体论连续体"作为统一的概念框架，通过语义/语用和属性/可供性两个正交维度进行刻画，采用实证方法（形式概念分析）从实际工程实践中提取理论，并通过对溯源知识的案例研究验证了框架的可行性。
AI.motivation: 解决知识图谱建模实践多样性导致的集成与复用成本高、脆弱性强的问题；为神经符号AI和GenAI中的自动化提供原则性理论支撑
AI.method: Empirical approach using Formal Concept Analysis (FCA); conceptual framework defined by two orthogonal distinctions (semantics/pragmatics and properties/affordances)
AI.result: 提出本体论连续体作为描述、比较、导航和转换知识图谱的统一框架
AI.conclusion: Ontological continuum as a shared research agenda for the KG community

title: AgForce Enables Antigen-conditioned Generative Antibody Design
summary: Antibody design methods condition on antigen structure to generate complementarity-determining regions (CDR), yet a systematic evaluation of baseline methods reveals that they largely ignore the antigen input. We identify three failure modes that explain this behavior. Antigen blindness arises because models derive predictions from antibody framework context rather than antigen information, producing nearly identical CDRs regardless of the target. Vocabulary collapse reduces predicted amino acids to three to five per position, far below the ground truth distribution in native sequences. Moreover, any model trained with standard per-position cross-entropy converges to the positional marginal distribution, making it provably unable to produce antigen-specific sequence predictions. We propose a novel encoder-decoder architecture called AgForce, that uses a graph neural network (GNN) as the encoder and specialized decoders for sequence-structure co-design. Specifically, we apply framework dropout, gated bottlenecks, and hyperbolic cross attention that prevent the antibody shortcut path. In the decoder, a Mixture Density Network (MDN) sequence head with Potts-like pairwise coupling and annealed Multiple Choice Learning (aMCL) replaces the cross-entropy objective with a multi-component distribution whose optimal solution differs from the positional marginal. An antigen cycle consistency head routes gradients through the sequence decoder, forcing predicted distributions to encode antigen identity. AgForce achieves the best binding quality and sequence recovery simultaneously on the CHIMERA-Bench dataset, improving amino acid recovery by 8% over the strongest sequence baseline while surpassing the baselines across all interface metrics, and nearly doubling the effective vocabulary of GNN methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/ag-force.git

AI.tldr: AgForce是一种新型抗体设计架构，通过GNN编码器配合MDN+aMCL解码器和抗原循环一致性机制，解决了现有方法忽略抗原输入导致的三类失败模式，显著提升了抗原特异性CDR设计和序列恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有抗体设计方法虽然以抗原结构为条件，但在生成CDR时却大量忽略抗原输入。研究识别出三个导致此问题的失败模式：1）抗原盲区：模型从抗体框架上下文而非抗原信息推导预测；2）词汇塌陷：预测的氨基酸缩减至每位置仅3-5种，远低于天然分布；3）标准逐位置交叉熵训练必然收敛至位置边缘分布，无法产生抗原特异性序列预测。
AI.method: AgForce采用GNN作为编码器，配合用于序列-结构协同设计的专门解码器。关键技术创新包括：防止抗体捷径路径的框架dropout、门控瓶颈和双曲交叉注意力机制；用MDN序列头（具有类似Potts的成对耦合）和退火多选择学习（aMCL）替代交叉熵目标函数；以及通过抗原循环一致性头强制预测分布编码抗原身份。
AI.result: 在CHIMERA-Bench数据集上，AgForce同时实现了最佳结合质量和序列恢复率。氨基酸回收率比最强序列基线提高8%，在所有界面指标上均超越基线，并将GNN方法的有效词汇量几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: AgForce通过创新的编码器-解码器架构和替代性训练目标，成功解决了抗体设计中的抗原盲区和词汇塌陷问题，在CHIMERA-Bench基准上同时实现了最佳结合质量和序列恢复率，氨基酸回收率提升8%，有效词汇量几乎翻倍。

title: Psy-Chronicle:A Structured Pipeline for Synthesizing Long-Horizon Campus Psychological Counseling Dialogues
summary: In recent years, large language models have shown substantial potential in psychological support tasks. However, existing psychological counseling data mostly rely on single-turn question answering or short multi-turn dialogues, making it difficult to characterize how college students' psychological distress accumulates, interacts, and gradually evolves over long periods within campus life events. To address this issue, this paper proposes Psy-Chronicle, a structured data-generation framework for synthesizing long-horizon campus psychological counseling dialogues. We generate a semester-spanning temporal stress event graph to model the chronological order and evolutionary dependencies among campus stress events. Through interactive simulation between a student agent and a counselor agent, together with a structured memory integration mechanism, Psy-Chronicle generates long-horizon dialogues with continuity across counseling sessions. Based on Psy-Chronicle, we construct and open-source CPCD, a Chinese long-horizon dialogue dataset for college psychological counseling, containing 100 student profiles, 90,000 counseling dialogues. We further build CPCD-Bench to evaluate models' long-horizon campus counseling capabilities from three dimensions: session-level response, long-horizon memory recall, and temporal-causal reasoning. Experimental results show that CPCD effectively improves session-level response generation and long-horizon memory recall for models with the same base architecture. Meanwhile, improvements in temporal-causal reasoning remain limited, indicating that event-chain organization and causal explanation are key challenges in long-horizon psychological counseling modeling. The related code and data are available at: https://github.com/EdwinUSTB/Psy-Chronicle

AI.tldr: Psy-Chronicle是一个用于合成校园长程心理辅导对话的结构化数据生成框架，通过时序压力事件图和Agent交互模拟生成CPCD数据集（100学生/90K对话）。实验验证其在会话响应和记忆召回上的有效性，揭示因果推理是当前模型的关键短板。
AI.motivation: 现有心理辅导数据主要依赖单轮问答或短程多轮对话，难以刻画大学生心理困扰在校园生活中的长期积累、交互与渐进演化过程。
AI.method: 提出Psy-Chronicle结构化数据生成框架，包含：(1)学期跨度的时序压力事件图建模事件的时间顺序与演化依赖关系；(2)学生Agent与咨询师Agent的交互模拟机制；(3)结构化记忆整合机制。基于该框架生成CPCD中文长程对话数据集，并构建CPCD-Bench从会话级响应、长程记忆召回、时序因果推理三个维度评估模型能力。
AI.result: CPCD数据集包含100个学生画像和90,000段辅导对话。实验表明，CPCD能有效提升模型的会话级响应生成和长程记忆召回能力，但对时序因果推理的提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 事件链组织与因果解释是长程心理辅导建模的关键挑战。Psy-Chronicle框架和CPCD数据集的开源，为该领域后续研究提供了重要的基准资源。

title: MPDocBench-Parse: Benchmarking Practical Multi-page Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing converts visually rich documents into machine-readable structured representations, forming a crucial foundation for information systems. Although many benchmarks have been proposed for document parsing, they remain inadequate for realistic scenarios.
