Existing benchmarks either focus on specific tasks or assess only single-page, text-centric settings, making them insufficient for practical multi-page parsing. Moreover, they lack fine-grained evaluation of semantic continuity, hierarchical structure recovery, and visual content preservation. To address these gaps, we propose MPDocBench-Parse, a benchmark for multi-page document parsing in real-world applications. It contains 433 manually annotated documents with 3,246 pages, covering 15 document types in English and Chinese, with diverse layout styles, and supports document-level end-to-end evaluation. We further design a comprehensive protocol for content fidelity and logical structure, covering text, table, and formula recognition, truncated text and table merging, figure extraction, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery. Experiments show that, while existing models perform well on basic text extraction, they still suffer clear limitations in semantic continuity integration, visual content parsing, and hierarchical structure recovery. MPDocBench-Parse provides a unified foundation for advancing document parsing toward more realistic scenarios.

AI.tldr: MPDocBench-Parse is a new multi-page document parsing benchmark with 433 documents (3,246 pages), 15 document types, supporting end-to-end evaluation. It addresses gaps in existing benchmarks by providing comprehensive evaluation of semantic continuity, hierarchical structure recovery, and visual content preservation. Current state-of-the-art models still show significant limitations in these areas despite excelling at basic text extraction.
AI.motivation: Existing document parsing benchmarks are inadequate for realistic scenarios: they either focus on specific tasks or assess only single-page, text-centric settings. They also lack fine-grained evaluation of semantic continuity, hierarchical structure recovery, and visual content preservation.
AI.method: The paper proposes MPDocBench-Parse, a benchmark containing 433 manually annotated documents with 3,246 pages covering 15 document types in English and Chinese. They design a comprehensive evaluation protocol for content fidelity and logical structure, covering: text/table/formula recognition, truncated text/table merging, figure extraction, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery.
AI.result: Experiments show that while existing models perform well on basic text extraction, they still suffer from clear limitations in semantic continuity integration, visual content parsing, and hierarchical structure recovery.
AI.conclusion: MPDocBench-Parse provides a unified foundation for advancing document parsing toward more realistic scenarios, revealing that current models still have significant limitations in semantic continuity integration, visual content parsing, and hierarchical structure recovery.

title: $\textit{BlockFormer}$ : Transformer-based inference from interaction maps
summary: Inference from interaction maps, such as centromere identification from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture techniques -- notably Hi-C -- can be formulated as a generic inverse problem: infer a set of parameters given a map summarizing pairwise interactions between entities through blocks of variable numbers and sizes. In this work, we introduce a data-driven approach that leverages shared structure between these maps, such as global alignment between localized patterns, while handling the variability in number and size of entities arising in real-world data. Our approach relies on a transformer architecture capable of handling such variability and a custom simulator to generate abundant, yet computationally cheap synthetic data for training. Applied to the problem of centromere localization, the method accurately recovers their genomic positions across a wide range of species of various genome sizes.

AI.tldr: BlockFormer 是一种"块感知"（block-aware）Transformer 架构：它把 Hi-C 等互作图视为由数量与尺寸都可变的块（block）组成的序列，用逐块分块（per-block patching）+ 逐块三维位置编码处理这种变异性，并由一个轻量级自定义模拟器产生海量廉价合成数据做预训练；在着丝粒定位任务上，它在多种真核生物中达到亚分辨率（<1 倍分辨率）精度，且推理速度远快于现有最优方法 Centurion。
AI.motivation: 从互作图反演实体级参数（如从 Hi-C 图中定位着丝粒）可统一表述为通用逆问题，但互作图具有块状（block-wise）结构：块的数目与尺寸随数据集变化，既含块内的局部模式，也含跨块的非局部对齐信息。现有的深度学习/GNN/序列模型或只处理单块、或需要为每张图重新训练，固定输入尺寸；监督学习需要昂贵的人工标注；贝叶斯方法需要设定可解的似然；Centurion 依赖高斯峰拟合的逐图非凸优化，非摊销、耗时且强依赖预定位；分子动力学类生物模拟器太慢，无法产生训练所需的成千上万张接触图。因此需要一种既能跨块数/块大小泛化、又只依赖廉价合成数据训练的摊销式方法。
AI.method: (1) 问题分解：把整体参数 θ∈R^n 的推断拆成 n 个一维子问题，对每个实体 i 用其互作子图 C_i（染色体 i 与其余染色体的 trans-block 序列）估计 θ_i，从而可处理任意实体数量。(2) 架构：受 ViT 启发将 C_i 切成 P×P 补丁，但为保持块结构，先对每个 block 单独做右下非对称零填充到补丁尺寸整数倍，再统一投影为 D 维 token，附加可学习 class token；关键创新是逐块三维位置编码 (i,j,k)（块索引 + 块内二维相对位置），经固定正弦-余弦编码投影到 D 维，以同时编码块数与块内位置；主干为 ViT 式多头自注意力 + LayerNorm + MLP（训练用 B=4、4 头、P=4、D=24），末端取 class token 经线性层 + sigmoid 映射到 [0,1] 再反归一化为真实位置。(3) 训练策略：用自制模拟器直接由着丝粒位置 θ 生成转置块（每个 trans-block 加高斯斑块 σ²∈U(0.1,10)、乘以强度因子、叠加不超过最大值 10% 的高斯噪声、绘制过中心的非交互十字），每 batch 随机化染色体数（2–10）、长度（2×10⁵–2×10⁶ bp）、目标实体、块数与分辨率 32 kb，训练 5 万样本、batch 200、200+ epochs，损失为归一化参数的 L2 回归。(4) 失效处理：块过大/分辨率过细时用粗-细多分辨率精化（粗定位后裁 60×60 补丁精修）；地图过噪时用降采样平滑或"真实斑点+模拟噪声"重构建。(5) 扩展：以 BlockFormer 为学习式摘要统计量，接入 SMC-ABC 与 SNPE（掩码自回归流）做贝叶斯后验估计；并在人类 IMR90 的单环区域做环位点定位（观测/期望归一化 + 峰预定位 + 两次前向分别估计 x、y 坐标）。
AI.result: 合成实验：BlockFormer（3D 逐块位置编码 + 逐块填充）整体最优且最稳定（1/14 块时平均误差 0.43/0.36），显著优于 ViT 与 CNN+注意力池化（后者误差 3–4 甚至更高），也优于无位置编码/1D/2D 变体；训练集若固定块数或固定斑块尺寸/无噪声，性能大幅退化（平均误差升至 2–9）。真实数据（S.C. 等 7 种酵母、疟原虫 3 个生命周期阶段、拟南芥）：归一化误差多数在 1 以下即亚分辨率（如 S.M. 0.59、L.K. 1.35、A.T. 精化后 6.12→精修 3.70、S.P. 35.0→4.3）；与 Centurion 结合精化后 S.C. 达 0.08（约 2 kb，远低于 32 kb 分辨率），且耗时大幅下降（如 P.F. 拟合 34.8 s vs Centurion 1064 s，A.T. Centurion 约 3.5 h vs BlockFormer 56.7 s）；模型对块数（1–15）、块大小、分辨率（20–70 kb）、测序深度（10%–50%）、有无 ICE 归一化均稳健，但对椭圆/环形等非高斯斑块 Centurion 略准而 BlockFormer 更快。后验估计中 ABC-Transf/NPE-Transf 给出更锐利、校准更好的后验（Wasserstein-2 距离最低，SBC 秩与 90% 覆盖率全局良好，仅个别维度过自信/过保守）；环定位上 BlockFormer（归一化误差约 2.0–2.2）优于 Centurion（3.3–3.7），但需预筛选单环区域且精度未必亚分辨率。
AI.conclusion: BlockFormer 证明了一种通用范式：只要互作图具有块状结构与可识别的"斑点"模式，就可用块感知 Transformer + 廉价定制模拟器训练出摊销式、亚分辨率精度的推断器，并在 Hi-C 着丝粒定位上匹配或超越 Centurion（Centurion 拟合后精度相近，但初始化更准、速度快约一个数量级以上，且无需按物种重跑）；同时可作为贝叶斯框架中的摘要统计量量化不确定性。局限：每个实体仅输出单个标量参数，无法处理未知数量参数或多斑点情形（环定位需预筛选），训练依赖模拟器与真实数据存在失配（主要来自端粒互作，去边界即可缓解），20 kb 等高分辨率下块尺寸超出训练范围需精化步骤，未来可推广到基因组 3D 构象等其他推断任务。

title: Do Factual Recall Mechanisms Carry over from Text to Speech in Multimodal Language Models?
comment: In *SEM 2026, the 15th Joint Conference on Lexical and Computational Semantics
summary:
In recent years, several Speech Language Models (SLMs) that represent speech and written text jointly have been presented. The question then emerges about how model-internal mechanisms are similar and different when operating in the two modalities. We focus on how these systems encode, store, and retrieve factual knowledge, which has previously been investigated for text-only models. To investigate mechanisms behind the storage and recall of factual association in SLMs, we leverage Causal Mediation Analysis, a technique previously applied to text-based models.
  Initial results using SpiritLM, a multimodal model integrating discrete speech tokens reveal discrepancies between text-to-text and speech-to-text results, suggesting that the emergent mechanisms for factual recall are only partially carried over from the text to the speech modality. These results advance our understanding of how internal mechanisms encode factual associations in SLMs while contributing insights for improving speech-enabled AI systems.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates how Speech Language Models encode and retrieve factual knowledge differently across speech and text modalities. Using Causal Mediation Analysis on SpiritLM, researchers found that mechanisms for factual recall partially transfer between modalities, advancing understanding of multimodal AI internals.
AI.motivation: As Speech Language Models (SLMs) that jointly represent speech and written text have emerged, it becomes important to understand how model-internal mechanisms operate similarly or differently across modalities, particularly for factual knowledge storage and retrieval.
AI.method: Causal Mediation Analysis was applied to SpiritLM, a multimodal model integrating discrete speech tokens. The researchers compared text-to-text and speech-to-text factual recall patterns.
AI.result: Initial results reveal discrepancies between text-to-text and speech-to-text factual recall, suggesting that emergent mechanisms for factual recall are only partially carried over from text to speech modality.
AI.conclusion: The research provides empirical evidence that factual recall mechanisms in SLMs are only partially transferred from text to speech, with speech-to-text and text-to-text results showing discrepancies. This highlights the need to understand modality-specific encoding in multimodal systems and informs future improvements for speech-enabled AI.

title: ExComm: Exploration-Stage Communication for Error-Resilient Agentic Test-Time Scaling
summary: A common failure mode in long-horizon agentic test-time scaling is error propagation, where factual errors or invalid deductions introduced at intermediate steps persist in the agent's belief state and contaminate later reasoning. Existing test-time scaling methods provide limited control over this process, as they often rely on agents to detect their own mistakes, select among flawed trajectories, or refine solutions only after errors have already shaped the reasoning path. We propose ExComm, a communication protocol for exploration-stage agentic test-time scaling. ExComm is motivated by the empirical observation that the majority of intermediate errors in parallel agentic reasoning produce detectable cross-agent factual conflicts. Leveraging the iterative structure of agentic workflows, ExComm periodically audits agent belief states to detect such conflicts, resolves them through a dedicated tool-based verification loop, and returns concise, targeted feedback to the involved agents. Corrections are incorporated through soft belief updates, which append verified feedback rather than overwriting existing beliefs. Furthermore, to prevent collapsing trajectory diversity due to communication, ExComm further introduces a trajectory diversification module that redirects redundant trajectories toward orthogonal strategies. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GAIA with Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite and Qwen3.5-4B show that ExComm consistently outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines, achieving average performance gains of 5.7% and 5.0% over the best-performing baselines, respectively. Further analyses demonstrate improved error recovery, favorable scaling behavior, stronger diversity than adapted communication baselines, and the best performance-cost trade-off among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: ExComm通过跨智能体事实冲突检测与验证机制解决长时域推理中的错误传播问题，结合软信念更新和轨迹多样化策略，在多个基准上实现显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前长时域智能体测试时扩展方法存在错误传播问题——中间步骤引入的事实错误或无效推论会持续存在于智能体信念状态中并污染后续推理。现有方法对此控制有限，因其依赖智能体检测自身错误、在存在缺陷的轨迹中选择，或仅在错误已影响推理路径后才进行优化。
AI.method: ExComm是一种用于探索阶段智能体测试时扩展的通信协议。该协议通过周期性审计智能体信念状态来检测跨智能体事实冲突，使用基于工具的验证循环解决冲突，并向涉事智能体返回简洁的定向反馈。修正通过软信念更新（追加而非覆盖）融入。此外，引入轨迹多样化模块，将冗余轨迹重定向至正交策略以防止轨迹多样性崩溃。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和GAIA上使用Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite和Qwen3.5-4B的实验中，ExComm一致性地超越强基线方法，分别实现5.7%和5.0%的平均性能提升。进一步分析表明该方法具有更好的错误恢复能力、更优的扩展行为、更强的多样性，且在评估方法中具有最佳的性能-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ExComm通过检测和解决跨智能体事实冲突，有效抑制错误传播，同时通过轨迹多样化模块保持探索多样性，实现了最佳的性能-成本权衡。

title: Alike Parts: A Feature-Informed Approach to Local and Global Prototype Explanations
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science (IJAMCS)
summary: Prototype-based explanations offer an intuitive, example-based approach to support the interpretability of machine learning black box classifiers but often lack feature-level granularity. We introduce a framework that integrates feature importance at two levels to address this gap. First, for local explanations, we propose \textit{alike parts}: a method that uses feature importance scores to highlight the most relevant, shared feature subsets between a classified instance and its nearest prototype, guiding user attention. Second, we augment the global prototype selection objective function with a feature importance term to actively promote diversity in the feature attributions of the selected prototypes. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that this augmented selection process maintains or, in some cases, increases the prediction fidelity of the surrogate model, suggesting that feature diversity does not compromise model fidelity.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes a two-level feature importance integration framework for prototype-based interpretability: "alike parts" for local explanations highlighting shared features, and augmented prototype selection promoting feature attribution diversity while maintaining fidelity.
AI.motivation: Prototype-based explanations lack feature-level granularity, limiting their interpretability for understanding ML black box classifiers.
AI.method: Integrate feature importance at two levels: (1) "alike parts" method for local explanations using feature importance to identify shared features between an instance and its nearest prototype; (2) augment global prototype selection with feature importance term to promote diversity in feature attributions.
AI.result: Experiments on six benchmark datasets show the augmented selection maintains or increases prediction fidelity without compromising model performance.
AI.conclusion: The augmented prototype selection maintains or improves prediction fidelity while increasing feature diversity, demonstrating that feature-level granularity can be enhanced without compromising model performance.

title: Structure Retention in Embedding Spaces as a Predictor of Benchmark Performance
summary: In this paper, we show that high-performing embedding models organize their embedding spaces in a consistent way. We evaluate 25 contemporary embedding models on five MTEB tasks spanning four diverse task categories (retrieval, bitext mining, pair classification, and summarization) in both English and multilingual settings, and reveal that nearest-neighbor overlap and magnitude differences in independent component analysis (ICA) between paired text instances strongly correlate (even up to 0.97) with performance on the given task. Ultimately, we show that embedding tasks display varying degrees of linearity and reliance on retention of local information. Our results further the understanding of embeddings, their relation to model performance, and shed light on possible future training objectives and optimizing conditional embeddings.

AI.tldr: 论文通过分析25个嵌入模型在5个MTEB任务上的表现，发现高绩效模型的嵌入空间具有一致的的组织方式。近邻重叠和独立成分分析(ICA)的幅度差异与任务性能高度相关（最高达0.97），揭示了嵌入任务的线性程度和局部信息保留需求的差异。
AI.motivation: To understand why high-performing embedding models perform better by investigating how they organize their embedding spaces.
AI.method: Evaluated 25 embedding models on 5 MTEB tasks across 4 categories (retrieval, bitext mining, pair classification, summarization) in English and multilingual settings. Applied nearest-neighbor overlap analysis and independent component analysis (ICA) to examine embedding space characteristics.
AI.result: Nearest-neighbor overlap and ICA magnitude differences between paired text instances strongly correlate with task performance, with correlation coefficients reaching up to 0.97.
AI.conclusion: The study reveals that embedding tasks exhibit varying degrees of linearity and differing reliance on local information retention, providing insights for future training objectives and conditional embedding optimization.

title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states. Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the Key--Value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets. We address this challenge by observing that KV reuse in ToT-style inference is governed by search dynamics: near-term decoding depends primarily on the active branch and its ancestors, whereas inactive subtrees have low short-term reuse probability yet must remain recoverable for backtracking. Motivated by this, we propose ArborKV, a structure-aware eviction framework that couples a lightweight value estimator with a tree-aware allocation policy, and performs purely token-extractive eviction with lazy rehydration to support revisits. Experiments on ToT-style reasoning benchmarks show that ArborKV achieves up to ~4x peak KV-memory reduction while preserving near-full-retention accuracy, enabling larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory.

AI.tldr: ArborKV是一种针对Tree-of-Thoughts推理的结构感知KV缓存淘汰框架，通过结合搜索动态预测与延迟再水化机制，实现约4倍内存削减，使更大规模的搜索配置在有限硬件下成为可能。
AI.motivation: Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) 推理虽然通过树结构搜索提升了LLM推理能力，但其KV缓存随分支数量线性增长，导致内存瓶颈，限制了搜索的深度和广度，需在内存限制与推理质量间做出妥协。
AI.method: ArborKV采用三层设计：(1) 轻量级价值估计器——基于搜索动态预测短期复用概率；(2) 树感知分配策略——为活跃分支及其祖先优先分配KV缓存；(3) 纯令牌级提取驱逐+延迟再水化——非活跃子树的KV状态在内存压力下可被驱逐，需要时通过重新解码再水化恢复，支持回溯操作。
AI.result: 在ToT风格推理基准测试中，ArborKV实现约4倍峰值KV内存 reduction，同时保持接近全保留的精度，证明其方法在内存效率与推理质量间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: ArborKV enables larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory, effectively democratizing complex ToT-style reasoning on commodity hardware.

title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 36 pages, 11 figures
summary: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos. Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, ReLU-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength. The distinction traces to the analytic structure of the correlation map: smooth activations admit a Taylor expansion near perfect alignment, while kinked activations develop a branch point with universal non-analyticity. As a corollary, the framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; a rank-flow tie-breaker then selects front-loaded schedules, substantially reducing held-out test loss at no extra computational cost, with accuracy gains as a consistent secondary effect. We test the predictions in MLPs and Vision Transformers and discuss CNN/ResNet extensions.

AI.tldr: A mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation to critical signal propagation reveals that smooth vs. kinked activations form distinct universality classes with different critical exponents and universal scaling collapse. The framework yields optimal front-loaded dropout schedules via a rank-flow tie-breaker, improving test performance across MLPs and Vision Transformers.
AI.motivation: Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, creating a gap in understanding how information propagates through deep networks at critical initialization. Existing theories lack a unified treatment of how dropout strength and network criticality interact across different activation functions.
AI.method: Mean-field theory treating dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos. Analytical derivation of critical and crossover scaling laws, identification of universality classes via correlation map analysis (Taylor expansion for smooth activations vs. branch point analysis for kinked activations), and universal two-parameter scaling collapse. Practical application: saturated dropout profile derivation and rank-flow tie-breaker for schedule selection.
AI.result: Critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay; smooth and kinked (ReLU-like) activations constitute distinct universality classes with different critical exponents; universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength; front-loaded dropout schedules selected via rank-flow tie-breaker achieve substantially reduced test loss with accuracy gains as secondary effect.
AI.conclusion: The framework unifies dropout theory across architectures, establishes a clear distinction between activation function universality classes, and provides practical scheduling strategies that improve test performance without additional computational cost. Predictions are validated across MLPs and Vision Transformers, with extensions to CNN/ResNet architectures discussed.

title: Evaluation of Chunking Strategies for Effective Text Embedding in Low-Resource Language on Agricultural Documents
summary: In this study, we compare the performance of four text chunking approaches: Recursive, Khmer-Aware, Sentence-Based, and LLM-Based within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework applied to Khmer agricultural documents. The document chunks are encoded using the BGE-M3 multilingual embedding model and retrieved using the FAISS library. Performance is evaluated using four metrics: Average Retrieval Score (L2 distance), Answer Relevance, Khmer Coverage, and Khmer Intersection over Union, all measured against ground-truth question-answer pairs. For evaluation, we perform 5-fold cross-validation over 18 question-answer pairs. We observe the best performance for the character-based Recursive chunking method with a chunk size of 300 characters, achieving the lowest L2 distance (0.4295 +- 0.0461), highest Answer Relevance (0.8663 +- 0.0199), and highest Khmer IoU (0.6441 +- 0.0347). A paired t-test shows a statistically significant improvement over the Sentence-Based chunking method in L2 distance (p = 0.0121). These results highlight the importance of segmentation granularity and structural preservation for optimizing dense retrieval in morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Khmer.

AI.tldr: This paper identifies the optimal text chunking method for RAG-based retrieval of Khmer agricultural documents, finding that character-based Recursive chunking with 300-character segments significantly outperforms other approaches for low-resource languages.
AI.motivation: Dense retrieval in morphologically complex, low-resource languages like Khmer requires optimal text segmentation strategies, yet the best chunking approach remains unclear.
AI.method: The study compares four text chunking approaches (Recursive, Khmer-Aware, Sentence-Based, and LLM-Based) within a RAG framework, using BGE-M3 for encoding, FAISS for retrieval, and 5-fold cross-validation over 18 QA pairs with four evaluation metrics.
AI.result: Recursive chunking (300 characters) achieves the best performance with the lowest L2 distance (0.4295 ± 0.0461), highest Answer Relevance (0.8663 ± 0.0199), and highest Khmer IoU (0.6441 ± 0.0347), with statistically significant improvement over Sentence-Based chunking (p = 0.0121).
AI.conclusion: The character-based Recursive chunking method with a chunk size of 300 characters is optimal for dense retrieval in Khmer agricultural documents, demonstrating the importance of segmentation granularity and structural preservation for low-resource languages.

title: EntmaxKV: Support-Aware Decoding for Entmax Attention
summary: Long-context decoding is increasingly limited by KV-cache memory traffic since each generated token attends over a cache whose size grows linearly with context length. Existing sparse decoding methods reduce this cost by selecting subsets of tokens or pages, but are designed for softmax attention, whose dense tails make any truncation discard nonzero probability mass. In contrast, $α$-entmax produces exact zeros, turning sparse decoding from dense-tail approximation into support recovery: if the selected candidates contain the entmax support, sparse decoding remains exact. While recent entmax kernels enable efficient training, they do not address the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, where dense inference still streams the full KV cache before sparsity is known. In this work, we introduce EntmaxKV, an entmax-native sparse decoding framework that exploits sparsity before KV pages are loaded. EntmaxKV combines query-aware page scoring, support-aware candidate selection, and sparse entmax attention. We analyze truncation error through the dropped probability mass $δ$, showing that output error is controlled by $δ$ and vanishes when the entmax support is recovered. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware entmax selector that estimates the entmax threshold from lightweight page statistics, adapting the selected budget to the score distribution. Empirically, EntmaxKV drops less probability mass, retains more support tokens, and achieves lower output error than softmax-based sparse decoding at matched KV budgets. On long-context and language modeling benchmarks, it closely matches full-cache entmax while using a small fraction of the KV cache, achieving up to $3.36\times$ (softmax) and $5.43\times$ (entmax) speedup over full attention baselines at 1M context length. Code available at: https://github.com/deep-spin/entmaxkv.

AI.tldr: EntmaxKV通过利用α-entmax的精确零值特性，在KV页面加载前利用稀疏性，结合查询感知评分、支持感知选择和高斯感知选择器，实现高效长上下文解码，在100万上下文长度下实现最高5.43倍加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受KV-cache内存流量限制严重。现有稀疏解码方法专为softmax注意力设计，密集尾部特性导致任何截断都会丢弃非零概率质量。α-entmax可产生精确零值，使稀疏解码从近似变为支持恢复。
AI.method: 提出EntmaxKV框架，融合查询感知页面评分、支持感知候选选择和稀疏entmax注意力；引入高斯感知entmax选择器，从轻量页面统计估计entmax阈值，自适应调整所选预算。
AI.result: 丢弃更少概率质量、保留更多支持token、在相同KV预算下实现更低输出误差。在长上下文和语言建模基准测试中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: EntmaxKV在100万上下文长度下实现3.36×(softmax)和5.43×(entmax)加速，匹配全缓存entmax性能，同时仅使用KV缓存的一小部分。

title: Audience Engagement with Arabic Women's Social Empowerment and Wellbeing: A Decadal Corpus
summary: This paper presents the Arabic Women and Society Corpus, a ten year collection of 252,487 public Arabic Facebook posts related to women's empowerment and social wellbeing. The corpus was collected from 51,660 pages across 77 countries between 2013 and 2024, resulting in more than 267 million user interactions. Each post includes engagement metrics such as shares, comments, and emotional reactions, providing a unique view of audience sentiment and social attention. The data were processed using an automated pipeline with language identification, normalization, and metadata cleaning to ensure reliability and reproducibility. The corpus enables large scale analysis of gender discourse, social reform, and emotional engagement across Arabic dialects. It supports research in Arabic natural language processing, computational social science, and digital communication studies. The dataset and accompanying documentation will be released under request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文发布「阿拉伯女性与社会语料库」（Arabic Women and Society Corpus），收录2013–2024年十年间来自全球77个国家、51,660个公共主页的252,487条与女性赋权和社会福祉相关的阿拉伯语公开Facebook帖子，并附超2.67亿条用户互动数据；数据集将在申请研究用途后开放。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语社交媒体研究长期缺乏大规模、可复现且覆盖多方言的公开语料，尤其缺少聚焦女性赋权、社会福祉与情感反应的数据集。既有资源多停留在通用阿拉伯语NLP或单一国家/平台，且缺少互动指标，难以支撑跨方言的性别话语与社会情感计算研究。该工作旨在构建一个十年跨度、跨国、跨方言且带有完整互动元数据的语料基础设施。
AI.method: 从2013年至2024年间，对77个国家的51,660个公共Facebook页面进行采集，共获取252,487条以女性赋权与社会福祉为主题的阿拉伯语公开帖子，记录超过2.67亿次用户互动（分享、评论及情感反应等）。数据处理采用自动化流水线，包含语言识别、文本归一化与元数据清洗三个环节，以提升数据一致性与可复现性；语料保留帖子文本及其互动/情感元数据，适配阿拉伯方言变体。数据集与配套文档以「按研究申请授权发布」的方式提供。
AI.result: 建成一个包含252,487条帖子、51,660个来源页面、覆盖77国与十年时间跨度的阿拉伯语女性与社会语料库，附2.67亿以上用户互动记录与经语言识别、归一化、元数据清洗的标准化处理流程。语料同时支持文本分析与互动/情感层面的定量分析。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库为阿拉伯语NLP、计算社会科学与数字传播研究提供了可扩展的数据基础，可用于分析阿拉伯方言中的性别话语、社会改革议题与情感参与度。数据及文档采用申请制研究使用授权，在促进可复现研究的同时兼顾数据治理与使用合规。

title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
comment: Code and model artifacts are available at https://github.com/sailing-lab/sr2am
summary: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three systems: simulative reasoning (System II) grounding deliberation in future-state prediction via a world model; self-regulation (System III) deciding when and how deeply to plan via a learned configurator; and reactive execution (System I) handling fine-grained action. Simulative reasoning provides unified planning across diverse tasks without per-domain engineering, while self-regulation ensures the planner is invoked only when needed. To test this, we develop SR$^2$AM (Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM), realizing both as distinct stages within an LLM's chain-of-thought, with the LLM as world model. We explore two instantiations: recording decisions from a prompted multi-module system (v0.1) and reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs (v1.0), trained via supervised then reinforcement learning (RL). Across math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking, v0.1-8B and v1.0-30B achieve Pass@1 competitive with 120-355B and 685B-1T parameter systems respectively, while v1.0-30B uses 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than comparable agentic LLMs. RL increases average planning horizon by 22.8% while planning frequency grows only 2.0%, showing it learns to plan further ahead rather than more often. More broadly, learned self-regulation instantiates a principle we expect to extend beyond planning to how agents govern their own learning and adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SR²AM（Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM），把智能体的决策分解为三个交互系统：System I 反应式执行、System II 基于世界模型的模拟式推理（规划）、System III 学习得到的"配置器"（自调节，决定何时规划、规划多深）。配置器与规划器被实现为 LLM 思维链中的两个独立阶段，LLM 本身充当语言空间的世界模型。训练采用 SFT + GRPO 强化学习。实验显示：8B 的 v0.1 达到整体 Pass@1 57.0，可与 120–355B 系统竞争；30B 的 v1.0 达到 71.3，与 685B–1T 系统相当，同时推理 token 少 25.8%–95.3%；RL 使平均规划视界提升 22.8%，而规划频率仅增加 2.0%，说明模型学会"想得更远"而非"想得更频繁"。
AI.motivation: 当前主流 agentic LLM 将智能体视为"带自适应计算的响应式策略"，期望规划能力从端到端训练中自发涌现。这种做法缺少对规划"是否存在、结构、视界"的可控机制，导致训练中推理长度急剧膨胀，token 消耗激增却无法稳定转化为准确率提升；同时也无法独立分析、调节和优化规划本身。已有工作各自只覆盖问题的一部分：努力量自适应（仅调节推理量）、模式路由（仅在任务开始时一次性决策）、工作流蒸馏（规则化、刚性、缺乏自由推理与模拟规划）、世界模型规划（每步强制模拟）。没有一个统一架构同时具备三者。
AI.method: 形式化：定义智能体-环境模型、信念状态与世界模型 f，给出基于世界模型的最优策略 π*_f（对动作序列与预测未来状态做期望回报最大化），并给出模拟式推理输出 c_t=(ŝ_t, a'_t, ŝ_{t+1},…,ŝ_T') 的规划表示；进一步将动作分布分解为 p_π(a_t|ŝ_t)=Σ p_α(a_t|ŝ_t,c_t)·p_{π_f}(c_t|ŝ_t,u_t)·p_κ(u_t|ŝ_t)，对应 System I/II/III。据此把既有范式定位为该分解的子集。实现：SR²AM 把配置器与模拟规划器实现为 LLM 思维链中的两个阶段（CoT 中 "<configurator>" 决策与 "Plan:" 结构化状态-动作-未来状态块，"Plan: None" 表示跳过规划），LLM 自身作为世界模型。两个实例化：(1) v0.1 多模块提示推理——配置器可自由调用 user_intent/planning/reflection/summary 子模块并迭代重规划，用 o4-mini 采集，过滤正确性并要求 >3 次模块/动作调用，得到 4,845 条 SFT 样本；(2) v1.0 计划重建——用 DeepSeek-V3.2 采集交错思维-动作轨迹，由标注 LLM 重建每步的配置器决策 û_t∈{0,1} 与结构化计划 ĉ_t，追加到原始思维后保留自由推理，并按任务类型控制规划视界（网页高不确定性任务截断至 ≤2 步），得到 10,787 条 SFT 样本。RL：奖励为答案正确/结构合规/最终答案可提取的三个二元信号分段组合（1/0.8/0.2/0.1/0），采用带非对称裁剪的 GRPO，按难度过滤数据（Pass@K 区间），30B+ 过滤截断轨迹防格式崩塌。基座分别为 Qwen3-8B（v0.1）与 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507（v1.0）；工具为 web_search、visit_tool、python_repl_tool。评估覆盖 11 个基准（数学 AIME-24/25、MATH-500；科学 GPQA-Diamond、SuperGPQA、HLE；表格 FinQA、MultiHier；网页 BrowseComp、GAIA-103、XBench-DeepSearch），与参考系统、无调节与部分调节类 agentic LLM 比较 Pass@1 与平均推理 token。
AI.result: SR²AM-v0.1-8B 整体 Pass@1 57.0、约 3,698 推理 token/轨迹，在同规模中优于其他系统并可与 30–32B 无调节 agent 及 120–355B 预训练 LLM+工具相当。SR²AM-v1.0-30B 整体 Pass@1 71.3，与 DeepSeek-V3.2(685B, 73.2)、Kimi-K2.5(1.0T, 70.9) 同工具配置下相当，超过纯文本 GPT-5.4-xhigh(68.4)，接近其带工具水平(78.3)，在 30–32B agentic LLM 中优于广泛的无调节与部分调节基线，与 MiroThinker-v1.5-30B(74.2) 竞争；相比 MiroThinker 少用 51.2% token（5,518 vs 11,295），对 Pass@1≥60 的同规模 agentic LLM 节省 25.8%–95.3% token。消融（SFT）：去自由推理（System I）降幅最大 66.6→46.8；去选择性规划（System III）token 增幅最大 4,925→5,451；去模拟规划结构（System II）与去视界控制（System III）均降准确率；完整分解优于直接 SFT 教师 CoT（66.6 vs 65.3），RL 后进一步升至 72.8（token 4,925→5,414）。规划视界：RL 将 2 步及 3+ 步计划占比从 5.3% 提升到 14.9%，未规划步占比稳定（15.6%→13.6%）；各任务平均视界增长 20.9%–32.7%（科学最大、网页最小）。RL 训练对比：Qwen3-8B 无调节基线 token 从约 4,100 持续上升、pass 率在 200 步后回落、上下文溢出率升至 22.4%；v0.1 稳定在约 2,100→3,600 token 且准确率持续上升、溢出可忽略，400 步时少 34.1% token 且 pass 率更高（56.2 vs 47.6）。数据规模实验：同教师下结构化分解在所有规模上稳定优于无调节推理重建（Pass@1 1.2–3.5%），换用更强教师（Qwen3-Coder-480B）后提升更大（1,600→3,200 样本时 Pass@1 60.9→72.9）。案例分析显示计划可捕捉无约束推理遗漏的错误、RL 产生带回退策略的前瞻性计划，但简单任务上存在过度规划（configurator 的"何时停止规划"校准仍主要来自 SFT，尚未被 RL 充分精炼）。
AI.conclusion: 把决策分解为"模拟式推理(System II) + 学习式自调节(System III) + 反应式执行(System I)"，在四类交互式推理任务上以显著更低的推理成本取得有竞争力的准确率，且消融证明三系统作用互补；带自调节的 RL 产生"更长视界而非更频繁规划"的质变，token 增长受控。这表明当前 agentic 模型对超长思维链的依赖可能源于把智能体建成无差别的响应式策略、缺乏对自身规划的真实自主调节；单一模拟规划框架在无需按域工程化的情况下跨任务通用，支持模拟式推理作为通用规划机制。作者认为该"配置器"原则可推广到推理之外的自我学习与适应治理；局限包括仅在语言交互推理上验证、语言空间世界模型预测力有限、缺少对 configurator 与世界模型精度的独立诊断、上下文与工具接口可改进、以及简单任务上过度规划的校准问题。

title: Amplifying, Not Learning: Fine-Tuned AI Text Detectors Amplify a Pretrained Direction
summary: AI text detectors amplify a pretrained typicality axis; they do not construct an AI-vs-human boundary. On raw encoders before any task supervision, projecting onto centroid(AI)-centroid(HC3) achieves NYT-vs-HC3 AUROC 0.806/0.944/0.834 across three architectures (86-106% of the fine-tuned discrimination ceiling: on RoBERTa-base, raw projection exceeds fine-tuning); on RoBERTa-base, full fine-tuning reduces discrimination below raw on both fluent-formal populations tested. The same axis inverts on non-native ESL writing (AUROC 0.06-0.20) -- a falsifiable prediction unique to the typicality reading. A 24-example frozen probe matches full fine-tuning (0.900 vs 0.895). A closed-form Jacobian predictor parameterises axis-manipulating interventions with R^2 = 1.000 universal, lifts ELECTRA-CE deployment TPR from 0.000 to 0.904 at FPR = 1%, and transfers to three independently-trained third-party RoBERTa detectors at 16/16 oracle-equivalence (57% NYT-FPR reduction on the OpenAI detector). Scope: encoder family; mechanism magnitude HC3-anchored; population-level shared axis with per-text mechanisms varying across architectures. Three operationally distinct probes -- text-surface caps_rate residualisation, geometric signed-epsilon ablation, closed-form text-pair predictor -- agree at cos 0.74/0.81/1.00 across three architectures, confirming observer-invariance. Under matched-TPR-0.90 evaluation, the published intervention zoo (CC, dealign-f2c) is calibration-equivalent across 27 cells (|Delta AUROC| <= 0.0081), and >= 97% of the LoRA->full-FT bias gap on ELECTRA is calibration shift, not learned representation -- the central claim's prediction confirmed.

AI.tldr: AI文本检测器的本质机制是通过预训练的典型性轴进行判别，而非构建新的AI-vs-human边界；原始编码器投影即可达到或超过微调后的性能；该轴在非母语写作上反转，表明这是模型内在的典型性感知而非针对AI的特异性检测。
AI.motivation: 理解AI文本检测器的实际工作机制——它们是否真的构建了AI-vs-human边界，还是只是放大了预训练的典型性轴。
AI.method: 在原始编码器上投射到centroid(AI)-centroid(HC3)轴；在三种架构（RoBERTa-base等）上验证；使用24-example冻结探测器；闭式Jacobian预测器参数化轴干预；三种操作不同的探测方法交叉验证。
AI.result: 在原始编码器上，该典型性轴已能达到AUROC 0.806-0.944；全量微调反而降低而非提升判别能力；同一轴在非母语ESL写作上反转（AUROC 0.06-0.20）；24-example冻结探测器与全量微调性能相当（0.900 vs 0.895）；闭式Jacobian预测器R²=1.000；ELECTRA-CE在FPR=1%下TPR从0.000提升至0.904。
AI.conclusion: LoRA到全量微调的偏差中≥97%是校准偏移而非习得表征；三种架构的探测方法（caps_rate残差化、几何符号ε消融、闭式文本对预测器）确认了observer不变性，cos相似度达0.74/0.81/1.00；在TPR=0.90匹配评估下，已发布的干预方法（CC、dealign-f2c）在27个单元格中等效（|Δ AUROC| ≤ 0.0081）。

title: GHI: Graphormer over Conditioned Hypergraph Incidence for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) requires models to bind sentiment evidence to the correct aspect, making it a natural testbed for fine-grained structural reasoning. We introduce GHI, a Graphormer-over-Conditioned-Hypergraph-Incidence framework that is designed as an incidence-based structural reasoning layer built on a bipartite topology. GHI represents diverse linguistic and semantic evidence as token--hyperedge incidence relations, allowing different structural signals to be incorporated through a unified interface. Extensive experiments on six standard ABSA benchmarks show that GHI outperforms all baselines on the SemEval domains, and multi-seed evaluations show stable improvements over strong DeBERTa. Further experiments show that with only 247M parameters, GHI approaches the performance of 11B Flan-T5 based methods on the ISE benchmark. Moreover, it demonstrates strong robustness on the challenging ARTS datasets, maintaining highly competitive performance where traditional models degrade. These results demonstrate that compact structural reasoning remains a valuable alternative to scale-driven approaches for fine-grained tasks.

AI.tldr: GHI是一种基于超图incident结构的新型ABSA框架，通过将语义证据建模为token-hyperedge关系实现统一表示，在保持参数效率（247M）的同时在多个基准数据集上达到最优或接近最优性能，证明了结构化推理在细粒度任务中的重要价值。
AI.motivation: ABSA任务要求模型将情感证据与正确方面绑定，是细粒度结构推理的自然测试平台，揭示了现有方法在处理复杂语义关系时的局限性。
AI.method: 提出GHI框架（Graphormer-over-Conditioned-Hypergraph-Incidence），采用基于二分拓扑的incident-based结构推理层，将语言和语义证据表示为token-hyperedge incident关系，通过统一接口整合不同结构信号。
AI.result: 在六个标准ABSA基准数据集上优于所有基线；多种子实验显示相对强基线DeBERTa具有稳定提升；247M参数接近11B Flan-T5在ISE基准的表现；在具挑战性的ARTS数据集上保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GHI方法在细粒度情感分析任务中展示了结构化推理相比规模化方法的有效性，仅247M参数即可接近11B参数模型的性能，表明紧凑的结构化推理是细粒度任务中规模化方法的有价值替代方案。

title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Extends arXiv:2605.19576 with the SWE-bench Verified evaluation and a non-divergence analysis (Proposition 1)
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20 rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together prevent expected performance from drifting below the no-skills floor.

AI.tldr: Ratchet通过单一冻结LLM智能体循环管理技能生命周期（编写、检索、策划、退休），在MBPP+ hard-100和SWE-bench Verified上分别实现+32.8pp和+22pp提升，证明技能退休机制和元技能先验是关键组件，填补了自进化技能库在生命周期管理上的空白。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM自编写的技能相比无技能基线提升为0.0pp，而人类策划的技能提升+16.2pp。这表明瓶颈不在于技能编写，而在于技能生命周期管理。
AI.method: 提出Ratchet框架，采用单一冻结LLM智能体循环实现技能的编写、检索、策划和退休。集成四种候选 hygiene 机制：outcome-driven retirement（基于结果的退休）、bounded active-cap（有限活动上限）、meta-skill authoring guidance（元技能编写指导）和 pattern canonicalisation（模式规范化）。
AI.result: MBPP+ hard-100上，Ratchet将pass@1从基线0.258提升至滚动均值0.584（峰值0.658）；消融实验显示退休机制和元技能先验是load-bearing组件；显式去重机制被元技能本身所包含；理论证明有限上限和退休阈值可防止性能发散。
AI.conclusion: Ratchet通过单一智能体循环成功解决了技能生命周期管理问题，在MBPP+ hard-100上实现+32.8pp提升，在SWE-bench Verified上实现+22pp提升。消融实验表明退休机制和元技能先验是核心组件，理论分析证明了算法的非发散性。

title: Value-Gradient Hypothesis of RL for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning substantially improves pretrained language models, but it remains understudied why critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO work as well as they do, and when they should provide the largest gains. We develop a value-gradient perspective of critic-free RL for LLM post-training. First, under a differentiable rollout and additive-noise parameterization, we show that the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation: the backward pass propagates costates whose conditional expectation equals the value gradient. Second, for discrete transformer policies, we show that autodifferentiation through attention produces empirical costates that approximate this value signal, with an error controlled by the sampling gap and policy entropy. These results motivate a decomposition of RL impact into value gradient signal and reachable reward headroom, yielding a criterion for when RL should be most effective along a pretraining trajectory.

AI.tldr: 从价值梯度视角为无评论家RL方法提供理论解释，揭示了注意力机制在估计价值信号中的作用，并给出了RL效益最大化的判断准则。
AI.motivation: PPO和GRPO等无评论家方法在LLM后训练中广泛应用，但其有效性机制尚不清晰，缺乏关于何时能获得最大收益的理论理解。
AI.method: 在可微分rollout和加性噪声参数化假设下，证明actor更新在期望上等价于价值梯度形式；利用注意力机制的自微分性质，通过注意力输出经验代价状态来近似价值信号。
AI.result: Actor更新可分解为价值梯度信号与可达奖励空间两部分；近似误差由采样间隔和策略熵控制。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了价值梯度视角下无评论家RL何时最有效的判断准则，为沿着预训练轨迹选择RL应用时机提供了理论依据。

title: IdioLink: Retrieving Meaning Beyond Words Across Idiomatic and Literal Expressions
summary: Idioms pose a fundamental challenge for language models, as their meaning cannot be inferred from surface form alone. Understanding such expressions, therefore, requires semantic abstraction beyond lexical overlap. We introduce IdioLink, a retrieval benchmark designed to test whether models can link idiomatic expressions to conceptually equivalent meanings expressed in literal or paraphrased forms. IdioLink comprises 10,700 documents and 2,140 queries, spanning 107 idioms with both literal and figurative uses. Each document and query is annotated with spans that convey the core meaning. Evaluating strong embedding baselines (e.g., BGE, E5, Contriever, and Qwen), we show that current models struggle to retrieve equivalent meanings across divergent surface realizations, relying instead on topical and shallow semantic cues. IdioLink exposes key gaps in idiom-aware semantic retrieval and provides a challenging testbed for future models.

AI.tldr: IdioLink是一个用于测试语言模型理解惯用语能力的检索基准，包含超过1万个文档和2千条查询。研究发现当前最先进的embedding模型在惯用语理解方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 惯用语的核心挑战在于其含义无法从表面形式直接推断，当前模型难以实现超越词汇重叠的语义抽象。
AI.method: 构建包含10,700份文档和2,140条查询的检索基准，涵盖107个惯用语，每份文档和查询均标注了传达核心含义的跨度，通过评估多个embedding基线模型来测试其跨表面形式匹配等价含义的能力。
AI.result: 当前模型在跨表面形式检索等价含义方面表现挣扎，暴露出对主题和浅层语义线索的依赖。
AI.conclusion: IdioLink provides a challenging testbed exposing critical gaps in idiom-aware semantic retrieval; current models (BGE, E5, Contriever, Qwen) rely on topical and shallow cues rather than true semantic abstraction for idiom understanding.

title: IdleSpec: Exploiting Idle Time via Speculative Planning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents solve complex tasks by leveraging multi-step reasoning with iterative tool calls and environment interactions, which incur idle time while waiting for observations. Despite the prevalence of idle time in most agentic scenarios, existing works treat it as an unavoidable overhead or propose restricted solutions that overlook varying computational budgets across different tool calls and future observation uncertainty, thereby leading to suboptimal utilization of idle time. In this paper, we introduce IdleSpec, a scalable and generic inference approach that leverages idle-time computation to improve agent performance while minimizing latency overhead. Specifically, IdleSpec iteratively generates plan candidates during idle periods and, once observations become available, aggregates them to guide the next reasoning step. For effective plan generation under observation uncertainty, IdleSpec samples between complementary drafting strategies (i.e., progressive and recovery) from a learned distribution that is updated via posterior feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that IdleSpec significantly improves agent performance in various agentic scenarios by effectively utilizing idle time. In particular, on the GAIA and FRAMES, IdleSpec achieves 55.6% average accuracy with Gemini-2.5-Flash, surpassing the vanilla baseline without idle-time usage by 5.1%. Furthermore, for MLE-Bench, which involves substantial delay from code executions, IdleSpec achieves performance gains of up to 9.1% on the Any Medal rate, highlighting its generalizability to long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: IdleSpec leverages idle-time computation during tool-calling in LLM agents by generating and aggregating plan candidates using complementary drafting strategies, achieving significant performance gains (5.1-9.1%) across multiple benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Idle time during tool-calling in LLM-based agents is prevalent but treated as unavoidable overhead. Existing solutions overlook varying computational budgets and future observation uncertainty, leading to suboptimal idle time utilization.
AI.method: IdleSpec iteratively generates plan candidates during idle periods and aggregates them upon observation arrival to guide next reasoning step. It employs complementary drafting strategies (progressive and recovery) sampled from a learned distribution updated via posterior feedback to handle observation uncertainty.
AI.result: On GAIA and FRAMES, IdleSpec achieves 55.6% average accuracy with Gemini-2.5-Flash, surpassing vanilla baseline by 5.1%. On MLE-Bench (code execution delays), IdleSpec achieves up to 9.1% improvement on Any Medal rate.
AI.conclusion: IdleSpec significantly improves agent performance in various agentic scenarios by effectively utilizing idle time, achieving 5.1% accuracy gains on GAIA/FRAMES and 9.1% improvement on MLE-Bench Any Medal rate, demonstrating generalizability to long-horizon tasks.

title: Hierarchical Variational Policies for Reward-Guided Diffusion
summary: Adapting pretrained diffusion models to downstream objectives such as inverse problems often requires expensive test-time guidance or optimization. We propose a principled framework for generating high-quality reward-aligned samples at substantially reduced inference cost. Our approach formulates test-time adaptation as a hierarchical variational model, where control is amortized into a lightweight yet expressive stochastic policy. This formulation naturally supports few-step diffusion sampling: large step sizes enable fast inference, while the learned policy maintains sample quality by providing structured per-step control. The resulting fully amortized sampler achieves a strong quality--speed tradeoff, matching or exceeding recent test-time scaling baselines while requiring significantly less compute. For example, on 4x super-resolution, our method achieves better perceptual quality with more than 5x faster inference compared to the best-performing baseline. We further extend our approach to a semi-amortized regime that combines cheap amortized proposals with limited test-time optimization, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual quality across several challenging inverse problems.

AI.tldr: Proposes an amortized test-time adaptation framework for diffusion models using hierarchical variational inference, enabling fast few-step sampling while maintaining quality. Achieves >5x speedup on 4x super-resolution with better results, and SOTA quality via semi-amortized extension.
AI.motivation: Existing methods for adapting pretrained diffusion models to downstream tasks (e.g., inverse problems) require expensive test-time guidance or optimization, making inference costly.
AI.method: Hierarchical variational framework that amortizes control into a lightweight stochastic policy; supports few-step diffusion sampling with large step sizes while maintaining quality through structured per-step control.
AI.result: On 4x super-resolution: better perceptual quality with over 5x faster inference than best baseline. State-of-the-art perceptual quality across multiple challenging inverse problems.
AI.conclusion: A fully amortized sampler achieving strong quality-speed tradeoff, with a semi-amortized extension that achieves SOTA perceptual quality across several inverse problems.

title: Harder to Defend: Towards Chinese Toxicity Attacks via Implicit Enhancement and Obfuscation Rewriting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require robust toxicity evaluation beyond explicit wording. This setting remains underexplored in Chinese, where toxicity may combine semantic indirectness with surface obfuscation. We introduce Chinese Implicit Toxicity Attack (CITA), a controlled red-team evaluation and defense-data generation framework, not a deployable evasion tool. CITA uses three stages: (i) Harmful Intent Learning, (ii) Implicit Toxicity Enhancement, and (iii) Obfuscation Variant Rewriting, to preserve harmful intent, increase implicitness, and add controlled surface variants. On CITA-generated evaluation samples, the seven tested detectors exhibit substantial missed-detection risks, reaching an average ASR of 69.48%; human evaluation further confirms preserved harmfulness and increased implicitness/evasiveness. As a downstream defense application, we fine-tune a Chinese Implicit Toxicity Defense model (CITD) with CITA-generated red-team data, showing that such data can improve robustness through additional training.

AI.tldr: CITA是一个用于中文LLM隐含毒性评估和防御数据生成的红队框架，通过三阶段方法生成高隐含性、高规避性的毒性样本，可有效揭示现有检测器的漏洞，并证明该数据能够增强防御模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有中文LLM毒性评估主要针对显性表述，缺乏对隐性毒性的系统性研究。中文毒性表达常结合语义间接性与表面混淆，增加了检测难度，是当前未被充分探索的重要安全领域。
AI.method: 采用三阶段递进式框架：(i)有害意图学习、(ii)隐含毒性增强、(iii)混淆变体重写。通过保留有害意图、提升隐含程度、添加表面变体三个维度，系统性生成难以被现有检测器识别的中文隐含毒性样本。
AI.result: 在CITA生成的测试集上，7个检测器平均攻击成功率(ASR)达69.48%，存在显著漏检风险；人类评估确认了样本的有害性保留、隐含性和规避性提升；基于该数据微调的CITD防御模型展示了改进的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CITA框架成功生成了具有高隐含性和规避性的毒性攻击样本，可用于红队评估和防御数据生成；CITD模型验证了CITA生成数据可有效提升中文LLM的毒性防御能力。

title: ST-SimDiff: Balancing Spatiotemporal Similarity and Difference for Efficient Video Understanding with MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant computational overhead when processing long videos due to the massive number of visual tokens required. To improve efficiency, existing methods primarily reduce redundancy by pruning or merging tokens based on importance or similarity. However, these approaches largely overlook a critical dimension of video content, i.e., changes and turning points, and they lack a collaborative model for spatio-temporal relationships. To address this, we propose a new perspective: similarity is for identifying redundancy, while difference is for capturing key events. Based on this, we designed a training-free framework named ST-SimDiff. We first construct a spatio-temporal graph from the visual tokens to uniformly model their complex associations. Subsequently, we employ a parallel dual-selection strategy: 1) similarity-based selection uses community detection to retain representative tokens, compressing static information; 2) temporal difference-based selection precisely locates content-changing points to preserve tokens that capture key dynamic shifts. This allows it to preserve both static and dynamic content with a minimal number of tokens. Extensive experiments show our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while substantially reducing computational costs. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-SimDiff.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型处理长视频时计算开销大的问题，提出将相似性用于识别冗余、差异性用于捕获关键事件的新视角，设计了无需训练的ST-SimDiff框架，通过时空图建模和并行双选择策略（相似性压缩静态信息、差异性保留动态事件），实现了高效的长视频处理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要通过剪枝或合并标记来减少冗余，但这些方法主要关注重要性和相似性维度，存在两个关键缺陷：1）忽略了视频内容中的变化和转折点这一关键维度；2）缺乏对时空关系的协同建模。
AI.method: 提出了一个无需训练的框架ST-SimDiff，包含三个核心步骤：1）构建时空图以统一建模视觉标记之间的复杂关联；2）基于相似性的选择，使用社区检测保留代表性标记以压缩静态信息；3）基于时间差异的选择，精准定位内容变化点以保留捕捉动态变化的关键标记。通过并行的双选择策略实现以最少标记同时保留静态和动态内容。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ST-SimDiff在显著降低计算成本的同时，性能显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: ST-SimDiff通过结合相似性（压缩静态信息）和差异性（捕获关键事件）两种选择策略，在显著降低计算成本的同时，在长视频处理任务上优于现有最先进的方法。

title: Representation Gap: Explaining the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Neural Networks from a Geometric Perspective
summary: Characterizing precisely the asymptotic generalization error of neural networks using parameters that can be estimated efficiently is a crucial problem in machine learning, which relies heavily on heuristics and practitioners' intuition to make key design choices. In order to mitigate this issue, we introduce the Representation Gap, a metric closely related to the generalization error, but admitting better-behaved asymptotic dynamics. Focusing on equivariant diffusion models and leveraging results from optimal quantization and point-process theory, we derive a precise asymptotic equivalent of the Representation Gap and show that it is governed by a single parameter, the \textit{intrinsic dimension} of the task, which is easy to interpret, efficient to estimate, and can be linked to the equivariances of common neural network architectures. We show that this asymptotic dynamic also extends to a broader range of tasks and training algorithms. Finally, we demonstrate empirically that our asymptotic law and intrinsic dimension estimation are accurate on a wide range of synthetic datasets, where these quantities are known, as well as on more realistic datasets, where we obtain results consistent with the related literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“表示间隙”（Representation Gap）这一几何量，用以统一刻画预测任务与生成建模任务的泛化行为，并证明其渐近尺度为 J·n^{-2/d}，其中 d 是任务的“内在维度”——对于等变模型等于商流形 Ω/G 的维数，对非等变模型等于 Ω 的维数。等变通过降维 d 严格改进渐近泛化率。该结论基于最优量化理论（Zador 定理）与点过程理论推导，并在合成数据集与真实数据集上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 精确刻画神经网络渐近泛化误差是机器学习的核心难题，现有 PAC 类界往往不紧，且依赖难以估计的量（如内在维度），同时泛化误差难以推广到生成式建模等任务；实践中的架构与训练设计高度依赖启发式与直觉。作者希望找到一种既与泛化误差紧密相关、又具有良好渐近动力学（可给出精确渐近等价式）且参数易于估计与解释的度量，从而以几何（数据流形与模型对称性）而非参数空间的视角来解释神经网络“不可思议的有效性”。
AI.method: 1）定义表示间隙 R(Ω,Ω_f)=∫_Ω inf_{z∈Ω_f} ℓ(y,z) p(y) dy，其中 ℓ 为（平方）测地距离；它是 Wasserstein 距离的特例，在 Ω_f 离散时退化为量化误差，因而可统一处理预测与生成任务。2）证明等变扩散模型的“虚拟数据增强”：若模型在 G 下等变且精确优化 DDIM 损失，则其预测空间恰为 Ω_f = G(𝔻)（对一般对称群推广 Kamb & Ganguli 2025 的定理，用 Laplace 近似证明 score 在轨道上聚集）。3）利用等距群作用与常体积轨道假设，将表示间隙约化为商流形 Ω/G 上的量化问题：R(Ω,Ω_f) = |G| ∫_{Ω/G} min_{z∈𝔻} ℓ_{Ω/G}(y,z) p(y) dy；再结合 Zador 定理（最优多样采样）与点过程/最近邻收敛定理（i.i.d. 采样），得到渐近等价式。4）把点过程定理从“期望意义”强化为“依概率收敛”，并给出显式常数 J_d、J_d^* 与密度泛函 V_d(p)、V_d^*(p)。5）监督预测情形：把输入-目标流形视为函数图像，度量可加分离 + f 的 L-Lipschitz 性给出 R_n = O_P(n^{-2/d}) 的上界；进一步证明 (1/(1+L))·E ≤ R ≤ E，从而 E = O(n^{-2/d_Ω})，与 Tahmasebi & Jegelka (2023) 的界相呼应。6）实验：DDIM 扩散模型（MLP，线性噪声调度 T=100，Adam，5e4 步），用 1000 模型样本与 1000 留出点估计 R_n；在 log-log 上做线性回归以估计内在维度 d=-2/slope；对比最优采样（K-means++、流形上离散 Lloyd）与 i.i.d. 采样。
AI.result: 理论结果：R_n ~_P J_d V_d(p) n^{-2/d}（i.i.d.）、R_n^* ~ J_d^* V_d^*(p) n^{-2/d}（最优多样），d = d_{Ω/G}；常数只依赖商流形几何与数据密度。等变性将有效维度由 d_Ω 降至 d_{Ω/G}，从而在 d_{Ω/G} < d_Ω 时严格改进渐近尺度（例：2D 球面非等变斜率 -1、等变斜率 -2）。i.i.d. 与最优多样数据集具有相同的渐近行为，仅需把有效样本量重标为 n_eff = (J_d^*/J_d)^{d/2} n。监督情形只给出 O(n^{-2/d}) 上界而非精确等价式（因输入-目标耦合使联合流形几何关键）。实验：合成数据集（Hypercube/Hypersphere/Swiss roll/Deformed sphere/Wave）上表示间隙严格服从预测幂律，且在 n 约 50 即进入渐近区；内在维度估计准确（立方体 d=1 估 0.95/1.07，d=5 估 4.93/5.06，球面 d=1 估 1.00/1.08，d=5 估 4.91/5.13，Swiss roll 真值 2 估 1.87/2.19）；真实数据集估计（MNIST 13、SVHN 13、CIFAR-10 18、MSCOCO 19、ImageNet 21）与 Pope 等 (2021)、Ansuini 等 (2019) 的区间一致。
AI.conclusion: 表示间隙为理解泛化提供了一个统一的几何框架：全局性质（记忆、等变、最小范数插值等）会塑造预测空间的几何结构，从而把泛化问题化为几何问题；内在维度可作为统一的几何原则，并有望指导架构与训练流程设计、支撑架构无关的知识迁移与协作学习，甚至提供基于“可教性”的信息论概念。局限包括：结论为渐近性质、仅针对精确等变与完全优化的 DDIM 类模型、依赖流形与群作用的正则性假设（常体积轨道假设可放宽）、监督预测仅得上界而缺少精确等价式。作者认为预测空间几何是理解真实任务不确定性与统计学习内在极限的有前景方向。

title: Pattern-and-root inflectional morphology: the Arabic broken plural
summary: We present a substantially implemented model of description of the inflectional morphology of Arabic nouns, with special attention to the management of dictionaries and other language resources by Arabic-speaking linguists. The breakthrough lies in the reversal of the traditional root-and-pattern Semitic model into pattern-and-root, giving precedence to patterns over roots. Our model includes broken plurals (BPs), i.e. plurals formed by modifying the stem. It is based on the traditional notions of root and pattern of Semitic morphology. However, as compared to traditional Arabic morphology, it keeps the formal description of inflection separate from that of derivation and semantics. As traditional Arabic dictionaries, the updatable dictionary is structured in lexical entries for lemmas, and the reference spelling is fully diacritized. In our model, morphological analysis of Arabic text is performed directly with a dictionary of words and without morphophonological rules. Our taxonomy for noun inflection is simple, orderly and detailed. We simplify the taxonomy of singular patterns by specifying vowel quantity as v or vv, and ignoring vowel quality. Root alternations and orthographical variations are encoded independently from patterns and in a factual way, without deep roots or morphophonological or orthographical rules. Nouns with a triliteral BP are classified according to 22 patterns subdivided into 90 classes, and nouns with a quadriliteral BP according to 3 patterns subdivided into 70 classes. These 160 classes become 300 inflectional classes when we take into account inflectional variations that affect only the singular. We provide a straightforward encoding scheme that we applied to 3 200 entries of BP nouns.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a pattern-and-root model for Arabic noun inflectional morphology that reverses the traditional Semitic approach. By prioritizing patterns over roots and separating inflection from derivation/semantics, the model achieves a simple, orderly taxonomy with 160 classes (expanded to 300 with inflectional variations) and has been implemented with 3,200 BP noun entries.
AI.motivation: The traditional root-and-pattern model of Semitic morphology is insufficient for managing dictionaries and language resources by Arabic-speaking linguists. The breakthrough needed is reversing the traditional model to give precedence to patterns over roots.
AI.method: The model reverses the traditional root-and-pattern Semitic model into pattern-and-root, giving precedence to patterns over roots. It keeps formal inflection description separate from derivation and semantics. Morphological analysis is performed directly with a word dictionary without morphophonological rules. Root alternations and orthographical variations are encoded independently from patterns in a factual manner.
AI.result: Nouns with triliteral BP are classified into 22 patterns subdivided into 90 classes; quadriliteral BP into 3 patterns subdivided into 70 classes. These yield 160 classes or 300 inflectional classes when accounting for singular-only variations. The taxonomy simplifies singular patterns by specifying vowel quantity (v or vv) and ignoring vowel quality.
AI.conclusion: The model provides a straightforward encoding scheme that has been applied to 3,200 entries of BP nouns, demonstrating practical feasibility of the pattern-and-root approach.

title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents are shaped not only by their language models, but also by the runtime harness that mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control. While existing agent adaptation methods mainly update model parameters, many failures in deterministic, rule-governed domains stem from mismatches at the model--environment interface. We propose Life-Harness, a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents without changing model weights or evaluation environments. Life-Harness evolves from training trajectories by converting recurring interaction failures into reusable interventions across environment contracts, procedural skills, action realization, and trajectory regulation, and remains fixed during held-out evaluation. On seven deterministic environments from $τ$-bench, $τ^2$-bench, and AgentBench, Life-Harness improves 116 out of 126 model--environment settings across 18 model backbones, with an average relative improvement of 88.5%. Harnesses evolved only from Qwen3-4B-Instruct trajectories transfer to 17 other models, showing that Life-Harness captures reusable environment-side structure rather than model-specific behavior. These results position runtime interface adaptation as a complementary alternative to model-centric agent training. Code is available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: Life-Harness通过运行时接口适配而非模型参数更新来改进LLM智能体，在18个模型上实现88.5%平均相对提升，证明运行时干预可跨模型迁移并捕获可复用的环境结构。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体适配方法主要更新模型参数，但在确定性、规则治理领域中，许多失败源于模型-环境界面的不匹配，而非模型本身的能力不足。
AI.method: Life-Harness是一个生命周期感知的运行时harness，通过训练轨迹演化，将 recurring交互失败转化为跨环境契约、程序技能、动作实现和轨迹调控四个维度的可复用干预措施，且在评估时保持固定。
AI.result: 在7个确定性环境中覆盖126个模型-环境设置，116个获得改进；18个模型骨架上平均相对改进达88.5%；从Qwen3-4B-Instruct演化出的harness可迁移至其他17个模型。
AI.conclusion: Life-Harness证明了运行时接口适配是与模型中心化训练互补的替代方案，具有良好的跨模型迁移能力。

title: X-Token: Projection-Guided Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation
summary: Cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation allows a student model to learn from teachers with incompatible vocabularies. Prior work operates on hidden states or logits; the latter is preferred as a drop-in replacement requiring no auxiliary components. Logit-based methods either use only the correct-token probability, missing the full 'dark knowledge' in the teacher's distribution, or operate on the full output distribution, relying on strict token partitioning and/or unprincipled heuristic ranking. We identify two key shortcomings of full-distribution, logit-based methods: (i) an uncommon-token failure, where critical tokens fall into the unmatched subset (e.g., Llama's 1100 multi-digit numerals under digit-splitting Qwen supervision) and are suppressed during training, reducing GSM8k from 12.89 to 2.56 compared to same-tokenizer KD from a weaker teacher; and (ii) over-conservative matching, where strict 1-to-1 matching excludes near-equivalent tokens across surface forms. These failures require distinct remedies: eliminating the partition when critical tokens are misaligned, and refining it when alignment is reliable. We propose X-Token, an approach with two complementary loss formulations targeting these issues. P-KL removes partitioning and aligns the student's distribution with the teacher's via a sparse projection matrix W (initialized from tokenizer-level string rules) to address the uncommon-token failure. H-KL retains the hybrid form while relaxing matching to align each student token with its top-ranked teacher mapping under W. Both objectives share W and extend naturally to multiple teachers. Empirically, on Llama-3.2-1B, X-Token outperforms the current state of the art GOLD by +3.82 average points with a Qwen3-4B teacher and by +0.5 with a Phi-4-Mini teacher. Further, a two-teacher setup (Phi-4-mini + Llama-3B) improves over single-teacher distillation by +1.3 points.

AI.tldr: X-Token 是一种面向跨分词器（cross-tokenizer）知识蒸馏的 logits 蒸馏方法，核心是一个由字符串规则初始化的稀疏投影矩阵 W，用于桥接学生与教师词表；针对 GOLD 的两类失效模式提出互补的两种损失 P-KL（去分区、直接投影对齐）与 H-KL（保留分区、放宽匹配），并支持跨词表族多教师蒸馏。在 Llama-3.2-1B 上，相比 SOTA 的 GOLD，Qwen3-4B 教师平均 +3.82 分、Phi-4-mini 教师 +0.5 分；Phi-4-mini + Llama-3B 双教师再提升 +1.3 分。
AI.motivation: 标准 KD 依赖共享分词器，使固定分词器的实践者无法利用更强或跨族教师（如 Llama-3.2-1B 无法蒸馏 Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini），也难以做跨族多教师融合。现有的 logit 分布类跨分词器方法（ULD、GOLD）存在两个结构性缺陷：(1)「uncommon-token failure」——分词粒度不一致时（如 Qwen 把多位数拆成单数字、Llama 把「1100」整体成词）关键 token 落入未匹配子集 U，受到 rank-based L1 的身份无关噪声与 common-KL 项通过全词表 softmax 归一化产生的抑制性梯度（附录 Proposition 1 给出 ∂L_common/∂z_j = p_S[j]·M_C(T) ≥ 0 的证明），导致 GSM8k 从同分词器弱教师的 12.89 跌至 2.56；(2)「over-conservative matching」——严格字符串相等的一对一匹配过于保守，排除了表面形式不同但语义等价的 token 对（如学生 Hundreds 对应教师 Hund+reds）。两类失效需要不同补救：当关键 token 错位时应消除分区，当对齐可靠时应细化分区。
AI.method: 整体三部分：(1) 序列对齐——确定性 DP span alignment，把师生 token 序列切成解码为同一文本的 chunk 对 { (A^S_k, A^T_k) }，并用 chain-rule merge 得到 chunk 级分布，DP 采用软打分（α_exact=3, α_comb=1.5, α_gap=−1.5），可避免 TRL 表面子串对齐在 BOS 不对称等情形下产生「超级组」；(2) 投影矩阵 W ∈ R^{|V_S|×|V_T|}——两遍确定性构造：canonicalized 精确匹配赋权 1；多 token 规则（教师侧重分词，跨度 ≤4）按 βγ^i (β=0.9, γ=0.1) 赋权，每行截断 top-4 并归一化；canonical 规则统一 Ġ/_/␣ 空格前缀、Ċ/\n 换行、byte-fallback <0xHH>、前导空白+标点、特殊 token 角色映射；每行非负且和为 1，使 Wᵀp_S 为教师词表上的合法分布（概率保性证明）。(3) 两种损失：P-KL 取消分区，用 p̃_S = Wᵀp̂_S 把学生分布投影到教师词表，直接计算 KL(p̂_T ‖ p̃_S)，为 U 中关键 token（如 201→[2,0,1]）恢复监督；H-KL 保留 hybrid 结构，但按 t* = argmax_t W[s,t] 把每个学生 token 的 top-1 教师映射加入公共集 C（扩展 C，超出严格字符串相等），再在扩展后的 C 上做 common-KL + ULD。此外支持多教师聚合 L = Σ α_m · (1/|K_m|) Σ_k L_{*,m}^(k)（同分词器教师用标准 token 级 KL），以及动态 KD/CE 缩放 L = sg(L_CE/L_KD)·L_KD + L_CE。P-KL 下 W 可与学生联合学习（LR 1e-2），H-KL 下固定。损失模式由「覆盖率审计」选择：按字符类别（数字位数、字母、标点、非 ASCII）统计其在 C 中的留存率，关键 token 落入 U 时用 P-KL，否则用 H-KL。
AI.result: 主要结果（Llama-3.2-1B 学生，3-shot，MMLU/GSM8k/MATH/Winogrande/HellaSwag 平均）：基线 Llama-1B 33.96，继续预训练无教师 36.63，同分词器 KD（Llama-3B→1B）38.40。跨分词器单教师：Qwen-4B 上 ULD 36.77、GOLD 35.03（GSM8k 仅 2.56，甚至低于无教师），X-Token P-KL 达 38.85（+3.82 vs GOLD，GSM8k 2.56→15.54，6.07×，并超过同族 KD 的 12.89），且比 ULD 高 +2.08；Phi-mini 上 GOLD 38.66、ULD 38.31，X-Token H-KL 达 39.18（+0.52）。多教师：Phi-mini + Llama-3B 达 40.48（比单教师 +1.3，比同族参考 +2.1），而 Phi-mini + Qwen-4B 仅 38.49，说明教师互补性（数学 vs 常识）比权重调节更关键；加第三个 Qwen 为 40.15，数学略降而常识微升。消融：P-KL/H-KL 在两教师上排序反转（Qwen +3.55 偏好 P-KL，Phi +1.68 偏好 H-KL），证实按分词器选择损失的必要；联合学习 W 优于冻结（38.85 vs 38.37，5/6 列胜）；动态 KD/CE 缩放略优于三种固定权重；多教师静态权重（偏向更强者，0.2/0.8）优于 CE/entropy/max-prob 三种自适应方案。
AI.conclusion: 跨分词器 KD 的关键是同时处理序列错位与词表错位：确定性 DP 对齐保证文本一致的 chunk 单位，规则初始化（可联合精炼）的稀疏投影矩阵 W 提供跨词表的确定性对齐，而按分词器错位类型自适应选择的 P-KL / H-KL 两种损失分别解决「关键 token 落在未匹配集」与「匹配过保守」两类失效，并使跨词表族多教师蒸馏成为可能。实证上 X-Token 一致优于 SOTA（GOLD）：Qwen3-4B +3.8、Phi-4-mini +0.5，多教师最高额外 +1.3。局限：仅在 Llama-3.2-1B 持续预训练下评测了有限的教师对；指令微调/偏好对齐模型、更大学生模型、低重叠词表族（SentencePiece、BPE、byte-level）以及用域条件路由替代静态多教师权重仍待研究。

title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
summary: Public transit route planning traditionally depends on structured map infrastructure and complex routing engines, and no existing dataset supports training models to bypass this dependency. We present TransitLM, a large-scale dataset of over 13 million transit route planning records from four Chinese cities covering 120,845 stations and 13,666 lines, released as a continual pre-training corpus and benchmark data for three evaluation tasks with complementary metrics. Experiments show that an LLM trained on TransitLM produces structurally valid routes at high accuracy and implicitly grounds arbitrary GPS coordinates to appropriate stations without any explicit mapping. These results demonstrate that transit route planning can be learned entirely from data, enabling end-to-end, map-free route generation directly from origin-destination information. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/GD-ML/TransitLM, with evaluation code at https://github.com/HotTricker/TransitLM.

AI.tldr: TransitLM是一个大规模公交路线规划数据集（1300万+记录），证明了LLM可以通过数据学习公交路线规划，实现无需地图基础设施的端到端路线生成。
AI.motivation: 传统公交路线规划依赖于结构化地图基础设施和复杂的路径引擎，且尚无现有数据集支持训练模型来绕过这一依赖。
AI.method: 提出TransitLM，一个大规模数据集，包含来自四个中国城市的超过1300万条公交路线规划记录，覆盖120,845个站点和13,666条线路，作为持续预训练语料库和三个评估任务的基准数据发布。
AI.result: 实验表明，在TransitLM上训练的LLM能够高精度生成结构有效的路线，并在没有任何显式映射的情况下隐式地将任意GPS坐标对应到合适的站点。
AI.conclusion: TransitLM数据集证明了公交路线规划可以完全从数据中学习，实现端到端的、无需地图的路线生成，直接从起终点信息输出结果。

title: Measuring Cross-Modal Synergy: A Benchmark for VLM Explainability
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) map complex visual inputs to semantic spaces, but interpreting the cross-modal reasoning of VLMs currently relies on post-hoc explainers evaluated via unimodal perturbation metrics. We expose a limitation in this paradigm: because multimodal datasets contain language priors and modality biases, VLMs frequently exhibit cross-modal redundancy, allowing them to answer visual queries using text alone. Consequently, unimodal metrics penalize faithful explainers, triggering an evaluation collapse where visual and textual rankings fundamentally contradict each other. %(Kendall's $τ= -0.06$). To resolve this, we introduce Synergistic Faithfulness ($\mathcal{F}_{syn}$), a scalable metric rooted in the Shapley Interaction Index that strictly isolates the joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities, serving as a highly accurate surrogate ($ρ= 0.92$) while achieving a $24\times$ computational speedup. Evaluating 8 distinct XAI methods across 3 VLM architectures and 3 benchmark datasets, reveals that explainers proposed for VLMs heavily over-index on visual salience and significantly underperform adapted attention-based methods in capturing true cross-modal synergy. By decoupling visual plausibility from cross-modal faithfulness, this work provides a rigorous evaluation framework required to safely audit VLM reasoning in high-stakes deployments.

AI.tldr: Problem: Current VLM explainability metrics suffer from "evaluation collapse" due to cross-modal redundancy in VLMs. Solution: Proposed Synergistic Faithfulness metric (F_syn) based on Shapley Interaction Index. Finding: VLM-specific explainers over-rely on visual features; adapted attention-based methods better capture cross-modal synergy.
AI.motivation: Current post-hoc explainers for VLMs are evaluated via unimodal perturbation metrics, but these fail because multimodal datasets contain language priors and modality biases. VLMs exhibit cross-modal redundancy, allowing them to answer visual queries using text alone. This causes unimodal metrics to penalize faithful explainers, triggering evaluation collapse with contradictory visual/textual rankings (Kendall's τ=-0.06).
AI.method: Introduced Synergistic Faithfulness (F_syn), a scalable metric based on Shapley Interaction Index that isolates joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities. Evaluated 8 XAI methods across 3 VLM architectures and 3 benchmark datasets.
AI.result: F_syn achieves high accuracy as a surrogate (ρ=0.92) with 24× computational speedup. VLM-specific explainers heavily over-index on visual salience and underperform adapted attention-based methods in capturing true cross-modal synergy.
AI.conclusion: This work establishes a rigorous evaluation framework for safely auditing VLM reasoning in high-stakes deployments by decoupling visual plausibility from cross-modal faithfulness.

title: TBP-mHC: full expressivity for manifold-constrained hyper connections through transportation polytopes
summary:
Hyper-Connections (HC) improve residual networks by introducing learnable mixing across multiple residual streams, but unconstrained mixing leads to training instability. Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) address this by enforcing approximate double stochasticity via Sinkhorn normalization, while mHC-lite ensures exact constraints through convex combinations of permutation matrices at the cost of factorial complexity. KromHC reduces this cost using Kronecker-product parameterizations, but restricts the mixing matrices to a structured submanifold of the Birkhoff polytope .
  We propose Transportation Birkhoff Polytope (TBP) parameterizations and their Recursive variants (RTBP), which construct exactly doubly stochastic mixing matrices with $(n-1)^2$ degrees of freedom. Our approach avoids iterative normalization and combinatorial explosion while preserving full expressivity of the Birkhoff polytope. Empirical results on language model pre-training' demonstrate competitive performance with improved stability and scalability.

AI.tldr: 作者提出Transportation Birkhoff Polytope (TBP)及其递归变体RTBP，将双随机混合矩阵的参数复杂度从阶乘降低到O((n-1)²)，同时保持 Birkhoff 多面体的完全表达能力，无需迭代归一化，在语言模型预训练中展现出竞争力。
AI.motivation: Existing Hyper-Connection (HC) methods suffer from training instability due to unconstrained mixing. While mHC-lite ensures exact constraints via convex combinations of permutation matrices, it incurs factorial complexity. KromHC reduces cost but restricts mixing matrices to a structured submanifold, limiting expressivity.
AI.method: The authors propose Transportation Birkhoff Polytope (TBP) parameterizations and their Recursive variants (RTBP), which construct exactly doubly stochastic mixing matrices using (n-1)^2 degrees of freedom through a novel parameterization approach that avoids iterative normalization.
AI.result: Empirical results on language model pre-training demonstrate competitive performance with improved stability and scalability compared to prior approaches.
AI.conclusion: TBP and RTBP provide a scalable and stable alternative for hyper-connection mixing, achieving full expressivity of the Birkhoff polytope without iterative normalization or combinatorial explosion.

title: Modeling Pathology-Like Behavioral Patterns in Language Models Through Behavioral Fine-Tuning
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used as computational tools for modeling human-like behavior. We introduce a behavioral induction framework that modifies model policies through fine-tuning on structured decision-making tasks: using synthetic datasets inspired by maladaptive behavioral patterns, including depression and paranoia, we train transformer-based language models to consistently select specific classes of actions across diverse contexts. We then test whether this behavioral optimization produces systematic changes in generative distributions.
  Across two architectures, fine-tuned models show stable, context-general shifts in next-token probability distributions, including increased probability assigned to negative and threat-related interpretations in open-ended language tasks. These effects generalize beyond training contexts and are detectable in qualitative completions, psychometric-style evaluations, and quantitative distributional metrics such as Jensen-Shannon divergence.
  Induced behavioral profiles also show partial specificity. Models optimized for different behavioral patterns exhibit dissociable response tendencies across evaluation probes, suggesting that structured behavioral training produces differentiated policy-level biases rather than generic distributional skew.
  We interpret these findings as evidence that consistent behavioral optimization in LLMs can generate stable behavioral and distributional patterns consistent with altered latent priors, linking action selection and language generation. More broadly, the results support a view of LLMs as policy-based systems in which behavioral constraints shape emergent representational structure, highlighting their potential as controlled testbeds for studying the relationship between behavior, interpretation, and generative language in computational models of cognition.

AI.tldr: 研究通过在模拟抑郁、偏执等行为模式的合成数据集上微调Transformer语言模型，证明行为优化可产生稳定且泛化的分布偏移和差异化反应倾向，支持将LLM作为基于策略的认知计算模型的观点。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型能否通过行为优化产生一致的、稳定的行为和分布模式，并检验这些模式是否与altered latent priors一致，从而为认知计算研究提供受控实验平台。
AI.method: 通过行为归纳框架微调Transformer语言模型：使用基于抑郁、偏执等适应不良行为模式生成的合成数据集进行训练，然后在多样化情境中测试模型行为，包括开放式语言任务、定性补全、心理测量式评估及Jensen-Shannon散度等定量分布指标。
AI.result: 微调模型在下一token概率分布上呈现稳定、跨情境的偏移，对负面和威胁相关解读的概率增加。效应泛化至训练情境之外，可通过多种方式检测。不同行为模式优化产生的模型表现出可区分的反应倾向。
AI.conclusion: LLMs可被视为基于策略的系统，其中行为约束塑造了涌现的表征结构。这项研究为使用语言模型作为认知计算模型提供了新的视角，支持将行为、解释与生成语言联系起来的研究框架。

title: LLM-Metrics: Measuring Research Impact Through Large Language Model Memory
summary: Citation counts remain the dominant metric for assessing research impact, yet they suffer from well-documented limitations: temporal lag, disciplinary bias, and Matthew effects. Here we propose LLM-Metrics, a research-impact assessment metric derived from the parametric memory of large language models (LLMs). The central hypothesis is that high-impact papers receive greater exposure in the academic community, that this exposure enters LLM training data in textual form, and that models consequently form stronger parametric memory of these papers. We designed four types of multiple-choice probes, covering title recognition, author recognition, method recognition, and venue recognition, and evaluated 549 computer science papers published in 2023-2024 across 17 LLMs spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters from six vendors. Of the 17 models, 15 produced positive predictions, 9 of which were significant at p less than 0.05, with an overall Spearman correlation of rho = 0.1495 and p = 0.0004 against citation counts. Three additional findings support the proposed mechanism. First, the predictive signal was stronger for 2024 papers, rho = 0.1880, whose citation counts were near zero at model-training time, reducing the plausibility of a simple reverse-causality explanation. Second, author-recognition probes showed the strongest discriminative power, consistent with an exposure-driven memory mechanism. Third, model scale and predictive power were non-monotonic: a 3B-parameter model, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, with rho = 0.1829, outperformed most larger models, supporting a selective-memory hypothesis in which the limited capacity of smaller models can serve as an effective information filter. LLM-Metrics offers a real-time, cross-disciplinary, citation-independent paradigm for research assessment.

AI.tldr: 研究团队提出LLM-Metrics，利用大语言模型的参数记忆来评估研究影响力。基于核心假设：高影响力论文在学术社区中获得更多曝光，进而进入LLM训练数据并形成更强的参数记忆。实验在17个LLM（0.5B-72B参数）和549篇CS论文上进行，证明了该方法的有效性（总体rho=0.1495, p=0.0004），同时揭示了模型规模与预测能力呈非单调关系。
AI.motivation: Citation counts, while dominant, suffer from well-documented limitations including temporal lag, disciplinary bias, and Matthew effects. There's a need for a real-time, cross-disciplinary, citation-independent assessment metric for research impact.
AI.method: Four types of multiple-choice probes (title, author, method, and venue recognition) were designed and evaluated across 17 LLMs (0.5B to 72B parameters) from six vendors, testing 549 computer science papers published in 2023-2024. Statistical analysis used Spearman correlation against citation counts.
AI.result: Of 17 models, 15 produced positive predictions (9 significant at p<0.05). Overall Spearman correlation: rho=0.1495, p=0.0004. Stronger signal for 2024 papers (rho=0.1880), author-recognition probes showed strongest discriminative power. Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (3B parameters) outperformed larger models with rho=0.1829.
AI.conclusion: LLM-Metrics provides a real-time, cross-disciplinary, citation-independent paradigm for research assessment. The approach leverages parametric memory of LLMs as an alternative metric for evaluating research impact, addressing limitations of traditional citation-based metrics.

title: I-SAFE: Wasserstein Coherence Metrics for Structural Auditing of Scientific AI Models
summary: Deep learning models are increasingly used in scientific prediction tasks where strong benchmark performance is often interpreted as evidence of scientifically meaningful behavior. This interpretation is fragile, as models may exploit shortcut features, dataset-specific regularities, or distributional biases that are predictive on held-out data but not aligned with domain-relevant structure. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textsc{I-SAFE} (Interventional Secure, Accurate, Fair and Explainable) framework, a post-hoc distributional auditing framework for scientific AI models centered on the Wasserstein Coherence Metric (WCM). Given a trained black-box predictor and an external structural prior encoding domain knowledge about task-relevant input structure, \textsc{I-SAFE} evaluates raw model outputs under structurally guided perturbations of the input. The proposed audit measures output-distribution coherence through three complementary metrics: a Quantile-Based Metric (QBM) for location-level coherence, the WCM for ordinal coherence, and a translation-invariant WCM variant for shape coherence. We instantiate \textsc{I-SAFE} on drug--target interaction (DTI) prediction using the Davis kinase benchmark, KLIFS (Kinase--Ligand Interaction Fingerprints and Structures) binding-pocket annotations, and three sequence-based DTI models: DeepConvDTI, DeepDTA, and TAPB.
