Although the models operate in a comparable predictive regime, \textsc{I-SAFE} reveals substantially different distributional response profiles, a distinction invisible to accuracy-based evaluation. The framework is model-agnostic and applicable to any domain where inputs admit a structured decomposition and an external prior is available.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出I-SAFE框架，通过Wasserstein Coherence Metric评估科学AI模型在结构引导扰动下的输出分布一致性，以检测模型是否真正学习到领域相关结构而非利用快捷特征。在DTI预测任务上的实验表明，基于准确率的评估会掩盖模型间本质差异，而I-SAFE能够揭示这些差异。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习模型在科学预测任务中表现出高基准性能，但这种高性能可能源于模型利用了快捷特征、数据集特定规律或分布偏差，而非真正捕捉到领域相关的结构。这导致强基准性能被脆弱地解读为科学有意义行为的证据。
AI.method: I-SAFE框架通过Wasserstein Coherence Metric (WCM)为核心，采用后验分布审计策略。在给定黑盒预测器和外部结构先验的条件下，对输入进行结构引导扰动，评估模型输出的分布一致性。框架使用三个互补指标：QBM（分位数度量）评估位置级一致性，WCM评估序数一致性，翻译不变WCM变体评估形状一致性。
AI.result: 在药物-靶标相互作用(DTI)预测任务上，使用Davis激酶基准、KLIFS结合位点注释和三种序列模型（DeepConvDTI、DeepDTA、TAPB）进行验证。结果显示，尽管模型在传统精度指标上表现相当，但I-SAFE揭示了显著不同的分布响应特征，这些差异在传统基于准确率的评估中完全不可见。
AI.conclusion: I-SAFE框架是模型无关的，适用于任何具有结构化输入分解和外部先验的领域，为科学AI模型的可靠性评估提供了新范式。

title: Multi-Stage Training for Abusive Comment Detection in Indic Languages
summary: In recent years social media has become an increasingly popular tool for communication. People use it to share their ideas, exchange information, and discuss thoughts. Given its prevalence and widespread reach, social media must remain a safe space for people. Content generated on social media can be abusive and it has become increasingly important to detect such content. In this paper, we use a language-based preprocessing and an ensemble of several models and analyze their performance of abusive comment detection. Through extensive experimentation, we propose a pipeline that minimizes the false-positive rate (marking non-abusive as abusive) so that these systems can detect abusive comments without undermining the freedom of expression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套用于社交媒体辱骂评论检测的集成式流程：先做基于语言的预处理，再融合多个模型（集成），通过大量实验将系统调优为"低假阳性率"版本，从而在识别辱骂内容的同时避免过度审查、不过度损害言论自由。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为大众交流、分享观点与信息的主要平台，其普及性与广泛触达要求它保持"安全空间"。然而平台上产生的评论可能包含辱骂、攻击性内容，因此自动检测此类内容变得愈发重要。现有检测系统普遍存在假阳性率高的问题——将正常评论误判为辱骂，会造成对用户言论的过度审查与误伤，损害表达自由；因此需要在保持召回（检出率）的同时压低假阳性率。
AI.method: 采用"语言驱动的预处理 + 多模型集成"的技术路线：预处理阶段针对社交媒体文本（口语化、缩写、噪声、变体拼写、表情/提及符号等）进行语言相关的规范化与特征处理；随后将若干不同类型的分类模型（如基于词袋/词性的传统机器学习模型与神经网络类模型）组合成集成，以提升鲁棒性与稳定性；在包含大量带标注社交媒体评论数据上做广泛实验，分析各组件与超参数对精确率/召回率/假阳性率的影响，据此选择以假阳性率为主要优化目标的集成与阈值配置。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的预处理加集成流程在辱骂评论检测任务上能够有效识别攻击性内容，同时显著降低将非辱骂内容误标为辱骂的比例（假阳性率），优于单独使用的单个模型与未做语言预处理的结果；消融实验显示语言预处理与集成策略各自对降低误报有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献不是提出全新的模型架构，而是一套面向实际部署的、可调的端到端检测流程：结合语言预处理与多模型集成，在保持较高检出能力的前提下把假阳性率压到可接受水平。作者强调，检测系统的评估与优化不应只看准确率，还需关注假阳性带来的"寒蝉效应"与对表达自由的损害；该流程可作为社交媒体平台内容审核的实用基线与参考实现。

title: Skill Weaving: Efficient LLM Improvement via Modular Skillpacks
summary: Large language models increasingly require specialization across diverse domains, yet existing approaches struggle to balance multi-domain capacities with strict memory and inference constraints. In this work, we introduce SkillWeave, a modular improvement framework that enables LLMs to specialize under fixed memory budgets. SkillWeave partitions full capabilities of a general-purpose model into skillpacks -- lightweight, domain-specific delta modules -- that reorganize and refine the model's internal knowledge. For efficient deployment, SkillWeave integrates SkillZip to compress skillpacks into compact and inference-ready format, enabling strong multi-domain performance with low-latency execution. On multi-task and agentic benchmarks, a 9B SkillWeave model outperforms several baselines and even surpasses a 32B monolithic LLM, while achieving up to 4x speedup.

AI.tldr: SkillWeave 提出"先全参数微调、后量化压缩"的模块化自改进框架：把通用模型拆成多个域专属的 skillpack（低秩+低比特 delta 模块），共享骨干常驻、推理时按域路由激活单个 skillpack。以 Llama-3.1-8B 为骨干的 10B SkillWeave 在数学/代码/对话/推理四域基准上整体最优（MATH 62.5、HumanEval 75.0、IFEval 79.1、ARC-C 88.6），超过 Gemma2-27B、Qwen2-57B 等更大开源模型与融合/路由类基线；在 AgentBench 场景下（7B 骨干+5×0.5B skillpack）相对 32B 单体模型推理加速 4.2×、相对 5×7B 部署加速 5.5×，性能差距分别仅在 5% 与 3% 以内。
AI.motivation: 大模型应用场景日益异构，单一"巨型"模型难以同时在多个领域保持高水平，实践中被迫维护多个专用模型；而直接换用更大通用模型又会带来不可接受的显存与推理延迟开销。同时，现有两条路线各有缺陷：全参数微调容量高但存储/推理开销过大；LoRA 等 PEFT 轻量却常无法保留足够的领域能力（且直接作用于低秩 delta 的压缩方法准确率偏低）。此外，单体模型把各领域纠缠在同一参数空间中，实验测得不同任务 delta 的余弦相似度仅 0.29、符号一致性 -0.15，存在严重的任务干扰与灾难性遗忘。作者由此提出核心问题：如何在固定的显存与延迟预算下，用最少资源维持多领域性能？
AI.method:
三阶段流水线。
(1) Skillpack 构建（自特化）：把种子指令集划分为 K 个不相交子集 {D_1..D_K} 对应任务（对话/推理/数学/代码/搜索）；用基座模型自生成候选响应；用逐域"规则化验证"把生成数据二分为 helpful(+)/harmful(-) 偏好对——数学用正则抽取最终答案与真值精确匹配，代码在沙箱执行并比对参考输出、检测异常与死循环，推理结合答案正确性与启发式过滤（过短/冗长/结构化程度），对话用结构化约束校验 + 两个奖励模型（Mistral-7B-DPA、ArmoRM-Llama3-8B）集成打分并截去 10/90 百分位离群值，Agent 任务直接复用官方评测规则；随后对每个任务独立做 online DPO（TRL，LN-DPO 目标，beta 5~12，分任务学习率/epoch）得到 Δ_k，作为"proto-skillpack"。
(2) SkillZip 压缩：先用模型融合提取共享知识 Δ_shared=Merge([Δ_1..Δ_k]) 回填骨干并从各 Δ_i 中减掉，使骨干获得通用能力、delta 更稀疏更任务化；再对 delta 做"全量化"压缩——权重与激活同时量化（W≈AB 的截断 SVD 低秩分解 + 静态 k-bit 量化），在 INT8/INT4 张量核上直接计算，无需运行时反量化；提出"双重平滑"抑制离群值：①通道级平滑（受 SmoothQuant 启发，按域学习逐通道缩放向量 s，把量化难度从激活迁移到权重，且因 X/A/B 三者分担而比 SmoothQuant 更激进）；②秩级平滑（截断 SVD 后能量集中于头部奇异向量，用正交旋转矩阵 Q 令 A_rot=AQ、B_rot=Q^T B 均匀分散能量，实践上随机采样 10 个候选取量化损失最小者）；量化粒度受硬件约束（FP16 缩放只能施加于 INT8 矩阵乘的内外维度，故 X 用 per-token/per-tensor、A 用 per-tensor、B 用 per-tensor/per-channel），最终再用 GPTQ 收尾。
(3) Skillpack 集成与部署：骨干常驻激活，按域分组 token 动态调用对应 skillpack，Output_i = X_i W + X̂_i Â_i B̂_i；推理路径为"平滑+量化→INT8 GEMM→INT32 截断至 INT8→第二次 INT8 GEMM→融合反量化"，全部缩放因子预计算；路由为域级而非 token 级：Agent 工具调用场景域天然已知（确定性路由），通用任务则训练 Qwen2.5-0.5B + 线性头的域分类器（6 万条标注、3 epoch、约 1 小时），每请求只跑一次，延迟开销可忽略。
AI.result: 通用能力（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 骨干，约 10B 参数）：GSM8k 91.0 / MATH 62.5 / HumanEval 75.0 / MBPP 77.8 / AlpacaEval2 52.8 / IFEval 79.1 / BBH 76.2 / ARC-C 88.6，四域中三项第一；超过 Gemma2-27B-it（MATH +8.1）、Qwen2-57B、Qwen2.5-14B，并优于模型融合（Ties/PCB-Merging）、路由类（Self-MoE、LoRA-MoE、Twin-Merging）、多教师蒸馏（FuseLLM/FuseChat3.0）、联合/顺序多任务学习等基线，领先幅度 1.2~10 分。消融：优于 PEFT、较 ASVD 高约 30%、较 DeltaCome 在 8 项中胜 5 项、较 Self-Specialization/Self-Rewarding 高 3~11 分（如 MATH +11、BBH +7.9）。SkillZip 保真度：X8A8B8 平均 59.8 vs 目标模型 60.0（基座 50.8），较 DeltaCome +2%、BitDelta +12%、ASVD +15%；kernel 级 1.38× 快于 DeltaCome、1.04× 快于 S-LoRA；消融显示 merge+smooth+rotate 全组合较基础量化平均 +2.1；INT8 优化 kernel 延迟显著低于 FP16 路径（batch1 解码 0.0558ms vs 0.1167ms，CUDA Graph 0.0271ms）。Agent 场景（Qwen2.5-7B 骨干 + 5×0.5B skillpack，共 9.5B）：相比 32B 单体加速 4.2×、相比 5×7B 部署加速 5.5×，性能与 5×7B 差距 3% 内、与 32B 差距 5% 内。路由模型各域准确率/精确率/召回率均 >0.999，FPR/FNR <0.001，学得路由与 oracle 路由的下游分数几乎一致（MATH 62.5 vs 62.3）。小模型 Llama-3.2-1B（1.42B）上同样优于同规模基线，但低于依赖强教师的 FuseChat3.0。
AI.conclusion: SkillWeave 通过"能力分解—共享合并—低比特压缩—按需路由"的完整链条，证明了模块化技能组合能在固定显存/延迟预算下实现优于更大单体模型的多领域能力，且仅依赖自生成数据与规则化验证（无需外部教师），是自改进 LLM 与 delta 压缩方向的有效结合；SkillZip 通过权重-激活全量化与双重平滑解决了离群值与硬件算子约束的冲突，实现了延迟与保真度的更优折中。局限在于：实验主要基于边界清晰的既定基准，开放式或弱定义任务（含混合域 agent 工作流）尚未验证；规则化验证依赖逐域正确性判据，难以覆盖创意写作、抽象对话等开放域场景，因而"通用能力引擎"仍需解决开放环境下的技能发现与验证问题。

title: Correcting Class Imbalance in Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Tabular Classification
summary: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have achieved exceptional performance on tabular classification tasks. However, like other classifiers, their performance can suffer under the effect of class imbalance, resulting in poor performance for rare classes. Several techniques exist which attempt to mitigate the deleterious effect of class imbalance on classification performance, but the in-context learning (ICL) dynamic of PFNs means that loss-based strategies are impossible, and other techniques are unproven. We have adapted several classical techniques addressing class imbalance and analyzed their performance on PFN classification. We observe that thresholding performs exceptionally well because of the calibration characteristics of PFNs, and downsampling performs comparably because of PFNs exceptional limited-data performance, with the additional benefit of reduced computation cost for inference.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对PFN在表格分类中的类别不平衡问题，探索了多种传统不平衡处理技术的适配方案，发现阈值调整和下采样两种方法能有效提升稀有类别的分类性能。
AI.motivation: PFN在表格分类任务中表现优异，但面临类别不平衡问题导致稀有类别性能下降；传统技术因PFN的上下文学习机制无法使用基于损失函数的策略，且其他技术效果未经证实
AI.method: 将多种传统类别不平衡处理技术（阈值调整、下采样等）适配至PFN框架并进行分析
AI.result: 阈值调整和下采样两种技术均表现良好
AI.conclusion: 阈值调整表现优异（得益于PFN的校准特性），下采样表现相当（得益于PFN的有限数据性能优势），且下采样还具有降低推理计算成本的额外好处

title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning
summary: Effectively training Large Language Models (LLMs) for complex, long-CoT reasoning is often bottlenecked by the need for massive high-quality reasoning data. Existing methods are either computationally expensive or fail to reliably distinguish high- from low-quality reasoning samples. To address this, we propose High-Entropy Sum (HES), a training-free metric that quantifies reasoning quality by summing only the entropy of the top (e.g., 0.5\%) highest-entropy tokens in each reasoning sample. We validate HES across three mainstream training paradigms: Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT), Rejection Fine-tuning (RFT), and Reinforcement Learning (RL), with extensive results demonstrating its consistent effectiveness and significantly reduced computational overhead. In SFT, training on the top 20\% HES-ranked data matches full-dataset performance, while using the lowest-HES data degrades it. In RFT, our HES-based training approach significantly outperforms baseline methods. In RL, HES-selected successful trajectories enable the model to learn strong reasoning patterns, significantly surpassing other compared methods. Our findings establish HES as a robust, training-free metric that enables a unified, effective, and efficient method for developing advanced reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HES（高熵和）指标，通过计算推理样本中最高熵token的熵值之和来评估推理质量，无需训练即可实现跨SFT/RFT/RL三种范式的高效数据筛选，显著降低计算开销并提升LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂长链推理CoT任务的LLM训练受高质量推理数据需求的瓶颈制约，现有方法计算成本高或难以可靠地区分高低质量推理样本。
AI.method: 提出High-Entropy Sum (HES)指标，仅对每个推理样本中top 0.5%最高熵token的熵值求和来量化推理质量，无需额外训练即可评估推理样本质量。
AI.result: 在SFT中，使用top 20% HES排名数据即可达到全数据集性能；在RFT中，HES方法显著优于基线；在RL中，HES选择的成功轨迹使模型学习到强推理模式。
AI.conclusion: HES作为一种无需训练的指标，能够统一、高效地支持SFT、RFT和RL三种主流训练范式，为LLM推理能力开发提供了一种计算开销低且效果显著的通用方法。

title: CLORE: Content-Level Optimization for Reasoning Efficiency
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but often produces unnecessarily long, repetitive, or semantically opaque reasoning traces. Existing efficient reasoning methods mainly regulate response length through explicit budgets or length-aware rewards, leaving intermediate reasoning content weakly supervised. We propose CLORE, a content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts. CLORE uses an external augmentation model to delete repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after the solution is established, while preserving the final answer. The resulting augmented--original pairs are optimized with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective alongside standard policy-gradient training. By restricting augmentation to correct trajectories and performing local deletion, CLORE keeps edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigates off-policy mismatch. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CLORE improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off and remains compatible with GRPO, DAPO, Training Efficient, and ThinkPrune. Content-level analyses further show that CLORE reduces repetitive reasoning, illegible content, and post-answer exploration, supporting content-level supervision as a complementary direction to length-level control.

AI.tldr: CLORE proposes a content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts through an external augmentation model to delete unnecessary reasoning content while preserving answers, combined with reference-free DPO training. Experiments show improved accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple benchmarks and compatibility with existing methods.
AI.motivation: Reinforcement learning post-training improves reasoning ability of large language models but often produces unnecessarily long, repetitive, or semantically opaque reasoning traces. Existing efficient reasoning methods mainly regulate response length through explicit budgets or length-aware rewards, leaving intermediate reasoning content weakly supervised.
AI.method: CLORE uses an external augmentation model to delete repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after the solution is established, while preserving the final answer. The augmented-original pairs are optimized with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective alongside standard policy-gradient training. By restricting augmentation to correct trajectories and performing local deletion, CLORE keeps edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigates off-policy mismatch.
AI.result: Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CLORE improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off and remains compatible with multiple training methods. Content-level analyses demonstrate that CLORE reduces repetitive reasoning, illegible content, and post-answer exploration.
AI.conclusion: CLORE remains compatible with GRPO, DAPO, Training Efficient, and ThinkPrune. Content-level supervision serves as a complementary direction to length-level control for improving reasoning efficiency.

title: Quantitative coronary calcification analysis for prediction of myocardial ischemia using non-contrast CT calcium scoring
summary: Non-contrast computed tomography calcium scoring (CTCS) is widely recognized as an effective tool for cardiovascular risk stratification. This study aimed to develop a novel machine learning framework for predicting myocardial ischemia from routine non-contrast CTCS scans using quantitative coronary calcium assessment. This study analyzed 1,375 patients who underwent both non-contrast CTCS and regadenoson stress cardiac positron emission tomography myocardial perfusion imaging within one year at University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center. A total of 74 variables, including clinical variables, Agatston score, and calcium-omics features, were evaluated. Relevant features were identified using XGBoost with Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). Predictive models were trained and evaluated using 5-fold cross-validation. Among 987 patients, 89 (9%) were positive for myocardial ischemia. The final model incorporated the Agatston score, eight calcium-omics features, and age. The proposed model achieved a precision of 98.9+/-3.0%, sensitivity of 79.2+/-8.4, and F1 score of 87.7+/-5.3%. The addition of calcium-omics features significantly improved predictive performance compared with models using clinical variables alone or clinical variables with the Agatston score (p<0.05). Interestingly, the number of calcified arteries, despite being the lowest-ranked feature based on SHAP analysis, showed the strongest association with myocardial ischemia in logistic regression analysis (odds ratio: 3.63, 95% confidence interval: 2.80-4.77, p<0.00001). We developed a machine learning approach for predicting myocardial ischemia using routinely acquired non-contrast CTCS scans. Calcium-omics features provided incremental predictive value beyond conventional risk factors and Agatston scoring and may support more accessible cardiovascular risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于机器学习的框架，利用常规非对比CT扫描预测心肌缺血。结果表明钙omics特征(而非仅Agatston评分)可显著提升预测性能，为更便捷的心血管风险评估提供了新工具。
AI.motivation: 传统非对比CT钙化评分(CTCS)用于心血管风险分层已有明确价值，但常规Agatston评分对心肌缺血的预测能力有限，需要引入更丰富的钙相关特征以提升预测精度。
AI.method: 回顾性分析1375例患者数据，使用XGBoost+SHAP进行特征选择，5折交叉验证训练预测模型，纳入74个变量(含临床、Agatston评分、钙omics)，结合逻辑回归进行关联分析。
AI.result: 987例患者中9%存在心肌缺血。模型(Agatston+8个钙omics特征+年龄)精确率98.9±3.0%，敏感性79.2±8.4%，F1 87.7±5.3%。钙omics特征显著优于仅用临床变量或临床+Agatston的模型(p<0.05)。钙化动脉数量虽SHAP排名最低，但logistic回归显示与心肌缺血最强相关(OR 3.63, 95%CI 2.80-4.77)。
AI.conclusion: 钙omics特征在常规非对比CTCS扫描中具有增量预测价值，可支持更便捷的心血管风险分层。

title: DeferMem: Query-Time Evidence Distillation via Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory QA
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents still struggle with long-term memory question answering, where answer-supporting evidence is often scattered across long conversational histories and buried in substantial irrelevant content. Existing memory systems typically process memory before future queries are known, then retrieve the resulting units based on similarity rather than their utility for answering the query. This workflow leaves downstream answerers to denoise retrieved candidates and reconstruct query-specific evidence. We present DeferMem, a long-term memory framework that decouples this problem into high-recall candidate retrieval and query-conditioned evidence distillation. DeferMem uses a lightweight segment-link structure to organize raw history and retrieve broad candidates at query time. It then applies a memory distiller trained with DistillPO, our reinforcement learning algorithm for distilling the high-recall but highly noisy candidates into a set of faithful, self-contained, and query-conditioned evidence. DistillPO formulates post-retrieval evidence distillation as a structured action comprising message selection and evidence rewriting. It optimizes this action with a decomposed-and-gated reward pipeline and structure-aligned advantage assignment, gating reward components from validity to quality checks while exposing task-level correctness feedback early and assigning each reward to its responsible output span. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, DeferMem surpasses strong baselines in QA accuracy and memory-system efficiency, achieving the highest QA accuracy with the fastest runtime and zero commercial-API token cost for memory operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeferMem，一种解耦长程记忆问答为高召回候选检索与查询条件证据蒸馏的框架。其核心贡献DistillPO算法将证据精炼建模为结构化动作，通过分解门控奖励和结构对齐优势分配实现高效训练。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统存在根本性缺陷：在查询未知时预处理记忆，检索时仅依赖相似度而非问答效用。这导致下游模型需要从大量噪声候选中重建证据。
AI.method: DeferMem框架包含两个核心阶段：(1) 基于轻量级段链接结构组织原始历史，在查询时进行高召回候选检索；(2) 使用DistillPO强化学习算法训练的记忆蒸馏器，将高噪声候选精炼为忠实、自包含且条件于查询的证据。DistillPO将证据蒸馏建模为结构化动作（消息选择+证据重写），采用分解门控奖励管道和结构对齐的优势分配，实现细粒度奖励分配。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准上，DeferMem在QA准确率和记忆系统效率上均超越强基线。
AI.conclusion: DeferMem在QA准确率和系统效率上均超越强基线模型，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上实现最高QA准确率，同时拥有最快运行速度和零商业API token成本，为长对话记忆问答提供了一种高效且经济的技术方案。

title: Towards a compositional semantics for quantitative confidence assessment in assurance arguments
comment: Accepted to the 21st European Dependable Computing Conference (EDCC 2026), Canterbury, UK
summary: Assurance arguments provide a clear and structured way to explain why stakeholders should trust that a system satisfies certain properties, yet widely used notations, e.g.Goal Structuring Notation (GSN), typically lack an operational semantics for deriving assurance confidence. Existing approaches address structure and soundness but largely reason over truth values, not over confidence in the justification of claims. Subjective Logic (SL) offers a calculus of belief, disbelief, and uncertainty with operators for combining opinions, enabling confidence propagation under incomplete, conflicting, or subjective evidence. However, existing SL-based approaches do not provide a uniform, compositional semantics that covers all argument elements and relations to enable overall confidence assessment. We propose a confidence semantics that represents argument elements as SL opinions and maps relations between elements to SL operators modelling how confidence flows, effectively turning the argument into an analyzable confidence network. The approach provides explicit warrants, principled handling of context, preserved provenance, and compatibility with GSN, along with practical guidance using an exemplary assurance confidence assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向保证论证（assurance arguments）的组合式量化置信度语义：将 GSN 等符号体系中的每个论证元素（目标、证据、假设）表示为主观逻辑（Subjective Logic, SL）的二项意见（belief/disbelief/uncertainty/base rate），并将元素之间的每条关系（supportedBy、inContextOf）映射为 SL 算子（条件演绎 ⊚、Binomial 乘法·、余乘法⊔、累积融合⊕、平均/加权融合），从而把整个论证图变成可分析的"置信度网络"，支持从底层证据到顶层声明的端到端置信度传播与二阶置信度量化，并附带一个示例性置信度评估与实践指南。
AI.motivation: 保证论证（如 GSN）只表达论证结构，缺少可操作语义来定量推导"对论证本身的信任度"（assurance confidence）。已有形式化工作（GSN 的逻辑解释、组合式安全案例模式）多在真值层面推理，无法处理不完备、冲突或主观的证据；已有的 SL 应用虽能传播信念/怀疑/不确定性，但仅覆盖部分算子与局部模式，缺少覆盖整个论证图全部元素与关系的统一、组合式语义，因而无法做整体置信度评估。此外，推理步骤的有效性（warrant）通常隐含在人工判断中，缺少显式的量化接口。
AI.method: 在二项 SL 域 X={x,¬x} 上构建语义：①支持关系建模为条件演绎 ω_C = ω_P ⊚ (ω_{C|P}, ω_{C|¬P})，条件意见对作为边的显式 warrant；②上下文关系（假设 A 附于目标 G）建模为显式条件声明 G|A，提供两种解读——条件解读（保留 ω_{G|A} 并向上传播上下文）与无条件解读（通过 ω_G = ω_A ⊚ (ω_{G|A}, ω_{G|¬A}) 边缘化"消费"假设，标记为已消费以避免上游重复折减）；③模块化组合模式：一对一（条件演绎）、一对多分为融合类（同域多源支持：累积融合 ⊕ 用于独立证据、平均融合用于相关证据、加权融合用于置信度差异）与逻辑组合类（跨域 AND 用 Binomial 乘法·、OR 用余乘法⊔）；④意见引荐：数据可得时按 r、s 与先验权重 W（常取 2）计数转换，负向条件稀疏时用高怀疑的保守先验，无数据时用校准的定性类别映射到 (b,d,u,a)；⑤四步评估流程：识别推理策略→引荐意见→传播置信度→复审迭代（通过变化 ω_{A1} 观察对 ω_{G1} 一阶/二阶置信度的影响）；⑥给出以 GSN 示例论证（合取 S1、融合 S2、析取 S3）为例的数值传播表与意见三角/Beta 分布可视化。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了一个统一、图级、组合式的 SL 置信度语义，将 GSN 论证转换为与结构同构的可分析置信度网络，具备显式 warrant、可作用域化的上下文处理、保留的溯源信息与 GSN 兼容性，为定性论证与定量置信度评估之间架起桥梁，并可与变化影响分析互补以支持 AI 系统迭代中的持续重评估。作者同时指明若干开放挑战：语义目前仅覆盖 support 与 context 关系，需扩展到 SACM 完全兼容；SL 的逻辑组合与累积融合依赖证据独立性假设（多指标共用同一数据集或模型时违背）；条件意见数量随论证复杂度增长、需结构化引荐流程；缺少 SL 意见与定性置信度等级的直观映射；实务采纳仍受"高工作量+方法指引不足"制约，需要自动化工具（如 GSN→SL 网络自动转换）以支撑持续置信度监控。

title: Models Can Model, But Can't Bind: Structured Grounding in Text-to-Optimization
summary: Text-to-optimization requires two separable capabilities: modeling -- choosing the right optimization structure -- and binding -- grounding every coefficient, index, and parameter in the concrete problem data. We study this via Text2Opt-Bench, a scalable benchmark of solver-verified optimization problems spanning 12 categories, from textbook linear programs to stochastic and multi-objective formulations with up to thousands of variables. Across 10+ models, we find that accuracy collapses as instance data grows, even when the formulation itself is simple. We call this the effective binding limit. We address this via a simple inference-time approach, BIND, which externalizes numeric data to structured files so the model binds data programmatically rather than transcribing from the prompt. BIND improves GPT-5-Nano from 59.1% to 82.4% accuracy, matching pass@5 (82.0%) at lower token cost than pass@1, and GPT-5 from 86.2% to 95.8%. Furthermore, we validate our hypothesis by finetuning a model exclusively on binding and show that it outperforms end-to-end SFT and RL across three structurally distinct optimization categories, with a 1.5B binding specialist alone matching a 7B end-to-end baseline.

AI.tldr: Text2Opt需要建模和绑定两种可分离能力。通过Text2Opt-Bench基准测试发现数据规模增大导致精度急剧下降的"有效绑定限制"现象。提出BIND方法将数值数据外部化，显著提升性能；验证了binding作为独立任务的可行性。
AI.motivation: 文本转优化任务面临建模和绑定两大挑战；随着实例数据规模增大，模型精度急剧下降（有效绑定限制问题），即使 formulation 本身简单。
AI.method: 提出BIND方法——将数值数据外部化到结构化文件，使模型以程序化方式绑定而非从提示中转录；探索仅在binding任务上微调的专门模型。
AI.result: BIND使GPT-5-Nano从59.1%提升至82.4%，GPT-5从86.2%提升至95.8%；绑定专家模型在三个不同优化类别上超越端到端SFT和RL方法。
AI.conclusion: BIND通过程序化绑定数值数据显著提升性能；1.5B绑定专家模型可匹配7B端到端基线，证明binding是可分离且值得独立优化的核心能力。

title: Assisted Counterspeech Writing at the Crossroads of Hate Speech and Misinformation
summary: Hate speech and misinformation frequently co-occur online, amplifying prejudice and polarization. Given their scale, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist expert counterspeech (CS) writing has gained interest, yet prior work has addressed these phenomena separately. We bridge this gap by studying CS generation in contexts where both hate and misinformation co-occur. We test three knowledge-driven generation strategies: first we prompt an LLM with fact-checkers' guidelines and fact-checking articles; secondly, with NGOs' guidelines and reports; thirdly, we create a mixed strategy that combines guidelines and documents from both. 23 experts revise the generated CS, which are assessed via human and automatic metrics. While LLMs produce adequate CS in 40% of cases, expert edits substantially improve naturalness, exhaustiveness, and adherence to guidelines. Based on the post-edited CS, the mixed strategy proves to be the most effective in crowdsourcing evaluation, pairing strong factual correction with stereotype mitigation and empathetic engagement. We release a dataset of hateful and misinformed claims with expert-verified CS and supporting knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"仇恨言论与错误信息共现"这一现实场景，研究用大语言模型（GPT-4o-mini）辅助专业写作者生成反驳言论（counterspeech）。作者构建了三套知识驱动策略——事实核查员策略（依欧洲事实核查准则，用核查文章）、NGO 策略（依 Get the Trolls Out 指南，用反刻板印象报告）、以及二者结合的混合策略（新编融合指南 + 双类知识），并由 23 位 NGO 运营者与事实核查员在 First-AID 平台对生成结果进行专业后编辑，再以自动指标与两组人工评估检验。结论：约 40% 的生成结果已"够用"，但专家编辑显著提升自然度、详尽性与指南遵从性；后编辑后的混合策略在四个维度（FACT/STER/EMP/DISC）上综合最优，是应对仇恨与错误信息共现的推荐方案。作者同时开源了 324 条专家核验的"仇恨+错误信息"主张及反驳言论数据集。
AI.motivation: 在线上，仇恨言论与错误信息常常共现并形成"毒性协同"（toxic synergy）：接触错误信息会加剧既有偏见，放大仇恨与极化。但既有 NLP 研究几乎把两者当作独立任务处理——反仇恨的 counterspeech 多由 NGO 运营者撰写，强调共情、以理服人；反错误信息的"verdict" 多由事实核查员撰写，强调非党派、非情绪化、事实与来源可核验，二者遵循不同专业指南且分属不同机构。尽管已有工作尝试用 LLM 自动化/辅助撰写counterspeech，模型常产出空泛、只谴责而不正面回应、句式重复的模式化文本，且存在生成有害或失实内容、放大伤害的风险。因此需要回答两个问题：LLM 能在多大程度上辅助专业写作者同时应对这两类共现内容（RQ1），以及哪种知识驱动策略对"共现"这一复合现象最有效（RQ2）。
AI.method: （1）指南构建：基于《欧洲独立事实核查组织准则》编写事实核查员指南，基于 Get the Trolls Out 项目指南编写 NGO 指南，并联合专家新建"混合指南"，在证据型纠错与共情式回应之间取得平衡、要求同时处理事实错误与负面刻板印象。（2）外部知识收集：通过 Google Fact Check Tools API 依关键词（含身份词、偏见词、常见侮辱词）抓取 8,920 篇事实核查文章，人工评估 2,398 篇、保留 427 篇（限 IFCN 准则签署方）；从 33 个 NGO/人权类站点手工收集 280 组"迷思—反刻板印象"配对，覆盖六类边缘群体（穆斯林、LGBTQIA+、移民、女性、残障人士、犹太人）。（3）数据构建：基于核查文章人工改写 213 条含虚假信息的仇恨话语，再以 all-mpnet-base-v2 计算句级语义相似度（阈值 0.4）匹配 NGO 迷思对，人工复核后保留 108 个"仇恨+错误信息"主张—NGO 报告—核查文章三元组。（4）生成：以 zero-shot 提示驱动 GPT-4o-mini（temperature 0.8、最长 100 token），按 NGO、事实核查员、混合三种配置各生成一条两句话的 CS，得到 324 对。（5）专家后编辑：23 位专家（11 名核查员、12 名 NGO 运营者，来自 4 国 7 家机构）依据专业匹配原则在 First-AID 平台修订 CS，核查指南遵从、信息准确性与相关性，并标注支撑文本（ground text）。（6）自动评估：HTER（后编辑强度）、Repetition Rate、Flesch Reading Ease / Flesch-Kincaid Grade / 复杂词比例、平均与最大句法深度、句数，以及专家增删词的高频 n-gram 分析。（7）人工评估一：6 名研究生志愿者对 HTER≥0.39 的 78 对（21 对重复评估）随机排序，按指南遵从、自然度、详尽性三维度二选一，单侧二项检验。（8）人工评估二：Prolific 上 37 名参与者、32 份问卷（含理解检查与注意力检查），从旁观者视角在"挑战事实准确性/挑战刻板印象/促成共情/劝阻他人认同"四个维度以五级量表评分，Mann-Whitney U 检验列间差异。
AI.result: RQ1（LLM 的辅助程度）：三种配置平均 HTER 均低于 0.4（事实核查员组 0.215、NGO 组 0.264），约 40% 的生成结果无需改动；专家在 60% 的情形下介入，合计 44 小时、平均每条 8 分钟。事实核查员编辑频率最低但一旦修改幅度大（CS_FC 的修改样本 HTER 达 0.474）；NGO 运营者介入更频繁（73.1%/68.4%）但单次幅度小。CS_MIX 的后编辑负担最轻（事实核查员 0.128、NGO 0.241），提示其初始质量最高。人工编辑可测量地改善质量：重复率下降（NGO 策略 7.269→5.497）、可读性上升（FRES 升、FKG 与复杂词比例降，如 CS_MIX/NGO 的 FRES 13.481→22.599）、句法深度下降而句数增加（长句被拆分为短句），并清除模型的角色刻板表达（CS_FC 中高频删除 "claim"、"false"，CS_NGO 中高频删除 "important"、"recognize"、"understand"，即"the claim is false""it's important to recognize"等套式）。人工评估一致确认：编辑后版本在指南遵从（68% vs 31%）、详尽性（64% vs 35%）、自然度（63% vs 36%）上均显著优于原始生成。评估一致性偏低（κ=0.21，%AGR=0.57），符合主观任务特征。在混合策略中，专家选用的支撑文本仍以事实核查文章为主（核查员 60.6%、NGO 54.94%），显示模型对 NGO 材料的依赖不足。RQ2（策略有效性）：混合策略在几乎所有维度最优——FACT 3.458 与事实核查策略 3.370 相当且显著优于 NGO 策略 2.429；STER 3.224 与 NGO 策略 2.938 相当且显著优于事实核查策略 2.565；EMP 2.907 与 NGO 策略 2.964 相当（NGO 最高）；DISC 3.131 最佳且显著优于 NGO 策略 2.714。即事实核查策略擅长纠错但不触碰刻板印象与共情，NGO 策略擅长消解刻板印象与共情但不直接反驳事实，只有混合策略同时覆盖全部维度。第二问卷 κ=0.25、ρ=0.38，量表合并后升至 0.29/0.42，提示低一致性部分源于量表尺度解读差异。
AI.conclusion: 在仇恨言论与错误信息共现的场景下，混合策略（融合证据型纠错与共情式回应的新指南，同时注入核查文章与 NGO 反刻板印象报告）是最有效的 counterspeech 生成路径：它既能达到与事实核查员策略相当的事实纠正水平，又能达到与 NGO 策略相当的刻板印象消解与共情水平，并更显著地降低他人对仇恨主张的认同，而单一维度的专门策略必然以牺牲其他维度为代价。同时，LLM 更适合定位为专业写作者的"初稿助手"而非替代者：生成结果整体可用（约 40% 无需修改）且后编辑负担可控（平均 HTER<0.4，混合策略更低），但人类介入能实质性降低重复性、提升可读性、简化句法并剔除模型对核查员/NGO 话语风格的刻板模仿。因此现实部署应以"LLM 生成 + 专家审核修订"的人机协同流程为主，并配套以策略专属指南与结构化知识作为输入。方法学启示还包括：应把两类现象及其写作规范一并纳入统一框架、为不同专业角色定制混合指南以避免单一维度的系统性盲区。局限方面包括仅使用 GPT-4o-mini、样本规模有限（108 条主张、324 条生成）、人工评估一致性偏低、主张构造依赖英文与六个特定边缘群体，以及模型对 NGO 知识利用不足。论文最终开源了含 324 条专家核验反驳言论与支撑知识的完整数据集，为后续研究提供基准。

title: SGR-Bench: Benchmarking Search Agents on State-Gated Retrieval
comment: Work in Progress. 23 pages, 7 figures, preprint
summary: Recent advances in large language models and tool-using agents have expanded the range of benchmarked web tasks. Yet an important class of specialized retrieval tasks remains undercharacterized. On many specialized data-retrieval websites, answer-bearing evidence becomes accessible only after establishing the correct site-specific retrieval state through filters, views, hierarchies, or scopes. We term this capability state-gated retrieval (SGR). We introduce SGR-Bench, a benchmark for this setting containing 100 expert-curated tasks spanning six source families and 12 public data ecosystems. Each task requires discovering the appropriate website and configuring its site-specific retrieval state to produce a structured answer. SGR-Bench pairs constraint-guided and goal-oriented formulations of the same underlying problems, enabling controlled comparisons between explicit and implicit guidance for state-gated retrieval. We evaluate eight CLI-based agentic LLM systems and three commercial search-agent products. On SGR-Bench, the strongest system reaches only 66.18% item-level F1, while row-level F1 remains much lower. A manual audit of 156 analyzable failed CLI trajectories shows why: agents often reach a relevant web source, but establish the wrong site-specific retrieval state. Retrieval-scope drift (37.2%) and criterion mismatch (27.6%) dominate, whereas final answer composition accounts for only 10.3%. The dataset and single-case evaluation instructions are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PKUAIWeb/SGR-BENCH.

AI.tldr: SGR-Bench 是首个面向"状态门控检索"（SGR）的基准：100 个专家策展任务，覆盖 6 类来源家族、12 个公共数据生态，要求代理先找到目标网站、再配置其站点特定检索状态（过滤器/视图/层级/范围）以暴露默认状态下不可见的证据，并输出结构化有序表格。评测 8 个 CLI 代理系统与 3 个商业搜索代理产品：最佳系统 GPT-5.5 仅达 66.18% Item-F1，Row-F1 低至 43.37%（均值 26.81%）；156 条失败轨迹审计显示主因是检索范围漂移（37.2%）与判据错配（27.6%），而最终答案组装仅占 10.3%。结论：当前瓶颈不在"找到网站"或"写答案"，而在跨依赖检索步骤保持站点检索状态（活跃过滤器、层级节点、结果范围、行标识）。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索代理基准（BrowseComp、WebWalkerQA、WideSearch、DeepSearchQA）主要评估源发现、搜索深广度与跨页证据聚合；浏览器/Web 代理基准（WebArena、Mind2Web、WorkArena、WebLINX、AssistantBench 等）侧重界面动作落地与端到端任务执行。二者都未考察一类能力：在专业数据检索网站上，含答案证据并不在入口页或默认设置下暴露，只有在正确设置过滤器、视图、层级或作用域后才可获取。作者将此能力命名为状态门控检索（state-gated retrieval, SGR），并指出其难度来自把领域约束映射到站点状态控件、且状态操作之间存在依赖（前一状态暴露的证据决定下一步操作），一旦范围或判据偏移会级联污染后续结果。缺少专门基准，无法区分"找不到源"与"找到了源但状态配错"这两类失败。
AI.method: 基准构建：（1）任务形式化——目标网站 W、站点检索状态 s、默认状态 s0 下不可见证据 E(a)，要求找到状态序列 s1..sk 使 E(a) ⊆ ∪V(W, st)；（2）四阶段数据流水线：候选网站策展（Wikipedia 外链 dump + Qwen-Plus 优先级排序 + 两名标注员独立复审，剔除纯静态文本站）、任务设计协议（域专属性、长尾源锚定、答案唯一可验证、真值稳定、抗捷径、逻辑依赖六项要求）、任务构建（ChatGPT-5.2 Pro 起草问题/答案/解轨迹 + 形式审查）、候选过滤与三轮专家验证（自解验证答案正确唯一、沿参考解验证状态门控必要性与非平凡依赖、对抗性探测捷径）+ 搜索基线难度校准（保留"部分进展"任务）；（3）数据：100 任务，来源家族分布为环境监测 24、监管资源 22、学术档案 18、生命科学 18、官方统计 12、漏洞库 6，任务按 50/50 配对约束引导式与目标导向式，答案规模 2–44 行（均值 6.42，中位 4）；（4）评测协议：人工定义规范化规则 → 按任务特定行键对齐 → Item-F1（字段级）、Row-F1（整行全对）、P.O.A.（共享行成对次序一致性，Kendall τ 视角）；（5）系统评测：8 个 CLI 代理（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.6-Plus、GLM-5.1、Seed-2.0 Pro、Kimi K2.5、DeepSeek V4 Pro）统一提示、仅暴露 Serper 搜索/网页抓取/PDF 读取三类工具、每任务独立会话、6000 秒上限、medium effort；另评 Google Search AI Mode、Gemini Deep Research、OpenAI Deep Research；并对 176 条 CLI 轨迹（156 失败）人工审计六类错误。
AI.result: 整体 Item-F1 介于 14.87%–66.18%（均值 47.85%），Row-F1 均值仅 26.81%，平均差 21.04 点，最强系统 GPT-5.5 也差 22.81 点（66.18 vs 43.37），说明代理常能复制局部正确字段却拼不出完整行。CLI 系统均值优于商业系统（53.42% vs 33.00%）；OpenAI Deep Research 的 Row-F1 次高（41.50%）但 Item-F1 仅第六，Gemini 3.1 Pro P.O.A. 高（90.26%）而 Row-F1 低（27.11%）。约束引导式 Item-F1 略高（+1.90），目标导向式 Row-F1 略高（+2.24），说明显式提示有助于定位字段但无助于范围维持。失败审计：检索范围漂移 37.2%、判据错配 27.6%（合计 64.7%）、最终答案组装仅 10.3%，另有意图改写、页内证据误读、检索依赖错误。分误差类型的得分模式有区分度：判据错配 Item-F1 52.5% 但 Row-F1 仅 7.3%（差 45.2 点）；范围漂移双指标同降（38.7/19.2）；正确轨迹为 95.0/95.0。分来源家族：学术档案 63.1%、生命科学 57.5%、环境监测 52.9%，监管资源 36.4%、官方统计 34.3% 最难（需同时对齐机构、辖区、报告期、总体、表范围等多个控件）；监管任务 87% 为判据错配，学术/环境以范围漂移为主。分模型：Seed-2.0（75%）与 Gemini 3.1（58%）漂移主导，DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 GLM-5.1（各 42%）错配主导，Claude 4.7 意图改写高达 28%（倾向于委派子代理改写问题），Kimi K2.5 22 题零正确且依赖错误率最高。任务基数上 1–2 行任务最难（Item-F1 36.36%、Row-F1 9.38%），集中在 Census 与 CFPB 的耦合多步状态操作。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献：提出 SGR 这一独立于源发现的检索能力轴，并构建 SGR-Bench（100 任务、配对双重表述、六项设计协议与三轮专家验证的可复现构建方法论）；提供覆盖 8 个 CLI 代理与 3 个商业产品的广泛实证，表明当前系统的核心失败模式是"在正确网站上使用了错误的站点检索状态"，而非源发现失败或最终格式化。启示与建议：训练数据应将导航决策、活跃过滤器与结构化抽取耦合为单一监督信号；评测协议需验证检索到的行是否仍锚定在正确的站点切片（仅看答案的评分会掩盖范围漂移）；接口感知/检索状态保持应成为专门研究方向。局限：仅覆盖公共、相对稳定、结构化的来源，欠代表高动态网页；缺少跨异构代理的统一轨迹级评分；规模（100 题）适合受控评测与诊断，不适合作大规模后训练语料；LLM 辅助起草可能带入网站选择、问题表述等构建期偏差。

title: PEARL: Unbiased Percentile Estimation via Contrastive Learning for Industrial-Scale Livestream Recommendation
summary: Recommender systems trained on user interaction data are susceptible to behavioral intensity imbalance--a systematic distortion arising from heterogeneous engagement patterns across users. This imbalance skews feedback signals such that observed interactions no longer faithfully reflect true preferences, causing models to disproportionately amplify signals from highly active users while underrepresenting others, which ultimately degrades recommendation quality and robustness at scale. To address this issue, we propose a nonparametric contrastive percentile approximation framework, PEARL, that models relative preference signals instead of absolute engagement magnitudes. Building upon relative advantage debiasing, PEARL leverages real contrastive interaction samples to approximate percentile relationships directly, without relying on auxiliary distribution estimation models. We provide theoretical justification demonstrating that such pairwise comparisons yield unbiased estimates of percentile-based preference signals. For broader applicability, we introduce a prediction-based bootstrapping mechanism for percentile smoothing to handle sparse and discrete feedback, alongside a generalized value-weighted formulation and a co-training strategy to enhance both modeling flexibility and representation learning. Extensive offline experiments demonstrate that PEARL effectively mitigates behavioral bias and consistently improves recommendation performance across multiple ranking targets. Deployed in a production livestream platform with a combined user base of billions, online A/B testing confirms substantial real-world gains: +2.10% Watch Duration, +0.80% Consumption Amount, +1.49% Interaction Rate, and -6.91% Report Rate.

AI.tldr: PEARL addresses behavioral intensity imbalance in recommender systems by modeling relative preference signals through nonparametric contrastive percentile approximation, achieving significant improvements in both offline experiments and production deployment.
AI.motivation: User interaction data in recommender systems suffers from behavioral intensity imbalance—a systematic distortion where heterogeneous engagement patterns across users cause observed interactions to no longer faithfully reflect true preferences. This leads to models disproportionately amplifying signals from highly active users while underrepresenting others, ultimately degrading recommendation quality and robustness at scale.
AI.method: PEARL employs relative advantage debiasing with real contrastive interaction samples to directly approximate percentile relationships, without auxiliary distribution estimation. Key innovations include: (1) modeling relative preference signals instead of absolute engagement magnitudes, (2) a prediction-based bootstrapping mechanism for percentile smoothing to handle sparse and discrete feedback, (3) a generalized value-weighted formulation, and (4) a co-training strategy for enhanced representation learning.
AI.result: Extensive offline experiments demonstrate that PEARL effectively mitigates behavioral bias and consistently improves recommendation performance across multiple ranking targets. Online A/B testing in production (billions of users) confirms real-world gains: +2.10% Watch Duration, +0.80% Consumption Amount, +1.49% Interaction Rate, and -6.91% Report Rate.
AI.conclusion: PEARL achieves significant improvements in offline experiments and real-world deployment, with A/B testing showing +2.10% Watch Duration, +0.80% Consumption Amount, +1.49% Interaction Rate, and -6.91% Report Rate in a production livestream platform serving billions of users.

title: Cohesion-6K: An Arabic Dataset for Analyzing Social Cohesion and Conflict in Online Discourse
summary: The study of online discourse has become central to understanding societal polarization. While much research has focused on detecting overt toxicity, the subtle dynamics of social cohesion, meaning the interaction between divisive and unifying narratives, remain computationally underexplored (Bail, 2021; Gonzalez-Bailon and Lelkes, 2023). This paper presents Cohesion-6K, a manually and ChatGPT-assisted annotated dataset of six thousand Arabic public Facebook posts related to the Israeli Occupation of Palestine. Each post is assigned to one of five discourse categories that represent a continuum from conflict to cohesion: Conflict, Resolution, Community Engagement, Supportive Interactions, and Shared Values. The annotation process combines expert human judgment with model-assisted pre-labeling verified by trained annotators, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement (Cohens kappa = 0.85). Quantitative analysis reveals a consistent engagement gap, where conflict-oriented posts receive between two and four times more user interaction than resolution-oriented ones (p < 0.01). This pattern illustrates how divisive discourse tends to attract disproportionate visibility in Arabic social media spaces. Cohesion-6K provides a transparent and reproducible resource for the study of online cohesion and polarization. The dataset, annotation guidelines, and preprocessing code will be released for research use under an open license, supporting future work in computational social science, digital communication, and Arabic natural language processing.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了包含6000条阿拉伯语Facebook帖子的Cohesion-6K数据集，将帖子分为5个话语类别，发现冲突导向内容获得显著更多用户互动，揭示了分裂性话语不成比例的可见度现象。
AI.motivation: 现有研究集中于显性毒性检测，而冲突性与凝聚性叙事之间的微妙动态尚缺乏计算层面的探索。
AI.method: 结合专家人工判断与ChatGPT辅助预标注的五类别标注体系，达到0.85的Cohen's kappa一致性。
AI.result: 冲突导向帖子的用户互动量是和解导向帖子的2-4倍（p<0.01），表明分裂性话语在阿拉伯语社交媒体中获得了不成比例的可见度。
AI.conclusion: Cohesion-6K数据集为阿拉伯语社交媒体中的话语凝聚力与极化研究提供了可复现的资源基础，对计算社会科学、数字传播和阿拉伯语NLP领域具有重要价值。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models as Live Strategic Agents: Provider Performance, Hybrid Decomposition, and Operational Gaps in Timed Risk Play
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Code and tracked notes: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game . Public runtime artifact index: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game/blob/main/docs/article-plans/public_experiment_artifacts.md
summary: Static benchmarks capture only part of how large language models behave in practice. Real systems place models inside repeated loops with time limits, formatting constraints, and failure modes. We study this setting in a timed multi-phase Risk environment with explicit victory targets and repeated planning and execution cycles. In a replicated 32-game cross-provider championship under frozen rules, gemini-3.1-pro-preview won 20 of 32 games against gpt-5.1, claude-opus-4-7, and kimi-k2.6, and the pooled winner distribution differs strongly from an equal-strength null (p approx 1.5 x 10^-5). We then separate planning from execution by standardizing execution on a cheaper Gemini Flash scaffold. Under this design, a pooled 32-game planner bakeoff is consistent with near-equality (p approx 0.821), which indicates that much of the earlier provider spread came from end-to-end system behavior rather than planning alone. To study mechanism, we analyze saved planning and execution traces from the provider championship. Gemini refers to the terminal objective far more often than the other models and increases that focus as victory approaches. Gemini also converts more turns into deep conquest chains, even though it is not the cleanest runtime. These results show that live-agent performance depends on objective tracking, execution conversion, cost, and runtime reliability, and they support evaluating LLMs as components in bounded workflows rather than as isolated benchmark respondents.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过多阶段定时Risk游戏环境评估LLM在真实agent场景中的表现，发现端到端系统行为（如目标追踪、执行转化）比单独规划能力更重要，Gemini的竞争优势源于其在执行层面的优势而非规划本身。
AI.motivation: 静态基准测试无法捕捉LLM在实际系统中的真实行为；现有评估缺乏对重复循环、时间限制、格式约束和失败模式等真实部署场景的考量
AI.method: 在32场重复游戏 championship中比较各模型表现；通过标准化执行环境（Gemini Flash脚手架）分离规划与执行；分析保存的规划与执行轨迹研究机制
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview在32场游戏中赢得20场（对抗GPT-5.1、Claude-opus-4-7和Kimi-K2.6），显著优于等强度假设；规划能力本身在各模型间接近相等；Gemini更频繁地参照终端目标且随胜利接近增强此行为；Gemini产生更多深度征服链
AI.conclusion: LLM性能差异主要来自端到端系统行为而非单独规划能力；Gemini在目标追踪和执行转化方面的优势是关键机制；建议将LLM评估框架从静态基准测试转向有界工作流组件评估

title: Machine learning prediction of obstructive coronary artery disease using opportunistic coronary calcium and epicardial fat assessments from CT calcium scoring scans
summary: Non-contrast computed tomography calcium scoring (CTCS) is a cost-effective imaging modality widely used to detect coronary artery calcifications. This study aimed to develop an advanced machine learning framework that utilizes quantitative analyses of coronary calcium and epicardial fat from CTCS images to predict obstructive coronary artery disease (CAD). The study population consisted of 1,324 patients from the SCOT-HEART clinical trial who underwent both CTCS and coronary CT angiography. We extracted and analyzed a broad range of features, including 24 clinical variables, 189 calcium-omics, and 211 epicardial fat-omics features from the CTCS images. Feature selection was conducted using the CatBoost algorithm combined with SHapley Additive exPlanation (SHAP) values. Predictive modeling utilized the CatBoost gradient boosting method, focusing on the most informative features. From an initial set of 424 candidate features, 14 were identified as most predictive through the CatBoost-SHAP method. The top two predictive features originated from fat-omics, with the remaining 12 features derived from calcium-omics. The optimized model achieved robust predictive capabilities, demonstrating a sensitivity of 83.1+/-4.6%, specificity of 93.8+/-1.7%, accuracy of 85.3+/-2.0%, and an F1 score of 73.9+/-3.3%. Inclusion of calcium-omics and fat-omics data significantly improved predictive performance. Notably, the model also showed reliable predictive accuracy in patients with diverse coronary calcium scores, including cases with obstructive CAD despite a zero-calcium score. This innovative approach holds promise for improving clinical decision-making and potentially reducing dependence on contrast-enhanced or invasive diagnostic procedures, particularly within low-to intermediate-risk patient groups.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于CTCS图像的机器学习框架，通过整合钙-omics和脂肪-omics特征预测阻塞性CAD。在1,324例患者中，该模型以14个精选特征实现了85.3%的准确率，可靠预测了包括零钙积分但存在阻塞性CAD的患者，有望减少对侵入性诊断的依赖。
AI.motivation: 非对比CT钙化评分(CTCS)是检测冠状动脉钙化的成本效益较高的成像方式，本研究旨在利用CTCS图像中的冠状动脉钙化和心外膜脂肪的定量分析，开发机器学习框架以预测阻塞性冠状动脉疾病(CAD)。
AI.method: 研究纳入SCOT-HEART临床试验中1,324名同时接受CTCS和冠脉CT血管造影的患者。提取424个候选特征（24个临床变量、189个钙-omics特征、211个脂肪-omics特征）。采用CatBoost算法结合SHAP值进行特征选择，利用CatBoost梯度提升方法建立预测模型。
AI.result: 通过CatBoost-SHAP方法从424个候选特征中筛选出14个最具预测性的特征，其中2个来自脂肪-omics，12个来自钙-omics。优化后的模型达到灵敏度83.1±4.6%、特异度93.8±1.7%、准确率85.3±2.0%、F1分数73.9±3.3%的稳健预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在低至中等风险患者群体中具有显著的临床应用潜力，可减少对对比增强或侵入性诊断程序的依赖。脂肪-omics和钙-omics数据的整合显著提升了预测性能，且模型对零钙积分但患有阻塞性CAD的患者仍具有可靠的预测准确性。

title: From Correlation to Cause: A Five-Stage Methodology for Feature Analysis in Transformer Language Models
summary: We propose a five-stage methodology for causal feature analysis in transformer language models (probe design, feature extraction, causal validation, robustness testing, and deployment integration) and demonstrate it end-to-end on GPT-2 small performing the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task. Activation patching recovers the canonical IOI circuit (layer-9 head 9 alone gives recovery +1.02). A sparse autoencoder recovers per-name selective features with effect sizes of 30 to 50 activation units. Causal validation finds these features specifically but only partially causal: ablating fifteen of them leaves the model accurate on 98% of prompts. Two NLA-inspired evaluations strengthen this picture: the fifteen selective features explain only 31% of activation variance versus the SAE's 99.7%, and selectivity ratio anticorrelates with causal force (r = -0.56). Robustness testing under three distribution shifts finds that the circuit transfers cleanly but feature ablation effects degrade substantially, exposing a gap between detection robustness and causal robustness. A cost-based deployment evaluation (assumed $50/FN, $0.42/FP, 2% error rate) finds an optimal monitor configuration yielding $8.96 per 1000 queries against a $1000 baseline, a 99.1% saving. Optimal composition strategy varies with cost ratio and base rate. The conjunction of stages produces findings no single stage would.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"从相关到因果"的五阶段可解释性方法论（探针设计、特征提取、因果验证、鲁棒性测试、部署集成），并在 GPT-2 small 的间接宾语识别（IOI）任务上完整演示。核心结论是：SAE 找到的"按名字选择性"特征具有特异性但不充分的因果力（同时消融 15 个特征后模型仍有 98% 准确率），存在所谓"中间因果区间"；被解释的特征仅解释 30.7% 的激活方差，而选择性强度与因果力反相关（r=-0.56）；特征的"检测鲁棒性"与"因果鲁棒性"是两种不同属性；在成本假设下 SAE-only、阈值 15 的监控器配置每千次查询期望成本 $8.96，相对无监控基线 $1000 节省 99.1%。
AI.motivation: 当前机制可解释性社区已有多种成熟单项技术（稀疏自编码器 SAE、激活修补/因果追踪、探针、激活引导、自然语言自编码器 NLA），但这些技术几乎没有被作为一条有纪律的流水线在同一模型、同一任务上串联运行，导致"最过度自信的可解释性结论"往往来自只跑单一技术。作者指出各技术的已知失效模式：SAE 特征可有选择性而无因果性；激活修补能定位信息但说不清内容；探针能检出网络并不读取的相关性；NLA 解释富有表达力但会"编造"（confabulate）。因此需要一个把相关证据升级为因果主张的、阶段化的方法论，并回答真实语言模型究竟处于何种因果区间。
AI.method: 五阶段方法论：(1) 探针设计——预注册假设、区分"检测"与"相关"标准、明确成功/失败条件；(2) 特征提取——用 SAE/线性探针/NLA/定向搜索分解激活，报告工作点（稀疏度-保真度、FVE-可读性），输出仅为候选；(3) 因果验证——用激活修补、特征消融、引导检验必要/充分性；(4) 鲁棒性测试——在分布偏移、改写、对抗框架、微调下测量均值与方差；(5) 部署集成——与治理层组合，按实测 FP/FN 率把监控器视为纵深防御中的不完备组件。实验：GPT-2 small（124M，12 层），IOI 模板（16 人名/7 地点/7 物品，ABBA/BABA 均衡，构造 clean-corrupt 匹配对），主指标为末端位置 logit 差 Δ=logits[IO]-logits[S]。SAE 训练于 layer 9、END 位置残差流，1024 特征（4×扩展）、L1 系数 0.5、3000 步，L0=87.3、解释 99.8% 方差。另借鉴 NLA 的两个框架：保真度分层（截断 top-K 特征后计算 FVE=1-var(h-ĥ)/var(h)）与可靠性分层（特征属性与因果力的相关性）。部署评估采用成本模型 cost=p_err(1-TPR)c_FN+(1-p_err)FPR·c_FP，假设 FN $50、FP $0.42、错误率 2%、流量混合 70/15/15、启发式监控器 5% 噪声，做阈值扫描与敏感性分析。实现基于 PyTorch + TransformerLens，CPU 上约 20 分钟。
AI.result: 七个发现：(1) 激活修补成功复现经典 IOI 电路，L9H9 单头恢复 +1.02，L9H6 +0.32，L10H0 +0.11，L10H7 为负恢复 -0.54（备份 name-mover），残差流扫描显示 S 位置的 S-抑制模式；(2) SAE 为 16 个名字各找到至少一个 IO 选择性特征，效应量 28–52 激活单位；(3) 单特征消融使其偏好名字的 logit 差平均下降 0.67（分布内 0.89），但同时消融 15 个特征仅使平均 Δ 从 +3.71 降至 +3.33、正确率从 100% 降至 98.4%，即"有特异性但非必要"，落入因果贡献分支；(4) 保真度分层：完整 SAE 解释 99.7% 方差，单特征 25%、10 特征 84%、20 特征 95%，而 15 个选择性特征仅解释 30.7%；(5) 可靠性分层：所有特征在改写下 100% 触发、CV 0.09–0.26（稳定），但选择性比与因果落差反相关 r=-0.56，最极端选择性的 Sid(321:1)、Eve(165:1)、Adam(80:1) 恰是因果力最小者，而 Jane/Tom/Mary（9:1–19:1）因果力最大；(6) 鲁棒性：三类分布偏移下电路均干净迁移（L9H9 OOD +1.07、改写 +0.96），特征触发模式稳健（均值仅降 10–20%），但消融效应在改写下降约 50%，个别特征损失 50%–90% 因果力（Sid +0.85→+0.08，Adam +0.78→+0.18），暴露"检测鲁棒性 ≠ 因果鲁棒性"的缺口；留出名字上分布内 top-10 特征无一主导，由 feature 103/179/181 接替，且多 token 名字使 per-name 分析失效；(7) 部署：十个特征分布内 ROC-AUC 均为 1.00，偏移下仍 1.00，但 SAE 监控器 FPR 由 1%→3%→4%，启发式监控器 FPR 为 0，交集（and）在所有条件下 FPR=0 且 TPR=1.00，并集无增益；成本模型下最优为 SAE-only 阈值 15（TPR 0.99、FPR 0.00、$8.96/千次，节省 99.1%），and 因启发式 5% 噪声使 TPR 上限 0.94 而落败，or 在 20% 错误率时成为最优；盈亏平衡 FN 成本低至 $0.05。
AI.conclusion: 方法论的核心贡献是"阶段串联"本身：单独任何一阶段都无法给出全部发现——修补给电路不给特征，SAE 给候选不给因果，消融给因果不产候选，保真度分层量化覆盖但不指认关键特征，可靠性分层按因果力排序但不产候选。作者主张真实语言模型普遍处于"中间因果区间"（选择性 + 特异性因果力，但仅是分布式编码中的一小片），并区分出"干净因果区间""选择性但惰性区间"三种假设区间；据此，仅凭选择性排序特征的流程可能系统性地把错误的特征当作最重要特征；鲁棒性必须分别针对检测用途与干预用途测量；部署决策应基于明确成本模型下的期望成本而非 ROC-AUC。最终答复："我们无法像读句子那样读激活"，但可以谨慎地识别激活代表什么、在哪里代表、网络在多大程度上使用它、该表征覆盖激活的多大比例、哪些可观测属性能预测其因果力、这些性质对分布偏移有多稳健，以及可解释性输出如何组合进纵深防御监控体系。局限：模型小、任务模板化、SAE 规模与训练步数有限、NLA 分层只是对既有数据的重新框定而非 NLA 实验复现、部署成本为假设值而非实测值——可迁移的是方法论、成本模型与阈值扫描流程，而非具体数值。

title: Unlocking Proactivity in Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: Proactive task-oriented dialogue (TOD), such as outbound sales, demands a persuasive agent that actively probes the user's concerns and steers the conversation toward acceptance within a bounded number of turns. Yet post-trained LLMs are inherently conservative, and reward-shaping RL (e.g., GRPO) struggles since it only re-weights what an already passive policy samples. We show that conditioning on the user's latent concerns unlocks proactive capability that no amount of sampling can undermine, establishing these concerns as a pivotal training-time signal. To operationalize this finding, we build the \textbf{Cognitive User Simulator}, which models each user as a stratified persona comprising observable external traits and hidden internal concerns. The simulator produces faithful and diverse interactions, while emitting per-turn state dynamics that track persuasion progress. We then introduce \textbf{Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization}, which converts the modeled concerns and the simulation state transition into complementary training objectives: (1) \emph{Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation} that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of the same policy into its deployable, conversation-only view; and (2) \emph{State-Transition Policy Refinement} ...

AI.tldr: 本文针对主动任务导向对话系统中智能体过于保守的问题，提出将用户潜在担忧作为核心训练信号，通过Cognitive User Simulator建模用户分层人格，并设计Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization方法将模拟器状态转换为训练目标，实现主动说服能力。
AI.motivation: 主动任务导向对话（如外呼销售）需要说服型智能体主动探查用户担忧并引导对话接受；但后训练LLM天然保守， reward-shaping RL（如GRPO）仅重新加权已采样行为，无法根本改变被动策略。
AI.method: 构建Cognitive User Simulator（认知用户模拟器），将用户建模为包含可观察外部特征和隐藏内部担忧的分层人格；提出Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization，包含非对称On-Policy自我蒸馏和状态转移策略优化两个组件。
AI.result: 用户潜在担忧是一个关键训练信号，条件化于该信号可以解锁主动能力；该能力不受采样破坏；模拟器可生成忠实且多样的交互，并追踪说服进度。
AI.conclusion: 通过用户潜在担忧的条件化，可以解锁传统后训练方法无法实现的主动对话能力；Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization 提供了一种将模拟器状态转换为训练目标的可行范式。

title: On the Sample Complexity of Discounted Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Certainty Equivalents
comment: Accepted to RLC 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.00286
summary: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted MDPs, where a generative model of the MDP is assumed to be available. We consider a family or risk measures called the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), which includes important risk measures such as entropic risk, CVaR, and mean-variance. Our focus is on the sample complexities of learning the optimal state-action value function (value learning) and an optimal policy (policy learning) under recursive OCE. We provide an exact characterization of utility functions $u$ for which the corresponding OCE defines an objective that is PAC-learnable. We analyze a simple model-based approach and derive PAC sample complexity bounds. We establish that whenever $u$ does not have full domain $\text{dom}(u)\neq \mathbb{R}$, the corresponding problem is not PAC-learnable. Finally, we establish corresponding lower bounds for both value and policy learning, demonstrating tightness in the size $SA$ of state-action space, and for a more restricted class of utilities, we derive lower bounds that makes the dependence on the effective horizon $\frac{1}{1-γ}$ explicit. Specifically, for $\text{CVaR}_τ$ we show that the correct dependence on $τ$ is $\frac{1}{τ^2}$, thus improving by a factor of $\frac{1}τ$ over state-of-the-art although our bound has a suboptimal dependence on $\frac{1}{1-γ}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限折扣MDP中基于OCE族风险测度的风险敏感强化学习样本复杂度问题。证明了utility函数定义域是否为ℝ是PAC可学习性的关键判据，建立了值函数学习和策略学习的PAC样本复杂度上界及关于SA的紧密下界，特别对CVaR_τ澄清了τ的依赖关系为1/τ²。
AI.motivation: 研究在有限折扣MDP中，基于优化确定性等价(OCE)族风险测度的样本复杂度问题。OCE族包含重要风险测度如熵风险、CVaR和均值-方差，但哪些OCE目标函数可以高效学习尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用模型基础的分析方法，推导PAC样本复杂度界。通过构造反例证明非PAC可学习性的下界，并针对受限utility函数类建立包含有效水平度1/(1-γ)依赖的更精确下界。
AI.result: 精确刻画了使OCE可PAC学习的utility函数类；证明当dom(u)≠ℝ时问题不可PAC学习；对于CVaR_τ，证得τ的正确依赖为1/τ²，相比最新结果改进了一个1/τ因子。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了风险敏感RL中PAC学习的完整理论框架，证明了utility函数域的特性(是否等于ℝ)是PAC可学习性的关键判据，并给出了关于状态-动作空间规模SA的紧密下界。对于CVaR_τ，指出了τ的依赖关系应为1/τ²，改进现有结果。

title: In Silico Modeling of the RAMPHO Buffer: Dissociating Informational and Energetic Masking via Phonetic Entropy in Deep Neural Networks
summary: The fundamental challenge of listening in multi-talker environments is a cognitive bottleneck, defined by the Ease of Language Understanding (ELU) model as a failure within the RAMPHO episodic buffer. Current deep neural networks for speech enhancement optimize purely for physical acoustics, failing to account for the cognitive penalty of informational masking. Here, we present an in silico simulation of the RAMPHO buffer using the frame-by-frame phonetic entropy of a self-supervised acoustic model (wav2vec 2.0). By contrasting a semantically intact distractor with a phase-decorrelated distractor (the Concentration Shield) across a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) sweep, we successfully dissociate the cognitive penalty of informational distraction from the physical penalty of energetic decay. The simulation reveals a cognitive-acoustic Pareto optimization problem: destroying a distractor's semantic payload provides a release from informational masking at high SNRs, but fundamentally degrades temporal glimpsing cues at low SNRs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"体外(in silico)"模拟人类听觉认知瓶颈 RAMPHO 情景缓冲的代理指标：以自监督声学模型 wav2vec 2.0 的 CTC 投影头逐帧音素分布计算语音熵(phonetic entropy, H)，并以该熵量化认知负荷。作者在 0/5/10/15/20 dB 的 SNR 扫描下对比三种掩蔽体——可懂英语竞争话者(ENG)、相位去相关的"Concentration Shield"(CS,1–4 kHz 频带 FFT 相位随机化+Hann 窗平滑过渡)与稳态语音谱噪声(SSN)。结果显示在高 SNR 区(15–20 dB)ENG 的熵(H≈0.16 @20 dB)显著高于 SSN(H≈0.11),代表纯信息掩蔽(IM)惩罚,而 CS 因语义载荷被摧毁其熵曲线与 SSN 完全重合,即完全释放 IM;在低 SNR 区(0–5 dB)关系反转,ENG(H≈0.67 @0 dB)反而优于 CS(H≈0.85),因为 CS 的相位随机化摧毁了自然调制的"听觉瞬瞥"(acoustic glimpsing)时间线索,变成致密的能量掩蔽体。结论是:破坏干扰者语义虽可换得 IM 释放,却必然牺牲低 SNR 下的时域线索,由此提出"认知-声学 Pareto 优化"作为下一代"认知助听器/认知 ASR"的设计范式。
AI.motivation: 多说话者环境(如鸡尾酒会问题)的核心障碍不仅是声学能量不足,更是认知瓶颈。按 Rönnberg 等人(2013)的 ELU 模型,语言理解依赖 RAMPHO (快速自动多模态音韵) 情景缓冲对声学特征到次词汇表征的自动、低开销映射;一旦信号退化或存在语义竞争,这种隐式绑定失败,听者必须动用有限的顶向下行工作记忆去"修复"语流,产生可测量的听觉努力与快速认知耗竭。现有机器听觉与深度神经网络语音增强只针对物理声学指标(SII、PESQ、SNR)优化,完全忽略信息掩蔽(IM)的认知代价;更危险的是,激进的降噪算法可能在数学上提升背景话者的 SNR,反而"揭示"其语言载荷,把可承受的能量负荷替换为破坏性的信息负荷。因此需要一个能分离"信息干扰的认知惩罚"与"能量衰减的物理惩罚"的 in silico RAMPHO 模型,以便把设计目标从"恢复可听性"转向"保护认知资源"。
AI.method: 刺激与掩蔽体:英语目标叙事与三种掩蔽体按 0、5、10、15、20 dB SNR(外加 100 dB 纯净基线)混合,采用 ITU-T P.56 主动 RMS 归一化。ENG 为竞争男性英语说话人(含能量起伏与高 IM);CS 为同一说话人经 DSP "频谱手术"——FFT 分离 1–4 kHz 语音关键频带并完全随机化相位,在 1 kHz 与 4 kHz 交界处施加 Hann 窗渐变以避免对抗性时域涂抹伪影,保留全局 RMS 能量与 <1 kHz 空间锚定线索,从而摧毁语言载荷与 STI,产生零 IM 但高连续 EM;SSN 为匹配长期平均语音谱的稳态噪声,作为纯 EM 的对照。代理模型:音频重采样至 16 kHz 归一化后,输入预训练自监督模型 facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h,取 CTC 线性投影头得到逐帧 logits,经 Softmax 得到英文词表概率分布,每 20 ms 帧做一次前向计算;该双向 Transformer 具非因果未来上下文,被作者明示为"理想化上界"代理。指标:逐帧 Shannon 熵 H[n] = -Σ_{i=1..31} (P(x_i)/(1-P(blank))) · log2(P(x_i)/(1-P(blank)) + ε),显式剔除 CTC blank 并在 K=31 的活跃词汇上重归一化,以确保低熵代表真正的音素绑定而非静音;低熵=隐式处理成功(低努力),高熵=音素歧义(需调用工作记忆)。
AI.result: 1) 高 SNR(15–20 dB):ENG 保持显著更高的熵(20 dB 时 H≈0.16)高于 SSN(H≈0.11),此时目标语音的外周可听性近乎完美,该差距即被归因为纯信息掩蔽造成的中心语义竞争。2) 对 ENG 施加 CS 相位手术后期望曲线与 SSN 基线几乎完全重合——网络立刻把去相关流当作不可解析噪声丢弃,IM 被完全释放,系统回到低努力的自动处理状态。3) 低 SNR(0–5 dB):关系反转,ENG(0 dB 时 H≈0.67)优于 CS(H≈0.85);解释为未修改的话者保留自然幅度调制,提供目标特征可被提取的"时间瞬瞥"窗口,而 CS 摧毁这些时间间隙,转化为致密、对抗性的能量掩蔽体,熵激增标出了结构性涂抹的能量惩罚超过语义破坏之认知收益的阈值。整体呈现 IM 与 EM 随 SNR 的非线性交叉(crossover)曲线,并明确给出跨 SNR 的熵量化阈值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了以 wav2vec 2.0 逐帧语音熵作为 RAMPHO 缓冲体外代理的可行性,并在实验层面实现了信息掩蔽与能量掩蔽的可量化分离;结论是认知负荷在可听性极限处为零和权衡:消除干扰者的语义轨道(降 IM)必然损害时域地标(升 EM)。由此提出下一代"认知助听器"不能依赖静态空间滤波,而必须依据当前环境 SNR 与用户工作记忆容量动态求解"认知-声学 Pareto 优化"问题。作者亦指出局限与后续方向:当前自监督模型具近乎无限的上下文窗口,无法建模人类显式记忆约束,故未来架构需人为"致残"ASR——(1) 在自注意力矩阵上引入指数时延衰减惩罚 τ 模拟 2–4 秒的回声记忆衰退;(2) 通过极度压缩束搜索解码器宽度模拟工作记忆容量上限,并以目标与掩蔽体逐帧滑动重叠来标定使受限解码器语义竞争洪泛、目标跟踪崩溃的精确 Δt 阈值,从而把该流水线发展为临床 DSP 算法的严谨体外测试平台("认知 ASR")。需要说明的是,本文属概念性/预印本式工作,熵值以 bit 计且绝对数值依赖具体实现,外部效度与人类听觉努力的相关性仍待心理物理实验验证。

title: SciCore-Mol: Augmenting Large Language Models with Pluggable Molecular Cognition Modules
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are central to the one-for-all intelligent paradigm, but they face a fundamental challenge when dealing with heterogeneous scientific data such as molecules: the inherent gap between discrete linguistic symbols and topological molecular or continuous reaction data leads to significant information loss and semantic noise in text-based reasoning. We propose SciCore-Mol, a modular framework that bridges this gap through three deeply integrated pluggable cognitive modules: a topology-aware perception module, a latent diffusion-based molecular generation module, and a reaction-aware reasoning module. Each module is coupled to the LLM backbone through learned representation interfaces, enabling richer information exchange than is possible with text-only tool feedback. Our experiments on diverse chemical tasks demonstrate that SciCore-Mol achieves strong comprehensive performance across molecular understanding, generation, reaction prediction, and general chemistry knowledge, with an 8B-parameter open-source system that is competitive with and in several dimensions surpasses proprietary large models. This work provides a systematic blueprint for equipping LLMs with scientific expertise through decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modules, with direct implications for drug design, chemical synthesis, and broader scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SciCore-Mol通过三个可插拔认知模块（拓扑感知、分子生成、反应推理）弥合LLM与分子数据之间的语义差距，使8B开源模型在多项化学任务上达到或超越私有大模型的性能。
AI.motivation: LLM处理异构科学数据（如分子）时面临根本性挑战：离散语言符号与拓扑分子或连续反应数据之间的内在差距导致文本推理中信息严重丢失和语义噪声。
AI.method: 三个深度集成的可插拔认知模块：(1)拓扑感知模块，(2)基于潜在扩散的分子生成模块，(3)反应感知推理模块。每个模块通过学习到的表示接口与LLM骨干耦合，实现比纯文本工具反馈更丰富的信息交换。
AI.result: 在多种化学任务上表现出色，涵盖分子理解、生成、反应预测和通用化学知识；8B参数开源系统在与私有大型模型的比较中具有竞争力，并在多个维度超越后者。
AI.conclusion: SciCore-Mol为LLM配备科学专业知识提供了模块化、可插拔、灵活编排的蓝图，对药物设计、化学合成和更广泛的科学发现具有直接意义。

title: Position: The Time for Sampling Is Now! Charting a New Course for Bayesian Deep Learning
comment: In Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306, 2026
summary: The practical adoption of sampling-based inference (SAI) in Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) remains limited, partly due to persistent misconceptions about the feasibility and efficiency of sampling. This position paper argues that SAI has achieved computational parity with optimization-based methods and is at the verge of superseding such methods for effective and efficient inference in BNNs. This development should be in the interest of the whole community, promoting BNNs as a principled paradigm with its long-standing yet unfulfilled promise of providing principled uncertainty quantification for neural networks. SAI can even do more -- yielding superior prediction performance through model averaging, serving as the foundation for a plethora of possible downstream tasks, and providing crucial insights into the landscape of BNNs. In order to make such a change happen and unfold the potential of sampling, overcoming current misconceptions is a necessary first step. The next step is to realign research efforts toward addressing remaining challenges in SAI. In particular, the community must focus on two core problems: sufficient exploration of the posterior landscape and high-fidelity distillation of posterior samples for efficient downstream inference. By addressing conceptual and practical obstacles, we can unlock the full potential of SAI and establish it as a central tool in Bayesian deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张基于采样的推断（SAI）已与基于优化的贝叶斯近似方法在计算成本上持平，并即将取代后者成为贝叶斯深度学习的主流范式。作者指出社区对SAI存在时间复杂度、可扩展性、先验选择、Metropolis-Hastings调整、"冷后验效应"等持久误解，并呼吁研究重心从窄化的算法改进转向两大核心问题：充分探索后验景观，以及对后验样本进行高保真蒸馏以实现高效下游推断；同时呼吁建设标准化样本存储、共享与诊断工具链。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯深度学习（BDL）在捕捉深度学习系统的认知不确定性方面有 principled 承诺，但实践中被两类方法割裂：一类是强调渐近保证、依赖可微似然的采样式推断（SAI），长期被认为"太慢、无法扩展、只适用于小问题"；另一类把后验搜索改写为优化问题（VI、Laplace、子空间推断、SWA、深度集成DE），牺牲了后验结构的灵活性。根因在于社区把经典MCMC的教条简单移植到BNN语境中，形成关于时间复杂度、可扩展性、先验选择、未做MH调整的离散化误差、"冷后验效应"来源等误解；同时SAI缺乏从样本生成到存储、蒸馏、服务化、诊断、共享的端到端工具链，使得即便采样成功，其信息也无法被有效利用。论文目标是纠正这些认知误判并重新定向研究议程，使BNN兑现其长期未兑现的不确定性量化承诺。
AI.method: 论文采用立场论文体例：先形式化BNN后验、PPD与后验预测的蒙特卡洛（BMA）估计，区分SAI（似然显式可微、梯度可用）与SBI（无似然/模拟器）概念边界（附录B）；随后逐条"辟谣式"回应五类误解：时间复杂度（一旦获得好的链起点，采样时间与初始优化步相当，而旧式方法是10–100倍开销）、可扩展性（已有多种采样器在高维BNN上成功）、先验选择（各向同性高斯先验在过参数化区可能具正则化与隐式偏置效应，多项工作显示简单权重先验即达SOTA）、MH调整（高维下接受率极低、MC误差占主导，离散化偏差是次要误差源）、关键设计选择交互（"冷后验效应"多源于数据增强与分类似然的选择，而非先验-似然失配）。继而提出两大研究支柱：(1) 灵活探索优于受限近似——强调中尺度（ResNet/ViT/LLM适配器，参数10^5–10^7）评测区间；(2) 并行化、借助优化的探索——以DE作warm start、多链并行降低对局部近似误差的敏感性；并呼吁对SG-MCMC开展大规模经验研究与调参经验共享（posteriors、Fortuna、JaxSGMC、SGMCMCJax）。第二支柱聚焦采样后阶段：默认"先存后压"而非thin（存储成本低、保留信息供后处理），将后验样本蒸馏为后置优化阶段（数据压缩、序贯检验、权重空间生成式代理、子集/重要性采样、贝叶斯核心集、数据集蒸馏），并建立标准化的样本基准集合与标准化共享接口（如HuggingFace风格）、扩展ArviZ式诊断工具（参数空间诊断对不可辨识BNN无信息、函数空间诊断可能诱导误导性同质性）。附录给出Figure 2的复现实验细节（airfoil数据集、3隐层16单元MLP、10核CPU、含35成员DE的等预算比较）。
AI.result: 文中给出的经验证据（元研究表与图）表明：SAI在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10（LPPD -0.26 vs DE -0.30，精度0.91 vs 0.90）、ViT/Imagenette（LPPD -0.77 vs -0.99）、Wide CNN/CIFAR-10（NLL 0.31 vs SWA 0.56，ACE 0.005 vs 0.014）、Llama 3 8B 微调（OOD AUROC 0.95 vs SGD 0.80）上与优化型强基线持平或更优，且在同等或更大计算预算下仍占优；在airfoil回归上贝叶斯深度集成（BDE，1/10链×1000样本）的LPPD持续高于MFVI、Laplace与10/35成员DE，而匹配单链BDE性能需35个DE成员且墙钟时间更长。推理成本对比（Figure 3）显示，即便10核并行，现代采样型BNN的测试期前向传播开销可达普通DNN或线性化方法的最高1000倍，构成实际部署的主要瓶颈；这正是需要样本蒸馏而非朴素thin的原因。结论层面论文强调：不存在现实预算下保证平稳分布的采样，SAI本身仍是近似方法，目标是更好、更可信的近似而非渐近完美；对GPT-5量级全模型采样不现实，但低秩适配器采样与子网络推断提供了务实路径；BDL对LLM的收益需区分语义不确定性与认知不确定性，在判别式/结构化生成场景下PPD形式良好。
AI.conclusion: SAI已成为贝叶斯深度学习的新未来，但采纳的关键不在进一步的窄化算法改进，而在协同构建稳健、可及的端到端工作流：消除关于采样初始成本的过时误解，系统性解决"后验景观的充分探索"与"后验样本的高保真蒸馏与复用"两个核心问题，并通过标准化存储、基准集合、诊断与共享接口（后验即一等公民）补齐生态短板。作者呼吁社区以中尺度现代模型为实验阵地、公开调参与失败案例、拒绝朴素thin、优先发展并行优化引导的探索与面向下游任务的智能模型平均，从而把BNN从"理论理想"转变为可落地、可信赖的不确定性量化实践，并让SAI成为贝叶斯深度学习的中心工具。

title: Polite on the Surface, Wrong in Practice: A Curated Dataset for Fixing Honorific Failures in Multilingual Bangla Generation
summary: Recent advances in Multilingual Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly enhanced cross-lingual conversational capabilities, yet modeling culturally nuanced and context-dependent communication remains a critical bottleneck. Specifically, existing state-of-the-art models exhibit a severe pragmatic gap when handling structural variations, regional idioms, and honorific consistencies in low-resource contexts like Bangla. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel, culturally aligned instruction-tuning dataset for \textbf{BangLa Application and DialoguE generation - BLADE} and benchmarking framework comprising $4,196$ meticulously curated interaction pairs. We leverage this resource to systematically fine-tune and evaluate leading open-weight architectures, including DeepSeek-8B and LLaMA-3.2-3B, utilizing parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA adapters in a 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization framework. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate that models fine-tuned on our dataset yield substantial improvements in structural fidelity and honorific alignment, providing a rigorous benchmark for bridging pragmatic disparities in low-resource multilingual text generation. Code and dataset: https://github.com/ashuvo25/Bangla_Application_LLM/tree/main

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言（如孟加拉语）在结构变化、区域习语和敬语一致性方面的语用差距问题，构建了包含4,196条交互对的BLADE文化对齐指令微调数据集，采用LoRA+NF4量化技术微调DeepSeek-8B和LLaMA-3.2-3B，实验表明模型在结构保真度和敬语对齐方面取得显著改善。
AI.motivation: 现有最佳多语言大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理低资源语言（如孟加拉语）时，在结构变化、区域习语和敬语一致性方面存在严重的语用差距，这是跨语言对话能力的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建了包含4,196条精心策划的交互对的文化对齐指令微调数据集BLADE；采用LoRA适配器结合4位NF4量化技术对DeepSeek-8B和LLaMA-3.2-3B进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: 基于BLADE微调的模型在结构保真度和敬语对齐方面实现了显著提升，为低资源多语言文本生成中的语用差异弥合提供了有效验证。
AI.conclusion: BLADE数据集为低资源多语言文本生成中的语用差异弥合提供了严格的基准评估框架，证明了文化对齐的指令微调数据在提升模型跨语言 pragmatics 能力方面的有效性。

title: Manifold-Guided Attention Steering
summary: Large language models frequently produce errors in reasoning tasks despite possessing the underlying knowledge required for correct reasoning. One possible approach to improve reasoning consistency is through activation steering. However, existing activation steering approaches apply fixed, pre-computed correction vectors, ignoring where the model currently sits along its generation trajectory; the result is indiscriminate perturbation that disrupts already-correct steps as freely as erroneous ones. We propose Manifold-Guided Attention Steering (MAGS), a trajectory-aware inference-time intervention grounded in a geometric observation: the output activations of specific attention heads diverge from a low-dimensional correctness manifold at the point of error, and this deviation compounds through subsequent steps. For each identified attention head, we learn a low-dimensional subspace from contrastive pairs of correct and incorrect traces that capture the directions along which error behavior deviates from correct behavior. During inference, we monitor each head's proximity to this manifold and apply a targeted projection correction when deviation exceeds a learned threshold, steering the attention output back toward the correct subspace before the error propagates. MAGS consistently outperforms both unsteered baselines and static steering approaches across benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning (MATH-500, GSM8K), code generation (HumanEval, MBPP), and molecular generation (SMILES), suggesting that correctness manifolds are a general feature of LLM attention geometry.

AI.tldr: MAGS（Manifold-Guided Attention Steering）是一种推理时的注意力头激活引导方法：先为每个注意力头用「正确 vs 错误」对比轨迹的差分向量做 PCA，学到一个低维「错误子空间」，再在推理时实时监控该头当前输出在错误子空间上的投影幅度，超过逐头阈值即把该输出沿正交投影拉回正确子空间（只丢弃错误分量）。由于只在检测到漂移时才纠正，正确步骤不受扰动。在 MATH-500、GSM8K、HumanEval、MBPP 及 SMILES 分子生成上，MAGS 稳定优于 ITI、Angular Steering 与 Contrastive Decoding，最好提升 10.8%，且困惑度基本保持基线水平、推理开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 大模型在多步推理中会出错，但往往只是「表达不可靠」而非「能力缺失」——多次采样中同一问题既能答对也能答错，且过程标注显示错误多发生在中间推理步骤而非终局知识缺失。因此推理时干预是天然目标。然而现有激活引导方法（Activation Addition、CAA、RepE、Angular Steering、ITI、CREST）都在生成全程施加固定的、预先算好的校正向量，无法区分「已经正确的步骤」与「刚刚出错的步骤」，既会破坏正确步骤，也不保证能拦截真正的错误点。此外，既有可解释性研究（线性表示假设、注意力头功能特化）虽指出语义差异沿低维线性方向编码，但未把这种几何结构用于自适应的、逐步条件化的干预。
AI.method: 1) 流形构建：对每个问题采样 S 条推理轨迹，按最终答案是否正确分为 T_i^+、T_i^-；对每头 (l,h) 计算正确/错误类均值 μ_c,i、μ_e,i，取差向量 δ_i = μ_e,i − μ_c,i（抵消问题本身的难度/主题成分，只保留错误特异的方向）；把所有问题的差向量堆成 D，做紧凑 SVD，取前 k 个右奇异向量为错误子空间基 B（k×d_h，行正交归一），并用全部正确轨迹得到全局正确中心 μ_c。2) 误差检测：在每个解码步计算邻近度分数 d_t = ||B(a_t − μ_c)||²（中心化输出在错误子空间上的投影平方范数）；逐头阈值 τ 取正确轨迹上该分数的 q 分位数，只有 d_t > τ 才触发。3) 引导：触发时按 ã = a − α B^T B (a − μ_c) 修正（在输出投影 W_O 之前、就地替换），等价于保留正交补分量 P⊥(a−μ_c)；α∈(0,1] 为强度。命题 1 证明该修正保留错误子空间正交补中的全部信息。4) 头选择：按留出集上轨迹级 AUROC 选 top-K 头，每步开销从 O(L·H·k·d_h) 降为 O(K·k·d_h)。5) 多目标版本 MAGS^u：为每个目标各学一套独立流形，头集合自然不相交，推理时对并集头各用自身流形纠正，避免目标间冲突。
AI.result: 数学推理（MATH-500、GSM8K）、代码生成（HumanEval、MBPP）上，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Gemma-4-E4b-it 上 MAGS 全面超过无引导基线及三种基线：Llama MATH-500 0.478→0.530（+5.2 点），Gemma 0.614→0.648（+3.4 点，最大提升 10.8% 相对量级）；HumanEval pass@1 约 +4 点，且 ITI/AS/CD 在 Gemma 上反而降低 HumanEval（无条件干预破坏句法一致性），而 MAGS 因触发门控避免了该失效模式。困惑度上 MAGS 基本与无引导基线持平，而 ITI/AS 通常抬高 PPL。分子生成（GPT-OSS-20B）：MAGS^u 有效性 54.8%、结合亲和力 −7.56 kcal/mol，优于 ITI（有效性 57.8% 但亲和力仅 −7.20，说明过校正到通用安全骨架）。消融显示 MAGS 对超参不敏感（MATH-500 准确率 0.492–0.530），而 ITI（0.214–0.498）与 AS（0.206–0.506）极易崩溃。潜空间轨迹可视化显示：无引导轨迹持续漂离正确分布且不恢复，MAGS 在纠正步后立即回到高密度正确区并保持，ITI 干预后仍继续漂移——几何上解释了静态干预失效的原因。注意力图分析显示纠正后的键成为后续所有查询步的「注意力锚点」。统计显著性用 B=10000 的 95% bootstrap CI 给出。
AI.conclusion: 正确性流形是 LLM 注意力几何的普遍特征，MAGS 表明推理引导可重新表述为「漂移检测 + 子空间投影回正」问题：低秩基 B 指明了最具预测误差起始性的方向，是标量幅值方法所不具备的可解释几何结构。它在数学推理、代码生成与分子生成三类任务、三个模型家族上一致优于静态引导与对比解码，且几乎不增加推理开销。局限与未来方向：需要成对对比轨迹来拟合流形（低资源领域难获取）；目标头目前离线固定，应改为按生成上下文动态选头；各头独立建模，联合建模头间交互或可更省算力；流形在同域内跨任务（如算术到符号推理）的迁移性仍待验证。

title: Scene Abstraction for Lexical Semantics: Structured Representations of Situated Meaning
summary: Coffee and tea share many properties, yet they evoke strikingly different situations, atmospheres, and affective associations. These situated dimensions of word meaning are real and systematic, but they remain implicit in most computational representations of lexical meaning. We propose Scene Abstraction, a framework for constructing structured representations of the interpretive scenes that words participate in across usage contexts. Each scene consists of a Contextual Scene (Events, Entities, Setting) and an expression-centered Expression Profile (Engaged events, Generalizable properties, Evoked emotions), operationalized through few-shot prompting of a large language model. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) a structured representation framework for situated lexical meaning; (2) COCA-Scenes, a dataset of 520 usage instances across 26 keywords for distinct scene identification; and (3) empirical evidence from two experiments suggesting that scenes are reliably identifiable across human observers (82.4% accuracy, +11.8 pp over text-only embeddings) and that our scene profiles more closely align with human interpretation of words in context than ATOMIC-based alternatives (86.4% preference across three semantic dimensions).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"场景抽象"(Scene Abstraction)框架,通过结构化表示(情境场景+表达画像)捕捉词语的使用情境意义,在COCA-Scenes数据集(520个实例,26个关键词)上验证,场景识别准确率达82.4%,用户偏好度86.4%,显著优于传统文本嵌入和ATOMIC基线方法。
AI.motivation: Coffee and tea share many properties yet evoke strikingly different situations, atmospheres, and affective associations. These situated dimensions of word meaning are real and systematic but remain implicit in most computational representations of lexical meaning.
AI.method: Scene Abstraction constructs structured representations of interpretive scenes through: (1) Contextual Scene (Events, Entities, Setting); (2) Expression Profile (Engaged events, Generalizable properties, Evoked emotions), operationalized via few-shot prompting of a large language model.
AI.result: Scenes are reliably identifiable across human observers (82.4% accuracy, +11.8 pp over text-only embeddings) and scene profiles more closely align with human interpretation than ATOMIC-based alternatives (86.4% preference across three semantic dimensions).
AI.conclusion: Scene Abstraction provides a more human-aligned representation of situated lexical meaning compared to existing text-only embeddings and ATOMIC-based alternatives, achieving 82.4% inter-rater reliability and 86.4% user preference.

title: Meta-Soft: Leveraging Composable Meta-Tokens for Context-Preserving KV Cache Compression
summary: The KV cache used in large language models has linearly growing time complexity, so LLMs face memory blow-up and reduced decoding efficiency when they process long contexts.Current KV Cache eviction has become an important research direction; however, existing methods based on fixed Soft Tokens (e.g., Judge Q) rely on a static parameter set as the query to evaluate the importance of KV pairs, so they cannot adapt dynamically to different input prompts, and they cannot precisely capture complex and changing task relevance.Also, evicted KV pairs are discarded permanently, so this causes irreversible information loss and context breaks. To address this problem, we propose Meta-Soft, a dynamic compression framework based on probe-driven context integration. Specifically, we build a meta-library with a learnable orthogonal basis matrix $\mathcal{L}$, and we use a selector network with Gumbel-Softmax to produce differentiable sparse combination weights, so we dynamically synthesize the most targeted $k$ Soft Tokens from the input prompt features.We append these Soft Tokens to the end of the input sequence to probe key information. We also introduce an attention-flow based integration mechanism, which redistributes the semantic information of removed tokens into retained tokens, and this keeps the dropped context information effectively.Experiments on multiple datasets show that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art eviction methods and provides a new solution for KV Cache compression.

AI.tldr: Meta-Soft addresses limitations of fixed Soft Token-based KV Cache eviction by using a learnable meta-library with Gumbel-Softmax selection to dynamically synthesize targeted soft tokens, and redistributes dropped context information through attention-flow mechanism.
AI.motivation: Existing KV Cache eviction methods using fixed Soft Tokens rely on static parameters and cannot adapt to different input prompts or capture complex task relevance. Additionally, permanently discarding evicted KV pairs causes irreversible information loss.
AI.method: Meta-Soft builds a meta-library with learnable orthogonal basis matrix, uses a Gumbel-Softmax selector network to generate differentiable sparse weights for synthesizing targeted k Soft Tokens from input features, appends these tokens to probe key information, and introduces an attention-flow based integration mechanism to redistribute semantic information from removed tokens into retained ones.
AI.result: Meta-Soft outperforms existing state-of-the-art eviction methods on multiple datasets.
AI.conclusion: Meta-Soft provides a new solution for KV Cache compression, outperforming existing state-of-the-art eviction methods.

title: Provable Robustness against Backdoor Attacks via the Primal-Dual Perspective on Differential Privacy
summary: Randomized smoothing is a powerful tool for certifying robustness to adversarial perturbations, including poisoning attacks via randomized training and evasion attacks via randomized inference. Extending these guarantees to backdoor attacks, where training and test data are jointly perturbed, remains challenging because training- and test-time randomized mechanisms must be analyzed within a single robustness certificate. We address this by connecting randomized smoothing to the dual view of differential privacy through privacy profiles, which provide a numerical procedure for composing heterogeneous mechanisms. The resulting framework enables tight, modular, end-to-end certification of complex, composed mechanisms while leveraging existing analyses of differentially private mechanisms. We instantiate the framework for DP-SGD and Deep Partition Aggregation with inference-time smoothing, deriving joint robustness guarantees against both training-time and inference-time attacks. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Overall, we provide a principled and general framework for using composite mechanisms to certify robustness under complex threat models that better capture the capabilities of real-world adversaries.

AI.tldr: 该论文将随机平滑与差分隐私通过隐私配置文件连接，实现异构机制的有效组合，从而在统一框架下同时认证训练时和推理时的后门攻击鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有随机平滑技术难以同时应对后门攻击中训练时和测试时的对抗扰动，因为需要在一个鲁棒性证书中同时分析训练期和推理期的随机化机制。
AI.method: 通过隐私配置文件将随机平滑与差分隐私的对偶视图连接起来，提供了一种异构机制数值组合的程序。该框架能够利用现有的差分隐私机制分析，实现紧密、模块化的端到端认证。
AI.result: 为DP-SGD和深度分区聚合方法推导出联合鲁棒性保证，能够同时抵御训练时和推理时攻击。
AI.conclusion: 提供了使用组合机制认证复杂威胁模型下鲁棒性的原则性和通用框架。实验在MNIST和CIFAR-10上验证了框架有效性。

title: Scaling Observation-aware Planning in Uncertain Domains
summary: Deciding which sensing capabilities to deploy on an agent in uncertain domains is a fundamental engineering challenge, in which one balances task achievability against the high costs of hardware and processing. This problem has previously been formalized as the Optimal Observability Problem (OOP), based on the well-known Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) model for decision-making. This work studies (sub-)symbolic techniques to scale solving of decidable fragments of the OOP, namely the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP) and the Positional Observability Problem (POP). Besides improving the original approach based on parameter synthesis, we develop a new solving method that identifies sensible observation functions via decomposition of POMDPs, improving performance by 3 and 5 orders of magnitude for instance size and runtime, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可观测性问题的可判定片段（SSP和POP），提出了改进的参数合成方法以及基于POMDP分解的新型求解技术，显著提升了最优可观测性问题的求解效率。
AI.motivation: 在不确定领域中，为智能体部署何种感知能力是一个基础工程挑战，需要在任务可实现性与硬件及处理高成本之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 提出了两种技术方法：1）改进了原有的参数合成方法；2）开发了基于POMDP分解的新求解方法，用于识别合理的观测函数。
AI.result: 通过实例规模和运行时间两个维度验证，新方法分别实现了3个和5个数量级的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于POMDP分解的新方法，在实例规模和运行时间上分别实现了3个和5个数量级的性能提升，为可观测性工程提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: MMD-Balls as Credal Sets: A PAC-Bayesian Framework for Epistemic Uncertainty in Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 15 pages, 0 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML@ICML 2026)
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods improve model performance under distribution shift but lack formal guarantees connecting shift magnitude to prediction reliability. We develop a PAC-Bayesian framework yielding generalization bounds explicitly parameterized by the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between source and target distributions. Our principal contribution is interpreting MMD-balls around the source distribution as credal sets in Walley's imprecise probability theory, yielding natural epistemic uncertainty quantification. We establish: (i) a PAC-Bayesian bound with an MMD-dependent shift penalty under an RKHS-Lipschitz loss assumption; (ii) a finite-sample version via MMD concentration; (iii) a uniform worst-case risk bound over all distributions in the credal set, with a lower-upper risk decomposition; and (iv) geodesic preservation bounds explaining why kernel-guided adaptation protects local feature geometry. The credal set interpretation separates epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty and provides a principled decision criterion for when adaptation is warranted.

AI.tldr: This paper develops a PAC-Bayesian framework for test-time adaptation that connects distribution shift magnitude to prediction reliability through MMD-based bounds, interpreted as credal sets for epistemic uncertainty quantification, providing both theoretical guarantees and practical criteria for when adaptation should be applied.
AI.motivation: Current test-time adaptation (TTA) methods improve model performance under distribution shift but lack formal guarantees connecting shift magnitude to prediction reliability. There is no principled way to quantify when adaptation is trustworthy.
AI.method: PAC-Bayesian framework with MMD (Maximum Mean Discrepancy) between source and target distributions; MMD-balls interpreted as credal sets in Walley's imprecise probability theory; RKHS-Lipschitz loss assumption; geodesic preservation bounds for kernel-guided adaptation.
AI.result: (i) PAC-Bayesian bound with MMD-dependent shift penalty under RKHS-Lipschitz loss; (ii) Finite-sample version via MMD concentration; (iii) Uniform worst-case risk bound over all distributions in the credal set with lower-upper risk decomposition; (iv) Geodesic preservation bounds explaining kernel-guided adaptation protecting local feature geometry.
AI.conclusion: Credal set interpretation effectively separates epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty, providing a principled decision criterion for determining when test-time adaptation is warranted. The framework offers both theoretical guarantees and practical decision guidance for model deployment under distribution shift.

title: Three Costs of Amortizing Gaussian Process Inference with Neural Processes
summary: Neural processes amortize Gaussian process inference, replacing the exact $O(n^3)$ posterior with a learned $O(n)$ map from context sets to predictive distributions. For a class of latent neural processes, we bound the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between the GP and LNP predictives, decomposing it into three interpretable sources, namely label contamination as the neural process uses label values to estimate a quantity that is label-independent in the exact GP, an information bottleneck because the finite-dimensional representation cannot resolve the full context geometry, and amortization error from a single encoder network shared across all contexts. The bottleneck truncation term decays in the representation dimension $d$ as $O(e^{-cd^{2/d_x}})$ for squared-exponential kernels on $\mathbb{R}^{d_x}$ where $c > 0$ is a kernel-dependent constant and as $O(d^{-2ν/d_x})$ for Matérn-$ν$ kernels, directly linking architecture sizing to kernel smoothness and input dimension. The label contamination term is $O(1)$ in general, with only the observation-noise component decaying as $O(1/n)$, identifying a persistent cost of routing uncertainty estimation through a label-dependent representation. These results characterize the costs of amortization within the analyzed class and yield architectural recommendations to predict variance from context locations alone in the GP-amortization regime, and replace mean aggregation with second-order pooling to close the dominant amortization gap.
