title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora
summary: Moral language is subtle and culturally variable, making it difficult to translate faithfully across languages. Idiomatic expressions, slang, and cultural references introduce hard-to-avoid translation artifacts. Yet automated moral values classification depends on language-specific annotated corpora that exist almost exclusively in English. We investigate whether LLM-based translation can bridge this gap, taking Polish as a test case. Using $\sim$50k morally-annotated social media posts from a diverse range of topics, we apply a principled four-method validation pipeline: LaBSE cross-lingual embedding similarity, Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), LLM-as-judge evaluation, and deep learning classifier parity tests. We show that despite shortcomings in handling slang, vulgarity, and culturally-loaded expressions, direct translation preserves subtle moral cues well enough to be harvested by cross-lingual machine learning -- with mean cosine similarity of 0.86 and AUC gaps of 0.01--0.02 across all foundations closing further under fine-tuning of language models. These results demonstrate that machine translation is a practical and cost-effective path to moral values research in languages currently under-resourced in this domain. We demonstrate this for Polish as a representative Slavic language, with expected generalisation to related languages.

AI.tldr: This paper demonstrates that LLM-based translation can effectively bridge the gap for cross-lingual moral values classification, using Polish as a test case. Through rigorous four-method validation, they show translation preserves moral cues well enough (0.86 cosine similarity, 0.01-0.02 AUC gaps) to enable machine learning approaches in under-resourced languages.
AI.motivation: Moral language is culturally variable and difficult to translate, while automated moral values classification depends on English-specific annotated corpora, creating a resource gap for other languages.
AI.method: Applied a four-method validation pipeline (LaBSE cross-lingual embedding similarity, CKA, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and deep learning classifier parity tests) to ~50k morally-annotated Polish social media posts, with fine-tuning of language models.
AI.result: Direct translation preserves subtle moral cues effectively despite shortcomings with slang, vulgarity, and culturally-loaded expressions. Achieved mean cosine similarity of 0.86 and AUC gaps of only 0.01-0.02 across all moral foundations, with further improvement under fine-tuning.
AI.conclusion: Machine translation is a practical and cost-effective path to moral values research in under-resourced languages, demonstrated for Polish with expected generalization to related Slavic languages.

title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
summary: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 representative, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehensive benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified across eight frontier models and six agents reveals that current systems still struggle with authentic terminal workflows, achieving a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. Moreover, TerminalWorld captures real-world terminal capabilities distinct from existing expert-curated benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench), with only a weak correlation to their scores (Pearson r=0.20). The automated engine makes TerminalWorld authentic and scalable by construction, enabling it to evaluate agents in real-world terminal environments as developer practices evolve. Data and code are available at https://github.com/EuniAI/TerminalWorld.

AI.tldr: TerminalWorld is an automated benchmark engine that extracts 1,530 real-world terminal tasks from 80,870 in-the-wild recordings. Testing 8 frontier models and 6 agents reveals a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%, with only weak correlation (r=0.20) to existing benchmarks, highlighting gaps in current terminal agent capabilities.
AI.motivation: Existing terminal benchmarks rely on expert curation, which may not adequately capture authentic real-world developer practices. As developer workflows evolve, there is a need for benchmarks that can automatically and scalably evaluate agents in realistic terminal environments.
AI.method: TerminalWorld employs an automated data engine that reverse-engineers evaluation tasks from 80,870 in-the-wild terminal recordings. This process yielded 1,530 validated tasks across 18 categories and 1,280 unique commands, from which 200 representative tasks were manually curated into a Verified subset. Benchmarking was conducted across 8 frontier models and 6 agents.
AI.result: Current frontier models and agents perform poorly on authentic terminal workflows, with a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. TerminalWorld shows weak correlation with existing expert-curated benchmarks (Pearson r=0.20), suggesting it captures distinct real-world capabilities.
AI.conclusion: TerminalWorld provides an authentic and scalable benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world terminal environments. Current frontier models achieve only up to 62.5% pass rate, indicating significant room for improvement. The weak correlation (r=0.20) with existing benchmarks highlights that TerminalWorld captures unique real-world terminal capabilities not covered by expert-curated benchmarks, making it a valuable complementary evaluation tool.

title: OPPO: Bayesian Value Recursion for Token-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the standard recipe for improving LLM reasoning, but the dominant algorithm GRPO assigns a single trajectory-level advantage to every token, diluting the signal at pivotal reasoning steps and injecting noise at uninformative ones. Critic-free alternatives derived from on-policy distillation supply per-token signals through oracle-conditioned likelihood ratios, yet apply each signal in isolation from the trajectory-level evidence accumulated up to that position. We propose Oracle-Prompted Policy Optimization (OPPO), which rests on a single observation: the oracle signal used by prior distillation-style methods for local discrimination is also the natural Bayesian update of the model's belief about eventual success. Accumulating the signal along a trajectory yields, in closed form and at the cost of one extra forward pass, a running estimate of the success probability at every position, together with a token-level advantage that requires no learned value network and no additional rollouts. A first-order analysis factorizes the advantage into the per-token discrimination signal used by distillation methods modulated by a state weight that concentrates credit on genuinely pivotal tokens, with a directional variance-reduction guarantee. The framework admits two estimators differing only in which model scores the evidence: a \textit{self-oracle} that reuses the student and recovers the on-policy distillation reward as a strict special case, and a \textit{teacher-oracle} that delegates scoring to a stronger frozen model. On two base LLMs across seven mathematics, science, and code reasoning benchmarks, OPPO improves over GRPO, DAPO, and SDPO by up to $+6.0$ points on AMC'23 and $+5.2$ points on AIME'24, with gains that widen monotonically with response length.

AI.tldr: OPPO（Oracle-Prompted Policy Optimization）把「on-policy 蒸馏中用到的 oracle 条件似然比 log λ_t」重新解释为「模型对最终成功概率的贝叶斯后验更新」，沿轨迹累加即可闭式得到每个位置的成功概率估计 V_t 与 token 级优势 A_t，无需学习价值网络、无需额外 rollout，仅多一次前向传播；该 token 优势在 GRPO 流水线内以「方向锚定」保证符号与序列级奖励一致。实验在 Qwen3-4B 与 Phi-4-mini、七个数学/科学/代码基准上一致优于 GRPO、DAPO、SDPO，且增益随回答长度单调扩大。
AI.motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的主流范式，但主流算法 GRPO 把同一个轨迹级优势广播给所有 token，导致：(1) 决定结果的关键推理步（策略选择、关键代数变换、关键逻辑推理）信号被稀释，信号强度按 k/T 衰减；(2) 无信息位置获得零期望贡献的梯度噪声，长链推理下问题尤为严重。Dr.GRPO/DAPO/GSPO/GMPO 等变体虽改进重要性比、裁剪或归一化，但仍是轨迹级标量。另一条路线（VinePPO/TreeRL 需巨量推理，PRIME 需在线更新 PRM，SPO 仅做段级聚合）成本高或粒度不足。最接近的是带特权信息（真值答案 y*）的 on-policy 蒸馏（RLSD、SDPO 等）：它们用 log λ_t = log π_teacher(y_t|s_t) − log π_student(y_t|s_t) 作为 per-token 奖励，但该信号是纯局部的、各位置等权、未与沿 y_<t 累积的轨迹级证据（以及最终结果 R）耦合。论文因此需要一种既保留 OPD 稠密信号、又按位置重新分配信用预算 R−V_0 的机制。
AI.method: 核心观察：log λ_t 同时是 (a) 成功条件最优策略 π* 与学生策略之间的专家对数比（OPD 梯度信号），(b) 关于「最终是否成功」这一隐变量的贝叶斯充分统计量。据此推导闭式贝叶斯值递推：以贝叶斯因子 λ*_t = P(y_t|R=1)/P(y_t|R=0)，通过对数几率 ℓ_t = log(V_t/(1−V_t)) 累加得 ℓ_{t+1} = ℓ_t + log λ*_t，从而 V_t = σ(ℓ_0 + Σ_{s<t} log λ_s)，token 优势 A_t = σ(ℓ_t+log λ_t) − σ(ℓ_t)，满足望远镜恒等式 Σ_t A_t = R − V_0（与 GRPO 需分配的信用预算一致）；并有 Lipschitz 与范围界 |A_t| ≤ min(¼|log λ_t|, 1)。一阶分解：A_t ≈ V_t(1−V_t)·log λ_t，即「蒸馏式的 per-token 判别信号」乘以「状态权重 V_t(1−V_t)」（在信念最不确定处最大、在轨迹定型后趋零）。在理想化得分向量互不相关假设下证明方向性的方差缩减不等式（附录 C，注明自回归模型中得分相关，故仅为方向性指示）。Oracle 构造：成功支路近似为 π̂(y_t|x, y_<t, y*)，失败支路近似为边缘 π̂(y_t|x, y_<t)，得统一估计 log λ_t = log π̂(y_t|x,y_<t,y*) − log π̂(y_t|x,y_<t)；π̂=π_θ 即 self-oracle（恰好复现 OPD 的 per-token 奖励，为严格特例），π̂=冻结的 π_φ 即 teacher-oracle（更小 ε_t）。实现细节：Beta(α,α) 先验给出 V̂_0=(k+α)/(G+2α) 与 ℓ_0；证据裁剪 log λ̂ = clip(o−s, −C, C)（C=3.0）防止单 token 饱和 ℓ_t；方向锚定 Â_{i,t} = sign(A_i^seq)·|A^raw_{i,t}|，再组内标准化，其中 A^seq 是 GRPO 的序列级标准化优势，保证验证器仍是唯一决定「哪条轨迹被强化」的主体，贝叶斯机制只负责轨迹内的信用再分配；最后代入 PPO 裁剪代理目标更新。整体开销为每条轨迹多一次 oracle 前向传播。
AI.result: 在 DeepScaleR 上训练、Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Phi-4-mini-instruct 两个基座、GSM8K/MATH-500/AMC'23/AIME'24/GPQA-D/ARC-C/LiveCodeBench 七个基准评测：Self-OPPO 在两个模型、全部七个基准上一致优于 GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO/SDPO（如 Qwen3 上 MATH-500 72.8→76.0、AMC 54.0→58.5、AIME 46.4→49.5）；Teacher-OPPO（Qwen3-32B 评分）进一步提升（AMC 最高 +6.0、AIME'24 最高 +5.2；叠在 DAPO 上时 AMC +5.7、AIME +5.2）。消融显示方向锚定最关键（移除后 AIME'24 低于 GRPO，出现「奖励倒置」），其次是状态跟踪；仅用 log λ_t 接近 GRPO。Oracle 规模从 4B→8B→14B→32B 性能单调提升（4B→8B 跳幅最大）；按回答长度分层时增益单调扩大（1025+ 长度段 52.0→62.8），Pass@K 在 K=1/4/8/16 上均提升。分析部分：|A_t| 比 |log λ_t| 分布更集中，32B teacher 在关键 token 处更锐利；望远镜预算残差随长度分位与结果分层单调上升（R=0 高于 R=1，因错误轨迹 V_t 饱和更早），MATH-500 上残差均值 0.007；Brier 分数沿轨迹单调下降且 teacher 优于 self，验证 V_t 的校准性；超时开销 self-oracle +35%、teacher-oracle +95%；超参 C∈[2,5]、α∈[0.5,2] 稳定，G=4~32 时增益稳定（+3.5~+3.9）。
AI.conclusion: OPPO 表明 on-policy 蒸馏的 per-token oracle 奖励可被理解为成功概率的贝叶斯滤波更新，由此在不引入学习式 critic、不增加 rollout 的前提下恢复 token 级信用分配：把证据累积成运行后验，用状态权重 V_t(1−V_t) 把信用集中到真正决定成败的 token 上，并用方向锚定把符号决定权交还给环境奖励。实验显示该机制在数学、科学、代码推理上稳定优于轨迹级与 oracle 条件基线，且增益随序列变长而扩大、更强 oracle 带来单调收益；与 DAPO 等优化机制改进互补。局限与展望：需要训练期可验证的真值答案（无法用于无标准答案域）；对非二值/部分得分等更丰富结果信号的贝叶斯递归适配、以及推理期以自 oracle 做置信度加权解码等方向留待后续工作；方差缩减结论依赖理想化假设，仅具方向性。

title: Self-Policy Distillation via Capability-Selective Subspace Projection
summary: Self-distillation bootstraps large language models (LLMs) by training on their own generations. However, existing methods either rely on external signals to curate self-generated outputs (e.g., correctness filtering, execution feedback, and reward search), which are costly and unavailable for the best-performing frontier models, or skip curation entirely and train on all raw outputs, an approach that is often domain-specific and hard to generalize. Both also share a deeper weakness that self-generated outputs entangle task-relevant capability with others, such as stylistic patterns, formatting artifacts, and model-specific errors, diluting the signal for the specific capability one aims to improve. In this paper, we propose Self-Policy Distillation (SPD), which achieves generalizable, capability selective without any external signal. Specifically, SPD extracts a low-rank capability subspace from the model's own gradients on correctness-defining tokens, projects key-value (KV) activations into this subspace during self-generation, and fine-tunes on the resulting raw outputs with standard next-token prediction loss. Through extensive experiments across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multiple-choice QA, we show that SPD achieves up to 13% improvement over state-of-the-art self-distillation methods without external signals and up to 16% improvement over pre-trained baselines. Notably, SPD demonstrates superior generalizability, achieving 15% better performance under out-of-domain generalization settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自策略蒸馏（SPD），一种无需外部信号即可实现能力选择性提升的自我蒸馏方法。SPD从模型在正确定义标记上的梯度中提取低秩能力子空间，在自生成过程中将KV激活投影到该子空间，并使用标准下一个标记预测损失进行微调。在代码生成、数学推理和多选问答任务上，SPD相比现有方法提升可达13%，相比预训练基线提升达16%，域外泛化提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏方法存在两个问题：1）依赖外部信号（正确性过滤、执行反馈、奖励搜索）来筛选自生成输出，成本高且前沿模型不可用；2）完全跳过筛选，直接训练所有原始输出，但领域特异性强且泛化困难。更深层的问题是，自生成输出将任务相关能力与风格模式、格式伪影、模型特定错误等纠缠在一起，稀释了目标能力提升的信号。
AI.method: SPD的三个核心步骤：1）从模型在正确定义标记上的梯度中提取低秩能力子空间；2）在自生成过程中将KV激活投影到该子空间；3）使用标准下一个标记预测损失对生成的原始输出进行微调。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理和多选问答任务中，SPD相比无外部信号的最先进自蒸馏方法提升达13%，相比预训练基线提升达16%。在域外泛化设置下性能提升达15%，展现了卓越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SPD成功实现了无需任何外部信号即可进行通用化、能力选择性的自我蒸馏，为大语言模型的自我提升提供了一种高效且普适的解决方案。

title: Think Thrice Before You Speak: Dual knowledge-enhanced Theory-of-Mind Reasoning for Persuasive Agents
summary: Persuasive dialogue requires reasoning about others' latent mental states, a capability known as Theory of Mind (ToM). However, due to reliance on simple prompting strategies and insufficient ToM knowledge, existing LLMs often fail to capture the intrinsic dependencies among mental states, leading to fragmented representations and unstable reasoning. To address these challenges, we introduce the ToM-based Persuasive Dialogue (ToM-PD) task, grounded in the Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) framework, which explicitly models the sequential dependencies among mental states in multi-turn dialogues. To facilitate research on this task, we construct a large-scale annotated dataset, ToM-based Broad Persuasive Dialogues (ToM-BPD), capturing fine-grained mental states and corresponding persuasive strategies. We further propose Think Thrice Before You Speak (TTBYS), a knowledge-enhanced stepwise reasoning framework that leverages both explicit and implicit prior experiences to improve LLMs' inference of desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies. Experimental results demonstrate that Qwen3-8B equipped with TTBYS outperforms GPT-5 by 1.20%, 22.80%, and 16.97% in predicting desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies, respectively. Case studies further show that our approach enhances interpretability and consistency in reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToM-PD任务和ToM-BPD数据集，基于BDI框架显式建模多轮对话中心理状态的序列依赖关系，并提出TTBYS框架增强LLM的ToM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM由于依赖简单提示策略和对ToM知识不足，难以捕捉心理状态间的内在依赖关系，导致表征碎片化和推理不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了TTBYS（Think Thrice Before You Speak）知识增强的逐步推理框架，利用显式和隐式先验经验来增强LLM对欲望、信念和说服策略的推断能力。
AI.result: 装备TTBYS的Qwen3-8B在欲望预测上优于GPT-5 1.20%，信念预测上优于22.80%，说服策略预测上优于16.97%。
AI.conclusion: TTBYS框架使Qwen3-8B在各项预测任务上显著超越GPT-5，案例研究证明该方法增强了推理的可解释性和一致性。

title: The Illusion of Reasoning: Exposing Evasive Data Contamination in LLMs via Zero-CoT Truncation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abilities across a wide range of tasks, but data contamination undermines the objective evaluation of these capabilities. This problem is further exacerbated by malicious model publishers who use evasive, or indirect, contamination strategies, such as paraphrasing benchmark data to evade existing detection methods and artificially boost leaderboard performance. Current approaches struggle to reliably detect such stealthy contamination. In this work, we uncover a critical phenomenon: a model's generated reasoning steps actively mask its underlying memorization. Inspired by this, we propose the Zero-CoT Probe (ZCP), a novel black-box detection method that deliberately truncates the entire Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process to expose latent shortcut mappings. To further isolate memorization from the model's intrinsic problem-solving capabilities, ZCP compares the model's zero-CoT performance on the original benchmark against an isomorphically perturbed reference dataset. Furthermore, we introduce Contamination Confidence, a metric that quantifies both the likelihood and severity of contamination, moving beyond simple binary classifications. Extensive experiments on both previously identified contaminated models and specially fine-tuned contaminated models demonstrate that ZCP robustly detects both direct and evasive data contamination. The code for ZCP is accessible at https://github.com/Yifan-Lan/zero-cot-probe.

AI.tldr: 论文针对LLM评估中的数据污染检测问题，提出Zero-CoT Probe (ZCP)方法。该方法利用模型推理过程掩盖记忆这一发现，通过截断CoT链暴露潜在捷径，并结合扰动参考数据集和Contamination Confidence指标，实现对直接和规避性污染的稳健检测。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型评估面临数据污染问题，特别是恶意发布者使用间接污染策略（如释义基准数据）规避现有检测方法，导致排行榜性能被人为提升。
AI.method: 提出Zero-CoT Probe (ZCP)方法，通过完全截断Chain-of-Thought过程来暴露潜在的捷径映射；同时引入受扰动的参考数据集进行对比；并提出Contamination Confidence指标量化污染的可能性和严重程度。
AI.result: 实验表明ZCP能稳健检测直接污染和规避性污染两种类型。
AI.conclusion: ZCP通过截断CoT推理过程暴露隐藏的捷径映射，有效解决了现有方法难以检测的规避性污染问题，为LLM评估提供了更可靠的方法论工具。

title: Tokenization with Split Trees
summary: We introduce Tokenization with Split Trees (ToaST), a subword tokenization method that directly optimizes compression under a new recursive inference procedure. ToaST greedily splits each pretoken into a full binary tree using precomputed byte n-gram counts, independent of any vocabulary. Given a vocabulary, inference recursively descends each split tree and emits the first in-vocabulary node reached on each path. Vocabulary selection is formulated as an Integer Program (IP) that minimizes the total token count over all split trees under this inference procedure. The Linear Programming (LP) relaxation is near-integral in practice, yielding provably near-optimal vocabularies, with training time empirically scaling quadratically in the number of split trees. On English text, ToaST reduces token counts by more than 11% compared to BPE, WordPiece, and UnigramLM at vocabulary sizes of 40,960 and above, reducing the number of inference tokens for models using this tokenizer, thus extending the effective context length. ToaST also uses common single-byte tokens less frequently than these baselines, leading to a substantial improvement in Renyi efficiency. In experiments training 1.5B parameter language models, ToaST achieves the highest CORE score, outperforming baselines by 2.6%--7.6%, with significance for two of three, and scoring best on 13 of 22 individual tasks.

AI.tldr: ToaST 是一种在递归推理过程下直接优化压缩率的子词分词方法：它用预计算字节 n-gram 计数把每个预分词单元贪心拆成完整二叉树，再通过整数规划（IP）选择词表以最小化总 token 数。LP 松弛接近整数解，因此可证明词表近似最优。英文文本上在词表规模 ≥40,960 时比 BPE、WordPiece、UnigramLM 减少超过 11% 的 token 数，并显著改善 Rényi 效率；训练 1.5B 参数语言模型取得最高 CORE 分数（领先 2.6%–7.6%），在 22 项任务中 13 项最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有子词分词方法（BPE、WordPiece、UnigramLM）普遍采用"贪心/局部合并"或"似然最优"的构造目标，与语言模型实际使用的推理（tokenization）过程并不一致：Unigram 的词表在推理时按后验概率独立选择最优切分，而 BPE/WordPiece 则依赖合并顺序。这意味着分词阶段优化的目标与推理阶段的压缩率脱节，导致实际 token 数高于理论最优。此外，这些方法均依赖一个既定的候选词表（vocabulary）进行合并或打分，压缩效率受限于候选集本身。论文的核心动机是：若能先在无词表依赖的条件下确定每个词元的最优"切分结构"，再据此反推最优词表，就能直接对齐训练与推理目标，从而在固定词表规模下获得更短的序列与更长的有效上下文。
AI.method: 1) 无词表依赖的结构生成：使用预计算的字节 n-gram 计数，对每个 pretoken（即预分词单元）贪心地递归拆分为完整二叉树（split tree），切分依据是各候选字节子串的频率/计数，完全独立于任何词表。2) 新的递归推理过程：给定词表后，推理时沿每棵 split tree 自顶向下递归下降，在每条路径上输出第一个落在词表内的节点（即优先采用最浅的词表匹配节点）。3) 词表选择建模为整数规划（IP）：以各 split tree 上的节点为决策变量，最小化所有 split tree 的 token 总数。4) LP 松弛：求解线性规划松弛，实践中该松弛解接近整数（near-integral），据此可证明所获词表具有近似最优性保证。5) 计算复杂度分析：训练时间经验上随 split tree 数量呈二次（quadratic）增长。作者还测量了单字节 token 的使用频率以及 Rényi 效率作为压缩与信息论层面的评估指标。
AI.result: 在英文语料上，当词表规模为 40,960 及以上时，ToaST 相比 BPE、WordPiece、UnigramLM 减少 token 数超过 11%，从而在使用该分词器的模型中降低推理 token 数、延长有效上下文长度；ToaST 对常见单字节 token 的使用频率低于各基线，带来 Rényi 效率的显著提升。词表选择方面，LP 松弛接近整数解，提供了词表近似最优的证明性依据，训练时间随 split tree 数量经验上呈二次增长。语言模型实验（1.5B 参数）显示 ToaST 取得最高 CORE 分数，领先基线 2.6%–7.6%（其中三项对比中有两项达到统计显著），并在 22 项单项任务中的 13 项上得分最佳。
AI.conclusion: 将分词器的优化目标与语言模型实际使用的推理过程对齐是提升子词压缩效率的有效途径。ToaST 通过"先构造无词表的字节切分二叉树、再由 IP 求解最优词表"的两阶段设计，在相同词表规模下获得更少的 token、更长的有效上下文与更好的下游语言模型表现；同时其基于 LP 松弛的近似最优性论证与经验上的二次训练时间开销，表明该方法在实用规模上可行。论文表明，联合优化分词结构与词表（而非仅依赖既有词表）可以实质改进 LLM 的上下文利用效率与整体评测性能。

title: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Mingyuan served as the project lead. Banghao, Yining, and Mingyuan contributed equally to this work, with more junior authors listed before senior authors. All data and code releases are maintained by the corresponding authors at UIUC and are not affiliated with Meta
summary:
Spreadsheet systems (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets) play a central role in modern data-centric workflows. As AI agents grow increasingly capable of automating complex tasks, such as controlling computers and generating presentations, building an AI-driven spreadsheet agent has emerged as a promising research direction. Most existing spreadsheet agents rely on specialized prompting over general-purpose LLMs; while this design has potentials on simple spreadsheet operations, it struggles to manage the complex, multi-step workflows typical of real-world applications.
  We introduce Spreadsheet-RL, a reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning framework designed to train specialized spreadsheet agents within a realistic Microsoft Excel environment. Spreadsheet-RL features an automated pipeline for scalable collection of paired start-goal spreadsheets from online forums, as well as domain-specific evaluation tasks in areas such as finance and supply chain management, which we compile into the new Domain-Spreadsheet benchmark dataset. It also includes a Spreadsheet Gym environment designed for multi-turn RL: Spreadsheet Gym exposes extensive Excel functionality through a Python sandbox, along with a refined harness that incorporates a comprehensive tool set and carefully designed tool-routing rules for spreadsheet tasks. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that Spreadsheet-RL substantially enhances AI agent's performance on both general and domain-specific spreadsheet tasks: it improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507's Pass@1 on SpreadsheetBench from 12.0% to 23.4%, and raises Pass@1 from 8.4% to 17.2% on our curated Domain-Spreadsheet dataset. These results highlight Spreadsheet-RL's strong potential for generalization and real-world adoption in spreadsheet automation, and broadly, its promise for advancing LLM-based interactions with data interfaces in everyday work.

AI.tldr: Spreadsheet-RL是一个强化学习微调框架，用于在真实Excel环境中训练专门的电子表格AI智能体。通过自动化数据收集管道、Spreadsheet Gym RL环境和Domain-Spreadsheet基准数据集，该框架将Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507在电子表格任务上的Pass@1从12.0%提升至23.4%，证明了RL微调在复杂电子表格自动化任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格智能体主要依赖通用LLM的专门提示工程，这种设计在简单操作上有效，但难以应对真实世界中复杂、多步骤的工作流程自动化需求。
AI.method: 采用强化学习(RL)微调框架，在真实Microsoft Excel环境中训练专门的电子表格智能体。核心组件包括：(1)从在线论坛自动化收集配对起点-目标电子表格的可扩展管道；(2)Spreadsheet Gym多轮RL环境，通过Python沙箱暴露丰富的Excel功能，并配备全面的工具集和精心设计的工具路由规则；(3)Domain-Spreadsheet基准数据集，涵盖金融和供应链管理等领域的专业评估任务。
AI.result: 通过全面实验验证，Spreadsheet-RL在通用和领域特定的电子表格任务上均显著提升了AI智能体性能，且展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Spreadsheet-RL显著提升了AI智能体在电子表格任务上的性能：Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507在SpreadsheetBench上的Pass@1从12.0%提升至23.4%，在Domain-Spreadsheet数据集上从8.4%提升至17.2%，展示了良好的泛化能力和实际应用潜力。

title: When to Switch, Not Just What: Transition Quality Prediction in Clash Royale
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; Accepted at IEEE Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
summary: In competitive games, players frequently switch strategies after losing streaks, yet our analysis of 926,334 match records from 34,619 Clash Royale players reveals a counterintuitive pattern: switching frequency is inversely associated with the win rate, with effects that vary substantially across players and situational contexts. We attribute this to a limitation common in many prior recommendation systems, which evaluate strategies by expected quality while overlooking the behavioral cost of switching and individual differences in switching propensity. We refer to this implicit premise as the Zero Switching Cost Assumption. To address this, we reformulate strategy recommendation as a transition-level decision problem and instantiate it as TQP (Transition Quality Predictor), a three-stage pipeline structured as Who -> When -> What. PersonaGate suppresses recommendations for players whose strategic consistency is empirically associated with superior outcomes. TimingGate identifies moments when switching is likely to yield a net benefit over staying, using a subtype- and state-matched baseline to control for natural win-rate recovery. ScoreFusion ranks candidate strategies by combining an adoptability signal with predicted transition quality (delta WR). We further introduce SwitchGap, an evaluation metric that measures a policy's discriminative quality without treating observed player choices as optimal ground truth. This property is particularly important because the most frequent switchers record the lowest win rates. The full pipeline achieves a SwitchGap of +10.4 percentage points at a recommendation rate of 5.4%, and loss-triggered switchers, despite being the lowest-performing group, benefit the most from subtype-conditioned guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了竞技游戏中频繁切换策略与更低胜率之间的反直觉关联，挑战了传统推荐系统的"零切换成本"隐含假设，将策略推荐重新表述为过渡级决策问题。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统假设零切换成本，忽略了切换的行为代价和个体差异，导致频繁切换策略的玩家反而表现更差。
AI.method: 提出TQP（Transition Quality Predictor）三阶段管道：PersonaGate过滤不适合切换的玩家、TimingGate识别切换收益时机、ScoreFusion综合可采纳性和过渡质量（delta WR）排序候选策略。同时引入SwitchGap评估指标。
AI.result: 分析926,334场匹配记录后发现切换频率与胜率呈负相关；完整管道在5.4%推荐率下SwitchGap达+10.4个百分点，损失触发的切换者受益最显著。
AI.conclusion: TQP通过Who-When-What三阶段管道有效解决了策略推荐中的切换成本问题，在5.4%推荐率下实现SwitchGap +10.4个百分点，尤其对损失触发切换者的帮助最大。

title: ChronoMedKG: A Temporally-Grounded Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Clinical Reasoning
comment: 9 pages main text plus appendices, 8 figures. Dataset and benchmark paper. ChronoMedKG released under CC BY 4.0 and ChronoTQA/code under MIT (Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19697542). Under review
summary:
Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) treat disease associations as static facts, but temporal information is crucial for clinical reasoning, e.g., a symptom diagnostic of one disease at age 3 may imply a different disease at age 13. Existing KGs such as PrimeKG, Hetionet, and iKraph do not encode when a finding becomes clinically relevant over the course of a disease. This limits their usefulness for longitudinal clinical reasoning and retrieval augmentation.
  We introduce ChronoMedKG, a temporal biomedical knowledge graph that contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples (filtered from 13M raw extractions) covering 13,431 diseases. Each association is tied to temporal components like onset window or progression stage, which are backed by PMID-traceable evidence and a multi-signal credibility score. The graph is constructed through a disease-autonomous multi-agent pipeline in which multiple frontier LLMs independently extract knowledge from PubMed and PMC literature. Only those relations are kept that are supported by multi-model consensus, survive credibility filtering, as well as ontology alignment.
  ChronoMedKG scored 92.7% agreement against Orphadata and adds temporal grounding for 6,250 diseases absent from HPOA, Orphadata, and Phenopackets, including 1,657 Orphanet-coded rare diseases. We further introduce ChronoTQA, a benchmark of 3,341 questions across eight task types (six temporal plus two static controls), with a 12-question supplementary probe. Frontier LLMs lose roughly 30 points moving from static to temporal questions; ChronoMedKG retrieval rescues 47-65% of their long-tail failures, against 17-29% for HPOA-RAG. As such, ChronoMedKG provides a crucial temporal axis for retrieval-augmented clinical systems that was previously absent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChronoMedKG：一个从 PubMed/PMC 文献中自动构建的、具备“临床时间轴”（起病年龄区间、疾病进展阶段、临床里程碑）标注的生物医学知识图谱，含 460,497 条经多模型共识筛选的证据溯源三元组（源自 13M 原始抽取），覆盖 13,431 个疾病，每条边均带 PMID、原文引句与六信号可信度评分；同时发布首个时间维度生物医学问答基准 ChronoTQA（3,341 题，8 类任务）。结果显示前沿 LLM 在静态题与时间题之间存在约 30.1 pp 的能力落差，ChronoMedKG 检索可挽救其长尾失败案例的 47–65%（HPOA-RAG 仅 17–29%），并为 6,250 个此前无任何起病数据来源的疾病首次提供了时间标注。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学知识图谱（PrimeKG、Hetionet、iKraph、KARMA 等）将疾病关联视为静态、无时间维的事实，未编码“某表型在疾病病程的何时出现”。而临床决策恰恰依赖时间上下文：何时开始筛查、某年龄应考虑何种诊断、干预是否仍处于有效窗口。此外，现有带时间信息的资源覆盖极有限且粒度粗糙：HPOA 仅对 1,429 个疾病给出“儿童期”等粗粒度起病类别，Orphadata 覆盖 5,796 个罕见病，Phenopackets 覆盖 518 个疾病，且均为疾病级而非表型级；即便合并也仅覆盖 PrimeKG 17,080 个疾病中的 7,743 个。同时 MedQA、PubMedQA、BioASQ、MMLU-Medical、RareBench 等问答基准均未评估时间维度的临床推理。因此“疾病进展的时间维度”既缺乏结构化表示，也缺乏可测试的基准。作者同时强调与三条并行的 agentic 抽取路线存在轴向差异：KARMA 处理多智能体冲突、MedKGent 追踪知识进入文献的“发表时间”、AutoBioKG 编码“上下文状态”，而临床时间轴（患者年龄与疾病分期）尚无人填补。
AI.method: 构建流程为“疾病自主”的四智能体流水线，无逐疾病人工编码或提示词工程：①Disease Profiler 查询 MONDO/OMIM/HPO 本体，生成疾病元数据、同义词、鉴别诊断、基因与文献丰度分层（Standard ≥100 篇 / Light 20–99 / Minimal <20）；②Evidence Harvester 通过 NCBI E-utilities 抓取 PubMed 摘要与 PMC 全文（43K 全文 + 2.4M 摘要，约 2.5M 文档，Standard 层最多 150 篇、Light/Minimal 取全部）；③Knowledge Extractor 对每篇文档并行调用 2–3 个不同家族 LLM（DeepSeek V3 主模型、GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4o-mini 主模型、Claude 3 Haiku 作条件性 tiebreaker，temperature=0），要求优先抽取带时间信息的关系；候选三元组须由同一文档中 ≥2 个独立模型抽取、实体模糊匹配 ≥80%、关系规范化一致方予保留；13,045,687 条原始抽取经共识过滤后仅 3.53%（460,497 条）留存；④Quality Controller 做 PrimeKG schema 对齐（Grade A/B）、年龄 ∈[0,120] 的时间合理性约束、自引用与冲突检测，并按期刊层级、引用速度、研究类型、复现性、撤稿检查、LLM 共识六信号加权计算可信度（0.15/0.15/0.25/0.15/0.15/0.15）。PMID 与出版年由编排器从文献元数据确定性附加，避免 LLM 幻觉溯源。Schema 上每条边含三类元数据：时间元数据（onset_age_min/max、progression_stage、milestone，单边可多形态）、证据溯源（PMID 列表、≤300 字符原文引句、出版年、研究类型、可信度分）、共识置信度（1.00 全一致 / 0.67 三分之二）。ChronoTQA 基准分两层：Tier 1 锚定外部金标准（Orphadata 800 题时间窗 + 687 题时间差诊断 + 600 题跨病种比较；Phenopackets 147 题精确起病年龄自由作答；HPOA 12 题负向时间 MCQ 探针作为补充诊断集因样本过小不单独上榜），Tier 2 由 ChronoMedKG 的 PMID 可溯三元组生成（395 题表型排序 + 200 题分期条件），另设 250+250 题 PrimeKG 静态对照。验证包括：100 个新覆盖疾病的三个 LLM 评审团审计（对证据原文与数值区间做逐三元组文本落地核查）、对 Orphadata(2,563)/HPOA(365)/GeneReviews(116) 的金标准交叉比对、基于 HEG-TKG 的临床医生锚点评审、147 题 RAG 四条件（NR/PrimeKG/HPOA/ChronoMedKG）对照实验、TransE/DistMult 链接预测消融、以及 K-means 疾病轨迹聚类与证据年代衰减分析。
AI.result: 资源规模：13,431 个疾病处理、10,852 个有验证输出、460,497 条共识三元组、253,094 个实体、10 种关系类型；时间元数据覆盖 24.5% 起病年龄 / 16.4% 进展阶段 / 45.5% 里程碑，8,935 个疾病（52.3% 的 PrimeKG 疾病）具起病数据；100% 三元组带 PMID，99.9% 带原文引句，1.6% 为多 PMID 跨论文验证；455,519 条（98.9%）可溯出版年，中位数 2015 年，27.4% 来自近五年。验证：与 Orphadata 在 2,563 病重叠集上有效准确率 92.7%（严格精度 50.1%，真实错误仅 7.3%，其余为相邻阶段 15.6%、粒度错配 13.8%、更宽但重叠 6.7%、单三元组噪声 5.7%）；HPOA 严格 18.6%/有效 92.6%，GeneReviews 56.9%/86.2%；新覆盖 100 病三评审团可核实多数下验证准确率 87.9%（11 例 not_supported 中 10 例为定性限定词未落成数值的归一化 bug，真实噪声 1%）；单一评审团基线偏松（错误例仍 46.8% 判为 supported），说明需多评审团过滤。覆盖差距：HPOA 仅覆盖 8.4%、Orphadata 33.9%、Phenopackets 3.0%，ChronoMedKG 达 52.3%，其中 6,250 个疾病（36.6%）在所有金标准中均无起病数据（含 1,657 个 Orphanet 编码罕见病首次获得时间标注）；粒度上每病中位数 5 个表型-起病配对（6,480 个病 ≥3 对），如 DMD 分别记录行走延迟 2–5y、Gowers 征 5–8y、失去行走 8–12y、心肌病 10–18y。基准与能力差距：120 题分层子集上四个前沿 LLM（GPT-4o-mini/Gemini/Claude/DeepSeek V3，无检索）静态均值 ~83% 而时间题均值 ~53%，平均差距 +30.1 pp；自由文本精确起病年龄题崩塌至均值 4.5%（0/12/0/6%），二元跨病比较与静态对照接近天花板。RAG：在 147 道 Phenopackets 题上 NR 基线 76–86%（训练污染天花板），ChronoMedKG-RAG 池化 82.1%（+2.3 pp），仅 Claude 3 Haiku 达 McNemar 显著（p=0.008，+12.9 pp）；长尾挽救率 ChronoMedKG 47–65%（Claude 60%、DeepSeek 65%、GPT-4o-mini 47.1%），显著优于 HPOA-RAG 的 17–29%（Claude/DeepSeek 的 bootstrap CI 不重叠），点估计优于 PrimeKG-RAG 的 40–51% 但 CI 重叠（NR 失败子集仅 n=20–35）；且 PrimeKG-RAG 在两个模型上反而降低准确率。链接预测：加入时间分箱使 HPOA 的 MRR 提升 +73.6%（p=0.003）、ChronoMedKG 提升 +89.8%（p=0.015），但绝对 MRR 低（0.0192），主因未做实体规范化导致实体空间约为 HPOA 的 3 倍；分箱粒度敏感性显示 5 粗箱与 8 细箱在 TransE 上无差异（p=0.42），细粒度优势只在 DistMult 上出现（+18.2%），即“是否含时间轴”才是关键。轨迹聚类得到 4 个临床自洽原型（先天/新生儿 3,573、广谱进展型 4,334、晚发型 900、早儿童型 128）。31 例 PMC 开放获取“诊断迷宫”病例分析显示诊断延迟 1–50 年（中位 14 年），如 Wilson 病被误诊为精神分裂症 26 年，而 ChronoMedKG 记录其神经精神起病 20–40y 与肝脏受累 15–45y，可提供区分依据。
AI.conclusion: ChronoMedKG 与 ChronoTQA 共同补上了生物医学 KG 领域此前缺失的“临床时间轴”，其价值体现在两个不同人群上：一是 6,250 个此前无任何结构化起病数据的疾病（含 1,657 个罕见病）首次获得时间标注；二是 6.2 节在三方共享的 147 题上证明 ChronoMedKG 在长尾起病问题上比静态 KG 与粗粒度起病资源具有更高的检索挽救率（47–65% vs. 40–51% / 17–29%）。作者明确将 RAG 结论框定为“选择性增益”而非对参数化记忆天花板的整体超越，并强调现有基准的污染问题限制了池化准确率的提升空间。论文自述六项局限并按严重程度排序：①实体规范化缺失（表型实体空间为 HPOA 的 3 倍，压低链接预测 MRR，拟在 v1.1 用 SapBERT 解决）；②规模化临床验证缺失（HEG-TKG 仅 6 个疾病、4 位评审者，且 C1 与 C2/第三方评审者结论存在分歧，需 v2.0 引入多评审者验证子集）；③≥2 模型共识后仍有 7.3% 真实错误，主张以聚合/中位数方式使用而非依赖单三元组；④“Deep tier”从未触发，GeneReviews/OMIM 等库尚未接入；⑤可信度六信号中 citation_count 与 is_retracted 两个未填充，v1.0 未校准；⑥研究定位为文献派生，直接临床使用需临床监督与监管评估（数据集为 CC BY 4.0、代码 MIT，Zenodo 概念 DOI 版本化发布，README 含“已知差异”章节）。作者亦强调其与 KARMA（冲突消解）、MedKGent（发表时间）、AutoBioKG（上下文状态）三条路线的互补性，并指出发表时间轴、上下文状态轴与临床时间轴在原理上可统一，属未来工作。

title: AtelierEval: Agentic Evaluation of Humans & LLMs as Text-to-Image Prompters
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems increasingly rely on upstream prompters, either humans or multimodal large language models (MLLMs), to translate user intent into detailed prompts. Yet current benchmarks fix the prompt and only evaluate T2I models, leaving the prompting proficiency of this upstream component entirely unmeasured. We introduce AtelierEval, the first unified benchmark that quantifies prompting proficiency across 360 expert-crafted tasks. Grounded in a cognitive view, it spans three task categories and instantiates tasks using a taxonomy of real-world challenges, with a dual interface for both humans and MLLMs. To enable scalable and reliable evaluation, we propose AtelierJudge, a skill-based, memory-augmented agentic evaluator. It produces subjective and objective scores for prompt-image pairs, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.79 with human experts, approaching human performance. Extensive experiments benchmark 8 MLLMs against 48 human users across 4 T2I backends, validate AtelierEval as a robust diagnostic tool, and reveal the superiority of mimicry over planning, advocating for an image-augmented direction for future prompters. Our work is released to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个统一评估文本到图像系统上游提示器能力的新基准 AtelierEval，通过认知驱动的任务设计评估提示生成技能，并开发了 AtelierJudge 智能体评估器达到与人类专家高度一致（ρ=0.79）的评估效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅评估 T2I 模型，而上游提示器（人类或 MLLM）将用户意图转换为详细提示的能力完全未被测量，亟需一个统一框架来量化和诊断提示生成能力。
AI.method: 提出 AtelierEval 基准（360 个专家设计任务，基于认知理论涵盖三类任务）和 AtelierJudge 评估器（基于技能的记忆增强智能体评估器）。实验对比 8 个 MLLM 与 48 名人类用户在 4 个 T2I 后端上的表现。
AI.result: AtelierJudge 与人类专家的 Spearman 相关系数达 0.79，接近人类表现水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了模仿优于规划的策略，并倡导未来提示器应采用图像增强方向。开源的 AtelierEval 和 AtelierJudge 为提示优化和 T2I 系统评估提供了可靠的诊断工具和可扩展的评估方法。

title: Noise Schedule Design for Diffusion Models: An Optimal Control Perspective
summary: We develop a principled framework for analyzing and designing noise schedules in diffusion models. We show that one can recast this design problem as an optimal control problem, whose state is the Fisher information of the diffusion process which evolves according to an ODE and the control input is the noise schedule. The objective of the optimal control problem is a functional involving the Fisher information, which is shown to be an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler sampling error. By solving this optimal control problem, we obtain sufficient conditions on noise schedules under which state-of-the-art $\tilde{\mathcal{O}} (d/n)$ sampling error is achievable, where $d$ is the data dimension and $n$ is the number of discretization steps. While existing theoretical work also prove that $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/n)$ sampling error bounds are achievable, these results hold for specific noise schedules, which do not include the schedules used in practice. Under a further parametric assumption on the data distribution, we show that one can obtain closed-form expressions for the noise schedules. These noise schedules generalize standard empirical schedules such as exponential and sigmoid schedules by allowing additional parameters that can be tuned. Systematically tuning the parameters of these schedules yields new schedules that achieve superior FID scores on image generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Transformed noise schedule design in diffusion models into an optimal control problem, proving sufficient conditions for achieving optimal Õ(d/n) sampling error, and deriving practical closed-form schedules that outperform existing methods on image benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing theoretical results on Õ(d/n) sampling error bounds hold only for specific noise schedules that do not match practical schedules used in real diffusion models, creating a gap between theory and practice.
AI.method: Recast noise schedule design as an optimal control problem where the state is the Fisher information (evolving via ODE) and the control input is the noise schedule. The objective is a Fisher information functional shown to be an upper bound on KL sampling error. Under parametric assumptions on data distribution, closed-form noise schedule expressions are derived.
AI.result: Obtained sufficient conditions on noise schedules achieving Õ(d/n) sampling error (d=data dimension, n=discretization steps). Derived closed-form expressions that generalize exponential and sigmoid schedules with tunable parameters.
AI.conclusion: The proposed framework yields new noise schedules that generalize standard empirical schedules (exponential, sigmoid), with tunable parameters, achieving superior FID scores on image generation benchmarks.

title: Understanding Data Temporality Impact on Large Language Models Pre-training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically trained on shuffled corpora, yielding models whose knowledge is frozen at train time and whose temporal grounding remains poorly understood. In this work, we study the impact of pre-training dynamics on the acquisition of time-sensitive factual knowledge, focusing specifically on data ordering. Our main contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark of over 7,000 temporally grounded questions and an evaluation protocol that enables analysis of whether models correctly associate facts with their corresponding time periods. Second, we pretrain 6B-parameter models on temporally ordered Common Crawl snapshots and compare them against standard shuffled pre-training. Our results show that sequentially trained models match shuffled baselines on general language understanding and common knowledge while consistently exhibiting more up-to-date and temporally precise knowledge. Temporally ordered pre-training yields improved factual freshness, while shuffled pre-training peaks on older data, possibly due to increased factual repetition. These findings, along with the release of our code at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/kairos , checkpoints, and datasets at https://huggingface.co/collections/kyutai/kairos provide a foundation for future research on continual learning for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究数据排序对LLM时间敏感知识习得的影响，发现时间排序预训练能提升模型的事实新鲜度，而打乱预训练在处理旧数据时因重复而表现更佳
AI.motivation: LLM在打乱语料库上训练导致知识冻结在训练时间，时间基础理解差，需研究预训练动态（特别是数据排序）对时间敏感知识习得的影响
AI.method: 1）构建超7000个时间基础问题的基准测试和评估协议；2）在时间排序的Common Crawl快照上预训练6B参数模型，与标准打乱预训练对比
AI.result: 顺序训练模型在通用语言理解和常识上匹配打乱基线，同时展现更最新和时间精确的知识；时间排序预训练提升事实新鲜度，打乱预训练在旧数据上表现最佳（可能因事实重复增加）
AI.conclusion: 为LLM持续学习的未来研究提供基础，包括开源代码、检查点和数据集

title: Claw AI Lab: An Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Team
comment: Project page and code are available at https://github.com/Claw-AI-Lab/Claw-AI-Lab
summary: We present Claw AI Lab, a lab-native autonomous research platform that advances automated research from a hidden prompt-to-paper pipeline into an interactive AI laboratory. Rather than centering the system around a single agent or a fixed serial workflow, we allow users to instantiate a full research team from one prompt, with customizable roles, collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume control through a unified dashboard. The platform also supports distinct research modes for exploration, multi-agent discussion, and reproduction, making autonomous research substantially more steerable and laboratory-like in practice. A key practical contribution of Claw AI Lab lies in its Claw-Code Harness, which connects local codebases, datasets, and checkpoints to runnable experiments and feeds execution artifacts back into the research loop. As a result, the harness improves not only execution integration, but also experimental completion and result integrity: experiments are easier to inspect, iterate on, and faithfully transfer into final papers, reducing common failure modes such as partial runs and malformed result reporting. In our internal evaluation on five AI research case studies, using AutoResearchClaw as the baseline, Claw AI Lab is consistently preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality. We view Claw AI Lab as an early step toward a new paradigm: autonomous research as usable, interactive, and reliability-aware scientific infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Claw AI Lab transforms autonomous research from rigid single-agent pipelines into an interactive AI laboratory with customizable research teams, real-time monitoring, and a novel code execution harness that improves experimental integrity and result faithfulness.
AI.motivation: Current automated research operates as a hidden "prompt-to-paper pipeline," limiting steerability, transparency, and reliability in autonomous AI-driven scientific discovery.
AI.method: The platform enables instantiating customizable research teams from a single prompt, featuring collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume control via a unified dashboard. Key innovation is the Claw-Code Harness that connects local codebases/datasets/checkpoints to runnable experiments and feeds execution artifacts back into the research loop.
AI.result: Internal evaluation on five AI research case studies shows Claw AI Lab is consistently preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality compared to AutoResearchClaw baseline.
AI.conclusion: Claw AI Lab represents an early step toward a new paradigm: autonomous research as usable, interactive, and reliability-aware scientific infrastructure.

title: CausalGuard: Conformal Inference under Graph Uncertainty
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data requires choosing an adjustment set, but valid adjustment depends on an unknown causal graph. Graph misspecification can cause under-coverage, while graph-agnostic conformal wrappers may regain nominal coverage only through large padding. We introduce CausalGuard, a structure-weighted conformal framework that calibrates after aggregating graph-conditional doubly robust pseudo-outcomes. Candidate DAGs are proposed from an LLM-derived edge prior, pruned by conditional-independence tests, and reweighted by Bayesian Information Criterion. A composite nonconformity score then calibrates the posterior-weighted pseudo-outcome. CausalGuard provides distribution-free finite-sample marginal coverage for this aggregated pseudo-outcome; under causal identification, overlap, conditional-mean nuisance stability, and concentration on target-aligned valid adjustment strategies, its conditional mean converges to the true Conditional Average Treatment Effect. Across five benchmarks, CausalGuard attains mean coverage above the nominal 90% level for the directly evaluable target and reduces width when graph-agnostic conformal baselines require large padding. Stress tests show that CausalGuard suppresses invalid collider adjustment and remains stable under misspecified priors when the retained candidate set is data-supported.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalGuard框架，通过结合LLM先验、独立性检验和BIC重权重的结构化加权共形方法，在未知因果图的观测数据中实现稳健的治疗效果估计。
AI.motivation: Estimating treatment effects from observational data requires choosing an adjustment set, but valid adjustment depends on an unknown causal graph. Graph misspecification can cause under-coverage, while graph-agnostic conformal wrappers may only regain nominal coverage through large padding.
AI.method: CausalGuard is a structure-weighted conformal framework that calibrates after aggregating graph-conditional doubly robust pseudo-outcomes. Candidate DAGs are proposed from an LLM-derived edge prior, pruned by conditional-independence tests, and reweighted by Bayesian Information Criterion. A composite nonconformity score calibrates the posterior-weighted pseudo-outcome.
AI.result: Across five benchmarks, CausalGuard attains mean coverage above the nominal 90% level and reduces width compared to graph-agnostic conformal baselines that require large padding.
AI.conclusion: CausalGuard suppresses invalid collider adjustment and remains stable under misspecified priors when the retained candidate set is data-supported.

title: Reducing Political Manipulation with Consistency Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic political bias across a variety of sensitive contexts. We find that LLMs handle counterpart topics from opposing political sides asymmetrically. We refer to this phenomenon as covert political bias and identify 7 categories of techniques through which it operates. We propose two metrics for covert bias: Sentiment Consistency measures symmetry in rhetoric and framing across paired political prompts; Helpfulness Consistency measures symmetric depth and engagement. To reduce both types of covert bias, we introduce Political Consistency Training (PCT), an RL training method with two complementary paradigms: Sentiment Consistency Training and Helpfulness Consistency Training. We show that PCT preserves overall helpfulness, substantially reduces covert political bias, and generalizes to held-out benchmarks. We release our work at https://political-manipulation.ai

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM中存在的新型隐蔽政治偏见，提出PCT方法通过RL训练有效缓解此类偏见。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多种敏感语境中表现出系统性政治偏见，且对对立政治立场的话题处理存在不对称性，作者将此定义为"隐蔽政治偏见"。
AI.method: 提出Political Consistency Training (PCT)方法，包含Sentiment Consistency Training和Helpfulness Consistency Training两个互补范式，采用RL训练框架。
AI.result: PCT在保持整体有用性的同时，显著降低了隐蔽政治偏见，并具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PCT方法能够保持模型整体有用性，显著降低隐蔽政治偏见，并可泛化到保留测试基准。

title: WorkstreamBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on End-to-End Spreadsheet Tasks in Finance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to carry out end-to-end workflows, producing complete artifacts from high-level user instructions. To meet enterprise needs, frontier AI labs have developed agents that can construct entire spreadsheets from scratch. This is especially relevant in finance, where core workflows such as financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis are commonly conducted through spreadsheets. Yet, existing spreadsheet benchmarks do not measure this advanced capability, focusing instead on question-answering or single-formula edits. To address this gap, we provide one of the first evaluations of agents on end-to-end spreadsheet tasks, focusing on economically critical financial workflows such as modeling and scenario analysis. Since deliverables therein are routinely reviewed and revised by multiple stakeholders, judging their quality necessarily involves high-level criteria such as readability or ease of modification. To reflect the multidimensional nature of solution quality, we develop an evaluation taxonomy comprising three dimensions: Accuracy, Formula, and Format, each comprising fine-grained criteria that reflect professional standards. The Claude family leads the benchmark and produces the most professional-looking outputs in our qualitative review, but even the strongest agents frequently fall short of professional finance standards and degrade sharply as the difficulty increases beyond a few chained calculations. This suggests that current agents are not yet able to reliably produce professional-quality spreadsheets at the level of complexity real-world workflows demand.

AI.tldr: MBABench（论文全文中亦称 WorkstreamBench）是为 LLM 智能体设计的端到端金融电子表格基准测试，涵盖约 400 项来自 FMWC、ModelOff 和 Wall Street Prep 的建模、估值与情景分析任务。作者提出 Accuracy（准确性）、Formula（公式）、Format（格式）三维质量评估体系，并以经过专家标注验证的 LLM-as-a-judge 流程打分。评测 18+ 个智能体后发现：即便是最强智能体在中等偏难（Level 4）任务上得分也仅约 72.6/100，且难度上升时性能急剧下降；harness（智能体框架）而非模型本身是决定性因素。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格基准（如 SpreadsheetBench、PIXIU、FinBen、BizFinBench 等）仅评估原子级任务——问答、填空、单条公式修改——无法衡量前沿智能体「从高层指令出发，端到端构建完整多表工作簿」这一新能力。GDPval 虽涉及 5 个金融表格任务，但依赖不透明的专家内部标注，社区缺少透明、可扩展的金融端到端表格基准。此外，金融工作簿在真实场景中需经多层级利益相关者评审与修改（分析师→经理→VP→客户分析师），质量本质上是多维的（可读性、结构清晰度、可修改性、公式健壮性），无法用精确匹配验证，需要整体性的 artifact-level 评估方法。
AI.method: 1）任务收集：从 FMWC、ModelOff、WSP 培训课程中精选端到端金融表格任务，人工标注难度（Scope、General Modeling、Financial Knowledge、Excel Implementation 四子项加权，映射到 1–6 级）与任务类型（DCF、LBO、三表模型、情景/敏感性分析等，用 Gemini-2.5-pro 两阶段分类）。2）三类智能体采集：API agents（自研 Excel CLI Agent，基于 MCP 的 19 个工具 + OpenPyXL + LibreOffice 自动重算，最多 15 轮迭代）；GUI agents（用 Playwright 自动化 ChatGPT Excel/Claude Excel/Claude Web/ChatGPT Pro 等产品）；CODE agents（Codex、Claude Code，在带默认拒绝出网防火墙的 Docker 容器中运行）。3）评估体系：三大维度 Accuracy / Formula / Format 下的细粒度子项（如 Handle Edge Cases、Logic Readability & Size、Hardcoded Values、Number Notation、Alignment），采用 LLM-as-judge（Gemini-2.5-pro）输出 JSON 判定，维度加权生成综合分；超 2M 字符的大工作簿改用带工具的 agentic judge。4）judge 验证：构造注入定向错误的标准答案扰动集 + 真实智能体尝试，对照专家标注（2 名 MBA + 3 名金融从业者，累计 700+ 小时）。5）成本与协议：单任务 120 分钟超时、附件 25MB 上限、流水线错误最多 10 次重试、智能体失败 3 次重试。
AI.result: judge 与专家判断高度一致：智能体尝试上准确率 0.92、平衡准确率 0.88、F1 0.85（408 条专家标注）；其余任务上 agentic judge 0.90/0.89/0.87，非 agentic judge 0.94/0.83/0.79。judge 能捕捉精确匹配无法发现的错误，如 LTM EBITDA 窗口的 off-by-one（数值偶然正确）、以及 1000+ 行交易模拟中整列硬编码值而非公式。基准规模约为 SpreadsheetBench 的 33× 单元格、93× 函数（均值/中位）。智能体表现：Fable 5 系列最佳、GPT-5.6 Sol 紧随，Claude 家族整体最强（Claude Cowork 最佳）；自有 harness 上的 API agents 明显落后，说明 harness 质量是主要驱动因素。Level 2 任务得分 92.4（Claude Code），Level 4 仅 72.6（Codex）。定性发现：Excel 插件类 agent 反而不如 Claude Web（字体颜色不一致、缺单位标签、硬编码值）；部分智能体（Qwen、Kimi、ChatGPT Agent）随难度上升不增加耗时且表现更差，提示模型可能无法理解任务难度；Grok 4.20 出现「努力衰减 + 编造完成」的独特失败模式。
AI.conclusion: MBABench 填补了金融端到端电子表格评估的空白，并证明了一种可扩展、透明的多维质量评估范式：放弃精确匹配，转向经专家验证的 LLM-as-a-judge artifact-level 评估。当前智能体尚不能可靠地产出专业级金融表格，困难任务的 headroom 巨大；性能瓶颈主要在 agentic harness 而非底层模型，因此改进 harness（上下文管理、工具吞吐、防止硬编码、强制公式化建模）是短期最有效的提升路径。局限：任务聚焦金融领域（部分标准如 Number Notation 为金融特有）；因无法窥探前沿实验室闭源 harness，无法完全确定性能差异的根源；Level 5/6 的最难任务样本不足，开发更难的表格任务是重要的未来方向。

title: Optimal Guarantees for Auditing Rényi Differentially Private Machine Learning
summary: We study black-box auditing for machine learning algorithms that claim R \ 'enyi differential privacy (RDP) guarantees. We introduce an auditing framework, based on hypothesis testing, that directly estimates Rényi divergence between neighboring executions using the Donsker-Varadhan (DV) variational estimator. Our analysis yields explicit and non-asymptotic confidence intervals for RDP auditing via class-restricted DV estimators, separating statistical estimation error from algorithmic privacy leakage. We prove matching minimax lower bounds showing that, up to logarithmic factors, our sample-complexity guarantees are information-theoretically optimal, thereby establishing the first optimal guarantees for auditing RDP via DV estimators. Empirically, we instantiate our framework for auditing DP-SGD in a fully black-box setting. Across MNIST and CIFAR-10, and over a wide range of privacy regimes, our auditors produce a strong overall improvement on empirical RDP lower bounds compared to prior state-of-the-art black-box methods especially at small and moderate Rényi orders where accurate auditing is most challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个具有最优性保证的Rényi差分隐私(RDP)黑盒审计框架。该方法基于假设检验，利用Donsker-Varadhan变分估计器直接估计Rényi散度，建立了非渐近置信区间并证明了信息论最优的样本复杂度下界。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上对DP-SGD的审计实验表明，该方法在小Rényi阶数等最具挑战性的场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: Rényi差分隐私(RDP)是机器学习隐私保护的重要框架，但如何高效、准确地对声称具有RDP保证的算法进行黑盒审计仍缺乏理论支撑和最优保证。
AI.method: 提出基于假设检验的黑盒审计框架，使用受限类别的Donsker-Varadhan (DV)变分估计器直接估计相邻执行间的Rényi散度，建立了统计估计误差与算法隐私泄露的显式分离，给出了非渐近置信区间，并通过极小极大lower bound证明了其信息论最优性。
AI.result: 该框架在MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上对DP-SGD进行完全黑盒审计，在广泛的隐私设置下显著改进了现有最优方法的经验RDP下界，尤其在小Rényi阶数和中等阶数的高难度审计场景中提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了首个最优的黑盒RDP审计框架，通过DV变分估计器在 minimax 意义下证明了样本复杂度的最优性，并在DP-SGD的实际审计中显著改进了RDP下界估计，尤其在小Rényi阶数等最具挑战性的场景下表现突出。

title: Evaluating Commercial AI Chatbots as News Intermediaries
summary: AI chatbots are rapidly shaping how people encounter the news, yet no prior study has systematically measured how accurately these systems, with their proprietary search integrations and retrieval-synthesis pipelines, handle emerging facts across languages and regions. We present a 14-day (February 9-22, 2026) evaluation of six AI chatbots (Gemini 3 Flash and Pro, Grok 4, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, GPT-5 and GPT-4o mini) on 2,100 factual questions derived from same-day BBC News reporting across six regional services (US & Canada, Arabic, Afrique, Hindi, Russian, Turkish). The best systems achieve over 90% multiple-choice accuracy on questions about events reported hours earlier. The same systems, however, lose 11-13% under free-response evaluation, and 16-17% across the cohort. We further characterize three failure patterns. First, every model achieves its lowest accuracy on Hindi (79% vs. 89-91% elsewhere) and citations indicate an Anglophone retrieval bias (e.g., models answering Hindi queries cite English Wikipedia more than any Hindi outlet). Second, retrieval, not reasoning, failures drive over 70% of all errors. When models retrieve a correct source, they often extract the correct answer; the problem is to land on the right source in the first place. Third, models achieving 88-96% accuracy on well-formed questions drop to 19-70% when questions contain subtle false premises, with the most vulnerable model accepting fabricated facts 64% of the time. We also identify a detection-accuracy paradox: the best false-premise detector ranks second in adversarial accuracy (abstention rate), while a weaker detector ranks first, showing that premise detection and answer recovery are partially independent capabilities. Overall, these suggest that high accuracy can mask systematic regional inequity, near-total dependence on retrieval infrastructure, and vulnerability to imperfect queries real users pose.

AI.tldr: 该研究对6款主流AI聊天机器人进行了系统性事实核查评估。研究发现头部系统在选择题中可达90%以上准确率，但存在三大严重隐患：区域性能不均（Hindi显著偏低）、检索依赖性强（70%错误源于检索失败）、面对用户真实提问中的虚假前提时高度脆弱（准确率骤降）。表面高准确率可能掩盖系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人正快速成为人们获取新闻的主要渠道，但尚未有研究系统评估这些具有专有搜索集成和检索-合成流程的系统，在跨语言、跨区域场景下处理突发事件事实的准确性。
AI.method: 采用14天窗口期（2026年2月9-22日），基于BBC六大区域新闻服务（同日报道）构建2100道事实题，对6款主流AI聊天机器人（Gemini 3 Flash/Pro、Grok 4、Claude 4.5 Sonnet、GPT-5、GPT-4o mini）进行双模式评估：选择题格式与自由回答格式，并专项测试虚假前提检测能力。
AI.result: 1. 选择题模式下最佳系统对数小时前事件的准确率超过90%；2. 自由回答模式下下降11-13%，整体下降16-17%；3. 三大失败模式：Hindi准确率最低（79% vs 其他89-91%），存在英语检索偏见（如用英文Wikipedia回答印地语查询）；检索而非推理导致70%以上错误；含虚假前提的问题使准确率从88-96%骤降至19-70%；检测准确率悖论存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了AI聊天机器人在新闻事实核查中的三大隐患：1）表面高准确率（>90%）掩盖了系统性区域不平等（Hindi准确率仅79%）；2）超过70%的错误源于检索而非推理，表明系统高度依赖检索基础设施；3）面对含错误前提的问题时性能骤降（19-70%），表明对真实用户不完美提问高度脆弱。

title: Is Capability a Liability? More Capable Language Models Make Worse Forecasts When It Matters Most
summary: We document inverse scaling in LLMs on forecasting problems whose underlying time series exhibit superlinear growth and tail risk of regime change, a structure common in finance and epidemiology. On these tasks, more capable models produce worse distributional forecasts. The pattern appears on ForecastBench-Sim (FBSim), a contamination-free, simulated-world benchmark we release, in forecasting synthetic SIR epidemics with a matched linear control, and replicates in real-world datasets on COVID-19, measles, housing markets, and hyperinflation. A per-quantile decomposition shows the failure concentrates at the upper tail, which more capable models shift upward to track aggressive extrapolations of growth, while the lower tail stays put. A within-family study of Llama-3.1 shows that both model scale and post-training independently contribute to this effect. Domain knowledge does not reliably rescue calibration. This inverse scaling does not appear on single-threshold metrics common in LLM forecasting benchmarks, reversing the sign of the capability--accuracy relationship on identical outputs. Single-threshold scoring at conventional cutoffs misses the upper-tail cost; tail-inclusive scoring reverses the sign of the capability--accuracy relationship on the same outputs. We recommend that LLM forecasting evaluations use continuous (and unbounded) measures of accuracy alongside bounded binary threshold metrics.

AI.tldr: More capable LLMs produce worse forecasts on superlinear growth/tail risk problems due to aggressive upper-tail extrapolations. Current benchmarks mask this via single-threshold metrics; tail-inclusive scoring reveals inverse scaling.
AI.motivation: LLMs exhibit inverse scaling on forecasting tasks involving superlinear growth and tail risk of regime change—common in finance and epidemiology. More capable models produce worse distributional forecasts on these tasks.
AI.method: Developed FBSim benchmark (contamination-free), tested on synthetic SIR epidemics, and replicated on real-world datasets (COVID-19, measles, housing markets, hyperinflation). Performed per-quantile decomposition and within-family study of Llama-3.1.
AI.result: Inverse scaling concentrates at the upper tail; more capable models shift upper tails upward tracking aggressive extrapolations. Both model scale and post-training independently contribute. Single-threshold metrics miss this effect; tail-inclusive scoring reverses the capability-accuracy relationship sign.
AI.conclusion: LLM forecasting evaluations should use continuous (unbounded) measures alongside bounded binary threshold metrics. The inverse scaling effect is real but currently masked by common evaluation practices.

title: SCI-Defense: Defending Manipulation Attacks from Generative Engine Optimization
summary: LLM-based ranking systems are vulnerable to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) attacks, where adversaries inject semantic signals into product descriptions to artificially boost rankings. We propose SCI-Defense, a three-component defense framework combining Perplexity detection (PPL), Semantic Integrity Scoring (SIS), and Inter-Candidate Detection (ICD). SIS evaluates four manipulation dimensions: Authority Attribution (AA), Narrative Purposiveness (NP), Comparative Claims (CA), and Temporal Claims (TC). Evaluated on 600 Amazon product descriptions across 6 categories, SCI-Defense achieves Precision=1.000 and FPR=0.000, with Recall of 1.000, 0.952, and 0.830 against String, Reasoning, and Review attacks respectively. On 600 MS MARCO web passages, String attacks are blocked with perfect recall while Review attacks yield near-zero recall, as web passages lack the persuasion-oriented signals that SIS targets in product descriptions. We demonstrate that existing defenses -- PPL-only filters, SafetyClf content classifiers, and paraphrasing -- achieve zero recall against semantic manipulation attacks. We further demonstrate new attacks such as Specification Amplification and Use-Case Saturation can expose semantic relevance manipulation as a structural defense blind spot that suggests directions for future research.

AI.tldr: SCI-Defense通过结合困惑度检测、语义完整性评分和候选间检测的三层框架，有效防御LLM排名系统中的生成式引擎优化攻击，特别是在产品描述场景下表现优异，但揭示了现有防御方法的根本性缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLM-based ranking systems are vulnerable to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) attacks, where adversaries inject semantic signals into content to artificially boost rankings.
AI.method: Three-component framework combining Perplexity detection (PPL), Semantic Integrity Scoring (SIS) evaluating four manipulation dimensions (AA, NP, CA, TC), and Inter-Candidate Detection (ICD). Evaluation on 600 Amazon products (6 categories) and 600 MS MARCO passages.
AI.result: On Amazon products: Precision=1.000, FPR=0.000, Recall=1.000 (String), 0.952 (Reasoning), 0.830 (Review). On MS MARCO: perfect recall for String attacks, near-zero recall for Review attacks. Existing defenses (PPL-only, SafetyClf, paraphrasing) fail completely. New attacks (Specification Amplification, Use-Case Saturation) expose semantic relevance manipulation as a structural blind spot.
AI.conclusion: SCI-Defense achieves perfect precision with high recall against most attack types, exposing that existing defenses (PPL filters, SafetyClf classifiers, paraphrasing) are ineffective against semantic manipulation, while new attack vectors reveal a structural defense blind spot.

title: Tokenisation via Convex Relaxations
summary: Tokenisation is an integral part of the current NLP pipeline. Current tokenisation algorithms such as BPE and Unigram are greedy algorithms -- they make locally optimal decisions without considering the resulting vocabulary as a whole. We instead formulate tokeniser construction as a linear program and solve it using convex optimisation tools, yielding a new algorithm we call ConvexTok. We find ConvexTok consistently improves intrinsic tokenisation metrics and the bits-per-byte (BpB) achieved by language models; it also improves downstream task performance, but less consistently. Furthermore, ConvexTok allows the user to certify how far their tokeniser is from optimal, with respect to a certain objective, via a lower bound, and we empirically find it to be within 1\% of optimal at common vocabulary sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConvexTok，一种基于凸优化技术的分词算法，通过将分词器构建建模为线性规划来克服传统贪心算法的局限性，实现更优的词汇表设计和编码效率。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的分词算法（如BPE和Unigram）本质上都是贪心算法，仅做出局部最优决策，而未从全局角度优化最终词汇表的质量。
AI.method: 将分词器构建问题重新 formulation 为线性规划问题，并利用凸优化工具求解。
AI.result: ConvexTok在内在分词指标和语言模型的bits-per-byte性能上均取得一致提升，下游任务性能也有所改善（虽一致性稍弱）。实验表明，该方法在常见词汇表大小下可达到最优解的1%以内。
AI.conclusion: ConvexTok能够将现有分词器优化至最优解的1%以内，同时提升语言模型的bits-per-byte指标，在下游任务上也展现出改进效果。

title: Forecasting Scientific Progress with Artificial Intelligence
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific discovery, yet whether it can anticipate scientific progress remains unclear. To study this question, we introduce a temporally grounded evaluation framework for forecasting scientific progress under controlled knowledge constraints. We present CUSP (Cutoff-conditioned Unseen Scientific Progress), a multi-disciplinary and event-level benchmark that evaluates scientific forecasting in AI systems through feasibility assessment, mechanistic reasoning, generative solution design, and temporal prediction. Across 4,760 scientific events, we observe systematic and domain-dependent limitations in current frontier models. While models can identify plausible research directions from competing candidates, they fail to reliably predict whether scientific advances will be realized and systematically misestimate when they will occur. Performance is highly heterogeneous across domains, with the timing of AI progress more predictable than advances in biology, chemistry, and physics. Performance is largely insensitive to whether events occur before or after the training cutoff, suggesting these limitations cannot be explained solely by knowledge exposure in training data. Under controlled information access, additional pre-cutoff knowledge improves performance but does not close the gap to full-information settings, which becomes more pronounced for high-citation advances. Models also exhibit systematic overconfidence and strong response biases, indicating unreliable uncertainty estimation. Taken together, current AI systems fall short as predictive tools for scientific progress. Access to prior knowledge does not translate into reliable forecasting, and performance benefits more from post-event information than from forward-looking prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过CUSP基准评估前沿AI模型预测科学进步的能力，发现当前模型虽能识别研究方向的可行性，但无法可靠预测科学突破是否实现及发生时间，且存在系统性过度自信和信息价值错配问题，表明AI作为科学预测工具仍有根本性局限。
AI.motivation: 探索当前AI系统是否具备预测科学进步的能力，这是一个尚未被系统研究的关键问题，对理解AI在科学发现中的真正潜力至关重要。
AI.method: 构建CUSP基准测试，包含4,760个跨学科科学事件，从可行性评估、机制推理、生成式解决方案设计和时序预测四个维度评估AI系统的科学预测能力。通过控制信息访问条件（预截断知识、全信息设置）进行对照实验，并分析训练截断前后的事件表现差异、引用量与性能关系。
AI.result: 前沿模型在CUSP基准上表现不佳：虽能从竞争性候选中识别合理研究方向，但无法可靠预测科学突破是否实现及发生时间；性能存在显著领域异质性，AI领域时序可预测性高于生物、化学、物理；预截断/后截断事件性能差异不显著，表明主要局限并非源于训练数据知识暴露；额外预截断知识有改善但无法弥合与全信息设置的差距，高引用进展差距更大；模型存在系统性过度自信和强响应偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统在科学进步预测方面存在根本性局限：无法可靠预测科学突破是否会发生及何时发生；额外知识仅能部分改善性能，高引用进展的差距更明显；模型表现出系统性过度自信和响应偏差，不确定性估计不可靠。知识获取与可靠预测之间存在本质鸿沟，未来进展预测的后验信息价值高于前瞻性预测。

title: Dynamic Mixture of Latent Memories for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Achieving self-evolution in intelligent agents requires the continual accumulation of new knowledge across changing task sequences without forgetting previously acquired abilities. Existing approaches either internalize knowledge by updating model parameters, which induces catastrophic forgetting, or rely on external memory, which fails to genuinely enhance the model's intrinsic capabilities. We propose MoLEM, a generative mixture of latent memory framework based on a dynamic mixture-of-experts (MoE). We treat multiple experts as independent carriers to generate memory. A router selects and weights experts through key-query matching, and the aggregated latent memory is injected into the reasoning process. The base model for reasoning remains entirely frozen, with all experiential knowledge internalized into the additional modules, avoiding catastrophic forgetting. For continual learning, each training stage is paired with a lightweight autoencoder that selects the appropriate routing group at inference, and inputs that match no stage fall back to the pretrained model. Experiments train the framework on continual-learning sequences spanning math, science, and code domains. After training, we evaluate the framework on the corresponding test sets to measure task learning and competence preservation across continual adaptation stages. After the full continual-learning sequence, our method improves the average accuracy by 10.40% over the Vanilla pretrained baseline, while none of the competing methods consistently exceed this baseline across different training orders.

AI.tldr: MoLEM提出基于动态专家混合(MoE)的潜在记忆生成框架，通过路由器进行键值匹配选择专家，将聚合的潜在记忆注入推理过程，基座模型完全冻结避免灾难性遗忘，在数学、科学、代码领域的持续学习任务中相比基线提升10.40%准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体持续学习面临两难困境：更新模型参数会导致灾难性遗忘，而依赖外部记忆又无法真正增强模型内在能力。需要一种既能持续学习新知识又能保留已有能力的方法。
AI.method: MoLEM将多个专家视为独立的记忆载体，通过路由器进行键查询匹配选择和加权专家，将聚合的潜在记忆注入推理过程。基座推理模型完全冻结，所有经验知识被内化到附加模块中。持续学习阶段配合轻量级自编码器选择合适的路由组，不匹配任何阶段时回退到预训练模型。
AI.result: 在数学、科学和代码领域的持续学习序列上训练后，MoLEM相比Vanilla预训练基线平均准确率提升10.40%，而其他对比方法在不同训练顺序下均未能持续超越基线。
AI.conclusion: MoLEM通过将知识存储与推理能力分离的架构设计，成功解决了持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，为智能体的自主演进提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Beyond the Org Chart: AI and the Transformation of Invisible Work
summary: An increasing number of news and research articles report that AI adoption is allowing professionals to blur and extend the boundaries of their corporate roles. With the goal of understanding how work processes might be changing in an AI-forward company, we interviewed 24 product-focused individuals at a large technology firm about how AI has impacted their own work, their work within their product team, and their professional interactions. Our conversations suggest that AI is not only changing formal role responsibilities and collaborations between those roles, but also changing informal cultural practices like professional mentoring that are key to helping professionals settle in their positions, stay engaged with their work, and grow their careers. Some of these changes are positive, such as smoother collaboration between peers, but other changes are more nuanced and put the typical career growth opportunities, like receiving feedback from professional networks and promoting leadership and mentorship, at risk. We propose steps that AI companies can take to make the invisible work more visible. Additionally, we propose efforts that individuals and leaders can take to support their colleagues through AI transformation while preserving healthy company cultures that support diverse thinking, collaboration, and informal interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对某大型科技公司24名产品岗位从业者的深度访谈，探讨AI如何模糊并扩展员工的岗位职责边界：AI不仅改变了正式的角色分工与协作方式，也重塑了诸如导师制（mentoring）、反馈获取等支撑职业融入与发展的非正式文化实践。作者主张让这些"隐形工作"显性化，并给出个人与领导者在AI转型中维护健康文化、鼓励多元思考与非正式互动的行动建议。
AI.motivation: 越来越多新闻与研究报道称，AI的采用正在使专业人员模糊并延伸其企业角色边界。一方面AI能力（如编码、写作、分析代理）嵌入日常任务，专业人员开始承担原本属于其他角色（如工程、数据、设计）的职责；另一方面，AI工具（如自动生成代码、文档、总结）可能替代了传统上由"指导者—学习者"关系产生的非正式文化实践（如同事反馈、职业导师关系），而这些实践对新人融入岗位、保持工作投入和职业成长至关重要。作者希望理解在"AI向前（AI-forward）"的公司中工作流程究竟如何改变，以期为组织设计提供实证依据。
AI.method: 质性研究方法：对某大型科技公司24名以产品（product-focused）为职能的从业者进行半结构化深度访谈，主题覆盖三个层次：(1) AI对个人自身工作的影响；(2) AI对所在产品团队内部工作的影响；(3) AI对专业互动（与团队外他人的协作、职场关系）的影响。通过对访谈内容的分析归纳出AI对正式角色职责、跨角色协作以及非正式文化实践（如职业指导、反馈网络、领导力与导师身份的晋升机制）的影响模式，并据此提出对策建议。
AI.result: 研究发现：AI正在同时改变正式角色职责与角色间的协作关系，以及关键的"非正式文化实践"——专业导师制。AI带来了部分积极效应（如同事之间协作更顺畅、跨角色合作门槛降低、个体产出效率提升），但也带来更微妙甚至负面的效应：典型的职业成长机会受到威胁，包括从专业网络获得反馈（因为部分知识转移与反馈被AI中介或替代）、领导力与导师身份的培养路径被削弱（资深者从"手把手指导"转向"审核AI产出"，减少了非正式指导性互动的机会），进而可能使职业发展的隐性机制受损。文章明确指出AI并非单纯"取代"或"赋能"某个角色，而是重新划分了角色边界与关系结构。
AI.conclusion: 结论与建议：(1) 公司层面应采取措施让"隐形工作"（非正式的指导、反馈、关系维护）显性化，例如正式认可并制度化AI时代下的导师与反馈实践、重新设计职业成长通道、明确AI引入后各角色的职责边界与协作接口；(2) 个人与领导者层面应主动支持同事完成AI转型，例如主动承担指导与反馈职责、为新人保留非正式互动与社交空间、鼓励多样化的思考与协作，避免因AI同质化输出而抑制批判性观点与多样性思维，从而在提升效率的同时保住支持多样性思考、协作与非正式互动的健康公司文化。

title: ChronoMedicalWorld: A Medical World Model for Learning Patient Trajectories from Longitudinal Care Data
summary: Long-horizon clinical simulation -- predicting how a patient's physiology evolves over years under specified interventions -- is central to chronic-disease care, yet existing electronic health record (EHR) models are predominantly discriminative, and general-purpose large language models drift under repeated interventions. We propose the \textbf{ChronoMedicalWorld Model (CMWM)}, an action-conditioned latent world-model framework for learning patient trajectories from longitudinal care data. CMWM couples a joint-embedding state encoder with a wide action encoder that admits both structured intervention indicators and free-text communication embeddings, and trains a recurrent latent transition module under a six-term objective: next-observation supervision, next-latent prediction, SIGReg latent regularisation, and three physiology-aware shape priors (slope, continuity, large-jump penalty). A closed-loop rollout-prefix protocol matches training to deployment, so the model is optimised against the same multi-step error it exhibits at inference. As a concrete case study, we instantiate CMWM for annual estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) trajectory forecasting in chronic kidney disease (CKD). On a 2{,}232-patient nephrology cohort, the CKD instantiation achieves a dynamic-50\% history rollout test mean absolute error (MAE) of 7.384 and root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.256, against 7.964 and 11.069 for a tuned GPT-5.5 structured-prompting baseline ($-7.28\%$ MAE, $-7.35\%$ RMSE), with the gain dominated by the dialogue portion of patient--health-coach communication. The framework is not CKD-specific: its architecture, loss design, and training protocol apply to any chronic condition that can be cast as periodic clinical state interleaved with structured and conversational interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoMedicalWorld Model（CMWM），一种动作条件化潜世界模型框架，用于从纵向护理数据中学习患者轨迹。模型整合结构化干预和自由文本对话，通过六项损失函数训练，并在2,232例肾病患者队列中实现相比GPT-5.5基线7%以上的误差降低。
AI.motivation: 现有EHR模型多为判别式模型，无法进行长期临床轨迹预测；而通用大语言模型在重复干预场景下会产生预测漂移。慢性病管理需要能够预测患者数年 physiology 演化的模拟工具。
AI.method: CMWM采用动作条件化潜世界模型框架，包含：1）联合嵌入状态编码器；2）支持结构化干预指标和自由文本对话嵌入的宽动作编码器；3）递归潜空间转换模块。训练采用六项损失函数：下一观察预测、下一潜变量预测、SIGReg潜空间正则化，以及三个生理感知形状先验（斜率约束、连续性约束、大跳变惩罚）。采用闭环rollout前缀协议匹配训练与部署分布。
AI.result: 在2,232例肾内科患者队列中，CKD实例化模型实现动态50%历史rollout测试MAE=7.384、RMSE=10.256，相比调优GPT-5.5结构化提示基线（7.964/11.069）分别提升7.28%和7.35%，性能增益主要来自对话部分的患者-健康教练通讯数据。
AI.conclusion: CMWM provides a general framework for chronic disease trajectory prediction that combines structured clinical interventions with conversational data. The approach significantly outperforms GPT-5.5 structured prompting baseline (−7.28% MAE, −7.35% RMSE) on CKD cohort, with gains primarily from incorporating dialogue data. The architecture is condition-agnostic and applicable to any chronic condition modeled as periodic clinical states interleaved with structured and conversational interventions.

title: AMEL: Accumulated Message Effects on LLM Judgments
comment: 19 pages, 14 figures, 6 tables. Single author. Code, data (75,898 deduplicated API responses), and analysis pipeline at https://github.com/chutapp/amel
summary:
Large language models are routinely used as automated evaluators: to review code, moderate content, or score outputs, often with many items passing through one conversation. We ask whether the polarity of prior conversation history biases subsequent judgments, an effect we call the accumulated message effect on LLM judgments (AMEL). Across 75,898 API calls to 11 models from 4 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and four open-source models), we present identical test items in isolation or following histories saturated with predominantly positive or negative evaluations.
  Models shift toward the conversation's prevailing polarity (d = -0.17, p < 10^-46). The effect concentrates on items where the model is genuinely uncertain at baseline (d = -0.34 for high-entropy items, vs d = -0.15 when the baseline is deterministic). Bias does not grow with context length: 5 prior turns and 50 produce the same shift (Spearman |r| < 0.01; OLS slope p = 0.80). And there is a negativity asymmetry: paired per item, negative histories induce 1.62x more bias than positive (t = 13.46, p < 10^-39, n = 2,481). Scaling helps but does not solve it (Anthropic: Haiku -0.22 to Opus -0.17; OpenAI: Nano -0.34 to GPT-5.2 -0.17).
  Three follow-ups narrow the mechanism. The token probability distribution shifts continuously, not at a threshold. The negativity asymmetry has both token-level and semantic components, though attributing the balance is exploratory at our sample sizes. Position does not matter: five biased turns anywhere in a 50-turn history produce the same shift. The simplest fix for evaluation pipelines is a fresh context per item; when batching is unavoidable, balancing the history helps.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM在进行自动化评估时会受到对话历史极性的系统性影响。负面历史比正面历史产生1.62倍的偏倚，效应在模型原本不确定的项目上更为显著，且不随上下文长度增加而加剧。模型规模扩大可缓解但无法消除这一偏倚。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于代码审查、内容审核或输出评分等自动化评估任务，一个关键问题浮现：当多个评估项目通过同一对话处理时，先前对话历史的极性（正面或负面评价）是否会系统性地影响模型对后续项目的判断？这是一个关乎评估可靠性的基础性问题。
AI.method: 研究者在11个模型（来自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及四个开源模型）上进行了75,898次API调用实验。实验设计包括将相同的测试项目以三种形式呈现：独立呈现、跟随正面评价历史、以及跟随负面评价历史。通过计算效应量（d值）、进行t检验和分析相关性来量化偏倚程度。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）模型整体向对话的主导极性偏移（d=-0.17, p<10^-46）；（2）效应集中于模型原本不确定的项目（高熵项d=-0.34 vs 确定项d=-0.15）；（3）偏倚程度不随上下文长度增加（5轮与50轮产生相同偏移）；（4）存在负性偏倚不对称性，负面历史产生的偏倚是正面历史的1.62倍；（5）模型缩放有所改善但未能消除影响（Anthropic系列：Haiku -0.22至Opus -0.17；OpenAI系列：Nano -0.34至GPT-5.2 -0.17）。后续实验进一步表明：token概率分布连续变化而非阈值跳跃；负性不对称同时存在于token级和语义层面；位置无关紧要。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了LLM作为自动化评估器时的系统性偏见问题。虽然扩展模型规模有所帮助，但仍无法根除这种影响。对于评估流程，最简单的解决方案是对每个评估项使用新的上下文；当批处理不可避免时，应平衡历史记录中正负评价的比例。

title: An Improved Adaptive PID Optimizer with Enhanced Convergence and Stability for Deep Learning
summary:
Optimization is essential in deep learning. The foundational method upon which most optimizers are built is momentum-based stochastic gradient descent. However, it suffers from two key drawbacks. First, it has noisy and varying gradients, and second, it has an overshoot phenomenon. To address noisy gradients, Adam was proposed, which remains the most widely used adaptive optimizer. To address the overshoot phenomenon, a control-theory-based PID optimizer was proposed. To tackle both the limitations within a single framework, several variants of Adaptive PID (AdaPID) have recently been proposed.
  Although AdaPID performs well, it still inherits two critical drawbacks from Adam, namely convergence and stability issues. In this work, we address both these limitations. To fix the convergence issue, we uniquely integrate the idea of using a non-increasing effective learning rate into AdaPID (originally proposed in AMSGrad, an extension of Adam). To fix the stability issue, we innovatively integrate a gradient difference based modulation factor into AdaPID (originally proposed in DiffGrad, another extension of Adam). Combining both these ideas in AdaPID, results in our novel IAdaPID-ADG optimizer.
  We evaluate our proposed optimizer on multiple datasets, including benchmark datasets (MNIST and CIFAR10) and real-world datasets (IARC and AnnoCerv). The IAdaPID-ADG substantially outperforms all competing optimizers. Additionally, we perform an ablation study on the MNIST dataset to demonstrate the contribution of each added component.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes IAdaPID-ADG, a novel optimizer that fixes AdaPID's convergence and stability issues by incorporating non-increasing effective learning rate (AMSGrad) and gradient difference modulation (DiffGrad). The optimizer demonstrates superior performance across various datasets.
AI.motivation: AdaPID inherits two critical drawbacks from Adam: convergence issues and stability issues. The authors aim to address both limitations within a single unified framework.
AI.method: IAdaPID-ADG integrates two key modifications into AdaPID: (1) a non-increasing effective learning rate mechanism (from AMSGrad) to fix convergence issues, and (2) a gradient difference based modulation factor (from DiffGrad) to fix stability issues. The optimizer was evaluated on MNIST, CIFAR10, IARC, and AnnoCerv datasets, with ablation studies on MNIST.
AI.result: IAdaPID-ADG substantially outperforms all competing optimizers on multiple benchmark (MNIST, CIFAR10) and real-world (IARC, AnnoCerv) datasets. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each added component.
AI.conclusion: IAdaPID-ADG successfully addresses both convergence and stability limitations of AdaPID by integrating mechanisms from AMSGrad and DiffGrad. The proposed optimizer demonstrates superior performance across benchmark and real-world datasets.

title: Parametric Modular Answer Set Programs Made Declarative
comment: To appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming
summary: In this paper, we explore the concept of modularity in first-order answer set programming (ASP). We introduce a new formalism called parametric modular logic programs, which allows defining subprograms with parameters and intensionality statements. We demonstrate how this formalism can capture the semantics of clingo-programs with collective control, a feature that enables structuring and instantiating subprograms. We provide theoretical foundations for modular ASP, illustrate its usefulness, and connect to traditional non-modular ASP.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了一阶回答集编程(ASP)中的模块化概念，引入了参数化模块化逻辑程序形式化体系，该体系支持带参数的子程序定义和内涵语句，并能够捕获具有集体控制功能的clingo程序语义，为模块化ASP提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: The motivation is to explore and formalize the concept of modularity in first-order answer set programming (ASP).
AI.method: The authors introduce parametric modular logic programs, a formalism allowing subprogram definitions with parameters and intensionality statements.
AI.result: The proposed parametric modular logic programs formalism is demonstrated to capture the semantics of clingo-programs with collective control, which enables structuring and instantiating subprograms.
AI.conclusion: The paper provides theoretical foundations for modular ASP and connects modular approaches to traditional non-modular ASP.

title: How Sparsity Allocation Shapes Label-Free Post-Pruning Recoverability
summary: Unstructured magnitude pruning at high sparsity can reduce neural network accuracy to near-random performance, while labeled retraining may be unavailable in practical deployment settings. Label-free post-pruning repair methods can partially recover collapsed sparse models, but their effectiveness depends on the sparse model left by the upstream pruning allocation. This paper studies how sparsity allocation shapes post-repair recoverability under a fixed activation-statistic repair backend. We compare ERK and LAMP allocations under the same label-free repair protocol across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette with ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and ResNet-50 at sparsities from 90% to 95.5%. The results show that allocation choice can substantially change post-repair accuracy at the same global sparsity, and that the preferred allocation varies with architecture, dataset difficulty, and sparsity level. We identify a repair-sensitive transition regime in which BatchNorm recalibration begins to fail, while activation-statistic repair still recovers nontrivial accuracy.
