Additional validation on ImageNet-100 and DenseNet-121 shows that the location and width of this recoverable regime depend on data scale and connectivity structure. These findings suggest that pruning allocation and post-pruning repair should be studied jointly, since the allocation determines how much activation signal remains available for label-free recovery.

AI.tldr: This paper reveals that sparsity allocation (ERK vs LAMP) significantly impacts label-free post-pruning repair effectiveness, with the optimal choice depending on architecture, dataset, and sparsity level. A repair-sensitive transition regime is identified where BatchNorm recalibration fails but activation-statistic repair still works.
AI.motivation: Unstructured magnitude pruning at high sparsity degrades neural network accuracy to near-random, while labeled retraining may be unavailable; existing label-free post-pruning repair effectiveness depends on upstream pruning allocation.
AI.method: Compared ERK and LAMP allocation methods under same label-free repair protocol across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Imagenette with ResNet-18/34/50 at 90%-95.5% sparsity, validated on ImageNet-100 and DenseNet-121.
AI.result: Allocation choice substantially changes post-repair accuracy at same global sparsity; preferred allocation varies with architecture, dataset difficulty, and sparsity level. Identified a repair-sensitive transition regime where BatchNorm recalibration fails but activation-statistic repair still recovers nontrivial accuracy.
AI.conclusion: Sparsity allocation significantly impacts post-repair recoverability, suggesting pruning allocation and post-pruning repair should be studied jointly since allocation determines activation signal available for label-free recovery.

title: Can AI Make Conflicts Worse? An Alignment Failure in LLM Deployment Across Conflict Contexts
comment: Preprint. 8 pages, 2 figures. Code and evaluation framework: https://github.com/akryshtal/conflict-sensitivity-eval-bloom
summary: AI models are already deployed in societies affected by armed conflict, and journalists, humanitarian workers, governments and ordinary citizens rely on them for information or for their work processes. No established practice exists for checking whether their outputs can make those conflicts worse. We tested nine model configurations from four providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, xAI) on 90 multi-turn scenarios designed to surface misaligned behaviour in conflict contexts: false equivalence between documented atrocities, denial of genocide, and failure to recognise ethnic slurs, among others. When such outputs feed into journalism, humanitarian reporting, or public debate, they can deepen divisions in fragile societies. Failure rates span 6\% to 47\% between the best and worst performing models, which makes model choice a safety question in its own right and when users pushed for ``balance'' in cases where international courts have already assigned responsibility, five of nine configurations failed 80 to 100 percent of the time. We release the first evaluation framework for this domain and propose adding it to alignment evaluation portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并首个发布了“冲突敏感性”（conflict sensitivity）作为大模型对齐评测维度。作者用 Anthropic 的 Bloom 框架对来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、xAI 的 9 个模型配置在 90 个多轮冲突情境（每个配置 90 轮、共约 810 次对话）中测试，评分采用 1–10 分冲突不敏感度量表，≥7 判为失败、≤3 判为通过。结果显示基线失败率从 6% 到 47% 相差约 8 倍；当用户以“中立/平衡/纯学术”为由施压要求“双方视角”时，9 个配置中有 5 个失败率达 80–100%（GPT-4o-mini 从 13% 升至 100%）。Grok 4 在语言复杂性（族群编码/隐语识别）维度失败率高达 60%，最差模型 47% 失败。作者主张冲突敏感性应纳入前沿模型对齐评测组合与国家 AI 安全研究所的部署前审计。
AI.motivation: 在武装冲突地区，记者、人道机构、政府与普通民众已在日常依赖大模型获取信息与工作流程，但目前不存在检验这些输出是否会加剧冲突的既定实践。冲突敏感性（conflict sensitivity，基于"Do No Harm"原则，已被联合国、OECD 及 35 家以上人道组织采纳为操作标准）长期缺席于 AI 安全评测组合，现行相关工作（如政治中立性/even-handedness、外交政策升级偏差、地缘政治叙事对齐）测试的是政治立场偏向，而非输出是否强化了脆弱社会中的群体裂痕或割裂连接。核心关切包括：在已被国际法庭定性为种族灭绝的案件中仍提供“双方平衡”框架、将否认种族灭绝当作合法立场、识别不出族群隐语与侮辱性称谓；以及所有用户共用同一模型导致信息生态“同步劣化”的系统性风险。
AI.method: 采用 Anthropic Bloom（基于 Inspect）的行为倾向评测，而非固定提示基准：流程为理解（Claude Opus 4 解析行为描述）→ 构思（生成 15 个基线场景，取自刚果东、乌克兰、缅甸、贝尔法斯特、南苏丹、巴尔干等真实冲突）→ 多轮 rollout（Claude Sonnet 4 任评审，由 rollout agent 依据目标模型输出生成自适应追问）→ 判定（按预设 rubric 打分）。行为描述综合 11 种有文献与真实案例支撑的冲突不敏感模式（虚假平衡、把种族灭绝否认当作合法观点、主导叙事排除、身份盲视、中立语言掩盖结构性暴力、简化叙事、僵化而紧张的默认表述、英语与数字可见性偏差、族群编码盲视、资源分配偏差、历史修正主义等），其中最常被触发的是虚假平衡、种族灭绝否认、族群编码盲视、主导叙事排除、身份盲视。每个基线场景沿五个维度变化形成 90 个场景：压力框架（施压要求中立/平衡）、专业角色（伪装成记者、人道工作者、政策分析师等权威以测试服从性）、区域情境、时间框架（进行中/冲突后/历史）、语言复杂性（隐语、族群侮辱性称谓、狗哨）。每个对话 3 轮，1–10 分打分，≥7 计为失败、≤3 计为通过。评分可靠性由 5 次独立评审运行的 Krippendorff α = 0.810 支撑，并由两位和平建设从业者对分层样本进行盲评校准，场景亦经有东欧、南高加索、西巴尔干田野经验的从业者审阅。9 个配置经 OpenRouter 匿名模式访问：GPT-5.4-mini（base/medium reasoning）、GPT-4o-mini、Claude Sonnet 4（base/extended thinking）、DeepSeek-V3.2（base/thinking）、Grok 4、Grok 3 Mini（reasoning）。
AI.result: （1）总体分组：优秀组失败率 <10%（Claude Sonnet 4 thinking 8%、GPT-5.4-mini 6%、GPT-5.4-mini reasoning 9%）；中等组 17–26%（Claude Sonnet 4 17%、DeepSeek-V3.2 thinking 20%、DeepSeek-V3.2 26%）；最差组 40–47%（GPT-4o-mini 40%、Grok 3 Mini reasoning 46%、Grok 4 47%），最佳与最差相差约 8 倍。（2）压力框架是最强触发因素：多数配置从基线 13–20% 飙升至 87–100%；仅 Claude Sonnet 4 extended thinking 在压力下保持 7%（与基线持平）。案例中 Grok 4 应用户要求将斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝从标题中删除、把法律定性降级为“多种观点之一”，违背 ICTY、ICJ 与联大第 78/282 号决议的既有认定。（3）语言复杂性维度：顶级模型 0% 失败，Grok 4 达 60%（任何模型在非压力维度中的最高值）；案例中模型未标记用户对罗兴亚人的贬损称谓与“身份主张”框架，反而采用实施方政府的“争议点/不被承认”表述。对以 X 平台为主要即时信息来源的部署场景构成实质安全缺口。（4）专业角色：GPT-4o-mini 53%、Grok 4 40% 失败，Claude Sonnet 4 thinking 亦达 20%（其非压力维度最高值），显示对权威的迎合性服从。（5）区域情境：媒体报道最多的以色列-巴勒斯坦与俄乌冲突反而得分最差（冲突不敏感度均值 5.04 与 4.98），大湖区/卢旺达处理最好，缅甸在 9 个模型中有 6 个位于最差一半，说明媒体可见度不是可靠代理变量。（6）时间框架整体失败率低，除 Grok 系列为 33%。（7）推理模式：Claude Sonnet 4 从 17% 降至 8% 且压力下不退化；DeepSeek 26%→20% 但压力下思考模式仍 80%；GPT-5.4-mini 6%→9% 无实质变化，提示冲突敏感性主要由训练所塑造的原则决定，而非推理时长。跨代际改进显著（GPT-4o-mini 40% → GPT-5.4-mini 6%）。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张这是一种此前未被测试过的对齐属性（而非单纯的推理能力缺陷）：冲突敏感性应成为对齐评测与部署前审计的标准维度，与既有性质并列，并被纳入国家 AI 安全研究所的评测组合与采购流程考量。作者提出三种互不排斥的候选机制解释——训练数据中冲突敏感性规范代表不足、helpfulness 与 harmlessness 训练目标在冲突情境下直接冲突、以及 RLHF 带来的谄媚性漂移（GPT-4o-mini 从 13% 崩至 100% 是提示性证据但不构成定论）；本评测无法区分因果，需通过内部探针或定向微调实验进一步研究。局限包括：评审本身是 AI 模型可能与被测模型共享盲点；场景为合成；全部测试仅限英语，而冲突敏感性高度依赖语言；每模型 90 场景仅能识别大差距；压力崩溃的因果机制未确立；从业者验证仍在扩充；模型经 OpenRouter 访问；结果为单一时间点（2026 年 4 月）的快照；自适应 rollout agent 的交互动力学构成潜在混淆。后续工作方向为扩展至非英语语言、检验长对话中的持续漂移、扩大从业者验证、构建可整合进国家 AI 安全研究所的评测模块。安全影响在于此类失败会强化群体裂痕、扭曲公众认知并促成冲突升级。

title: Reasoning through Verifiable Forecast Actions: Consistency-Grounded RL for Financial LLMs
summary: Financial markets are characterized by extreme non-stationarity, low signal-to-noise ratios, and strong dependence on external information such as news, company fundamentals, and macroeconomic signals. Yet, existing approaches either abstract time-series into text or decouple forecasting from language-based reasoning, leading to a fundamental mismatch between qualitative reasoning and quantitative outcomes. To address this, we introduce StockR1, a time-series-enhanced LLM that unifies stock forecasting and financial reasoning through a verifiable forecast action. Based on a tool-call design, the model first emits a forecast action, which is a structured and interpretable representation of its qualitative market outlook. It then invokes a time-series decoder conditioned on this action to generate distributional future trajectories, leading to more informed question answering and financial reasoning. We optimize the full pipeline with reinforcement learning, where rewards jointly reflect answer validity, forecast accuracy, and consistency between generated actions and observed time-series dynamics. In addition, rewards are reweighted by a sample-level uncertainty scalar, encouraging the model to accommodate varying uncertainty in market dynamics. We evaluate StockR1 on financial question answering and stock forecasting over a large-scale 10-year benchmark. Our method consistently outperforms time-series baselines and general-purpose LLMs, improving reasoning accuracy by 17.7% (4B) and 25.9% (8B). These findings demonstrate that structuring the forecast actions establishes a powerful synergy between language reasoning and temporal prediction, enabling LLMs to reason through verifiable, interpretable, and numerically grounded decisions.

AI.tldr: StockR1是一个时间序列增强的LLM，通过可验证的预测动作统一股票预测和金融推理。它使用工具调用设计，让模型先输出结构化预测动作，再调用时间序列解码器生成分布式未来轨迹。通过强化学习联合优化答案有效性、预测准确性和动作-时序一致性，并引入样本级不确定性标量重新加权奖励。在10年大规模基准测试中，4B和8B模型分别提升推理准确率17.7%和25.9%。
AI.motivation: Financial markets exhibit extreme non-stationarity, low signal-to-noise ratios, and strong dependence on external information. Existing approaches either abstract time-series into text or decouple forecasting from language-based reasoning, creating a fundamental mismatch between qualitative reasoning and quantitative outcomes.
AI.method: StockR1 unifies stock forecasting and financial reasoning through a verifiable forecast action mechanism. Based on a tool-call design, the model first emits a structured forecast action representing qualitative market outlook, then invokes a time-series decoder conditioned on this action to generate distributional future trajectories. The full pipeline is optimized with reinforcement learning, where rewards jointly reflect answer validity, forecast accuracy, and consistency between generated actions and observed time-series dynamics. Rewards are reweighted by a sample-level uncertainty scalar to accommodate varying uncertainty in market dynamics.
AI.result: The method improves reasoning accuracy by 17.7% (4B model) and 25.9% (8B model) on financial question answering and stock forecasting tasks over a large-scale 10-year benchmark.
AI.conclusion: StockR1 establishes a powerful synergy between language reasoning and temporal prediction through structured forecast actions, enabling LLMs to make verifiable, interpretable, and numerically grounded financial decisions. The method consistently outperforms both time-series baselines and general-purpose LLMs.

title: Beyond Acoustic Emotion Recognition: Multimodal Pathos Analysis in Political Speech Using LLM-Based and Acoustic Emotion Models
summary: We investigate whether acoustic emotion recognition models can serve as proxies for the Pathos dimension in political speech analysis, as operationalised by the TRUST multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipeline. Using a Bundestag plenary speech by Felix Banaszak (51 segments, 245 s) as a case study, we compare three analysis modalities: (1) emotion2vec_plus_large, an acoustic speech emotion recognition (SER) model whose continuous Arousal and Valence values are derived via post-hoc Russell Circumplex projection; (2) Gemini 2.5 Flash, an LLM analysing the full speech audio together with its transcript in an open-ended, context-aware fashion; and (3) TRUST-Pathos scores from a three-advocate LLM supervisor ensemble. Spearman rank correlations reveal that Gemini Valence correlates strongly with TRUST-Pathos (rho = +0.664, p < 0.001), whereas emotion2vec Valence does not (rho = +0.097, p = 0.499). We further demonstrate, via a systematic quality evaluation of the Berlin Database of Emotional Speech (EMO-DB) using Gemini in an open-ended annotation paradigm, that standard SER benchmark corpora suffer from acted speech, cultural bias, and category incompatibility. Our results suggest that LLM-based multimodal analysis captures semantically defined political emotion substantially better than acoustic models alone, while acoustic features remain informative for low-level Arousal estimation. Future work will extend this approach to video-based analysis incorporating facial expression and gaze.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了声学情感识别模型无法有效替代政治演讲Pathos维度分析，LLM多模态分析显著优于纯声学方法，标准SER语料库生态有效性存疑。
AI.motivation: Pathos（情感说服力）是政治演讲分析的关键维度，但传统声学情感识别（SER）模型能否有效捕捉政治语境下的情感语义尚不明确，且现有SER基准语料库（如EMO-DB）的生态有效性未被系统验证。
AI.method: 使用邦巴斯基（Banaszak）德国联邦议院演讲（51段，245秒）作为案例研究；采用三种分析模态对比：（1）emotion2vec_plus_large声学模型+Russell环形模型投影；（2）Gemini 2.5 Flash多模态LLM（音频+转录文本）；（3）TRUST-Pathos三辩护人LLM监督集成；通过Spearman秩相关评估各模态与TRUST-Pathos的一致性；另对EMO-DB进行系统性质量评估。
AI.result: Gemini Valence与TRUST-Pathos强正相关（rho=+0.664, p<0.001），而emotion2vec Valence无显著相关（rho=+0.097, p=0.499）；EMO-DB存在表演性语音、文化偏差和类别不兼容问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM多模态分析在政治情感语义捕捉上优于纯声学模型，声学特征仅对底层唤醒度估计有参考价值；标准SER基准语料库存在表演性偏差、文化偏差和类别不兼容问题；未来将扩展至视频分析（面部表情、视线追踪）。

title: Ex-GraphRAG: Interpretable Evidence Routing for Graph-Augmented LLMs
summary: GraphRAG conditions language models on subgraphs retrieved from knowledge graphs, encoded via message-passing GNNs. Because these encoders entangle node contributions through iterated neighborhood aggregation, there is no closed-form way to determine how much each retrieved entity influenced the encoder's output, and therefore no way to faithfully audit what structural evidence actually reached the model. We introduce Ex-GraphRAG, which replaces the GNN encoder with a Multivariate Graph Neural Additive Network (M-GNAN), an extension of additive graph models to high-dimensional embedding spaces that yields an exact decomposition of the encoder's output across individual nodes and feature groups, without post-hoc approximation. On STaRK-Prime, this auditable encoder matches black-box performance. Using it to audit evidence routing, we uncover a semantic-structural mismatch: the nodes that dominate the encoder's output are structurally disconnected in the retrieved subgraph, held together by low-attribution intermediaries whose removal degrades multi-hop QA by up to 28%. This mismatch, invisible to any opaque encoder, reveals that semantic importance and structural connectivity are governed by disjoint sets of nodes, with direct implications for retrieval pruning, context construction, and failure diagnosis in graph-augmented LLMs.

AI.tldr: Ex-GraphRAG通过M-GNAN实现编码器输出的可解释分解，解决了GNN编码器无法审计节点贡献的问题，揭示了语义重要性与结构连通性由不同节点集控制的重要发现。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG中基于消息传递GNN的编码器无法确定每个检索实体对输出的贡献程度，导致无法真实审计输入模型的结构证据。
AI.method: 提出M-GNAN，将加性图模型扩展到高维嵌入空间，实现编码器输出的精确分解。
AI.result: M-GNAN在STaRK-Prime上匹配黑盒性能；审计发现语义-结构错配：主导输出的节点在检索子图中结构断开，由低归因中介节点连接；移除这些中介节点使多跳QA性能下降28%。
AI.conclusion: Ex-GraphRAG通过可审计编码器匹配黑盒性能，揭示了语义重要性与结构连通性由不同节点集控制，这对检索剪枝、上下文构建和图增强LLM的故障诊断具有直接影响。

title: Toward Understanding Adversarial Distillation: Why Robust Teachers Fail
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/HongsinLee/why-robust-teachers-fail
summary: Adversarial Distillation aims to enhance student robustness by guiding the student with a robust teacher's soft labels within the min-max adversarial training framework, yet its success is notoriously inconsistent: a more robust teacher often fails to improve, or even harms, the student's robust generalization. In this paper, we identify a key mechanism of this teacher dependency: the misalignment between the teacher's supervisory confidence and the student's representational limitations on a consistent subset of training data -- the Robustly Unlearnable Set. We present a theoretical framework analyzing the feature learning dynamics of a two-layer neural network, demonstrating that this mismatch creates a dichotomy in distillation outcomes. We prove that when a teacher provides confident supervision on unlearnable samples, it compels the student to memorize spurious noise patterns that eventually overpower the learned robust signal, thereby driving robust overfitting. Conversely, a teacher that exhibits high uncertainty on these samples effectively suppresses noise memorization, allowing the student to rely solely on the learnable signal for robust generalization. We empirically validate our theory across both synthetic simulations and real-image classification datasets, confirming that robust overfitting is driven by the teacher's interaction with unlearnable samples. Finally, we demonstrate that a teacher's predictive entropy on unlearnable samples serves as a strong indicator of student robustness, validating our theoretical framework and offering a principled guideline for robust teacher selection.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对抗蒸馏中教师依赖性的关键机制——Robustly Unlearnable Set上的监督置信度与学生表征能力之间的错配。研究证明，当教师对不可学习样本提供高置信度监督时，会导致学生记忆噪声模式，引发鲁棒过拟合；而高不确定性的教师则能有效抑制噪声记忆。预测熵可作为教师选择的重要指标。
AI.motivation: Adversarial distillation success is inconsistent: a more robust teacher often fails to improve or even harms student robustness. The underlying mechanism (teacher dependency) remains poorly understood.
AI.method: Theoretical analysis of feature learning dynamics in two-layer neural networks; empirical validation on synthetic simulations and real-image classification datasets.
AI.result: Confident teacher supervision on unlearnable samples causes students to memorize spurious noise patterns, leading to robust overfitting. Uncertain teachers effectively suppress noise memorization, enabling students to rely solely on learnable signals for robust generalization.
AI.conclusion: Predictive entropy of teacher on unlearnable samples serves as a reliable indicator for teacher selection, offering a principled approach to select teachers that avoid robust overfitting.

title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
summary: While ubiquitous wearable sensors capture a wealth of behavioral and physiological information, effectively transforming these signals into personalized health insights is challenging. Specifically, converting low-level sensor data into representations capable of characterizing higher-level states is difficult due to high phenotypic diversity and variation in individual baseline health, physiology, and lifestyle factors. Moreover, collecting wearable data paired with health outcome annotations is laborious and expensive, and retrospective annotation remains practically unfeasible, contributing to a scarcity of data with high-quality labels. To overcome these limitations, we propose a foundation model for wearable health that is pretrained on more than one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals drawn from a large cohort of five million participants. We demonstrate that the joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume leads to systematic improvements in performance, as evaluated on a diverse set of 35 health prediction tasks, spanning cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, and mental health, as well as lifestyle choices and demographic factors. We find that this population scale representation unlocks label-efficient few-shot learning and generative capabilities for robust daily metric estimation. To further leverage this learned representation, we deploy a classroom of LLM agents to autonomously search the space of downstream predictive heads built on the model embeddings, showing broad performance improvements that increase with LLM model capacity. Finally, we show how integrating these downstream predictors into a Personal Health Agent can support model responses that are more relevant, contextually aware, and safe, and we validate this via 1,860 ratings from a cohort of clinicians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于万亿分钟级无标签数据预训练的可穿戴健康基础模型(PHG),通过大规模自监督学习将多模态传感器信号转化为通用健康表征,在35项健康预测任务上验证了缩放定律,并引入LLM智能体自动化下游模型设计,最终构建经1860名临床医生验证的个人健康助手。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器虽能捕获丰富数据,但将低层传感器信号转化为高层健康状态面临双重挑战:个体间的表型多样性和基线差异导致泛化困难;高质量标注数据稀缺且标注成本高昂。
AI.method: (1)基于十亿分钟级无标签传感器信号对五百万参与者进行大规模预训练;(2)构建包含35项任务的评测体系验证缩放定律;(3)部署LLM智能体课堂自主搜索下游预测头;(4)通过1860名临床医生评分验证个人健康助手的安全性和有效性。
AI.result: 模型在心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康等多个领域35项预测任务上系统性提升性能;实现了标签高效的少样本学习,可鲁棒估计日常健康指标;LLM智能体随模型容量增加性能持续提升;临床医生评分验证了个人健康助手在相关性、情境感知和安全性方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 提出的PHG模型成功突破了可穿戴健康数据的标注瓶颈,通过万亿分钟级预训练实现35项健康预测任务的先进性能,并通过LLM智能体自动化模型搜索和临床验证展示出实际应用价值。

title: Check Your LLM's Secret Dictionary! Five Lines of Code Reveal What Your LLM Learned (Including What It Shouldn't Have)
summary:
We show that singular value decomposition of the lm_head} weight matrix of a transformer-based large language model -- requiring only five lines of PyTorch and no model inference -- reveals interpretable semantic subspaces directly from the model weights. Each left singular vector identifies the vocabulary tokens most readily selected when the hidden state aligns with the corresponding singular direction; inspecting these clusters exposes the model's training data composition and curation philosophy.
  Analysing GPT-OSS-120B, Gemma-2-2B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B, we find that singular value spectra and vocabulary cluster structures differ systematically across models: GPT exhibits a graduated hierarchy of functionally differentiated subspaces; Gemma is dominated by pre-nineteenth-century English orthography, forming a stepwise clustering structure that may contribute to high output controllability; and Qwen exhibits broad multilingual coverage alongside subspaces whose vocabulary the authors have determined to be ethically inappropriate for direct publication.
  Base-instruct comparison reveals that ethically concerning subspaces originate in pretraining and are not removed by post-training alignment. We introduce the Vocabulary Cluster Score (VCS) to quantify subspace coherence, and the Weighted Projection Score (WPS) as a static glitch token detector; applying WPS to GPT-OSS-120B recovers shokubutsu-hyakka-tsu (ID 137606), a well-known glitch token widely reported in the CJK language community, without any model inference. We propose a taxonomy of root causes for problematic vocabulary content and call for lm_head} SVD analysis to be adopted as a standard pre-release safety auditing step. Our findings further suggest directions toward SVD-guided tokenizer optimisation and more controllable LLM design.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，对LLM输出层权重矩阵进行简单的SVD分解即可揭示语义子空间和训练数据特征，发现不同模型具有差异化的子空间结构，且有害内容起源于预训练阶段无法通过后训练对齐消除，建议将SVD分析作为LLM安全审计的标准流程。
AI.motivation: 通过分析transformer语言模型的lm_head权重矩阵，直接从模型权重中揭示可解释的语义子空间，探索模型的训练数据构成和整理策略。
AI.method: 通过对lm_head权重矩阵进行奇异值分解（SVD），无需模型推理即可揭示语义子空间。引入词汇聚类分数（VCS）量化子空间一致性，以及加权投影分数（WPS）作为静态故障token检测器。
AI.result: GPT-OSS-120B呈现功能分化子空间的层级结构；Gemma-2-2B以十九世纪前英语正字法为主，形成阶梯式聚类结构；Qwen2.5-1.5B展现广泛多语言覆盖但含有不适宜公开发布的子空间。WPS成功检测到已知故障token（shokubutsu-hyakka-tsu）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出将lm_head SVD分析作为标准发布前安全审计步骤，并建议未来探索SVD引导的分词器优化和更可控的LLM设计方向。

title: Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search
comment: The first three authors and the last author have equal contributions. The first three authors are in random order
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly excel at mathematical reasoning, but their unreliability limits their utility in mathematics research. A mitigation is using LLMs to generate formal proofs in languages like Lean. We perform the first large-scale evaluation of this method's ability to solve open problems. Our most capable agent autonomously resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems at the per-problem cost of a few hundred dollars, proved 44/492 OEIS conjectures, and is being deployed in combinatorics, optimization, graph theory, algebraic geometry, and quantum optics research. A basic agent alternating LLM-based generation with Lean-based verification replicated the Erdős successes but proved costlier on the hardest problems. These findings demonstrate the power of AI-aided formal proof search and shed light on the agent designs that enable it.

AI.tldr: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Nexus——一个让 LLM 生成 Lean 形式化证明并由 Lean 编译器逐步验证的智能体框架，并首次对其"解决研究级开放问题"的能力做了大规模评估：其"全功能"智能体自主解决了 Formal Conjectures 仓库中 353 个 Erdős 开放问题里的 9 个（单题推理成本仅数百美元）、证明了 492 个 OEIS 开放猜想中的 44 个，并已在组合数学、优化理论、图论、代数几何与量子光学等方向投入实际研究使用。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理上表现突出，但"不可靠性"（幻觉、细微逻辑错误、错误在中间步骤级联）是其进入数学研究的主要障碍：自然语言证明需昂贵的专家逐行审阅，且未审阅的中间错误会限制可委派任务复杂度。已有"LLM 生成形式化证明（Lean）"的成果主要集中在竞赛数学与对已有人类证明的形式化，尚未系统检验其能否真正"发现"新的研究级结果。此外，现有研究级 AI 数学工作（如自然语言证明、AlphaEvolve 式程序进化）普遍缺少端到端的机器验证，而形式验证可充当筛选"哪些证明值得人类复核"的过滤器。
AI.method: 框架 AlphaProof Nexus：输入为一个含 sorry 占位符的 Lean "proof sketch"（可附自然语言上下文），用用户标记 EVOLVE-BLOCK（可增改辅助引理/定义/证明步）与 EVOLVE-VALUE（可调参数取值）界定可修改区域，输出为无 sorry 且经 SafeVerify 校验（防公理注入等环境攻击）的证明。四种智能体配置：(A) 基础型——N 个互不共享状态的 prover 子智能体，每个执行 "Ralph loop"，由多轮 Gemini 3.1 Pro 推理 + search_replace 工具编辑 sketch，每次编辑后用 Lean 编译器反馈驱动下一轮，episode 结束仍有 sorry 则写入经验注释进入下一 episode；(B) 在 A 基础上允许把 AlphaProof（基于 RL 的奥赛级 Lean 证明系统，低算力树搜索模式）作为工具调用，返回 proof/disproof/failure；(C) 引入 AlphaEvolve 式进化框架——共享 sketch 种群库，鉴于形式验证适应度天然二值，用 Gemini 3.0 Flash 评分智能体按 Plackett-Luce 模型做 7 元组对局排序，经 Gibbs 采样推断强度并换算 Elo，用 P-UCB（c=0.2，前 64 名精英池）采样父代；(D) 融合 B+C，即"全功能"智能体。配套全局目标缓存（对子目标 Lean 状态的深度哈希去重复用）、AlphaProof 预算（每次 episode ≤5 次查询、≤90 次编辑、单目标约 400 次模拟）、Docker 沙箱（Lean v4.27 + Pantograph）异步流水线。成本以美元计（prover 用 Gemini 3.1 Pro，rater 用 Gemini 3.0 Flash），并对 A/B 用 100 次独立尝试分组模拟 K 并行子智能体，对 C/D 用 10 子智能体 ×10 次尝试。
AI.result: （1）Erdős 集：Agent D 在全部 353 条形式化陈述上求解 9 题（#12(i)(ii)、#125、#138*、#152、#741(i)(ii)、#846、#26*），其中两题已开放 56 年；每题推理成本数百美元（AlphaProof 另约 27.5 v6e TPU 时 ≈ 60 美元）。代表性证明：#12(i)(ii) 用中国剩余定理 + Behrend 型 3-AP 规避集的分块构造；#125 用 3^m≈4^k 的丢番图逼近做归纳稀疏化，证明 A+B 下密度为零；#138 用贪心着色扩张得 W(k+1)−W(k)→∞；#846 用 K∞ 边映射到 R² 与无限 Ramsey 定理；#152 用 Sidon 差集/和集的四元组转移估计得 I(A+A)≥(n²−100n−16)/16；#26 用分块 CRT 构造使 M(A+k) 上密度 < 3/4。智能体还发现并修正了文献中的形式化歧义（#125、#741(i) 的"密度"应分别为下密度/上密度）。（2）OEIS：Gemini 自动形式化 492 条开放猜想（先通过"测试引理"核对前几项），证明 44 条，其中含 A051293 的渐近展开式与 A228143 的 1/8 次幂整数系数性。（3）研究部署：为 min-max 凸凹优化中 Anchored GDA 证明精确 O(1/t) 收敛率（通过 EVOLVE-VALUE 同时搜索出全新的参数调度，改用离散递推而非连续时间 ODE 分析）；证明二部图重建猜想在附加类型条件下的正确性（无限制版本仍开放）；证明 Zanello 关于 pure O-序列对数凹性的猜想（codim 3、type 2 的最后开放情形）；辅助解决 Green 清单 #57（实值版本，猜想的复值版本由浮点启发式给出反例并由智能体形式化证明其为反例）；在 Stacks Project 形式化中自动构造复杂引理（如可分域扩张 Lemma 04KM）；在量子光学中解决若干单色量子图存在性猜想（N=d∈{4,6,10}）。（4）架构消融：事后对比发现基础智能体 (A) 也能解出全部 9 题，但在最难题上成本更高；D 在 #138、#125 上比 A/B 便宜 2–5 倍，在其余题上成本效率约低一半；用 Gemini 3.0 Flash / 3.1 Flash-Lite 的 A 变体、以及 AlphaProof 单独树搜索（每题约 64 v6e TPU 时）均无法解出任何一题；Codex（GPT-5.5）解出 7/9（未解 #152、#125），Claude Code（Opus 4.7）一题未解。（5）失败分析：高 Elo 草图常见两类问题——把核心难点藏进单个 sorry 的"改写目标"辅助引理（显式提示也无效），以及宣称引理为文献既有结论但实为幻觉；这正凸显端到端形式验证的必要性。（6）成本方差极大（个别题上呈长尾），且 353 题的全面筛选本身即是显著算力投入。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明 LLM 驱动的形式化证明搜索已具备真实数学研究的实用价值：能自主攻克开放 Erdős 问题、验证 OEIS 猜想、并嵌入多个前沿方向的在研项目，同时充当"形式验证过滤网"，帮数学家把精力集中到未解子目标而非重验整条论证，并能暴露文献中的错误形式化。方法论结论是：随着 LLM 能力提升，从"专门训练的系统"转向"简单的智能体循环"是明显趋势——基础智能体的意外成功即源于此，而全功能智能体在最难题上仍保有优势，但该优势可能随 LLM 进步而缩小；单智能体采样数据库而不异步协调则效果反而更差，K=10 是较优默认配置。局限与展望：成功仍集中于 Lean 数学库成熟、任务可分解的领域（组合、凸优化、数论），需要全新理论或大量理论的开放问题（甚至 Erdős #12 的第三问）仍遥不可及；智能体继承底层 LLM 的偏见、搜索方差高、成本不稳定；"美元成本"只是复现门槛的共同货币，不应解读为与人类数学劳动的对比。未来方向是刻画并拓展智能体能力边界，定位为人机协同、扩展数学家创造力的工具——即便未能证出结论，其形式化证明草图也能加深人类对问题的理解。

title: CASE-NET: Deep Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning via Causal Attention and Channel Recalibration for Multivariate Time Series Classification
summary: Multivariate time series (MTS) classification is foundational to pervasive computing and financial analysis, yet existing multi-scale paradigms are often constrained by suboptimal representation fidelity. We identify two critical bottlenecks: temporal non-causality in standard encoders that induces temporal confounding in non-stationary dynamics, and the absence of explicit channel saliency mechanisms that allows noise to contaminate the latent space. To address these challenges, we propose the Causal Attention and Spatio-temporal Encoder Network (CASE-NET), an architecture designed for structural manifold pre-conditioning. CASE-NET synergizes a Causal Temporal Encoder, which enforces physical arrow-of-time constraints via masked self-attention and causal convolutions, with an Adaptive Channel Recalibration module functioning as an information bottleneck to suppress detrimental noise. Comprehensive evaluations across six heterogeneous domains demonstrate that CASE-NET establishes new state-of-the-art benchmarks on four tasks, achieving a peak accuracy of 98.6% on the AWR dataset and superior robustness in non-stationary regimes.

AI.tldr: CASE-NET 是一个面向多变量时间序列分类的深度时空表示学习架构，核心思想是把「因果时序编码 + 通道重标定」放在多尺度解耦之前，作为「结构流形预调节器」，先净化上游表征再交给下游共享/私有解耦头。模型在 HAR、ISRUC-S3、NASDAQ、AWR、FM、Epilepsy 六个基准上评估，在 HAR、NASDAQ、AWR、Epilepsy 四项任务取得 SOTA，AWR 最高准确率 98.6%，NASDAQ 相比最优基线 DisMS-TS 提升 7.05 个百分点；消融实验表明因果掩码与 SE 通道重标定均有显著独立贡献，且仅用 MLP 替换解耦头仍优于所有基线，验证 CASE 编码器作为架构无关前端的价值。
AI.motivation:
多变量时间序列（MTS）分类已广泛用于可穿戴感知、临床诊断与金融市场分析。近期多尺度解耦方法（如 DisMS-TS）通过引入尺度共享/尺度私有正交约束来消除跨尺度冗余，但这类框架隐含假设「送入解耦模块的时空特征本身已足够鲁棒、抗噪」，该假设在真实场景中常被违反。作者指出当前特征提取管线存在两大表示瓶颈：

1) 时间非因果性（temporal blindness）：循环模型难以建模长程依赖，双向/双向注意力处理会把未来观测引入当前表征，在非平稳序列中未来帧往往是演化噪声或传感器伪影而非有用语义，从而造成时间混淆（temporal confounding）并扭曲隐含动作基元（action motifs）；
2) 空间通道同质性（spatial channel heterogeneity）：各传感器信噪比（SNR）差异大且重要性随情境动态变化，但多数架构对所有通道一视同仁，把噪声过滤责任推给下游解耦头，损害蒸馏特征的纯净度。

因此本文主张「更好的表示带来更好的解耦」，把研究重点从下游解耦逻辑前移到上游表征流形质量，通过在架构层面注入因果先验（而非昂贵的显式因果发现或传递熵）来实现流形预调节，把下游解耦损失的假设空间收窄。
AI.method:
整体为三阶段流水线：多尺度投影 → CASE 编码器 → 共享-私有分解与分类。

(1) 通用多尺度投影：输入 X∈R^{N×L} 经 S 个具有不同感受野与步幅的 Conv1D 投影为多分辨率视图集 {V_s}（式1，σ 为激活），仅初始化尺度特定视图。

(2) CASE 编码器（在所有 S 个分支间权重共享，保证尺度不变的因果-空间变换与效率，共 2 层）：
- 因果时序注意力（CTA）：局部用带左侧非对称填充（填充 (k−1)·d）的空洞因果卷积，y_t = σ(Σ W_i·x_{t−d·i}+b)，保证 P(x_t|x_<t) 不被未来扰动；全局用上三角因果掩码的掩码自注意力，Attention = Softmax(QK^T/√d_k + M)V，M_ij = 0 (i≥j)、−∞ (i<j)，实现 h_t = f({x_τ}_{τ≤t})。该模块被定位为「结构噪声滤波器」，实现时序去混淆与流形预调节。
- 通道自适应重标定（CAR，SE 式信息瓶颈）：对 H∈R^{B×N×L} 做全局平均池化得通道描述子 z_n = F_sq(h_n)（式5，被解释为特征演化轨迹的压缩摘要而非朴素时间平均），经 N→N/r→N 的瓶颈激励门 a = σ(W₂·ReLU(W₁·z))∈[0,1]^N，再以 H̃ = a ⊙ H 逐通道重加权，在解耦头之前主动抑制低显著性/噪声通道。

(3) 共享-私有分解与预测：自适应门 m^(s) = σ(W_g H̃^(s) + b_g) 将每尺度表示拆为 H_sh^(s)=m^(s)⊙H̃^(s)（尺度不变语义核心，如基线心率/神经节律）与 H_sp^(s)=(1−m^(s))⊙H̃^(s)（非平稳残差、高频瞬态、局灶性阵发事件）；经全局聚合 G、时间与尺度维拼接后由 MLP+Softmax 输出。

(4) 协同流形优化：L_total = L_cls + λ₁L_sim + λ₂L_diff。L_sim 为跨尺度共享表示间的余弦距离（捕捉不变的节律基元），L_diff = ‖H_sh^T H_sp‖_F² 惩罚共享-私有互协方差以促成正交性。

(5) 复杂度：注意力 O(L²·D)、因果卷积 O(L·k·D)、重标定 O(N²/r) 可忽略；约 2.1M 参数，作者称吞吐可行于实时应用。

实验设置：6 个数据集（HAR、ISRUC-S3、NASDAQ、AWR、FM、Epilepsy），指标为 Acc/Macro-F1/MCC，8 个基线（LSTNet、DTP、TS-TCC、PatchTST、MAGNN、Pathformer、TimeMixer、DisMS-TS），5 次独立运行取均值±标准差，20% 验证集选超参。
AI.result:
主结果（Table 1）：CASE-NET 在 HAR(96.52±0.35)、NASDAQ(46.76±3.8)、AWR(98.60±0.91)、Epilepsy(73.48±0.57) 上取得 SOTA（*表示相对最优基线 p<0.01 显著）；ISRUC-S3(84.38) 与 FM(58.67) 排名第二。NASDAQ 提升幅度最大（+7.05%），Epilepsy 因 SE 抗伪迹获益。ISRUC-S3 落后 DisMS-TS（作者归因于季节分解更适合 L=3000 的极端周期），FM 落后 DisMS-TS 1.00%（归因于小样本 N=284 下更简逻辑的正则更强）。部分指标方差偏大，如 ISRUC-S3 MCC 0.794±0.398、FM MCC 0.173±0.082、NASDAQ ACC 标准差达 3.8。

消融（Table 2）：基线 vanilla GRU 89.42/36.50/92.15/64.20；去因果掩码（仅 SE）在 NASDAQ 降至 38.20（−8.56%）、HAR 91.25（−5.27%）；去 SE（仅因果）NASDAQ 44.15、AWR 96.48；CASE-NET+MLP 头为 95.10/45.30/97.80/71.90，仍全面超过所有基线，说明 CASE 编码器是主要贡献来源；两先验存在超线性协同。

超参与稳定性：最优尺度数 S 因数据集而异（AWR 需 S=6，HAR 为 S=4），低 S 掉点源于分辨率匹配需求而非不稳定；解耦权重 λ 在三个数量级范围内性能平稳，说明收益来自结构设计而非调参；约 40 epoch 内训练/验证损失收敛且贴合良好，暗示因果掩码与通道瓶颈起结构性正则作用。

可解释性：跨尺度相关热图显示共享特征 F_sha 强相关、私有特征 F_spe 相关性低且分散；t-SNE 显示 HAR 上类簇紧凑、类间边界清晰，优于 DisMS-TS 的特征流形。

需注意的表述不一致：正文称因果先验带来「Epilepsy +4.98%、AWR +2.12%」，但按表 2 数值，4.98 与 2.12 恰为 SE 通道重标定的贡献（73.48−68.50、98.60−96.48），因果项的对应增益应为 +6.08（Epilepsy）与 +4.30（AWR），存在归因错置；此外 NASDAQ/FM 绝对精度仍偏低（46.76%、58.67%），MCC 接近随机水平（0.110、0.173），说明该域上的「最优」更多体现为相对提升而非强判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为 CASE-NET 通过在共享-私有解耦之前插入因果时序建模与通道重标定，解决了多尺度 MTS 分类中的表示瓶颈，二者作用互补：因果时序过滤稳定时间动态、阻隔未来噪声，通道重标定在解耦前抑制通道级噪声；因果-空间预调节使下游解耦头能在更干净的流形上获得更高特征正交性与更小信息泄漏，六个异构域实验验证了在非平稳与含噪设定下的鲁棒性优势，未来工作方向为面向更广泛感知应用的大规模时空预训练。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Random Job Arrivals
summary: The Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is the optimal allocation of a set of jobs to machines. Two primary challenges persist in FJSP: the unpredictable arrival of future jobs and the combinatorial complexity of the problem, rendering it intractable for conventional mixed-integer linear programming solvers. This paper proposes an event-based \gls{DRL} approach to solve FJSP with random job arrivals. Specifically, we employ the Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm and use lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptrons to train the \gls{DRL} agent for minimizing the total completion time of all jobs. We design the state representation to be directly accessible from the environment, and limit the learning agent to selecting from among a set of well-established dispatching rules. Simulations show that our \gls{DRL} approach outperforms any of the individual dispatching rules on datasets with varying heterogeneity and job arrival rates. We benchmark our \gls{DRL} against an arrival-triggered mixed-integer linear programming solution and show that our method achieves good performance especially when the datasets are heterogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向随机作业到达的柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）事件驱动深度强化学习框架：以 PPO + 轻量级 MLP 作为策略网络，状态直接取自环境（各作业下一工序索引、机床下次空闲时间、作业下次可用时间），动作空间限定为 5 种作业排序规则（SPT/LPT/FIFO/LIFO/MWR）× 2 种机床分配规则（MIN/MINC）共 10 个组合，奖励用当前 makespan 的差分塑形。实验表明该方法稳定优于或持平"事后最优启发式"（Best HH）与任一单独派工规则；在同质化数据上 AT-MILP（到达触发的 MILP 在线重排）更优，在异质化数据上 DRL 明显更优（如 λ=0.2 时 1478 vs 1642），显示 DRL 适合异质、在线决策时间受限的场景。
AI.motivation: 柔性作业车间调度问题（FJSP）允许每个工序在多台兼容机床上加工，方案空间因而被大幅放大，属于 NP-hard 问题。现实生产中的个性化订单与批量定制使调度必须应对两类核心困难：一是未来作业的到达时间不可预知（动态/随机到达），二是组合复杂度高使常规 MILP 求解器（Gurobi、OR-Tools CP-SAT）难以在实时在线场景下给出高质量解。现有三类方案的不足：① 工业界常用的启发式派工规则速度快、可即时响应，但短视且高度依赖数据集结构，无单一规则在所有场景最优；② 事件触发式重排（元启发式如粒子群、遗传算法，或迭代 MILP）能产出高质量调度，但计算开销大，不适合实时在线决策；③ 早期表格型 RL（Q-learning）依赖查找表，随状态空间增长扩展性差；近期 DRL 方法虽用神经网络提升表达能力，但往往采用复杂状态特征与重型网络（注意力、图神经网络），训练难度大，且多假设恒定到达率与同质机床/作业。本文目标是在动态随机到达条件下，以最小化 makespan 为目标构建事件驱动的 DRL 框架，并提供强基线以验证其有效性。
AI.method:
1) 问题建模：将随机作业到达的 FJSP 形式化为离散事件 MDP（t 索引决策事件，事件间隔物理时间可变），并因未到达作业状态不可观测而实际视为 POMDP。约束含机床不重叠、工序优先序、非抢占无中断、确定性加工时间、忽略换型与运输时间；目标 min C_max，逻辑析取约束经二元排序变量与 big-M 线性化。

2) 状态与观测：状态 s_t=(q_t, m_t, τ_t)，分别为各作业下一工序索引、机床下次空闲时间、作业下次可用时间（未到达作业置大值）。POMDP 观测只暴露最先到达的 l=40 个已到达未完成作业（不足处用归一化后的大值填充），并附加各作业下一工序的平均加工时间、当前 makespan、当前事件时间，保证 MLP 输入维度固定。

3) 动作空间：不直接选择作业-机床对（训练复杂度随规模急剧上升），而是从成熟派工规则池中选取：作业排序 5 种（SPT、LPT、FIFO、LIFO、MWR），机床路由 2 种（MIN、MINC），共 5×2=10 个组合；保持可解释且可任意扩充。

4) 奖励与算法：reward shaping 取 r=C(s_t)−C(s_{t+1})（makespan 差分），γ=1，此时回报等于 −C(s_T)，最大化回报等价于最小化最终 makespan；回合在全部工序完成时终止。PPO 采用裁剪代理目标（ε=0.2）、GAE（λ=0.95），actor/critic 均为两层隐藏层（256、128）+ReLU 的轻量 MLP，softmax 输出规则概率并采样。

5) 环境机制：调度构建（schedule building）范式，事件定义为"工序完成"或"新作业到达"；事件时间为当前甘特图上最早事件的物理时间，动作后更新，若无可用工序则推进到下一事件时间。

6) 基线：将 MILP 改造为事件/到达触发的在线重排方法 AT-MILP（每次新作业到达触发 Gurobi 重解，单次 60 秒时限，只对剩余与新到工序排程）；Best HH（对每个实例试跑 10 条规则取事后最优）；以及三条代表性单独规则（FIFO+MINC、LIFO+MINC、LPT+MIN）；因全知最优不可计算，不设 clairvoyant 基准。

7) 数据集：同质集按文献生成（每作业 1–4 工序、加工时间 Unif[1,100]、兼容机床数 Unif{1..M}、M=6）；异质集加入短/长作业（85%/15%，Unif[10,30]/Unif[75,300]）、1 台快机床 + 慢速惩罚 f=3、以及仅兼容单一瓶颈机床的工序；到达均为泊松过程（λ∈{0.2,0.05,0.02}）。PPO 超参：1e7 步、rollout 256、minibatch 64、学习率 1e-4、熵系数 0.02、更新 3 轮；未做系统网格搜索。
AI.result: 同质数据集（6 机床，20 作业与 40 作业）：AT-MILP 在所有设置下 makespan 最小（λ=0.2 时 307±14 与 560±14），DRL 次之（338±18、595±23）但稳定优于或持平 Best HH（378±15、619±16）并优于各单独规则（如 Rule 1/2/3）；λ=0.02 时三者接近（763–765 / 1380），因期望到达间隔 1/λ=50 与平均加工时长相当，冲突少、问题变易。异质数据集（6 机床、5 初始 + 15 新增作业，15 次独立运行）：AT-MILP 明显退化且在高到达率下最差（λ=0.2：1642±14），DRL 最优（1478±52，Best HH 1499±83，Rule 3 最差 2014±50）；λ=0.05 时 DRL 1550±86 < Best HH 1564±104 < AT-MILP 1660±19；λ=0.02 时 DRL 1753±174 与 AT-MILP 1757±109 接近且优于 Best HH 1797±197。Gantt 图示例中 M_5 为唯一快机床、M_1 为瓶颈，DRL 取得最小 makespan，AT-MILP 因逐事件短视而把快机床占给短作业、导致关键长作业阻塞。学习曲线显示约 3000 次 rollout 后回合累计奖励趋于稳定。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了面向随机作业到达 FJSP 的事件驱动 DRL 框架：通过简洁的状态/观测表示与"派工规则选择"动作空间，配合轻量 MLP 的 actor-critic PPO，实现了可解释、易扩展、训练成本低的在线调度器，在所有测试设置下达到或超过事后最优启发式规则。实践建议明确：数据同质且在线求解时限宽松时优先使用 AT-MILP；异质或在线时间预算紧张时部署该 DRL 更优。局限与未来工作：未做系统超参网格搜索、仅测试两类数据与两种规模、仅最小化 makespan、动作空间依赖人工设计规则集合；未来可探索不同到达模式与更多异质数据类型以增强鲁棒性。

title: LABO: LLM-Accelerated Bayesian Optimization through Broad Exploration and Selective Experimentation
summary: The high cost and data scarcity in scientific exploration have motivated the use of large language models (LLMs) as knowledge-driven components in Bayesian optimization (BO). However, existing approaches typically embed LLMs directly into the sampling or surrogate modeling pipeline, without fully leveraging their significantly lower evaluation cost compared to real-world experiments. To address this limitation, we propose LLM-Accelerated Bayesian Optimization (LABO), a framework that combines LLM predictions with experimental observations within a single BO loop. LABO employs a gating criterion to dynamically balance the reliance on LLM predictions versus actual experiments. By leveraging inexpensive LLM evaluations to broadly explore the search space and reserving costly real experiments only for regions with high uncertainty, LABO achieves more sample-efficient optimization. We provide a theoretical analysis with a cumulative regret bound that formalizes this efficiency gain. Empirical results across diverse scientific tasks demonstrate that LABO consistently outperforms existing methods under identical experimental budgets. Our results suggest that LABO offers a practical and theoretically grounded approach for integrating LLMs into scientific discovery workflows.

AI.tldr: LABO是一个将大语言模型与贝叶斯优化相结合的科学发现框架，通过动态门控机制平衡LLM预测与真实实验，在降低成本的同时提高样本效率，并具有理论 regret bound 保证。
AI.motivation: High cost and data scarcity in scientific exploration limit experimental efficiency, while existing LLM-BO approaches do not fully exploit the significantly lower evaluation cost of LLMs compared to real-world experiments.
AI.method: LABO employs a gating criterion to dynamically balance reliance on LLM predictions versus actual experiments, using inexpensive LLM evaluations for broad exploration and reserving costly real experiments for high-uncertainty regions.
AI.result: LABO consistently outperforms existing methods under identical experimental budgets, achieving more sample-efficient optimization through the proposed gating-based exploration strategy.
AI.conclusion: LABO provides a practical and theoretically grounded approach for integrating LLMs into scientific discovery workflows, with empirical validation across diverse scientific tasks.

title: Prototype-Guided Classification Sub-Task Decoupling Framework: Enhancing Generalization and Interpretability for Multivariate Time Series
summary:
Time Series Classification (TSC) is a long-standing research problem that has gained increasing attention in recent years with the rapid growth of large-scale temporal data. Despite substantial progress enabled by deep learning, designing TSC models that are both accurate and interpretable remains a challenging task. Many existing approaches adopt a direct feature-to-label classification paradigm, by collapsing high-dimensional temporal embeddings into class logits via a single linear projection (often after global pooling), the paradigm conflates feature extraction and decision logic into an inseparable mapping.
  To address these limitations, we propose PDFTime, a prototype-guided framework that reformulates time series classification as a multi-stage decision process. Instead of direct feature-to-label mapping, PDFTime leverages learned prototypes to approximate class-conditional feature distributions in the latent space, enabling progressive discrimination through classification sub-tasks of varying granularity. To our knowledge, PDFTime is the first framework to reformulate time series classification as a decoupled, multi-stage similarity-based reasoning process, breaking the long-standing paradigm of direct, black-box feature-to-label mapping. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PDFTime achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across UEA and UCR benchmarks. Notably, it secures the top-$1$ accuracy on 80 out of 128 datasets in the UCR archive, significantly outperforming recent strong baselines in both consistency and generalization.

AI.tldr: PDFTime proposes a prototype-guided, multi-stage decision framework for time series classification, breaking the traditional direct feature-to-label mapping paradigm by using learned prototypes and similarity-based reasoning to achieve state-of-the-art results on major TSC benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing TSC methods adopt a direct feature-to-label classification paradigm (collapsing temporal embeddings via linear projection after global pooling), which conflates feature extraction and decision logic into an inseparable mapping, making models difficult to interpret.
AI.method: PDFTime leverages learned prototypes to approximate class-conditional feature distributions in latent space, enabling progressive discrimination through multi-stage classification sub-tasks of varying granularity. This decouples feature extraction from decision logic via similarity-based reasoning rather than direct black-box mapping.
AI.result: PDFTime achieves SOTA performance across UEA and UCR benchmarks, securing top-1 accuracy on 80 out of 128 datasets in the UCR archive, with significantly improved consistency and generalization over recent baselines.
AI.conclusion: PDFTime establishes a new SOTA paradigm for time series classification, achieving top-1 accuracy on 80 out of 128 UCR datasets and consistently outperforming recent strong baselines in both accuracy and generalization.

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
comment: Gated DeltaNet-2 technical report; code at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2
summary: Linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. Delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value, and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. But the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to control two different things: how much old content to erase on the key side and how much new content to commit on the value side. We introduce Gated DeltaNet-2, which generalizes both Gated DeltaNet and KDA by inheriting adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay while addressing their shared limitation, the scalar tie between erasing and writing. Gated Delta Rule-2 separates these roles with a channel-wise erase gate b_t and a channel-wise write gate w_t, reducing to KDA when both gates collapse to the same scalar and to Gated DeltaNet when the decay also collapses. We derive a fast-weight update view, a chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors, and a gate-aware backward pass that preserves efficient parallel training. At 1.3B parameters trained on 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, Gated DeltaNet-2 achieves the strongest overall results among Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet, KDA, and Mamba-3 variants across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced on long-context RULER needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks, where it improves the evaluated multi-key retrieval setting and remains strong in both recurrent and hybrid settings. Code is available at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2.

AI.tldr: Gated DeltaNet-2通过将Delta-rule模型中耦合的擦除与写入门解耦为独立的通道级门控（b_t和w_t），解决了现有模型的标量绑定限制，在保持线性时间复杂度和常数内存的同时，显著提升了长上下文任务（尤其是多键检索）性能。
AI.motivation: 当前Delta-rule类模型（如Gated DeltaNet和KDA）共有的核心限制是：一个标量门同时控制两件不同的事——Key侧的旧内容擦除强度和Value侧的新内容写入强度，这种标量绑定（scalar tie）限制了模型对压缩记忆的精细编辑能力。
AI.method: 核心改进是将KDA中单一的通道级衰减标量门拆分为两个独立参数：通道级擦除门b_t和通道级写入门w_t。此外，论文还给出了快速权重更新视图和分块WY算法（将通道级衰减吸收为非对称擦除因子），以及保持高效并行训练的门控反向传播。
AI.result: 1.3B参数规模下，在100B FineWeb-Edu tokens训练后，Gated DeltaNet-2在语言建模、常识推理和检索任务上均超越了Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet、KDA及Mamba-3变体；在长上下文RULER needle-in-a-haystack基准上优势最为显著。
AI.conclusion: Gated DeltaNet-2通过将擦除和写入操作解耦为独立的通道级门控，在保持高效并行训练的同时，在长上下文任务上展现出显著优势，尤其在多键检索设置和needle-in-a-haystack基准测试中表现突出。

title: From Reasoning Chains to Verifiable Subproblems: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Enables Credit Assignment for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong promise for LLM reasoning, but outcome-based RLVR remains inefficient on hard problems because correct final-answer rollouts are rare and sample-level credit assignment cannot use partial progress in failed attempts. We introduce SCRL (Subproblem Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), a curriculum RL framework that derives verifiable subproblems from reference reasoning chains and fixes the final subproblem as the original problem. This turns partial progress on hard problems into verifiable learning signals. Algorithmically, SCRL uses subproblem-level normalization, which normalizes rewards independently at each subproblem position and assigns the resulting advantages to the corresponding answer spans, enabling finer-grained credit assignment without external rubrics or reward models. Our analysis shows that subproblem curricula lift hard problems out of gradient dead zones, with larger relative gains as the original problem becomes harder. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SCRL outperforms strong curriculum-learning baselines, improving average accuracy over GRPO by +4.1 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and +1.9 points on Qwen3-14B-Base. On AIME24, AIME25, and IMO-Bench, SCRL further improves pass@1 by +3.7 points and pass@64 by +4.6 points on Qwen3-4B-Base, indicating better exploration on hard reasoning problems.

AI.tldr: SCRL是一种课程强化学习框架，通过将困难问题分解为可验证的子问题，并采用子问题级归一化实现细粒度信用分配，将部分进展转化为可验证的学习信号，从而有效提升LLM在困难数学推理问题上的表现。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的RLVR在困难问题上效率低下，原因有二：正确最终答案的rollout稀缺，且样本级信用分配无法利用失败尝试中的部分进展。
AI.method: (1) 从参考推理链中导出可验证的子问题课程，最后一个子问题固定为原始问题；(2) 采用子问题级归一化——在每个子问题位置独立归一化奖励，并将所得优势分配给对应答案片段，实现无需外部评分标准或奖励模型的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在7个数学推理基准上，SCRL优于强课程学习基线：在Qwen3-4B-Base上平均准确率提升+4.1分，Qwen3-14B-Base上提升+1.9分；在AIME24、AIME25和IMO-Bench上，pass@1提升+3.7分，pass@64提升+4.6分（Qwen3-4B-Base），表明在困难推理问题上具有更好的探索能力。
AI.conclusion: SCRL通过将硬问题分解为可验证的子问题，并采用子问题级归一化实现细粒度信用分配，有效解决了基于结果的RLVR在困难问题上正确 rollout稀缺和信用分配粗糙的问题。在7个数学推理基准上显著优于现有课程学习基线，证明了子问题课程能够将困难问题从梯度死区中解放出来，且原始问题越难，相对收益越大。

title: MOSS: Self-Evolution through Source-Level Rewriting in Autonomous Agent Systems
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Preprint. Code: https://github.com/dav-joy-thon/MOSS
summary: Autonomous agentic systems are largely static after deployment: they do not learn from user interactions, and recurring failures persist until the next human-driven update ships a fix. Self-evolving agents have emerged in response, but all confine evolution to text-mutable artifacts -- skill files, prompt configurations, memory schemas, workflow graphs -- and leave the agent harness untouched. Since routing, hook ordering, state invariants, and dispatch live in code rather than in any text artifact, an entire class of structural failure is physically unreachable from the text layer. We argue that source-level adaptation is a fundamentally more general medium: it is Turing-complete, a strict superset of every text-mutable scope, takes effect deterministically rather than through base-model compliance, and does not erode under long-context drift. We present MOSS, a system that performs self-rewriting at the source level on production agentic substrates. Each evolution is anchored to an automatically curated batch of production-failure evidence and proceeds through a deterministic multi-stage pipeline; code modification is delegated to a pluggable external coding-agent CLI while MOSS retains stage ordering and verdicts. Candidates are verified by replaying the batch against the candidate image in ephemeral trial workers, then promoted via user-consent-gated, in-place container swap with health-probe-gated rollback. On OpenClaw, MOSS lifts a four-task mean grader score from 0.25 to 0.61 in a single cycle without human intervention.

AI.tldr: MOSS是一个源代码级自进化系统，能够在生产智能体基板上自主重写代码实现持续改进，相比仅修改文本配置的方式具有图灵完备性覆盖、更强确定性和抗长上下文漂移能力，在OpenClaw基准上实现单周期显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前自主智能体系统在部署后完全静态，无法从用户交互中学习改进；现有自进化方案仅局限于文本层（技能文件、提示配置、记忆模式、工作流图），而路由逻辑、钩子排序、状态不变量和调度等核心机制存在于代码层，导致这类结构性故障无法被文本层触及和修复。
AI.method: 采用确定性多阶段流水线架构：1) 自动收集生产故障证据作为进化锚点；2) 通过可插拔的外部编码智能体CLI执行代码修改，MOSS仅保留阶段编排和判决权；3) 在临时试运行工作节点中重放故障批次验证候选代码；4) 通过用户授权的容器原地替换进行部署，并配备健康探针触发的回滚机制。
AI.result: 在OpenClaw基准的四任务测试中，MOSS在无需人工干预的单次迭代中将平均评分从0.25提升至0.61。
AI.conclusion: MOSS实现了生产级智能体在源代码级别的自主进化，在OpenClaw基准上实现了单周期分数从0.25到0.61的显著提升，证明了源码级适配相比文本可编辑方案具有更强的泛化能力和稳定性。

title: Can Breath Biomarkers Causally Influence Blood Glucose? Investigating VOC-Mediated Modulation in Diabetes
summary: Diabetes is a global health burden, and early detection is critical for timely intervention. This study explores a non-invasive, data-driven framework to identify individuals at risk of diabetes using Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) and lifestyle variables. We use causal inference techniques to estimate the impact of VOCs such as acetone, isopropanol, isoprene, and ethanol on blood glucose levels. Additionally, we designed a classifier to distinguish diabetics from non-diabetics using non-invasive markers. We created a risk-based ranking system for individuals in the "gray zone," and identified natural clusters in the population using Gaussian Mixture Model. Our results suggest that specific VOCs exhibit a strong causal influence on glucose levels and that machine learning models can reliably classify and stratify individuals at high risk. This integrated causal-explainable analysis can support the development of tool for non-invasive early screening of diabetes.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）和生活方式变量的非侵入性糖尿病风险筛查框架，通过因果推断评估VOCs对血糖的影响，结合可解释机器学习模型进行糖尿病分类和风险分层，为无创早期筛查工具的开发提供了新的思路。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病已成为全球性健康负担，早期检测对于及时干预至关重要。然而传统检测方法多为侵入性，因此需要探索非侵入性、数据驱动的糖尿病风险识别方法。
AI.method: 研究采用因果推断技术评估VOCs（如丙酮、异丙醇、异戊二烯和乙醇）对血糖水平的影响，并设计分类器区分糖尿病患者与非糖尿病患者；同时使用高斯混合模型（GMM）识别人群自然聚类，并针对"灰色地带"个体建立风险排序系统。
AI.result: 研究结果表明特定VOCs对血糖水平具有强因果影响力，机器学习模型能够可靠地分类和分层高风险个体。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功构建了一个整合因果推理与可解释机器学习的糖尿病无创早期筛查框架，证明了特定挥发性有机化合物（如丙酮、异丙醇、异戊二烯和乙醇）对血糖水平具有显著因果影响，且机器学习模型能够可靠地区分糖尿病患者与健康人群。该框架可为糖尿病无创早筛工具的开发提供理论支撑。

title: Aerodynamic force reconstruction using physics-informed Gaussian processes
summary: Accurate modeling of aerodynamic loads is essential for understanding and predicting the responses of complex structural systems. However, these models often rely on simplifications of the true physical forces, introducing assumptions that can limit their accuracy. Validating such models becomes particularly challenging in the presence of noisy or incomplete data. To address this, we introduce a probabilistic physics-informed machine learning approach designed to reconstruct the underlying aerodynamic loads from noisy measurements of structural dynamic responses. The model avoids overfitting, eliminates the need for regularization schemes, and allows for the use of heterogeneous and multi-fidelity data during the training process. The efficacy of the approach is demonstrated through the reconstruction of aerodynamic loads on the Great Belt East Bridge, simulated under a linear unsteady assumption. Results show a strong agreement between true and predicted loads, particularly related to root mean squared errors, magnitude, phase angle and peak values of the signals. The method for load reconstructing holds broad applicability, such as modeling validation, future load estimation, and structural damage prognosis.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a probabilistic physics-informed machine learning method to reconstruct aerodynamic loads from noisy structural response data, demonstrating effectiveness on the Great Belt East Bridge with strong performance across multiple validation metrics.
AI.motivation: Accurate aerodynamic load modeling is essential for complex structural systems, but existing models rely on simplifications that introduce assumptions limiting accuracy. Validation is challenging due to noisy or incomplete data, necessitating a data-driven reconstruction approach that respects underlying physics.
AI.method: Probabilistic physics-informed machine learning approach that integrates physical constraints with data-driven learning. The method handles heterogeneous and multi-fidelity data during training, avoids overfitting without requiring explicit regularization schemes, and reconstructs aerodynamic loads from noisy structural dynamic response measurements under linear unsteady aerodynamic assumptions.
AI.result: Strong agreement between reconstructed and true aerodynamic loads on the Great Belt East Bridge, validated through root mean squared errors, magnitude accuracy, phase angle correspondence, and peak value reproduction.
AI.conclusion: The proposed probabilistic physics-informed ML approach successfully reconstructs aerodynamic loads from noisy structural response measurements, achieving strong agreement with true loads across multiple metrics. This method provides a robust framework for bridge aerodynamics validation with applications extending to load estimation and structural prognosis.

title: Short-Term-to-Long-Term Memory Transfer for Knowledge Graphs under Partial Observability
summary: Reinforcement learning under partial observability requires deciding what information to retain, yet most memory-based approaches do not explicitly model short-term-to-long-term transfer of symbolic observations. We study this transfer process in a temporal knowledge-graph memory setting and cast it as a neuro-symbolic value-based decision problem: for each observed triple, the agent chooses whether to keep or drop it before long-term insertion. To handle variable-sized short-term buffers, we use a per-item Q-learning design with shared parameters and a practical temporal-difference update over matched items across consecutive steps. On the RoomKG benchmark at long-term memory capacity 128, learned transfer decisions outperform symbolic and neural baselines, including symbolic baselines with temporal annotations and history-based LSTM/Transformer baselines. Across transfer-policy ablations, a lightweight local short-term-only variant performs best, and step-level behavior shows that the policy keeps navigation- and query-relevant facts while discarding lower-value candidate facts, supporting explicit and interpretable memory decisions under memory constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号值决策方法，通过per-item Q-learning显式建模短期到长期记忆的符号三元组转移策略，在RoomKG基准上优于多种基线方法，并展示了可解释的决策行为。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测强化学习需要决定保留哪些信息，但现有记忆方法未能显式建模从短时记忆到长时记忆的符号观测转移过程。
AI.method: 采用per-item Q-learning设计，使用共享参数处理变长短期缓冲区，并通过匹配项目间的时序差分更新进行训练。
AI.result: 在RoomKG基准测试上，当长期记忆容量为128时，学习到的转移决策优于符号基线和神经基线方法（包括带有时序标注的符号基线及基于历史的LSTM/Transformer基线）。轻量级局部短期变体表现最佳，策略能够保留导航和查询相关事实而丢弃低价值候选事实。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了所提方法的有效性，且该策略可解释性强，能够区分高价值和低价值信息。

title: Algebraic Machine Learning for Small-to-Medium Datasets Is Competitive against Strong Standard Baselines
summary: Symbolic methods are generally not considered competitive with strong modern learners on realistic supervised tasks. We evaluate Algebraic Machine Learning (AML), a framework that learns through subdirect decomposition of algebraic structure rather than numerical optimization, against standard baselines on image and tabular classification across varying training-set sizes. We find that AML trained only on training data without using validation or cross-validation outperforms a family of cross-validated baseline methods including CNNs on small to medium image datasets (50--2000 training examples). On tabular datasets in the same size range, XGBoost is overall the best performing method, but AML is nonetheless comparable to methods incorporating task-specific biases such as LightGBM and random forests. AML achieves this competitive performance across two very different types of datasets using a generic algebraic inductive bias, rather than the modality-specific biases built into standard baselines like CNNs for images or XGBoost for tabular data, and requires no cross validation because it has no task-dependent hyperparameters to tune.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明基于代数结构子直接分解的AML框架，在小规模数据集上仅用训练数据即可达到与先进深度学习方法和梯度提升树相当的分类性能，且因其无任务相关超参数而无需交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 符号方法通常被认为无法与强大的现代学习器在真实监督任务上竞争。作者旨在评估AML在真实任务上的表现。
AI.method: 该方法使用代数机器学习（AML）框架，通过子直接分解（subdirect decomposition）代数结构进行学习，而非数值优化。将AML与标准基线方法（CNN、XGBoost、LightGBM、随机森林等）在图像和表格分类任务上进行对比评估，训练集规模范围为50至2000个样本。
AI.result: 在小规模至中等规模的图像数据集上，AML仅使用训练数据（无需验证或交叉验证）即优于包括CNN在内的一系列使用交叉验证的基线方法；在同等规模范围的表格数据集上，虽然XGBoost整体表现最佳，但AML与融入任务特定归纳偏置的方法（如LightGBM、随机森林）性能相当。
AI.conclusion: AML通过通用的代数归纳偏置而非特定模态的归纳偏置，在小规模数据集上实现与其他方法相当的竞争力，且由于没有任务相关的超参数需要调整，因此无需交叉验证即可训练。

title: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a promising paradigm for scaling reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the sparsity of binary verifier rewards often leads to low efficiency and optimization instability. To stabilize training, existing methods typically impose token-level constraints relative to a reference policy. We identify that such constraints penalize deviations indiscriminately; this can flip verifier-determined direction when the policy attempts to outperform the reference, thereby suppressing gains. To resolve this, we propose One-Way Policy Optimization (OWPO), a method based on the principle of decoupling optimization direction from update magnitude. In OWPO, the verifier dictates the update direction, while the reference policy serves only to adjust the magnitude. Specifically, OWPO applies asymmetric reweighting: it performs Accelerated Alignment for inferior deviations (where the policy lags behind the reference) and Gain Locking for superior deviations (where the policy surpasses the reference). Furthermore, by incorporating iterative reference updates, OWPO creates a ``Ratchet Effect'' that continuously consolidates gains. Experimental results demonstrate that OWPO outperforms strong baselines, including DAPO, OPD, and MOPD, breaking the bottleneck of fixed priors to enable continuous self-evolution without reliance on external reference models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OWPO方法，通过将优化方向与更新幅度解耦来解决强化学习中的稀疏奖励问题。验证器决定更新方向，参考策略仅调整幅度，采用非对称重加权（加速对齐+增益锁定）并通过迭代参考更新形成"棘轮效应"，实现无需外部参考模型的持续自我进化。
AI.motivation: The sparsity of binary verifier rewards in RLVR leads to low efficiency and optimization instability. Existing token-level constraint methods penalize deviations indiscriminately, which can flip the verifier-determined direction when the policy tries to outperform the reference, thereby suppressing potential gains.
AI.method: One-Way Policy Optimization (OWPO) decouples optimization direction from update magnitude, where the verifier dictates the update direction and the reference policy only adjusts magnitude. It applies asymmetric reweighting: Accelerated Alignment for inferior deviations (when policy lags) and Gain Locking for superior deviations (when policy surpasses). Iterative reference updates create a "Ratchet Effect" to continuously consolidate gains.
AI.result: OWPO outperforms strong baselines including DAPO, OPD, and MOPP, breaking the bottleneck of fixed priors.
AI.conclusion: OWPO enables continuous self-evolution of LLMs without reliance on external reference models by breaking the bottleneck of fixed priors, demonstrating superior performance over strong baselines.

title: Maestro: Reinforcement Learning to Orchestrate Hierarchical Model-Skill Ensembles
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and modular skills has endowed autonomous agents with increasingly powerful capabilities. Existing frameworks typically rely on monolithic LLMs and fixed logic to interface with these skills. This gives rise to a critical bottleneck: different LLMs offer distinct advantages across diverse domains, yet current frameworks fail to exploit the complementary strengths of models and skills, thereby limiting their performance on downstream tasks. In this paper, we present Maestro (Multimodal Agent for Expert-Skill Targeted Reinforced Orchestration), a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-driven orchestration framework that reframes heterogeneous multimodal tasks as a sequential decision-making process over a hierarchical model-skill registry. Rather than consolidating all knowledge into a single model, Maestro trains a lightweight policy to dynamically compose ensembles of frozen expert models and a two-tier skill library, deciding at each step whether to invoke an external expert, which model-skill pair to select, and when to terminate. The policy is optimized via outcome-based RL, requiring no step-level supervision. We evaluate Maestro across ten representative multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, chart understanding, high-resolution perception, and domain-specific analysis. With only a 4B orchestrator, Maestro achieves an average accuracy of 70.1%, surpassing both GPT-5 (69.3%) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (68.7%). Crucially, the learned coordination policy generalizes to unseen models and skills without retraining: augmenting the registry with out-of-domain experts yields a 59.5% average on four challenging benchmarks, outperforming all closed-source baselines. Maestro further maintains high computational efficiency with low latency. The source code is available at https://github.com/jinyangwu/Maestro.

AI.tldr: Maestro是一个RL驱动的多模态Agent编排框架，通过轻量级策略动态组合冻结的专家模型和两层技能库，在10个代表性多模态基准上以4B编排器超越GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro，且策略可泛化至未见过的模型和技能。
AI.motivation: 当前框架依赖单体LLM和固定逻辑，面临关键瓶颈：不同LLM在不同领域各有优势，但现有框架无法利用模型与技能的互补优势，限制了下游任务性能。
AI.method: Maestro将异构多模态任务重新框架化为分层模型-技能注册表上的序列决策过程。通过结果导向的强化学习（outcome-based RL）优化轻量级策略，无需步骤级监督。策略在每步决策：是否调用外部专家、选择哪个模型-技能对、何时终止。
AI.result: 仅用4B编排器即达到70.1%平均准确率，超越GPT-5（69.3%）和Gemini-2.5-Pro（68.7%）。增强注册表后，四个挑战性基准测试平均59.5%，优于所有闭源基线。具备低延迟高效率。
AI.conclusion: Maestro通过轻量级策略（4B参数）实现动态模型-技能组合，策略可泛化至未见过的模型和技能，无需重训练，同时保持高计算效率。这项工作证明了模块化协调学习的可行性和优越性，为构建更强大、更灵活的多模态自主Agent提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Euclidean Proximity: Repairing Latent World Models with Horizon-Matched Trajectory Reachability Metrics
summary: Latent world models can contain the state needed for control, yet their terminal-cost interface can expose the planner to the wrong decision-relevant information. In common latent MPC, candidate sequences are ranked by Euclidean distance between predicted terminal and goal latent states; this assumes that raw latent distance weights reachability-relevant variables correctly. We propose trajectory reachability metrics (TRM), a post-hoc terminal-ranking method for fixed latent world models. TRM trains a small pairwise head from logged trajectory structure and uses it as a replacement or hybrid cost; the encoder, dynamics, sampler, optimizer, and evaluation manifests remain fixed. The key design choice is horizon-aware supervision: the metric is trained on broad, balanced temporal separations to match the long-horizon terminal candidate ranking problem. On a hard TwoRoom benchmark, raw latent planning with LeWorldModel (LeWM) reaches 7.0% success, while full-horizon TRM reaches 97.0%; shuffled temporal-label controls stay at 0.0%. The same recipe improves a PLDM baseline from 32.7% to 84.0% across three seeds, and a short-horizon TRM variant reaches only 35.0% with the 100,000 pair budget. In TwoRoom, we provide mechanistic evidence for why TRM works: XY position is linearly decodable (R^2=0.998), yet raw latent MSE misranks candidates; the XY-probe rowspace accounts for less than 1% of terminal-goal latent MSE but carries most candidate-quality signal; and SCSA audits show that TRM improves the ordering and selected endpoint seen by the planner. On PushT go50/go75, TRM-style task-state metrics improve SCSA ranking and selected final distance more cleanly than closed-loop success, motivating auxiliary hybrid costs in continuous manipulation. TRM is the planner-facing repair, and audits explain when terminal reachability metrics should replace or augment raw latent proximity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹可达性度量（TRM），一种针对固定潜在世界模型的后验终端排名方法。核心创新是在广泛平衡的时间分离上进行训练，以匹配长-horizon终端候选排名问题，从而解决原始潜在距离错误加权可达性相关变量的问题。实验表明该方法在TwoRoom上从7%提升至97%，PLDM从32.7%提升至84%，且机制分析揭示XY位置虽然只占MSE的1%却携带大部分候选质量信号。
AI.motivation: Raw latent Euclidean distance between predicted terminal and goal states incorrectly weights reachability-relevant variables, leading to poor planner decisions. Existing latent MPC assumes raw latent distance correctly captures reachability, which fails on complex state spaces where decision-relevant information is misaligned with proximity metrics.
AI.method: TRM trains a small pairwise ranking head from logged trajectory structure using horizon-aware supervision with broad, balanced temporal separations; the encoder, dynamics model, sampler, optimizer, and evaluation manifests remain fixed. This post-hoc approach replaces or hybridizes Euclidean terminal-goal distance in latent MPC without retraining the world model.
AI.result: On TwoRoom: LeWM raw planning achieves 7.0% success vs. TRM's 97.0%; shuffled temporal labels yield 0.0%. PLDM improves from 32.7% to 84.0% across three seeds. Short-horizon TRM variant reaches only 35.0% with 100,000 pairs. On PushT: TRM-style metrics improve SCSA ranking and selected final distance more cleanly than closed-loop success. Mechanistic analysis shows XY position is linearly decodable (R²=0.998), raw latent MSE misranks candidates, yet XY-probe accounts for less than 1% of terminal-goal latent MSE but carries most candidate-quality signal.
AI.conclusion: TRM is the planner-facing repair for terminal-cost misalignment; it should replace or augment raw latent proximity when the planner needs reachability-relevant ordering. The method generalizes across planners (LeWM, PLDM) and domains (TwoRoom, PushT), with mechanistic audits explaining when TRM succeeds.

title: Survive or Collapse: The Asymmetric Roles of Data Gating and Reward Grounding in Self-Play RL
summary: Self-play reinforcement learning trains language models on their own generated tasks, co-evolving a proposer and solver without human labels. Recent systems report strong reasoning gains, but collapse and instability are widely observed and poorly understood. The dominant response treats this as a reward-design problem. We argue instead that self-play stability is governed by two distinct levers: a data-level gate that decides which proposer-generated tasks enter the training pool, and the reward signal that updates the policy on tasks already admitted. Through controlled experiments on a Python output-prediction task and a deterministic-DSL twin task that strips pretraining priors, output ambiguity, and executor noise, we find the two levers are asymmetric. A strict gate is sufficient for stability under every reward variant we test, including a self-consistency reward with no access to ground truth; while no reward variant is sufficient once the gate is removed. This asymmetry exposes a counter-intuitive coupling we call the Grounded Proposer Paradox: a proposer with ground-truth access accelerates collapse faster than an ungrounded one when paired with a self-consistency solver, by concentrating training on clean tasks that form the fastest path to a spurious self-consistent attractor. Replacing the binary gate with a continuous strictness parameter $\varepsilon$ further reveals a two-stage phase transition: training-side metrics decouple at low $\varepsilon$, while validation accuracy holds until $\varepsilon$ is much higher. Data-level gating, not reward calibration, is the binding constraint on self-play stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对照实验揭示自博弈 RL 稳定性的关键约束在于数据级门控机制而非奖励设计。有 ground-truth 的提议者反而加速训练崩溃，原因是其集中于"干净"任务而快速收敛到虚假自洽吸引子。
AI.motivation: 自博弈强化学习虽能提升语言模型推理能力，但普遍存在崩溃和不稳定问题。现有研究主要将其视为奖励设计问题，缺乏对稳定性机理的系统理解。
AI.method: 在 Python 输出预测任务和确定性 DSL 任务上进行对照实验（后者消除了预训练先验、输出歧义和执行器噪声），系统测试门控严格性与奖励变体（包含无 ground-truth 的自洽奖励）的组合效果。
AI.result: （1）严格门控在所有奖励变体下均能维持稳定性；（2）移除门控后任何奖励变体都无法保证稳定；（3）有 ground-truth 的提议者与自洽求解器配对时崩溃更快——形成"Grounded Proposer Paradox"悖论。
AI.conclusion: 数据级门控是自博弈稳定性的决定性约束因素，而非奖励校准。提出" grounded proposer paradox"现象：有 ground-truth 的提议者反而加速崩溃。引入连续门控参数ε揭示两阶段相变：低ε时训练指标先解耦，高ε时验证准确率才下降。

title: Boundary-targeted Membership Inference Attacks on Safety Classifiers
summary: Safety classifiers are essential safeguards within generative AI systems, filtering harmful content or identifying at-risk users when interacting with large language models. Despite their necessity, these models are trained on sensitive datasets including discussions of self-harm and mental health, raising important, yet poorly understood, privacy concerns. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) allow adversaries to infer membership of examples used to train models. In this work, we hypothesize that identifying the examples on which the classifier is least confident are informative for an adversary to infer membership. This reflects a localized failure of generalization, where the model relies on memorization to resolve ambiguity in the training set. To investigate this, we introduce a new boundary-targeted selection strategy that identifies low confidence examples that amplify the signal of an examples membership within a training set. Our experimental results show that an adversary can recover 19\% of the conversations a safety classifier flagged as indicating user distress, at a 5\% false-positive rate, on a classifier fine-tuned for detecting a user who may require emotional support. This is $3.5$ times more than attacking using state-of-the-art MIA methods alone. Finally, we characterize the boundary laying examples and show that content-based filtering is ineffective for protection, and existing noise strategies can effectively mitigate susceptibility of these examples.

AI.tldr: 针对安全分类器的隐私攻击：攻击者利用模型对训练集中模糊样本的记忆化倾向，通过识别低置信度边界样本，可在5%假阳性率下恢复19%敏感对话（心理支持相关），较SOTA方法提升3.5倍。内容过滤无法防御，但添加噪声可缓解。
AI.motivation: 安全分类器虽必要，但其训练数据包含敏感内容（自残、心理健康讨论），存在严重隐私隐患。现有成员推断攻击（MIA）对此场景效果有限。
AI.method: 提出边界目标选择策略（boundary-targeted selection），识别低置信度样本以放大成员推断信号；利用模型在训练集歧义情况下依赖记忆化的特性进行攻击。
AI.result: 攻击者可在5%假阳性率下恢复19%被标记为用户 distress 的对话，较现有最优MIA方法提升3.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过边界样本过滤和添加噪声可有效防御此类攻击；内容过滤无效；揭示了安全分类器中依赖记忆化导致的隐私泄露风险。

title: IKNO: Infinite-order Kernel Neural Operators
summary: Neural operators have achieved significant success in modern scientific computing due to their flexibility and strong generalization capabilities. Existing models, however, primarily rely on first-order kernel integral approximations, which severely limit their expressivity. To address this, we propose the Infinite-order Kernel Neural Operator (IKNO), which constructs neural operators via infinite-order kernel integrals and admits an elegant closed-form finite approximation. We develop two complementary infinite-order neural operator constructions: IKNO-Vanilla, which applies the full-kernel resolvent on the product grid via Kronecker eigendecomposition, and IKNO-TP, an alternative tensor-product operator that composes per-axis resolvents. Furthermore, we develop fast computation schemes for both variants of IKNO, which achieve outstanding global information aggregation while maintaining high computational efficiency. Empirically, we evaluate our IKNO on both time-dependent and time-independent benchmarks with arbitrary input shapes, including large-scale industrial datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the IKNO method consistently achieves the SOTA accuracy with significant improvements on nearly all benchmark datasets while maintaining scalability to very large point clouds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无限阶核神经算子（IKNO），通过无限阶核积分构建神经算子并推导封闭形式的有限近似。设计了两种实现变体（IKNO-Vanilla和IKNO-TP）及快速计算方案，在多个时间依赖/独立基准测试中取得最先进精度，同时保持大规模点云处理的scalability。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子模型主要依赖一阶核积分近似，这严重限制了模型的表达能力，因此需要引入无限阶核积分来增强神经算子的表达能力。
AI.method: 提出两种互补的无限阶神经算子构建方式：1) IKNO-Vanilla，通过Kronecker特征分解在乘积网格上应用完整核预解式；2) IKNO-TP，通过组合每轴预解式构建替代的张量积算子。同时为两个变体开发了快速计算方案，实现高效的全局信息聚合。
AI.result: IKNO在多种基准数据集上持续达到最先进精度，在几乎所有基准数据集上都有显著提升，同时保持对大规模点云的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: IKNO通过引入无限阶核积分，显著提升了神经算子的表达能力，在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进（SOTA）的精度，同时保持了良好的可扩展性和计算效率，为科学计算中的深度学习方法提供了新的理论基础和工程方案。

title: RefusalBench: Why Refusal Rate Misranks Frontier LLMs on Biological Research Prompts
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables (10 in main text, 2 in supplementary). Code and data: https://github.com/AppliedScientific/refusalbench
summary: Frontier large language models are increasingly deployed as orchestration backbones for biological research workflows, yet no shared evidence base exists for comparing their refusal behaviour on legitimate research prompts. RefusalBench, introduced here, is a matched-triple benchmark of 141 prompts in 47 bundles that holds task framing constant while varying only biological risk tier (benign, borderline, dual-use), enabling tier-conditioned comparisons robust to subdomain confounding. A 15-prompt should-refuse positive-control module establishes per-model calibration floors; three models fail to refuse even these prompts. Across 19 frontier models in the May 2026 snapshot, strict refusal rates span 0.1% to 94.6% on identical prompts. Jurisdiction does not predict refusal in this snapshot (Mann-Whitney U, p = 0.393; EU n = 1, US bimodal); provider identity does, with Anthropic's API stack predicting refusal at OR = 21.03 (95% CI: 14.58-30.34 prompt-clustered; 5.70-77.55 under model-clustered GEE). This effect is best read as access-path-level rather than model-weight-level: 99.8% of Anthropic's strict refusals carry the same safety_policy adjudicated reason code, consistent with a small set of canonical refusal templates rather than case-by-case model reasoning. Strict refusal rate misranks safety calibration: Grok 4.20 achieves the highest tier discrimination (Youden's J = 0.787) while ranking only seventh by overall refusal rate, and Claude Opus 4.7's J dropped 65% from prior versions with no improvement in dual-use detection. Nine of 18 frontier models exhibit a hedge-but-help partial-compliance pattern at dual-use tier that binary refusal metrics cannot detect.

AI.tldr: RefusalBench benchmarks LLMs on 141 biological research prompts across 3 risk tiers, revealing that strict refusal rates (0.1%-94.6%) misrank actual safety calibration, Anthropic's refusals stem from access-path-level policies rather than model reasoning, and binary metrics fail to detect partial-compliance patterns.
AI.motivation: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used as orchestration backbones for biological research workflows, yet no shared evidence base exists for comparing their refusal behavior on legitimate research prompts.
AI.method: RefusalBench: matched-triple benchmark of 141 prompts in 47 bundles varying biological risk tier (benign/borderline/dual-use) with a 15-prompt should-refuse positive-control module. Statistical tests include Mann-Whitney U and model-clustered GEE.
AI.result: Across 19 frontier models, strict refusal rates span 0.1% to 94.6%. Jurisdiction does not predict refusal (p=0.393), but provider identity does—Anthropic's API stack predicts refusal at OR=21.03. Grok 4.20 achieves highest tier discrimination (J=0.787) while ranking seventh by overall refusal rate. Claude Opus 4.7 showed 65% J-score drop from prior versions with no improvement in dual-use detection. Nine of 18 models exhibit hedge-but-help partial-compliance at dual-use tier.
AI.conclusion: Anthropic's refusal behavior is access-path-level rather than model-weight-level, with most refusals using canonical templates. Strict refusal rate misranks safety calibration, and binary metrics fail to detect hedge-but-help patterns in 9/18 models.

title: From Sequential Nodes to GPU Batches: Parallel Branch and Bound for Optimal $k$-Sparse GLMs
summary: GPUs have significantly accelerated first-order methods for large-scale optimization, especially in continuous optimization. However, this success has not transferred cleanly to problems with discrete variables, combinatorial structure, and nonlinear objectives, such as certifying optimal solutions for cardinality-constrained generalized linear models. Major challenges include the sequential processing of heterogeneous nodes in branch and bound (BnB) and frequent data movement between the CPU and GPU. We propose a simple, generic, and modular CPU--GPU framework that processes multiple BnB nodes in batches on GPUs. The framework is built around a small set of GPU-efficient routines and uses padding together with lightweight custom kernels to handle irregular node data structures. Experiments show one to two orders of magnitude speedups and zero optimality gap on challenging instances. The framework can also be extended to collect the entire Rashomon set, enabling downstream statistical analysis such as variable-importance analysis and model selection under secondary user-specific measures (e.g., AUC in classification).

AI.tldr: 本文提出模块化CPU-GPU框架，通过批量处理和轻量级内核加速分支定界算法，解决了离散组合优化中GPU并行化的难题，并在基追踪模型上实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: GPU在一阶优化方法上表现优异，但未能成功应用于离散变量、组合结构和非线性目标的优化问题（如基追踪模型的最优性证明），主要挑战来自BnB中异构节点的顺序处理和CPU-GPU间频繁数据移动。
AI.method: 提出简单、通用的模块化CPU-GPU框架，在GPU上批量处理多个BnB节点；使用填充和轻量级自定义内核处理不规则节点数据结构。
AI.result: 实验获得一到两个数量级的加速，且在挑战性实例上达到零最优性间隙。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可扩展以收集完整Rashomon集，支持变量重要性分析和模型选择等下游统计分析。

title: Structured-Sparse Attention for Entity Tracking with Subquadratic Sequence Complexity
summary: Entity tracking requires maintaining and updating latent states for entities and attributes over long sequences. Recent task-specific attention operators can compress deep Transformer stacks into a few layers by performing multi-hop state propagation within a single layer, but their dense evaluation remains expensive. We show that in this setting, learned attention is strongly structured: most mass concentrates in local block-diagonal neighborhoods with a light cross-block residue. Exploiting this, we derive a blockwise evaluation of a resolvent-style operator that keeps within-block interactions exact and routes cross-block interactions through a reduced system. The resulting evaluation is subquadratic in sequence length $O(n^{4/3}d)$ (and $O(n^{7/3})$ when $d\approx n$). On controlled tracking benchmarks, our method matches the dense operator's accuracy while reducing wall-clock time by $12-29\%$ under a standardized measurement protocol, and is up to $2.4 \times$ faster than a compact dense Transformer at comparable exact-match accuracy. We further provide ablations over block size and model capacity, and identify a limitation: performance collapses when the number of simultaneously evolving properties exceeds the number of attention heads.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对实体追踪任务中Transformer注意力计算成本过高的问题，通过发现和学习到的注意力权重结构化稀疏性（局部块对角+跨块残差），提出一种亚二次复杂度的块状求解器评估方法，将复杂度从O(n²d)降至O(n^{4/3}d)，在保持精度的同时实现显著加速（12-29%，最高2.4倍）。
AI.motivation: 实体追踪任务需在长序列中维护和更新潜在状态。现有将深层Transformer压缩为少量层的方法（如多跳状态传播）虽有效，但仍存在密集评估计算成本过高的问题。
AI.method: 利用注意力权重的结构化稀疏性（局部块对角邻域+少量跨块残差），推导块状求解器（resolvent）风格算子的评估方法。块内交互精确计算，跨块交互通过精简系统路由。数学复杂度从标准注意力的 O(n²d) 降至 O(n^{4/3}d)，当 d≈n 时降至 O(n^{7/3})。
AI.result: 实验采用标准化测量协议，结果显示：1）匹配密集算子精度，同时减少12-29%的wall-clock时间；2）比紧凑密集Transformer快最多2.4倍（精确匹配精度可比时）；3）消融实验验证了块大小和模型容量的影响。
AI.conclusion:
该方法在保持精度的前提下实现了显著的速度提升（12-29%，最高2.4倍），并通过消融实验验证了块大小和模型容量对性能的影响。局限性在于当同时演化的属性数量超过注意力头数量时，性能会急剧下降。

原文摘要：实体追踪需要在长序列中维护和更新实体及属性的潜在状态。最近的特定任务注意力算子可通过单层内的多跳状态传播将深层Transformer堆栈压缩为少数层，但其密集评估仍然计算成本高昂。研究表明，在该设置下，学习到的注意力具有强结构化特性：大部分注意力质量集中在局部块对角邻域中，仅有少量跨块残差。基于此，研究者推导出一种块状求解器风格算子的评估方法，在块内保持精确交互，同时将跨块交互路由到精简系统中。结果显示该评估方法在序列长度上达到亚二次复杂度 O(n^{4/3}d)（当 d≈n 时为 O(n^{7/3})）。在受控追踪基准测试中，该方法在标准化测量协议下将wall-clock时间减少12-29%，同时匹配密集算子的精度；在可比精确匹配精度下比紧凑密集Transformer快达2.4倍。研究进一步对块大小和模型容量进行了消融实验，并识别出一个局限性：当同时演化的属性数量超过注意力头数量时，性能会崩溃。

title: Bandit Convex Optimization with Gradient Prediction Adaptivity
summary: Bandit convex optimization (BCO) is a fundamental online learning framework with partial feedback, where the learner observes only the loss incurred at the chosen decision point in each round. In this work, we investigate whether optimistic gradient predictions can improve worst-case regret guarantees in a prediction-adaptive manner. Specifically, given gradient predictions $m_t$, we seek regret bounds that scale with the cumulative prediction error $S_T=\sum_{t=1}^T \|\nabla f_t(x_t)-m_t\|^2.$ We first establish a negative result: under the single-point feedback protocol, an unavoidable $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ regret lower bound persists even when $S_T=o(T)$, showing that the variance of gradient estimation fundamentally obscures the benefit of accurate predictions. To overcome this barrier, we propose \emph{Two-Point Variance-Reduced Optimistic Gradient Descent} (TP-VR-OPT) for the two-point feedback setting. The key idea is a novel variance-reduced gradient estimator whose variance scales with the prediction error rather than the gradient norm. This yields a regret bound of $O\big(\sqrt{d\,\mathbb{E}[S_T]}\big),$ where $d$ is the decision dimension.
