Complementing this result, we establish an information-theoretic lower bound that scales as $Ω(\sqrt{\mathbb{E}[S_T]})$, providing a fundamental characterization of the best achievable prediction-adaptive regret and showing that TP-VR-OPT is optimal up to a factor of $\sqrt d$. We further develop adaptive variants that eliminate the need for prior knowledge of $\mathbb{E}[S_T]$ or the horizon $T$, and extend our framework to non-stationary environments, establishing dynamic regret guarantees that adapt simultaneously to the cumulative prediction error and the comparator path length.

AI.tldr: This work addresses prediction-adaptive regret in bandit convex optimization. It proves that single-point feedback cannot benefit from accurate predictions due to fundamental variance barriers, but proposes TP-VR-OPT in two-point settings achieving order-optimal √(E[S_T]) regret up to √d factor.
AI.motivation: Investigate whether optimistic gradient predictions can improve worst-case regret in bandit convex optimization in a prediction-adaptive manner (scaling with cumulative prediction error S_T).
AI.method: Two-Point Variance-Reduced Optimistic Gradient Descent (TP-VR-OPT) - novel variance-reduced gradient estimator whose variance scales with prediction error rather than gradient norm, overcoming single-point feedback barriers.
AI.result: Single-point feedback: unavoidable Ω(√T) lower bound persists despite S_T = o(T). Two-point feedback: O(√(d·E[S_T])) regret bound with matching information-theoretic lower bound Ω(√(E[S_T])).
AI.conclusion: TP-VR-OPT achieves O(√(d·E[S_T])) regret, proven optimal up to √d factor. Adaptive variants eliminate need for prior knowledge. Framework extends to non-stationary environments with dynamic regret guarantees.

title: Reinforced Graph of Thoughts: RL-Driven Adaptive Prompting for LLMs
summary: Graph of Thoughts (GoT), a generalized form of recent prompting paradigms for large language models (LLMs), has been shown to be useful for elaborate problem solving. By executing a graph of operations, thoughts of the LLM are structured as an arbitrary graph, forming the actual graph of thoughts. Originally, the graph of operations is defined manually, which requires in-depth knowledge about the solution of the problem to solve. Such a static graph of operations is rigid and therefore lacks adaptability. We propose Reinforced Graph of Thoughts (RGoT), an automated approach to the GoT prompting paradigm that leverages reinforcement learning (RL) to adaptively generate a graph of operations from a human-defined set. Results indicate that, under certain constraints, it is possible to construct graphs of operations adaptively to the task's complexity in an automated way.

AI.tldr: RGoT是一种改进的思维图提示方法，通过强化学习自动生成操作图，解决了传统GoT需要人工手动定义、缺乏适应性的问题。
AI.motivation: 原始GoT范式中的操作图需要人工手动定义，要求操作者深入了解问题解决方案，且静态定义缺乏灵活性和适应性。
AI.method: 利用强化学习(RL)技术，从人类定义的集合中自适应生成操作图，替代原有的静态人工定义方式。
AI.result: 实验表明，在一定约束条件下，可以根据任务复杂度以自动化方式自适应地构建操作图。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了在一定约束条件下，可以根据任务复杂度自动适应性地构建操作图，为GoT范式的自动化应用开辟了新途径。

title: A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models
comment: A detailed tutorial on Diffusion models and SDE
summary: This tutorial develops diffusion models from the viewpoint of differential equations. We begin with the conditional Gaussian forward process and show that this path admits both an ordinary differential equation (ODE) representation and a stochastic differential equation (SDE) representation. Averaging the conditional process over the data distribution then yields marginalized forward ODE and SDE formulations that transport the data distribution $p_0=p_{\mathrm{data}}$ to a Gaussian prior $p_1=\mathcal{N}(0,I)$. We next derive the corresponding reverse-time dynamics, namely the reverse SDE and the reverse probability-flow ODE, both of which are governed by the marginal score $\grad\log p_t(x)$. This leads to a training objective for score estimation and shows that the standard noise-prediction objective is equivalent to score matching up to an additive constant independent of the model parameters. We then discuss sampling methods for the learned reverse dynamics, including DPM-Solver, as well as guided sampling through classifier guidance and classifier-free guidance. Finally, we compare DDPM and DDIM with the reverse SDE/ODE framework and show that they share the same training objective, while DDPM sampling corresponds to discrete reverse-SDE sampling and DDIM sampling corresponds to reverse-ODE sampling.

AI.tldr: 本教程从微分方程角度统一了扩散模型理论，证明条件高斯前向过程可表示为ODE和SDE形式，通过反向时间动力学推导建立了score matching训练目标的合理性，并揭示DDPM/DDIM分别为反向SDE和反向ODE的离散采样实现，为理解和改进扩散模型提供了统一的数学框架。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型领域存在多种离散算法（DDPM、DDIM）和连续时间公式（SDE、ODE），但缺乏统一的形式化框架来理解它们之间的内在联系与等价性。
AI.method: 从条件高斯前向过程出发，推导其ODE和SDE表示；通过对数据分布平均化得到边际化前向方程；进一步推导反向时间动力学（反向SDE和概率流ODE），证明标准噪声预测目标等价于score matching（仅差一个与模型参数无关的常数）；讨论DPM-Solver、分类器引导和无分类器引导等采样方法。
AI.result: 建立了扩散模型的统一微分方程框架，证明了DDPM和DDIM与连续时间反向动力学的关系：两者训练目标一致，DDPM对应反向SDE的离散化，DDIM对应反向ODE的离散化。
AI.conclusion: DDPM和DDIM共享相同的训练目标，DDPM采样对应离散反向SDE采样，DDIM采样对应反向ODE采样，从而在统一框架下建立了传统离散方法与连续时间微分方程方法的等价性。

title: Two is better than one: A Collapse-free Multi-Reward RLIF Training Framework
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of LLMs, but often depends on external supervision from human annotations or gold-standard solutions. Reinforcement learning from internal feedback (RLIF) has recently emerged as a scalable unsupervised alternative, using signals extracted from the model itself. However, existing RLIF methods typically rely on a single internal reward, which can lead to reward hacking, entropy collapse, and degraded reasoning structure. We propose a multi-reward RLIF framework that decomposes the training signal into two complementary components: an answer-level reward based on cluster voting and a completion-level reward based on token-wise self-certainty. To combine these signals robustly, we apply GDPO-based normalization to reduce reward-scale imbalance. We further introduce KL-Cov regularization, which targets low-entropy token distributions responsible for disproportionate entropy reduction, preserving exploration and preventing late-stage collapse. Across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, our method improves stability and robustness over prior unsupervised RL approaches, while achieving performance close to supervised RLVR methods. These results show that complementary internal rewards, combined with targeted regularization, can support stable long-horizon reasoning without relying on external ground-truth supervision. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多奖励内部反馈强化学习框架，通过答案级聚类投票奖励和完成级自确定性奖励结合KL-Cov正则化，实现无需外部监督的稳定长时推理。
AI.motivation: 现有RLIF方法依赖单一内部奖励，存在reward hacking、entropy collapse和推理结构退化问题。
AI.method: 提出多奖励RLIF框架，将训练信号分解为答案级聚类投票奖励和完成级token自确定性奖励；采用GDPO归一化平衡奖励尺度；引入KL-Cov正则化针对低熵token分布以保留探索性并防止晚期崩溃。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，方法稳定性和鲁棒性优于先前无监督RL方法，性能接近有监督RLVR方法。
AI.conclusion: 互补的内部奖励结合针对性正则化可以支持稳定的长时推理，无需依赖外部ground-truth监督即可达到接近有监督RLVR的性能。

title: Can Transformers Learn to Verify During Backtracking Search?
summary: Backtracking search underlies classical constraint solvers, planners, and theorem provers. Recent transformer-based reasoning systems explore search trees over their own intermediate steps. A common training recipe fits an autoregressive next-token loss on offline solver traces. The model's input at each step is a cumulative trace of all prior decisions. The optimal continue-or-backtrack predictor depends only on the current search state, since two trajectories reaching the same state admit the same viable continuations. We show that decoder-only transformers trained on cumulative traces fail this requirement in two ways: the trace can scatter state features across many positions (scattered retrieval), and the predictor can condition on the trajectory rather than the state (history entanglement). We address scattered retrieval with localization, a trace-level fix that rewrites each decision block to expose state features locally. We address history entanglement with Selective State Attention (SSA), a fixed attention mask that enforces state-based decisions structurally without modifying training data, objective, or parameters. We focus on reactive verification, after propagation has exposed a contradiction. We test SSA on 3-SAT, graph coloring, Blocks World, and backtracking parsing. On same-state pairs that differ only in prior history, SSA emits identical decisions while a cumulative-trained causal baseline does not. Our contribution is a diagnostic of transformer behavior on serialized trajectory data, paired with a structural fix. Pretrained language models that search over their own reasoning steps may face the same failure. Our analysis opens up inference-time context clearing as a candidate way to apply the same isolation without retraining.

AI.tldr: The paper diagnoses two failure modes in decoder-only transformers trained on cumulative search traces (scattered retrieval and history entanglement), and proposes a structural fix called Selective State Attention (SSA) that enforces state-based decisions without retraining. Evaluated on 3-SAT, graph coloring, Blocks World, and backtracking parsing tasks.
AI.motivation: Decoder-only transformers trained on cumulative traces fail the requirement that optimal decisions depend only on the current search state, due to two problems: scattered retrieval (state features scattered across many positions) and history entanglement (conditioning on trajectory rather than state).
AI.method: Localization rewrites each decision block to expose state features locally, addressing scattered retrieval. Selective State Attention (SSA) uses a fixed attention mask to enforce state-based decisions structurally, addressing history entanglement.
AI.result: On same-state pairs differing only in prior history, SSA emits identical decisions while cumulative-trained causal baseline does not, successfully isolating state-dependent decisions.
AI.conclusion: SSA enforces structurally state-based decisions without modifying training data, objective, or parameters, and opens up inference-time context clearing as a candidate approach.

title: The Double Dilemma in Multi-Task Radiology Report Generation: A Gradient Dynamics Analysis and Solution
summary: While multi-task learning based automatic radiology report generation (RRG) is widely adopted to ensure clinical consistency, most focus on architectural designs yet remain limited to coarse linear scalarization strategies. These strategies cannot effectively balance the hard constraints of discriminative clinical supervision with the smoothness requirements of report generation. To address these problems, we analyze the failure mechanism of linear scalarization from the perspective of gradient dynamics, utilizing the stochastic differential equation (SDE) framework to characterize it as a "Double Dilemma" of drift term deviation and diffusion term decay. Based on this, we propose a backbone-agnostic optimizer named Conflict-Averse Magnitude-Enhanced Gradient Descent (CAME-Grad). Through conflict-averse direction rectification and magnitude-enhanced energy injection, the algorithm not only ensures geometric validity, but also avoids local optimal solutions. Then, the adaptive gradient fusion mechanism is used to establish a dynamic balance between the theoretical optimal direction and the task-specific inductive bias. Experiments show that as a universal plug-and-play optimizer, CAME-Grad brings substantial and consistent improvements across eight diverse RRG methods, elevating overall clinical efficacy performance by an average of 2.3\% on MIMIC-CXR and 1.9\% on IU X-Ray. Our code is available at https://github.com/vpsg-research/CAME-Grad.

AI.tldr: This paper analyzes the failure mechanism of linear scalarization in multi-task RRG using SDE framework, identifying it as a "Double Dilemma" of drift term deviation and diffusion term decay. To address this, they propose CAME-Grad optimizer with conflict-averse direction rectification and magnitude-enhanced energy injection, achieving ~2% improvement across multiple RRG methods.
AI.motivation: Existing multi-task learning RRG methods rely on coarse linear scalarization strategies that fail to balance hard constraints of discriminative clinical supervision with smoothness requirements of report generation.
AI.method: The paper proposes Conflict-Averse Magnitude-Enhanced Gradient Descent (CAME-Grad), a backbone-agnostic optimizer that addresses the "Double Dilemma" through: (1) conflict-averse direction rectification and magnitude-enhanced energy injection for geometric validity and avoiding local optima, (2) adaptive gradient fusion mechanism to establish dynamic balance between theoretical optimal direction and task-specific inductive bias.
AI.result: Experiments demonstrate that CAME-Grad achieves substantial and consistent improvements across eight diverse RRG methods, with average clinical efficacy gains of 2.3% on MIMIC-CXR and 1.9% on IU X-Ray.
AI.conclusion: CAME-Grad serves as a universal plug-and-play optimizer that brings substantial and consistent improvements across diverse RRG methods, elevating overall clinical efficacy performance by 2.3% on MIMIC-CXR and 1.9% on IU X-Ray.

title: ARC-STAR: Auditable Post-Hoc Correction for PDE Foundation Models
summary: Partial differential equation (PDE) foundation models are pretrained networks that forecast how physical fields like velocity and pressure evolve from a single reusable solver. On unfamiliar flows their predictions drift step by step, errors concentrate in a few regions, yet retraining destabilizes the network and uniform post-hoc correction overlooks this spatial concentration. To address this, we propose a frozen-solver post-hoc correction framework, Adaptive Risk-Calibrated Spatial Triage for Auditable Refinement (ARC-STAR). ARC-STAR organizes correction into three stages: a global corrector removes broad solver bias, a blockwise local refiner cleans the post-global residual, and, at deployment, a label-free score routes refinement to high-risk blocks under a compute budget. The framework is designed to be (i) frozen-host, preserving the pretrained solver without fine-tuning; (ii) auditable, with global and local stages trained and evaluated separately for measurable contributions; and (iii) budget-aware, using a blockwise interface that either refines the full field or routes limited compute to high-risk regions. Across five flow benchmarks spanning ten regime cells, ARC-STAR is the only method that cuts velocity rollout error by at least 36x over raw Poseidon on every cell. The global stage reduces raw host error by 91-99%, and the local stage further reduces the remaining post-global residual by up to 94.4%. Our code implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arc_star.

AI.tldr: ARC-STAR 是一个针对冻结 PDE 基础模型（Poseidon / DPOT-Ti）的部署时后置校正框架，把校正拆成可审计的三阶段：①全局校正器 G_φ（TFNO，6 层 Fourier、width 64、16 modes）以 5 步闭环自回归损失消除整体求解器偏差；②块级局部精修器 L_θ（ConvNeXt 风格，16×16 中心块、halo h=8、halo-read/center-write 契约）清理全局校正后的残差；③部署时用无标签风险分数（速度创新 + 动能梯度，λ_KE=0.05）按 top-k 路由块到精修器，在给定计算预算下把算力投到高风险区域。同一套 L_θ 在 k=B（稠密）与 k<B（预算受限）下直接复用，无需重训。结果：在 5 个不可压 Navier–Stokes 家族、10 个 benchmark–regime cell 上，速度 10 步 rollout 误差相对原始 Poseidon 至少降低 36×（比值 0.0036–0.0274），全局阶段消除 91–99% 原始误差，局部阶段再消除 9.6–94.4% 的残余；单一无标签分数在所有 cell、所有预算下取得最低或近最低的路由前沿，并可迁移到结构不同的 DPOT-Ti 宿主。
AI.motivation: PDE 基础模型（Poseidon、DPOT、PROSE-FD、MPP 等）被当作冻结的通用求解器复用，当部署流动不同于预训练分布时，自回归 rollout 会把每步微小误差逐步放大；按新 regime 重训/微调代价高且不稳定，而"稠密均匀后处理"这一主流路线隐含假设"广域校正后残差在空间上均匀"，从而把算力平均分配到几乎无误差的区域。作者先做了一个关键的诊断实验：对冻结 Poseidon 在 10 个 benchmark–regime cell 上做广域残差校正后，把预测场切成 64 个 16×16 块并按误差占比排序，发现残差仍然显著空间集中（每 cell 平均 Gini 0.48，介于均匀零假设与稀疏激活之间；误差最高的 20% 块承担 38–64% 的剩余误差）。这种集中形态对应湍流中涡核与剪切层的已知结构，在结构迥异的 DPOT-Ti 骨干上同样出现，说明它是 host-无关的结构化机制而非统计噪声或预训练伪影。由此引出核心问题：在宿主网络固定的前提下，如何让一个训练好的校正层既可分解审计（分别测量"广域清理"与"局部清理"各贡献多少），又能在可调计算预算下部署而无需重训？
AI.method: 方法（Method）。ARC-STAR 包裹冻结宿主 H，构成三级流水线。Stage I 全局校正器：G_φ 输入 (x_t, x̂_{t+1}) 加两个正弦网格坐标（10 通道），1×1 提升到 d_v=64，6 层 Tucker 因子化 Fourier 卷积（m=16）配 1×1 逐点残差，GELU 激活，输出 2 通道速度残差并裁剪到 ±0.8293，仅写速度通道（通过投影 Π_uv）；训练时把 H 冻结并闭环反馈，用 5 步自回归速度 L2 损失优化，收敛后冻结 G_φ，使后续局部阶段看到的输入分布与部署一致。Stage II 局部精修器：ConvNeXt 风格（3×3 提升至 96 通道、6 个 7×7 depthwise + LayerNorm + 1×1 扩张/收缩块、3×3 输出头，约 0.48M 参数），输入为当前状态与全局后场拼接的 8×32×32 halo 窗口，中心裁剪后只写 16×16 中心块，残差乘外积 Hann 窗（边长 16）以抑制块边界不连续。训练分两步：Step 2a 在 post-global 场上做稠密 patch 预训练（可选按残差能量重加权 w_b，部署配置用均匀权重），Step 2b 在 k=B 的完整混合 rollout 中做 AR 微调（AR 深度课程 1→2→5 步，权重衰减 1e-4）。由于每次前向只看到一个 halo 窗口、不感知其他块状态，k=B 训练的模块可直接用于任意子集 S_t(k)，未选中块与 post-global 场逐位（bit-exact）相同。Stage III 推理与路由：计算无标签风险图 r_t(p)=|Δu_t|+|Δv_t|+λ_KE(|∂_x K|+|∂_y K|)（Δ 为 post-global 场与当前场之差，K 为动能），按块均值聚合为 s_b(t)，取 top-k 块送入 L_θ，未选中块直接透传；输出再反馈进自回归 rollout。审计机制：定义 A=1−L_glob/L_raw、J_loc=1−L_hyb/L_glob，总改进可精确分解为 1−L_hyb/L_raw = A + (1−A)·J_loc（既是逐 run 恒等式，也给出聚合损失层面的协议级对应），从而把每个 cell 的短板定位到单一阶段。实验协议：Poseidon-T 冻结宿主；5 个 2D 不可压流家族（NS-G、KF、NS-SL、NS-PwC、NS-Sines）× 中/极端粘度两档 = 10 cell；2π×2π 周期域、128×128 网格、Δt=0.05；每 cell 200 条训练轨迹、4 条官方留出轨迹 × t0∈{5,10} 得 n=8 配对 rollout；指标为每次运行 UV 相对 L2 除以同次原始 Poseidon 后的中位数（比值中位数而非中位数之比），并做 10,000 次配对 bootstrap CI 与 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正。基线分四族：稠密算子（FNO/TFNO/UNO/U-Net/ResNet/PDEArena）、迭代精修（PDE-Refiner）、后置校正（Leray 投影、DenseRes、Poseidon-FT Partial/LoRA）、测试时校正（Newton–Krylov PINN 残差、PINO-TTO-lite），以及 9 个共享同一宿主/全局/局部模块与预算网格的路由策略（TTA 方差、谱/小波高频、kNN/Mahalanobis/PCA 新颖性、梯度显著图、两步时间一致性、学习误差头）。
AI.result: 主要结果。（1）精度：在 10 个 cell 上 ARC-STAR 的 10 步 UV 相对 L2 比值全部 <0.03（最低 0.0036 NS-SL-m，最高 0.0274 KF-m），即每个 cell 至少改善 36×；10 个 cell 中 7 个为最佳，比 DenseRes 逐 cell 改善 2.6–251×，优于两种 Poseidon 参数高效微调基线至少 9/10 cell；无任何基线能在所有 cell 保持同等一致性（ResNet 在 NS-G-x 超过 10³×，PINN-Residual TTO 多数 cell 反而劣于原始宿主）。(2) 边界 cell：NS-G(m,x) 与 KF(m) 上从头训练的 FNO/UNO 更优，作者用审计解释为"全局阶段后残差已低于 0.05、局部 headroom 不足"（NS-G-ext 的 J_loc 仅 9.6%），并给出该 cell 上非重叠 CI 的边界说明。(3) 阶段审计：全局阶段在所有 cell 消除 91–99% 原始误差；局部阶段进一步消除 9.6–94.4% 残余，绝对贡献在 NS-PwC/NS-Sines 四 cell 上达原始误差的约 2.8–9.8%；配对 bootstrap 显示局部阶段在所有 10 个 cell 上显著（离散符号检验下限 p≈0.0078，BH 校正后 q<0.05）。(4) 预算路由：单一无标签分数在所有 cell、所有 k/B∈{0,…,1} 预算下取得最低或近最低前沿，优于 9 种外部路由策略且无需 per-cell 调参；k/B 曲线单调无拐点，验证无训练—测试间隙；打分与真实块残差的平均 Spearman ρ≈0.58（0.41–0.73），作者明确不主张形式化保形校准。(5) 跨宿主迁移：同一模板用于冻结 DPOT-Ti（7.53M AFNO）时在 NS-Gauss 取得 0.0139 比值，动能漂移从原始 +61% 降到 −5.3%（GT 为 −0.13%），但作者坦承迁移只是部分的——在局部阶段主导的 cell 上会不及原始 DPOT-Ti（host-specific 过拟合）。(6) 消融与稳健性：去掉 Hann 窗后每个 cell 都变得比原始宿主更差（退化 7–682×），说明它是 halo-read/center-write 一致性契约的结构性组成而非锦上添花；λ_KE 在 0–0.2 的 40× 范围内仅产生 ≤14.2% 漂移，属软超参；block/halo 扫描显示 (b=16, h=8) 为联合最优，b=32 因上下文密度下降劣化 32%；数据效率上 N=10 条轨迹已达 15.6× 改善、N≈100 饱和，说明宿主提供主要预测信号；延长 rollout 到 H=15 仍保持 ≥25× 改善（最差增长 3.2×）；能量谱检查显示总动能与 GT 相差 0.3%、耗散区过冲从 56× 降到 17×；散度诊断显示校正不引入虚假不可压性违规（均值 1.07× raw，介于 raw 与 GT 之间）；时延上局部阶段每步仅增加约 2.7–19 ms，但在 128² 分辨率下预算旋钮主要作用于 FLOPs 与显存而非墙钟时间。
AI.conclusion: 结论与贡献：ARC-STAR 证明"冻结宿主 + 两级可审计校正 + 无标签空间路由"是部署期修正 PDE 基础模型 rollout 漂移的一条可行路线，其核心洞见是广域校正后的残差仍空间集中（与湍流涡核/剪切层机制对应、跨 host 成立），因此算力应按块风险而非均匀分配；halo-read/center-write 契约使单一训练好的局部模块可在任意预算下免重训复用，分阶段训练/评估则提供了"改进来自哪一级"的即时归因（A + (1−A)J_loc 恒等式），实用意义在于可预先判断某个新 regime 是否值得做路由校正。作者同时明确界定边界：三个边界 cell（NS-G m/x、KF m）说明局部 headroom 不足时应改用稠密 Fourier 算子而非路由校正；跨宿主迁移只在全局阶段主导的 cell 上成立。局限：限于二维不可压 Navier–Stokes、周期网格与速度通道校正，未覆盖可压/三维/非周期、更长 rollout；训练需每 cell 约 200 条轨迹（saturate 于 ~100）；Hann 消融是"训练—测试失配"而非重训的架构消融，未彻底排除；与 PhysicsCorrect 的缓存 Jacobian 变体因算力预算未做直接对比；每 cell 仅 n=8 配对运行，簇级 bootstrap 下 KF(m) 与 NS-G(x) 的"最佳"结论应视为 borderline；预算旋钮在 128² 网格上并不带来墙钟加速。

title: How Many Different Outputs Can a Transformer Generate?
summary: We study how we can leverage only a handful of characteristics of a transformer's architecture to closely predict the number of different sequences it can output, both qualitatively and quantitatively. We provide an upper bound depending on the length of the prompt, which we show empirically to be tight up to a factor less than 10, across architectures and model sizes. Our analysis also provides a theoretical explanation for previously observed empirical failures of transformers on simple sequence tasks, such as copying and cramming. Formally, we prove that (i) the maximal length of accessible sequences (those that the transformer can output for some prompt) grows linearly with the prompt length, (ii) beyond a critical threshold, the proportion of accessible sequences decays exponentially with sequence length, and (iii) the linear coefficient relating prompt length to accessible sequence length admits a theoretical upper bound. Notably, these results hold even with unbounded context and computation time.

AI.tldr: 研究通过transformer的架构特征预测其可输出的不同序列数量，建立了与提示长度相关的理论上限，经验验证表明该上界紧致（误差<10倍）。形式化证明了可达序列的最大长度随提示长度线性增长，临界阈值后可达序列比例指数衰减，且线性系数存在理论上限。
AI.motivation: 理解和预测transformer架构在序列输出能力方面的基本限制。
AI.method: 基于transformer架构特征预测其输出序列数量，建立理论上限并通过多种架构和模型规模的经验验证。
AI.result: 1) 经验验证：所提上界在跨架构和模型规模下紧致（误差因子<10）；2) 理论证明：可达序列最大长度与提示长度呈线性增长；3) 临界阈值后可达序列比例随序列长度指数衰减；4) 线性系数存在理论上限。
AI.conclusion: 理论界限在无界上下文和计算时间条件下仍然成立，表明这些是transformer架构本身的固有局限。

title: Holomorphic Neural ODEs with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Interpretable Discovery of Complex Dynamics
summary: Complex dynamical systems governed by holomorphic maps such as $z^2 + c$ exhibit fractal boundaries with extreme sensitivity to initial conditions. Accurately modelling these structures from data requires methods that respect the underlying complex-analytic geometry, yet Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) within Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) lack complex-analytic priors, violate the Cauchy--Riemann conditions, and function as opaque approximators incapable of yielding governing equations. We introduce Holomorphic KAN-ODE, a framework that replaces the MLP with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) whose learnable B-spline activations reside on network edges, and incorporates Cauchy--Riemann equations as a differentiable regularization to preserve holomorphic structure. We evaluate on six families of complex dynamical systems spanning polynomial and transcendental classes. With only 280 parameters ($16\times$ fewer than the MLP baseline), the network achieves velocity-field $R^2 > 0.95$ on all six systems, correctly identifies all six governing symbolic families through automatic spline-to-formula fitting, and reconstructs Julia set fractal boundaries with up to 98.0\% agreement. Crucially, the model exhibits only 4\% MSE degradation under 10\% observation noise versus $15.2\times$ for MLPs, and achieves 90.4\% improvement in transfer learning from quadratic to cubic dynamics. While the MLP attains lower pointwise reconstruction error due to its larger capacity, the KAN uniquely provides interpretable symbolic equations, enforced holomorphic structure, and superior noise resilience, capabilities that are entirely absent in black-box architectures. These results establish KANs as a parameter-efficient, interpretable alternative to MLPs for physics-informed discovery of holomorphic dynamics.

AI.tldr: Holomorphic KAN-ODE框架：用带B样条激活的KAN（仅280参数）和柯西-黎曼正则化取代MLP，实现全纯动力系统的物理信息发现，在6个系统中R²>0.95，100%识别符号族，Julia集重建98%，噪声鲁棒性比MLP高380倍。
AI.motivation: 全纯映射如z²+c具有分形边界，对初值极度敏感。现有MLP在Neural ODE中缺乏复分析先验，违反柯西-黎曼条件，仅作为黑盒逼近器无法导出控制方程。
AI.method: 用B样条激活函数的KAN替代MLP，将柯西-黎曼方程作为可微分正则化项强制保持全纯结构，仅280参数（MLP的1/16）。通过自动样条-公式拟合实现符号公式识别。
AI.result: 速度场R²>0.95（全部6系统），符号家族识别率100%（6/6），Julia集边界重建98.0%一致，参数仅280个（比MLP少16倍），噪声弹性远超MLP（4% vs 1520% MSE降解），二次到三次动态迁移学习提升90.4%。
AI.conclusion:
KANs (仅280参数) 在复动力系统建模中成为MLPs的参数高效且可解释的替代方案，具有符号方程可解释性、强制全纯结构保持和卓越的噪声鲁棒性（4% MSE降解 vs MLP的15.2倍）。

关键成果：6个系统全部达到R²>0.95，正确识别全部6个符号族，重建Julia集边界达98.0%一致率，噪声下4% MSE vs MLP 15.2倍退化，迁移学习提升90.4%。

title: Vector Policy Optimization: Training for Diversity Improves Test-Time Search
summary: Language models must now generalize out of the box to novel environments and work inside inference-scaling search procedures, such as AlphaEvolve, that select rollouts with a variety of task-specific reward functions. Unfortunately, the standard paradigm of LLM post-training optimizes a pre-specified scalar reward, often leading current LLMs to produce low-entropy response distributions and thus to struggle at displaying the diversity that inference-time search will require. We propose Vector Policy Optimization (VPO), an RL algorithm that explicitly trains policies to anticipate diverse downstream reward functions and to produce diverse solutions. VPO exploits that rewards are often vector-valued in practice, like per-test-case correctness in code generation or, say, multiple different user personas or reward models. VPO is essentially a drop-in replacement for the GRPO advantage estimator, but it trains the LLM to output a set of solutions where individual solutions specialize to different trade-offs in the vector reward space. Across four tasks, VPO matches or beats the strongest scalar RL baselines on test-time search (e.g. pass@k and best@k), with the gap widening as the search budget grows. For evolutionary search, VPO models unlock problems that GRPO models cannot solve at all. As test-time search becomes more standardized, optimizing for diversity may need to become the default post-training objective.

AI.tldr: VPO提出了一种针对多样性的强化学习算法，通过利用实际场景中常见的向量值奖励函数（如代码生成的各测试用例正确性），显式训练LLM生成覆盖不同权衡空间的解决方案集合。在四项任务中，VPO在测试时搜索指标上匹配或超越最强标量RL基线，且随搜索预算增加优势扩大；在进化搜索场景中，VPO解锁了GRPO完全无法解决的问题。
AI.motivation: Current LLM post-training optimizes pre-specified scalar rewards, leading to low-entropy response distributions that struggle with diversity requirements of inference-time search procedures (e.g., AlphaEvolve). As test-time search becomes more standardized, this diversity limitation becomes a critical bottleneck.
AI.method: Vector Policy Optimization (VPO) - an RL algorithm that exploits the observation that rewards are often vector-valued (e.g., per-test-case correctness, different user personas). VPO replaces the standard GRPO advantage estimator to explicitly train policies to anticipate diverse downstream reward functions and produce diverse solutions across different trade-offs in the vector reward space.
AI.result: Across four tasks, VPO matches or beats the strongest scalar RL baselines on test-time search metrics (pass@k, best@k), with the performance gap widening as search budget grows. For evolutionary search specifically, VPO models unlock problems that GRPO models cannot solve at all.
AI.conclusion: VPO is a drop-in GRPO replacement that trains LLMs to output solution sets specializing to different trade-offs in vector reward space. Results show VPO matches/beats strongest scalar RL baselines on test-time search metrics, with gap widening as search budget grows; crucially, VPO models unlock problems that GRPO models cannot solve in evolutionary search, suggesting diversity optimization may need to become default post-training objective.

title: Decomposing Ensemble Spread in Lorenz '96 With Learned Stochastic Parameterizations
summary: Weather and climate forecasts are inherently uncertain due to chaotic dynamics, imperfect initial conditions, and incomplete representation of the underlying physical processes. Operational ensemble forecasts aim to represent these uncertainties through forecast spread, yet many approaches yield underdispersive estimates, with spread that grows too slowly relative to forecast error. Using the two-scale Lorenz 1996 system as a widely used, controlled testbed, we design a systematic approach to disentangle intrinsic variability, initial-condition perturbations, and stochastic model uncertainty. We compare multiple ensemble configurations and parameterization strategies, including existing deterministic and autoregressive as well as novel Bayesian and flow-based approaches. Our results show that ensemble perturbations do not increase the system's long-term variance; rather, they regulate how rapidly trajectories decorrelate and explore the invariant measure. Stochastic parameterizations, particularly those with temporally persistent structure, enhance early spread growth and improve spread-error consistency. Overall, we bring clarity to how different sources of uncertainty interact in a chaotic system and provide guidance for the design and evaluation of stochastic parameterizations in weather and climate models.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用Lorenz 1996系统比较了多种集合预报参数化策略，发现随机参数化（尤其是时间持续性结构）能有效改善预报离散度与误差的一致性，为天气预报和气候模型中的随机参数化设计提供了理论指导和实践建议。
AI.motivation: 天气预报和气候预测本质上面临混沌动力学、初值不完美和物理过程表示不完整带来的不确定性。现有业务集合预报普遍存在欠离散问题，即预报离散度相对于预报误差增长过慢，需要系统性地理解和改进。
AI.method: 采用双尺度Lorenz 1996系统作为受控测试平台，设计系统化方法分离内禀变异性、初值扰动和随机模型不确定性，比较了确定性方法、自回归方法以及新颖的贝叶斯方法和基于流的生成方法等多种集合配置和参数化策略。
AI.result: 集合扰动不会增加系统的长期方差，而是调控轨迹去相关速度和不变测度的探索方式；具有时间持续结构的随机参数化能增强早期离散度增长，改善离散度-误差一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为天气和气候模式中随机参数化方案的设计与评估提供了系统性指导，阐明了不同不确定性源在混沌系统中的交互机制。

title: Explainable AI for Data-Driven Design of High-Dimensional Predictive Studies
summary: Predictive modelling is important for health data analysis and data-driven clinical decision-making. However, predictive studies are challenging to design optimally by hand when tens or even hundreds of features require selection, transformation, or interaction modelling. While complex machine learning models offer high performance, their "black-box" nature limits the clinical trust, transparency, and interpretability required for decision-making. We developed and evaluated an Exploratory AI Recommender that provides data-driven recommendations to improve predictive performance of existing interpretable statistical models. The developed framework uses flexible AI modelling to capture complex data patterns and explainable AI techniques to translate the patterns into three recommendation types: feature exclusion, non-linear terms, and feature interactions. We evaluated the framework by comparing predictive performance of a baseline (i.e., no interactions or non-linear terms) Cox Proportional Hazards (CPH) model against an augmented CPH incorporating recommendations suggested by our method. The primary analysis predicts the time to the first occurrence of a fall or related injury in 245,614 patients. Our method recommended excluding 23 features, including non-linear terms for two features, and including 221 suggested feature interactions. The C-index improved from 0.805 (95% CI 0.798-0.812) to 0.815 (95% CI 0.809-0.822), and so did calibration (intercept: -0.006 to 0.003; slope: 1.063 to 0.950). All recommendations were supported by existing literature. The method also proved effective on two additional public datasets, demonstrating wider applicability. The proposed Exploratory AI Recommender demonstrates the potential of explainable AI and data-driven study design to improve the process of developing, and the performance of high-dimensional transparent predictive models.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种Exploratory AI Recommender框架，利用可解释AI为Cox比例风险模型提供数据驱动的优化建议（特征排除、非线性项、特征交互），在24.5万患者跌倒预测任务中成功将C-index从0.805提升至0.815，兼顾了模型性能与临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: 健康数据预测建模面临挑战：手动优化涉及数百特征的筛选、转换和交互建模设计困难；复杂机器学习模型虽性能高但存在"黑箱"问题，缺乏临床信任、透明度和可解释性，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 开发了Exploratory AI Recommender框架，使用灵活AI建模捕获复杂数据模式，并利用可解释AI技术将模式转化为三类建议：特征排除、非线性项和特征交互。通过比较基线Cox比例风险模型与融合建议的增强模型的预测性能进行评估。
AI.result: 建议排除23个特征、添加2个非线性项和221个特征交互。C-index从0.805提升至0.815，校准性也改善（截距：-0.006至0.003；斜率：1.063至0.950）。所有建议均获得文献支持，并在两个额外公开数据集上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了可解释AI和数据驱动的研究设计在提高高维透明预测模型开发过程和性能方面的潜力，可同时提升模型表现和临床可解释性。

title: No Epoch Like the Present: Robust Climate Emulation Requires Out-of-Distribution Generalisation
summary: Climate emulation is an out-of-distribution (OOD) projection task. This is precisely the challenge where modern Machine Learning (ML) methods are most prone to failure. Consequently, while current ML emulators trained on present climate achieve high in-distribution performance, their future reliability under the inevitable distribution shifts of a changing climate remains a critical, poorly understood blind spot. Addressing this challenge requires a fundamental shift in how we understand, evaluate, and design climate emulators. In this work, we first confirm that climate change drives a statistically significant and progressively growing shift in atmospheric state distributions, rendering standard evaluation protocols insufficient. We empirically establish that seasonal variation serves as an effective proxy for these long-term climate shifts, providing access to $\textit{real-world}$ distribution shifts without recourse to heuristics like synthetic perturbations. Motivated by this link, we introduce a novel evaluation framework that leverages seasonal shifts as a rigorous, zero-overhead testbed for emulator robustness. Our systematic characterisation confirms that current state-of-the-art hybrid-ML emulators degrade significantly under these realistic shifts. Finally, we chart a path forward by identifying compositional generalisation, the ability to form novel combinations from observed elementary components, as a principled route towards robust climate emulation. We demonstrate that physically motivated decompositions substantially improve OOD performance with only modest trade-offs against in-distribution performance, providing an avenue towards ML-driven climate emulators robust to an unknown future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个"零成本"的鲁棒性评测框架：气候模拟本质是分布外（OOD）预测任务，而季节循环可作为气候变化分布偏移的物理有效代理；据此在 ClimSim 基准上证明当前最先进的混合ML模拟器在真实分布偏移下系统性地退化，并指出"组合式泛化"（按物理机制分解为专家模型）是提升OOD鲁棒性的可行路径。
AI.motivation: 数值地球系统模型（ESM）计算成本高昂，限制了气候研究；机器学习模拟器（ML emulator）虽有潜力，但气候预测本质上是一个分布外（OOD）预测任务：模型在"当下气候"训练，却被部署到统计特性已偏移的未来气候中。现存研究普遍缺失或简化了OOD评估：多数工作完全不做OOD测试，做了的也仅覆盖不超过三个情景，常用均匀SST升/降温等物理上不合理的扰动，且缺乏度量偏移程度的标准化指标，也未区分"分布偏移导致的退化"与"情景本身可预测性差异"。因此需要一套系统、公平、零额外数据成本的鲁棒性评测框架，并需要重新思考ML气候模拟器的架构设计。
AI.method: 1) 偏移量化：用ERA5月再分析（1975–2025中的1979–2025，2.5°，10512网格点）构建由2m气温、500hPa位势高度、总柱可降水量、对数降水组成的多元大气状态分布，按五年期分段，以1979–1988为基线，用能量距离（ED）、MMD（高斯核+中位数启发式）、PCA降维后的kNN KL散度计算多元距离，并以两样本置换检验（ED/MMD各1000次、KL 500次）评估显著性。2) 季节代理验证：受"涌现约束"（emergent constraints）文献启发（季节温度循环约束ECS、雪反照率反馈等），提出季节变率作为协变量偏移代理；用200组随机搜索采样的MLP在四个纬度带（NH/SH中纬、NH/SH热带）做两组独立划分——季节划分（冷季训练/暖季测试）与气候变化划分（1979–1988训练/2019–2025测试），以Pearson/Spearman相关检验季节OOD RMSE能否预测气候变化OOD RMSE，并以OOD/ID比作为先验诊断量。3) 评测框架：提出相对误差指标 e_r(i,j)=L(f_θi(X_j))/L(f_θj(X_j))（用ID基线归一化，消除情景内在可预测性差异），配合ED度量偏移幅度；在ClimSim（E3SM-MMF 10年模拟，1399输入→308输出）上按DJF/MAM/JJA/SON×4区域×7种架构（Squeezeformer、ResLSTM、PAO、ConvNeXt、EncDec-LSTM、U-Net、MLP）×3种子训练336个模型，得到1008个OOD结果，并先通过将顶部15个垂直层置零消除平流层漂移以保证平稳性。4) 组合式泛化：在辐射过程（NETSW、FLWDS）上实现经典分段物理参数化（晴空/云天双分支、透射率、Stefan–Boltzmann长波、38个可调参数、L-BFGS-B分阶段标定）作为鲁棒性上限参考；再实现组合式MLP（4个专家：晴空短波、云天短波、晴空长波、云天长波，各只接收相关输入特征，冻结由物理模型标定的云量门控α与昼夜指示，加权组合输出），与MLP、Squeezeformer对比。
AI.result: 1) 气候变化造成显著且随时间加剧的多元分布偏移：置换检验p值随预测时段单调下降（<10⁻²），三种散度指标趋势一致，边际分布（KDE）显示各变量系统性漂移。2) 季节代理有效：在四个区域中的三个，季节OOD性能与40年气候变化OOD性能呈统计显著正相关（跨架构的排序一致性），证明季节偏移可用于排名模型；但当气候变化信号相对季节信号过弱（OOD/ID比的IQR过小）时相关性被采样噪声主导、符号不可靠，该情形可由OOD/ID比先验诊断。3) 现有SOTA模拟器不鲁棒：E[log e_r]与ED之间普遍呈显著正斜率（区域、热力/辐射/水文-环流等变量组、训练季节、各架构均成立），即偏移越大性能越差；两类例外得到物理解释——多变量偏移会掩盖任务相关变量的差异（辐射过程），以及某些季节训练分布本身优于"本征"ID分布（e_r<1，如SON训练对JJA云 tendency更优）。4) 组合式泛化有效：物理模型最鲁棒但ID技巧最差（仅38参数、R²最低）；组合式MLP在鲁棒性上优于所有ML基线，同时ID R²显著高于物理模型，恢复了复杂辐射动力学能力；该模式在JJA/DJF/SON/MAM四个训练季节上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 气候模拟必须把鲁棒性视为一等需求：气候变化确实驱动大气状态分布的显著漂移，因此标准评测协议不足；季节循环可作为真实、零成本、结构化的OOD测试床；现有混合ML模拟器（包括Kaggle冠军架构与U-Net）在真实分布偏移下系统性退化，说明它们尚未学到足够好的物理动力学近似；按物理不变的机制（如晴空/云天、变量子集、方程约束）对模型做分解，即组合式泛化，是兼顾ID技巧与OOD鲁棒性的有原则路径。作者指出未来方向是数据驱动的机制/分区识别（从物理指定式分解走向物理学习式分解），并指出存在ID技巧与偏移稳定性之间的权衡取舍问题，同时坦承局限：分析变量集精简、仅月尺度与单一预测任务、能量距离可能掩盖偏移信号、组合式方法目前仅验证于辐射过程且依赖先验领域知识。

title: What are the Right Symmetries for Formal Theorem Proving?
summary: Formal theorem provers based on large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to superficial variations in problem representation: semantically equivalent statements can exhibit drastically different proof success rates, revealing a failure to respect structural symmetries inherent in formal mathematics. This raises a central question: what are the right symmetries for formal theorem proving? We introduce rewriting categories, a category-theoretic framework capturing the compositional, generally non-invertible transformations induced by proof tactics, and use it to formalize two symmetry notions: proof equivariance, governing how proof distributions transform under rewrites, and success invariance (i.e., invariance of success probability), requiring equivalent statements to be solved with the same probability. We observe that state-based next-tactic provers naturally satisfy proof equivariance by operating on proof states. In contrast, state-of-the-art LLM-based provers satisfy neither property, exhibiting large performance variation across equivalent formulations. To mitigate this, we propose test-time methods that aggregate over equivalent rewritings of the input, showing theoretically that they recover success invariance in the sampling limit, and empirically, that they improve robustness and performance under fixed inference budgets. Our results highlight symmetry as a key missing inductive bias in LLM-based theorem proving and suggest test-time computation as a practical route to approximate it.

AI.tldr: 论文针对LLM定理证明器对语义等价陈述表现不一致的问题，提出用范畴论框架"重写范畴"形式化对称性概念，证明基于状态的证明器满足等变性而LLM证明器均不满足，并验证测试时聚合等价重写可有效提升性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM形式定理证明器对问题表示的表面变化高度敏感：语义等价的陈述可能表现出截然不同的证明成功率，这揭示了模型未能尊重形式数学中固有的结构对称性。
AI.method: 引入"重写范畴"（rewriting categories）——一个范畴论框架，用于捕捉由证明策略诱导的组合性、通常不可逆的变换。基于此形式化了两种对称性概念：证明等变性（证明分布在重写下的变换规则）和成功不变性（等价陈述应具有相同的求解概率）。提出测试时方法，聚合输入的等价重写。
AI.result: 基于状态的下一步策略证明器自然满足证明等变性；而最先进的LLM基础证明器两种性质均不满足，在等价公式化间表现出较大性能差异。测试时聚合方法在采样极限下可恢复成功不变性，并在固定推理预算下提升鲁棒性和性能。
AI.conclusion: 对称性是LLM定理证明中缺失的关键归纳偏差，测试时计算是逼近对称性的实用方法。

title: An Evidence Hierarchy for Bayesian Object Classification via OSINT-Aided Heterogeneous Sensor Fusion
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure; \c{opyright} 2026 The Authors. Submitted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multisensor Fusion and Integration (MFI 2026). Under review
summary: Heterogeneous sensor fusion is vital for detecting, localizing, and classifying CBRNE threats. However, individual sensors are often only capable of detecting a subset of relevant threats with varying reliability or can even provide only indirect threat indications, making threat classification challenging. Furthermore, high clutter rates on the sensor side present a great challenge for fusion systems. Additionally, the limited availability of high quality datasets hinders the advancement of learning-based detection and classification models in smart sensors. To mitigate these sensor related shortcomings, a context-aware and domain knowledge-enhanced fusion process is proposed. First, a novel evidence hierarchy is established that enables modeling of direct, indicative, and contextual information. Second, contextual information about the environment is introduced into the fusion process, by collecting, processing, and exploiting OSINT inputs. Third, all levels of the evidence hierarchy are used to craft a Bayesian threat type classification mechanism with domain knowledge-informed priors. The proposed methodology is evaluated in simulated scenarios, and the results demonstrate the benefit of the proposed fusion approach in terms of robustness to clutter and prior mismatch, with an overall classification accuracy of up to 95%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CBRNE威胁检测中的异构传感器融合问题，提出了一种上下文感知与领域知识增强的融合框架。通过构建证据层级、利用开源情报和贝叶斯分类机制，有效解决了传感器检测能力有限和高杂波环境下的威胁分类难题，在模拟场景中实现了95%的分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 异构传感器融合面临多重挑战：单个传感器检测能力有限、可靠性不均且仅能提供间接威胁指示；高杂波率严重影响融合系统性能；高质量标注数据集稀缺制约了智能传感器学习模型的开发。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知与领域知识增强的融合方法：(1)建立证据层级体系，涵盖直接信息、指示性信息和上下文信息三个层次；(2)通过收集、处理和利用开源情报(OSINT)输入将环境上下文信息引入融合过程；(3)采用贝叶斯威胁类型分类机制，结合领域知识构建先验分布。
AI.result: 仿真场景验证表明，该方法在抗杂波性和先验错配鲁棒性方面表现优异，威胁分类准确率高达95%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的融合方法在模拟场景中验证有效，具有较强的抗杂波性和先验匹配鲁棒性，分类准确率达到95%。

title: Tailoring Teaching to Aptitude: Direction-Adaptive Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is an emerging LLM post-training paradigm in which the model serves as its own teacher: conditioned on privileged information such as a reference trace or hint, the same policy provides dense token-level supervision on its own rollouts. However, recent studies show that OPSD degrades complex reasoning by suppressing predictive uncertainty, which supports exploration and hypothesis revision. Our token-level analysis shows that this failure arises from applying a uniform direction of teacher supervision across tokens with different uncertainty levels: conformity to the privileged self-teacher suppresses exploration at high entropy, while deviation from the teacher degrades step accuracy at low entropy. Accordingly, we propose \textbf{Direction-Adaptive Self-Distillation} (\textbf{DASD}), which reframes privileged self-distillation from uniform teacher imitation into entropy-routed directional supervision: high-entropy tokens are pushed away from the privileged teacher to preserve exploration, while low-entropy tokens are pulled toward the teacher to stabilize step-level execution. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, DASD achieves the best macro Avg@16 over strong RLVR and self-distillation baselines. Pass@$k$, reasoning-health, and generalization analyses show that these average gains come from preserving exploration without sacrificing step-level execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DASD，通过根据token不确定性水平自适应调整监督方向来解决OPSD在复杂推理中的退化问题：高熵token远离教师以保留探索，低熵token靠近教师以稳定执行。
AI.motivation: 当前OPSD方法对所有token应用统一的教师监督方向，导致高熵时过度顺从而抑制探索，低熵时过度偏离而损害步骤准确性。
AI.method: 将特权自蒸馏从统一的教师模仿重新框架为熵路由方向监督：针对高熵token远离特权教师以保留探索能力，针对低熵token拉向教师以稳定步骤级执行。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准测试中，DASD相比强RLVR和自蒸馏基线获得了最佳的宏平均性能(Avg@16)，并通过Pass@k、推理健康度和泛化分析验证了性能提升来自保持探索能力同时不牺牲步骤级执行。
AI.conclusion: DASD在六个数学推理基准上实现了最佳的宏平均性能(Avg@16)，同时保持了探索能力而不牺牲逐步执行精度。

title: Detecting Atypical Clients in Federated Learning via Representation-Level Divergence
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative training across distributed clients with heterogeneous data, but such heterogeneity often leads to unstable updates and degraded global performance. Moreover, in practical deployments, client updates may deviate from the expected behavior not only due to benign not i.i.d. distributions, but also due to distributional shifts or anomalous inputs, raising concerns about the reliability of the aggregation process. In this work, we propose a lightweight geometric signal to quantify the functional deviation of a client with respect to the global model. Instead of comparing model parameters or gradients, our approach measures how the local training of each client alters the activation-induced partition of the input space, evaluated on a shared probe set. This yields a permutation-invariant, interpretable metric of client--global divergence that captures differences in how data is processed by the model. We show that this signal effectively identifies clients that induce atypical functional changes, distinguishing stable yet heterogeneous clients from those whose updates significantly diverge from the global regime. As a result, the proposed metric provides a simple tool for monitoring client behavior and enabling risk-aware aggregation strategies in federated learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于几何信号的功能偏差度量方法，通过共享探测集评估客户端本地训练对输入空间激活诱导划分的影响，用于识别联邦学习中偏离全局模型的异常客户端，为风险感知聚合提供轻量级监控工具。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中数据异构性导致更新不稳定和全局性能下降，且实际部署中客户端更新可能因数据分布偏移或异常输入而偏离预期行为，传统方法难以有效识别和区分良性异构与恶意偏离。
AI.method: 利用共享探测集评估客户端本地训练如何改变输入空间的激活诱导划分，生成几何信号来量化客户端-全局功能偏差，无需比较模型参数或梯度。
AI.result: 该信号能有效识别诱导非典型功能变化的客户端，成功区分稳定异构客户端与显著偏离全局状态的客户端。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于激活诱导划分的功能偏差度量可有效识别异常客户端，为联邦学习中的风险感知聚合策略提供了轻量级监控工具。

title: Adaptive Measurement Allocation for Learning Kernelized SVMs Under Noisy Observations
summary: Kernel methods are typically formulated under the assumption of exact, noise-free access to the Gram matrix. However, in emerging settings such as quantum machine learning, each kernel entry must be inferred from noisy observations, and its accuracy depends on how a limited measurement budget is allocated. Despite this, existing approaches overwhelmingly rely on uniform allocation, which equalizes estimator variance but ignores the highly non-uniform dependence of kernelized classifiers on the Gram matrix. In this work, we introduce an adaptive measurement-allocation strategy for learning kernelized Support Vector Machines (SVMs) from noisy Bernoulli observations. Our approach combines two complementary principles: (i) geometric sensitivity, capturing how perturbations of individual kernel entries affect the classifier margin, and (ii) active-set instability, quantifying the probability of discrete changes in support-vector membership induced by measurement noise. These signals define a task-aware allocation scheme that concentrates measurements on the most decision-critical regions of the kernel matrix. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that the benefit of adaptive allocation is governed by the heterogeneity of the induced kernel importance structure, leading to distinct regimes in which adaptive or uniform strategies are preferable. Empirical evaluations on synthetic datasets demonstrate that adaptive allocation significantly improves support-vector recovery, margin estimation, and decision-function accuracy under fixed measurement budgets. A dual-coefficient stability criterion further enables early stopping, achieving near-optimal performance while using only a fraction of the measurement cost. Additional experiments on quantum kernels derived from real-world data reveal a regime-dependent behavior aligned with known phenomena such as kernel concentration. Together...

AI.tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive measurement-allocation strategy for learning kernelized SVMs from noisy Bernoulli observations in quantum machine learning settings, using geometric sensitivity and active-set instability as allocation signals. Theoretical analysis reveals regime-dependent optimality between adaptive and uniform strategies, with experiments demonstrating improved performance and efficient early stopping capability.
AI.motivation: Traditional kernel methods assume exact, noise-free Gram matrices, but emerging applications (particularly quantum machine learning) require inferring kernel entries from noisy observations with limited measurement budgets. Existing methods rely on uniform allocation which ignores the non-uniform dependence of classifiers on different kernel entries.
AI.method: The authors introduce an adaptive measurement-allocation strategy combining: (i) geometric sensitivity analysis measuring how individual kernel entry perturbations affect classifier margin, and (ii) active-set instability quantification of support-vector membership changes. These signals create a task-aware allocation scheme focusing measurements on decision-critical kernel matrix regions.
AI.result: Adaptive allocation significantly improves support-vector recovery, margin estimation, and decision-function accuracy compared to uniform allocation under fixed measurement budgets. Near-optimal performance is achievable with only a fraction of the measurement cost when using the early stopping criterion.
AI.conclusion: The proposed adaptive allocation strategy significantly outperforms uniform approaches when the kernel importance structure is heterogeneous, with a dual-coefficient stability criterion enabling efficient early stopping. The method shows regime-dependent behavior aligned with quantum kernel concentration phenomena.

title: EmoTrack: Robust Depression Tracking from Counseling Transcripts across Session Regimes
summary: Text-based counseling is an important interface for AI mental-health support, where transcripts may be used to monitor depression severity and flag sessions requiring timely human review. However, robust PHQ-8 prediction across session regimes remains challenging: fine-tuning-based methods can exploit richer supervision but may generalize poorly under data scarcity, while prompt-based LLM methods are data-efficient but usually treat each transcript holistically and provide limited support for longitudinal context. We study robust depression tracking from counseling transcripts across single-session and multi-session regimes. We introduce LongCounsel, a multi-session counseling dataset with session-level PHQ-8 supervision for evaluating repeated-session tracking under partial symptom disclosure and cross-session continuity. We further propose EmoTrack, a PHQ-8 prediction framework that combines LLM-extracted clinical signals with frozen turn-level semantic embeddings and trains symptom-specific predictors over the resulting transcript representation. When prior sessions are available, EmoTrack can further incorporate them through compact cross-session memory. Experiments on LongCounsel and DAIC-WOZ show that EmoTrack achieves a clear gain on the real single-session benchmark, including a 13.5% relative MAE reduction over the strongest DAIC-WOZ baseline, and remains competitive with the strongest longitudinal baseline on LongCounsel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmoTrack——一种融合「LLM 抽取的临床特征分数」与「冻结句嵌入的逐轮语义」的 PHQ-8 总分预测框架：用编码器-解码器联合编码临床 token 与来访者话语 token，再以 8 个 PHQ-8 条目查询向量分别读取证据；纵向场景下可选用紧凑的上一会话记忆（槽位检索 + 摘要路径 + 门控残差）作为辅助证据。配套发布多会话合成基准 LongCounsel（每条轨迹 5 次会谈、含会话级 PHQ-8 标注）。五个评测设置下归一化聚合误差相对最强基线下降约 6.1%，DAIC-WOZ 上 MAE 从 2.8234 降至 2.4708（正文口径约 12.5%，摘要写 13.5% 存在不一致）。
AI.motivation: 文本咨询是 AI 心理健康支持的重要接口，可用于监测抑郁严重度并标记需及时人工复核的会谈。现有两类方法各有明显缺陷：临床推断类方法（LLM 问答/特征打分）虽提供显式临床结构，但只给出会话级结论，无法指出哪些话语支撑了具体分数；训练类方法（句向量+预测器）保留局部对话细节，却必须在稀少的标注转录上自学临床结构，且往往把整段转录当作整体处理，缺乏纵向支持。此外，三大挑战尚未解决：(i) 异质证据（少量具名临床分数 vs 变长话语向量序列）需在交互的同时保留每个分数的语义身份；(ii) 不同 PHQ-8 条目需要不同证据（失眠话语对应睡眠条目、无价值感对应低自尊条目），单一池化读出会强迫所有条目共享同一摘要；(iii) 历史上下文可能缺失或在症状变化后已过时。
AI.method: 核心表示：将临床特征与来访者话语建模为「可按条目选择性检索」的异质证据，而非全局池化。①联合证据编码：LLM（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）按 AIDA schema 抽取 F=23 个临床特征分数（8 个 PHQ 对齐症状指标 + 5 个语言模式特征 + 10 个认知扭曲标记，0–10 分），用训练集统计量 z-归一化；每个临床 token = MLP_score(z_i) + 特征身份嵌入 e_feat + 临床组嵌入 e_group，从而在分数相同时仍可区分；对话分支用冻结的 Qwen3-Embedding-8B（4096 维）编码来访者话语，经线性投影 + LayerNorm 得到定长向量（DAIC-WOZ 取前 N_max=80 轮来访者话语，去除咨询师话语与空话语）。②主干：将两类 token 拼接为单一序列（加 padding mask），过 2–3 层 Transformer 编码器做全序列自注意力；解码器含 4 层，用 J=8 个可学习 PHQ-8 条目查询向量交叉注意力读出，得到每条目一个表征 D∈R^{8×d}。③训练目标：每条目经 linear+sigmoid 映射到 [0,3] 的中间分，总分 = 8 项之和；损失 = 聚合 Huber + λ_sym·条目级 Huber（可选），另加可选的假阴性惩罚 L_FN（对真实分≥10 而预测<10 的会话惩罚）。④可选纵向记忆：将上一会话来访者话语投影后由 S 个可学习槽位查询压缩为记忆槽，各条目表征分别检索并经 sigmoid 门控残差更新；另有均值池化摘要路径同样经门控注入；训练时以 p_hist 概率做历史 dropout，使模型兼容有/无历史两种情形。模型 d=64、h=4、约 1.02M 可训练参数，AdamW，lr=1e-3、weight decay=1e-2、batch 32、warmup+余弦衰减、梯度裁剪、早停。
AI.result: 五个评测设置（DAIC-WOZ 真实单次、E-DAIC 冻结迁移、LC8-Qwen35-35B / LC8-GPT54-mini / LC8-GPT56-Luna 纵向）：EmoTrack 归一化聚合误差 NAE=0.714，最优（最强基线 LMIQ(now) 0.760，约降 6.1%）。DAIC-WOZ 上 MAE 2.4708±0.3892，优于最强基线 AIDA 的 2.8234±0.2099（正文称 12.5% 降幅；摘要称 13.5%，两处不一致），优于 LMIQ 3.0285 与所有训练类基线（≥4.09）；但参与者级配对置换检验 p=0.1901、bootstrap 区间 [-0.158, 0.815] 均跨越零，差异未达统计显著（47 名测试参与者中 28 名更优）。E-DAIC 无适配迁移：3.6977±0.2665，第二名，优于 AIDA 4.2538 及所有训练类基线（≥4.9047），落后 LMIQ(now) 3.4722。纵向：LC8-GPT54-mini 3.8447±0.1181（最优，优于 EnsemBERT-Qwen3-Emb 3.9184，1.9%）；LC8-Qwen35-35B 2.6238（第三，落后 Lau 等 0.0294）；LC8-GPT56-Luna 3.0887（第四，落后 0.1133）；是唯一在五个集合均进前四、三个集合进前二的方法。消融：条目查询读出优于均值池化头（DAIC 2.4708 vs 2.6889；LC8-Qwen35 2.6238 vs 2.7364）；去掉临床特征 MAE 升至 4.7479，去掉嵌入升至 2.7049；加入咨询师话语或仅用咨询师话语均变差；同特征下 Ridge/MLP/GBDT 均不及注意力主干；记忆消融（无记忆 2.7097→2.6238；摘要+检索最优于 GPT54-mini）；λ_sym=0.5 在 LC8-Qwen35 上同时改善总分与条目 MAE（0.5674→0.4251），DAIC 上验证集选择 0；history dropout 0.1/0.2 最优；记忆槽 4 即可，历史上限扩展到两次会话更优。附加分析：假阴性惩罚 λ_FN=2.5 将 FNR 从 0.708 降至 0.422（优于最强基线 0.588），代价是 MAE 升到 4.037、FPR 升到 0.267；条目级偏差显示躯体类条目被低估、精神运动被高估；推理成本极低（LC8 上 0.029 GPU 小时 vs Lau 等 7.23/23.72）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：联合「临床-语义」建模是跨会话场景下文本抑郁严重度估计的有效路径。EmoTrack 以 1.02M 参数的轻量预测器在五个设置上取得最低归一化聚合误差（约 −6.1%），在真实 DAIC-WOZ 上取得最低 MAE（2.4708 vs 2.8234），在冻结迁移与纵向评估中保持竞争力；消融支持「双分支输入互补」「PHQ-8 条目查询读出」「注意力主干」「可选上一会话记忆」等设计；可选假阴性惩罚能以小幅 MAE 代价显著降低漏检率，契合筛查/分诊需求。局限：纵向证据依赖合成数据（LongCounsel-8）与真实单次数据（DAIC-WOZ），缺乏真实多会话临床验证；上游 LLM/嵌入模型未必最强；条目级误差尚不足以支撑症状级应用；PHQ-8 预测仅是临床决策支持的一部分，仍需校准、阈值分诊、不确定性估计、隐私保护与人在环复核，作者明确将其定位为「抑郁追踪组件」而非诊断或干预系统。

title: Long-term Fairness with Selective Labels
summary: Long-term fairness algorithms aim to satisfy fairness beyond static and short-term notions by accounting for the dynamics between decision-making policies and population behavior. Most previous approaches evaluate performance and fairness measures from observable features and a label, which is assumed to be fully observed. However, in scenarios such as hiring or lending, the labels (e.g., ability to repay the loan) are selective labels as they are only revealed based on positive decisions (e.g., when a loan is granted). In this paper, we study long-term fairness in the selective labels setting and analytically show that naive solutions do not guarantee fairness. To address this gap, we then introduce a novel framework that leverages both the observed data and a label predictor model to estimate the true fairness measure value by decomposing it into the observed fairness and bias from label predictions. This allows us to derive sufficient conditions to satisfy true fairness from observable quantities by using the confidence in the predictor model. Finally, we rely on our theoretical results to propose a novel reinforcement learning algorithm for effective long-term fair decision-making with selective labels. In semisynthetic environments, the proposed algorithm reached comparable fairness and performance to an agent with oracle access to the true labels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"选择性标签"（标签仅在正决策时被观测，如信贷、招聘）场景下的长期公平性。作者首先证明用已接受人群计算的差异度（Δ^{A=1}）无法保证真实公平（Prop 3.1，机会均等下恒为0），随后提出用标签预测器做插补的通用框架，把观测差异度 Δ̃ 分解为真实差异度 Δ 与插补偏差 r^iε^i（Thm 3.2），并借助IPW与域适应泛化界给出仅依赖可观测量的充分条件（Thm 3.5/3.6），最后据此设计强化学习算法 SELLF（PPO + 差异度优势正则 + Rényi散度正则），在半合成环境中取得了与拥有真实标签的oracle智能体相当的公平性与回报。
AI.motivation: 现有长期公平（long-term fairness）研究通常假设决策者的标签 Y 全部可观测，因而能直接计算群体间差异度 Δ_t = μ¹−μ⁰ 并在每一步施加公平约束。但在贷款审批、招聘、医疗诊断等实际场景中，标签（如"是否有偿还能力"、"是否再犯"）只有在被接受（正向决策）时才被揭示，拒绝者的标签不可观测，这被称为"选择性标签（selective labels）"。这种部分可观测性使得群体效用的无偏估计成为非平凡问题：仅用已接受子集计算的差异度是"有偏的"甚至退化的（机会均等下恒为0），算法可以学会"掩盖"真实不公平；同时先前文献（Kilbertus et al. 2020; Creager et al. 2020; Chang & Wiens 2024 等）在选择性标签下的分析多限于时间不变的分布或单轮迭代，缺乏动态反馈循环下的长期公平理论保证与可执行算法。
AI.method: 形式化：定义 ℱ-MDP（状态为 (x,z)，标签 Y∼Bern(α(x,z))，动作二元，敏感属性二分类），研究三种依赖标签的公平准则：资格均等（Qualification Parity）、准确率均等（Accuracy Parity）、机会均等（Equality of Opportunity）。理论部分：(1) Prop 3.1 给出负结果——仅用已接受人群估计的 Δ^{A=1} 为 0 不是真实 Δ 为 0 的充分条件（机会均等下 Δ^{A=1}≡0），并给出各准则下的分解式；(2) Thm 3.2 观测差异度分解：Δ̃=Δ±(r¹ε¹−r⁰ε⁰)（资格/准确率均等），Δ̃=μ¹κ¹−μ⁰κ⁰、κ^i=1−r^iε^i/φ̃^i（机会均等），其中 r^i 为分组拒绝率、ε^i 为被拒人群上的预测器误差；(3) Thm 3.3 由 |Δ|≤|Δ̃|+|r¹ε¹−r⁰ε⁰| 推出以 ω/2 为界的充分条件；(4) 利用域适应与逆概率加权（IPW）从未标注的被拒人群估计误差：权重 w(x,i)=a[1:K]^i/r^i ·(1−π[K])/(1−∏(1−π[k]))，配合覆盖性假设（AS 3.4，D_R^i 绝对连续于 D_A^i）与 Cortes et al. (2010) 的 IPW 泛化界，得到 ε^i ≤ ε̂^i_{A,w} + O(√(d₂(D_R^i‖D_A^i)/N^i)（Thm 3.5，d₂ 为二阶 Rényi 散度）；(5) Thm 3.6 给出完全可观测且可执行的充分条件：Σ_i r^i|ε̄^i| ≤ ω/2 且 |Δ̃| ≤ ω/2（机会均等除以 φ̃^i 并引入 v=max r^i|ε̄^i|/φ̃^i）。附录 C 给出多组扩展（此时分解退化为不等式）。算法 SELLF：PPO 基座，对优势函数加惩罚项 β₁·max{|Δ̃_t|−ω/2,0}（资格均等用 Δ̃_{t+1}），并叠加 Rényi 正则项 L^Renyi=c¹E[w²|Z=1]+c⁰E[w²|Z=0] 以同时压低误差界与被拒/被接受分布分离度；预测器 φ 用 PPO 采集数据以自归一化 IPW 加权 BCE 损失训练；同时可加探索/半随机化版本 SELLF (Semi-sto.)。实验：FICO 信贷、COMPAS 再犯、ENEM 升学三个半合成环境（126 维特征），与 PPO、POCAR、POCAR (Oracle)、FOCOPS、ELBERT 对比，ω=0.05，50 万步。
AI.result: 1) 负结果被严格证明：机会均等准则下 Δ^{A=1} 恒等于 0，故所有基于已接受人群的公平算法（PPO、POCAR、FOCOPS、ELBERT）在信贷环境的机会均等下差异度高达 0.30–0.41，远超 0.05 约束，退化为纯奖励最大化；这解释了选择性标签下朴素方案失效的原因。2) 理论上给出可观测充分条件：只要 |Δ̃|≤ω/2 且 Σ_i r^i|ε̄^i|（机会均等为除以 φ̃^i 的形式）≤ω/2，则真实差异度以高概率 ≤ω；因此可通过降低预测器误差/降低 Rényi 散度或降低高误差群体的拒绝率两条路径保障真实公平。3) 实验：SELLF 在信贷环境机会均等下真实差异度 0.03–0.05，与 POCAR (Oracle) 的 0.05 相当但累计回报更高（1246 vs 1157），因其接受率更高、缩小了接受/拒绝人群分布差异；再犯环境准确率均等下 SELLF 是唯一满足 0.05 约束者（0.05，回报 991，接近 PPO 的 999）；升学环境资格均等下 SELLF 与 POCAR (Oracle) 差异度最低（0.12）但均未达 0.05。4) 消融显示 Rényi 正则权重 β₂ 至关重要：β₂<0.1 时观测-真实差异度间隙扩大、Rényi 散度升至 6 以上、重要性权重最大值超 150；β₂=0.1 时间隙趋近 0 且真实差异度最低，β₂=0.2 则因过度接受而导致差异度回升。5) 复杂度代价约为 PPO 的 2 倍（15.8–22.4 分钟 vs 7.3–12.8 分钟/50 万步）。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统地把"选择性标签"与"长期公平"两个问题结合：证明了朴素解（仅用已接受人群评估差异度）无公平保证并会掩盖真实不公平，提出基于标签预测器插补 + IPW/域适应误差界的通用框架，把真实差异度分解为可观测差异度与可量化的插补偏差，并推导出完全依赖可观测量的可执行充分条件；据此提出 SELLF 强化学习算法（在 PPO 上加入观测差异度的优势正则与 Rényi 散度正则、用 IPW 训练预测器），在半合成环境中达到与拥有真实标签的 oracle 智能体可比的长期公平性与回报，同时具备对覆盖性假设轻微违反（半随机化版本）的鲁棒性。局限与展望：分析依赖群体动力学平稳（可定期重训）与接受/拒绝分布覆盖性（需主动探索）假设；IPW 方差与在线部署学习在_high-stakes_ 场景中的可行性受限，未来工作包括离线算法版本及非二元多动作设定；作者同时强调公平具情境依赖性，技术干预需结合领域知识与部署后监控。

title: One LR Doesn't Fit All: Heavy-Tail Guided Layerwise Learning Rates for LLMs
summary: Learning rate configuration is a fundamental aspect of modern deep learning. The prevailing practice of applying a uniform learning rate across all layers overlooks the structural heterogeneity of Transformers, potentially limiting their effectiveness as the backbone of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we introduce Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR), an adaptive scheme that assigns distinct learning rates to individual Transformer layers. Our method is grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which characterizes the empirical spectral density (ESD) of weight correlation matrices to quantify heavy-tailedness. Layers with weaker heavy-tailedness are assigned larger learning rates to accelerate their training, while layers with stronger heavy-tailedness receive smaller learning rates. By tailoring learning rates in this manner, LLR promotes balanced training across layers, leading to faster convergence and improved generalization. Extensive experiments across architectures (from LLaMA to GPT-nano), optimizers (AdamW and Muon), and parameter scales (60M-1B) demonstrate that LLR achieves up to 1.5x training speedup and outperforms baselines, notably raising average zero-shot accuracy from 47.09% to 49.02%. A key advantage of LLR is its low tuning overhead: it transfers nearly optimal LR settings directly from the uniform baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Heavy-Tailed自正则化理论的层级学习率分配策略LLR，通过谱密度分析量化Transformer各层重尾性，动态调整各层学习率以实现平衡训练，在多种架构和规模下实现1.5倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: 均匀学习率忽略Transformer各层间的结构异质性，可能限制LLM训练效果；现有方法多针对CNN设计，对Transformer层级特性缺乏考虑
AI.method: HT-SR理论量化权重相关性矩阵的谱密度(ESD)来表征重尾性；根据层间重尾性差异分配不同学习率——重尾性越弱的层分配越大学习率以加速训练，重尾性越强的层分配更小学习率
AI.result: 在LLaMA到GPT-nano等多种架构、AdamW和Muon优化器、60M-1B参数规模的实验中获得最高1.5倍训练加速，零样本准确率从47.09%提升至49.02%
AI.conclusion: LLR transfers nearly optimal LR settings directly from uniform baseline, achieves up to 1.5x training speedup, and improves zero-shot accuracy from 47.09% to 49.02%, making it a low-tuning-overhead method for training Transformers.

title: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
summary: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years. This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality. Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles. They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 4.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability. Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed. They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE. Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文解析地求解了连续版 Mountain Car（36 年悬案未决）的最优控制，得到形式极简的最优策略 π(x,v)=C·v（并给出含边界/墙约束的"解析最坏情形策略" π_ana，平均回报 99.39，逼近理论上界 100）；据此提出"Chebyshev 策略"——用多元 Chebyshev 多项式基参数化高斯策略的均值/方差，作为 MLP 策略的即插即用替代品：在 Mountain Car 上把 regret 降低 6.18 倍（PPO 下 4.24 倍），可训练参数少 277 倍（4355→约16），并在 Pendulum 与 Quanser Aero 2 真机平台上稳定优于 MLP。
AI.motivation: 1) RL 在真实世界的落地仍受制于 Dulac-Arnold 等总结的九大挑战（样本效率、可解释性/可审计性、实时性、训练稳定性等），且对训练动力学、隐式正则化等理论基础理解不足；作者主张"回到第一性原理"——对物理形式典型的低维控制任务先求出解析最优解，再从中反推应有策略结构。2) Mountain Car（Moore, 1990）是探索延迟奖励的经典基准，但自其提出 36 年来从未有已知的解析最优解，因此"当前 SOTA 距离最优有多远"这一根本问题悬而未决。3) 从最优解的简洁性出发，作者认为低维控制的最优策略极为简单，通用神经网络（MLP）策略类可能在归纳偏置/过拟合上带来系统性次优，因此需要一种更具几何结构先验、更轻量、可解释且可实时推理的通用逼近器。
AI.method: 【一、Mountain Car 解析最优解（3 步法）】将离散 MDP 化为连续时间问题 ẍ=a_max·α−g·cos(3x)，并作空间化重构：(1) 引入势能 U(x)，由能量守恒 dE/dt=0 套用非线性振子定理（Königsberger 2004），无动作时车辆等价于数学摆（在 x̂=−π/6 处势能最低），解为第一类不完全椭圆积分；(2) 定义"冲程"(stroke) 与解卷空间变量 ξ(t)=x0+∫|ẋ|dτ，把时域动作转成空间作用场 ã(ξ)，损失化为 ℓ=∫(ã(ξ)/(−2U(ξ))^{1/4})²dξ，结合 Cauchy–Schwarz 变体引理 2.3 证明：所有到达目标的最小损失动作必为 α(t)=C·ẋ(t)，即策略 π(x,v)=C·v（与 x 无关），常数 C 由等式条件 (5) 定出；(3) 重新施加约束（|v|≤v_max、左墙非弹性反弹 t*=≤999），枚举冲程数 k，分"单相"（不撞墙）与"双相"（撞墙后重置为 (x_min,0) 再单冲程上顶）两类，得每个 k 的最优 C_{1,k}, C_{2,k}，数值搜索表明双相严格优于单相（x0=−0.6：99.63 vs 99.46），且最优解总是以零速度撞墙、零速度抵达目标（C_2=4.8358）。针对 MDP 期望回报，定义"解析最坏情形策略" π_ana(x,v)=sign(v)·max(C(x,v)|v|, α_boot)，C=4.8358（二相区域）/4.8346 其它区域，x̂ 附近用 α_boot=0.1 破除平衡点退化，得回报 99.15–99.52；用 Matlab fmincon 离散优化在第三个小数位上确认连续解即为离散最优（差值小于时间离散化误差）。【二、Chebyshev 策略】推广多元 Chebyshev 多项式 T_{d1..dn}(x)=∏T_{d_i}(x_i)（d_i≤d），在加权 L²_w（权重 (1−x²)^{−1/2}）下证明其加权正交归一且构成 P_d^n（维数 (d+1)^n）的正交归一基，从而在 max-degree≤d 的子空间上稠密于连续策略空间（universal/dense）；用两个（PPO 另加 critic 共三个）多元 Chebyshev 多项式分别参数化高斯策略的 μ(s) 与 σ(s)，在 PyTorch 中实现为 MLP 的即插即用替代；σ 用较低次数 d≤3 且初始化为 1，其余系数小随机初始化 ±10⁻³；用多元 Horner 方案求值，仅需 (d+1)^n−1 次乘加。【三、实验】Mountain Car（100 个均匀 x0∈[−0.6,−0.4]）、Pendulum-v1（50×50 起始状态）、Quanser Aero 2 直升机式真实平台（1-DOF、非线性动力学、仿真训练→真机零样本迁移）；对比 PPO / ARS / REINFORCE / SAC，每组训练 20（或12）个种子取最优者；另做 PPO 隐层规模消融、REINFORCE×8 优化器×6 架构共 960 次的 MLP 失败实验、以及次数 d=1…50 的维度诅咒实验。
AI.result: 【Mountain Car】π_ana 回报 99.39（99.15–99.52），已知 x0 的 π_opt,x0 为 99.59，接近平凡上界 100。SOTA 遗憾极高：ARS 96.67（r=2.72，最低 92.51）、SAC 94.61（r=4.78）、PPO 93.91（r=5.48）、DDPG 93.51、TD3 93.48、TRPO 92.49、A2C 91.16、TQC 61.14。Chebyshev 策略全面胜出：CH-3-ARS 98.95（r=0.44，遗憾降 6.18×）、CH-3-REI 98.62（r=0.77）、CH-3-PPO 98.10（r=1.29，降 4.24×）；标准差亦更小、与 π_ana 的 L2 距离更近（0.068–0.152 vs 0.21–0.43）。反直觉结果：经典 REINFORCE 配 MLP 在 960 次训练中几乎全部无法求解（仅个别低分），配 Chebyshev 却成功且优于所有 MLP 策略；PPO 缩小网络（[32,32]、[64] 等）反而更差，说明并非容量不足而是策略类/归纳偏置问题。参数 4355→约 16（277×），Horner 求值 (d+1)^n−1 次乘加，利于嵌入式实时执行。【Pendulum】CH-6-ARS −150.8 vs ARS −218.3；CH-5-PPO −162.8 vs PPO −176.2（CH-3-REI −466.3 明显落后）；最优 MLP 为 SAC −147.2。【Aero 2 仿真】CH-3-PPO −49.2 vs PPO −84.6、CH-3-ARS −125.2 vs ARS −721.8（ARS-MLP 几乎失控）；CH-3-PPO 功率消耗 1.65 W vs PPO 37.05 W，消除了 PPO 学到的 bang-bang 控制（该策略导致电机显著发热，需插入冷却）。【Aero 2 真机】CH-3-PPO 俯仰偏差 0.0279 rad（real/sim=1.134）vs PPO 0.0910 rad（2.151），真机上偏差改善 3.3×；CH-3-ARS 0.0821（1.312）vs ARS 0.3592（0.995）；CH-3-PPO 功率 0.50 W vs PPO 52.6 W。【稳健性】次数 d=4~20 时回报稳定且优于所有神经 SOTA，d≥30 起部分智能体不再到达目标、方差增大、吞吐从 61 步/s 降至 4 步/s，REINFORCE 在 d=10 即失败，呈现明显维度灾难。【附带的基准改进建议】左墙右移可把最优解从双相变回单相；将 v_max 由 0.07 降至 0.05 可让速度约束生效、丰富任务难度；左墙置于 [−0.651, 0.310] 区间时问题不可行。
AI.conclusion: 1) 36 年悬案首次闭合：连续版 Mountain Car 的最优控制具有"极简"结构 α(t)=C·ẋ(t)（本质为"螺旋"型状态空间轨迹、以零速度抵达目标以避免多余动能），而现代 RL 智能体存在出人意料的大遗憾，说明瓶颈不在网络容量而在探索、算法与策略参数化的归纳偏置。2) 由此提出的 Chebyshev 策略是一个从第一性原理导出的通用（稠密于连续策略空间）轻量策略类：正交归一基带来好的采样效率与训练稳定性，(d+1)^n 的基函数规模使参数与计算量远低于 MLP，同时天然具备可解释性、实时推理与嵌入式部署优势，可作为神经网络的替代或补充，直接回应真实世界 RL 的样本效率、可解释性、可审计性、实时性与训练稳定性等挑战。3) 局限：基函数数量随维度呈组合爆炸（n 为几十至几百的现代控制/人形机器人场景受限）；一致（均匀）收敛是双刃剑——与 MLP 的分层架构相比，Chebyshev 策略难以针对状态空间重要区域差异化分配容量，因而在类 bang-bang / 滑模控制的场景下 MLP 仍更合适；高次数时出现数值与训练稳定性问题。4) 作者建议未来方向：构建 MLP 与 Chebyshev 表征层的混合架构（使二者互为特例），并呼吁把解析洞察更深入地融入 RL，以期在安全攸关的机器人、能源管理、自动系统中落地更可信的决策控制。

title: From Patches to Trajectories: Privileged Process Supervision for Software-Engineering Agents
summary:
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long teacher trajectories is the dominant way to instill investigation and reasoning in open software-engineering (SWE) agents. Since every retained response becomes an imitation target, the student inherits the final outcome and intermediate flaws, including ungrounded leaps and redundant loops. High-quality training data must be effective(each step is grounded and narrows the agent's epistemic gap to the correct fix) and efficient(each step is information-bearing rather than redundant or looping). Existing recipes filter or relabel teacher rollouts using only a binary terminal verifier, which does not directly target these axes and provides no supervision on instances where the teacher fails.
  Most real issue includes a developer-authored reference patch, $p^\star$, revealing the file paths, runtime behaviors, and coding conventions presupposed by the correct fix, yet standard pipelines discard it. We propose Patches-to-Trajectories (P2T), which uses $p^\star$ as privileged information during curation and formulates trajectory construction as bi-objective optimization over per-step effectiveness and trajectory length. A reverse phase distills $p^\star$ into a latent process graph, $G^\star$, of contextual facts and solution milestones. A forward phase curates trajectories from blinded teacher continuations by scoring per-step progress against $G^\star$ under a leakage-blocking groundedness check and retaining the shortest effective segments.
  Using only 1.8k curated SWE-Gym instances, P2T improves effectiveness and efficiency over outcome-filtered SFT and its tool-error-masking variant. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises Pass@1 by up to 10.8 points while reducing per-instance inference cost by ~15%, with consistent gains on SWE-bench Lite. Size-matched ablations and qualitative analysis further isolate trajectory quality from data scale.

AI.tldr: P2T是一种利用参考补丁作为特权信息进行轨迹精选的方法，通过反向阶段从补丁中蒸馏出过程图G*，前向阶段基于G*进行每步接地检查和最短有效片段筛选。该方法仅用1.8k精选数据即可显著提升SWE-bench表现并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有监督微调（SFT）方法使用二元终态验证器过滤或重标记教师 rollout，导致学生 agent 继承中间步骤中的不合理跳跃和冗余循环。现有的数据筛选方法未能直接优化步骤级别的有效性和效率，也无法为教师失败的实例提供监督信号。
AI.method: P2T将轨迹构建形式化为基于每步有效性和轨迹长度的双目标优化问题。反向阶段将参考补丁蒸馏为隐式过程图G*（包含上下文事实和解决方案里程碑）；前向阶段通过基于G*的逐步进展评分和泄漏阻断的接地检查来筛选轨迹，保留最短的有效片段。
AI.result: 仅使用1.8k个精选的SWE-Gym实例，P2T在有效性和效率上均超越了基于结果过滤的SFT及其工具错误掩码变体。在SWE-bench Verified上Pass@1提升最高10.8个百分点，每实例推理成本降低约15%，SWE-bench Lite也有一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: P2T在SWE-bench Verified上将Pass@1提升最多10.8个百分点，同时将每实例推理成本降低约15%，在SWE-bench Lite上也有一致性提升。规模匹配的消融实验和质量分析进一步证明了轨迹质量的核心作用。

title: Riemannian geometry meets fMRI: the advantages of modeling correlation manifolds and eigenvector subspaces
summary: Correlation matrices are fundamental summaries of functional brain networks, yet standard analyses often treat entries independently, ignoring the curved geometry of correlation space. Existing geometric methods frequently lack closed-form operations or depend on arbitrary region ordering, limiting scalability. We introduce a scalable geometric framework with two components: (i) the Off-log metric, a smooth transformation mapping correlation matrices to symmetric zero-diagonal matrices. This enables closed-form expressions for distances, Frechet means, and linear models, allowing standard statistical modeling without complex manifold optimization. (ii) Grassmannian subspace discrimination, which compares subjects via principal-angle distances between eigenvector subspaces, resolving inherent sign and basis ambiguities. Both components integrate into standard machine-learning workflows for inference, regression, and classification. Validated across two clinical cohorts (Parkinson's and psychosis) and three ageing fMRI datasets, the Off-log metric increased sensitivity in permutation tests and matched or exceeded Riemannian and Euclidean baselines in classification. Brain-age prediction performance was comparable, with Riemannian metrics excelling in two of three cohorts. The Grassmannian method consistently outperformed Euclidean baselines, highlighting disease-relevant networks. Overall, geometry-aware representations improve sensitivity and predictive performance while remaining straightforward to deploy at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套可扩展的"几何化"fMRI 功能连接分析框架，包含两个部件：(1) Off–log 度量——将相关矩阵经矩阵对数并去对角后平滑双射到"空心对称矩阵"空间，再拉回 Frobenius 内积，从而得到置换不变、log-Euclidean 型且具闭式距离/Fréchet 均值/线性模型的几何，可直接套用常规统计与机器学习流程；(2) Grassmannian 子空间判别——用主角度距离比较图拉普拉斯特征向量张成的子空间，规避特征向量的符号与基旋转歧义。在 2 个临床队列（帕金森病、非情感性精神病）与 3 个老龄化 fMRI 数据集上验证：Off–log 提升置换检验敏感性并在分类上匹配或超过 Riemann/Euclidean 基线；Grassmannian 判别稳定优于 Euclidean/LDA 基线并定位到疾病相关网络；脑龄预测表现与基线相当（ECM 在 3 个队列中 2 个更优）。
AI.motivation: 静息态 fMRI 的功能连接通常由相关矩阵（Cor⁺(n) ⊂ Sym⁺(n)）概括，但标准分析把矩阵元素当作独立变量处理，忽略了相关空间本身的弯曲几何：欧氏平均往往落在流形之外，统计推断和机器学习也建立在错误的线性假设上。已有几何方法各有缺陷：SPD 流形上的仿射不变度量（AIRM）在做普通矩阵运算时会破坏单位对角；真正适配相关矩阵的商仿射度量（QAM）缺乏闭式表达式，维度高时计算难以承受；而基于 Cholesky 分解的 ECM/LEC 虽有闭式解，却依赖变量（脑区）的任意排列顺序，缺乏置换不变性。这些限制使几何方法难以规模化落地。此外，在涉及特征分解的分析中（PCA/ICA、图拉普拉斯谐波），特征向量的符号翻转与简并特征值下的基旋转是人为不变量，直接把特征向量当作欧氏向量会引入虚假变异，而这一「子空间」视角在神经影像中几乎未被利用。
AI.method: ① 相关矩阵几何：用 Off–log 双射 Log_off(C)=Off(log C)=log C − Diag(diag(log C)) 将相关矩阵映到对称零对角空间 Hol(n)，逆映射 Exp_off(S)=exp(S+D(S))（D(S) 由 diag(exp(S+D))=1 隐式确定，存在唯一，迭代求解）。在 Hol(n) 上拉回 Frobenius 内积得到 Off–log 度量：d_off(C1,C2)=‖Log_off(C2)−Log_off(C1)‖_F，测地线与 Fréchet 均值退化为 Off–log 坐标中的直线与算术平均。该结构被证明使 Cor⁺(n) 成为 log-Euclidean 交换 Lie 群（运算 ⋆），度量在单位元处等于 Frobenius 内积且双不变，故单位元处的切空间即 Lie 代数，提供全局坐标而非局部近似；同时保持置换不变性。② 分析任务：以 Biswas–Ghosh 两样本置换检验（1000 次置换）比较原始相关矩阵与 Off–log 切空间投影；脑龄回归用 Elastic Net + 折内 PCA + 嵌套 5 折 CV（MAE、R²）；分类用线性 SVM（ANOVA F 特征选择、z-score、嵌套 5 折，AUC 调参），对比 Raw、Off–log、ECM、LEC。③ Grassmannian 判别：由相关矩阵构造加权邻接矩阵（负边置零、20% 稀疏化阈值），计算归一化图拉普拉斯 L=I−D^{-1/2}WD^{-1/2}，按间隙谱 g_j=λ_{j+1}−λ_j 确定低频子空间维数 k，取每被试前 k 个特征向量作为 Gr(k,n) 上一点；用主角度（UᵀV 的 SVD）与 d²_G=Σθ² 定义距离，Karcher 流迭代求各类 Fréchet 均值作为初始中心，最大化 Fisher 型比值 D_B/(D_W+ε)，新样本按最近中心判别，5 折嵌套 CV，并与同样特征上的 LDA 比较。数据：cam-CAN(627)、HCPAging(599)、NKI(894)（Schaefer 200 分割）做脑龄；DataPD（20 PD/17 HC，Schaefer 400）与 DataNAP（60 NAP/57 HC，Glasser 360）做分类与置换检验。
AI.result: 置换检验：DataPD 中 Off–log 切空间表示显著（p=0.01）而原始相关矩阵不显著（p=0.37）；DataNAP 两种表示均 p<0.001。分类（表2）：Off–log 在所有指标上最佳——DataPD 准确率 0.693/AUC 0.762（Raw 0.461/0.517，ECM 0.532/0.592，LEC 0.536/0.567）；DataNAP 准确率 0.701/AUC 0.812（Raw 0.657/0.766）。脑龄（表1）：cam-CAN 原始最好（MAE 6.782，R² 0.783；Off–log 6.968/0.768；ECM 7.170/0.698），HCP-Aging 与 NKI 则 ECM 最佳（5.280/0.794 与 6.380/0.787），Off–log 与原始相当、略逊于 ECM，说明切空间化不损害预测但收益依任务而异。Grassmannian 判别（表3）稳定优于 LDA 基线：DataPD 准确率 0.693 vs 0.543（LDA 敏感度 1.0/特异度 0.0，退化为全判阳性），DataNAP 0.692 vs 0.463（敏感度 0.767 vs 0.583）。判别区域与已知疾病网络一致：PD 集中于显著性网络与边缘系统，NAP 集中于下顶叶皮层、后扣带、外侧颞叶、下额叶与背外侧前额叶。
AI.conclusion: 把 fMRI 相关矩阵当作流形上的点（而非无约束欧氏向量）、把谱信息当作子空间（而非有序基），可在敏感性、稳定性与下游预测性能上带来可测的增益，且因 Off–log 的闭式/置换不变/双不变性质，无需复杂流形优化即可嵌入现有统计与机器学习流水线。作者强调方法论层面的权衡：切空间投影便宜但仅局部近似（数据离散度大时会低估距离并引入偏差），流形原生方法（如 Grassmannian 判别）更忠实但计算更重，且切空间化本身并不保证下游性能提升——最优几何表示依赖任务（分类倾向 Off–log，脑龄回归倾向 ECM/原始）。局限包括：临床样本量偏小、基线模型刻意简化（线性 SVM/Elastic Net）、矩阵对数/指数要求满秩（秩亏时需正则化或收缩）、跨队列/分割/预处理流程的泛化性尚未验证，未来需更大规模多中心评估以及核 SVM、GNN、流形神经网络等更具表达力的模型检验「几何×模型容量」交互。

title: Learning Causal Orderings for In-Context Tabular Prediction
summary:
In-context learning for tabular data sets strong predictive standards in observational settings; it however primarily relies on correlational structure, which becomes unreliable under distribution shift or intervention. While established methods to discover causal structure exist, they are often focused on structure identifiability and decoupled from the predictive architectures that could benefit from them.
  To bridge these perspectives, we study how to simultaneously infer and enforce causal structure in the form of topological variable orderings into tabular prediction. Unlike standard architectures, our model TabOrder uses causal order-constrained attention, basing predictions only on features that precede a target under a learned causal order. Similar to causal discovery methods, TabOrder learns the optimal variable ordering in an unsupervised manner through a likelihood-based objective. We justify this choice under standard functional model classes and also study how sample missingness, a common challenge in tabular data, interacts with causal direction identification. Empirically, we confirm that TabOrder recovers accurate variable orderings while addressing prediction and imputation tasks, as well as gives insight into real-world biological data under intervention.

AI.tldr: TabOrder bridges causal discovery and tabular prediction by integrating causal variable orderings into neural architectures through order-constrained attention, learned unsupervised via likelihood-based objectives, with empirical validation on prediction/imputation tasks and biological intervention data.
AI.motivation: In-context learning for tabular data relies on correlational structure, which becomes unreliable under distribution shift or intervention. Existing causal discovery methods focus on structure identifiability but are decoupled from predictive architectures. A gap exists between causal structure discovery and prediction models that could benefit from causal knowledge.
AI.method: TabOrder uses causal order-constrained attention, basing predictions only on features preceding a target under a learned causal order. The optimal variable ordering is learned unsupervised through a likelihood-based objective, justified under standard functional model classes. The paper also studies how sample missingness interacts with causal direction identification.
AI.result: TabOrder recovers accurate variable orderings while effectively addressing prediction and imputation tasks, and provides insight into real-world biological data under intervention.
AI.conclusion: TabOrder successfully bridges causal discovery and predictive modeling, achieving accurate variable orderings while addressing prediction and imputation tasks, with insights into biological data under intervention.

title: Physics-Informed Generative Solver: Bridging Data-Driven Priors and Conservation Laws for Stable Spatiotemporal Field Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing continuous physical fields from sparse measurements is a central inverse problem, but data-driven generative models can produce states that violate governing dynamics. We introduce a physics-informed generative solver that separates stable prior learning from inference-time enforcement of conservation laws. Martingale-Regularized Score Matching regularizes score pretraining with a Score Fokker-Planck constraint, yielding a dynamically stable prior. Physics-Informed Implicit Score Sampling then guides denoising trajectories by gradients of physical residuals, projecting samples toward admissible manifolds without retraining. In acoustics, the method co-generates pressure and particle velocity from sparse sensors, enabling dense virtual arrays that suppress spatial aliasing. The same framework generalizes to real-world ERA5 meteorological fields under extreme sparsity. Together, this work establishes a rigorous and generalizable paradigm for solving high-dimensional inverse problems, bridging the gap between generative artificial intelligence and first-principles science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息生成求解器，通过将稳定先验学习与推理时物理守恒律 enforcement 分离，解决稀疏测量下的连续物理场重建问题，在声学和气象领域验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏测量重建连续物理场是一个核心逆问题，但数据驱动的生成模型可能产生违反物理守恒律的状态，因此需要在保持生成能力的同时强制物理约束。
AI.method: Martingale-Regularized Score Matching：使用Score Fokker-Planck约束正则化分数预训练，获得动态稳定先验；Physics-Informed Implicit Score Sampling：利用物理残差梯度引导去噪轨迹，将样本投影到可行流形上，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在声学领域实现了从稀疏传感器共同生成压力场和粒子速度场，支持密集虚拟阵列并抑制空间混叠；在极端稀疏条件下成功泛化到真实ERA5气象场。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为解决高维逆问题建立了严格且可泛化的范式，弥合了生成式AI与第一性原理科学之间的鸿沟。在声学虚拟阵列和气象ERA5数据上都验证了方法的有效性。

title: From Snapshots to Trajectories: Learning Single-Cell Gene Expression Dynamics via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) provides high-dimensional profiles of cellular states, enabling data-driven modeling of cellular dynamics over time. In practice, time-resolved scRNA-seq is collected at only a few discrete time points as unpaired snapshot populations, leaving substantial temporal gaps. This motivates trajectory inference at unmeasured time points. Existing methods mainly follow two directions, optimal-transport (OT) alignment provides distribution-level matching between observed snapshots, while continuous-time generative models support forecasting via learned dynamics. However, two challenges remain: (i) unpaired snapshots render local transitions between adjacent time points ambiguous, leading to unstable supervision; and (ii) long-horizon prediction relies on repeated integration, where small modeling errors compound and cause distribution drift. To address these challenges, we propose single-cell Flow Matching (scFM), a latent generative framework based on coupling-conditioned flow matching. First, we compute entropically regularized OT couplings between adjacent snapshots and use them to construct soft, weighted flow-matching targets for learning time-dependent velocity fields. Second, we learn bidirectional velocity fields and leverage their consistency to refine couplings and improve temporal coherence under sparse supervision. Third, we introduce distribution-level alignment and latent dynamic regularization to anchor long rollouts and mitigate drift. Experiments on real-world time-series scRNA-seq datasets show that scFM consistently improves distributional prediction performance for both temporal interpolation and extrapolation. Moreover, scFM yields more accurate trajectory reconstruction and temporally coherent visualizations where intermediate time points are absent, indicating a more faithful recovery of underlying temporal gene expression dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出scFM框架，通过耦合条件化流匹配解决单细胞轨迹推断中不成对快照监督不稳定和长时预测误差累积两大挑战，在真实数据集上验证了其优越的分布预测和轨迹重建能力
AI.motivation: 时间分辨单细胞RNA测序数据仅在少数离散时间点采样（不成对快照），导致：①相邻时间点间的局部转换模糊，不稳定监督；②长时程预测需重复积分，小误差累积导致分布漂移
AI.method: single-cell Flow Matching (scFM)，基于耦合条件化流匹配框架，包含三个核心组件：①使用熵正则化最优传输计算相邻快照间的耦合，作为软加权流匹配目标；②学习双向速度场并利用一致性约束改进耦合与时间一致性；③引入分布级对齐与潜在动态正则化锚定长时程预测
AI.result: 在真实时间序列scRNA-seq数据集中，scFM显著提升分布预测性能（插值和外推），实现更精确的轨迹重建和时间一致的流形可视化，能忠实恢复缺失时间点的基因表达动态
AI.conclusion: scFM provides a unified framework that simultaneously addresses coupling refinement, sparse supervision, and long-horizon drift in trajectory inference for scRNA-seq data.

title: A Boundary-Layer Mechanism for One-Third Scaling in Online Softmax Classification
summary: Hard-label classification is usually trained with smooth surrogate losses, most prominently softmax cross-entropy. We isolate an asymptotic mechanism by which this mismatch between smooth surrogate and discrete labels produces power-law learning curves in an online teacher-student model. After subtracting the mean logit, the thermodynamic-limit dynamics close in centered variables: a growing centered student-teacher alignment $D$ and the residual student variance $Δ$. At late times, examples away from teacher decision boundaries are already classified confidently and contribute exponentially little. Only boundary layers of width $O(D^{-1})$ remain active, while the noise of fixed-learning-rate online gradient descent maintains a nonzero $Δ$. As a function of the training time $α$ the late-time solution yields a $α^{-1/3}$ power law not only for the test loss but also for the generalization error $ε_g$, i.e., one minus test accuracy. This is much slower than the $α^{-1}$ Bayes-optimal reference for the same model. We further show that learning-rate schedules can improve the generalization error towards a $ε_g \sim α^{-1/2}$ power law. Simulations support the predicted order parameter dynamics and learning curves. Controlled experiments with correlated Gaussian inputs and whitened pretrained features show that data structure can dominate transients. Therefore, our result is an asymptotic, complementary mechanism rather than an alternative to spectral explanations of neural scaling laws.

AI.tldr: 本文给出一个不依赖数据谱的"边界层"机制，解释在线 softmax 交叉熵训练硬标签分类器时为何出现 1/3 次幂学习曲线：中心化后只有教师决策边界附近宽度 O(D^-1) 的样本仍对宏观流有贡献，边界层漂移给出 D∝α^(1/3)；固定学习率下在线 SGD 噪声维持残差方差 Δ 的噪声地板，使测试损失与泛化误差（1−准确率）都满足 α^(-1/3)，而学习率退火可把误差指数改善到 α^(-1/2)。该机制是渐近的、与谱解释互补而非替代。
AI.motivation: 经验缩放定律通常由数据/特征协方差的幂律谱解释（核/随机特征/线性模型），但也可能存在非谱机制。硬标签（离散 argmax）却用平滑代理损失（softmax 交叉熵）训练，这种"标签-损失不匹配"本身可能产生幂律学习曲线。Liu et al.
