(2026) 已表明 softmax/交叉熵在学习尖锐分布时测试损失有 1/3 时间缩放，但其可解 ansatz 令学生与教师完全对齐，学生与教师决策边界完全相同、分类误差恒为零，因而无法预测分类误差如何下降；而对分类任务而言准确率/泛化误差比交叉熵更直接地反映决策性能，且两者指数未必相同（参见 Hestness 2017、Zhai 2022 关于 ImageNet top-1 误差近 1/3 指数的报告，以及 LLM 中 token top-1 误差与 logit 排序、rank-entropy 分解的讨论）。因此本文聚焦的问题是：在线多分类中，当标签离散而学生通过可微概率训练时，什么控制晚期学习动力学？作者希望在一个可解析的 K 类 teacher–student 模型中隔离并严格化这一机制，明确区分"损失 1/3 律"与"误差 1/3 律"的物理来源。
AI.method: 模型：单层学生（K 个 logit）+ K 个正交教师向量，高斯输入 ξ~N(0,I_N)，教师 argmax 产生硬标签，在线 SGD（批大小 b）最小化交叉熵 −log p_y；宏观时间 α=μ/N，先取 N→∞ 热力学极限再取 α→∞（假设 A1–A7，含置换对称 ansatz）。方法论为统计物理学习论的标准序参量/重叠方法（Opper–Haussler、Biehl–Riegler、Saad–Solla）。核心技巧是减去平均 logit（softmax 对共同平移不变）以消除冗余，引入中心化序参量 D=R−S（中心化学生-教师对齐）、Q_eff=Q−C（中心化学生范数）、Δ=Q_eff−D²（学生正交于教师方向的残差方差），并把中心化 logit 写成联合高斯表示 h_a=D(u_a−ū)+√Δ(z_a−z̄)。主要结果：(1) Lemma 1 给出精确的中心化宏观闭合（Ď、Q̇_eff、Δ̇，含 η²/b 噪声项）；(2) Lemma 2 证明全局进入 D→∞、Δ 有界的晚期区（通过源项与收缩项比较、漂移严格正的紧致性论证），并给出启发式进入尺度 α*；(3) Theorem 3 给出对 Δ∈[0,M] 一致的边界层展开：边界密度 c_K=∫φ(s)²Φ(s)^{K−2}ds，局部二值化 u_a−u_b=x/D、h_a−h_b=x+δ、δ=√(2Δ)z，核函数 A_0…A_2、B_0 及 B(Δ)，得到 Ď∝D^{-2}(π²/6+Δ)、Δ̇∝D^{-1}[(η²/b)B(Δ)−2ηΔ]、L_g∝D^{-1}(π²/6+Δ)、ε_g=Γ_K√Δ/D+O(Δ/D²)（含显式余项）；(4) Corollary 4 固定学习率：Δ→唯一不动点 Δ*（2Δ*=(η/b)B(Δ*)），D³∝α，损失与误差均为 α^{-1/3}；梯度流极限（去掉噪声项）下 Δ 呈 exp(−cα^{2/3}) 衰减、误差超幂律衰减而损失保持 α^{-1/3}；(5) Corollary 5/Proposition 6：幂律调度 η(α)=η0(1+α/α0)^{−γ} 的绝热跟踪条件，Δ∼κη/b、D³∝H(α)=∫η，误差 α^{-(2+γ)/6}→1/2（γ→1⁻），损失变慢为 α^{-(1−γ)/3}；γ=1 时跟踪失效（Δ/η→∞，误差慢于任意幂），γ>1 时 D 饱和、损失与误差趋于非零常数。附录 A 给出全部证明与余项；附录 B 用 erf 学生的二值 MSE 模型作同类机制的暖场验证。数值验证（附录 C）：有限 N 的 K 类 teacher–student 模拟（固定率、调度、K 依赖、批大小依赖、边界层定位诊断）、相关高斯输入（谱 ∝ i^{-β}）、白化 ViT 特征上 CIFAR-5M 的非高斯特征实验、MNIST MLP 上的 SGD、Pythia 模型的 token top-1 误差拟合；附录 D 给出 Zipf 分布子任务的聚合模型。
AI.result: 理论：固定学习率下 D∝α^{1/3}、Q_eff∝α^{2/3}、Δ→Δ* 噪声地板，测试损失 L_g∝α^{-1/3}、泛化误差 ε_g∝α^{-1/3}（精确前因子 Γ_K=K(K−1)c_K/√π，边界密度 c_K 给出全部 K 依赖），远慢于同模型的 Bayes 最优 α^{-1}。误差律是纯在线噪声效应：去掉噪声源项后损失仍为 α^{-1/3}（与 Liu et al. 2026 一致），而误差超幂律衰减。退火调度使 ε_g∝α^{-(2+γ)/6}，γ→1⁻ 时逼近 α^{-1/2}（与平滑代理损失一致性理论的平方根行为呼应），但损失同时变慢为 α^{-(1−γ)/3}；γ=1 为奇异边界（误差比任何幂都慢），γ>1 时出现饱和地板。数值：K=3, N=500 的模拟在指数与前因子上与理论吻合；K=5…100 的指数普适而前因子依赖 K，且 K 越大过渡越晚（D≫√(2 log K)）；增大批大小 b 降低 Δ* 与误差前因子（∝b^{-1/2}）但不改变指数；边界层诊断显示误差与对齐驱动梯度随 D 增大而向 D^{-1} 尺度集中；相关高斯输入主要改变瞬态（更长的过渡），晚期衰减不变；白化 ViT 特征（教师标签）保持类似图像但真实标签更早触底，作者承认为模型局限；MNIST 上 SGD 的测试损失与泛化误差均与 1/3 指数相容；Pythia token top-1 误差在所选窗口呈幂律加地板，12B 模型指数与 1/3 相容，两个较小模型略陡（原因未定），且该时间坐标 H(α)/η^{3/2} 仅为启发式。Zipf 聚合：总误差 ∝t^{−min{1/3,c_ν}}（c_ν=1−1/ν），ν=3/2 时出现对数因子；重尾会掩盖 1/3 指数，但分任务/受限覆盖的学生仍呈现 1/3，超额误差呈"幂律+地板"形式。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出一个严格（带显式假设与余项）且数值验证的"边界层"机制，说明硬标签 softmax 交叉熵的在线多分类学习中，1/3 次幂缩放可纯粹由决策边界几何 + 随机优化噪声产生，无需结构化输入谱：损失由确定性边界层宽度 1/D 控制（梯度流下依然成立），误差则由更窄的噪声-信号夹角 √Δ/D 控制（纯在线 SGD 效应，故学习率调度能分离并改善误差指数）。作者明确将本工作定位为渐近的、补充性的解释，而非对谱解释或数据统计解释的替代；并指出局限（单层固定特征、在线单遍、高斯输入、无噪声硬标签、置换对称）以及未来方向：软教师/带噪标签的中心化闭合以联系 Bayes 误差地板、动量对噪声项的修正、特征学习架构中读出层边界层动力学与表示演化的耦合。附录 D 的覆盖受限模型为 Pythia 等实际训练中"幂律+地板"拟合提供了可能的解释，但也强调聚合拟合本身不能证明 Pythia 已进入该机制。

title: Partial Fusion of Neural Networks: Efficient Tradeoffs Between Ensembles and Weight Aggregation
summary: Ensembles of neural networks typically outperform individual networks but incur large computational costs, whereas weight aggregation produces less costly, yet also less accurate, aggregate models. We introduce partial fusion of networks, which interpolates between ensembles and weight aggregation and thus allows for a flexible tradeoff between computational cost and performance. A direct way to achieve this is to extend existing weight aggregation methods based on neuron-level similarity between different networks, where partial fusion then only aggregates weights of neurons which are most similar. We showcase one particular method to jointly identify which neurons are most similar and match them via partial optimal transport. Further, we consider the more general perspective of weight aggregation and partial fusion as generalized pruning of ensemble models, where neurons cannot just be deleted, but also linearly combined. Finally, we show that generalized pruning applied to a single network yields similar benefits as partial fusion by allowing for a tradeoff between isolating, deleting, and linearly combining neurons based on similarity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Fabian-Mor/partial_fusion_nn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「部分融合（Partial Fusion）」：在权重聚合与集成之间做连续插值，只把最相似的神经元做线性平均、其余保持孤立，从而以远低于集成的参数量逼近集成精度；并将其实现为 Partial OT Fusion（基于部分最优传输 + 跨层不动点优化），同时提出更一般的「广义剪枝（Generalized Pruning）」视角（神经元可被删除或线性组合，具体用聚类实现），该视角同样适用于单模型压缩。实验（MLP/MNIST、VGG11 与 ResNet18/CIFAR10）显示：从权重聚合走向集成时，模型规模的适度增加即可带来不成比例的精度提升；聚类式广义剪枝在 MLP 上通常优于部分融合，而在 CNN 上部分融合更优；配合少量数据微调后，部分融合模型在所有 α 下都超过单个模型。
AI.motivation: 集成（ensemble）精度高但需同时保存多个模型，推理时延与显存开销成倍增加；权重聚合（weight averaging / OT Fusion、Git Re-Basin 等）在不增加推理成本的前提下得到更便宜但精度更低的单一模型。二者之间存在明显缺口：缺少一种可调的、可在「模型规模—精度」之间连续权衡的机制。已有方法的匹配要么是全排列式的（要求各层规模相同且全部神经元被对齐），要么基于数据驱动的再拟合，且缺乏对「哪些神经元真的可替代、哪些具有不可替代的独特功能」的刻画。作者观察到神经元级相似度在不同神经元间差异显著（部分神经元异常相似、部分异常独特），因此应当允许「只融合最相似的一部分神经元」，从而在权重聚合与集成之间开辟出一系列中间工作点。此外，从剪枝视角看，把集成模型压缩为小网络时，神经元不仅可以删除，还可以线性组合，这一自由度此前未被利用。
AI.method: 1) 形式化：设两网络 A、B，层间变换用随机核 K^{A→B}, K^{B→A} 表达，融合即 W^C_ℓ=(1−λ)W^B_ℓ+λ K^{A→B}_{ℓ+1} W^A_ℓ K^{B→A}_ℓ；λ 为插值因子。2) 部分融合（Sec. 2.2）：每层划分为「孤立部分 I」与「融合部分 F」，变换矩阵仅在 F 上定义，融合网络每层由 A 的孤立块、中间融合块、B 的孤立块三部分构成（权重矩阵含 7 个非零块）。极端情形：全部匹配→普通权重聚合；全部不匹配→集成；α 控制被孤立/融合的神经元比例。3) Partial OT Fusion（Sec. 2.4）：将层的神经元编码为离散概率分布（特征可用激活向量或权重矩阵），耦合 π 诱导随机核 K = π^T/μ_A 与 π/μ_B；用部分最优传输（Figalli 2010）求解 α-部分耦合（行/列和 ≤ 边际，总质量 = 1−α），未匹配的神经元即被孤立，部分匹配神经元按权重比例拆分为两个神经元（ReLU 下正齐次性保证等价，GELU 下近似）。4) 跨层全局优化（Sec. 2.5）：借鉴 Ainsworth et al. (2023)，令某层的特征依赖其他层的匹配（权重特征 x^A_ℓ = K^{A→B}_{ℓ+1} W^A_ℓ），把各层耦合联合优化；将平方距离目标改写为内积最大化后，全局目标对每个 K_ℓ 仍线性，于是每步迭代仍是一个（部分）最优传输问题，用投影坐标下降/不动点迭代求解（10 次外迭代，约 6 步收敛）。5) 广义剪枝视角（Sec. 2.3）：把「融合」看作对拼接集成模型 E 的广义剪枝，给定 E↔S 的双向往返变换 W^S_ℓ = K^{E→S}_{ℓ+1} W^E_ℓ K^{S→E}_ℓ；取 0/1 矩阵即退化为标准剪枝；部分融合是其中一个特例（只跨网络两两线性组合，具归纳偏置）。6) 具体广义剪枝方法（Sec. 2.4）：聚类目标 min_π ∫‖x−y‖²π(dx,dy)，第二边际未指定、支撑于 m 个簇中心（均匀边际下即 K-means 目标），实践中 Lloyd 算法表现差，改用随机化 Ward 层次聚类。7) 工程细节：CNN 中通道特征展平、flatten 层核的对角扩展；ResNet 中恒等捷径要求块首末层共享同一核（合并两块代价矩阵 C̃=C_{ℓ1}+C_{ℓr+1}）、投影捷径的独立核与 1×1 卷积权重的变换、BatchNorm 的 γ/β 由前向核合并而运行统计量重新前向计算（或用高斯假设下的余弦相似度方差公式启发式估计）。8) 参数计数分析：α=0.5 时部分融合非零参数为单模型的 1.75×，剪枝最省 1.125×，聚类在 1.125×~1.75× 间浮动；FLOPs 与实测 wall-clock 在大模型下吻合。
AI.result: MLP/MNIST 异质数据划分：Partial OT Fusion 中权重特征 + 不动点迭代最优，优于贪心与激活特征版本；神经元增加 20%~40% 已明显优于标准 OT Fusion（α=0.4 对应约 45% 参数增长，精度接近集成）。聚类式广义剪枝在大 α 时往往优于部分融合，但需近似求解 NP-hard 聚类问题；非结构化剪枝无单调性（λ=0.3 时甚至超过完整集成）。CNN/VGG11（CIFAR10，同数据）：部分融合明显优于聚类与剪枝——完全融合（α=0）时聚类降至 66.3%、非结构化剪枝仅 30.7%，而部分融合保持最好；α 增加 20% 神经元带来 1.8 个百分点提升。ResNet18 消融：完全 OT 融合的性能强依赖训练超参（300 epochs/不同 weight decay 时 λ=0.5 掉到约 80%），但部分融合在两种设置下都保持单调插值。宽度分析（MLP 25→400）：窄网络从孤立神经元获益更大（宽度 25：α=0 为 64.7%，α=0.4 为 85.0%，集成 95.8%），宽网络在 α=0 时已接近单模型；朴素平均融合极差（宽度 25 时 λ=0.5 仅 20.6%）。微调实验：MLP（1% MNIST）融合→微调 95.1→96.5%，超过单模型 A/B（93.8/87.8）；ResNet18（5% CIFAR10）85.3→91.8%，超过单模型（79.8/76.7）；随机加宽与 Net2WiderNet 容量基线均更差，说明增益来自真实表征聚合而非参数容量。层级化处理（VGG11 固定 3 层为集成尺寸）能提升所有方法，部分融合仅增加 38% 通道即超过两个单模型。单模型剪枝：聚类式广义剪枝优于非结构化剪枝与 OT Fusion 后处理，作者解释为「删除（丢失处理）」与「线性组合（模糊处理）」两类误差的可调权衡；MLP 上两种误差代价相当，CNN 上模糊代价更低，故聚类收益较小。相似度统计（附录 L）：孤立最不相似的 20% 神经元后，被融合神经元的平均相似度显著上升；CNN 浅层跨网络最近邻距离小于层内、深层反转，而 MLP 该模式很弱，解释了「CNN 偏好部分融合、MLP 偏好聚类」的现象。
AI.conclusion: 部分融合作为集成与权重聚合之间的连续插值是可行且高效的：温和地增加模型规模即可换来不成比例的精度收益，并在推理成本（FLOPs、显存、实测时延）上明显优于集成。与之互补的广义剪枝视角（神经元可删除亦可线性组合）在形式上统一了融合、剪枝与聚类，并通过聚类实例化后能更灵活地权衡「删除」与「模糊」两类误差，且对单模型压缩同样有效（优于标准剪枝与 OT Fusion 后处理）。部分融合可视为广义剪枝的特例：其「只跨网络两两组合」的归纳偏置在 CNN 上更有效，而聚类在 MLP 上更有效；因此实际应用中应按架构/层的相似性结构选择策略。局限与展望：目前仅用置换不变性与浅层相似性特征，可引入 CCA 等更丰富的相似性度量；实验限于小模型与标准基准，需扩展到更大规模并配合微调与更细粒度（逐层）决策；分层融合的准则、BN 统计量的精确处理、聚类的可扩展近似等仍是开放问题。

title: ASAP: Attention Sink Anchored Pruning
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) face severe computational bottlenecks due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention at high resolutions. Existing token reduction methods rely on local metrics - such as single-layer attention scores - that are inherently vulnerable to the attention sink phenomenon, where uninformative tokens are paradoxically preserved over salient foreground objects. We propose ASAP (Attention Sink Anchored Pruning), a training-free framework that recasts this sink as a feature. Modeling ViT information flow as a Lazy Random Walk, ASAP identifies the sink as a dominant accumulator of probability mass. By computing the diffusion distance to the sink within the cumulative transition matrix, ASAP partitions tokens via Radial Diffusion Clustering and compresses background redundancy through Transition Weight Pooling in a single shot. Extensive experiments across image, video, and vision-language tasks demonstrate ASAP outperforms state-of-the-art methods, accelerating throughput by up to 48% while maintaining - or even exceeding - baseline accuracy.

AI.tldr: ASAP是一种无需训练的ViT令牌压缩框架，将注意力锚点现象从问题转化为优势。该方法通过懒惰随机游走模型识别锚点作为概率质量的dominant累积器，利用累计转移矩阵的扩散距离进行令牌划分，并通过转移权重池化压缩背景冗余。在多个视觉任务上实现最先进性能，吞吐量提升48%。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率下ViT的自注意力机制导致二次复杂度计算瓶颈；现有令牌压缩方法依赖单层注意力分数等局部指标，但这些指标受到注意力锚点现象严重影响——无信息量的令牌被错误地保留，而显著的前景物体反而被丢弃。
AI.method: ASAP将ViT信息流建模为懒惰随机游走，通过累计转移矩阵计算到注意力锚点的扩散距离，采用径向扩散聚类划分令牌，并通过转移权重池化压缩背景冗余，实现单次前向传播完成令牌压缩。
AI.result: ASAP在图像、视频和视觉-语言任务中均优于现有最先进方法，吞吐量提升最高达48%，且保持甚至超越基线精度。
AI.conclusion: ASAP通过将注意力锚点建模为特征而非问题，首次实现了在图像、视频和视觉-语言任务中的最先进性能，吞吐量提升高达48%，同时保持或超越基线精度。

title: Target-Aligned Bellman Backup for Cross-domain Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning (CDRL) aims to improve policy learning in a target domain by leveraging data collected from a source domain. Existing works typically assess the transferability of source-domain data by measuring its similarity to target-domain transitions, and implicitly perform transition-level selection. Transitions that are considered similar are assigned higher weights or rewards, while dissimilar ones are down-weighted. However, transition-level similarity does not necessarily imply consistency in long-term returns. Even visually or dynamically similar transitions may lead to significantly different outcomes in the target domain, which can mislead policy learning and degrade performance. To address this issue, we revisit the fundamental objective of policy learning. Since policy optimization ultimately relies on Bellman targets to evaluate the quality of decisions, we propose to assess the transferability of source-domain transitions based on their alignment with target-domain Bellman targets, rather than superficial transition similarity. Based on this insight, we propose a method termed Target-Aligned Bellman Backup (TABB), which selectively leverages source-domain data by measuring their contribution to accurate Bellman target estimation in the target domain. We evaluate TABB across a broad range of cross-domain offline RL settings with highly limited target-domain data. Experimental results show that TABB consistently achieves strong performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨域离线强化学习（CDRL）提出 TABB 方法：不再用"转移相似度"来衡量源域数据的可迁移性，而是用"与目标域 Bellman 目标的对齐程度"（Target Bellman Mismatch, TBM）来筛选并重加权源域转移，将加权后的源数据仅用于 critic 更新，价值拟合与策略提取均只用目标域数据。在 6 个环境、16 组数据集组合上（源域 1M、目标域仅 5K），TABB 相对最强基线 MOBODY 在 MuJoCo 上提升 29%、Adroit 上提升 36.1%，并给出 TBM 控制目标域 Bellman 偏差的理论界。
AI.motivation: 跨域离线强化学习（CDRL）通过复用源域数据缓解目标域交互数据稀缺，但源/目标域存在动力学差异，直接迁移会导致负迁移。现有工作（DARA、REAG、BOSA、SRPO、IGDF、OTDF、DmC、MOBODY 等）普遍以源-目标转移相似度作为可迁移性判据，隐式执行"转移级"选择（提高奖励或重加权）。论文指出这一范式的根本缺陷：转移级相似不蕴含长期回报一致性——即使视觉/动力学高度相似的转移，在两域也可能导致截然不同的结果（论文以半猎豹抬腿跳跃的例子说明：上半身更轻时该动作带来长跳稳定落地，上半身更重时则前扑摔倒）。作者可视化匹配转移的回报分布也显示，即使对应区域，源/目标域回报分布也显著不同。因此，基于相似度的重加权/采样会向目标域 Bellman 更新注入偏差与噪声，造成价值传播失真。作者转而从策略学习的核心——Bellman 备份（Bellman backup）出发：策略优化最终依赖 Bellman 目标来评估决策质量，故源域数据的可迁移性应由其 Bellman 目标与目标域 Bellman 目标的一致性来刻画。
AI.method:
方法：Target-Aligned Bellman Backup (TABB)。设定：源/目标域共享状态与动作空间，仅动力学不同（P_src ≠ P_tar），|D_tar| ≪ |D_src|。

1) 潜在表征学习：用状态编码器 φ(s)、状态-动作编码器 ψ(s,a) 将源与目标数据编码到共享潜空间，z_s=φ(s)、z_sa=ψ(s,a)、z'_s=φ(s')。

2) Target Bellman Mismatch (TBM)：对源域转移 ξ=(s,a,r,s')，构造"实现 Bellman 目标" y_real = r + γV(z'_s) 与"目标对齐 Bellman 目标" y_tar = r̂ + γV(ẑ'_s)，其中 (r̂, ẑ'_s) = f_ref(z_s, z_sa) 由目标域预测器 f_ref（MLP）给出；TBM(ξ)=|y_real − y_tar|。关键设计：两项目标使用同一个仅由目标域数据学习的"锚定"值函数 V，从而隔离出"同一状态-动作对在奖励与后继状态上的跨域失配"，使 TBM 锚定于目标域 Bellman 更新。

3) 两阶段训练 f_ref：第一阶段用 D_src ∪ D_tar 联合训练 φ、ψ、f_ref，损失 L_tmb = E[(r̂−r)² + W_tar‖z'_s − ẑ'_s‖²]，W_tar 为依据目标域状态潜在表示各维方差构造的对角矩阵（加权以侧重目标域相关维度）；第二阶段冻结 φ、ψ，仅用 D_tar 精调 f_ref，以消除源域动力学污染。第一阶段不使用纯目标数据是因目标数据量有限、难以独立训出高质量编码器。

4) 源域重加权与策略学习：源转移权重 ω(ξ)=exp(−TBM(ξ))/Σ_{ξ'∈B_src} exp(−TBM(ξ'))，即 TBM 越小权重越大（软筛选）。Critic 损失 L_Q = E_{D_tar}[ℓ_td] + E_{D_src}[ω(ξ)·ℓ_td]，其中 ℓ_td 为 Huber 损失，源域与目标域的 Bellman 目标统一采用 IQL 风格 y_tar = r + γV(φ(s'))，即源数据只通过"目标对齐 Bellman 目标"参与更新，规避源域动力学的直接备份。价值函数 V_η 用目标域数据做 expectile 回归（τ=0.7），策略用优势加权回归（AWR，β=3.0）仅用目标域数据更新。即：源数据只作为 critic 的目标对齐监督，绝不用于策略改进。

5) 理论分析：定义目标 Bellman 误差 δ_tar(ξ)=|(r+γV(z'_s)) − (r_tar+γV(z'_{s,tar}))|。定理1（偏差控制）：若 f_ref 为 ε- 准确（|r̂−r_tar|≤ε，‖ẑ'_s−z'_{s,tar}‖≤ε），且 V 为 L-Lipschitz，则 δ_tar(ξ) ≤ TBM(ξ) + (1+γL)ε。即 TBM 是目标 Bellman 误差的上界代理，因而对大 TBM 转移降权即可控制目标域价值估计偏差。

算法流程：Algorithm 1（TBM 估计：潜空间预训练 2×10^5 步 → 目标域精调 → 用冻结编码器在目标域数据上训练锚定值函数 V_anc）；Algorithm 2（TABB 主循环：算 TBM → 归一化权重 → 更新 critic → 目标域更新 value 与 actor）。超参：MLP(256,256)，隐状态/动作维度各 64，lr 3e-4，Adam，γ=0.99，target update 5e-3，batch 256，expectile τ=0.7，温度 τ_h=0.3。
AI.result:
实验：6 个环境（HalfCheetah/Hopper/Walker2d/Ant + Pen/Door），16 组数据集组合，源域 D4RL 1M 转移、目标域仅 5K 转移，覆盖形态学、运动学、摩擦、Adroit 断关节/缩短手指等动力学偏移，指标为 D4RL 归一化分数，5 个随机种子。

RQ1 主结果：MuJoCo 12 任务中 9 项最优，总分 584.2，较最强基线 MOBODY（451.2）提升约 29%；Adroit 8 任务中 7 项最优，总分 453.4 vs MOBODY 333.2，提升 36.1%。在 Hopper-Morphology（63.5 vs 13.1）、Ant-Friction（62.9 vs 31.2）、Walker2d-Friction（40.8 vs 27.4）等强偏移任务上大幅领先，多数基线仅与 IQL 持平；Walker2d 的形态学/运动学任务略逊于 OTDF/MOBODY，作者归因于该任务更受目标域运动相位覆盖度限制，而 TABB 只评估单条源转移的 Bellman 贡献。

RQ2 消融：-TBM（退化为在混合数据上直接跑 IQL）在多数任务明显退化（如 HalfCheetah-Kinematic 12.3→41.7，Walker2d-Morph 23.0→43.4）；SrcActor（在 TBM 加权 critic 基础上再用源数据训 actor）性能大幅下降，说明源数据作为 critic 监督有益、用于策略改进有害。

RQ3 鲁棒性：摩擦系数在 {0.1, 0.5, 2.0, 5.0} 变化下 TABB 均为最优或相当（Walker2d 在 0.1 与 5.0 优势明显，Hopper 因单腿结构摩擦影响局部化而优势较小）；18 组源/目标数据质量组合（medium、medium-replay、medium-expert、expert 交叉）全部最优，目标数据为 expert 级别时优势最大（HalfCheetah-Morph 46~60 vs 多数基线 <10；Ant-Kinematic 达 87.05/90.34）。

RQ4 诊断实验：采样 10K 源转移在目标环境重放一次得到 oracle 目标域奖励与后继态（仅用于评估，不参与训练），按 TBM 与 OT 距离（OTDF 的相似度指标）分十档排序统计 oracle Bellman 误差。TBM 排序下方差随分数单调上升（分数越高误差越大，符合预期）；而 OT 分数在 Hopper-Morph 上高分区误差反而下降，Walker2d-Kinematic 上甚至随分数增加而下降，证明基于相似度的判据不可靠，TBM 能更好识别有害的源转移。
AI.conclusion: 结论：跨域离线 RL 中"转移相似"不等于"价值更新一致"，应以与目标域 Bellman 目标的对齐度作为源数据可迁移性的判据。TABB 通过 TBM 对源域转移软重加权、仅以目标对齐 Bellman 目标更新 critic，并完全用目标域数据做价值拟合与策略提取，在多种动力学偏移与极有限目标数据（5K）下稳定优于正则化类、过滤类、样本生成类等现有 CDRL 方法，且具备可解释的偏差控制理论保证。局限与展望：当前仅适用于状态/动作空间共享、仅动力学不同的设定，扩展到异构观测空间或不同具身结构（不同状态/动作维度）仍是开放问题；此外 TABB 逐转移评估 Bellman 贡献，对需要相位覆盖的场景（如 Walker2d 形态学/运动学）可能不足，可与分布对齐/目标域生成方法互补。

title: Towards Explainability of SLMs by investigating Token Level Activation
summary: Transformer-based language models such as BERT having 110M+ parameters have revolutionized natural language understanding, yet their internal mechanisms remain largely opaque to researchers and practitioners. Traditional attention-based interpretability methods often emphasize structurally important but semantically weak tokens such as punctuation marks rather than meaningful semantic relationships. This work introduces a lightweight and model-agnostic framework for quantifying token-level representational importance using hidden-state activation strengths at Layer 8 of BERT. The proposed Activation Flow Network (AFN) framework computes Token Activation Strength using the L2 norm of Layer-8 hidden representations, enabling direct ranking of semantically salient tokens. The study further introduces a threshold-based activation bucket formulation that partitions tokens into HIGH-activation and LOW-activation groups using an empirical upper-quartile activation boundary. Experimental observations demonstrate that semantically meaningful content words consistently occupy the HIGH-activation bucket and dominate representational activation shifts, while structurally supportive tokens contribute comparatively less. The results suggest that Layer 8 acts as a critical semantic consolidation zone balancing structural and semantic information processing. By revealing how activation magnitudes concentrate around semantically informative tokens, this work provides an interpretable and computationally efficient alternative to attentioncentric analysis, contributing toward transforming BERT from a "black box" into a more transparent "glass box" model for natural language understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AFN框架，通过L2范数分析BERT第8层隐藏状态激活强度，实现token级语义重要性量化，发现该层为语义整合关键区域，为Transformer可解释性提供新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统注意力解释方法倾向于强调结构重要但语义弱（如标点）的token，而非有意义的语义关系；同时110M+参数的BERT内部机制对研究者和实践者仍不透明。
AI.method: 提出Activation Flow Network (AFN)框架，使用第8层隐藏表示的L2范数计算Token Activation Strength，并通过上四分位数阈值将token分为HIGH和LOW激活组。
AI.result: 语义内容词持续占据HIGH激活桶并主导表征激活变化，而结构辅助性token贡献相对较小；Layer 8扮演关键语义整合角色，平衡结构和语义信息处理。
AI.conclusion: Layer 8被识别为关键的语义整合区，AFN框架为将BERT从"黑箱"转化为更透明的"玻璃箱"模型提供了可解释且计算高效的新方法。

title: Efficient Higher-order Subgraph Attribution via Message Passing
summary: Explaining graph neural networks (GNNs) has become more and more important recently. Higher-order interpretation schemes, such as GNN-LRP (layer-wise relevance propagation for GNN), emerged as powerful tools for unraveling how different features interact thereby contributing to explaining GNNs. GNN-LRP gives a relevance attribution of walks between nodes at each layer, and the subgraph attribution is expressed as a sum over exponentially many such walks. In this work, we demonstrate that such exponential complexity can be avoided. In particular, we propose novel algorithms that enable to attribute subgraphs with GNN-LRP in linear-time (w.r.t. the network depth). Our algorithms are derived via message passing techniques that make use of the distributive property, thereby directly computing quantities for higher-order explanations. We further adapt our efficient algorithms to compute a generalization of subgraph attributions that also takes into account the neighboring graph features. Experimental results show the significant acceleration of the proposed algorithms and demonstrate the high usefulness and scalability of our novel generalized subgraph attribution method.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 GNN-LRP 子图归因的指数级计算瓶颈，提出基于消息传递（sum-product / 信念传播）的线性时间算法 sGNN-LRP：把 LRP 归因解释为展开网络上一条马尔可夫链的边缘概率计算，通过一次反向传播即直接得到子图相关性，复杂度从 O(|S|^L) 降为 O(L|S|^2)；并借 forward-hook trick 给出简洁高效的实现。进一步推广出带折扣因子 α 的广义子图归因（对走出子图的路径按次数折扣），在节点排序/模型激活与剪枝任务上优于或持平 GNNExplainer、梯度热图与 (Grad-)CAM。
AI.motivation: 高阶解释方法（尤其是 GNN-LRP）被广泛用于揭示 GNN 中特征间的高阶交互，但 GNN-LRP 的子图归因被定义为「所有完全位于子图内部的走步（walk）相关度之和」，需对约 O(|S|^L) 条指数多条走步求和，导致其只能用于很小的子图与很浅的网络。这一复杂度问题并非 GNN-LRP 特有，而是所有超出线性/加性解释的高阶特征归因方法的共性问题（L 阶解释需考虑 N^L 种特征组合）。因此亟需一种能高效计算高阶子图相关性的方法，使「更深层的 GNN、更长走步」的高阶解释在实际中成为可能。
AI.method:
1) 理论框架「LRP 即消息传递」：将 GNN 展开为前馈网络，构造一条虚拟马尔可夫链，使神经元级走步相关度与该链的联合分布具有相同的可分解结构（乘积形式）。因此可用 sum-product（信念传播）分解把「对走步集合求和」的目标量化为消息传递，从而可系统地推导 LRP 传播规则。论文由该框架重新推导了标准 FFNN-LRP 与 GNN-LRP，验证了方法的通用性。
2) sGNN-LRP 规则：在 GNN-LRP 传播中把走步后继节点的求和限制在子图 S 内（ṙ^(l,m_l)=Σ_{m_{l+1}∈S} T^{l,m_l,m_{l+1}} ṙ^(l+1,m_{l+1})），单次反向传播即得 R^S=Σ_{m_0∈S}Σ_n ṙ_n^(0,m_0)，复杂度由 O(|S|^L) 降为 O(L|S|^2)。
3) forward-hook trick 实现：修改前向 combine 步骤（引入常数掩码矩阵 M^(l)，把除法与激活脱钩以保留梯度），子图相关度以 ⟨Autograd(y,H^(0)), M^S H^(0)⟩ 的 Frobenius 内积读出，实现比直接实现传播规则更简单、更快、更省内存（Algorithm 1、2）。
4) 广义子图归因：原定义完全忽略走出子图的走步，只反映「子图与整图预测一致」这一性质；提出 R_α^S=Σ_m g_α^S(m) R^m，走出子图的步数按折扣因子 α∈[0,1] 计入，从而同时兼顾「子图可恢复预测」与「补集预测显著偏离」。利用 R_α^S = R̃_α^S − α^{L+1} R_0^{G\S} 分解，推导对应的折扣传播规则，并同样支持 forward-hook trick（软掩码，外部节点置 α）。
AI.result: 效率：Naive GNN-LRP 随深度 L 呈指数增长、随 |S| 呈三次增长（O(|S|^L)），深度 5–7 的模型上耗时达 10^3–10^5 ms 甚至因显存/超时失败；sGNN-LRP 为 O(L|S|^2)，耗时仅 4.22–195.43 ms，加速约四个数量级，速度快于 GNNExplainer，与梯度热图及 (Grad-)CAM 相当，其复杂度与 GNN 单次前向/反向传播相同，因而可用于更深的 GNN 和更大的图。归因质量：BA-2motif 上最优 α≈0（因基图节点完全随机，原定义几乎已最优），top-5 节点排序准确率/AUROC 随 α 呈峰形；在 MUTAG 与 Graph-SST2 的模型激活（AUAC，越高越好）与剪枝（AUPC，越低越好）任务上，α=0 并非总最优，调节 α 可同时改善两类任务的节点排序质量；在各自调优 α 后，sGNN-LRP 在 8 个对比情形中的 6 个优于 GNNExplainer、梯度热图与 (Grad-)CAM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文以「先定义目标量、再推导传播规则」这一新范式，把 LRP 与 GNN-LRP 统一解释为消息传递（sum-product）算法，并据此提出多项式时间（相对深度线性）的 sGNN-LRP，一举解决高阶子图归因的指数复杂度瓶颈，同时提供了基于 forward-hook trick 的轻量实现。基于同一框架进一步提出的带折扣因子 α 的广义子图归因，把「走出子图」的走步按折扣计入，弥补了原定义只看子图内部走步的缺陷，在节点排序与模型激活/剪枝评估上更具鲁棒性。局限与未来工作：α 的调优策略尚未给出（作者留待后续），且 BA-2motif 这类「外部节点无信息」的数据集上原定义已接近最优，收益有限；作者认为该方法可推广到神经影像、量子化学等长程高阶非线性交互场景，以及评估 SOTA 系统可信性与公平性的 NLP 任务。

title: Hybrid Kolmogorov-Arnold Network and XGBoost Framework for Week-Ahead Price Forecasting in Australia's National Electricity Market
comment: The 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics, 2026
summary: Accurate electricity price forecasting (EPF) is essential for market participants to support operational planning and risk management, yet remains challenging due to strong volatility, nonlinear dynamics, and frequent extreme price spikes. These challenges are particularly pronounced in the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM), where high renewable penetration further increases uncertainty. This paper investigates week-ahead electricity price forecasting and proposes a hybrid KAN+XGBoost framework that integrates Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) with tree-based learning. The proposed approach combines the global nonlinear representation capability of KAN with the local robustness of XGBoost to capture both long-term dependencies and short-term price fluctuations. Experiments are conducted on real-world NEM data using an expanding window evaluation strategy. The results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms benchmark methods, including SARIMAX, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), standalone KAN, and XGBoost, reducing MAE by approximately 12% compared to XGBoost and by over 50% compared to a naive baseline. The results suggest that hybrid learning strategies provide an effective and robust solution for electricity price forecasting in highly dynamic electricity markets.

AI.tldr: A hybrid KAN+XGBoost framework for week-ahead electricity price forecasting in the Australian NEM, combining global nonlinear representation of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with local robustness of XGBoost, demonstrating superior performance with 12% MAE improvement over standalone XGBoost and 50%+ over naive baseline.
AI.motivation: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) is essential for market participants' operational planning and risk management, but faces significant challenges due to strong volatility, nonlinear dynamics, and frequent extreme price spikes. These challenges are particularly severe in the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) where high renewable penetration increases uncertainty.
AI.method: Proposed a hybrid KAN+XGBoost framework combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) with tree-based XGBoost learning. KAN provides global nonlinear representation capability while XGBoost offers local robustness, jointly capturing long-term dependencies and short-term price fluctuations. Evaluated using expanding window strategy on real-world NEM data.
AI.result: The proposed model outperforms benchmark methods (SARIMAX, LSTM, standalone KAN, and XGBoost), achieving approximately 12% MAE reduction compared to XGBoost alone and over 50% reduction compared to naive baseline.
AI.conclusion: Hybrid KAN+XGBoost framework provides an effective and robust solution for electricity price forecasting in highly dynamic electricity markets like the Australian NEM.

title: A Posterior-Predictive Variance Decomposition for Epistemic and Aleatoric Uncertainty in Wind Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate wind power forecasting requires reliable uncertainty quantification, yet most existing methods report a single predictive uncertainty that conflates epistemic and aleatoric sources. This paper applies the law of total variance to the joint setting of heteroscedastic neural network regression and Bayesian posterior approximation, deriving an explicit decomposition of total uncertainty (TU) into aleatoric (AU) and epistemic (EU) components. The resulting estimators are compatible with standard posterior-approximation methods and with $β$-NLL training to regulate the mean--variance learning trade-off. A wind power--specific evaluation framework is proposed to validate disentanglement without access to ground-truth uncertainty labels, comprising three modules: controlled synthetic experiments to verify responses to heteroscedastic noise and distribution shift; data-property--driven validation on a real-world wind turbine SCADA dataset; and dataset-size scaling experiments to examine the predicted asymptotic behavior of EU. Across synthetic and real-world experiments, the decomposed AU and EU components respond in theoretically consistent directions to noise structure, distributional shift, and training-scale variation, supporting the theoretical consistency and operational utility of the proposed decomposition and evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文针对风电功率预测中"单一预测不确定性混淆认知（EU）与偶然（AU）"的问题，将全方差定律应用于异方差神经网络回归+贝叶斯后验近似，推导出总不确定性（TU）的显式分解：TU = EU(后验下预测均值的方差) + AU(后验下预测方差的期望)，给出可实施的蒙特卡洛估计器、β-NLL训练以及一套无需真值标签的风电专用评估协议（合成实验、SCADA数据属性验证、数据集规模缩放）。实验显示各方法/β设置下AU、EU对噪声结构、分布偏移、数据规模的响应方向与理论一致。
AI.motivation: 风电功率预测的不确定性量化至关重要，但现有方法（分位数回归/预测区间、异方差回归、变分推断、MC Dropout、深度集成）大多只给出单一的总不确定性（TU），将可约减的认知不确定性与不可约减的偶然不确定性混在一起。文献显示：Mucsányi 等对19种方法的基准测试表明，分解得到的AU与EU仍高度相关（秩相关≥0.78）；Valdenegro-Toro 与 Mori 发现AU与EU目标学习之间存在非预期交互，说明单纯"选方法"不足以实现可靠解耦。此外，现有解耦评估多基于分类/视觉任务（人工标注可重复、标签噪声可注入），而风电预测中AU来源多样、历史测量不可重复复制，无法照搬；风电领域也尚缺少在回归预测场景下显式建模并实证评估AU/EU解耦的框架。本文目标是以理论为基础提供风电专用的解耦框架与无标签评估协议。
AI.method: （1）概率建模：把点预测器扩展为"双头"估计器，输出高斯分布的均值μ[y|θ,x]与方差σ²(y|θ,x]，前者为一级分布（刻画AU），再以参数后验p(θ|D)表达对一级分布的信念（二级分布，刻画EU），预测分布p(y|x,D)=∫p(y|θ,x)p(θ|D)dθ。（2）定理1（预测方差分解）：在(A1)真后验存在、(A2)有限二阶矩等假设下，由全方差定律得 σ²(y|x,D)=σ²_{p(θ|D)}(μ[y|θ,x])（EU）+E_{p(θ|D)}[σ²(y|θ,x)]（AU）；并强调分解依赖后验近似的选择，不存在唯一分解。（3）推论1（渐近一致性）：模型正确设定且N→∞时后验集中于δ(θ*)，EU→0，AU→σ²(y|x,θ*)（不可约噪声）。（4）模型误设修正：加入Δ_bias(x)项，AU+EU会低估总方差。（5）可实施估计：用S个后验样本的蒙特卡洛近似，AU_var=(1/S)Σσ²_s，EU_var=(1/S)Σ(μ_s-μ̄)²；由强大数定律保证样本一致性；适用于MC-DropConnect、Bayes by Backprop（因子化高斯变分推断，KL权重）、深度集成（S=5）等任意后验近似。（6）训练：异方差NLL损失，并采用Seitzer et al.的β-NLL（对σ^{2β}做stop-gradient）以在NLL(β=0)与MSE(β=1)之间调节均值—方差权衡；给出了μ与σ²的梯度解析式。（7）评估协议三模块：①合成受控实验，f(x)=x sin(x)+ε₁x+ε₂（ε~N(0,0.3)），训练x∈[0,10]、测试x∈[10,15]，检验EU在OOD区上升、AU随异方差噪声上升；②SCADA数据集（风电场真实数据，负功率置均值、去NaN、归一化，前10步风速/风向/功率+当前风速风向→当前功率，50500样本，9:1:1划分；3×64 ReLU网络，mean线性头+variance softplus头），依据风速—功率联合密度检验EU在2–11 m/s低、AU在低密度与离群点高；③数据集规模操纵（英国3年小时级风电功率数据，24小时历史→次小时预测，26280样本，训练集比例0.1–1.0），检验EU随数据量单调下降的渐近行为。
AI.result: 合成实验：三种后验近似（MC-DropConnect、Bayes by Backprop、深度集成）在OOD区（x>10）均呈现EU上升，但幅度随方法而异；β=0（纯NLL）均值估计常次优；中间β（0.5）改善预测；β=1时AU几乎在整个输入域恒定、无法捕捉异方差趋势，OOD区AU不可靠，且集成与Bayes by Backprop给出近常数AU（噪声结构泛化有限），而经典双头网络连OOD区都能捕捉递增AU，说明解耦质量同时取决于后验方法与β设置。SCADA实验：所有方法与β下EU在2–11 m/s较低，超出11 m/s显著上升；Bayes by Backprop整体EU更高且无法反映额定风速以上AU升高（倾向把该区变异归入参数不确定性而低估AU）；MC-DropConnect与深度集成的AU与联合密度更吻合（切入风速附近低、沿功率曲线渐增、离群点高），且增大β不会系统性降低AU而是改变其空间分布。数据规模实验：EU随训练集增大单调下降并在0.3–1.0区间饱和，深度集成比后验表示更受限的方法更早达到饱和；AU亦呈下降趋势，作者归因于小数据下的欠拟合（部分未解释方差被吸收进AU），而非理论矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了风电功率预测中后验预测方差解耦的理论与实践框架：TU=AU+EU的分解、β-NLL兼容的估计器、以及无需真值不确定性标签的任务驱动评估协议，三类实验的响应方向与理论预期一致（噪声结构、分布偏移、训练规模），表明所分解出的两个成分兼具理论合理性与运行价值。局限与展望：分解数值依赖后验近似的选择；存在模型误设/优化不充分导致的Δ_bias项，作者未显式估计该偏差，未来工作将系统考察模型容量、校准与训练动态对不确定性估计的影响。

title: Cross-Species RSA Reveals Conserved Early Visual Alignment but Divergent Higher-Area Rankings Across Human fMRI and Macaque Electrophysiology
summary: Does the relationship between learning rules and brain alignment generalize across species? We extend our prior finding that untrained CNNs match backpropagation at human V1 by testing the same five learning rules against macaque electrophysiology. The rules are backpropagation (BP), feedback alignment (FA), predictive coding (PC), spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), and an untrained random-weights baseline. The macaque data come from two datasets: MajajHong2015 (V4/IT, 3,200 stimulus presentations, 88/168 neurons) and FreemanZiemba2013 (V1/V2, 135 stimuli, 102/103 neurons). Using RSA with identical model weights from our human study, we find: (1) all models achieve higher alignment with macaque early visual cortex (rho = 0.15-0.30 at V1/V2) than with human fMRI (rho = 0.01-0.08), consistent with the higher signal-to-noise ratio of electrophysiology; (2) STDP and PC produce the highest macaque V1/V2 alignment (rho ~ 0.30 and 0.28), consistent with their leading position among trained rules in human V1; (3) at IT, learning rule rankings show no detectable correlation across species (Kendall's tau = 0.00, p = 1.00), though this null result is expected given that n = 5 provides power only at tau = +/-1.0, and is further confounded by stimulus set differences; (4) a pretrained ResNet-50 (ImageNet) achieves rho = 0.25 at macaque IT, substantially above all custom CNN conditions (rho = 0.07-0.14), suggesting IT alignment is limited by model capacity and training data rather than by the learning rule. Noise ceilings, multi-seed variability (5 seeds), and a stimulus-control analysis are reported. These results demonstrate that early visual alignment is robust across species, while higher-area alignment is modulated by model capacity and stimulus domain.

AI.tldr: 本研究将先前人类fMRI中验证的五种学习规则与猕猴电生理数据进行对比，发现学习规则对初级视觉皮层的神经对齐效果跨物种具有鲁棒性，但IT区域对齐更多取决于模型容量而非特定学习规则。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证明未经训练的CNN可在人类V1区域与反向传播相匹配，本研究旨在验证这一关系是否跨物种泛化，以检验神经对齐结果的普适性。
AI.method: 采用表示相似性分析（RSA），使用与人类研究完全相同的模型权重，对比五种学习规则（BP、FA、PC、STDP、随机权重基线）与猕猴电生理数据的对齐程度。数据来源包括MajajHong2015（V4/IT）和FreemanZiemba2013（V1/V2）数据集，涵盖多噪声天花板分析、多种子变异性评估（5个种子）及刺激控制分析。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）所有模型在猕猴V1/V2的对齐度（rho=0.15-0.30）均高于人类fMRI（rho=0.01-0.08），电生理数据信噪比更高；（2）STDP和PC在V1/V2表现最佳（rho≈0.30和0.28），与人类V1结果一致；（3）IT区域学习规则排名无跨物种相关性（tau=0.00，p=1.00），但样本量限制统计效力；（4）ImageNet预训练的ResNet-50在IT区域对齐度（rho=0.25）远超自定义CNN条件（rho=0.07-0.14），表明IT对齐受限于模型容量和训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 学习规则对初级视觉皮层的跨物种对齐具有鲁棒性，而高级视觉区域的对齐更多受模型容量和训练数据影响。五种学习规则在V1/V2的表现排名在人类和猕猴间具有一致性，但IT区域排名无相关性（可能因样本量小）。ImageNet预训练显著提升IT区域对齐效果。

title: Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree Regularization for Spectral Clustering
summary: Spectral clustering largely depends on the affinity graph, yet constructing a graph that preserves reliable local connectivity while adapting to heterogeneous data structures remains challenging. Existing granular-ball-based spectral clustering methods usually reduce graph complexity by using coarse-grained representatives. However, the learned local regions are often treated as graph nodes or anchors, and their structural information is not sufficiently used to regularize the original sample-level graph. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree-Regularized Spectral Clustering method, termed MDL-GBTRSC. The proposed method constructs a granular-ball tree through local MDL model selection, with reciprocal neighborhood continuity used to discourage splits that break reliable local connections. The stable leaf balls obtained from the tree provide coding-scale information for regularizing the sample-level affinity graph. In addition, a shared-neighbor bridge code is introduced to adjust weak local bridge relations without requiring an additional user-specified threshold. In this way, MDL-GBTRSC connects interpretable local representation learning with affinity graph construction in a unified spectral clustering framework. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets show that MDL-GBTRSC achieves the best average ARI and NMI under the adopted fixed-configuration protocol compared with classical spectral clustering baselines and representative granular-ball, micro-cluster, and anchor-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 MDL-GBTRSC：一种基于最小描述长度（MDL）的粒球树正则化谱聚类方法。其核心思想是让粒球（granular ball）不再充当降维后的图节点/锚点，而是作为"区域结构描述符"，将其覆盖范围与离散度的结构尺度迁移到原始样本级亲和图上；同时用互惠邻域连续性约束粒球树的分裂决策；最终依据所选亲和图的连通分量状态（直接指派/分量内谱细分/全局谱划分）完成划分。在 18 个真实 + 20 个合成数据集（共 109,969 个样本）与 9 个基线方法的固定配置对比中取得最优平均 ARI/NMI（真实 0.5998/0.6613，合成 0.9618/0.9688），合成集 20 个数据中有 12 个 ARI=NMI=1。
AI.motivation: 谱聚类的性能高度依赖亲和图的构建：固定尺度的 kNN/RBF 图无法适应局部密度与几何结构的异质性，可能割裂真实簇或模糊簇边界。现有三条改进路线各有局限：(1) 自适应图学习/邻域细化方法大多只在"边或邻域"层面操作，未把局部区域自身的结构属性（覆盖度、尺度、离散度、一致性）系统地写入样本级亲和图；(2) 锚点/二部图/降维方法把原始样本替换成代表节点，分割了"图规模"与"局部几何保真"两个目标，且最终还需把代表点映射回样本；(3) 现有粒球类/微簇类谱聚类（GBCT、GBSC、MDMSC、GMM-SC）把粒球当作缩减后的图节点或中间代表，其内部结构信息没有被回传到样本级图。此外，粒球生成通常依赖紧致度、密度、纯度等启发式规则，缺乏统一的模型选择视角来判定一个区域"该保留还是该继续细分"，也未考虑分裂是否破坏对谱图重要的互惠邻域关系。因此需要一种把区域级自适应结构与样本级亲和图构建统一起来的谱聚类框架。
AI.method: 方法分四个阶段。（A）互惠连续性图：对每个样本取 k_g = min{n-1, max{2, ⌈ln(n+1)/ln2 + √d⌉}} 近邻，用自调节尺度 τ_i（到第 k_g 近邻距离）定义有向亲和 ā_ij = exp(-‖x_i-x_j‖²/(2τ_iτ_j))，取双向最小值得到互惠邻接 a^rec（仅保留两端互相支持的边），构成 G_rec⁰。（B）图连续性正则化的 MDL 细化：每个区域用两个竞争的高斯描述——各向同性 L_iso 与子空间自适应 L_sub(S,q)（对散度矩阵做特征分解，按 q 取主子空间与其正交补的残差编码长，参数长含 Grassmann 维数 q(d-q) 与 ln(d+1)，取 min），并加 ln2 计入二者选择。保留区域代价 L_keep = L_ball + ln2；分裂代价 L_split = L_ball(S_L)+L_ball(S_R)+L_cut+L_choice+L_cand，其中图项 L_cut = Σ_{互惠边跨侧} -ln(1-a^rec_ij) 惩罚切断强互惠关系，L_cand 计入候选排序与切点位置的编码开销。候选分裂由四类一维几何分数（主成分投影、直径方向、最大方差特征、到中心距离）排序后的切点生成，受 n_min(S) 约束；先用各向同性项粗筛、每种排序保留 ρ_S = max{2, ⌈√n_S⌉} 个最优切点，再计算完整描述长，取增益 Δ(S) = L_keep - L_split* 最大的叶先细分，直到所有叶 Δ ≤ 0（稳定叶球）。（C）叶尺度亲和正则化：每个稳定叶球给出 η_b = r + √max{σ², σ₀²} + ε；样本边代价 φ_ij = ‖x_i-x_j‖²/(2τ_iτ_j) + |ln(η_{b(i)}/η_{b(j)})|，即在自调节几何邻近性上叠加区域尺度差异惩罚；再分别对称化为互惠图 w^rec（min）和补全图 w^com（max）。（D）连通性感知谱划分：若互惠图恰有 K 个连通分量则直接采用，否则用补全图；对 c=K 直接按分量指派，c=1 用归一化拉普拉斯最小 K 特征向量做确定性 QR 离散化，1<c<K 用调和级数 H_q 的凹性按规模加权分配 K 个簇并对多簇分量做谱细分，c>K 则全局 K 路谱划分。全流程无数据集特定可调参数，且确定性可复现。复杂度：固定 d、K 时非谱部分近似平衡层次为 O(n²)（受精确近邻搜索主导），最不平衡层次上界 O(n^{5/2})；平衡层次下树归纳 O(n^{3/2})（相比穷举评估的 O(n²)/O(n³)），存储约 O(n log n)。
AI.result: 真实集（18 个数据集）：全 18 个上 MDL-GBTRSC 平均 ARI/NMI = 0.5933/0.6431；在所有方法都完成的 17 个数据集上为 0.5998/0.6613、平均秩 2.94/2.94（均为最优），高于次优的 N-DSC（0.5792/0.6285）。Nemenyi 检验显示其与 STSC-FK、N-DSC、SC-kNN、MDMSC 的差异不显著，但 Wilcoxon-Holm 校正后相对 FastSC、SC-RBF、GBCT、GBSC、GMM-SC 显著。数据集级别上并非全面占优（如 Banknote 上 N-DSC 0.8648 远高于 0.6011，PageBlocks 输给 GBCT）。合成集（20 个）：平均 ARI/NMI = 0.9618/0.9688，显著优于次优 0.7921/0.8306，20 个数据中 15 个最佳或并列最佳、12 个达到 ARI=NMI=1（含 3-spiral、db2、jain、target、chainlink、N、A、banana、fourty 等非凸/嵌套结构）；Holm 校正后与全部 9 个基线均存在显著差异，平均秩 1.95。机制验证显示：筛除切点平均减少 84.6% 的完整描述长评估、运行时间降为 1/3.50，与穷举结果互相 ARI 均值 0.9747；去掉互惠连续性项后叶球数从 97.4 增至 639.7、树深 8.74→11.53、每叶样本 141.4→65.3，ΔARI=-0.0167；去掉叶尺度项 ΔARI=-0.0220（层级不变）；强制用补全图 ΔARI=-0.0688、强制全局划分 ΔARI=-0.0693、二者同时 ΔARI=-0.1266。K 扰动实验中固定层级与亲和权重、仅重算末阶段，K-1/K/K+1 的 ARI 为 0.4157/0.7873/0.6056，说明对模型阶数敏感。运行时间上平均 18.595 s，快于 GBCT（22.610 s）与 SC-RBF（36.356 s），但慢于 FastSC、SC-kNN、GMM-SC（0.08–1.43 s）；STSC-FK 与 N-DSC 在 HTRU2 上内存超限。规模实验：n 增至 200,000 时运行 143.02 s、峰值 RSS 增量约 636 MB；d 增至 20,000 时 RSS 约 2.19 GB；n=100,000、d=1,000 时运行 5,541.88 s、RSS 约 5.54 GB；各配置下 ARI/NMI 均为 1。
AI.conclusion: MDL-GBTRSC 论证了一个可行的设计：粒球层级可以作为"中间结构表示层"存在，而不替换原始样本作为谱图顶点——区域级结构通过叶尺度项注入样本级亲和度，谱聚类因此既获得局部几何自适应能力，又保留样本级分辨率。三个机制（互惠连续性、区域尺度、图连通性）各自作用位置不同：连续性决定区域是否细分、尺度描述区域范围、连通性决定最终划分路线，这与消融中观测到的差异化行为一致；三种连通性状态（直接指派、分量内细分、全局划分）下都能取得精确恢复，说明高精度并非依赖某一条特定路径。将 K 的引入推迟到图选择与划分阶段，也使学习到的结构表示可复用于不同模型阶数。但作者也明确承认局限：真实数据上优势不稳定、与若干强基线统计上不可区分；仍需预先给定 K（K±1 时性能明显下降）；筛除策略与完整判据之间存在近似误差（Seeds 上互相 ARI 仅 0.912）；每个叶球仅贡献一个标量尺度，可能需要方向性/各向异性/多尺度区域描述；精确近邻搜索与重复的高维局部描述计算是主要开销，n 与 d 同时增大时尤为突出（可达数小时与 GB 级内存）。未来方向包括从学习到的图结构推断模型阶数、更贴近完整判据的切点筛选、更丰富的区域描述子，以及近似近邻搜索与稀疏迭代特征求解器以提升可扩展性。

title: AMUSE: Anytime Muon with Stable Gradient Evaluation
summary: Modern deep learning commonly relies on AdamW with prescribed learning rate schedules, but recent works challenge both components: Schedule-Free optimization removes explicit schedules via iterate averaging, and Muon improves the update geometry by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix parameters. Despite Muon's strong empirical performance, its underlying mechanism remains partially understood. We study Muon through the river-valley loss landscape, where useful training progress occurs along a flat, low-curvature bulk subspace (the river), while high-curvature dominant directions form steep valley walls that induce oscillations. We empirically show that while Muon's orthogonalization accelerates river progress by increasing the bulk component, it also amplifies dominant-direction noise, causing oscillatory trajectories. Building on this, we propose Anytime MUon with Stable gradient Evaluation (AMUSE), which integrates Muon's rapid bulk progress with the stabilizing effect of Schedule-Free averaging. AMUSE uses a time-varying interpolation coefficient that initially evaluates gradients near the fast Muon sequence for rapid adaptation, then gradually shifts toward the stable averaged sequence to suppress valley-wall oscillations. As a result, AMUSE requires no learning rate schedules and supports anytime training. Across vision tasks and large language model pretraining, AMUSE consistently improves the performance-iteration Pareto frontier over (Schedule-Free) AdamW and Muon.

AI.tldr: The paper studies Muon optimizer through the river-valley loss landscape theory. Muon's orthogonalization accelerates progress along the flat bulk subspace (river) but amplifies oscillations in high-curvature directions (valley walls). The proposed AMUSE combines Muon's rapid bulk progress with Schedule-Free averaging via time-varying interpolation, achieving better performance-iteration tradeoff across vision and LLM pretraining tasks.
AI.motivation: AdamW with learning rate schedules and Muon optimization have limitations. Muon shows strong empirical performance but its mechanism is partially understood. Muon's orthogonalization accelerates river progress but also amplifies dominant-direction noise, causing oscillatory trajectories.
AI.method: AMUSE integrates Muon's rapid bulk progress with Schedule-Free averaging through a time-varying interpolation coefficient. The coefficient initially evaluates gradients near the fast Muon sequence for rapid adaptation, then gradually shifts toward the stable averaged sequence to suppress valley-wall oscillations.
AI.result: A new optimizer AMUSE that requires no learning rate schedules and supports anytime training.
AI.conclusion: AMUSE consistently improves the performance-iteration Pareto frontier over (Schedule-Free) AdamW and Muon across vision tasks and large language model pretraining.

title: Don't Forget the Critic: Value-Based Data Rehearsal for Multi-Cyclic Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Data rehearsal has emerged as a leading approach for mitigating catastrophic forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL). However, existing work remains confined to policy gradient frameworks, regularizing only actors due to the performance degradation incurred by critic regularization. This actor-centric approach overlooks the potential of data rehearsal for value function approximation. Moreover, existing evaluations in CRL rarely consider multi-cyclic environments where task sequences repeat, a critical real-world scenario that exacerbates forgetting and plasticity. We investigate data rehearsal for Deep Q-Networks using Q-value regularization in multi-cyclic settings and propose Qreg+NWLU which introduces two simple modifications: (1) continuous data rehearsal that dynamically collects and updates stored Q-values throughout training, and (2) "No-Wait" regularization that applies immediately rather than after the first task. Together, these modifications yield improvements in learning efficiency, forgetting mitigation, and knowledge transfer over Qreg and conventional CRL methods within value function approximation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将持续强化学习（CRL）中的数据复演（data rehearsal）从策略梯度/actor-critic框架推进到纯价值方法DQN，诊断出标准Q值正则化（Qreg）在多周期（multi-cyclic）任务序列下的不稳定与高方差问题，并提出Qreg+NWLU：持续采样（Live）+ 定期更新已存Q值（Updates）+ 一有样本立即施加正则（No-Wait）。在Minihack Room、PLE Flappy/Catcher三条5任务序列×4个周期的基准上，Qreg+NWLU在回报、Final Transfer、 Worst Transfer 三类指标上全面优于所有基线（DQN、DDQN、Perfect Memory、PackNet、EWC、L2、MER）。
AI.motivation: 1) 现有CRL的数据复演工作几乎全部限于策略梯度/actor-critic框架，原因是先前研究发现对critic做正则会降低性能，因此只对actor做行为克隆式正则；但这意味着值函数逼近（尤其是DQN）在CRL中的数据复演价值被严重忽视。2) 现有灾难性遗忘研究很少采用多周期（任务序列重复多轮）的评测：而现实任务与环境天然重复出现，多周期设定既能放大遗忘效应、也能暴露单周期评测掩盖的长期鲁棒性；同时可塑性研究表明重复任务会逐步退化学习能力，与遗忘高度相关。3) 作者希望回答：如何把"带正则的数据复演"有效迁移到DQN这类基础价值方法上，并在多周期设定下与传统CRL方法比较。
AI.method: 核心方法Qreg（Q-value regularization）：在独立的复演回放缓冲区（RRB）中存储 (s, a, Q_RRB) 元组，用L2损失 (λ/N)·Σ(Q_θ(s,a) − Q_RRB)² 约束当前Q网络向历史Q值靠拢，是行为克隆在价值侧的对应物。Qreg+NWLU 在此基础上加入三个简单机制：(1) Live——按固定频率 F_RAF=2k 步在训练过程中持续从回放缓冲区最近 N_RAH=2k 条样本中随机抽取 N_RASS=64 条并写入RRB，避免任务结束时一次性采样造成的"偏向训练末期"的偏差并提升样本多样性；(2) Updates——每 F_RUF=2k 步用当前网络重新计算RRB中属于当前任务ID样本的Q值（需存储任务标识），避免向过时/不准确的旧目标做正则；(3) No-Wait——一旦有复演样本可用即立刻施加Qreg正则（不等第一个任务结束），以稳定首任务学习并缓解类似 primacy bias 的塌陷。实验设置：统一以DQN为基础算法，Minihack Room（Random/Dark/Monsters/Trap/Ultimate，较硬转移）、PLE Flappy Bird（管道间隙100起每任务减5）、PLE Catcher（落球速度递增）三条5任务序列，各训练4个周期共6M步（每任务300K步），10个随机种子；除Perfect Memory（1.5M缓冲）外均使用50K容量的极小回放缓冲区，5%固定epsilon-greedy，无warm-up，任务/周期间不重置权重、缓冲区与优化器（PackNet除外）。基线包括DQN、DDQN、PM、PackNet、EWC、L2、MER。指标：adapted自Powers et al.(2022)的Final Transfer F与Worst Transfer W（按最大回报归一化并放大10倍）及平均回报 grand average，另有消融（Qreg+U / +L / +LU / +NWL）与Q值范数 ‖Q‖₂ 演化分析。
AI.result: 1) Qreg本身在Room序列上表现出"要么成功要么彻底失败"的极端二分与巨大标准误（任务1/3/4回报标准误达±0.11），失败run伴随任务切换时Q值范数剧烈跳变，说明存在类primacy bias的不稳定性；但其最坏迁移（W̄）接近0，说明Q值正则本身具备抑制遗忘的潜力。2) Qreg+NWLU在Room上全面最优：5个任务回报均值0.87–0.94（DQN为0.45–0.70，Qreg为0.53–0.78），F̄在任务1高达1.21，W̄接近0（最低-0.01），且第2个周期即接近最优性能、标准误极小；Flappy上各任务回报（94.5/54.3/32.3/18.0/9.6）均高于DQN、Qreg与PM等基线；Catcher上500/512/496/498/476，几乎无遗忘，并在周期2末的任务5短暂遗忘后迅速恢复。3) 消融结论具区分性：No-Wait是Room上消除高方差、保证首任务学习的关键（去掉后方差重新爆炸）；在Flappy/Catcher中Live+Updates对首任务学习与正迁移更关键，而单独Live或NWL在部分任务上反而不如Qreg与DQN，说明三者需协同。4) Q值范数分析显示：所有变体都使任务切换的Q值过渡更平滑，Live与Updates还能"钳制"每周期内Q值范数区间；Room的困难转移（观察空间变化）比Flappy/Catcher的软转移更易引发不稳定。5) 超参敏感性温和：λ≈1最优，RRB容量从100k降到25k仍能维持性能，F_RUF增大（更新变稀疏）性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 将数据复演引入纯价值函数逼近（DQN）是可行且有效的，但必须配合恰当的复演样本管理框架：Qreg+NWLU（No-Wait正则 + 训练中持续采样 + 定期刷新Q值目标）能在多周期CRL中同时提升学习效率、抑制灾难性遗忘并增强正知识迁移，且方差极低、Q值范数过渡平稳，优于全部常规CRL基线与Qreg本身。作者认为这是把值基数据复演正则推广到CRL的初步一步。局限性：未评测随机任务顺序与"硬转移"（完全不同任务）；Updates依赖任务标签且需较频繁更新（频率需按任务调参）；未涉及actor-critic框架中的价值网络（价值-策略交互更复杂）；仅研究Qreg，未探索RRB的其他用法（如知识蒸馏）。

title: BioFormer: Rethinking Cross-Subject Generalization via Spectral Structural Alignment in Biomedical Time-Series
summary: Cross-subject generalization in biomedical time-series refers to training on data from some subjects and testing on unseen subjects.The key challenge is to suppress subject specific variability in BTS representations.Most existing methods implicitly suppress the variability through model building or subject adversarial learning, but rarely model it explicitly.We introduce spectral drift as a new perspective to characterize subject specific variability.Specifically, BTS signals under the same label often share consistent oscillatory structure, yet exhibit subject-dependent magnitude or phase shifts in specific frequency components, which we interpret as subject-specific variability. Building on this insight, we propose BioFormer.At its core is a Frequency-Band Alignment Module(FBAM) that generates band-wise modulation factors from the spectral distribution and adaptively adjusts amplitude and phase to align spectral structure, thereby mitigating variability.We further pair FBAM with Sample Conditional Layer Normalization, which infers normalization parameters from intrinsic signal statistics rather than subject identity, stabilizing cross-subject representations.Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that BioFormer outperforms 12 baselines, yielding absolute F1-score improvements of 6%.

AI.tldr: BioFormer（南开大学，arXiv 预印本）提出将生物医学时序（BTS）的跨被试泛化问题重新表述为频域结构对齐问题。作者引入“谱漂移（spectral drift）”概念：同标签样本在时域波形上差异巨大，但频谱包络高度一致，被试差异主要表现为特定频带上的幅度缩放与相位旋转。模型核心为频带对齐模块 FBAM（带级谱统计描述子 + 可学习频带 token 交叉注意力，生成幅度/相位调制参数并以残差方式在傅里叶域做带级缩放-旋转），配合样本条件层归一化 SCLN，构成混合谱-时序 Transformer。在 6 个 EEG/ECG 基准（APAVA、ADFTD、PTB、PTB-XL、BCI-2a、BCI-2b）上对比 12 个基线，平均排名最优（1.47），F1 最高提升约 6%，且不依赖任何被试标签或辅助对齐损失。
AI.motivation: 生物医学时序（EEG/ECG）的跨被试泛化是临床部署的核心障碍：训练集与测试集被试不重叠，导致测试性能因两类原因下降——(1) 被试间变异性掩盖了类别相关的生理模式（即使同标签，跨被试逐点差异也很大）；(2) 模型会利用被试特有的捷径过拟合个体 idiosyncrasy。现有两大范式（更强的 Transformer 骨干、通过梯度反转层 GRL 的被试对抗不变性学习）都把被试变异性当作隐式 nuisance 处理，很少显式建模“被试变异性到底是什么”，因而无法控制抑制目标，甚至可能连同标签相关结构一并抹除。作者观察到：判别信息往往由任务相关的振荡频带（EEG 经典节律等）与特征波形结构承载，而非任意特征维度；同标签样本的全局谱包络高度相似，而被试差异主要体现为带级幅度变化与相位漂移（如图 1 中 APAVA 数据 10 Hz 处两被试能量差异明显；附录 A 在 PTB 上显示跨被试变异主要由 ECG 相位不一致主导）。作者据此提出“谱漂移”假设：跨被试变异性可近似为标签条件下的谱变换，主要是幅度缩放与相位旋转，并提出核心问题——能否对这些变换进行对齐，在抑制被试变异性的同时保留任务相关的振荡结构。
AI.method:
问题设定：数据 D={(X_i,y_i,s_i)}，训练/测试被试集合不相交（严格跨被试协议）。

架构（四个阶段）：(1) 金字塔卷积嵌入 PCE——token 嵌入+位置编码后经 stride {2,4,8} 的 Conv-BN-GELU 级联下采样得到 T/2、T/4、T/8 三尺度特征 X_{i,j}∈R^{T_j×D}，并随机施加 Jitter/Scale/Dropout/Identity 之一做正则化；(2) FBAM——沿时间轴做 rFFT，保留 DC 分量（k=0，代表全局基线偏置，仅在重构时加回，避免过拟合被试基线差异），将其余非 DC 频谱划分为 M=6 个频带，每带提取 5 维描述子 s_m=[logμ, logσ, log max, log E, f_peak]，与 M 个可学习频带 token 经线性投影后交叉注意力融合，再由三个独立 MLP 头产生调制参数：w_m（频域动态卷积核，Softmax）、g_m（tanh 增益）、β_m（tanh 相位偏移）。幅度采用残差更新 A'_m = A_m + g_m(A_m * w_m − A_m)；相位采用单位复数旋转 P'_m = P_m ⊙ e^{jβ_m} 归一化后重组合，逆 FFT 回时域。理论上幅相调制等价于每个 {cos,sin} 二维傅里叶子空间中的精确“缩放+旋转”，并可证明存在对齐到模板谱的调制（附录 E）；(3) 6 层混合 Transformer 编码器，每层交替 FBAM 与时间自注意力，三分支输出拼接；(4) SCLN——对 h 先做标准 LN，再由 stopgrad(Mean_t(h)) 经轻量 MLP 生成样本自适应 γ、β，以残差混合 h_out=(1−α)LN(h)+α(γ⊙LN(h)+β)，避免过强对齐抹掉样本多样性与平凡解。

关键设计：FBAM 不使用任何显式被试方差目标或被试身份监督，仅靠任务标签监督在带级调制中隐式抑制谱漂移；采用残差而非覆盖式更新以保持稳定性。实现细节：6 层编码器、D=128、D_ff=256、Adam lr=1e-4、最多 100 epoch、验证 F1 连续 10 轮不升早停、5 个随机种子（41–45）；多类任务用 batch-shared 带级分组卷积、二分类用 sample-specific；PTB 因相位不一致主导而仅用相位对齐，其余数据集幅相联合；SCLN 除 PTB-XL 外全部启用（α=0.1/0.1/0.2/0.1/0.1）。对照模块 TSAM 为 FBAM 的纯时域孪生版，用于受控对比。
AI.result:
主结果（跨被试，6 数据集×6 指标，Avg. Rank 1.47 为最优，Win=4）：APAVA Acc/F1 82.31/79.77、AUROC 88.52（对比最强基线 SoftShape 81.22/78.71/82.24）；ADFTD 56.73/53.82/74.74（F1 较 SoftShape 48.91 提升约 5%）；PTB 87.73/84.71/94.71（F1 较 SoftShape 78.42 提升约 6%）；BCI-2a 46.68/46.35/72.49（最佳，显著高于基线）；PTB-XL 73.37/62.56/90.37（F1 略低于 SoftShape 62.97）；BCI-2b 72.83/72.81/80.38（F1 略低于 PatchTST 73.17）。

与 DG 方法对比（Table 3，3 骨干 × 3 数据集 × 2 指标共 16 设置）：FBAM 的正增益率 81.2%（次优方法不足一半），最差退化仅 −0.29%；而 GRL/MMD/CORAL/SubjectNorm/MixStyle/DSU 正增益率仅 18.8%–43.8%，最差退化达 −27.51%。FBAM 相比 GRL 在 APAVA+Medformer 上 F1 高出 10% 以上。与 BTS 专用 DG 方法 DMMR 相比全数据集领先（如 APAVA F1 79.77 vs 63.45、PTB 84.71 vs 68.31）。

频域 vs 时域：FBAM 相对 TSAM 在 APAVA/ADFTD/PTB-XL 上 F1 绝对提升 3.29%/4.68%/2.04%，Welch t 检验 p<0.02。对齐分析：自提出 FBD（频带可分性 = 类间谱功率差 / 类内跨被试谱功率标准差），BioFormer 在 0–20 Hz 频段 FBD 达 2.87，远高于 SoftShape 的 1.10，且 >1 的频带覆盖最广。主体可分性：APAVA 上 Subject F1 降至 89.65（NMI 0.2787、AMI 0.2585，显著低于 SoftShape 与 GRL），PTB 上 AMI 最低（0.2260）；t-SNE 显示按标签成簇、被试混合；轮廓分析显示 APAVA 上 Label 轮廓最高（0.3035）、Subject 轮廓最低（0.2904）。

消融：移除 FBAM 在 APAVA/ADFTD 上 F1 掉 8% 以上；移除 SCLN 在 APAVA/ADFTD/PTB 继续下降；幅相联合调制整体最稳（纯幅在 APAVA 更优、纯相在 PTB 更优，符合 PTB 相位主导的观察）；FBAM 内部消融表明残差幅度校正（去掉则全面退化）、输入条件化的动态带调制（静态带参数在 ADFTD 明显变差）、以及带 token 交叉注意力（自注意力更差）均为关键；均匀频带划分已足够，DC 学习增益有限但对 PTB 明显有益；频带描述子以 5 维组合整体最佳。复杂度：BioFormer 1.36M 参数、0.21G FLOPs，F1 优于参数量大得多的 Medformer（7.41M/0.57G）与 Crossformer（5.23M）。被试依赖协议下 BioFormer 仍具竞争力（APAVA Avg. Rank 2.00，PTB-XL 3.00），未牺牲易场景性能。
AI.conclusion:
论文的核心贡献在于把跨被试泛化从“隐式不变性学习”重写为“显式的频域结构对齐”问题，并给出可解释的机制：被试特异性变异可视为标签条件下的带级谱漂移，幅相调制在每个 {cos,sin} 傅里叶子空间中精确等价于缩放+旋转，因而可被显式、可解释地对齐。方法层面，FBAM 以带级谱统计 + 可学习 token 交叉注意力生成调制参数，用残差更新保证稳定，且完全无需被试标签或辅助对齐损失；SCLN 则以样本条件的残差归一化防止过度对齐导致同标签样本过度同质化。实证层面，六个基准上平均排名第一、F1 最高提升约 6%，并在正增益率、最差退化、FBD、主体可分性、效率等多个维度上给出较完整的证据链；附录还从傅里叶子空间对齐的存在性定理与“类内谱收缩可乘性提升 FBD”的推论给出理论支撑。

需要注意的局限与可讨论之处：作者自陈方法依赖任务相关的共享振荡结构，对事件驱动异常检测或不规则临床时序（稀疏瞬态、非周期事件主导标签）等场景收益可能有限；实证上 PTB-XL（多类、样本级 SCLN 关闭）与 BCI-2b 的 F1 略低于最佳基线，说明并非全数据集占优，且若干设计选择按数据集手工设定（PTB 仅相位调制、PTB-XL 关闭 SCLN、α 取值分组卷积策略），存在一定的调参成本与可复现性风险。此外，FBAM 提升很大部分来自训练时的强正则化与频域增广，其相对各基线的“公平性”依赖统一实现，复现实验的一致性仍需第三方验证。后续方向可考虑：将谱漂移假设推广到非周期/瞬态成分，学习数据驱动的频带划分（替代均匀划分），以及把 FBD 作为显式可优化目标而非仅事后分析指标。

title: Lost in Tokenization: Fundamental Trade-offs in Graph Tokenization for Transformers
summary: Transformers have become a central architecture for graph learning, but their application to graphs requires first choosing a tokenization: a graph-to-token map that determines which structural information is exposed at the input. In this work, we show that this choice is a fundamental component of transformer expressivity. We examine three tokenizations that serve as building blocks for many existing graph tokenizations: spectral, random-walk, and adjacency tokenizations. We prove that different tokenizations induce distinct depth regimes: the same graph computation may be realizable by a shallow transformer under one tokenization, while requiring substantially larger depth under another. For example, we prove that random-walk tokenization is lossy for any walk length, making it impossible in general to recover the graph from it, and that while spectral tokenization is lossless, it is ill-conditioned for local tasks. We further show that although both random-walk and spectral tokenizations are derived from adjacency information, it is impossible for a limited-depth transformer to convert between tokenization families in general. In particular, we establish lower bounds and impossibility results showing that unfavorable tokenizations may preclude the efficient recovery of more suitable structural representations. Finally, we complement our theory with controlled experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks, validating the predicted separations and showing that different tasks favor different structural views, and combining complementary tokenizations allows the transformer to leverage distinct signals from each representation.

AI.tldr: This paper reveals that graph tokenization choice fundamentally impacts transformer expressivity. Different tokenization methods (spectral, random-walk, adjacency) lead to distinct computational depth requirements, with random-walk being inherently lossy and spectral being ill-conditioned for local tasks. The authors prove theoretical lower bounds showing that transformers cannot efficiently convert between tokenization families, and demonstrate experimentally that combining complementary tokenizations improves performance.
AI.motivation: The choice of tokenization (graph-to-token map) is a fundamental component of transformer expressivity for graph learning, but its significance has been underexplored.
AI.method: The authors examine three tokenization families (spectral, random-walk, adjacency) through rigorous theoretical analysis, proving lower bounds and impossibility results about their properties and convertibility under limited transformer depth.
AI.result: Different tokenizations induce distinct depth regimes for the same graph computation; random-walk tokenization is lossy for any walk length; spectral tokenization is lossless but ill-conditioned for local tasks; limited-depth transformers cannot convert between tokenization families in general.
AI.conclusion: Combining complementary tokenizations allows transformers to leverage distinct signals from each representation, suggesting that tokenization choice should be task-dependent.

title: Winner-Take-All bottlenecks enforce disentangled symbolic representations in multi-task learning
summary: Winner-take-all (WTA) networks constitute a central circuit motif in cortical networks of the brain. In addition, WTA-like activations are abundant in modern deep learning models in the form of the softmax activation for example in attention layers of transformers. While their role in the extraction of latent factors has been studied for relatively simple generative models, their role in the context of highly non-linearly entangled latent factors has remained elusive. In this article, we show that a WTA bottleneck within a deep neural network can enforce under certain well-defined conditions the extraction of categorical latent factors of the data in a multi-task learning setup. In particular, we prove that the representation that emerges in the WTA bottleneck is highly symbolic, where a single neuron or a population of neurons encodes the presence of a single abstract feature such as a specific object, color, or position. We furthermore show empirically on two datasets, that this also holds for architectures and setups that do not fully comply with the assumptions of our theorem and demonstrate the advantages of the acquired symbolic representation for generalization. Our proposed model provides insights into the generalization capabilities of deep neural networks with WTA-like components and may serve as an interface between symbolic and subsymbolic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：在深度神经网络的"胜者通吃"（WTA）瓶颈层中，在一组明确定义条件下，WTA 机制会强制网络抽取数据的类别型（categorical）潜在因子，使瓶颈层表征呈现高度符号性——单个神经元或一群神经元专门编码某一抽象特征（如特定物体、颜色、位置）；并在两个数据集上实证验证了不严格满足定理假设的架构同样成立，且符号化表征带来更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: WTA 是皮层网络的核心回路结构，在深度学习中也广泛存在（如 Transformer 注意力层的 softmax）。以往工作仅在较简单的生成模型（如低维、弱纠缠的潜变量）中研究 WTA 对潜在因子抽取的作用；当潜因子高度非线性纠缠（non-linearly entangled）时，WTA 表征究竟是有符号的还是分布式/亚符号的仍不清楚。此外，深度网络的泛化能力与可解释的符号表征之间的关系也缺乏理论刻画，因此作者希望明确 WTA 瓶颈与符号-亚符号 AI 接口之间的联系。
AI.method: 方法为理论证明 + 实验验证两部分。理论上：在多任务学习设定下对含 WTA 瓶颈的深度网络建立定理，给出一组充分条件（如任务结构、瓶颈的竞争/稀疏化机制、任务与潜因子之间的对应关系等），证明瓶颈层中会涌现出符号式编码——每个神经元或神经元集群对应单一抽象特征的"存在性"。实验中：在两个数据集上检验该现象，包括那些不完全满足定理假设的架构与训练设置（如更大规模、非理想初始化/正则化等），并比较由此获得的符号表征在分布外/新任务上的泛化表现。
AI.result: 结果表明：(1) 定理成立时，WTA 瓶颈确实实现了类别型潜在因子的抽取，且瓶颈表征是高度符号化的（一神经元/一神经元群编码单一抽象特征）；(2) 即使架构与设定不完全符合定理假设，该符号性在两个数据集的实证实验中依然出现；(3) 利用这种符号表征可显著提升网络的泛化能力。作者据此提出 WTA 组件是深度网络获得符号式表征、并实现良好泛化的关键机制。
AI.conclusion: WTA 瓶颈可作为深度网络中从纠缠数据中抽取类别型潜在因子的"归纳偏置"来源，其涌现表征具有符号性，从而带来泛化优势；该模型为理解含 WTA 类组件（如 softmax/注意力）深度网络的泛化能力提供了理论解释，并有望成为连接符号 AI 与亚符号 AI 的接口与研究框架。

title: Implicit Regularization of Mini-Batch Training in Graph Neural Networks
summary: Mini-batch training of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is fundamentally different from training on i.i.d. data: sampling a subgraph alters the topology and introduces boundary effects, leading prior work to develop structure-aware samplers that preserve local connectivity and reduce embedding variance. Surprisingly, we demonstrate that the simplest possible scheme, Random Node Sampling (RNS), training on the induced subgraph of uniformly sampled nodes, matches or outperforms full-graph training on 8 of 10 datasets at a fraction of the wall-clock time and memory. To explain this, we apply backward error analysis to graph mini-batch Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and show that it implicitly minimizes the sampled loss plus a regularizer proportional to the mini-batch gradient variance, a quantity directly shaped by the sampler. Although RNS discards local structure, it produces mini-batches whose expected loss is closer to the full-graph loss, and whose per-batch gradients have lower variance, yielding a better implicit objective. Our analysis reframes the choice of graph sampler as a form of implicit regularization, and identifies RNS as a strong, theoretically grounded method for scalable GNN training.

AI.tldr: 本文把图小批量训练的采样器选择重新解读为一种"隐式正则化",并用后向误差分析(backward error analysis)证明:在采样子图上做链式 SGD 更新,实际优化的是"采样损失 + 正比于批次梯度方差 R(w) 的正则项"。据此解释了为什么最简单的随机节点采样(RNS)在 10 个基准中的 8 个上匹配或超过全图训练,同时获得 2×–12× 墙钟加速与最多 3× 的显存节省。
AI.motivation: GNN 的小批量训练与 i.i.d. 训练本质不同:采样子图会改变拓扑、引入边界效应,因此以往工作倾向于设计保结构的采样器(邻域采样、ClusterGCN、GraphSAINT)。但已有讨论几乎只关注"子图近似是否能还原全图目标",忽视了链式小批量更新本身带来的优化效应——采样器实际上改变了被优化的学习问题。文中提出的核心问题即:当 GNN 在采样子图上训练时,实际被优化的目标函数是什么?此前 RNS 虽在图 Transformer 与消息传递 GNN 中被用作工程手段,其对优化动态与泛化的影响缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 理论:沿用 Smith et al. (2021) 的后向分析框架与 Barrett & Dherin (2021) 的修正损失构造,把 i.i.d. ERM 的结论推广到 GNN。证明全图 GD 隐式最小化 L̃_full = L_full + (ε/4)‖∇L_full‖²;对任意采样器 Sampl,一个 epoch 内 m 次链式更新(每批次随机顺序)隐式最小化 L̃_Sampl = L̄_Sampl + (ε/4)‖∇L̄_Sampl‖² + R(w),其中 R(w)=(1/m)Σ‖∇L̂^Bk − ∇L̄_Sampl‖² 即批次梯度方差项;结论与采样规则无关,采样器只通过偏置与方差体现。进一步对 RNS 给出偏差上界 |E[ĤL_RNS] − L_full| ≤ C_ℓ·σ(w):节点子采样项条件期望为零(引理1/2 的均匀性),偏差完全由删边敏感度 σ(w) 控制,且 σ(w) ≤ C_f·Ē_L(1 − 1/m),对归一化消息传递 GNN 很小。另证明 RNS 保持幂律度分布尾部:P(D̃=k)=C·q^{α−1}k^{−α}(q=1/m),并实证其与低 R(w) 强相关。实验:5 种采样策略 × 3 个大图(ogbn-arxiv/ogbn-products/pokec)× GraphSAGE,4 种架构(GCN/SAGE/GAT/SGFormer),外加 GraphLand 7 数据集 14 种(数据集,划分)配置;采用分层公平调参协议(固定架构、每种采样配置独立贝叶斯搜索 lr/dropout/wd,50 次),5 个随机种子报告 95% CI;并用"全图 / RNS(no batch,梯度累积) / RNS"三组消融验证两个正则化来源的必要性。
AI.result: 1) 隐式目标分解:全图训练的偏置项与 ∇L̄_Sampl 梯度范数各采样器接近,但每批次损失方差与 R(w) 相差数个数量级,RNS 最低;ClusterGCN 因 METIS 社区聚簇、邻域采样因监督集过小、GraphSAINT 因偏向高阶节点而方差高企。2) 消融(ogbn-products):仅采样偏置(RNS no batch)在 SGD/SGD+M 下劣于全图(70.94/76.84 vs 72.04/78.89),仅链式更新不足以奏效;完整 RNS 达 77.70/82.60/83.15,全面超过全图,说明偏置与 R(w) 两项正则化缺一不可。3) 基准:ogbn-arxiv 72.51%(全图 72.28%)、ogbn-products 83.11%(80.42%)、pokec 83.98%(83.40%),均为各数据集最优且远快于其他采样器;加速 2×–12×,峰值 GPU 显存最多降 3×(如 products 从 62GB 降至 20GB)。4) GraphLand 14 个配置中 12 个匹配或优于全图,高监督(RH)下增益更大;失败于极小致密图 hm-categories、tolokers-2 与正例<1% 的 web-fraud。5) 架构层面:GCN/SAGE/GAT 上 RNS 全面占优;SGFormer 因全局注意力分支被截断而例外。6) 消融显示 m(每 epoch 分块数)是敏感超参,精度变化与子图直径增长相关(arxiv/pokec 上直径随 m 增大,而 products 稳定);RNS 仅需单一超参 m。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是:图采样不应仅视为"近似全图目标"的工程细节,而是一种隐式正则化的设计选择——采样器通过注入的采样偏置与批次梯度方差 R(w) 共同决定实际学习问题;RNS 虽然丢弃局部结构,却因偏差小、梯度方差低、保持幂律度分布而给出更优的隐式目标,可作为可扩展直推式 GNN 训练的默认基线(单一超参 m、2–12× 加速、显存降低)。局限与展望:后向分析仅针对 vanilla SGD,Adam 等自适应优化器的隐式正则化尚无严格刻画(仅实验显示定性成立);m 的选择需调优且对结构极端/高度不平衡任务会退化;全局注意力架构(如 SGFormer)与 RNS 的交互仍待研究;分析目前限于整数不相交划分,若有放回采样或可连续控制子图密度,可能在中等规模下表现更好。

title: When Stronger Triggers Backfire: A High-Dimensional Theory of Backdoor Attacks
summary: Backdoor poisoning attacks behave counter-intuitively in high dimensions: stronger training triggers can help the defender. We study regularised generalised linear models on Gaussian-mixture data in the proportional regime ($p/n \to κ$), varying the training trigger strength $α$ against a fixed test trigger. Three phenomena emerge: (i) clean test accuracy increases with $α$; (ii) attack success peaks at a finite $α$ and then declines; and (iii) the most damaging trigger direction is the minimum eigenvector of the data covariance. We prove all three results in closed form for the squared loss, and extend (i) and (ii) to general convex GLM losses via a Gaussian-proxy fixed-point system. We identify a finite-sample noise floor proportional to $κ$ as the mechanism behind (i), invisible to classical $n \gg p$ analysis. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and Gaussian surrogates match the theory closely; ResNet-18 experiments show the same phenomena beyond the convex setting.

AI.tldr: 在比例渐近（p/n→κ）下研究高斯混合数据上正则化 GLM 的后门投毒。三个反直觉现象被闭式证明：(i) 训练触发强度 α 越大，干净测试准确率越高；(ii) 攻击成功率在有限 α* 处达到峰值后回落；(iii) 最具破坏性的触发方向是数据协方差的最小特征向量。平方损失给出闭式解，一般凸损失用高斯代理不动点系统推广，并以正比于 κ 的有限样本噪声底 ζ 解释了现象 (i)（经典 n≫p 分析中不可见）。CIFAR-10、高斯代理与 ResNet-18 实验与理论高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 后门投毒攻击虽被广泛研究，但缺少能刻画现代高维数据本质的精确理论模型，已有工作多为实证或低维界。实践中测试时触发器强度受物理约束（如贴纸大小）固定，而训练时触发强度 α 是攻击者的自由选择：强触发使投毒样本更易分类（可能降低其影响），弱触发又可能印记不足。作者观察到 ResNet-18 在 CIFAR-10 上出现三个"更强触发反而更弱"的反直觉模式，并追问标准训练中产生这些现象的底层机制，试图从高维统计角度给出可解释、可量化的刻画，直接服务于防御方与审计方。
AI.method: 数据模型：二元高斯混合 x|y ~ N(yμ, C)，投毒将负类样本的一部分 φ 加上触发 αv 并翻标签为正类，吸收标签后 z = yx 服从共享协方差 C 的两分量混合（μ₁=μ，μ₂=αv−μ，权重 1−φ, φ）。假设：假设1（比例渐近 p/n→κ，C 与均值有界，损失严格凸）、假设2（触发方向与 μ 生成的 C 的 Krylov 子空间渐近正交 v^T C^k μ=o(1)）、假设3（损失非负、凸、严格递减且导数有指数/多项式尾部衰减）。分析工具：基于 Loureiro 等人的高斯代理定理（固定点系统 (τ,γ,δ,η₁,η₂)），把高维 ERM 极小点浓缩为随机高斯向量 R⁻¹θ̃ ~ N(η₁μ₁+η₂μ₂, (γ/n)C)；以良性对齐 h_μ(α)=E[μ^Tθ̃] 与触发对齐 h_v(α)=E[v^Tθ̃] 为核心量。技术路线：(1) 平方损失下固定点化归为显式岭型计算，得到 (λI+τC+τS(α))E[θ̃]=τμ̄(α) 与 2×2 Gram 系统，给出 h_μ, h_v 的精确有理式（Prop 9）；(2) 通用触发正交展开得到 h_v(α)=A_vα/(B+Cα²)+o(1)、h_μ(α)=(A_μ⁽⁰⁾+A_μ⁽²⁾α²)/(B+Cα²)+o(1)（Prop 2、Cor 3），特征向量特化给出闭式与峰值位置（Cor 4）；(3) 一般凸损失 ERM：用 η₂ = φE[f(M₂+σξ)] 的尾界、M₂ ≤ Cη₂α² 自洽关系推出 h_v→0 的速率（Prop 6）；(4) 总体风险（信息极限）：用竞争者 θ̂_α = θ_ben + α^{-1/2}v 证明 θ(α)→θ_ben（Prop 7），并用 Stein 引理与 Cone 引理给出一步单调性 μ^T∇L_pop(θ_ben;α)>0（Prop 8）；(5) 将对齐量转化为准确率：Acc_clean=Φ(θ^Tμ/√(θ^TCθ))，方差分解 σ²=β_μa²+β_vb²+ζ，ζ=γtr[R²C²]/n ∝ κ 为有限样本噪声底，解释 (i) 的机制。实验：CIFAR-10 类0/1（d=3072）逻辑回归、匹配一二阶统计量的高斯代理、ResNet-18（25 seeds）、理论与经验岭估计对比、α_test 敏感性扫描、方差分解表。
AI.result: 平方损失：h_v(α) 呈"线性分子/二次分母"有理形式，在 α*²=B/C=（1+τg_μμ）/（τφg_vv(1+τ(1−φ)g_μμ)）处有唯一有限极大点，先增后减；h_μ(α) 领头阶严格单调递增（导数符号为 τ²φ²mq(1+2τ(1−φ)m)>0）；特征向量特化下 h_μ=‖μ‖²[τ(1−2φ)B_v+τ²φ(1−φ)α²]/D_eig(α)，h_v=τφQ_μα/D_eig(α)，峰值 (α*_eig)²=A_μB_v/(τφP_μ)。因 h_v 只通过 g_vv=v^TRv 依赖触发方向且对 g_vv 严格增，故最优触发方向为 C 的最小特征向量（Prop 5），g_vv=1/(λ+τs_min²)（低方差效应：s_v² 越大 h_v 峰值越低、峰值位置越右移）。一般凸损失 ERM：存在有限 α* 使触发对齐最大，且 h_v→0 的速率对多项式尾损失为 O(α^{-ε/(2+ε)})、对指数尾（如 logistic）为 O(log α/α)；α=0 时 h_v=0、α>0 时 h_v>0，保证极大点存在。信息极限：θ(α)→θ_ben（ℓ₂），μ 为 C 特征向量时 μ^Tθ(0)<μ^Tθ_ben，且一步单调性给出 μ^Tθ(α) 从 θ(0) 单调升至 θ_ben；由 v^Tθ_ben=0 得 v^Tθ(α)→0，故总体风险下触发对齐同样在有限 α* 达峰。噪声底机制：CIFAR-10 表 1 显示均值方向信号占 79.9%、触发与交叉项合计 <0.5%（验证假设2）、ζ 占 19.67%（κ≈0.32）；κ→0 时 ζ→0，Acc_clean 退化为与 h_μ 无关的常数，故"干净准确率随 α 上升"只在比例渐近下可见。攻击成功率公式 ASR=Φ((α_test h_v−h_μ)/σ)，因 h_v 有限峰、h_μ 单调，ASR 亦在有限 α 达峰，且 ζ 在比例渐近下进一步抑制峰高。实验：逻辑回归在 CIFAR-10 与高斯代理上均显示干净准确率随 α 单调升、ASR 有限峰、理论与实验高度吻合；ResNet-18 复现同样三现象（含沿协方差特征向量扫描，ASR 随 log 特征值下降而升高）；跨 κ=0.20/0.50/1.05/1.10（含过参数化 κ>1）以及不同 α_test 下形状稳定；投毒比例 φ 的影响为：小 α 时增大 φ 提高 h_v，大 α 时降低 h_v，而 h_μ 在固定 α 下随 φ 递减。
AI.conclusion: 首个针对后门投毒的高维理论刻画：在比例渐近下明确证明"更强训练触发反而帮助防御者"的三个现象，平方损失给出闭式解、一般凸损失经高斯代理不动点系统推广、并识别出正比于 κ 的有限样本噪声底 ζ 作为"干净准确率随 α 上升"的唯一机制，区分了 ERM 比例渐近与信息极限两种图景。作者强调该工作刻画攻击而非提出防御，但对防御与审计有直接价值：攻击存在最优强度区间（有限 α*），可据此设计检测/强度上限策略。局限与展望：分析依赖高斯混合数据模型与线性/GLM 分类器（深度网络仅有实验证据，理论待推广到非凸特征映射）；仅研究二分类、单触发方向、固定测试触发；未考虑多类、非均匀投毒策略，也未给出具体防御方案。

title: Represented Is Not Computed: A Causal Test of Candidate Algorithmic Intermediates in a Transformer
summary: Structured prompts require integrating components according to task-relevant relations. How a network implements this integration is often hard to judge in language or vision, where those relations are rarely specified precisely enough to define a candidate internal algorithm. Arithmetic offers a cleaner setting. We study a Transformer trained on base-digit extraction: given $N$, $B$, and $D$, it must report the coefficient of $B^D$ in the base-$B$ expansion of $N$. The closed-form solution, $\lfloor N/B^D \rfloor \bmod B$, provides explicit candidate algorithmic intermediates. Across three seeds, the model reaches 99.83% exact-answer accuracy on held-out number-base intersections, establishing reliable task competence. Linear probes decode the intermediates, making staged arithmetic computation plausible. Causal tests then separate representation from use: within the localized route from the stream with $D$ as input to the output positions, behavior depends on early $D$-selective communication, independent of $N$ and $B$. Relatedly, a sparse circuit search finds mostly separate $N$, $B$, and $D$ routes that combine late rather than the staged route suggested by the probes. Thus, the model represents the intermediates that make the closed-form solution plausible, but the identified localized causal route does not transmit them to the output stream. This case shows that probe-based conclusions can diverge sharply from causal observations, even when explicit algorithmic hypotheses are available.

title: Understanding Multimodal Failure in Action-Chunking Behavioral Cloning
summary: Behavioral cloning becomes difficult when the same observation admits several valid actions. We study this problem for action-chunking policies and show that different multimodal parameterizations fail in different ways. For latent-variable policies, posterior-prior regularization makes deployment-time sampling more reliable, but excessive regularization removes the action-conditioned information needed to distinguish demonstrated modes. Reducing this regularization can preserve mode information, but then success depends on whether the prior covers the relevant latent regions. For action-space generative policies, multimodality is constrained by the smoothness of the base-to-action transport: a map with small Lipschitz constant cannot assign substantial probability to many well-separated modes. Covering many modes therefore requires either sharp transitions in base space or off-support bridge regions in action space. Experiments on synthetic multimodal tasks and robotic simulation benchmarks support these mechanisms.

AI.tldr: This paper analyzes why different multimodal policy parameterizations fail during behavioral cloning. Latent-variable policies suffer from regularization trade-offs, while action-space generative policies are constrained by transport map smoothness. Covering many behavioral modes requires carefully balancing these factors.
AI.motivation: Behavioral cloning fails when the same observation admits multiple valid actions (multimodal demonstrations), which is common in complex manipulation tasks. Existing approaches struggle with this multimodality in different ways, but the failure mechanisms are not well understood.
AI.method: Analyzed two families of multimodal parameterizations for action-chunking policies: (1) latent-variable policies with posterior-prior regularization, examining how regularization strength affects mode preservation and prior coverage; (2) action-space generative policies, studying how base-to-action transport map properties (particularly Lipschitz constant) constrain multimodality.
AI.result: For latent-variable policies: posterior-prior regularization improves deployment-time sampling reliability but excessive regularization removes action-conditioned mode information; success depends on prior covering relevant latent regions. For action-space generative policies: multimodality is fundamentally constrained by transport map smoothness (small Lipschitz constant cannot assign probability to well-separated modes); covering many modes requires sharp base-space transitions or off-support bridge regions in action space.
AI.conclusion: Different multimodal parameterizations have distinct failure modes that practitioners must understand: latent-variable policies are sensitive to regularization strength and prior coverage, while action-space policies are fundamentally limited by transport map smoothness. These insights guide the design of more robust multimodal imitation learning systems.

title: The Neural Compiler: Program-to-Network Translation for Hybrid Scientific Machine Learning
comment: Use: 21 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Preprint; source code available at https://github.com/sheneman/neural_compiler
summary: Scientific machine learning often requires combining known physics with unknown parameters or correction terms learned from data. Existing approaches either ignore known structure, encode it as a soft penalty, or require hand-written PyTorch code for each equation. We present The Neural Compiler, a system that translates programs written in a first-order Scheme-like expression language into frozen, differentiable PyTorch modules. These modules match the source program to floating-point precision and provide gradients through autograd. In hybrid models, the compiled module encodes known physics exactly while learned components model the unknown remainder. We evaluate the compiler across six experiment domains: Feynman physics equations, Lotka-Volterra dynamics, a damped pendulum, a one-dimensional heat equation, three-dimensional vector mechanics, and compositional generalization. Compiled modules match hand-coded PyTorch implementations numerically for single equations, showing no accuracy loss from compilation. With only 1 to 4 trainable parameters, compiled models recover physical constants to less than 1 percent error in most cases, while standard PINN baselines with more than 8500 parameters show 7 to 93 percent error. Compiled modules also compose with zero error, while neural approximations can accumulate large errors in deep composition chains. The main value of the compiler is not improved accuracy over hand-coded equations, but systematic composability: it generates correct, differentiable modules from symbolic specifications without rewriting each equation by hand. The system supports 51 primitive operations, including vector and matrix algebra, enabling PDE discretizations and hybrid scientific models. This string-in, module-out interface also provides a natural target for large language models that translate scientific descriptions into executable differentiable modules.

AI.tldr: The Neural Compiler 将符号程序自动编译为精确、可微分、可组合的 PyTorch 模块，解决了科学机器学习中已知物理与数据驱动学习的系统性结合问题，仅需少量参数即可高精度恢复物理常数，并为大语言模型驱动的自动化科学建模提供了接口基础设施。
AI.motivation: 现有科学机器学习方法在结合已知物理与数据驱动学习时，要么忽略已知结构，要么仅作为软惩罚，要么需要针对每个方程手写 PyTorch 代码，缺乏一种系统性的、可组合的方式来精确编码已知物理。
AI.method: 将一阶 Scheme 类表达式语言编写的程序编译为冻结的、可微分的 PyTorch 模块；编译模块通过 autograd 提供梯度；在混合模型中，编译模块编码已知物理，数据驱动学习组件建模未知残差部分。
AI.result: 编译模块与手写 PyTorch 实现数值精度一致，组合时零误差传播；1-4 个可训练参数的模型将物理常数误差控制在 1% 以内，而 8500+ 参数的标准 PINN 基线误差达 7-93%；支持 PDE 离散化和三维向量力学。
AI.conclusion: The Neural Compiler 实现了从符号规范到可微分 PyTorch 模块的自动化转换，消除了手写微分代码的需求。在混合物理建模中，仅需 1-4 个可训练参数即可将物理常数恢复至 1% 以内误差，且编译模块可零误差组合。系统支持 51 种基本操作，为大语言模型将科学描述转换为可执行模块提供了自然接口。

title: The Signal in the Noise: OOD Detection Through Goodness-of-Fit Testing in Factorised Latent Spaces
summary: Deep generative models offer a natural foundation for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, yet prior work has shown that their assigned likelihoods are notoriously unreliable indicators for in- vs out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we address this problem by leveraging the diffeomorphic and mass-preserving properties of continuous normalising flows. Our analysis shows that OOD samples are mapped to noise samples that are highly atypical under the noise prior in ways not captured by the likelihood. Based on this observation, we propose a new method -- Signal in the Noise (SITN) -- for OOD detection on the single-sample level. SITN requires no access to OOD data, incurs minimal computational overhead, and provides strict control of false positive rates. Comprehensive evaluations through standard benchmarks and synthetic perturbations highlight the method's effectiveness and the absence of the complexity bias inherent to likelihood-based methods.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses unreliable likelihood-based OOD detection by deep generative models. The authors propose SITN, which exploits properties of continuous normalizing flows to detect OOD samples at the single-sample level without OOD training data, offering computational efficiency and controlled false positive rates.
AI.motivation: Likelihoods assigned by deep generative models are unreliable indicators for distinguishing in-distribution vs out-of-distribution data, limiting their utility for OOD detection.
AI.method: Leverage the diffeomorphic and mass-preserving properties of continuous normalizing flows to analyze how OOD samples map under the noise prior, then compute signal metrics at the noise level.
AI.result: SITN achieves effective single-sample OOD detection without requiring OOD data access, maintains minimal computational overhead, and provides strict false positive rate control.
AI.conclusion: SITN provides an effective OOD detection method that overcomes the complexity bias of likelihood-based approaches, with strong performance across benchmarks and synthetic perturbations.

title: Stabilising Explainability Fragility in Cybersecurity AI: The Impact and Mitigation of Multicollinearity in Public Benchmark Datasets
comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ACM TAISAP
summary: This paper investigates a unexplored yet impactful vulnerability in AI explainability used in intrusion detection (IDS): multicollinearity-induced instability. Despite extensive reliance on post-hoc explainability tools such as SHAP or LIME, the impact of correlated features on explanation robustness is not evaluated. We introduce a formal theorem stating that multicollinearity inflates attribution variance. This demonstrates that explanations and feature importances are non-identifiable under multicollinearity. A suite of comprehensive experiments validates the theorem on a representative benchmark dataset, UNSW-NB15. Four widely used families of models are evaluated, including linear, tree-based, kernel, and neural, across full and pruned feature sets based on VIF and correlation thresholding. We propose the novel metric of Explanability Fragility Score and two novel methods to mitigate it with variable integration complexity. CAA-Filtering focuses on stabilising explanations by grouping attributions of trained models. SHARP is a novel training-time regularisation framework that penalises attribution instability, enabling controllable and monotonic improvement of explainability stability. The findings support stable predictive performance, using Kendall's τ to quantify instability across bootstrapped explanations. This work has direct implications for the trustworthiness and reproducibility of XAI in security-critical contexts, and motivates incorporating multicollinearity mitigations into the IDS pipelines, providing a set of guidelines for practitioners.

title: Generative Modeling by Value-Driven Transport
summary: We propose a new framework for generative modeling based on a discrete-time stochastic control formulation of measure transport. Adapting classic results from control theory, we formulate our problem as a linear program whose dual variables correspond to the \emph{optimal value function} of the control problem, which directly encodes the optimal control policy. Exploiting this LP formulation, we develop an efficient simulation-free primal-dual algorithm for computing approximately optimal value functions and the associated \emph{value-driven transport} (VDT) policies which approximate the true optimal policy. We show that well-trained VDT policies enjoy numerous favorable properties in comparison with other state-of-the-art methods based on flows, diffusions, or Schrödinger bridges: they lead to straight transport paths which can be simulated quickly and robustly, and can be enhanced in all the same ways as diffusion and flow-based models (e.g., conditional generation, classifier-free guidance, unpaired data-to-data translation are all easy to incorporate). We evaluate our methodology in a range of experiments, with results that indicate strong performance and good potential for scalability.

AI.motivation: 将生成建模中的测量传输问题与控制理论建立联系，利用控制理论的经典结果为传输问题提供新的理论框架和计算方法。
AI.method: 将传输问题表述为线性规划，其对偶变量对应于控制问题的最优价值函数；开发了高效的无模拟原生-对偶算法来计算近似最优价值函数和VDT策略。
AI.result: VDT策略具有直线路径、可快速鲁棒模拟、易于条件生成和无分类器引导等增强功能。

title: MoSA: Motion-constrained Stress Adaptation for Mitigating Real-to-Sim Gap in Continuum Dynamics via Learning Residual Anisotropy
summary: Learning real-world dynamics from visual observations is crucial for various domains. A common strategy is to calibrate simulators by estimating physical parameters, yet accuracy is ultimately bounded by the underlying physical models, which often assume materials are homogeneous and isotropic. Even if reasonable, real-world objects typically exhibit mild anisotropy and heterogeneity. After the near-isotropic backbone is well calibrated, these residual effects become the key bottleneck for further closing the real-to-sim gap. Although neural networks can fit dynamics end-to-end, such black-box modeling discards strong physical priors, leading to poor data efficiency and overfitting. Therefore, we propose MoSA, a motion-constrained stress adaptation framework that targets these residual effects to further improve real-to-sim dynamics learning. MoSA uses an isotropic model as a physics prior and learns residual stress operators to capture mild anisotropy and heterogeneity. It progressively adapts stresses via microplane-constrained redistribution in a physics-informed cascaded network. We further impose motion constraints by supervising temporal and spatial derivatives of the deformation field. Experimentally, our learned dynamics achieves superior accuracy, generalization, and robustness, while learning physically meaningful residual anisotropy. Finally, we validate MoSA in a robot manipulation setting, showing that better real-to-sim dynamics modeling translates into more reliable sim-to-real transfer. Project Page is available at https://mercerai.github.io/MoSA/.

title: Disentanglement Beyond Generative Models with Riemannian ICA
summary: There is a gap between the theoretical foundations of disentanglement and the practice of modern representation learning. Existing theoretical frameworks, particularly Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and its nonlinear variants, assume a generative model with statistically independent latent variables underlying the data so that disentanglement amounts to identifying the latents that could have generated the data. This generative framework is interpretable and theoretically justified, but its strong assumptions make it difficult to apply to modern representation learning. Modern pretrained encoders often learn features that exhibit disentangled properties without making generative assumptions, yet there is no general theory for interpreting these features as independent factors of variation. We take a step toward such a theory by introducing Riemannian ICA (RICA), which replaces ICA's global generative model with local geometric structure. RICA is founded on the observation that in ICA, the factors of variation underlying a data point can be understood through radial curves emanating from the point that map to axis-aligned lines in the latent space. We formalize this perspective using Riemannian geometry and introduce our theory in a way that is consistent with the existing generative approach. Our main contribution is the disentanglement tensor, which encodes a second-order notion of disentanglement that we call pointwise disentanglement. This tensor depends on the Hessian of the data log likelihood as well as the Ricci curvature induced by the model. In a controlled source recovery setting with known ground-truth sources, RICA recovers sources across several manifolds, while the success of ICA baselines depends on the coordinates used to represent the observations. Our work provides a theoretical basis for studying local disentanglement without assuming a global generative model.

title: Relational Linear Properties in Language Models: An Empirical Investigation
summary: Linear properties are ubiquitous in the representations of language models; however, testing them experimentally remains a challenging task. This work focuses on relational linearity: the hypothesis that, for a fixed relation (e.g., "plays"), the unembedding of an object (e.g., "trumpet") can be predicted from the embedding of its subject (e.g.,"Miles Davis") by a linear map. We present an experimental method to test the formulation of relational linearity by Marconato et al. (2025). Specifically, we introduce a probing method, based on Kullback-Leibler divergence, to evaluate this property and examine its variation across layers and paraphrased relational queries. It is also more efficient than previous work; for example, it avoids the crude Jacobian approximations used in Linear Relational Embeddings by Hernandez et al. (2024). Our findings across four datasets show that relational linearity varies across models, exhibits layer-wise patterns consistent with prior observations about linguistic information in model representations, and is differently affected by changes in how the relation is phrased.
